dbe skrun gsal bshad/'dzam gling yang steng du chags pa'i rang re'i bod mi rigs 'di nyid la lo rgyus ring zhing mi rigs kyi thun min gyi khyad chos ldan pa'i rig gnas gzhan dring mi 'jog pa zhig yod gshis/ deng cadza tshog r+sā tsho sbyonge /no 'tshotho 95 95 sa ma 95 sde:/r+sā༅tho tshog 'tsho 95 khyejo/sang 'a ma glang du bad ga pa sa bad kya srad 'khyar rag gsum ga bar gyur pa' bad spya gas kyi khyab khongs so sor zhib lajug bgyi ba'i rig lam gsar ba 'di gsar dar byung ste/ rgyal khab dang sa khul mang po zhig gis zhib 'jug las khungs ched btsugs kyis do snang chen po byas dang byed bzhin yod pa spyi dang / sgos su rang rgyal du nye ba'i lo 'ga' nas bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug gi las ka dbyar mtsho bzhin du rgyas pa'i dgos mkho'i ched dang / lhag par rgyal nang du spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi dpal yon gsum 'dzugs spel gyi rba rlabs 'phyur bzhin yod pa'ang mi'i shes rig la rag las stabs/ mi rigs so so'i rtsa ba'i rig gnas phul byung rnams nyams pa sor chud dang ma nyams gong 'phel gtong ba'i dgos mkho bcas la dmigs te/ 'di ga dpe skrun khang gis rgyal khab rim pa'i tshan rig zhib lajug gi rnam grangs gtso gras su tshud pa'i bod yig gi 〈bka' 'gyur 〉 dang 〈bstan 'gyur 〉 dpe bsdur ma par skrun 'grem spel byas dang byed mur yod pa ma zad/ da dung bod kyi mkhas dbang snga rabs pa dag gis mdzad pa'i gsung 'bum thams cad legs sgrig bya rgyu'i 'char gzhi ltar/ bod yig gi gna' dpe'i dpe dkon dpe tshogs du ma par du bskrun dang skrun bzhin yod la/ da lam rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan ras dgyes pa'i dga' ston du 'bul bya ni 〈rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum 〉 zhes pa ste/ 'di ni dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i skabs su byon pa'i tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i gsung chos rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs (pod 1 28yod pa )pa yin la/ yongs grags su rgyal dbang lnga pa zhes pa khong ni tā la'i bla ma sku phreng thams cad pas brtsams chos ches mang zhing / bed kyi chos srid rig gnas thad la mdzad pa ta cang rgya chen po sanang yod pa'i thun min skyes mchog cig yin/

bgrang bya gnyis kyi sngon du 'di ga dpe skrun khang nas ser gtsug dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang dang zhib gros byas mthar srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang / bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog 〈gangs can khyad nor 〉zhes pa'i dpe tshogs chen po mnyam 'brel gyis par skrun zhu rgyu'i gros mthun byung ba las/ gsung 'bum 'di nyid par du bskrun pa ni mnyam las kyi grub 'bras thog ma yin zhing / mu mthud las gzhi rgya bskyed yong ba'i ming gzhi yang tshugs pa yin/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi ma phyi bsdu rub dang / glog klad du 'jug pa/ zhu dag bcas ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas mdzad cing / sgrig rim dang dpe sgrigazhu dag skabs kyi gsal bshad zhu dgos pa rnams bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du bkod yod pa ltar lags pas bskyar zlos gsal bshad byas med/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi nang du/ lo rgyus rnam thar skor dang / gsan yig 'don chog sgrub thabs/ dbu phar 'dul mdzod sogs kyi 'grel bshad/ rten bzhugs dkar chag rtsis dkar nagagasol mchod/ chab shog bca' yig rdzogs chen khrid skor/ snyan ngag gi 'grel pa sogs nang don sna mang phun sum tshogs pa yod pas/ skabs de'i bod sa gnas kyi lo rgyus dang / mdo sngags rig gnas kyi skor la slob gnyer dang zhib 'jug byed mkhan rnams la rin thang gzhal du med pa'i dpyad gzhi'i nor sgrom zhig red/ 'di ltar dpe sgrig gi las ga'i brgyud rim cha tshang ba byas te par du bton mod/ nga tsho'i shes yon gyi chu tshad zhan pa dang mi sna nyung zhing las ka mang drag pas zhu dag dang dpe sgrig thad la chad lhag nor 'phyug yod nges pas mkhyen ldan rnams kyis legs spel nyes 'gog gi dgongs 'char thad gar stsol gnang mkhyen zhu rgyu dang / rting mar gsung 'bum 'di bzhin legs sgrig byed pa'i bya ba la phyogs gang thad nas rgyab skyor gnang mkhan gzhung sger kun la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhus//spungasa'i bod rig pa dpe lhan khang nas/spyi lo 2009lo'i zla 8par/2

gleng gzhi/rab dkar gangs ri'i phreng bas yongs su bskor zhing 'dzam gling go la chen po'i spyi gtsug tu chags pa'i mtho sgang bod ces grags pa'i sa yi thig ler/ pha sprel rgan dang / ma brag srin gnyis nas mched pa'i bod mi'i thog ma byung ba nas bzung / skye bo kun gyis rang rang gi rnam dpyod 'dra min gyi rtsal la brten nas rig pa'i gnas ci rigs gsar gtod dang / 'phel rgyas btang zhing gtong mus mchis/ lhag par dus rabs bdun pa'i skabs su sa gsum na snyan pa'i grags pa yongasasu khyab pa'i chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po zhes bya ba'i skyes mchog gang gi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i byed las nyag gcig gi mthu las/ bod kyi sa chen po'i khyon kun la khyab par nus shing / 'jig rten dang /'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos kyi gnas lugs mtha' dag ji bzhin ston par nus pa/ ches ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i bod kyi yi ge 'di bzhin thog mar srol gtod mdzad la/ skye rgu'i phan bde'i gzhi rtsa nang chos bod du bsgyur mgo brtsams pa dang / dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyis bsam yas su sad mi bdun gyis thog drangs rab byung gi sde dang / sgra bsgyur slob grwa thog mar btsugs nas blo rig bkra ba'i lo tsā ba du ma gso skyong gnang ste/ nye 'brel rgyal khab khag nas nang rig pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs gzhung snying bcud sna tshogs ljongs 'dir dar spel mdzad de/ shes rig mdzod brgya'i sgo 'phar yangs por phyes pa nas bzung / dus rabs rim pa'i nang yul khams 'dir 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la mnga' brnyes pa'i mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi skyes chen dam pa ji snyed byon pa rnams kyis snga phyir bod yig tu bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa dang / gsar rtsom mdzad pa'i bstan bcos thams cad 'u cag lta bus tshe gang ngal ba bsten nas bgrangs kyang bgrang bar dka' bas/ bod yul gyi gsung rab glegs bam thams cad gzhi gcig tu brtsigs na ri rgyal lhun po'i dpangs la'ang skyengs pa ster nus so zhes smras kyang 'ud du mi che/ de lta bu'i rtsa che'i rigs gzhung 1

rmongs pa'i nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman mchog bdud rtsi lta bu de dag gi ro bcud gangs can pa'i lus sems su shog bu snum tshos bzhin du sims pa nas bzung / skye bo phal pa dag gi blang dor 'byed pa'i shes rab kyi tshad kyang ches mthon por son te sgo gsum dge bcu'i las la brtson pa dang / byams dang snying rjes rgyud dul zhing / ya rabs dang gshis bzang gi mdzes sdug rang chas su ldan pa'i mi rigs khyad 'phags can zhig tu yar rgyas byung ba'i 'bras bur/ deng gi dus su'ang 'dzam gling yongs su gnas pa'i srid 'byor rig gsum spyi dang / yang sgos tshan rig rtser son gyi yul gru dag gi mi sna grags can rnams kyang yul 'di dang 'di nyid kyi rig gnas la blo kha phyogs sa dang / zhib 'jug bya yul zhig tu gyur don yang de'i phyir lags/'on kyang sems can spyi mthun gyi bsod nams nyams dmas su song ba'i nyer len las/ lo bcu'i god chags kyi khrod du stong gsum nor gyis bkang ste yon du phul na yang blu thabs bral ba'i gangs ljongs kyi khyad noX te/ gsung rab par shing dang bcas pa phal mo che me lha dang chu lha'i zhal du phul zin dag ni bskyar gso bya rgyu'i nus mthu rang cag su la'ang med la/ dus ngan de lta bu'i khrod nas sdes dbang gis da lta sa steng du lhag lus gsung rab dag kyang phal che ba dpe rgyun dkon rigs sha stag tu gyur stabs deng skabs rig gnas dngos rdzas kyi lam lugs gzhir bzung bdag srung byed dgos rkyen/ rigs gzhung don gnyer ba'i spyan lam du bstar ma thub pas gsung rab kyi dgos pa ji bzhin ma grub cing / de bas nyen tshabs che ba ni 'byung bzhi sogs kyi gnod pas sa steng du rtsa brlag mi gtong ba'i nges pa med gshis/ 'di kun bdag srung gnad 'khel bya rgyu de gzhan la 'gel thabs med pa'i rang cag kho na'i 'gan 'khri nyid du nges so/ /der brten se ra theg chen gling dang lha ldan gtsug lag khang mnyam 'brel gyis ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang zhes pa'i tshan pa zhig ched du btsugs nas da bar bgrang bya gsum lhag cam gyi ring la phyogs gnyis nas thun mong du ma thebs sgor sa ya gsum lhag 2

tsam btang ste dpe dkon myur skyob dang / deng skabs slob gnyer ba'i nyer mkho'i ched du gangs can khyad nor zhes pa'i dpe tshogs gsar du bsgrigs te da phan pod phreng nyis brgyar nye ba par skrun zin pa dang / dgon sde dang / spyi tshogs kyi dpe mdzod khang brgya la nye bar cha tshang gnyis re rin med 'bul lam zhus pa phud/ de byings ma gnas tsam gyi thog nas spus 'tshong zhus te/ rgyal bstan la sri zhu dang ris med ser skya thos bsam can rnams kyi thugs 'dun skong thabs zhu mus su mchis/'das pa'i lo zla'i nang nga tsho'i las gzhi la gong rim 'brel yod tshan pa khag gi dbu khrid nas gzigs skyong bla na med pa gnang ba dang / mkhyen dpyod mkha' ltar yangs shing / lhag bsam dung ltar dkar ba'i skyes chen du mas nga tsho'i las dar gdeng 'jog tshad med dang / ma nor lam ston/ ma dpe mkho 'don gnang ba sogs kyis mtshon/ nga tshor phyar ba gru 'degs kyis lhad med rgyab skyor rogs ram gnang bar rjes su yi rangs dang / snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhes zhu ba dang chabs ciga'abyung 'gyur yang ser gtsug nas dge lugs gsung 'bum gtso bor gyur pa'i ris med gsung rab dpe rgyun dkon rigs dang / zhib 'jug tshan pa khag dang / slob grwa khag la nye bar mkho ba'i rig gzhung dag kyang rim pas par skrun zhu rgyu'i 'dun pa snying bcangs su yod pa lags na/ lhag bsam rngam dpyod can gyi ris med ser skya kun nas ma dpe mkho 'don dang / nga tsho'i las gar ca che'i lam/ ston bka' slob mu mthud lhug stsol yod pa mkhyen zhes zhu'o/ /ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bas phyogs:ga khang nas/spyi lo 2009lo'i zla ba6pa'i tshes7 pa/

bsdusgrig gsal bshad/7gong sa lnga pa chen po mchog ni spyir sku tshe hril po chos srid gnyis kyis mtshon sku gsung thugs kyi gsang gsum mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas dus 'da' bar mdzad pa dang/ yang sgos mdzad pa'i mchog gsung gi mdzad pa ste/ dam pa gang gis rjes 'jug skal ldan rnams kyi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du bzhag pa'i yid bzhin nor bu las kyang lhag pa'i rtsa chen gsung 'bum dag ni/gang nyid sku 'tsho bzhugs skabs nas lha rtse dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du cha tshang par shing du brkos yod rung / rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs rtsa thor du song nas da lta gsung 'bum cha tshang gcig kyang btsal rnyed dka' bar gyur stabs/ snga phyir don gnyer lhag bsam can gyi tshogs pa dang mi sger mi nyung ba zhig la/ phyogs bsgrigs dang dpe skrun zhu 'dun yod kyang / ma dpe btsal 'tshol dang mi sna'i cha rkyen sogs rgyu rkyen sna tshogs la brten nas/ da bar sus kyang dpe skrun ma thub par rim 'gyangs su lus 'dug par brten/'di ga ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas spyi /spo 2005nas bzung snga phyir 'bras spungs dgon dang /pho brang po tā la/bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang sogs rig dngos tshan pa khag dang / de bzhin mi sger sogs nas ma dpe g.yar po zhus pa bzhin 'brel yod khag nas gang ci'i mthun 'gyur gang legs stsal ba brgyud dge lugs gsung 'bum gtso gnad du byas pa'i ris med kyi gsung 'bum pod stong phrag brgal ba zer bris su dpar ba dang / gzhan yang dpe dkon dang nyer mkho'i rigs dpe deb nyis brgyar nye ba nang khul par skrun byas zin pa dang /de'i khongs nas rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po'i gsung 'bum pod nyer lnga dang / sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang gi 'phros pod gsum bcas khyon pod nyer brgyad bzhugs pa/gangs can khyad nor dpe tshogs kyi pod 'phreng 171nas 198bar bsgrigs te rgya che'i gzigs pa 4

po'i spyan lam du phul ba yin/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi ma phyi ni pho brang po tā lar bzhugs pa'i rgyal dbang mchog gi gsung 'bum rmang gzhir bzung thog yi ge mi gsal ba dang dogs gnas can rnams se ra theg chen gling gi rgyal ba'i gzims chung bde ba can du bzhugs pa'i gsung 'bum dang / lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa'i gsung 'bum 'phrul par ma/ de bzhin dwags po mnga' ris grwa tshang gi gsung 'bum 'phrul par ma sogs ma dpe khag bzhi tsam la zhib bsdur zhus pa yin/glegs bam dang chos tshan gyi go rim ni/ deb 1nas4bar pod rtags 3) (kha) rtoganakhong ) ste rgyal dbang mchog gi don gyi rnam thar gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun pod bzhi dang / deb ldanas 7bar pod rtags 6) 'a) (ja) ste thun mong phyi'i rnam thar du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam pod gsum/ deb 8nas 10bar sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang gi 'phros pod gsum ste pod rtags la ( ja spu (ja3) (ja4)bkod yod/ deb 11pa la pod rtags6) storgyal dbang sku 'phreng gsum pa dang bzhi pa/ dpon slob paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan/ mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel/ 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ byang pa ris 'dzin chen po'i rnam thar bcas chos tshan bdun/ deb 12pa la pod rtags (ta)ste zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ nyang ston khra tshang pa/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar bcas chos tshan lnga/ deb 13pa la pod rtags 6)ste bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga zung 'jug sgrub pa'i shing rta sogs chos drug cu re gsum/ deb 14pa la pod rtags9)ste dam can chos srung rgya mtsho'i mngon rtogs mchod 'bul bskang bshags bstod tshogs sogs chos tshan bcu bdun/ deb 15pa la pod rtags 6)ste lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung sogs chos tshan bcu/ deb 16pa la pod rtags(pa)ste phar phyin blo bzang dgongs rgyan gdong lnga'i dbang po'i sgra dbyangs/ deb 17pa la pod rtags (pha)ste 'dul ba'i 5

las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog dang / chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta sogs chos tshan gsum/ deb 18pa la pod rtags (ba)ste bstod tshogs dngos grub rgya mtsho sogs chos tshan bcu gcig deb 19nas 21bar pod rtags (pa) (mi 6 ) sde sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag dang tham phud deb khrims yig 'go rgyangs sde bzhi'i sgo 'phar phye ba'i skal bzang pod gsum/ deb 22pa la pod rtags (dza)ste rgyal rabs deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs sogs chos tshan bzhi/ deb 23pa la pod rtags (wa)ste snyan 'grel dbyangs can dgyes glu sogs chos tshan gsum/ deb 24pa la pod rtags (zha)ste smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis/deb 25pa gsung nang ma (ka)ste bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i las byang khrag 'thung gad rgyangs sogs chos tshan nyer drug deb 26pa gsung nang ma (kha)ste tshe bdag gi /yig char rnam par dpyad pa'i yi ge ri thang mtshams kyi nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman gcig sogs chos tshan zhe gsum/ deb 27pa gsung nang ma rtog)sde rdzogs chen 'khrid yig rig 'dzin zhal lung sogs chos tshan nyer drug deb 28pa gsung nang ma 6)ste le'u bdun pa'i brgyud 'debs sogs chos tshan nga lnga bcas te pho brang po tā la'i gsung 'bum dkar chag gi go rim ltar bsgrigs pa yin/dmigs bsal zhu bya zhig la khong gi gsung las gsang ba rgya can bris ma pod gnyis bzhugs pa ta cang bka' gnyan pa dang / gsang ba khyab bsgrags mi rung ba'i bka' srol ltar 'dir yang par skrun zhus med pa thugs nges zhu rgyu ma zad/ ma dpe'i nang du mchod brjod sogs kyi skabs su lañdza mang tsam byung yang da lta glog klad du lañdza 'a yi ge med pas 'jog thub med pa bcas kyang thugs la nges par 'tshal zhu/lhag par du rnam/ dpyod dang ldan pa rnams kyis slad phyin ma phyir dpe sdur ba dang / 'tshol bde ba'i ched ma dpe'i shog grangs dang nyin srib kyi bsdus rtags (2na) (2ba ) 'di'i nang bkod yod/6

zhu dag byed skabs/ thog ma'i zhu dag dang / bskyar zhus/ yang zhus/ zhus chen bcas zhu dag gi rim pa bzhi lhag brgyud cing / tshig phrad dang / lhag bcas/ rgyan sdud gsum gyi phrad dang yig nor mngon gsal can re zung dag bcos byas pa phud/ skabs de'i yi ge'i 'bri srol/ deng skabs dang mi 'dra ba dper na/'bri la 'dri dang / tsong kha pa la btsong kha pa/ mtshams la 'tshams/ mthun la 'thun/mtsho la 'tsho/ rmad la smad/ byung la 'byung / rang rkya la rang skya/ grwa la ga klong la slong / rig 'dzin la rigs 'dzin/ rig gnas la rigs gnas/ rigs pa la rig pa/ gcod la spyod/ rdzong brda la rdzong sta/ rdzong bda' sogs kyang ma dpe sor bzhag byas yod/spyir na tshig don gnyis thad nas zhus dag pher nges su rloms kyang / nged rnams rtsom sgrig gi bya bar las dang po ba yin pa dang / shes rig nor gyis dbul bas phyogs gang thad nas mi ldeng ba'i cha sogs skyon dang nor 'khrul mi nyung ba zhig 'byung nges pas rgya che'i mkhyen ldan rnam pas thad gar ram/yig thog zhal par bcas gang rung gi thog nas nyes 'gog legs spel gyi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang rogs zhes dran skul zhu rgyu ma zad/ lhag par nged tsho'i las don thad lhag bsam rnam dag gis rgyab skyor gnang mkhan dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang / pho brang po tā la'i rig dngos do dam khang gis gtsos tshan pa khag dang / mi sger bcas nas gang ci'i thad slob ston dang mthun rkyen gyi rgyab skyor tshad med gnang bar snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhes lan brgyar zhu'o/ /ser ba khug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bas phyog sgrig khang nas/bod sa glang lo'i sa ga zla ba'i tshes 15la/7

mdzad pa po'i rnam thar mdor bsdus/ji skad du/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ dus mthar 'jig rten nyams pa na/ /sdom brtson rgyal po'i tshul gyis ni/ /'byung bar 'gyur ba the tshom med/ /dper na ma khol zhes bya dang / /me tog ces byar rnam par grags/ /zhes dang / gzhan yang bka' gdams glegs bam/ rat+na'i spyi lung / rdo rje gling pa'i gter lung / bka' thang sde lnga sogs bka' gter mang po nas 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul par lan cig min par gsungs pa'i rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po mtshan yongs rdzogs la thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde'am/byis pa'i mtshan bdud 'dul rdo rje dang / snyan ngag gi mtshan tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ gsang mtshan sngags smyon zil gnon ba 'ad pa rtsal dang / za hor gyi sngags mkhan che mchog 'dus pa rtsal/rnal 'byor pa gang shar rang grol/ de bzhin 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen nam za hor gyi ban+de zhes yongs su grags pa ste/ gang gi sprul gzhi 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi che ba'i yon tan dang / sprul brgyud na rim gyi rnam par byon tshul sogs ni sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa'i 'phros bzhi pa sogs chos 'byung lo rgyus deb ther khag las shes par bya zhing / rigs ni dpal ldan zhi ba 'tsho dang / jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha sku 'brungs pa'i rgyud za hor gyi rigs las chad pa/ dpal phag mo gru pa'i blon po'i gdung rgyud du yab bdud 'dul rab brtan dang / yum kun dga' lha mdzes gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i me sprul te spyi lo 1617lor lho kha 'phyongs rgyas 'phying dbar stag rtser sku 'byungs shing / sku na chung ngu'i dus nas dam pa'i rang mdangs lhag par gsal zhing byis pa phal pa'i spyod tshul las 'das pa'i khyad yon mnga'/ dgung lo gsum thog dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang /gling smad zhabs drung khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gnyis nas rwa sgreng gi jo bo 'jam dpal rdo rje 8

dang / lha sa'i jo bo shākya mu ne'i sku drung du zan ril brtag pa mdzad pa dang / chos skyong khag gi bka' lung rnams gcig mthun byung ba ltar paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan dang / chos rje sbyin pa dar rgyas sogs nas gtsang pa rgyal por snyan zhus bka' 'khrol bzhin rgyal ba sku 'phreng bzhi pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin zhus te mi ring bar dga' ldan pho brang du gdan drangs/ dgung lo dgu par paṇa chen rin po ches mkhan po dang / khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis las slob mdzad de dge tshul gyi bslab sdom bzhes te ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde zhes mtshan gsol ba dang / de nas rim bzhin khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ zha lu mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ nyang ston khra tshang pa chen po blo mchog rgya mtsho/ smon 'gro 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje sogs la bsam sbyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin du bsten nas gzhung chen bka' pod lnga dang / gsang sngags gsar rnying gi chos skor/ sgra snyan sman rtsis dang bcas pa rig gnas skor yongs su rdzogs pa la gsan bsam mthar phyin pa mdzad/ de nas dgung lo nyer gnyis pa sa pho stag gi lor lha ldan jo shāka yid bzhin nor bu'i drung du dpon slob paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyis mkhan po dang gsang ston/ khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis las slob/ byes pa rtsed thang pa byams pa smon lam gyis grib tshod pa mdzad de dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ dgung lo nyer drug par dga' ldan pho brang gi srid dbang yongs rdzogs bzhes te thog ma'i sde srid du phyag mdzod bsod nams chos 'phel bsko gzhag mdzad/dgung lo nyer dgu par pho brang po tā la'i pho brang rnying pa rgya bskyed thog pho brang dkar po gsar bzhengasamadzad cing / pho brang dkar po grub rjes dga' ldan pho brang gi chos srid kyi byed sgo gal chen khag der spel ba gnang / dgung lo so gsum pa 'a gso rig 'gro phan gling gsar du btsugs/ dgung lo sodrug thog gong ma shun tsis gdan zhug ltar pe cin du phebs/ dgung lo nga bzhi'i thog ra sa dang bsam 9

yas kyi gtsug lag khang bcas la nyams gso gnang ba/ gzhan yang rje 'dis dgon sde gsar 'debs mdzad pa dang / dgon sde khag tu lha khang dang rten mchod gsar bzhengs/ chos gnyis mchod rgyun sbyor 'jags mjad pa/ ris med gsung rab pod khrir nye bar dkar chag gsar bsgrigs/bsgrub bya khri phrag mang por dge tshul slong gi sdom pa bstsal ba dang / de bzhin dpe rgyun dkon rigs par 'debs byed rgyu khyab brdal gtong ched/ 'bras spungs dga' ldan pho brang gi par khang dang / pho brang po tā la'i ltag sgo'i rgyab kyi par khang bcas gsar du 'dzugs gnang mdzad pa sogs chos srid kyi mdzad pa spyi dang / lhag par rgyal dbang mchog gi don gyi rnam thar gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun/ phyi'i rnam thar du kū la'i gos bzang gis gtsos pa'i rnam thar/ gzhung chen khag gi 'grel pa dbu ma la theg chen rgya mtshor la jug pa'i gru rdzings dang / mdzod la chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta/ 'dul bar las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog rgyal rabs la deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhen nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ smin byed kyi 'khrid yig rnam gnyis te lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung dang / rdzogs chen 'khrid yig rig 'dzin zhal lung / de bzhin rtsis skar nag tshe bdag dris lan/dkar chag zhal gdams/ snyan mgur/ snyan dar zhal yig chab shog brtan bzhugs/ lam yigabasko 'ja'/ grwa tshang 'don cha/ dam can chos srung gi sgrub skor/ bsnyen yig sogs pod nyer lnga dang /gsang ba'i gras rtsa gsum lha dang mngon sum mjal zhing bgros pa la sogs pa'i rgya can nyer bzhi'i bu yig bka' rtsom gras pod gnyis bcas/ legs par bshad pa pod nyi shu rtsa bdun brtsams par gnang ste bstan 'gro'i phan bde rgya cher spel gnang mdzad nas mthar dgung grangs re drug ste rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu khyi ste 1682lor dgongs pa gzhan don du gshegs pa bcas dam pa gang gi rnam par thar pa mdor mtshon tsam du bkod pa las zhib phra rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang sogs mdzad rnam g.yin mang du bzhugs pa las mkhyen par zhu'o/ /ser gtsug nang spra na dpe rnying 'tsho lhab phyogs ga khang nas//(/

dkar chagasku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag dang tham phud deb khrims yig 'go rgyangs sde bzhi'i sgo 'phar phye ba'i skal bzang gi glegs bam ga sdo/ma pa/ (1)don grub ces pa sa lug hor zla drug pa nas bzung sde pa sangs rgyas rgya mtsho la sa ri sogs kyi tham ga rim song gi brjed byang deb ther 'go brjod rin chen phreng ba sogs/ (3)lcags pho spre'u'i lo hor sog gi rgyal rigs dpon khag tshor drag zhan dang bstun pa'i bdag rkyen gyi deb ther dpyad gsum gyis dag par gtan la phab pa mu thi la'i 'khri shing / (35)rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling gi rgyun gyi rnal 'byor dang dus kyi mchod par dgos pa'i bzo rgyan tshad dang dgos cha gtan 'bebs su byas pa'i deb ther dngos grub rgya mtsho sogs/ (82)dpal phag mo gru pa'i pho brang sne'u sdong rtse khul gyi bogs deb gsar bsgrigs phun tshogs nor bu'i 'dod 'jo/ (102)lha sa tshes bcu ba rnams kyis yer pa lha ri snying po'i mchod khang du 'phan sum cu phul ba'i kha byang rigs 'dzin 'jug ngogs sogs/ (108)1

bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems chos srung rnams dang gtsug lag khang sogs rten brten pa la snyan shal 'phan bla bre sogs phul ba'i zhal byang bsod nams ma dros mtsho chen sogs/ (141)sa byi cho 'phrul mchod pa'i dus jo shāka /rang byon lnga ldan byams pa chos 'khor/ rje btsun btsong kha pa/ dung skyong rgyal mo rnams la snyan shal phul ba'i kha yig legs byas rgya mtsho'i rlabs 'phreng sogs/ 5168)lcags byi bod 'bangs bde thabs su dmigs pa'i bsam yas su gser chab brgya mchod phul ba'i dus byang chub chen po'i snyan dar zhal yig phan bde'i skya rengs dang po sogs/ (221)lha sa'i bla ma lha khang gi rje btsun btsong kha pa chen po'i sku brnyan la phul ba'i kha btagasanyin mo bde legs ma'i zhal byang sogs/ (278)lcags khyi se 'bras dge gsum lha ldan bkra shis lhun po rnams kyi rten la dbul ba'i snyan shal kyi tshigs bcad skyid shod sprul sku ngag dbang bstan 'dzin 'phrin las kyi dgos tshul byung ba ltar bris pa phan bde'i shing rta sogs/ (297)

༄༄//sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag dang tham phud deb khrims yig 'go rgyangs sde bzhi'i sgo 'phar phye ba'i skal bzang gi glegs bam gsum pa bzhugs//ba nams ye shes ma dros 'khyil ba nas//sku bzhi'i chu bo 'gro khams gzhin brgyu bas//byang chub gsum gyi rgya mtshor 'phrin las rlabs//yol med zas gtsang sras pos shis pa stsol//mdzesasdug mtshan dpe'i sku yis kun yid brtan//nyer 'phrog mthong na mthun snang grub pa'i zhabs//rtsibs brgyad 'khor na ) lo'i ri mo rnam bkra las//rdul dmar bskyug la mgo bos lan brgyar gtug /thub dbang ljags chen bkram ste tshangs dbyangs rgyud/ /mkhyen brtse sor rtses bskul ba'i rtogs brjod glu//khol chung ut+pal chun po snyigs pa ding //gsar pa'i spel legs phreng ba thod 'ching mtshar//blo gros nya phyis khog nas rnam 'dren gyi//mdzad pa'i mu tig 'byul med tshig sbyor phreng //srad bur brgyu la skal bzang chos kyi mig/rgya mtsho ltar yangs des bskrun grags pa snyan//yon to bye ba'i myu gu bla nas sngar//'phel byed dad pa'i sa bon rgyal rnams kyi//rnam thar 'dri klog rgya cher spel ba yi//cho ga deng dus ku sha'i rtse bzhin phra/ /sna nam bya nag gdung dang rigs kyis btsun//sngags 'chang brtul zhugs grub pa'i nus mthur ldan//gong ma'i lung gis lho rgyud khri skor bdag/nor 'dzin bde bar skyong ba rim byon las//sa spyod rkang ba lko.u nga dbus na yongs 'du yi//'khri shing gnyis pa rgyal po bkra shis zhes//mkhyen yangs zla ba nya gang rnam dpyod kyis//mi zad par gyi kun+da'i 'dab ma phye//thub dbang yon to cha shas ches phra la//nyer dad bsod nams

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)srid 'dir shong dka' na/ /mdzad pa 'khrul med dbyar rnga phyogs bral rnar/ /byang chen rma bya'i mngal khur cis mi sbrum/ /bstan la ri mor yongs bgyid snying stobs kyis/ /nam mkha'i lto ba dbral bar gser mngal can/ /dngangs nas dgu tshigs skud pas nyer 'tsham par/ /blta ba'i ched du gdong bzhi sprul min nam/ /bsod nams zhing dbul 'bru lnga chags pa'i 'bras/ /gling bzhi lha gnas mnga' sgyur spyi bo skye'i/ /dbang thang chung ngur byed nus legs byas kyi/ /ri mo mig gsum pa des ga la dbyi/ /bstan par sri zhu yongs bskrun sngon byon gyi/ /'phags bod rgyal ba'i ngang tshul gangs can ljongs/ /gnyal byar 'dzin mar ding sang gnas so zhes/ /me tog phal cher phyogs der dgod pa bzhin/ /chos dkar smig ma'i tshal du skyed bsrings nas/ /'di phyi'i mdun ma lhun grub gar mkhan steng / /'gyings te thar lam 'chi med ba gam du/ /gzhon nu gdong drug tshul la 'khru nus shog /mi yi dbang phyug btsun mo sras bcas rnams/ /sku tshe rigs rgyud chab srid ngal bsos bu'i/ /grib mar bltos min mngon sum mched zla mā /'gyur ba'i rnam smin dkar por 'dzag par shog /(3na gi to me phod bdog pa tshangs pa'i ral klung nas/ /bsod nams mtho ris chu bos mi bdag gi /sdig sgrib dri 'khrus rtse mor gtan mdun gyi/ /zhabs sen tog gi 'od stong 'bar bar shog /dar rgyas nor bus mtshon pa rig byed mkhan/ /'di'i ched sgo gsum ngal ba bsten no cog /nyi ma'i gnyen gyi spyan ras dkyus ring pos/ /mi gnas myang 'das 'thob min btsa' bar shog /dge ba'i yon to cha rdzogs chu shel dbang / /rtsod ldan brlang spyod 'thibs por shar ba'i mod/ /brgya byin mig stong sprul nas duḥkha'i mun/ /btsal kyang ga re cung zad mi rnyed shog /nam mkhar nyi zla gza' skar 'od zer 'bar/ /gser ldan lto bar bkra shis g.yang du chags/ /mchog gsum lha dang drang srong rigs 'dzin gyi/ /bde tsheg me tog char chen bsnyil bar shog /ces bya ba chos rje skal bzang chos kyi rgya mtshos de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdzad pa 'khrul med bsgrigs par par rnying zhig snang ba deng sang gang du yod cha ma 'tshal bar brten bya nag rigs kyi thig le sa spyod rgyal po bkra shis kyis par gsar brkos kyi rgyu sbyor dang /—2

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 6)ye chos lung dkar po nas dar rgyas dang nor bus gtsos par mkhan bcu bkug ste zhal bkod kyis khyab pa'i tshe par byang zhig rtsoms//ma pa/bya ༷༷dī /༷ ༷/la ba ltar za 'a gyi rig byed pa tshas sras spus pa'i 3bsko rjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan don grub ces pa sa lug hor zla drug pa nas bzung sde pa sangs rgyas rgya mtsho la sa ri sogs kyi tham ga rim song gi brjed byang deb ther 'go brjod rin chen phreng ba//mnyam gzhag sor mos bteg pa'i bum bzang nas//bdud rtsi'i thigs 'phreng tshangs bugs lam brgyud de//srog gi ka ba nyer 'dzugs tshe mtha' yas//zhabs sen zla ba gtsug na rtag 'chang mdzod//dgyes chags spyan gyis dkyus ring zur mda' dang //lhan cig ut+pal dmar po'i zhags pa yis/ /srid zhi'i dngos kun 'ching ba'i sgyu thabs mkhan/ dpal ldan rigs byed dbang mos 4nartag tu skyongs//dpyad bzod tshig don yi ger spel pa'i 'gag/gnam gyi she mong tham kha'i ri mo'i rjes//rgyal po'i lung don zhabrul med 'jal byed pa'i//deb ther rin chen 'phreng bdeng 'dir spel//dzam+bha chu po'i gser gyi ri bo brgya phrag nyi gzhon khu bas byugs kyang cha tsam bsgrun par nus min pa//rtsa gnyis mtshan dang brgyad bcu'i dpe byad ston gyi mkha' la rgyu skar ltar bkra kun yid brtan 'phrog gzugs kyi sku//4brko sgo par mdzad des ris med 'gro rnams mthong thos dran dang reg pas rnam grol rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi'i seng ge/bkra shis 'khor lo'i ri mo gsal mdzes zhabs kyi rdul dmar lus can tshogs kyi gtsug na lhung ba'i dge legs stsol//skye ba lnga pa'i dung gi ri mo mgrin par yongs 'khyil rab yangs yi waṃ khog pa nas//yan lag drug cu'i rgyud mangs las drangs lung gi sde snod dbyangs su 'tsher ba snying po'i bcud//'gog lam bden gnyis zhi ba'i grong 'jug

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)'khor ba'i pha mtha' ring du brgal nus dam pa'i chos/ /yid can yongs kyi phan bde'i srog song gtan gyi skyabs gcig dngos po kun gyi btud phyag 'tshal/ /de 'dzin spel dang bka' bsdu'i byed por rgyal ba'i rnam par 'phrul po che/ /ma pham rigs (na sko sum dgra bcom la sogs mchogo dman theg pa'i dge 'dun rnams/ /gcig pu nyid las du ma'i gar bsgyur gtso 'khor tha mi dad pa yis/ /dbang rnon chos rjes 'brang pa'i dad pas byang chub bar du skyabs su 'gro /gser ri'i sbubs nas 'dzad med zla 'char ltar/ grub brnyes brgyad cu rgyan drug mchog gnyis sogs/ /tshad ma'i dpang gyur gaṅgā'i rdul rnyed kyis/ /gzhal dka'i rtogs brjod tshogs la snying nas gus/ /gangs can bsod nams skya rengs mas drangs pa'i/ /'phags chen rnam sprul chos rgyal nyin byed phreng / khrims gnyis pad dkar 'dab brgya yongs ba 'ad las/ /bde skyid sbrang rtsi mngar po ci yang 'dzag /snga phyi'i bstan la 'jig rten mig gcig pu/ /brda sprod smra ba rgyun chad med byon nas/ /bka' dang dgongs 'grel bsgyur ba'i bka' drin de/ /'dzam gling gser gyis gang bas gzhal nus su/ /khyad par sa lo shong dbang kun mkhyen bu/ /thugs rje dpal zhabs stag tshang zhwa lu pas/ /ljongs 'dir rmongs pa'i smag tu lnga rig gi /sngon med nyi ma rnam dpyod dgung nas shar/ /lo paṇa gyis bsgyur bdud rtsi'i thigs/ /rang ngoms gzhan gyi nges legs srog /nyer 'thung rigs bral grub mtha' yi/ /rab 'dzin ngang tshul bzang por dad/ /de lta na'ang log rtog rnyog ma yis/ /bshad sgrub chu klung mog por gyur pa la/ /sgra tshad gas gzhud nor bu ke ta gas/ /bsgrungs par byed rnams gcig tu bstan pa'i gsos/ /'on kyang yid srubs(5ba〉5da' yis snying ga rab phug ste/ /phyogs lhungs drag po'i gdon gyis smra ba'i kha phye nas/ /'thad ldan lugs bzang mang por smod pas rjes 'jug tshogs/ /ngan 'gro'i sa mkhan mkhas rlom de dag mi dge'i bshes/ /'phags yul grub mtha' rnam bzhi'i bzhed pa'i srol dang mdo rgyud chos tshul yin no cog /mtha' yas 'gal med rtogs te gdams par shar bas dgongs don ma lus bde blag tu/ /'jam dpal rdo rjes yongs 'dzin mdzad de legs rnyed shing rta chen po btsong kha pa/ /rjes 'brangs —4

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ tanarnyog ma'i lhad bral bstan 'dzin tshogs la lag pad 'dab stong spyi bor zum/ /nges don snying po'i yang snying 'khor lo bar pa yum sras bcu bdun gyi/ /gtso bor yongs gyur rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum yig gzugs brda dag phun tshogs gang / /legs spel legs byas srid 'di'i snod du ma shong nam mkha' ral dogs nas/ /dgu tshigs srad bus 'tshem pa'i sbyor bas tshangs pa rgan po da gdod brel/ /rin chen ljon shing bzhu jugs gser sbyangs zhun ma'i khu ba yis/ /nyer byug be+eḍūr ser po'i bsnyems 'phrog mi pham mgon po'i sku/ /rab bskrun sa bon byams pa'i 'dus pa dang po'i dus smin te/ /nyon mongs dgra tshogs 'joms la mig gsum pas kyang dgag tu ci/ /bsod nams gnam gyi she mong ka ba gyen bslang rtse/ /gzhan 'phrul gnas su bsnyegs par 'dod lha chung mar bcas/ /rang jus shor snyam lag pas 'gram bteg gdung ba'i mes/ /cher bsregs gzugs phung mya (6na〉na khang bur brgyal ba bzhin/ /de tshe lha mo bstan ma nor 'dzin las/ /lus phyed thon nas dge tshogs bsgrubs pa'i 'bras/ /bla med byang chub ring min thob pa yi/ /dbang por khas len mdzad des gcig tu spro/ /yang yang brgyu bar nyi zla zung / /ngal ngal go la'i lam bgrod na/ /snyan snyan glu dang me tog char/ /mang mang 'bebs la lha rnams brel/ /zhes shis pa brjod pa'i tshig gis sngun bsus te 'o skol gyi ston pa mnyam med bu ram shing pa zhes 'jig rten gsum gyi 'dren pa gcig pu ba de ni snying rje pad+ma dkar po nas bskal ba bzang po 'di la sangs rgyas stong dang lnga/ /gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa sogs las sangs rgyas stong du gsungs pa'i nang tshan yin la/ /sngon byung bskal pa chen po 'dzin pa zhes bya ba la gling bzhir dbang sgyur ba'i rgyal po rtsibs kyi mu khyud la mig mi 'dzum la sogs pa'i sras stong / /rgyal phran brgyad khri bzhi stong sogs yod pa'i mdun na 'don gyi gtso bo bram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul la sras brgyad cu/ /slob ma bram ze stong dang bcas pa mnga' ba las de'i sras bram ze rgya mtsho'i snying po sangs rgyas pa'i mtshan de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen snying por grags shing bram zes bskul ba ltar rgyal 'bangs mang pos de —5

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan sngar byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i rgyal po bde ba can du mgon po tshe dpag med/ mig mi 'dzum/ 'od zer kun nas 'phags pa dpal brtsegs kyi rgyal po/ mthu chen thob/ yon tan nor bu brtsegs/ 'jam (6brko pa la rdul bral yang dag brtsegs su kun gzigs sogs dang /mthar slob ma stong sems bskyed pa bskal pa bzang po 'di'i sangs rgyas stong du rim par lung bstan cing bram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul sems bskyed par dgongs te/ /zhing ma dag pa mi mjed 'jig rten gyi zhing / sems can ma rungs pa mi dge ba bcu tshang bar spyod pa/ mtshams med pa lnga byed pa shin tu gdul dka' ba rnams la thugs rjes lhag par gzigs nas smon lam chen po lnga brgya btab ste bden pa'i stobs brjod pas sangs rgyas rin cen snying pos legs so gnang ste byang chub semasadapa' rnams kyis brtson 'grus brtsams pa ni bzhi ste/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing ma dag par smon pa dang /zhes sogs dang / khyod ni pad+ma dkar po lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' 'o/ /gzhan ni me tog lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' 'o/ /zhes sogs bsngags pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa brjod de bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas bzhi pa shākya thub par lung bstan pa 'di nyid thugs bskyed pa'i thog mar bshad cing / /yang mdo sde bskal bzang du/ nga ni sngon tshe dman par gyur pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub de la/ /'jam gang zhig ni dbul bar byas nas su/ /dang por byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do/ /zhes rdza mkhan gyi khye'u snang byed du gyur pa'i tshe byang chub mchog tu thugs dang por bskyed/ de rjes gzhen nu brtson 'grus spyod du gyur pa'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa 'od 'phro la sogs pa'i spyan sngar sems bskyed nas rab tu dga' ba'i sa mngon du (7nasgo dzad/ tshong dpon shes rab bzang por sku 'byungs pa'i tshe sangs rgyas dkon mchog yan lag sogs la grangs med gnyis pa'i tshogs bsags te ring du song ba'i sa thob/gzhon nu sprin du gyur pa'i tshe bde gshegs mar me mdzad sogs la grangs med gsum pa'i tshogs bsags/ de nas grangs med pa'i bskal pa gcig gi ring goms pa'i tshogs kyis bsgrubs pas chos —6

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 9)kyi sprin gyi sa mngon du mdzad/ de'ang ji skad du/ /gtsang ma'i gnas dag spangs ba na/ /'og min gnas ni nyams dga' bar/ /yang dag sangs rgyas der 'tshang rgya/ /sprul pa po zhig 'dir 'tshang rgya/ /zhes pha rol tu phyin pa ltar na sa bcu rgyun gyi tha ma bar chad med pa'i lam gyi rnam mkhyen skad cig ma dang por sangs rgyas la/ /gsang sngags bla med kyi lugs la 'dus pa 'phags lugs kyi ār+ya de wa'i spyod bsdus dang ye shes zhabs lugs pa'i 'kha lung che ba gnyis ka dgongs pa mthun par sa bcu par gnas pa'i byang sems srid pa tha ma par gyur pa'i tshe 'og min du mkha' khyab kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa'i tshe phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis se gol gyi sgra de las bslang ste 'di tsam gyis 'tshang rgya mi nus gsungs pa la dris pa na sangs rgyas rnams kyis lha'i bu mo thig le mchog ma bkug nas dbang gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang dngos dbang du bskur rjes mngon par byang chub pa'i rim pa bstan nas bsgom du bcug pas mtshan phyed na stong pa gsum thim ste thams cad (7ba〉sgrir ba don gyi 'od gsal mngon du gyur pa de las dag pa'i sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs pa la sangs rgyas thams cad kyis dbang bzhi pa bskur nas spyod pa byed du bcug pas tho rengs skya rengs dang po 'char tsam na rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis shes bya'i sgrib pa phra zhing phra ba 'di spangs te mi slob pa'i zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang bsnyes nas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas/ rnal 'byor rgyud gyi lugs la dgung lo so lnga par phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas nam mkha' gang ba byon te se gol gtogs nas/ bsam gtan 'di ni rnam dag min/ /mthar thugs thob byed kyang 'di min/ /khyod kyi 'od gsal dmigs bya de/ /nam mkha'i ngos lta mchog yin no/ /zhes mgrin gcig gis gsungs pasating nge 'dzin/ de las bzhengs te rnam smin gyi sku lus der bzheng nas ye shes kyi lus 'og min du mngon byang lngas sangs rgyas shing ri rab kyi rtse mor rnal 'byor gyi rgyud gsungs par bshad/ theg pa 'og ma ltar na rgya rol sogs su rgyal bu don thams cad grub pa nyid so so skye bor zhal gyis 'ches te lo drug dka' ba spyad pa'i mthar srod la bdud btul/ dgung la mnyam par bzhag /tho rang mi —7

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)gnas pa'i ye shes mngon du mdzad pa sogs bshad tshul mtha' klas na'ang mdzad pa bcu gnyis bstan par mi mthun pa med cing / /de'ang mngon par rdzogasapar 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul bstan pa'i rjesasu/mdo las/ /zab zhi sprosabral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /bdud rtsi lta bu'i chos zhig kho bos rnyed/ /su la bstan kyangago bar mi nusapas/ /(8nayi smra nagasa'adab tshal du gnasapar bya/ /zhesazhag zhe dgu'i bar chos mi gsung pa'i tshul bstan par brten tshangs pa dang brgya byin 'jig rten gyi gtso bo yin pas de dag gis gsol ba btab nas chos gsungs na gdul bya rnams chos la ches cher 'jug pa'i dgos pa khyad par can gzigasanas 'od bkye bas stong gsum gyi bdag po tshangs pa gtsug phud can gyis shes te grogs tshangs pa 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa brgyad dang bcas 'ongs nas/gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa phul te gsol ba btab pas cang mi gsung ba'i zhal gyi bzhesapa tsam las chos kyi 'khor lo ma bskor bas brgya byin sgran nas/ des gser gyi maṇ+ḍal dpag tshad lnga bcu pa phul te gsol ba btab pa sogs kyis rkyen byas yul wa ra ṇa sir drang srong lhung ba ri dwags kyi nags su 'khor lnga sde bzang por chu stod zla ba'i tshes bzhir bka' dang po bden pa bzhi la brten pa'i chos 'khor/ gnas bya rgod phungapo'i rir 'khor stong nyis brgya lnga bsam lnga stong gi dge slong / dge slong ma/ dge brnyen pha ma byang chub semasadapa' khrag khrig brgya stong la yum sras bcu bdun sogs bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i chosa'akhor/ ri ma la ya dang yangasapa can sogasasu theg pa mtha' dag la yang dag par zhugs pa'i byang semasal bka' dang po dang bar pa'i sgras zin la dngos su 'gal ba ltar snang ba rnams rtsod pa bsal te tha ma legasapa rnam par phye ba'i chos 'khor te rim pa gsum du bskor/ de'ang rtog ge 'bar ba las/ /theg pa chen (8ba)po sangs rgyas kyi gsungs pa yin te/ rtsa ba'i bsdu ba po kun tu bzang po dang 'jam dpal dang gsang pa'i bdag po dang byamasapa la sogasapa rnamasagyisabasdusapa'i phyir ro/ /zhesa'abyung zhing gsang ba bsam gyisami khyab pa'i mdo dang phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud lasagasang ba'i bdag po nyid bka' bsdusapa por —8—

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ tanagasungs shing rgyud sdogazhan mang po las kyang de dang phyogs mtshungs pa byung / bi mā la su bha wa zhes bya ba'i ri la byang sems 'bum phrag bcu'i dbus su 'jam dpal gyis mngon pa/ byams pas 'dul ba/kun tu bzang pos mdo sde rnams bsdus pa theg chen gyi lugs su grags/ theg pa thun mong ba ltar na de bzhin gshegs pa zhi ba'i dbyings su mnal pa'i phyi lo gnas rgyal po'i khab tu kun dga' bo ma gtogs 'od srungs sogs dgra bcom pa bzhi brgya dgu bcu rtsa dgu byung bar dgos pa'i dbang gis 'od srungs kyis kun dga' bo la skyon phab pa'i rkyen gyis dgra bcom pa mngon du mdzad nas mdo sde snod bsdus tshul ni snam sbyar lnga brgya bting ba'i steng du kun dga' bo gsol ba dang gnyis kyis bskos pa bzhugs te 'go bor gleng gzhi/ bar du 'brel ba dang mtshams sbyor/ mtha' ma 'khor 'dus tshul dang rjes su yi rang bcug nas rgyal bas ji ltar gsungs pa ltar sgro skur med pa thugs nas gsungs/ nye ba 'khor gyi sngar ji lta ba bzhin 'dul ba dang / 'od srungs chen pos ma' pa'i bka' rnams bsdus/ de nas lo brgya dang bcu'i dus su mi rung pa'i gzhi bcu la brten nas dge 'dun rnams kyis sde snod (9na po sum zhal 'don dang bkra shis pa'i gso sbyong mdzad de bka' gnyis pa bsdus/ston pa gshegs nas lo bzhi brgya 'das pa na bdud sdig can gyi sprul pa bzang pos chos log bstan pa'i rgyun rjes 'brang rnams kyis bzung bar brten sde pa bco brgyad phan tshun gyi rtsod pa sun phyung sde rnam dag tu bsgrub pa'i ched mnyan yod du byang sems lnga brgya/ dgra bcom pa lnga brgya/ so skye'i paṇ+ḍita khri drug stong ste khri bdun stong gis mi brjed pa'i gzungs ma thob pa rnams kyi don du glegs bam la bris te bka' gsum pa bsdus/ sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas lo bzhi brgya na be rta'i yul du bram ze zhig la bu med par rmi lam du bram ze brgyar chos ston byas na 'byung bar lung bstan pa bzhin byas pas khye'u btsas par mtshan mkhan gyis mtshan bzang yang zhag bdun gyi tshe las med zer ba la ci phan dris bas bram ze brgya la chos ston byas na zla ba bdun dang dge slong brgyar drangs na lo bdun thub/ de las med zer bas lo bdun du nye ba na grogs dang bcas te lkoms par btang bas nā —9

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)la cwar slebs pa na bram ze sa ra has rab byung gi sdom pa phab cing tshe dpag 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i dkyil 'bor du dbang bskur/ /lo bdun 'gro ba'i nub mo mtshan thog thag gzungs 'don du bcug pas 'chi bdag gi g.yul las rgyal/ /bram zes gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du smin par mdzad cing mkhan po sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po'i drung du bsnyen par rdzogs gser 'gyur gyi rtsi la brten nas dge 'dun gyi 'tsho ba sbyar (9ba)bas log 'tshor bkod ces dbyung nas gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten bye ba gyis shig par bskul/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub sgrubs pas thob/ /dge slong bde byed gyis rig pa'i rgyan 'os pa'i gzhung 'bum phrag bcu gnyis byas nas thams cad sun dbyung ba 'dul ba'i don du 'dam bu byin du chos gsungs pa'i tshe byis pa gnyis chos nyan cing sa 'og tu 'gro ba klu yin zer bas slob dpon gyis gnod sbyin gyi 'dam khyer shog gsungs pa na klu'i rgyal pos gdan 'dren par bsgo ba bzhin byon nas chos gsungs/ bzhugs par zhus kyang ma gnang bar mchod rten bye ba bzheng pa'i 'dam dang 'bum gdan drangs pa'i zhabs nas cung zad ma bskur bar grags/klu rnams kyi grogs byas nas mchod rten phal cher grub la 'ga' zhig klu yul du mi 'gro ba'i phyir ma byas te klu sgrub ces pa'i ming du gyur cing shar phyogs ba ḍa be ka dang yul ra dar du gtsug lag khang mang du bzhengs/ sgra mi snyan du gshegs pa'i lam khar byis pa zhig la lag ris la rten nas rgyal por lung bstan cing tshur byon pa'i tshe byis pa rgyal por gyur pa bde spyod bzang pos rin po che mang du phul/slob dpon 'dis bya ba las kyi 'khor lo ma zad mdo sngags gso rig lugs kyi bstan bcos sogs ches mang ba mdzad/ khyad par theg pa chen po'i ming tsam yang ma grags pa'i dus dngos bstan stong nyid kyi rim pa gtso bor gyur ba'i theg pa chen po'i lta sgom spyod gsum gyi shing rta'i srol phye bas nyan thos sde pa dag ma rangs par (10na jig chen nam mkha'i pad+mo la/ /klu sgrub bdud kyi sprul pa byung / /che kha/kha zer/ laṅkar gshegs pa las/ lho phyogs be dha'i yul du ni/ /dge slong dpal ldan zhes —10

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'dagrags pa/ /de ming klu zhes 'bod pa ste/ /yod dang med pa'i phyogs 'jig pa/ /nga yi bstan pa 'jig rten du/ /bla med theg chen rab bshad nas/ /rab tu dga' ba'i sa sgrubs te/ /bde ba can du de 'gro'o/ /zhes byung / de'i rjes su chos mngon pa la dgra lan gsum dar ba'i rkyen gyis bram ze ma bsal ba'i tshul khrims bya bas bstan pa 'dzin nus pa'i bu zhig bskrun snyam nas rgyal rigs dang 'dus pa las 'phags pa thogs med 'brungs pa nar son pa na ri bya rkang gi phug tu lo gsum gyi bar byams pa bsgrubs pas ma 'grub par phyir thon pa na rgan po zhig gis shing bal gyi 'dab mas lcags kyi sdong po brdar nas kha ba bzo zer ba thugs su ma chud par mi de na re/ /snying stobs ldan pa'i skyes bu yis/ /bsgrubs na mi 'grub gang yang med/ /dka' yang brnag pa ma dor na/ /ri bo rnams kyang thal bar rlog /zer bas lo drug bskyar nas bsgrubs kyang mtshan ma ma byung bar phyi rol tu byon pasachu thigs dang bya sgros brag zad par mthong ste slar lo gsum bsnan pa'i lo bcu gnyis su bsgrubs rung byams pa dang ma mjal bas phyir byon pa'i lam du khyi mo khog smad 'bus g.yeng ba la snying rje skyes nas gser gyi spu gyis rang gi sha bcad pa'i nang du 'bu rnams 'jog snyam ste spyan btsum nas ljags kyis 'bu blangs pas khyi mo mi snang bar byams (10ba)pa dngos su gzigs pa na yus pa'i tshul gyis kye ma yab gcig bdag gi skyabs/ /ngal ba rgyas 'bod kyang gos ma mchis/ /ci'i phyir char sprin rgya mtsho'i dpung / /gdung pas bsregs te skom tshad 'bab/ /bdag gis de tsam bsgrub nas rtags kyang ma byung na thugs rje re chung zhes 'khangs pas rje btsun gyis nga dang po nas yod de khyod rang gi sgrib pa ches pas ma mthong la da lta snying rje chen po skyes pas dag nas mthong ba yin te khyod rang gi phrag gong du khur la ston cig gsungs nas bstan pas mthong ba ma byung bas der thugs yid ches nas dad/theg pa chen po'i chos dar bar zhu 'tshal zhus pas dga' ldan du 'gro zhes rje btsun gyi na bza' la 'jus te byon nas mi lo lnga bcu rtsa gsum mam zla ba drug bzhugs par mi mthun yang don la yum gyi mdo sogs theg pa chen po mang du gsan/ de dag gi don ston pa'i bstan bcos rtsom par zhus pas—11 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)byams chos lnga brtsams shing mi yul du byon nas de dag gi don 'grel par sa sde lnga dang sdom rnam pa gnyis mdzad do/ /gcung dbyigs gnyen kha che 'dus bzang gi slob mar gyur te grub mthas dbyen bcos pas/kye ma thogs med nags su lo/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis bar du ting 'dzin bsgrubs/ / ting 'dzin ma 'grub gang chen gyi/ /rgyab khal lon pa'i bstan bcos brtsams/ /zhes skur 'debs mdzad skad/ slob dpon 'dis sher phyogs kyi sbas don mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa'i shing rta'i srol legs par phye zhing / rma bya chen po las/ /thogs med ces bya'i dge slong ni/ /bstan bcos de ni don la mkhas/ /mdo sde drang don nges pa'i don/ /rnams pa mang po rab tu 'byed/ /ces byung / shing rta chen po rnam gnyis bstan pa 'di la/ /(11na8 zla ltar grags shing so so'i grub mtha'i ba ched srol mi mthun pa mang du byung ba rgyal tshab rnam pa gnyis kyi gzhung la brten nas 'grel pa las thub pa'i dgongs pa las phyi rol tu gyur pa zhig ga la yod/ 'on te lo rgyus la lar rig pa'i 'byung gnas nā lan+dar mkhas pa tsan+d+ra go mis thogs med kyi srol la brten te rnam rig gi phyogs bzung / slob dpon zla ba grags pas klu sgrub kyi gzhung sangs rgyas bskyangs sogs kyis bkral bar brten nas ngo bo nyid med pa'i phyogs bzung ste lo gsum gyi bar brgal brtags mdzad pas/ /der lta bar 'dus pa'i skye bo mang pos kyang phyogs tsam rig ste/ kye ma 'phags pa klu sgrub gzhung / /la la'i sman la la la'i dug /mi pham 'phags pa thogs medagazhung / /skye bo kun la bdud rtsi yin/ /zhes khye'u dang bu mo mang pos glu ni blangasaskad/ shing rta chen po gnyis kyi srol 'dzin pa ni/ drang nges rnams byed las/ shing rta chen po'i srol ni legs bzung nas/ /'dzam gling blo gsal bye ba'i mig 'byed pa/ /'phags pa lha dang dpa' bo sangs rgyas bskyangs/ /legs ldan 'byed dang zla ba grags pa'i zhabs/ /dbyigs gnyen zhabs dang de srasayon tan 'od/ shwakya 'od dang phyogs kyi glang po dang / /chos kyi grags pa'i zhabs sogs 'dzam gling rgyan/ /thub bstan mi nub rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i mchog /—12

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ tanaces rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta rnams kyis 'phags pa'i yul du bstan pa nyi ma ltar gsal bar mdzad/ bram ze chen (11ba〉tro sa ra ha dang grub pa'i 'khor sgyur bi rū la sogs grub chen brgyad cu rtsa bzhis mtshon pas mtha' klas pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa'i mthus 'gro ba rnams yang dag pa'i lam la 'god par mdzad pa ni lce brgyas bskal par brjod kyang brjod kyis mi lang / de'ang 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud du/ nga yi dus nas lo brgya na/ /kha ba can du mtsho bri nas/ /swā la'i nags tshal 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes mtsho bskams pa'i shul du mi'i 'gro ba chags par bshad pa ngasangs rgyas kya chos dung shā ri bus 'gog pa ri'i chu 'tshams su gter du sbas pa rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen pos gter nas bzhes pa dang bcas bod du thog mar byon pa'i tshe bod chus gang ba'i lo rgyus rnams phyogasamatshungs pa 'dra zhig snang zhing rgyal po ru pa te dmag stong phrag gcig dang bcas bud med du brdzus nas ri kha ba can gyi gseb tu zhugs pa las mi'i 'gro ba 'phel bar grags / /mkhas pa la la rgya gar sogs yul g.yin ltar thog ma nyid nas mi'i 'gro ba yod pa las gsar du 'phel ba ni 'thad pa'i phyogs kyang 'chad mod yongs su grags pa thugs rje chen po dang sgrol mas byin gyi brlabs pa'i spre'u dang brag srin mo las gdong dmar sha zan gyi phru gu rigs drug nas tshe 'phos pa drug byung ba'i dgra 'bru sdong lga dang nu bo dpa' mda' ste mi'u gdong drug dang yang na se ldong rmu stong ste ru mtshan bzhir grags shing mtshal pa'i deb dmar du de dag las mched pa'i rgyal phran sil ma mang du byung ba'i mthar bod spyi la dbang ba'i rgyal po lag na pad+mas (12na)byin gyis brlabs pa'i rje gnya' khri btsan po byon/ /de nas rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa bdun 'das pa na lha tho tho ri snyan shal gyi ring la dam pa chos kyi dbu brnyes/ de nas mi rabs lnga na mnga' bdag srong btsan sgam pos yi ge 'dri ('bri 〉snyog dang ra sar mo ches gtsos ba'i gsal sogs rten brten pa bzhengs pa'i dam pa chos kyi srol btod/ de nasami rabs lnga na rje khri srong lde'u btsan gyis mkhan chen zhib 'tsho/ sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+ma 'byung gnas—13

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)sogs paṇa grub du ma gdan drangs shing bod phrug shes rab kyi rtsal dang ldan pa rnams lo tsā bslab tu bcug /zan g.yang mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang brtsigs shing lo paṇa rnams kyis chos bsgyur te 'chad nyan gyis gtan la phab nas so sor thar pa'i sdom pa len pa dang gsang sngags kyi smin grol sogs bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa'i nang nas bye brag sher phyogs rlangs khams pa go chas 'bum thugs la bzung ༷ bas rlangs kyi thugs 'gyur ma/ rje btsan po'i mtshal khrag dang ra dkar po'i 'o ma sbyar te bris pa'i dum pa bzhi par re gzig dmar po lha sa gong gi sa phag mchod rten gyi nang bzhugs la yod par grags/ sbas shrī ma lja dang nyang in+d+ra wa ro gnyis kyis blangs pa'i rgya dpe'i steng nas mo byad rnams mnga' 'bangs la dpya khral bsdus nas bsgyur pas dpya 'bum du grags/ rje'i dbu skra'i gzhob rams la bsres te ra dkar gyi 'o ma dang sbyar nas dri med pa'i rig zig blon po dum pa bzhi pa de la lcags thur brgyus (12ba)pas lcags thur can du grags pa bsam yas su bzhugs kyang deng sang 'di na yod mi gsal zhing reg zig sde dmar gnyis la bla 'gyur chung ba zer/ /lo chen be+e ros slar yang rgya dpe dang bstun nas zhus chen du mdzad par dum bu drug pa glegs shing la gras nas par bkab can dang gsung rab kyi bar du pha wang gi tshang bcas pas pha wang can du'ang brjod pa bla 'gyur 'bring po/ 'brom bza' byang chub sman gyis ke ru gling du zhag mal bcas nas zas sna bcu gsum res sad mi mi bdun sogs rab byung sum brgyar bsnyen bkur te yum rgyas pa bam po re la shog dril re byas pa steng nas gdugs tshod thon pa dang tshar re sgrogs pa'i shog dril rnams kyi snod sha sgro zhig yod pas ming der thogs shing mchims phu na bzhugs/ mnga' bdag khri ral gyi dus lo paṇa rnams kyis skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab ste dum pa bcu drug tu bzhedas pa'i 'jug snod las gras te sha sgro can du btags pa bla 'gyur chen mo/ rgyal rabs 'ga' zhig gi bla rje ma gtogs 'bangs kyis gsung 'bum bzhengs par ma nus shing de rjes 'bangs kyis bzhengs pa'i bcu dgu tsam 'phel zhing lcang rdo rje tshul khrims kyis 'bum bcu dgu po thams cad la gtugs nas —14

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ tanabazhengs pas shin tu dag cing de las mched pa'i 'bum tshar drug cu sogs rgya cher dar/ bstan pa phyi dar la rngog lo tsā bas bal yul pham thing gi gtsug lag khang gi 'bum shes rab sgron ma/ snang gsal sgron ma/ /zla ba'i sgron me gsum lhag por yod pa gser zho gsum gyi (13na)rngan pa byin nas bstan pas sngon ma rnams la ting nge 'dzin brgya bcu dgu las med par brgya nyer gcig /zhus lan brgya nyer gcig tu mdzad cing sgo gsum rnam grangs bcu gcig zhus lan brgya nyi shu/ 'gres ring brgya lnga bcu/phyogs skor bdun cu rtsa gcig /mtshon byed kyi chos bdun cu/ 'gres rtsa bdun brgya bcu gcig /'gres thung bsnan pa'i 'gres rtsa khri dang bzhi brgya nyer dgu bam po sum brgya dang le'u don gnyis byung ba ni chos khungs btsun par mdzad/ yum 'bring po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag nyi shu rtsa lnga pa bam po brgyad cu rtsa gsum blo ka brgya le'u bdun cu don drug pa/ yum bsdus pa brgyad stong pa la phreng ba can dang bzo sbyangs dang sde can te gsum byung ba 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu zha lu lo chen gyis rgya dpe tha dad pa gsum po der pra ldi ska sha ni ska se ni ṣ+ka zhes gdags gzhi gcig la ming gi 'dogs tshul mi gcig pa tha dad pa ste phreng ba can la lha'i me tog dang lha'i bdug spos zhes pa 'gyur rgyas pa dang g.yin gnyis la lha'i me tog dang bdug pa zhes tshig nyung bar grags zhes bka' stsal ba ni legs par bshad pa chen po yin la/ byams zhus/ chos 'phags/ rtag tu ga yongs gtad de le'u bzhi klu'i yul du bzhugs pas deng sang byams zhus dang chos 'phags bsdoms pa'i les rtag tu ngu'i leg yongs gtad kyi le'u gsum du snang ba nyi khri dang brgyad stong pa nas kha bkang ba 'gos chos grub kyis rgya nag nas bsgyur to/ /de'ang 'jam dbyangs sa skya lo tsā bas/ shes (13ba)rab med pa'i longs spyod kyang / /phal cher rang la phan pa nyung / /'dod 'jo'i ba yi 'o ma yang / /be+e lus 'thung ba brgya lam yin/ /zhes phal cher sdig sdug gtam ngan khyad du bsad nas 'bad rtsol gyis rnyed pa'i nor rdzas rnams rang nyid la phan pa nyung zhing / de la brten nas bsags pa'i sdig pas rgyud la gos te duḥkhas mnar ba'i rgyu 'bras— /5

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)la spyod pa mang la/ de nyid las/ shes rab ldan pas nyes pa dag /sel bar nus kyis blun pos min/ /nam mkha' lding gis dug can sprul/ /bsad par nus kyi khā tas min/ /zhes shes rab dang ldan na grog mkhar dang sbrang rtsi ltar rtsol bas bsgrubs pa'i chu shing lta bu'i nor la snying por blangs te rnam dkar gyi dge tshogs bskrun pas bsam pa'i khyad par las rab sangs rgyas kyi myang 'das/ 'bring rang rgyal gyi myang 'das/ chung ngu nyan thos kyi myang 'das/ bsam pa tha mas kyang mngon mtho'i rten sogasaganas skabs kyi bde ba bsgrub pa'i phyir shar 'ol kha stag rtse nas drung yig dar rgyas bkra shis zhes lugs gnyis la sngo gros kyi 'jug pa yangs pa des stobs 'byor longs spyod kyis bsnyems pa dang dge ba che ge mo byas so zhes pa'i snyan grags don du gnyer ba ma yin par 'jig rten gsum gyi 'dren pa gcig pu ba mnyam med don kun grub pa'i bstan pa rin po che spyi dang khyad par khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po btsongs kha pa chen po'i ring lugs 'di nyid rgyal bstan gyi snying po dri ma med par ma zad ding sang dzā ti'i me tog 'khri shing 'khrigs pa'i tshal nas za (14na tshe(ga thags su bskrun pa'i bar gyi kun gzod kyi khyon la gnas so cog gi skye rgu'i bde skyid kyi srog gi zungs lta bur gyur pa nas srid mtha'i bar du 'phel zhing de nyid 'dzin pa'i bshes gnyen 'dus sde'i tshogs rnams dar ba dang sgos su 'di gar ring por 'tsho zhing tshe rabs kun tu 'khor du skye ba/ gnam gyis bskos pa'i tshangs pa mchod yon zung gi sku tshe mtshan sdus mnga' thang chab srid rnams rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i dga' ston ltar 'gyur ba 'jig rten spyi dang / bye brag gangs kyi ra bas yongs su bskor ba'i swā la'i ljongs 'dir rtsod ldan dus kyi tshad pa'i smag rum mtha' dag ming gi lhag mar byas te lo 'bras dus su smin cing mtha' bzhi'i las sgo thams cad ngang gis 'du ba'i longs spyod kyi dbang thang dang tshe'ang ring por gnas pa'i bzang po'i skal ba can dang / khyad par rgyu sbyor dar rgyas bkra shis dang / yar 'phel/ tshe brtan/ kun mdzes te bzhis gtsos nang tshang nye du 'khor g.yog dang / lto dkar ba dbu mdzad lha mgon gyis thog drangs bris pa nyi shu/ shog las pa snye mo ba gnyis/ sdos/dag pa e pa rab 'byams pa sngo bzang bstan — 16

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod jo khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'da'aphel dang mtsho sna pa sgra pa rnam rgyal phun tshogs/ bal po dz+nya na mu ni dang shing mngar/ do dam pa yar 'phel sogs mdor na sku dang gsung gi rten 'di'i ched du mi dang dud 'gror bcas pas sgo gsum gyi dge rtsa phra mo bgyis pa yan chad gnas skabs su tshe dang bsod nams/ dbang thang dang dpal 'byor/snyan pa dang grags pa/ bde zhing skyid pa thams cad yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas pa (14brkong rgyal ba ma pham mgon po'i 'dus pa dang por skyes te theg chen gyi chos la spyod pa'i skal ba dang ldan zhing rgyal ba des lung bstan dbugs dbyung mdzad de mthar thug gi 'bras bu ring por mi thogs par sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob ste sems can thams cad byang chub kyi lam la 'god nus pa dang / mdor na rigs drug gis bsdus pa'i 'gro ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal dang bral nas mngon mtho'i rten bzang po thob rim rgyas sa lam bgrod de zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang la reg pa sogs lhag pa'i bsam pa rgya chen po'i mthus 'phags pa'i yul du a the sirnya zhes pa phyogs 'dir don grub tu grags shing 'jam dbyangs gong ma'i khab tu gyi yi zhes pa sa mo lug gi lor yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum dbu shog dang po rnams blo chos gser ma dang / de phyin skya chos zhe gcig pa'i po ti nyi shu rtsa gcig /rgyal ba byams pa mgon po'i sku brnyan lugs ma tsha gser sbyib gsol byas pa phra rgyan can khru gang pa rnams legs par bzhengs pa'i 'bras bu'ang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong pa las de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyis glegs bam chen po la yi ge gsal zhing rab tu gsal ba legs par bris te me tog dang bdug pa dang dri dang 'phreng ba dang byug pa dang phye ma dang na bza' dang gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang dril bu dang ba dan dang 'khor yug tu mar me'i 'phreng ba dang mchod pa rnam pa mang pos bkur ster bya/ /bla mar bya/ brjed par bya/ mchod par bya/ ri mor bya/ bsnyen bkur bya ste/ kun dga' bo (15na 'di ni nga'i rjes su bstan pa'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di las thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / 'phags pa sdud pa las/ la las gaṅgā'i klung gi ji snyed zhing — 17

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)rnams na/ /sems can ji snyed 'khod kun dgra bcom gyis btul bas/ /gang gis shes rab pha rol phyin yig 'di bris te/ /sems can mchog la glegs byin bsod nams khyad par 'phags/ /zhes thub pa'i gsung rab yi ger 'dri ('bri tha dang bkur sti ri mor byas pa'i bsod nams kyi mtha' nam mkha'i tshad kyis bzung bar dka' ba sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi cha shas phra mo res kyang 'gro ba rnams kyi sdug bsngal mtha' dag sel ba'i rtsi sman du gyur pa sha stag yin na'ang gtso bor gdul bya'i rgyud kyi kun 'byung dang 'bras bu sdug bden ma lus pa drungs nas phyung ste mya ngan las 'das pa'i sar bkri ba'ang dam pa'i chos bstan pa la rag lus pa'i phyir/ /thams cad mkhyen pa btsong kha pa chen pos/ mdzad pa kun las gsung gi ni/ /mdzad pa mchog yin de yang ni/ /'di nyid phyir mkhas pa yis/ /'di las sangs rgyas rjes dran byos/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dam chos pad dkar las/ la las de bzhin rin chen gzugs byas pa/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan dang ldan pa'i gzugs/ /gang gis de phyir byas pa de dag kyang / /de dag thams cad byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /la las der ni rin chen sna bdun dang / /la las de bzhin zangs(15brkong 'khar ba las/ /bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi gzugs byas pa/ /de dag thams cad byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / mdo las/ su dag bde bar gshegs pa'i gzugs byed pa/ /de yi lus ni dri ma med pa dang / /pad+ma'i snying po lta bur 'jam zhing yang / /nad dang mya ngan sdug bsngal 'jig las thar/ /su dag 'jig rten mgon po'i gzugs byed pa/ /bran du mi skye mngag gzhug skye mi 'gyur/ /dbul phong mi 'gyur rigs dmar mi skye zhing / /dpa' bo rnams kyang nyams par yongs mi 'gyur/ /zhes rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i sku'i snang brnyan bzhengs pa'i legs byas kyi 'bras bu ni chu gter chen po a mra'i tshig gus gzhal bas kyang bgrang bar mi nus shing bye brag tu/ mdo las/ kun dga' bo ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pas dam bcas pas sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum du bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas pus mo — 18

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'dagayas pa'i lha nga sa la gtsugs te thal mo sbyar nas tshig 'di skad ces smon lam btab bo/ /zhes pa'i don bzhin 'phags pa byams pa'i smon lam gyi nang du 'byung ba mtha' dag ris med kyi 'gro la 'bras bu nyams su myong bar 'gyur bas rje btsun 'di nyid kyi smon lam gyi mthu phul du byung zhing ma pham pas dam bcas pa'i gzungs kyi skabs/ ji skad du/ gang gzungs 'di nyan pa dang / klog pa dang /kha rtan byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa dang / sgom par byed na gang gi tshe bdag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i (16na)byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par gyur pa na bdag gis sems can de nges par btsal bar bgyis ste dmyal ba na gnas kyang nges par brtan nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan par bgyi'o/ /tha na dud 'gro'i skye gnas su gyur ba'i ri dwags dang bya rnams kyi rna lam du sgrog par byed na/ de dag kyang bla na med pa yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan pa 'thob bo/ /'di thos pa tsam gyis nam du yang ngan so bskye bar mi 'gyur ro/ /ngan song gi dri mas gos so/ /ma'i mngal du yang mi skye'o/ /lha'i bskal pa stong du 'khor los sgyur pa'i rgyal por 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar bsams shing don du gnyer ba'i longs spyod thob par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis nam du'ang sems can de bskyur bar mi bgyid lags so/ /nges par bdag byang chub kyi snying po la mchis nas de ji ltar gyur kyang rung bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan par bgyi'o/ /zhes mgon po 'di nyid mthong thos dran reg tu byed pa thams cad ring por mi thogs par 'khor ba mtha' can du 'gyur zhing sgron me'i bskal pa 'di'i sangs rgyas lnga pa ma ga dha rdo rje'i gdan gyi spo la ma pham pa mchog gi sprul skur sangs rgyas pa'i tshe 'dus pa snga phyi bar gsum gang rung du gyur nas smin cing grol bar 'gyur pa'i rten 'brel gyi sgo 'phar la brten khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpas sogs sngon byon mkhas grub mang dag gi byams chen bzheng par mdzad pa dang / rgyal (16ba〉ba gnyis pa btsong kha pa chen pos ra sa 'phrul snang du mnyan yod mchod pa'i dga' ston rgya cher spel ba'i mjug — 19

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)tu byams pa gdan 'dren pa dgongs pa'i gnad che zhing thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dpal gyis/ nam zhig rdo rje gdan gyi ri bo'i spor/ /byams mgon wo byed dbang po shar ba'i tshe/ /bdag gi blo gros pad+mo kha bye nas/ /skal bzang bung ba'i tshogs rnams tshim byed shog /ces pa'ang don de dag la dgongs te shes par nus so/ /'gro kun gtan bde'i srog song rgyal bstan spyi/ /bye brag zhwa ser 'chang ba'i ring lugs zhal/ /ches 'dzu pa dkyusang spyan gyis srid pa'i mtha'/ /brgal te legasabyas lus phra'i brtan 'phrog shog /bshad sgrub tsan+dan dri 'dren bshes gnyen rlung / /mkhas grub ma la ya nas chad med kyis/ rnam gsum 'khor lo'i reg bya rab bsil bas/ dug lnga'i tsha gdung drungs nas 'byin par shog /tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rkang sen zla tshes pa/ /lus can gtsug gtor rtse mor mi nub cing / /bdag sogs skye bar 'bral med 'khor 'bangs su/ gyur te srid zhi'i dga' ston la spyod shog /mes po'i lung gis gnam nas yangs pa'i sar/ /mang bkur rgyal por bskos pa mchod yon gyi/ /sku tshe mnga' thang chab srid dpag bsam ljon/ khrims gnyis grib mar 'gro rnams ngal gsor shog /'jig rten yongs dang khyad par bod yul 'dir/ /nad 'khrugs dbul sogs du kha'i mun pa rnams/ /rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i nyi ma 'od po ches/ /mthar bskrad bde skyid (17na skong bas khyab par shog /yon bdag nang mi las byed bzo pos mtsho ni/ /phyogs 'dir lusang ga yid gsum 'gyas 'bad kun/ /srid par lha yi dpal 'byor nyams myong zhing / /ring min bla med ye shes thob par shog /'dis mtsho ni sngon bsags chos dkar sa bon dad pa'i zhing sar yongs btab pa/ /rnam dag smon lam drod gsher gyis bskyed rtsa sdong yal ga lo 'dab rtser/ /sgo gsum rtag tu tshim pa'i tshor ba a sgra'i 'bras bu rab dud pa/ /nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam sems can kun gyi longs su spyod pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/zhes drung yig dar rgyas bkra shis yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum dang mgon po ma pham pa'i sku brnyan bzhengs pa'i tshe dgos tshul byung ba ltar dkar chag che brjod dang 'brel ba bsngo smon gyi mtha' brten pa gtan mdun gser gyi snye ma 'di yang za hor gyi ban+de tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rjes pho brang —20

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'dachen po po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis pa mas thā bhā wan+tu/ /khal kha yer te na i la gug san kho thug thu'i las ka'i tham phud kyi kha byang dgos tshul ltar bris pa bsam don lhun grub/ /chen po'i lag rtags ri mo 'dab brgya'i kha/ /legs byas nyi mas bye ba'i ke sa ra/ mchog gsum spyan sngar g.yur zas 'di phyi'i don/ /lhun grub snang ba dkar pos khyab par shog /mi 'gyur klong yangs ngo bo chos sku'i mkhar/ /rang bzhin ma 'gags thugs rje'i (17ba 'ja' ris las/ /sna tshogs sprul bsgyur rol gar dpal chen po/ /'phrin las lhun grub phur pa'i dkyil 'khor lha/ /'phags bod grub brnyes mang po'i bzhed gzhung srol/ /gangs can bka' gter rnam grangs mtha' yas las/ /yang rtser son pa lugs gsum phur bu zhes/ /lha brag gdams pa'i yang bcud 'di ko mtshar/ /dgra bgegs snying gar phur dbal btab pa'i rtser/ /rnam shes dag zhing bskyal dang lhan cig par/ /rang nyid 'chi med bsgrub tshe bdud bzhi'i g.yul/ /'pham pa'i rgyal rnga srid rtse'i bar du snyan/ /dam tshig zhing sar ye shes sa bon char/ /phab pa'i byin rlabs snye ma g.yur za'i ched/ /nyes kun dri tshogs 'khrud pa'i maṇ+ḍal ra/ /mtho ris chu bo rgyun chad med 'bab snyam/ /zhing khams rgya mtsho'i mgon rnams rten gsum la/ /mngon sum zhugs par mnga' dbul dkyil 'khor che/ /srid pa'i dpal 'byor yod do cog rnams kun/ /tshangs pas gcig bsdus phyur bur spungs pa bzhin/ /yid srubs sde las rnam par rab rgyal ba/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas legs bshad bye ba'i gling / /rigs 'dzin tshogs rnams nyer spyod bskrun pa yi/ /bsod nam nam mkha'i khongs su shong 'di mtshar// dge ba 'dis kyang byed por gtogs so cog /sangs rgyas ma thob bar du dge legs kyi/ /'bras bu gser gyi gnyis 'thung mche ba bzhin/ /glang po can gyi bsod nams rjes 'gror shog /'di yang (18nasgo rta dang sa lug gnyis kyi lor gram pa dge slong blo bzang ngag dbang / gong dkar ba blo bzang dpal 'byor/ 'phyong rgyas pa ngag dbang nam mkha' gsum gyis rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i dkon gnyer gyi las tshan thog spyi rdzas kyi 'jog /dpal chen rdo rje ga 'ozhe nu'i dkyil thang / rab gnas kyi —21 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)khrus dkyil dang khrus gdan/ mnga' dbul gyi dkyil 'khor dang tsakli cha tshad rnams sra rtsi can/ /dngul gyi rnam rgyal bum pa che chung gsum/ /gos chen gyi snam sbyar bdun/ lcags sder bzhi/ mi rkang gling bu rag bshan can cha gcig /rtsi sgam tshon khra gser sgo/ga can cha bzhi/ stag sgam lcags bshan ma cha gnyis/ cog tse dmar 'jam gser shog ma che ba cha gcig dang chung ba bzhi/ yang che tsam gcig /sgam dmar 'jam gser shog ma cha gcig dril shugs nang byang dar dmar po phyi so hrug gis gtums pa'i rgyab lag kha 'dzin rnams rag gis byas pa zhe mtshungs brgya dang sum cu/ dung chos che ba shugasabacas/ ras khra'i 'bog /lho ras yug rnams la dge skos thems zin tshogs thog nas yas bsu mas skyel gyi gong dbul thog tu phab par srang sum brgya bdun cu zho gsum byung 'dug pa spangs mtho nges kyi 'jog byas pa'i dus dkyil thang gsum gyi rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag (18ba ji bang dge legs so/ /dbur stod sems dpa' chen po'i sprul sku ngag dbang phun tsho gis kyis rab byung bcu gcig pa lcags pho spre'u'i lo'i li tho gsar bzo mdzad bzhed kyi 'go brjod rtsoms shig ces pa skul ba ltar bkod pa chos kun gsal ba'i nyi ma/ /gtsug tor rtse mor 'pho med rtag bcings mchog tu mi 'gyur bde chen dngas pa'i shel ngos la/ /rnam kun mchog ldan stong gzugs mkha' la mkha' bzhin dga' mar mnyam sbyor rtsed 'jo'i brkyang bskum zhabs/ /sgrib gnyis snying rdul mun chung zla nyi sgra gcan srid pa'i go lar 'gro 'ong bral gdan la/ /gar bsgyur gzung 'dzin 'ching rgya'i pha rol rang sems dag pa kā la tsakra sa bdag skyongs shig /dbus 'gyur lco phyogs sa dkar (19na 〉 ( ba phyur bur spungs pa mchod rten chen po sa /dpal ldan rgyu skar dkyil 'khor zhal phye zla bzang la sogs skal bzang gdul bya rnams/ /smin grol lam bkod rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po'i ston pa shākya seng ge'i zhabs/ /'khor lo'i ri mo lus can gtsug gsal mig gsum pas kyang dbyi bar nus min bsngags/ /don dam gnas lugs rta ljang 'od kyis 'gro blo ba kū la yi kha/ /'byed par nus min tha snyad gtsug lag mdzes ma'i 'gram chang zegs ma —22

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzheng dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 9)yis/ /cig car ba ched pas dngar po'i bcud 'bab rtswa na'i ra yig gnyis pa'i tshogs/ /bde skyid mgrin glu dar dir sgrog mdzad brtan pa'i 'khor los bdag rjes bzung / /phyag na pad+ma'i thugs rje 'phrul chen drang srong a ga stas/ /phyi rol grub mtha'i dug tshogs thabs kyis rnam dag sman gyi chur/ /bsgyur la mos ngor shar ba'i ston pa lha chen mgrin sngon can/ /ma 'ongs sangs rgyas thal ba'i dbang por 'gyur la snying nas dad/ /rgyal rnams spangs rtogs yon tan cha rdzogs zla dkyil tshad/ /mnyam yang log rtog sprin bral yid mkhar rab gsal bar/ /sngon med mtshan dpe'i ri dwags gzugs bkra btsong kha pa/ /sangs rgyas kun las lhag pa'i mgon khyod gtan gyi skyabs/ /rigs ldan dus zhabs kong tse 'phrul gyi rgyal/ /rgya bal phyi nang mkhas grub su la'i ljongs/ /rwa 'bro shong glo kham pa khra mo sogs/ /lo paṇa drin dran dad pa'i spu long g.yo/ /ṭīka 'grel pod mthor brtsegs pa rdza khog zhabs/ /brdol par phra mo'i gnad gsang dal 'gro'i rgyun/ /'dzags par ma bltos 'jigs med chos kyi rgyal/ /dpal ldan grags pa smra ba'i seng ge che/ /sna bo'i bzhed pa'i lhan chung gos brdol mig /'gebs par brtson min mdo rgyud tha snyad gzhu/ /'gugs pa'i lung rigs 'phongs skyen rā ma ṇa/ /stag tshang lo tsā ris med bstan pa'i rgyan/ /phyi rol kun rdzob nang gi rdo rje'i lus/ /gnyis med sbyar bas zung 'jug g.yin dus 'khor/ /mngon gyur mkhas dang grub pa'i rtser son pa/ /don gyi mkha' sbyor bdun ldan nor bu bzang / /bsdus rgyud tshig tsam rjes su mi 'brang bar/ /rgyas 'grel dgongs don lon pa'i mkhur tshos las/ /'khrul med rtsis kyi ā tha'i gzugs byung ba/ /lhun grub rgya mtsho tshangasapa slar byon nam/ /gsar rnying phug pa'i phyag ba che'i mug na dgasang rnams/ gcig bsdus man ngag lugasakyi shing rta che/ /dpal mgon 'phrin las mched po cha bsags kyi/ /grong khyer kun tu btsal kyang ga la rnyed/ /legs bshad ma dros phyogs brgyar babs pa'i rgyun/ /zur rigs kun mkhyen smon 'gro paṇ+ḍi ta/ /gnyags ban nang ra zug po gzhen nu'i mtshan/ /ldum po don dbang bka' drin gang gisagazhal/ /dus 'khor dbyangs ra bal rtsis spor thang gzhung / /dgongs bstun mkha' dus me zhag 23

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)blang dor gnad/ /phra zhib dra mig me long byad shar bzhin/ /mthong de phyogs 'dir 'bad pas sbyangasapa'i 'bras/ /gsal gsal smra 'dod lce rtse dkan phugs (20na)2byar/ /mang mang 'dri ('bri 〉ka'i tshogs kyis skyid pa bskyur/ /nyung nyung gza' skar sa bdag rags pa'i tho/ /rang rang rigs mthun mgu byed 'di ma yin/ /yang yang bsams kyin phug pa man ngag lugs/ /btsun btsun khungs ldan phyogs 'dir sbyangs pa'i mthus/ /mkhas mkhas mang po tshogs pa'i gral 'grim tshe/ /mtho mtho'i spobs pa je mthor bteg la gzigs/ /mchog thun spyan dang mngon shes ma 'grub kyang / /lkog gyur srid pa'i bzang ga rjen pa sa ri tho me long ngos shar rta bdun gyis/ /chos kun gsal ba'i nyi ma deng 'dir 'dren/ /mig mi 'dzum rnams mkha' la gom stabs kyis/ /me tog 'thor nas cher bsngagasasgron me'i bskal/ /bzang por lngas lhag rnam par 'dren pa stong / /mu lha ka yi 'phreng ltar spel legs nas/ /sras bcas rgyal bas snying stobs chen po sa /legs bstod tshogs chen rdzogs dpang sa'i lha mos/ /khas blangs yid srubs mya ngan khang bu sa /brgyal byed sangs rgyas bzhi pa zlas kha khong sras/ /sa lug rigs ldan dbang mo sgyu 'phrul gyi/ /lhums zhugs lcags sprel me tog can zla yi/ /tshes bdun las skar rgyal babs sku bltams nas/ /bgrang bya mkha' mtsho ro dang mtshe ma 'das/ margad gos kyis klubs pa cang shes lo/ /sbrang dus zla ba'i rdzogs pa gsum pa'i tshes/ /bla med ye shes bdud rtsis rab ngo mes nas/ /mtshams mkha' ro dang 'khrig pa'i bgrang bya 'das/ dpa' (20bston zhes pa lcags pho 'brug gi lor/ /lag na rdo rje'i mtshon gdengs she bha la'i/ /zla bzang rgyal por rtsa ba'i rgyud gsungs nas/ /mkha' ro dbang po lag pa'i grangs rnams song / /gangs can skye rgya'i bsod nams rgya mtsho'i mgron/ /ring nas nyer bkug 'phrul snang ga smyo la/ /rtsod dus lor nge rgyal srong btsan rjes/ /bskrun nas bug lag mkha' zla sngon chad shar/ /rtsis 'go thog mar zug cing dbus 'gyur 'chang / /dam pa dang po'i sangs rgyas bsdus pa'i rgyud/ /rtsa rgyud rgyas 'grel pad dkar gyis mdzad dag /phebs nas me dang dbang po dus lo 'das/ /'jam dbyangs ngur smig gar bsgyur btsong kha —24

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 6) pas/ /dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling btab nas/ /mnyan yod mchod pa'i dus ston ra sa sa /btsugs nas bse ru ri bo lag pa 'das/ /'byul slad na bun phra mo dang bral zhing / /rtsis rig gangs ri srid pa'i rtser brnyeg pa/ /sngon med legs bshad pad dkar zhal gyi lung / /mdzad nas me rtse lag pa rnam par brgal/ /bye ba phrag longs dgu bcu rtsa drug tu/ /grong khyer ka lwa pa yi rgyal khab khrir/ /seng ges chos srid bskyangs nas lus can rnams/ /smin grol la bkod tshe dbang slebs pa'i lor/ /byings dang rnams 'gyur rkyen gyis nyer bsgrubs pa/ /legs sbyar lha yi skad du ru dra zhes/ /ljongs 'dir drag po 'jam dbyangs rgyal khab tu/ phin shin grags pa lcags pho spre'u'i lo/ /gaṅgā'i yab gcig mdangs 'dzin tsi ber can/ /sum ldan 'byung ba kha (21na tshe tha nas skyes klungs/ /dgu gling dbus su bra wa gser slog byon/ /kun la mnga' sgyur rgyal srid 'dzin pa'i tshe/ mkhas gzhung mang por bshad pa'i bzang ngan gyi/ /bcad lhug gnyis kyi phyag bzhes rnams grangs las/ /mchog dman kun gyis rtogs par sla ba'i phyir/ /ma 'dres so so'i yi ge ji bzhin 'god/ /'jig rten gsum gyi dga' tshal yangs po sna tshogs dge mtshan gyi dngos po kun lkog tu gyur pa mngon sum du rjen par gsal ba'i 'brul med phug pa'i man ngag rnam dag grub rtsis kyi lor dbang sgyur ba'i drang srong rgya mtsho dga'i 'bras bur/ zla ba'i lo la sbrul dang / tsan+dan dang / sbrang bu ma he dang / rwa'i dbyibs lta bu'i sprin gyis nam mkha' khyab ste dri med chu rgyun gyis nam mkha' khebs shing / /rtsi tog shing chen 'bru'i rigs rnams rgyas/ /ma he la sogs bzhene rnams 'phel/ mdzes rgyan bud med skyes pa'i tshogs rnams glu gar dang rol mo bcas kyis bsngags par byed/ khyad par rje 'bangs rnamasabade bar bshad/ de nyid las byung ba'i stong dang drug brgya nyi shu'i yul gru na mdzes par byed pa lo la dbang ba ma drug bu yi 'byung 'gros lhod por byang du len pa'i gos bur kā rti ka la babs pa'i tshe/shing mkhan gser bzo mgar rigs tha dad kun dang ba lang sems can rnams nad kyis 'jigs mi rnams mi bde la/ /lo legs par byed rgyal po phan tshun rtsod pa 'byung zhing / me tog dkar (21ba)—25

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)ser gyi 'bras bu rnams rgyas par 'gyur ro zhes dang / thun mong du dga' bar 'dzin par byed pa lo la dbang phyug pa snyan dngags mkhan gyi 'bras bur/ pa sangs nad med rgyal rigs rgyal/ /gdug pa rnams 'joms shing mgron po bde bar byed/ /tshong pa nor rgyas rin chen 'phel/ /lus la nad med bde bar btsa'/ /zhes bshad/ /gser ldan gyi khyon kun la stobs kyi she mong gis dbang sgyur ba rgyal po gtum drag lus dmar can gyi 'bras bu ni/ me yi stobs ni cher 'phel bas/ /nags dang 'bru sogs sreg par byed/ /mi rnams dbul por 'gyur ba'o/ /kun rdung mi rgod mang du 'phel/ /yul mkhar 'cha' dang lhag par 'ban/ /la la mun pas gdung bar byed/ /'bru rnams legs par smin gyur kyang / /glo bur rkyen gyis nyams par 'gyur/ /rgyal pos yul 'khor btang snyoms 'dor/ /zhes dang / bya ba las kyi 'khor lo'i 'phrul blon chu las skyes legs nyes kyi kha lo bar mngags par/ rgyal rigs bzang po stobs su 'phel/ /gdug pa'i sems can 'joms par 'gyur/ /skye bo nad med bde bar 'gyur/ /tshong pa rnams ni tshong rgyas shing / /grogs po ji snyed bde bar 'gyur/ /sgrum pa rnams ni bde bar btsa'/ /rin po che rnams 'phel bar 'gyur/ /zhes bshad/sa gsum gyi dkyil 'khor yangs por dge mtshan bde sdug gi chos du ma lkog gyur tu byed pa mngon sum du ston pa'i mig gsum pa mchog tu dga' (22na)ba'i 'grel pa dbyangs 'char ba'i rgyud nas khol du byung ba rus sbal gser gyi 'khor lo las/ yul dbus 'gyur 'chang du mang po skyes kyi khri stan rab tu yangs por drang srong lha'i blo gros legs byas bye bas 'khyud pa'i 'jug pa phyogs brgyar spro bas/ /rgyal po rgyal phran/ mnga' 'bangs kun bde bar spyod/ dbang phyogs su drag mo dang / lha mo rgyal stod kyi lang tsho'i ljon pa gsar pa rab tu dar bas 'jig rten gyi brtan pa yongs 'phrog par byed pa'i dga' mar nyi ma'i bu'i blo stobs kyi 'khri shing yun ring du 'byud pas rgyal po mnga' 'bangs kyi bde skyid dang/ phun sum tsho gis pa kun 'jig par byed/ gshin rje'i phyogs su rig byed kyi bu mo'i lag pad zum par rings pa phyogs kun las rgyal bar byed pa sna tsho gos mdog can gyi zla ba tshes pas —26

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ tanargyal po 'khor 'bangs rnams phan 0 rtsod cing bde bar byed/ dbang ldan mtshams gso ba'i lha mo'i lang tsho dngom par 'od zer dgu pa dang lha mtshams skyes/ blo mthun gyi grogs po mig gi dga' ston byed pas rgyal po 'khor 'bangs kun bde sdug spel mar byed kyang / khyad par khams gsum rnam rgyal rtsub spyod kyi bya ba phyogs bcur brtson pas bde ba spangs nas gdung ba bsgrub/ rgyal blon 'khor bcas mi bder sbyor/ gnod sbyin phyogs su lha mo sgrog smad kyi yul grur dkar po pa wa sangs bde bar spyod pas rgyal po bran 'khor rnams bde zhing (22bskyod par yun nam gnas kyi bar dang /gzhan ma phyogs mtshams rnams btang snyoms su gnas shing / zhib par rim pa ltar rgyu skar gyi lam yangs por gza'i bgrod pa 'pho ba dang bstun nas 'khor/ bal yul mkhas pa'i lugs bzang nas legs par bshad pa'i ka ra myang rtsis kyi bstan bcos las/ char 'bring / 'bru 'bring skad/ rto 'bring /bsil zhing drod chung / rlung che/ 'phel ba bzang / zing dang 'khrug pa med/ khyad par sha ka drag sbyangasalas/ /kun 'jug ces pa 'dzam gling gi yul kun khyab par lhas char 'bebs par byed/ ces bshad/ /gtsug lag khungs dang ldan pa
