mdo sde gsang ba stag sna'i bstan bcos sogs nas legs par bshad pa las/ de'ang rgya nag bstan bcos mdo sde gsang ba las/ sa bdag bzhengs te/ so zang rgyal/ so dkar 'bring / gnag rnams bzang /'bru zan dkon/ skrangs 'bur mang / gzhongs zhing rgyal/ nam stod zhed/ 'byung bar khams mo'i lo zhes bshad/ bcu gnyis lo gos las/ sa bdag gnas te/ /ston zlar 'bring la dmag 'gul/ yul gyi dbus su stogs pa mang / ju tse rgyal/ so thar rnon/ gro nas 'bring / bra sran rlon/ khri shi/ nub tu 'khrug pa 'ong / dmag bzheng / rgyal la blon brgol/ nam stod than/ nam smad zhod/ gzhongs zhing la sdur ma/ nor phyugs rin thang chung / ngang gis mi bde ba mang / bskor bas bsod nams rgyas pas bzang /(23na tshes dang / rgya nag stag chung las/lo legs/ ju tse rgyal/ gro nas 'bring / dmag dang mu ge bzhil/ nub tu zhakhrug pa 'ong / gshongs zhing pham/ rme ba dbus zhugs 'bras bur/ chos skor dang dge bshes la ga/ rgyal po dmangs su —27

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()'bab/lo nyes 'khrug pa 'ong /zhes dang /gzhung lugs kun la legs bshad kyi blo mig mchog tu yangs pa drang srong lha'i bla ma'i bstan bcos las//drag po la ni char pa med//than pas lo tog skye mi 'gyur//bag re skyes pa'i lo tog sogs//ser ba 'bu la sogs pas za//zhes dang /dus bstan me long las/drag po la lo thams cad legs//char snyoms par 'bab/ces bshad do//chos nyid gnyug ma mthong rlom rbad rkam gyis/kun rdzob rdzun phugs brdab smra'i zog tshul la/yi de'i dedagargyal bas bden pa gnyis//thabs dang thabs byung gsungs pa rgyang du bsrings//zhig tshul tho cor spyod la dpa' skad can//phra mo'i gtam tsam la yang bzhin 'gyur mkhan//phye leb mar me'i rtse nasaldog srid par//gzur gnas blo ldan ma' du ci la 'dzin//chos kun gdod nas stong pa tsam gyis kyang //tha snyad rten 'brel mi slur nges rnyed pa//klu sgrub dgongs don 'jam dpal snying po yis/legs bkral 'di la shes ldan su yis bston/de phyir dus 'khor dbyangs 'char rgyud 'grel dang //rgya nag rtsis gzhung 'brul pa med pa'i gsung //phyogs rer ma zhen rig pa'i 'byul 'khor gyi //dgongs pa gcig dril 23ba 'jig rten dga' ba'i rgyan//dngos bstan tshig tsam la zhen mun pa'i mda'//'phen pa'i zla bgol ji ltar 'dod rjes su//'don pa shes bya'i mtha' de ma bkag kyang //gsang ba'i man ngag chu stod zla ba brtsegs//srid pa'i chos kun mtha' dag gsal ba'i nyi//ma lusabade skyid pad dkar bzhad pa'i tshal//'khrul med sa srungs gom stabs ma bskyod par//lus can bung bar sim ster sbrang rtsi'i rgyun//legs byas bon dar drag yongs si'i ljon//gangs can dpal mo'i mngal khur sbrums pa las//bde skyid ro bda'i zas la yo' 'bangs rnams//spyod la mig mi 'dzum gyi skrun zlar shog/tshe ring gnam gyi she mong dpung pa'i khrims/gser gyi gnya' shing 'dzin ri mchog dman gyi//phrag par rtag lci'i dge legs lus phra'i mgrin//btegs nas snyan po'i brgyang glu len par shog/skye rgu'i bsod nams ri bo bsgril ba yi/khu ka seng ring lugs chu gter las thon pa//dga' ldan bstan pa'i nyi mas gsum gyi/khriX mun mthar byas snang ba ches dkar shog/phyogs

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'dare'i mig can dpyad gzhung spang ljongs bcud/ /myang ba'i skal phra ma yin gtsug lag gi sha khri ka tshal brgyu ba'i bal glang lus/ /rnam dpyod gser sbyangs rgyan gyis spud par shog /gza' skar tshes dusa'aphrod spyor mtho ris chab/ /blang dor 'phrog byed zha khas bsil lhung lhung rtser/ /bkra shis rkang tog ri chu bo'i gser/ /'od kyis (24na 'jig rten thams cad khyab par shog /sa lug ba po shis lhun por sher phyin lha khang bzhengs pa'i deb kyi 'go brjod dang mjug gi smon lam dgos tshul phyag mdzod bstan 'dzin gyo mtshos bskul bltar bkod pa t+pal chun po/rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i ye shes gzugs brnyan kun rdzob sgyu ma 'phrul po che/ /rnam rtog rdul med mtha' bral stong chen don dam gsal ba'i me long ngos/ /nye bar shar dang 'char ba'i byed po dusagasum 'dren pa bskyed mdzad yum/ zhes rab pha rol phyin ma khyod ni bdud bzhi'i dgra tsho gos lasargyal bsngags/ /ris med bgror brtse 'jam mnyen thugs kyi dper/ /lhag bsam dpung pas yongasabateg pad dkar 'dab/ /rgyud lnga'i 'gror (24ba7dzum tshems 'phreng ze 'bru las/ /phan bde mngar ba'i sbrang rtsi 'dzag des skyongs/ /dga' ldan gnas nas 'dzam gling bshes gnyen du/ /bskal bzang sgron me lnga pa spar ba'i dus/ /ring yang dngos su deng byon rgyal rnams kyi/ thugs rje'i 'jug pa tshad bzung med la dad/ /kun rdzob brdar btags mi 'jigs bzhi ldan sku/ /'byung gnas zla tshes skye 'phags byang chub sems/ /tshogs sbyor bse ru'i rang rgyal thos sgrog gi /rten star dbang phyug grangasaldan tshar du dngar/ /sgrib pa gnyis thub sras slob gzugs brnyan 'byug /skad gsang mthon posabasod nams mdongs mtha'i mngal/ /legs bzung yang srid kun bde'i cha bsags sgro/ /zlum por gzhog pa'i zlos gar sgyur la brel/ /nor bu'i do shal sna tsho gis phra yis brgyan/ /gzugs sku khri rgyab rab spras mig mi 'grum/ /'grod lam dbang gzhug dkris la skyengs ster ched/ /byed pos tshangs pa'i yulas nas sprul bzhin/ khrel rigs gser dngul gi gu sha li sogs/ /gcig tu ma nges yol go mtha' klas par/ /kun bzang mchod sprin khengs bskyung nam mkha' mdzod/ /sgo 'phar 'byed ba'i sngon —29

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)'gro'i cho ga bstar/ /nyang shab 'dzin ma'i lte ba sum rtsen yul/ /'phos 'drar rnam bkra phun tshogs dge mtshan gyi/ /nyer shis lhun po ltar brjid chos kyi sde/ lha chos bdun ldan bstan pa'i 'byung gnas mchog khres bya thams cad mkhyen pa'i pi waṃ rgyud/ /snyan po phyogs bral (25na)mkhas mang mgrin pa nas/ /nyer khugs glur blangs paṇa chen dge 'dun grub/ /gdan rabs mu thi la yi 'phreng dkar mdzes/ /khyad par rgyal kun 'dus pa'i blo gros kyi/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i tog gi zhabs bsil bar/ /mtho ris chos kyi chu bos lhab lhub can/ /bod yul bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan srid rtser bsgreng / /dam pa'i rnams 'phrul gaṅgā'i klung rdul gyis/ /bgrang nus min yang zhing 'di'i 'gro 'dren slad/ /blo gsal skal bzang ye shes rgya mtsho las/ /dam pa'i rol gar zla ba thon min nam/ /gang gis chasagar 'phrin las bla nas blar/ /'degs pa rnam par brtson pa'i rim gro ba/ /phun tshogs rab brtan bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho yi/ /ngang tshul kun dga' bo yi dpe slar byas/ zhar phyin gsal rten brten pa yis/ /'dren byed gzigs mor mtshar nus rnam thos bu'i/ /gan mdzod rjes 'gro'i deb ther ut+pa la'i/ /chun po mchog dman thod du mdzes 'di spro/ /zhes mchod par brjod pa'i snyan tshig sngon du 'gro bas g.yas ru gtsang gi rgyal khams kyi sa'i cha nyang shab kyi lte bar glegs bam rin po che las chos dge ba bcu yis khyad 'phags pa/ /gling phun sum tsho gis pa 'dzam bu'i gling / /sgos nyang shab sa yi lte ba ste/ /sa de yi nang nas khyad 'phags pa/ /mtho bkra shis brtan pa lhun po'i 'dab/ /nor pad+ma rā ga lta bur 'dun/ /zhes gnas dang gang zag cig car du lung bstan pa ltar/ /dkon chog 'bangs kyi skyes rabs las/ /nga khrims ldan mkhan po'i (25ba〉gur ston kyang / /nga thugs rje chen po su yi shes/ /zhes lung gis zin pa'i 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas ngur smrig gi gar gyis rnam par rol ba thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub pas chos kyi 'dus sde bkra shis lhun por dpal gyi sde chen phyag dar nas btab/ sdosnod gsum gyi 'chad nyan shin tu dar ba 'dzugs pa gnang ba'i mkhan thog tu mkhas btsun grub pa'i dbang phyug chad pa med par byon pa'i gdan rabs bcu drug pa 'phags pa —30

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'anarab 'byor nas rigs ldan 'jam dpal grags pa sogs 'phags chen dam pa'i yang srid yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos 'khor lo gsum gyi phyag rjes shin tu che ba'i mdzad pa'i cha shas lta bur mtshungs med sprul pa'i sku rin po che blo bzang ye shes kyi rnam par dkar ba'i 'phrin las kyi rgyun bzang po phyag mdzod phun tshogs rab brtan gyis khur khur ba'i 'phro mthud phyag mdzod bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos byas te don grub ces pa sa mo lug gi lo'i zla tshes kyi nyin sher phyin lha khang gsar du bsgrigs pa'i dkar chag bkod pa la/mjug sdoms kyi smon lam shis brjod ni/ /'khor bar yongs khyams 'khrul pa bkrag po ches/ /byisayid lnga par 'khrid pa'i 'bod sgrogs mgrin/ /mtha' bral lta ba'i nyag phran gyis bcad nas/ /gtan mdun sī tar rtag tu rtse 'jor shog /dman lam 'brog dgon stug por mi 'khyams par/ /gzhan phan sems kyi skyed tshal do ra sa rlabs chen spyod pa'i (26na)pha rol rdzogs pa'i gar/ /bsgyur la phyag na pad+ma dang mtshungs shog /zhe sdang sdong dum phung por spungs pa las/ /gnas ngan len me sbar pa'i tsha ba'i dbal/ /byams brtse'i char gyis gsher bas sems can rnams/ sims pa'i tshor ba rtag tu myong bar shog /gangs kyi rdul brtsegs ra ba'i khor yug mngal/ /rdzogs ldan gzhen nu'i yon tan ma lus pa/ /sbrums pa'i ljid kyis ring tshe 'byor ba yi/ /rngul chu'i 'phreng ba chad med 'bab par shog shes byar srid gzugs mkhyen can me long du/ /yongs shar 'jam dpal rdo rje btsong kha pa'i/ /bshad sgrub bur shing mngar pa'i ro bda' la/ khrid mthar skal ldan kun gyis longs spyod shog /blo bzang dam pa'i chos kyi rgyal mtshan che/ /bsod nams ye shes dpung pas bsgreng mkhas pa/ /rdo rje'i khri la skyil mo krung gcig gis/ /g.yo med rnam gsum 'khor lo bskor bar shog tags rab ches bkra bka' chen rab 'byams su/ /klas pas thos dang bsam pa'i shis brjod kyi/ /man+ta ra ba'i char gyi sa 'og dang / /sa steng sa bla'i khyon kun gang bar shog /phun tshogs rab brtan mtho ris skas 'dzegs nas//myang 'das grong khyer chen por myur 'jug cing / /bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i bsod nam dbang thang kun/ /—31 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)dbyar gyi chu gter lta bur 'phel bar shog /ched du sgo gsum ngal ba bsten pa'i tshogs/ /'di phyi'i mdun ma mtha' dag lhun grub cing / /rnam dkar gos bu mkha' mnyam lus can rnams/ /mi 'jigs (26ba lnga zhi ldan thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /su sti sri: / /bde gshegs rigs lnga yongs 'dus dkyil 'khor gtso/ /sman gyi bla ma snyigs dus 'gro 'dren mched/ /g.yu thog rje btsun sku yi sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ /gaṅgā'i rdul grangs des kyang mtshon du med/ /'on te gangs ljongs dbu ru skyid sna dang / /ru lag lung dmar sku bltams gsar rnying zung / /skye brgyud rim byon rnam thar med po che/ /dpyod ldan yongs kyi mi phyed dad pa'i gsos/ /tshul 'dir nam yang zad med mchod sbyin par/ /dar mo sman rams blo bzang chos grags kyis/ /bskul tshe rig byed gnyis pa shes mang gis/ /sor rtse'i 'phrul gyis phun tshogs gling du bskrun/ /legs byas bsags mthus dga' ldan ring lugs che/ /de 'dzin skyes bu dge 'dun sde dar zhing/ /pho brang chen po'i chab srid mnga' thang dang / /sa spyod mi dbang sku tshe rgyas par shog /rgya hor bod kyi kun bzod dpal mo'i mngal/ /mngon par lci ba phan bde'i khur po ches/ /bas kyi skye rgu rdzogs ldan dus ji bzhin/ /sgo gsum sim pa'i tshor ba myong bar shog /gso rig bstan pa ma la ya yi ljon/ / g.yur du za ba'i dri bsung ngad 'thul bas/ /'gro kun sgrib gnyis des skyed bzhi brgya dang / /rtsa bzhi'i nad zhi lha lus spun slar shog /par brkos bskul zhing zhus dag las byed sogs/ /tshe 'dir bde skyid dpal 'byor phun tshogs shing / /phyi ma be+e ḍūr snang ba'i zhing khams su/ /skyes nas sems can yongs kyi mgon 'gyur shog /(27na〉sa g.yu thog pa gsar rnying gnyis su byon pa'i rnam par thar pa'i par byang 'di'ang za sto gyi ban+de sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /lus can kun la gcig tu brtse ba'i brlan/ /gsher gyis thugs rje 'jam mnyen 'dab ma brgya/ /grol ba'i sbubs nas gtum chen dus mtha'i me/ /tsha rtsub dbal gyis bdud snying bsreg khyod bsngags/ /nyi 'od byugs pa'i byu ru'i lhun po'i ngos/ /in+d+ra ni la'i 'khri shing nyer 'gyud pa/ /mkha' —32

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 9)la mkha' sbyor e waṃ zung 'jug gis//bcu drug dga' bzhi'i lang tsho'i cha kun 'phel//ka nas ye dag rang byung rang shar ba//log 'dren sgyu ma'i glang wo 27bsgo go bo la//rdo rje'i phur mar gzas par chos dpa' ba//dbang drag rol gar pad+ma he ru ga://pe skar rgyal bsen snying khrag brngub pa la//lcags sdig mgo dgu grag stong rkan gyi sgra//bsgrag bya sgrag byed bral ba spros med dbyings//brdabasatshe 'jig rten gsum po cig car g.yo//sna tshogs zhal phyag rgyan dang cha lugs rnams//ma nges 'char ba pad+mā kā ra yi//ye rte ma'i 'phrul gyi zlos pa'i gar//gangs can dpal mo'i mngal du bsgyur mtha' yas/khrag sngags dmod mtsho ni rnon pos dgra bgegs rnams//phyer 'thag bka' babs 'jig rten mig gcig pu//be+e ro'i yang srid rin chen 'phreng brgyud mthar//skyon gter bdag gling pa'i mtshan de snyan//chos mdzod sgo brgya che ba'i nang tshan khrod//gnam lcags brag gi zab mo'i gter kha las//pad+mā kā ra drag por bsgrub pa'i thabs//nag phyogs bdud sde'i gshed du de byon mtshar//dkon cog rin cen 'dus pa' 'phrin las rgyun//bzang po spel la ngag gi dbang phyug dpal//chosagrags phun tsho gos mthu stobs nyin byed kyis//yongs smin dam pa'i sbrang rtsi gcig tu dngar//gang des bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po yi//rnal 'byor mchog gi thugs dam zab mo'i rten//gtsug lag gnyis pa shes pa'i sor rtse'i 'phrul//bsgyur tshe lha rnams gzigs mor mkha' las 'ongs//dge des bdud bzhi'i mgo 'phreng rgyu tho la//brgyus nas ga shar 'phyang ba'i khro bo yis//gnod byed sde brgyad spyi dang khyad par du//rgyal bsen dam sri thal bar rlog par shog/gangs can ljongs 'di'i bstan 'gro'i bde skyid kun//bla nas blar yang 'phel zhing bsams pa'i don//'grub par gung thang la khar bad 'byungs//zhal 2zha〉yel ji bzhin dga' ston la rol ga khres gnam lcags brag nasachos rgyal ga bdag gling pas gdan drangs pa'i pad+ma drag po'i bris thang //chos 'di'i bdag por lung gis si pa'i sprul pa'i sku mchog ngag dbang chos grags phun tsho gis kyis thugs dmo rten du gsar bzheng tshoganang skab rgyang yig bris shig par bkas bskul bltar za hor gyi sngags ston laganon bas pa rtsal gyis sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang pos bgyis pa gi rnyi ra stu//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)sirgyu'i dngas mtshor 'dab brgya bshad pa'i rtser/ /sangasargyas yongs kyi gsang ba gsum gyi 'phrul/ /'dzam gling che ba'i rig sngagasa'achang chen rtsal/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas 'khor 'das yongasakyi mgon/ /sku lnga mtshan (28bathargyad sna tshogs sprul pa'i gar/ /gcig las du mar bsgyur ba'i nang tshan nas/ /log 'dren tshar gcod chol pa'i khro rgyal che/ /gtum chen dpa' bo rdo rje gro bo lod/ /dmu stag steng 'bying rdo rje phur pa'i mtshon/ /gdengasanas brngams pa'i mod la 'khor 'das kyi/ /khro tshogs ma lus lag cha stabs gcig tu/ /'chor bar nus khyod srid gsum rnam par rgyal/ /cher snyigs dus 'dir dam sri 'byung po'i mun/ /mtsho rlabs ltar rjes non tshe thugs rje'i mkhar/ /mthu stobasanyi ma'i dngos brgya'i tsha zer can/ /drag po hūṃ sgrub me shel dkyil 'khor shar/ /lha sras rnam 'phrul chosargyal 'bri gung pa/ /gnam lcags me 'bar zab gter yongs 'du'i ljon/ /rgya cher spros pa'i lo 'dab phang phung dbus/ /snying po'i 'bras bzang ro bda' gcig tu smin/ /sgrub 'phrin gnam lcags rdo rje thog mda'i rgya/ rnam par grol ba'i ras dkar kun gsal ngos/ /tshon risadabang gzhu ltar bkra lha tshogs rnams/ /sgyu ma'i khengs pa bskyung la shar ba bzhin/ /pad 'byung thugs rje spyig ma'i tshal yangs por/ /chos grags mkhyen brtse nusamesarab bsnun pa/ /sprul sku'i gzhon nu rnam dpyod gdong drug can/ /lha sngags ye shes mdongs mtha'i steng na 'gying / /dkon chog gsum gyi 'phrin las 'khor ba'i mtha'/ /zad min bar du 'dren pa'i shing rta che/ /skyur ra 'jig rten gsum mgon ring lugs kyi/ /skal (29nathazang dga' bskyed spyan snga rin po che/ /ngag gi dbang phyug dbus smyon chos grags kyi/ /phun tshogs snga 'gyur bstan pa 'dzin pa la/ /pad 'byung gdung 'tshob sprul pa'i sku mchog gi /thugs dam rten gyi bris brnyan gsar bzhedas mthus/ shwakya'i bstan pa nya phyis khog yangs por/ /'gro ba'i bde skyed mu sti ka 'phel ba'i/ /bsod nams byas pa'i do shal ring po yis/ /byed por gtogs sogs 'jig rten mdzes rgyan shog /gnod byed rgyal bsen dam sri sde brgyad snying / /gnam lcags phur bus thal phyung phug pa'i khrag /btungs bas rab myosastag mchongs sder mo yis/ /nag phyogs yid srubs —34—

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 9)khog pa dgrol bar shog/tsha tsha skar ltar 'byug pa'i rdo rje yis//steng 'og bar gsum gdon bgegasaklad 'gems dang //chabs cig zhi rgyas dbang gi dngos grub char//bdag rgyud zhing sa gshin por dbab par shog/ces chos rgyal 'bri gung pa rin chen phun tshogs yab sras kyi thugs rje yongs su smin pas dpal e ṇ+ḍi ā ṇa'i slong dpon r+sā po'i ring lugs la thugs kyi bag chags bongs su gas pa'i sprul pa'i sku mchog dkon chog tshon las bzang po'am/ngag dbang chos grags phun tsho gos kyi thugs dam rten gsar du bzhengs pa'i rgyal yig rtsoms shig par bkas bskul bltar za hor gyi sngags smyon rdo rje thogs med rtsal gyis sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang 9bto bgyis pa dza yas//lcags pho spre'u'i lo hor sog gi rgyal rigs dpon khag tshor drag zhan dang bstun pa'i bdag rkyen gyi deb ther dpyad gsum gyis dag par gtan la phab pa mu thi la'i 'khri shing / bskal mang goms pa'i tshogs gnyis phung po ma dros klung chen 'khyil ba las//rigs drug 'gro rgyud zla 'phel la 'bab phan bde'i chu bo rnam pa bzhi//byams brtse'i 'dzin mar rtag tu chad med zas gtsang sras phyag 'khor lo yi//ri mo rab 'bar 'jig rten gsum gtsug mngon par mdzes pa'i dge legs stsol//snying dbus 'dab stong bsil sbyin mkhan steng gzhen nu'i tshul//'jo sgegazur phud lnga ldan mkhyen pa'i ral gri yis//rmongs chen dra ba 30na ) mtha' dag gcod pa'i 'jam dbyangs skur//ngag dbang lha mo'i mnyen lcug 'khril des bdag rjes bzung //ches dkar dge bcu'i drang thig srong po'i khrims//bka' rtags phyag rgyas ches btsan sgam po'i blo//rigs gsum sgyu 'phrul chos rgyal mes dbon sogs//gangs can lha gcig rim byon phyag gi gnas//rnam dpyod ri bo shes bya'i mtshor bsgril bas//mdo rgyud nyi zla thub bstan mkhar mdzes pa//nor rgyas thang yang ma bcad sngon med lha//sangs rgyas kun dngos btsong kha pa yis skyongs//mkhyen brtse'i yid bzhi 'phrin las gdengs

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()ga'i rtser//'od 'bar lus can bsod nams rlabs kyi 'phreng //yol med rgya mtsho'i 'jing gnas sa gsum du//bde legs 'dod dgu'i char chen 'bebs de rgyal//rjes chags dmar 'od mdangs ldan sgeg mo'i gzugs//ut+pal 'jam mnyen zhags pas srid pa gsum//'ching nus rgud pa yongs sel rigs byed mas//dngos grub nor bu'i mdzod kyi sgo phye zhig/phun tshogs dpal 'byor phyur mdzad glang po'i gdong //brtan g.yo ma lus nyer 'gugs 'dod pa'i rgyal//mi da 'byor pa'i mchog byin ngal bsos po//dgyes zhal 'dzum gyis rdzogs ldan mgron kun bos//tshangs pa'i mche ba las 'byungs dbyangs can lha//'dod khams dbang phyug tshul bzung nam gru ma//'jam dpal thugs kyi sprul pa sgrol ging che//beg tse lcam dral rnams kyis mel tshe mdzod//chen po hor gyi yul nas bstan srid khur//nyer 'khyer mchog 30bskom na bar par gtong ba'i sgo//'byed la go rims ma 'chol bsgrig srol srang //brlang spyod mtho dma' dang bral 'degs la spro//gcig tu ster phod shwa yis ma khyer zhing //nyer 'jungs sos nyi'i than gyis gdungs min par//'phral yun kun dge snyoms bstar ljang gzhen skyed//legs bsrings re 'khang dang bral snye ma smin//dpyod ldan gzur gnas blo yi srad bu la//gtan phab deb ther mu thi la yi 'phreng //legs brgyus gnam bskos rgyal khab chen po yi//'dun nas mdzes pa'i rgyan du deng 'dir spel/zhes shis pa brjod pa'i tshig gis jun bsus te byang phyogs tor sogs gi rgyal po rgyal rigs dpon khag rnams kyi nang tshan las mtsho sngon po dang 'dam tshor gzhi chags nas dmag srung sogs zhi drag gi bya bar 'phral 'phral 'byor dgos rigs la phogs dang //rnam dkar gyi dge tshogs bskrun par 'ongs pa'i 'grul pa'i rigs la zur gsos sogs bdag rkyen byed dgos so sor thob thang gi go rim mi 'chol zhing //'phar chag nges med sna tshogs kyi bslad pa ma zhugs par sne mo las 'dzin rnams byed bde zhing //gtong len gnyis ka 'tsham tshags zin pa'i ched du drag po zhes pa lcags pho spre'u'i lo snon gyi zla ba'i dus tshes dge bar gtan 'bebs kyi deb zer mu thi la'i 'khri shing bkod pa la//'og min zhing khams zhing gi gtso bor 6

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'danges pa lnga las mi g.yo bzhin/ /zhe sdang rdo rje'i sgyu 'phrul gar mkhan bgrang yas dkyil 'khor spro bsdu'i bdag /rtsa bshad cha mas rgyud sde 'dzin pa dge 'dun dkon (31na khog 'du 'god gnas/ /gsang chen 'dus pa'i gzhal yas khang bzang kun gzod rgyan du spud 'di rgyal/ /klu sgrub bzhed gzhung mar 'gos bka' srol gser/ /rnam dpyod brdungs la gzigs mor tshar dngar ba/ /sngon med legs bshad phras mdzes btsong kha pa'i/ /lugs 'dzin smad rgyud grags snyan srid rtser ldir/ shesarab seng ge'i nga ro'i sgra dbyangs nas/ /dus mig grangs mthar ngag dbang blo gros kyis/ /rgya mtsho'i bya ba las kyi 'khor lo'i dpal/ /sa 'dir lcang lo can de drangs pa bzhin/ /a la la zhes me 'brug dbos nya ba'i/ /mig gzugs tshes nas 'go brtsams rig pa 'dzin/ /ngur smig gos kyis zlos gar bsgyur ba'i tshal/ /kun dga' ra ba 'ding la gcig tu brel/ /lam rnyed gyis gtsos shing bzo drag po'i grangs / /rtsig mkhan ri bo las byed nam mkha'i nyi'i/ /sgo gsum g.yeng ba med par brtson pa la/ /zla ba phyed lnga'i khongs su nyer grub pa'i/ /gsal dang g.yos khang gcig bsdoms pa/ /'debasabyed ka ba mkha' mda'i rgya khyon la/ /rdo rje slob dpon bsti gnas phyi rol gyi/ /ra bar bcas pa ji bzhin lhun gyis grub/ /mkha' klu'i grangs ldan skyes bu'i sgyu rtsal gyis/ /dmar ser can lo'i zla ba gsum gyi bar / /steng 'og bar gyi mthil ldebs zhal ba kun/ /bzhin ras 'char ba'i me long lta bur dngas/ /gser ldan cang shes khra nya'i bug nyin nas/ /bkra sa lhu lags kyis gtsos ri mnga' yis/ /rgya bod mkhas grub rgyud sde rnam bzhi yi/ /lha tsho gos 'chi med lam du 'ja' ris bzhin/ /don grub gnam lo'i nyin byed nya khyim du/ /nyer bzhugs dkar cha'i rgyal ba gsum pa nas/ /phyed bzhi'i bgrang byar chos 'phel (31ba ji pa la 'dzin sogs/ /bcu gsum sor mo'i sgyu 'phrul smad po cher/ /gtsang khang nang bzhugs dus gsum sangs rgyas dang / /seng ge'i nga ro nye sras rnam pa brgyad/ /sgo srung dbang chen rta mchog 'dod dgu'i char/ /'bebs mdzad rnam mang thos pa'i gzi byin 'bar/ /sa gsum 'dar nus 'jigs byed ma he'i zhal/ /myur mdzad legs ldan gtso 'khor rnam pa gsum/ /—37

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)las gshin phyi nang ma mo tsa mu rji/ /thub bstan bsrung ba'i lcags rir gcig tu dpa'/ /yungs 'bru lta bu'i ring bsrel gyisamatshon pa'i/ /sku bal gdung dang rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i gzungs/ /bka' dang de 'grel glegs bam gnod sbyin gyi/ /'khor lo bum gter nang bzhugs pha mtha' yas/ /rten dang brten par bcas la smra ba'i sgo/ /rnam par phye nas phra zhib bye brag rnams/ /ma 'dres dbye ba'i khur chen phrag pa mā /'degs byed rab 'byams 'phyin las dar rgyas so/ /gzhal yas khang bzang bris dang 'bur gyi rten/ /dam tshigs 'khor lo'i chu klung 'khyil ba la/ /ye shes sems dpa'i gru char dbyer med du/ /'dres pa'i rab gnas cho gsal na lngar brlabs/ /snyan dar bcu gcig gis lhag brgya phyed gsum/ /zang gos bla bre snang gsal mar me'i kong / /bdun tshar ting dang bdug sposagazheng pa sogs/ /ma pham spyan sngar mchod pa'i sgrin phung spros/ /nyin bde gsum sogs snyan shal me mig gzugs/ /bla bre rnga sbug gtor sgam gong 'dra yis/ /mchod rdzas steng du go mtshon spyan gzigasarnams/ /dam can srung ma dgyes pa'i rdzas su spel/ /khri dang tsho gis stan nyer gnyas dus dgra'i dbang //dkyil 'khor sgrub mtshod la 'os cha rkyen dang / /rgya ja'i btung ba skol dang (32na 'dren pa'i snod/khro zur ja khra nyi shus g.yos khang mdzes/ /slob dpon nyer dpyad rgyal mtshan rnga thug sogs/ /tshul 'dir gang song bdog pa'i rin thang la/ /nyis stong bzhi brgya lnga bcu'i dngul srang tshad/ /phogs thebs ched du sa zhing 'ga' zhig sbyar/ /gnas khang phyi nang bdag por bcas pa rnams/ /bdud dpung kun 'joms zhing skyong gnod sbyin che/ /skye 'gro'i srog sdud 'chi bdag gshin rje yis/ /nyin dang mtshan du g.yel med mel tshe mdzod/ /bsod nams byas 'bras mnyam med dga' ldan pa'i/ /bshad sgrub bstan dang dge 'dun tshogs rnams 'phel/ /tshul bzhin 'dzin pa'i bshes gnyen mtha' klas pa/ /srid mthar sku tshe g.yung drung ltar brtan shog /nyan thos spyod mdzes bde chen nye lam gyi/ /rnam grol tshal ched gtong ba'i bang mdzod phye/ sgo gsum ngal ba sten rnams gnas skabs dang / /mthar thug don gnyis lhun gyis grub par shog /kun mkhyen tshad ma'i srang la 'khor ba'i mtha'/ /'jal dka'i —38

sku gsung thugasarten gsar bzhengasadang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegasabam gsum pa/ tanalus can mtha' dag sangs rgyas sar/ /ring min bgrod pa'i rgyu ru las dkar 'dis/ /mtshon pa'i dus gsum dge tshogs ji snyed bsngo/ /rnam 'dren de gsung sgrub mdzad byin rlabs dang / /rgyu 'bras rten 'byung nam yang mi bslu bas/ /bden pa'i mthu lasasa'og sasteng dang / /sabla phun tshogasadapal gyisakhyab par 31ga /cesabyang rtse chosarje ngag dbang blo grosargya mtshosasmad rgyud gra tshang gi dri gtsang khang le lag dang bcasa'aphrul snang nye 'dab su gsar du bskrun pa dang / ri bo dga' ldan du gser rnga che legasanyi shu rtsa drug /sbug chol gyi shubasartsi dmar rag shan ma brgyad/ dgun chosakyi tsha ba'i thebasasu (32ba〉kho bcu bdun/zhogs gur smon du lum chen mo'i brgya thang gsum sogasasbyar ba'i skabasadakar chagadagosatshulabyung ba ltaraza hor gyi brdzogasbyar ba'i yige pa ni mthar rgyasapa blo bzangadabang po'o/ /byams brtse'i chab kyis dug gsum zhugs bcil lhag bsam snying rje'i 'dzin ma la/ /smon 'jug sems kyi sa bon yongs smin sbyin tshul bzod brtson ro bda'i 'bras/ /ting 'dzin shesarab chu gter gyisabasgyur sku bzhi gser gyi snye ma can/ /thub dbang yongs 'du'i 'phrin lasagrib tu skye rgu mtha' dag bsil bar mdzod/ /gang gis gsung rab tasbur yi rgyud/ /rnam dpyod sor rtses brdung mdzad 'phags bod kyi/ /mkhas grub lo paṇa sa spyod mi la rje/ /dam pa'i ngang (33napol kun la snying nas rangs/ /khyad par dka' gnad the tshom dra ba'i tshogs/ /'jam dpal gsung gsang mtshon rnon gyis dbral bas/ tanas bya thamasacad gzigs pa btsong kha pa'i/ /zhabs pad rdul dmar byang chub bar du bsten/ /mgrin pa'i pad mtshor dbyangs can ngang mo dkar/ /legs bshad 'dus sil 'khrol pa snyan 'gyuraglu/ /dge tshogs la 'dun mkhas btsun rgya mtsho'i rnar/ /len mdzad bshad pa'i rdo rje khyod cig bsngags/ /'gro rgyud nyon mongs brgyad khri bzhi stong nad/ /chos phung de snyed sman gyis rab gzhil ba'i/ /sngon med sman pa rdzogs sangs rgyas khyod deng / /pad dkar lta bur byon pa nyi ma'i gnyen/ khyod gsung mi 'dzad ma drosargya mtsho las/ /mdo 'dul sher phyogasargyud sde'i chu bo bzhi/ /skal bzang gdul bya'i 'dzin mar chad med du/ /babasa'adis lus can nyon mongs dri ma bkru/ /de phyir brtse chen blo ldan g.yin phan sems/ /legasa'abyung bzang po'i thugasamanga' rgyal ba'i sras/ / bstan 'dzin rgyu skar —39

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)dbus na zla rgyas pas/ /sku gsung rten bzhengs dkar chag smon lam spel/ /de'ang thams cad mkhyen pa btsong kha pa chen pos/ /res 'ga' rgyal la dmigs pa'i dad pa dang / /skabs 'gar shing rta chen po'i sku drin dran/ /gzhan tshe mkhas pa'i bshes la gus pa dang / /nyams chung 'gro la snying nas brtse ba dang / /bstan pa rin chen ring du gnas 'dod pa/ /'di dag phan tshun 'gran cing 'phel bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar bde bar gshegs pa rnams gyis dang por thugs bskyed/ /bar (33ba〉du tsho gis bsags//mthar chos gzugs gyi sku gnyis mngon du mdzad nas sku gsung thugs gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa yon tan mi zad pa rin po che'i mdzod las byung ba'i 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du sems can thams cad la nye ring med par 'jug pa'i 'phrin las kyi rnam par thar pa la rgyu mtshan shes pa'i sgo nas mi 'phrogs pa'i dad pa bskyed pa ni 'khor 'das kyi yon tan ma lus pa'i rtsa ba ste/ /dkon mchog ta la'i gzungs las/ /dad pa sngon 'gro ma ltar bskyed pa ste/ /yon tan thams cad bsrung zhing 'phel bar byed/ /dogs pa sel zhing chu bo rnams las sgrol/ /dad pa bde legs grong khyer mtshon byed yin/ /dad pa rnyog pa med cing sems dang byed/ /nga rgyal spong zhing gus pa'i rtsa ba yin/ /dad pa nor dang gter dang rkang pa'i mchog /lag pa bzhin du dge sdud rtsa ba yin/ /zhes khrung la/ /gang la dad pa'i gzhi dang gtso bo ni/ rten 'brel bstod pa las/ mdzad pa kun las gsung gi ni/ /mdzad pa mchog yin de yang ni/ /'di nyid yin phyir mkhas pa yis/ /'di las sangs rgyas rjesadran byos/ /zhes pa ltar 'gro ba rnams kyi khams dang bsam pa dang bag la nyal ji lta ba bzhin mkhyen pas de dag gi rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa 'joms par nus pa'i snying po'i chos bstan pa la brten nas grol bar 'gyur ba yin zhing / /de'ang chos kyi sku las 'og min zhing gi gtso bor nges pa lnga ldan gyi longs spyod rdzogs sku las ma g.yos bawo du gdul bya thun mong ba'i don du mchog gi sprul sku/ /bzo ba sprul sku/ /skyeb sprul sku sogs sprul pa sna tsho gos ston pa ni sangs(34na/spyos spyi'i lugs srol yin la/ /bye brag 'o skol gyi ston pas kyang / rgyud bla ma las/ thugs rje chen pos 'jig rten mkhyen/ /—40

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ tana'ajig rten kun la gzigs nas ni//chos kyi sku las ma g.yos par//sprul pa'i rang bzhin sna tshogs kyis//skye ba mngone par skye ba dang //dga' ldan gnas nas 'pho ba dang //lhums su zhugs dang bltams pa dang //bzo yi gnas la mkhas pa dang //btsun mo'i 'khor gyis rol ba dang //nges 'byung dka' ba spyad pa dang //byang chub snying por gshegs pa dang //bdud sdebacom dang rdzogs pa ni//byang chub chos kyi 'khor lo dang //mya ga 'das par gshegs mdzad rnams//yongs su ma dag zhing rnams su//srid pa ji srid gnas par ston//zhes mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul bstan pa'i nang wo chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba ni//ma garnya rdo rje'i gdan byang chub kyi snying po can du srod la bdud btul//dgung la mnyam par bzhag/tho rengs mngon par rdzogs pa sangs rgyas pa'i bdun phrag dang po la lha rnams kyis mchod cing bstod//gnyis pa la stong gsum zhabs kyis bcags//gsum pa la byang chub kyi snying por spyan mi 'dzum par gzigs//bzhi pa la 'dzam bu gling mtha' dag zhabs kyisabacags//lnga pa la klu btang bzung gi gnas su bzhugs//drug pa la shing n+ya gro dha ra skyong gi drung du bzhugs//bdun pa la shing sgrol rgyu'i tshal du bzhugs te tshong pa ga gon dang bzang pos sbrang rtsi'i lde gu phul ba rgyal chen bzhis phul ba'i lhung bzed du bzhes te//lha yi bkra shis don 34ba〉spyab ste//zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad gsungs shing //der ma zad sangs rgyas rnams kyis chos mi gsung ba'i skabs med na'ang thun mong ba'i bsam don dang mthun par//zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas//bdud rtsi lta bu'i chos shig kho bos rnyed//su la bstan kyang go bar mi nus pas//mi smra nagasa'adabs tshal du gnas par bya//zhes chos mi gsung ba ltar bzhugs nas gdul bya'i don du 'gyur bar dgongs te thugs rje'i mthus stong gsum gyi bdag po tshangs pa gtsug phud can gyis gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang //mchod sbyin brgya bas gser gyi maṇ+ḍal dpag ṣ+ka bcu pa phul nasagasol ba btab bas yul wa ra ṇa sir 'khor lnga sde bzang po la bden pa bzhi la brten pa'i chosa'akhor//bya rgod phung po'i rir dge slong lnga stong daX //dge slong ma//dge bsnyen//byang chub sems

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)dpa' sogs khrag khrig brgya stong la 'phags pa yul 'khor bsrung gis zhug pa'i mdo las/ /stong pa zhi ba skye ba med pa'i tshul/ /mi shes pas ni 'gro ba 'khyams gyur te/ /de dag thugs rje mnga' ba'i thabs tshul dang / /rigs pa brgya phrag du mas 'dzud par mdzad/ /ces pa ltar yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum sogs bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i chos 'khor/ /ri ma la ya dang yangs pa can sogs su theg pa thams cad la yang dag par zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la 'khor lo dang gnyis kyi 'gal ba spangs te legs pa rnam par phye ba'i chos 'khor bskor ba de dag kyang / /de bzhin gshegasapa zhi ba'i dbyings su gzims (35na)pa'i lo phyi mar rgyal po'i khab tu dbyar gnas kyi tshe dgra bcom pa lnga brgya la gcig gis ma tshang ba 'od srungs chen pos kun dga' bo la skyon phab pas rkyen byas nas dgra bcom pa mngon du mdzad de snam sbyar lnga brgya bting ba'i stan la kun dga' bo gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las kyis bskos pa bzhugs te/ 'go bor gleng gzhi/ bar du 'brel dang mtshams sbyor/ mthar 'khor 'dus tshul dang rjes su yi rang bcug nas mdo sde'i sdosnod dang / de nas nye ba 'khor bskosanas 'dul ba'i sde snod sngar ji lta ba bzhi gyi rjes 'od srungs wo po bsko mkhan med par rang nyid kyis 'dzegs te mngon pa'i sde snod rnams bsdus/ ston pa mya ga las 'das nas lo brgya dang bcu na dge slong lha chen po sogs kyis lag len log par spyad pa rnams bsun dbyung ba'i ched du dgra bcom pa grags pa la sogs pa bdun brgyas yangs pa can du sde snod gsum gyi zhal 'don dang bkra shis kyi gso sbyong mdzad nas bka' gnyis pa bsdus/ /sangs rgyas gshegs nas lo bzhi brgya na dge slong bzang pos chos log bstan pa dar ba'i rkyen gyis sde pa bco brgyad nang phan tshun du rtsod pa mdzod 'grel rgyal sras mar/ /mi bco brgyad kyis ras yug gcig bgos pa so so la tshang bar byung ba'i don dang mthun par sde pa bco brgyad po lugs tshang mar bsgrubs pa dang / /mkha yod du dgra bcom pa lnga brgya/ /byang chub sems dpa' lnga brgya/ /so so skye wa'i paṇ+ḍita drug stong rnams kyis mi brjed pa'i gzungasam thob pa'i gang (35ba jig rnams kyi ched du glegs bams yi ger bris te bka' bsdu gsum pa —42

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ tanamadzad do/ /skabs 'gar shing rta chen po'i sku drin dran zhes pa ni legs bshad snying po las/ /bde gshegasagasungs rab tshul gnyis shing rta'i srol/ /legs par phye nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa mchog /sa gsum 'gro na nyi ltar gsal mdzad pa/ /klu sgrub thogs med zhabs la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /zhes pa nyi zla ltar grags pa'i shing rta chen po gnyis las/ nyi ma lta bu'i klu sgrub ni lang gshegs las/ /lho phyogs be dha'i yul du ni/ /dge slong dpal ldan zhes grags pa/ /de ming klu zhes 'bod pa ste/ /yod dang med pa'i phyogs 'jig pa/ /nga yi bstan pa 'jig rten du/ /bla med theg chen rab bshad nas/ /rab tu dga' ba'i sa sgrubs te/ /bde ba can du de 'gro'o/ /zhes lung bstan pa ltar be dha'i yul du bram ze zhig la khye'u zhig btsas par bram ze brgya dang dge slong brgya la chos ston rim bzhin byas na zla ba bdun dang lo bdun gyi 'chi ba bzlog pa tsam las thabs gzhan med par lung bstan pa la brten nas lo bdun nye ba na grogs dang bcas te yul gzhan du btang bas/ /nā lan+da'i mkhan po sgra gcan 'dzin gyis tshe dpag med 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor du smin par mdzad cing gzungs bzlas pas 'a bdag gis yul las rgyal/ /slob dpon des 'dus pa lha so gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor du bcug cing dge slong gi sdom pa gnang/ /dge 'dun mchod pa'i gser 'gyur gyi rtsis rkyen byas shar phyogs pa ḍa be ka (36na)dang yul ra dar du gtsug lag khang du ma dang mchod rten bye ba bzheng pa sogs kyi ched du klu'i yul du byon nas mchod rten gyi rgyu'i klu 'jim dang 'bum gdan drangs pa'i zhabs nas byams zhus sogs bzhi lus pa deng sang dngos bstan du yod pa 'di nyi khri dang brgyad stong pa nas kha bkang ba yin/ /rgyal po bde spyod sbyin bdag tu gyur nas sri zhu phun sum tsho gis pa mdzad/ /slob dpon 'di nyid rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pas bstan bcos mang por ma zad dus der theg pa chen po spyi dang dngos bstan stong nyid kyi rim pa rnams ming tsam yang mi bsgrag par shing rta'i srol legs par phye/ /de'i rjes su zla ba lta bu ni rma bya chen mo las/ /thogs med ces bya'i dge slong ni/ /—43—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)bstan bcos de ni don la mkhas/ /mdo sde drang don nges pa'i don/ /rnam pa mang po rab tu 'byed/ /ces lung bstan pa ltar bram ze ma gsal ba'i tshul khrims rgyal rigs dang 'dus pa las dbyig gnyen 'khrungs pa'i gcen gyis lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du dka' ba spyad de byams pa bsgrubs pas las sgrib dag nas mngon sum du rjes su bzung ste dga' ldan du byon/ /zla ba drug gam mi'i lo lnga bcu gang rung bzhugs pa'i bshad tshod mi 'dra'ang don du yum gyi mdo sogs theg pa chen po'i chos mang du gsan/ /de dag gi don gyi snying po bsdus te 'grel bar byed pa'i bstan bcos rtsom par bskul ba bzhin byams cho me sdo lnga brtsams/ /rang gnas su byon nas de dag gi don 'grel (36ba)bar sa sde lnga dang bsdom rnam pa gnyis sogs bstan bcos mang du mdzad par gcung dbyig gnyen ma rangs par/ /kye ma thogs med nags su lo/ /bcu gnyis bar du ting 'dzin bsgrubs/ /ting 'dzin ma 'grub glang chen gyi/ /rgyab khal longs pa'i bstan bcos brtsams/ /zhes gsungs skad/ /slob dpon 'dis sbas don mngon par rtogs pa'i bstan pa nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad do/ /gzhan tshe mkhas pa'i bshes la gus pa dang / /zhes pa ni legs bshad snying po las/ khreng rta chen po'i srol ni legs bzung nas/ /'dzam gling blo gsal bye ba'i mig 'byed pa/ /'phags pa lha dang dpa' bo sangs rgyas bskyangs/ /legs ldan 'byed dang zla ba grags pa'i zhabs/ /dbyig gnyen zhabs dang de sras yon tan 'od/ shākya 'od dang phyogs kyi glang po dang / /chos kyi gragasapa'i zha khas sogs 'dzam gling rgyan/ /thub bstan mi nub rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i mchog /mkhas pa'i dbang po rnams la gus phyag 'tshal/ /zhes pa ltar shing rta chen po gnyis kyi srol legs par 'dzin pa'i paṇa chen gyi ngag tu ma zad rig pa'i gnas bco brgyad dang / /bcu dang lnga la sogs pa la legasapar sbyangs shing grub mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i rgya gar shar nub lho byang dbus dang bcasapa'i mkhas pa rnams kyis bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa nyi zla ltar gsal bar mdzad pa las rim gyis lha mo dri ma med pa lung bstan pa'i mdo las/ nga yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyis stong lnga brgya na —44

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'dagadong dmar can gyi (37nasgo la du dam pa'i chos dar bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa thog tu babs te bod mun pa'i gling du dam pa'i chos kyi sgron me spar ba'i slad du rigs gsum mgon po sogs 'phags pas byin gyis brlabs pa las bod spyi la dbang sgyur ba'i rgyal po gnya' khri btsan po nas bzung gnam gyi khri bdun/ stod kyi steng gnyis/ bar du legs drug /sa la lde brgyad/ 'og gi btsan gsum ste gdung rabs nyi shu rtsa bdun gyi tha ma kun tu bzang po'i rnam par 'phrul pa lha tho tho ri snyan shal gyis pho brang yom (yum 〉sdu gla sgang du dam pa chos kyi dbu brnyes/ de nas rgyal rabs lnga na thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa srong btsan sgam pos gtsug lag khang dang rten bzhengs pa sogs kyi srol btod/de nas rgyal rabs lnga na 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sprul pa rje khri srong lde'u btsan dang / de'i dbon srasamanga' bdag khri lde srong btsan gnyis kyi ring mnga' 'og gi blo rno ba mang pos legs par sbyar ba'i skad la sbyangs te dam pa'i cho ge bsgyur ba'i lo tsā mdzad/ bstan pa phyi dar la paṇ+ḍita smri ti dz+nya na shrī/ jo bo chen po di paṃ kā ra shrī dz+nyā na/ paṇa chen gha ya dha ra/ spu smir pa'i bsod snyoms pa chen po shākya shrī sogasapaṇa grub du ma dang / lo tsā ba chen po rin chen bzang po/ 'brog mi lo tsā ba shākya ye shes nas bzung 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu chos skyong bzang po brgyud par bcas pa'i bar du byon pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyis bka' dang dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos gsar du ma bsgyur ba dang 'gyur zin 'chosapa sogs lod nyan (37ba tshe)sa gtan la phab pa'i rnam par thar pa la mi logs pa'i gus pa tshes cher 'phel bar 'gyur zhing / rgyal blon lo paṇa de dag gis dka' ba brgya phyag du ma'i sgo nasa'abad pas bsgrubs pa rnams kyang rang nyid zhi bde don gnyer ma yin par sdug bsngal gsum gyisamanar ba'i rigs drug gi sems can nyam thag pa rnams kyi don la dgongs pa'i rnam par thar pa'i rjes su zhugs te tshe rabs thog med nas drin gyi bskyangs pa'i ma rgan du shes pa sogs kyis drangs te/ /sems can tsam la dmigs pa'i snying rje/ chos la dmigs pa'i snying rje/ dmigs med la dmigs pa'i snying rjes rtsis zin pa ni theg pa chen po'i lam gyi thog mtha' bar gsum du gal che bas/ 'jug —43

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)pa las/ /gang phyir brtse nyid rgyal ba'i lo tog phun tsho gis 'di/ /sa bon dang ni spel la chu 'dra yun ring du/ /longs spyod gnas la smin pa lta bur 'dod gyur pa/ /de phyir bdag gis thog mar snying rjer bstod par bgyi/ /dang por nga zhes bdag la zhen gyur cing / /bdag gi 'di zhes dngos la chags bskyed pa/ /zo chun 'phyan ltar rang dbang med pa yi/ /'gro la snying rjer gyur gang de la 'dud/ /'gro ba g.yo ba chu yi nang gi zla ba ltar/ /g.yo dang rang bzhin nyid kyis stong par mthong ba yi/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /bstan pa rin chen ring du gnas 'dod pa/ /zhes pa phan pa dang bde ba ma lus pa 'byung ba'i rtsa lag ni lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa yin cing / rtogs pa'i bstan pa rgyud la skyed par lung gi bstan pa la thos bsam byas pa (38na〉pa rag lus/ /lung gi bstan pa'ang kyisangs rgyas bka' tshad ma dang / /de'i dgongs 'grel du gyur pa'i bstan bcos tshad ma la rag lus/ /sngon gyi 'grel byed mkhan po rnams kyis gzhung brling zhing / rtogs dka' ba dag la bla ma phyi ma rnams kyis tshig 'grel/ spyi don/ mtha' gcod/ zin bris mdzad pa rnams kyang rang bzos ma bslad pa'i khungs dang 'brel ba'i dbang po zhig nges par dgos pas/ thams cad kyi rtsa bar gyur pa ni rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog yin zhing /de'ang bzhugs tshul la theg pa'i mtho dma' dang / 'gyur gyi snga phyi sogs rnam grangs mang yang 'jug sgo'i dbang du byas na/ lha rtse'i lha btsun mched gsum dang / rgya shāka gzhen/ seng ye shes brtson 'grus/ myang rdo rje rgyal mtshan te yon mchod rnams kyis/ 'brog mi/ leng / stag gsum rgya gar du brdzangs pa'i zhal ta la/ bstan pa'i rtsa ba yin pas 'dul ba/ snying po yin pas phar phyin/ nying khu yin pas rdo rje theg pa slobs shog gsungs pa ltar/ bram ze'i rgyal po rgyal bshes kyis gnod pa byasanas bstan pa la 'phel 'grib byung ba'i dus lung gzhan rnams kyi dpe rnyed kyang gzhung bla ma'i dpe ma rnyed zhu ba'i bar kha cher dge slong zhig gis blo nas gang thon bris pa cung zad ma dag pa'i skyon yod cing / gzhung bla ma glegs bam zhugs la sbyangs pa'i thal khrod nas rnyed pa zhu ba'i zhabs cung zad ma —46

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'dardzogs pa 'di dag par grags/ dkar chag phang thang ma sogs kyi rjes su 'brangs te mtshal pa (38ba)bka' 'gyur du/ dang por lung gzhi/ gnyis par so thar gyi mdo dang rnam 'byed/ gsum par phran tshegs/ bzhi par zhu ba mdzad la/ bka' 'gyur them spangs mar go rim 'di dang cung mi mthun kyang don gyi cha la gang byas kyang 'gal ba med/ yum rgyas pa zhabs nas le'u bzhi ma tshang ba gzhan nas kha bkang ba tsam dang / brgyad stong pa la 'phreng can bzo sbyangs/ sdo can gsum 'gyur gyi khyad par tsam las don la mi mthun ba med cing / yum sras bcu bdun po 'gyur snga phyi khyad par mi 'dra ba thor bu las dogs pa'i gnas che bar mi snang / mdo mang la bskal bzang sogs glegs bam gcig nasaganyis gsum du 'ongs ba dang / chos tshan mang po phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i skor la mdo sde sna tshogs par ngos 'dzin zhing / 'di dag la theg pa che chung mangs ba'i drangs nges kyi khyad par mtha' klas kyang ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ 'jig rten khams ni stong dag tu/ /ngas ni mdo sdogang bshad pa/ /tshig 'bru tha dad don gcig ste/ /thams cad brjod bar nus ma yin/ /zhes gdul bya blo mchog dman tha dad pa'i snang ngo tsam yin pa la dgongs nas 'jam dbyangs kun dga' grol mchog gis/ dam chos kun gdul bya'i blo 'khrid las/ /phyogs 'dzin gyi grub mtha' skyong ma myong / /chos du ma ro gcig gi rnal 'byor nga / /gsungs par snang / dkon brtsegs dang phal chen bzhugs che bas logs su 'dren pa 'dug kyang don du mdo mang gi khongs su gtogs pa/ /(39na8kon mchog brtsegs par/ /rnam pa bcu drug gi chos bstan pa de rnams 'od srungs kyis zhus pa 'phags pa sdom pa gsum bstan par tshig don mdor bsdus nas de'i rgyas bshad sgo mtha' yas pa sogs le'u lhag ma rnams kyis bstan pas/ /rtsa 'grel lta bu/ sangs rgyas phal po cher snyan gyi gong rgyan dang / pad+ma'i rgyan sogs mtshan gyi rnams grangs su thams cad mkhyen pa ye bzang rtse ba gsung / dkar chag phang thang ma dang ldan dkar mar/ gsang sngags phyi'i rgyud rnams zhib mor bkod pa'i rjes su/ gsang sngags nang gi rgyud rnams ni ches gnyan pas re zhig 'dir ma bkod/ ces gsung pa mdo sgyu sems gsum bka' brgyad spyi bye brag —47—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)gi rgyud rnams can chen po/ bi mā la mi tra/ be+e ro tsa na/ rma gnyags/ bstan pa snga dar gyi mjug dang /phyi dar gyi 'gor so zur gnubs gsum sogs kyis 'chad nyan gyis gtan la phab par sngags gsar rnying gi chags sdang la brten 'jam yig 'ga' zhig byung bas kun mkhyen bus gsung rab rin po che'i mdzod du btang snyoms su bzhag pas dar so chung zhing / bka' 'gyur ro cog gi ming thogs par mi snang la/ gsar rgyud la/ rgya bo ba lung pas brtsams pa'i gnyis med rnam rgyal/ bde mchog ra li nyer gcig /mgon po dngos grub 'byung ba sogs the tshom gyi gzhi mang po phyir dbyung bas them spangs ma phyogs kyi glegs bam la (39ba)cung zad grangs nyung bar yod cing / da ltar rgyal ba'i bka' mdo rgyud kyi gleg bam rnams dang dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdag nyid chen po blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyi snang brnyan/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub pa'i 'byungs rabs nyi shu rtsa gsum gser zangs las grub pa rnams bzhengs par mdzad pa po ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i rnam thar zhal gsungs mar/ yang lan cig gi tshe ngas thog mar dbang ldan du phyin/ de na rje btsun byams pa dang / jo bo yab sras/ rje btsong kha pa rnams phebs gsung /chos mang po gsung gi 'dug pa rnams nyan/ de nas bdag 'gro don la gang du phyin na legs zhus pas/me tog pad+ma gcig dang / ser ba rdog po gnyis gnang ste/ 'di rnams gang du song bar 'gro don gyisagasung / de rnams mkha' la bskyur bas yol dkar du pad+ma de babs/ ser ba gcig dbur stod phyogs su babs/ gcig mdo khams phyogs su babs zhes kyang smras par grags/ zhes gsungs pa'i dbu rur babs pa de thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sras kyi gtso bo rgyal ba'i sras po shes rab 'phel ba yin par 'jam mgon bla ma dkon chog chos 'phel gyi gsungs las thos shing / rje sher 'phel ba'i skyes rabs kyi 'phreng ba tshar du dngar bar byon pa sprul sku blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis drag po zhes pa lcags pho spre'u'i lo do dam khur 'khrur ba dang dbon po blo bzang rgyal (40nasgo tshan/ sto dkar dngos grub dang btsun chung gnyis kyis gtsos pa'i brgya dang sum cu so lnga/ shing bzo ba mgon po can —48

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'dadagu /bal po pad+ma rnam dag gis gtsos pa'i drug rnams kyis legs par bsgrubs pa'i thub gsung rin po che bzhengs pa'i phan yon/ sdud pa las/ /bde bar gshegs kyi yum 'di glegs bam la bris te/ /'chang zhing me tog thog pas bsta stang byed gyur na/ /mchod rten byas mchod bsod nams desani char mi phod/ /ces dang / 'phags pa brgyad stong pa las/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi glegs bam chen po la yi ge gsal zhing rab tu gsal ba legs par bris te me tog dang bdug pa dang dri dang gnye ba dang byug pa dang phye ma dang na bza' dang gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang dril bu dang ba dan kho ra khor yug tu mar me'i phreng ba dang mchod pa rnam pa mang pos bkur bstir bya/ bla mar bya/ brjed par bya/ mchod par bya/ ri mor bya/ bsnyen bkur bya ste kun dga' bo 'di ni ngas rjes su bstan pa'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di las thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / pad dkar chen po las/ /kun dga' bo/ gang dag kha cig sangasargyas la dmigs nas tha na me tog gcig nam mkha' la 'thor na kun dga' bo dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag thams cad kyi 'bras bu mya ngan las 'das pa yin te (40bslogs dang / /sku rten bzhedas pa'i phan yon yang / spyan ras gzigs kyi theg pa chen po'i mdo las/ /'dren pa'i sku gzugs rab tu mdzes byas na/ /dbang ldan dbang phyug nyid kyi ltar 'gyur te/ /mi dman dga' ba'i sems kyis sangs rgyas mchode/ /rgyal ba mchog gi bstan la dad par 'gyur/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten dbang thob tshangs par 'gyur/ /yid 'ong shin tu mdzes pa'i sposang da can/ /dzaskru klung gser 'od byed dga' 'gyur ba'i/ /gzhal med khang mchog lta sdug thob par 'gyur/ /de ni ded dpon stobs bcu ldan pa po/ /sems can snying po mtshudas 'dra med pa thob/ /kha dog mtha' yas 'jig rten kun na gsal/ /gsar steng rin cen be+eḍūrla dang mtshungs/ /su zhig dga' ba'i yid kyi me tog blangs/ /dad skyes 'jig rten mgon la char du gtor/ /de ni mi yi 'jig rten bsod nams ldan/ /rgyal srid gnas nas rgyal ba mchog skur 'gyur/ /mya ngan tha ba bskams shing drir ldan lus/ /yan lag legs gnas mtshungs med thob par 'gyur/ /zhes —49

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)sangs rgyas sras dang nyan rang slob mar bcas pa'i sku dang gsung gi rten bzhengs shing sri zhus bgyis pa'i phan yon gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde legs thams cad kyi gnas su rgya cher bka' stsal to/ /bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i sems gyi pi waṃ rgyud/ /dang por bdungs tshe srid bde'i rgya (41na)mtsho che/ /dman lam rdzings bshig 'gro kun rin cen gling / /'khrid pa'i smon lam lhun gyis grub par shog /log bshad dri bkrus rnam dag lung rtogs kyi/ /mtho ris chu gos lhab lhub g.yo ba'i rtser/ /zhwa ser bstan pa'i tog 'od 'jig rten khams/ /yongs khyab dga' ston phyogs bcur rgyas par shog /sa'og sa steng sa bla'i 'gro kun rgyud/ /skye bar goms pa bsod nams dar ba'i mthu// smin pas sems pa'i tshor ba bskal bar gnyid/ /g.yur nus mes po'i spun zlar 'gyur bar shog /khyad par bod dang bod chen rgya hor du/ /nad 'khrug mu ge'i chad pa mthar byas nas/ /dge bcu'i khrims kyis rdzogs ldan phung po'i ldid/ /nor 'dzin dpal mo'i mngal du lci bar shog /yon sbyor rgyal ba'i sras por dkar nag gi /las 'brel thogs dang mthong thos dran zhing reg /rdzi phyogs rgyu ba'i yid can ma lus pa/ /'khor 'das yongs kyi bsam pa lhun grub shog /sku rten gsung rab bzhengs par ngal ba'i khur/ /nyer bsten do dam bzo rigs las byed dang / /bdog pa'i phan pa spel rnams mtho ris bde/ /rtag myong ring min rdzogs sangs rgyas thob shog /dge mtshan brgya phrag 'dus pa bkra shis kyi/ /bdud rtsi 'gro kun snying gi dpal be mā /'khyil bas srid zhi'i bde skyid srog gi gzungs/ /mi 'jig g.yung drung lta bur 'gyur bar 31ga /ces rgyal sras sprul pa'i sku blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos bka' 'gyur rin po che/ 5rten gra tshar gsar du bsgrun pa bya ba la kyi (41ba/mthor lo'i dkar chag dang 'brel ba'i smon lam zhig dgos zhes gsung gis bskul ba la brten nas za hor gyi bzhes pho brang po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang pos bgyis pa sarba rwa dza / / /byang chub chen por thugs bskyed brtan po'i g.yo med dam bca'i skyil mo krung / /ku sha'i stan steng bcas pa'i mod la bdud bzhi'i g.yul ngo pham mdzad de/ /mnyam gzhag gcig gi thun gyi tha mar —50

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ tanardzogs sangs rgyas pa don kun grub/ /'khor lo'i ri mo rnam bkra'i phyag mthil gtsug tu khyong la shis pa stsol/ /gdul dka'i 'gro ba lhag par brtse ba'i snying stobs chen po yis/ /pad dkar lta bu'i mdzad pa lus phrar nyer chags ba spu'i rtse/ /tsher ltar rab rtsub 'dod mes (42na bdungs ba'i rngul chusabazhin bkru zhing / /zhabs kyi pad+ma ra legs 'khyud mgo bos btud nas phyag bgyi'o/ /thog ma bar dang tha mar dge ba thub pa'i gsung / /chu srin 'byung gnas lta bur zab cing rgya che las/ /lo paṇa mkhyen yangs skyogs kyis cha tsam bcus pa yis/ /ljongs 'dir phal cher 'gyur kun legs byas bya ba'i zhing / /mkhyen pa'i rtsig ngos shes bya'i 'bod sgrogs gzugs/ /ma 'dres 'byed pa'i rnam dpyod dga' byed lhas/ /bstan 'dzin 'phongs skyen dbus na zla med pa/ /rje btsun blo bzang grags pas ring du skyongs/ /'phrin las gdugs dkar gcig gi grib bsil du/ /rgya hor bod kyi 'gro rnamasang la 'tsho ba/ /bsod nams rgya mtsho'i zhing gyur 'jig rten dbang / /thugs rje'i phyag gis 'gro kun dbugasaphyung zhig /brgya phrag sdud mdzad gnam sa'i dbang phyug che/ /bstan 'dzin da las rgyal po'i thugasadam du/ /rab spel 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan du mtshar/ /de'ang 'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇ+ḍita sa/ /mchod bstod 'dud pa'i bdag nyid can/ tshes pa brjod sogs mi 'gal te/ /thams cad du yang ston pa yi/ /che ba 'ba' zhig ston phyir ro/ /zhes pa ltar shis brjod/ /phyag bya dngos po nges bstan gyi tshigs su bcad pas(42ba〉sdun bsus te gleng bar bya ba ni/ /thams cad mkhyen pa si tu dge ba'i blo gros kyis/ /mkhas pa'i mdun sar mkhas pa'i gtam gyis dga' ba bskyed/ /chen po'i mdun sar chen po'i gtam gyis dga' ba bskyed/ /blun po'i mdun sar blun rmongs gtam gyis dga' ba bskyed/ /skye bo phal pa dmangs kyi mdun sar chal gtam grong pa'i tshig /kun dang mthun pa'i dga' bskyed mi chos rtsa ba yin/ /zhes pa ltar so so'i skabs thob dang 'brel chags pa zhig gal che bas/ /ji skad du mdzod las/ /lcags chu ri bong lug dang glang / /nyi zer rdul dang sro ma dang / /de las byung dang de bzhin du/ /sor tshigs zhes bya gong bdun 'gyur/ /sor mo nyi shu bzhi la khru/ khru bzhi la ni gzhu —51—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)gang ngo / /de dag lnga brgya rnams la ni/ /rgyang grags de la dgon par 'dod/ /de brgyad dpag tshad ces bya'o/ /zhes rdul phra rab nas rim pa bzhin du phra rags kyis rdzas 'dus 'phel ba las grub cing / /grub tshul sems can spyi mthun gyi las kyi dbang gis nam mkha' stong pa'i dbyings su phyogs bcu nas rlung g.yos te phan tshun 'phul bas shin tu brtan pa'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor kha dog sngo skya sa ya drug 'bum gyi rngams dang rgyar grangs med pa zhig chags/ rlung g.yos pa'i mthus gser gyi snying po can zhes bya ba'i sprin 'khrigs pa las babs pa'i char rgyun 'khyil ba rlung gis brten pa las chu'i dkyil 'khor 'bum phrag bcu gcig dang stong phrag nyi shu'i rngams tshad/ dpag tshad 'bum phrag bcu gnyis stong phrag sum brgya (43na)phrag phyed lnga thad ga'i tshad du yod pa/ /'og gzhi'i rgya mtsho rlung gis bsrubs pa'i rkyen gyis gser gyi rdul spris ma'i tshul sra mkhregs su chags pa ni gser gyi sa gzhi ste dpag tshad sum 'bum nyis khri'i rngams tshad dang / sngar gyi chu'i tshad las thur du dpag tshad sum 'bum nyis khri bri bas 'og gzhi sa dkyil chags pa nas bzung chu la dpag tshad 'bum phrag brgyad yod cing / /gser de'i thad ga'i tshad ni chu dang mnyam la/ gnyis ka'i mtha'i skor ni sum 'gyur te dpag tshad sa ya gsum dang drug 'bum tshig khri sum brgya lnga bcu yod/ de'i steng du sngar bzhin char gyi rgyun babs pa mtshor 'khyil ba 'o ma bsrubs pa las mar bzhin du khams rab las ri rab/ 'bring las gser gyi ri bdun/ tha ma las lcags ri sna tsho gos las gling rnams chags pa'i dngul/be+e ḍūrla/ shel dmar/ gser las grub pa'i ri rab/ ri bdun gser dang / gling rnams sa shas che ba'i khams sna tshogs pa khor yug ni lcags kyi rang bzhin can no/ /ri bdun gyi bar na klu rnams rtse zhing rol ba'i mtsho bdun/ mu 'byud 'dzin ri'i ngos nasalcags ri la thug gi bar ba tshwa can gyi mtshos phyogs mtshams thams cad gang ba ri rab kyi phyogs mdog gis kha bsgyur te mtsho rnams kyang dkar sngo dmar ser du snang bar mtsho chen bzhir grags shing / nam mkha' la'ang phyogs mdog gi mdangs so sor 'char/ phyi'i rgya mtsho'i shar phyogs nas —52

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'dalus 'phags dbyibs zla gam du (43ba tshen nas pa/ de'i nub na lus dang shar na lus 'phags/ gling gsum pa de ni gling gzhan tā la bdun srid kyi gyen du 'phags pa'i phyir ram/ /der skyes pa'i mi rnams gzugs che zhing lta na sdug pa'i phyir de ltar grags/ nub na ba lang spyod byid bas zlum po/ de'i nub na g.yo ldan dang shar na lam mchog 'gro /gling de'i mi rnams ba lang dang rin po che la longs spyod pa shas che bas de ltar grags/ byang na sgra mi snyan dbyibs gru bzhi/ de'i nub na sgra mi snyan dang shar na sgra mi snyan gyi zla/ gling de'i mi rnams longs spyod rang rang gi dpag bsam gyi shing las 'byung zhing 'chi ba'i zhag bdun na 'chi'o zhes sgra 'byung bas de ltar brjod/ /lho na 'dzam gling dbyibs shing rta de'i nub na rnga yab dang gzhan te gtso bo dang gling g.yog gi tshul du yod pa'i lho phyogs kyi gling 'di ni dza na skye ba la'o zhes pa'i byings la bu ka rkyen du byin nas bsgrubs pas dzaskru tri shas mtshan pa'i gling yin pa dang / /mtsho ma dros pa na shing 'dzam bu la 'bras bu dmar po rdza ma tsam chu'i nang du lhung ba'i sgra la 'dzam bu'i sgra byung bas de ltar brjod cing / gling gzhan rnams longs spyod kyi sa pa yin kyang / 'di nyid las kyi sa par bshad cing / ri rab kyang chos mngon pa nas bshad pa dang / dpal dus kyi 'khor lo nas gsungs tshul mi mthun par rdo rje'i rwa'i dbyibs can du yod pa'i 'og gi gling drug ni longs spyod kyi sa pa dang / gling gzhan rnams ni las gyi sa pa yin pas/ bsdus(44na〉skyud las/ gling ni zla ba 'od dkar can dang rab mchog ku sha dang ni mi'am ci dang khrung khrung dang / /drag po yang ni longs spyod sa ste bdun par dzaskru'i mi rnams gnas pa dag ni las kyi sa/ /zhes byung zhing gling de'i lte ba so: ta'i skad du ma ga dha zhes pa bod skad du dbus 'gyur 'chang ste/ dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa rnams mchog gi sprul pa'i skur 'tshang rgyas zin rgya bzhin pa rgya bar 'gyur ba'i gnas yin pa'i gzi byin gyis bskal mtha' dus kyang 'byung bas mi gnod par mkha' la zo ba btags pa ltar gnas par bshad/ de dag gi mtha' skor du mnyan yod/ gnas bcas/ tsam pa ka /phub ral can/ yangs pa can/rgyal po'i khab ste grong khyer chen po drug dang / de dag gi phyi rol phyogs bzhir mi 'gyur ba'i gzer lta —53

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)bu dang don rtsis kyi sgo nas gdul bya 'dul ba'i ched du 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi bzhugs gnas rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga/ lto phyogs na dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor ye shes sems dpa' dngos su ma bsdus pa 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten chen po/ de'i thad kyi rgya mtsho'i 'gram na phyag na pad+ma'i pho brang po ta la/ nub na gsang sngags thams cad kyi 'byung gnas 6nyi ya na he ru ga rang byung gi gtsug lag khang / byang phyogs na ka lwa pa rigs ldan gyi grong khyer chen po na sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' sprul pa'i chos rgyal gyi rnam pas dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo'i smin grol la skal ldan rnams bkri bar (44ba)mdzad pa/ gzhan yang kye rdo rje/ saṃ bhu ṭi/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho sogs las 'dzam gling chung ngu 'di nyid na yul nyer bzhi dang dur khrod brgyad sogs gnas sum cu rtsa gnyis yod par bshad cing / rma bya chen mo nas yul 'khor lnga brgya/ ljongs chen po brgya drug /yul phran stong / mi rigasami gcig pa sum brgya drug cu/ skad rigs bdun brgya nyi shu sogs mtha' klas pa yod par grags shing / bye brag tu rdo rje gdan nas brtsis pa'i ri nag po dgu 'das pa'i pha rol na gangs ri dpal dang ldan pa dang / ri spos ngad ldan gnyis kyi bar na yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i mtsho ma dros pa/de'i shar phyogs kyi brag glang po che kha gdangs pa 'dra ba nas gaṅgā dngul gyi bye ma 'dren cing / chu phran lnga brgya dang bcas pa/ lho phyogs kyi brag khyu mchog gi kha 'dra ba nas sis be+e ḍūrla 'a bye ma 'dren cing /chu phran lnga brgya dang bcas pa/ nub phyogs kyi brag rta'i kha 'dra ba nas pak+ṣu shel gyi bye ma 'dren cing /chu phran lnga brgya dang bcas pa/ byang phyogs kyi brag seng ge'i kha 'dra ba nas si ta gser gyi bye ma 'dren cing / chu phran lnga brgya dang bcas pa rnams mtsho me skor ba lan bdun g.yas skor du byas nas rang rang gi phyogs kyi mtsho la 'bab pa/ spos ngad ldan gyi byang phyogs dpag tshad nyi shu na brag gser gyi bya skyibs can lha ma yin gyi ngos zhes bya ba brag g.yog brgyad stong dang bcas pa'i byang dpag tshad nyi shu 'das pa na shing swā la'i rgyal po rab brtan bya ba 'dom bzhi bcu thur dang brgyad cu gyen du 'phags pa/ su la'i stong po'i (45na 'phreng ba rim pa bdun gyis bskor ba/ de'i shar phyogs dpag tshad nyi shu —54

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ tanardzing bu dal gyis 'bab pa/ rdzing g.yog brgyad stong dang bcas pa yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chus gang ba'i nang na pad+ma'i 'dab ma ba lang gi ko ba tsam sdong bu gzhol mda' tsam/ me tog shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam la ro sbrang rtsi dang 'dra ba/ brgya byin gyi glang po che rab brtan de glang g.yog brgyad stong dang bcas dgun zla bzhi brag gser gyi bya skyibs/ dpyid zla bzhi shing swā la rab brtan/ ston zla bzhi rdzing bu dal gyis 'bab pa rnams su rgyu bar bshad cing / gling rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa 'dzam bu'i gling gi lte ba rdo rje gdan gyi spo la 'o skol gyi ston pa zas gtsang gi sras pos srod la bdud btul/ dgung la mnyam par bzhag tho rengs zad mi skye shes pa'i ye shes mngon du mdzad nas zhag zhe dgu 'das pa'i mthar mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pas gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong pa dang /brgya byin gyis gser gyi maṇ+ḍal dpag tshad lnga brgya pa zhig phul nas gsol ba btabs pas/ yul wa ra ṇa sir drang srong lhung ba ri dwags kyi nags su nyan thos kyi theg pa la yang dag par zhugs pa lnga sde bzang po la bka' dang po bden pa bzhi'i chos kyi 'khor lo/ gnas bya rgod phung po'i rir byang chub sems dpa' gtso bor gyur pa'i 'khor rnam pa bzhi'i dge 'dun la bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i chos 'khor/ yul yangs pa can du theg pa mtha' dag la yang dag par zhugs pa'i 'khor la tha ma legs pa rnam bar phye ba'i chos kyi (45ba)'khor lo bskor nas sde snod gsum gyi bstan pa ches shin tu dar ba las/ sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das pa'i phyi lo rgyal po'i khab tu dgra bcom pa lnga brgya tsho gis pa'i dbus su 'phags pa kun dga' bos mdo sde/ nye bar 'khor gyis 'dul ba/ 'od srungs chen pos mngone pa'i bka' rnams bsdus pa bka' bsdu dang po/ ston pa gshegs nas lo brgya dang bcu na dgra bcom pa grags pa la sogs pas mi rung ba'i bzhi bcu sun byung nas sde snod gsum zhal 'don mdzad pa bka' bsdu gnyis pa/ ston pa nongs('das skos lo bzhi brgya 'das pa na mnyan yod du byang chub sems dpa'/ dgra bcom pa/ so so skye bo'i paṇ+ḍi ta mang po 'dus te sde pa bco brgyad yang dag pa'i bstan par bcug cing / mi brjed pa'i gzungs ma thob pa rnams kyi don du gzungs thob pa rnams—55

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)kyis gsung rab yi ger bris te glegs bam du bzhengs pa bka' bsdu gsum pa yin/ de nas ring zhig gi bar nyan thos kyi sde snod dar yang theg pa chen po ming tsam du gyur pa'i tshe/ ji skad du/ shin tu dpag par dka' ba rgyal ba'i yum/ /ji bzhin dgongs pa 'grel mdzad 'dzam gling rgyan/ /klu sgrub thogs med ces ni sa gsum na/ /yongs su grags pa'i zhabs la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /zhes sngon chad gzhan gyis bgrod ma myongs par sa mkhan mkhas pa dag gis lam gyi sgo phye ba ltar dngos bstan stong nyid dang sbas don mngon par rtogs pa'i thegs pa chen po'i gzhung lugs rma med pa dag gi srol legs par phye bas/ dpal mgon 'phags (46na)pa klu sgrub dang / 'phags pa thogs med gnyis la shing rta chen po gnyis zhes nyi zla ltar grags shing / klu sgrub kyi rjes su 'brangs ba thal rang gnyas dang / thogs med kyi rjesangs sems tsam rnam bden rdzun/ gzhan yang mdo sdepa dang bye smra ba sogs grub mtha' smra ba bzhi'i paṇ+ḍita rnams kyi thub pa'i gsung rab/ 'chad nyan gyisagatan la phab/ mda' bsnun zhabs dang rnal 'byor dbang phyug dpal ldan chos stong sogs grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur pa rnams kyis skal ldan rnams rdo rje theg pa'i smin grol la bkod de rgya gar gyi yul gru phal cher dam pa'i chos kyis dkar por gyur na'ang bod kha ba can mun pa'i smag rum lta bur dam pa'i chos 'byung ba ni/ sangs rgyas nyid gyis/ gdong dmar can gyi yul du dar bar lung bstan cing /de yang 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ kha ba can du mtsho bri nas/ sa su'i nag ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ zhesabod gyi yul mtsho ge gang ba sal thim nas swā la'i nags chags/ de nas rim gyis dud 'gro'i 'gro ba mang du 'phel/ de nas thugs rje chen pos byin gyis brlabs pa'i spre'u dang brag srin mo 'dus pa lasarigs drug nas tshe 'phos pa'i phrug gu drug byung ba rnams rim gyis spu byi zhing mjug ma thung ngur gyur nas mi'i dbyibs can du song / de dag rnams las rim gyi 'phel bar sga sdong 'bru gsum dgra dang bzhi/ nu bo dpa' mda' gnyis te bod mi'u gdung drug gis rgyal khams gang / de'i tshe ma sangs rgyasaspun dgu rgyal phran nyi shu rtsa lnga/ bcu gnyis/(46ba thal ma bzhi bcus rim gyis dbang byas/ 'on —56

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'dakyang glegs bam rin po cher/ bod ni rgyal po dag la tshad mar byed/ spyi la dbang pa'i rgyal po zhig med na dge ba bcu'i khrims 'tshal mi nus par dgongs te thugs rje chen po'i 'phrin las kyi mthu las rgya gar rgyal po dmag brgya pa'i sras rje gnya' khri btsan po lha ri zhol po'i rtser byon pa yon tan can gyi mi bcu gnyis kyis mthong ste gang nas 'ong dris pas mkha' la mdzub mo ger ba na lha nas 'ongs bar go ste gnya' ba'i khri la bteg nas gdan drangs 'bangs rnams kyi rjer mnga' gsol ba ni bod spyi la dbang ba'i thog ma yin/ chab srid sgrung lde'u bon gyis bskyangs/ de yang 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan pho brang yom (yum )bu gla sgang du bzhugs pa'i tshe/ nam mkha' nas dpang skong phyag brgya pa/ nga ma ṇi'i rkos phor/ gser gyi mchod rten/ mdo gza ma tog gi snying po yi ge drug pa rnams babs pa ci yin ma mkhyen kyang / mtshan gnyan po gsang bar btags nas mchod pa phul bas rgyal po slar yang gzhen sha can du gyur nas dgung lo drug cu 'phel bas brgya nyi shu'i bar bzhugs te bstan pa'i dbu brnyes/ de nas rgyal rabs lnga song ba na spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa mi rje srong btsan sgam pos thu mi saṃ sto ṭa rgya gar du brdzangs te sgra rig la mkhas par gyur pa rgyal blon gnyis kyis skyid shod nyang phran pho brang dmar rur rgya yig las bod kyi skad dang mthun par gtan la phab/ rgya bal gyi sras mo btsun mor bsus pa'i skal (47na)rdzong du jo shaka rnam gnyis sogs rten khyad par can gdan drangs/ rgyal blon gsum gyis pho brang dmar rur rigs gsum mgon po bsgrubs pas zhal gzigs/ bod srin mo gan rgyal du bsnyel ba lta bu'i sa'i me btsa' gnon par mtha' 'dul yang 'dul ru gnon gyi gtsug lag khang bcu gnyis brtsigs rjes/ gangs can gyi rdo rje gdan 'phrul snang dang ra mo che'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ rgya gar nas slob dpon ku sar dang / bram ze shrīkar/bal po'i slob dpon shrī la ma rgya nag gi slob dpon ha shang mahā ya na la sogs pa spyan drangs nasasde snod gsum dang / rgyud kyi cha lag mang rab bsgyur zhes ka khol mar byung / rgyal po nyid kyis thugasarje chen po zhi khro'i chos skor skal ldan mang por gnang nas grub pa brnyes pa sogs bstan pa'i srol —57

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)btod/ de nas mi rabs lnga na 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam par 'phrul pa mnga' bdag khri srong lde btsun gyis/ paṇ+ḍita chen po shān+ta ra k+ṣita spyan drangs/ mkhan pos dge ba bcu dang khams bco brgyad la brten pa'i chos gsungs shing yan lag brgyad pa'i khrims phog pas/ srid pa chags pa'i lha chen mthu bo che rnams ma dga' bar gnyan chen thang lhas dmar po rir thog phab/ yar lha she cas yar klungs phang thang gi pho brang chu la bskur/ bstan ma bcu gnyis kyis mi nad phyugs nad mang du btang bas mkhan pos lha srin 'dul bar sngags mkhan 'dzam bu'i gling na che ba'i brtul zhugs can pad+ma 'byung gnas gdan drongs zhes lung bstan pa (47ba lnga zhin pho nya mngags pa ltar lha srin gdug pa can thams cad dam la btags/ nam mkha' la rdo rje'i 'gros dang bcas te sa gzhi btul/ o tan+ta pu ri'i gtsug lag khang la dpe blangs pa'i zan g.yang mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ be+e ro tsa na sogs 'bangs blo rno ba mang pos lo tsā ba slabs/ mkhan pos sad mi mi bdun sogs rab tu byung ste bstan pa'i rtsa ba btsugs/ bi mā la mi tra/ sangs rgyas gsang ba/ shi dha gar+bha sogs paṇ+ḍita mtha' yas pa sbyan drangs/ 'chad nyan gyis gtan la phab/ rje 'bangs nyer lnga sogasasnod ldan mang por slob dpon chen pos yo ga rnam pa gsum gyis smin grol la bkod nas sa thams cad grub thob gyis bkang / be+e ro rma gnyags gnubs sogs kyis kun 'byed rgyal po/ mdo dgongasa'adus/ sgyu 'phrul sgrub sdo brgyad kyis rgyud lung man ngag rnams gsang ba'i tshul gyis bsgyur/ mkhyen pa'i spyan ldan si tu thams cad mkhyen pas rgyud bzhugs tshogs ches pas tshang ma 'drir ma nus kyi dogs nas gtso bsdus glegs bam gsum tsam du tshang bar dkar chag tu btab/ ma 'ongs pa'i don du phyon chen po ri brag mtsho gsum thams cad zab gter gyis bkang / lha sras mu khri btsan pos rgyal sde skar chung gi gtsug lag khang bzhengs shing lo paṇa rnams bla'i mchod gnas su bkur/ rgyal po yab sras 'di gnyis kyi ring la bstan pa dar rgyas su gyur/ de sras dpal phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa mnga' bdag khri lde gtsug brtan ni/ sgra sbyor bam (48na)po gnyis pa las/ rta'i lo la btsan po khri lde sgong 58

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod jos khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'dabatsan pho brang 'u shang rdo na bzhugs/ stod smad kyi dmag rje dang rkun chen btul/ gar log gi pho nyas phyags 'tshal zhing / nyi 'og gi mkhan po dzi na mi tra/ su ren+d+ra bodhi dwa na shī la sogs/ paṇ+ḍi ta du ma dang /lo tsā ba ska cog sogs gdan 'dzom par byas te yab mes kyi dus bsgyur ba'i 'gyur dka' ba rnams la skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab cing sngar ma 'gyur ba du ma gsar du bsgyur nas bstan pa nyi ma shar ba ltar mdzad/ mes dbon gsum po 'di'i ring lo paṇa byon tshul chos yang rnams mthun mi mthun sna tshogs pas kha tshon chod dka' ba'i phyir gsung rab bsgyur ba 'di dag mes dbon gsum gyi sku ring la byung bar nges pas phyogs gcig tu bkod par/ sde snod gsum las 'dul ba gzhi blo ka sum khri nyis stong bdun brgya/ bam po brgya dang dgu rnams paṇa chen sarba dz+nyā de wa/ bi rgyu kā ra bra bha/ dha rmā kā ra/ lo tsā ba ban+de dpal gyi lhun po/ slad kyi paṇ+ḍita ka ra bha dang / lo tsā ba baṇ+ḍi dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur ba/ dge slong pha'i so thar blo ka bdun brgya bam po so gnyis/ de'i rgya cher 'grel gyi rnamasa'abyed blo ka nyis khri bzhi stong dgu brgya bam po brgyad cu rtsa gsum/ dge slong ma'i so thar slo ka brgyad brgya bam po gnyis/ de rgyas par ston pa ma'i rnam 'byed glo ka brgyad stong bzhi brgya bam po nyer brgyad/sgyur byed gong 'dra/ gzhung bla ma'i zhu ba ma rdzogs pa blo ka gsum brgya bam po bcu gnyis/ zhu ba rdzogs(48ba tha blo ka tshig khri lnga stong dgu brgya bam po nga gsum gnyis kyi 'gyur lo tsā ba klu'i rgyal mtshan sogs kyis bsgyur bar mtshal pa bka' 'gyur du bshad/ rlangs kham pa go chas 'bum thugs la bzung nas bsgyur pas rlangs kyi thugs 'gyur ma/ rje btsad po'i mtshal khrag dang / ra dkar gyi 'o ma sbyar nas bris pa'i dum ba bzhi pa la regazig dmar po/ sbas mnyu shrī dang myang iṇ+ḍa ba ro gnyis kyis blangasapa'i rgya dpe'i steng nas yo byad rnams mnga' 'bangs la dbya khral bsdus nas bsgyur bas dbya 'bum du grags/ rje'i dbu skra'i gshob rams la bsres te ra dkar gyi 'o ma dang sbyar nas bris pa'i regazig sngon po dum pa bzhi pa de la lcags thur brgyus pas lcags thur can du grags so/ /reg zig sngo dmar gnyis rdo tshil gyis yab yob tu bsgyur bas de'i ming du thogs shing / bla —59

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)'gyur chung bar yang ngos 'dzin/ lo chen be+e ros 'gyur bcos mdzad pa glegs shing la gras nas dum bu drug pa par bkab can dang / pha wang gis tshang bsags nas pha wang can du grags pa bla 'gyur 'bring po/ 'bum gyi bam po de la shog dril rer byas ke tu gling du rab byung sum brgya la 'brom bza' byang chub sman gyis bsnyen bkur nas tshar re sgrog pa'i snod la ming btags te sha sgro can yum 'bring po bam po gya lnga/ le'u don drug yum bsdus pa bam po nyer bzhi/ le'u so gnyis pa/ 'gyur bcos kyi dbang gis mi 'dra ba gsum du byung ba phreng ba can dang / gzo sbyangs dang / sde can/ paṇ+ḍita shākya rtsen dang / dz+nya na si rnyi/ lo tsā (49na)ba dha rma tā shā las bsgyur/ khri brgyad stong pa bam po drug cu le'u gya gnyis pa lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde sogs kyis bsgyur/ shes rab khri pa bam po sum cu/ le'u so gsum pa paṇ+ḍi ta dzin mi tra/ pradz+nyā wa rma/ lo tsā ba ye shes sde gsum gyis bsgyur/ sher phyin sna tshogs pa nas sdud pa/ bi sdika ra sidha dang / dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ shes rab rtsal gyi rnam par gnon pas zhus pa bam po bdun pa/ shi len+d+ra bo dhi dang dzin mi tra/ lo tsā ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ 'gyur gong 'dra'i sher phyin bdun brgya pa/ lnga brgya pa/ sum brgya pa shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ sher phyin brgya lnga bcu pa/ nyer lnga pa/ lnga bcu pa/ yi ge gcig ma/ sher rab snying po glo ka nyer lnga pa paṇ+ḍi ta dri med bshes gnyen dang /lo tsā ba rin chen sde'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa dum bu zhe dgu yod pa'i sdom pa gsum bstan pa'i mdo/ dzi na mi tra/ su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ sgo mtha' yas pa su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ gsang ba bsam gyi mi khyab pa/ dzi na mi tra/ dā na shī la mu ni wa rma/ ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ rmi lam nges par bstan pa dang / bde ba can gyi zhing bkod bam po gsum pa/ dzi na mi tra/ dwa na shī la/ ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ mi zhakhrugs pa'i zhing bkod/ dzi na mi tra/ su ren+d+ra/ ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa go ma bkod pa dang / chos dbyings rang bzhin gyi dbye ba med par bstan pa/ theg pa chen po'i chos bcu bstan ba/ 'phags(49ba7 kun nas sgo'i legadzi na mi tra/ su ren+d+ra/ ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ 'od zer kun nas bkye ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdosnod —60

sku gsung thugs rten gsar tsongs dang mchod rdza khang bzang gi dkar ga glegs bam gsum pa/ 6)bstan pa/su ren+d+ra/shī len+d+ra/chos smi tshul khrims gsum gyi 'gyur/dga' bo mngal du gnas pa/dga' bo mngal du 'jug pa/'jam dpal gyi yon to bkod pa/shī len+d+ra bo dhi/dzi na mi tra/ye shesasde'i 'gyur/yab sras mjal ba/shī len+d+ra/dzi na mi tra/dā na shī la/ye shes sde'i 'gyur/gang posazhug pa/yul 'khor skyong gis zhug pa/dzi na mi tra/dwa na shī la/mu ni wa rma/ye shes sde'i 'gyur/drag shul ༅ gyis zhus pa/su ren+d+ra dang ye shes sde'i 'gyur/glog thab kyis zhug pa/bzang po lung bstan pa/dzi na mi tra/bra lha wa rma/ye shes sde'i 'gyur/cho 'phrul bstan pa/byams pa seng ge'i sgra/nye bar 'khor gyis zhug pa/lhag pa'i bsam pa bskul ba/dzi na mi tra/pradzha warma/su ren+d+ra/ye shesasde'i 'gyur/lag bzang gis zhug pa/dā na shī la/dzi na mi tra/ye shes sde'i 'gyur/des pas zhusapa/dzi na mi tra/su re ji/ye shes sde'i 'gyur/dpal byin gyis zhus pa/bad sa'i rgyal po char byed kyis zhug pa/bu mo blo gros bzang mos zhus pa/dzin mi tra/dwa na shrī la/ye shes sde'i 'gyur/mya ga med kyis byin pa lung bstan pa/dzi na mi tra dang ye shes sde'i 'gyur/dri med kyis byin pa lung bstan pa/dzi na mi tra/su re spro/ye shes sto 4ra/yon to rin bo che me kho kun nas rgyas pa/dzi na mi 50na ) tra/bradz+nyā wa rma/ye shes sde'i 'gyur/bsam gyis mi khyab par bstan pa/dzi na mi tra/dwa na shī la/mu ni wa rma/ye shes sde'i 'gyur/lha bu'i blo gros rab gnas kyis zhug pa/lo tsā ba klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/seng ges zhus pa/dwa na shī la/mu ni wa rma/me shes sde'i 'gyur/byang sems ye shes dam pas zhug pa/dwa na shī la/lto wa rma/ye shes sde'i 'gyur/tshong dpon bzang po skyong gisazhus pa/dzi na mi tra/su ren+d+ra/ye shes sto 'gyur/bu mo rnam dag dang ba dang /byams pas zhug pa'i chos brgyad pa/dzi na mi tra/dwa na shī la/ye shes sto 'gyur/'od srungs kyis zhug ba/dzi na mi tra/su re rlu/ye shes sto tsor/si bo tsho phung bo lung bstan pa/su ren+d+ra dang ye shes sto stir/blo gros mi zad pa dang /'jam dpal gyis zhus pa 'gyur gong tsā/gtsug na rin po ches zhus pa/ka mā la shī la dang /chos i tshul khrims kyi 'gyur// mo dpal phreng gi mdo/dzi na mi tra/su re spro/ye

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()shes sde'i 'gyur/drang srong rgyas pas zhus pa/dzi na mi tra/dwa na shī la/ye shes sde'i 'gyur/shin tu rgyas pa' sde snod sangs rgyas phal po che/sdong po bkod pa/bzang spyod kyi mjug sdud dang bcas par blo ka sum khri dgu stong sum cu/bam po brgya sum cu/blo ka sum cu pa rgya nag 'gyur/mdo 〈sna tshogs pa las/mdo sde bskal bzang paṇ+ḍita bi sdi ka ra si dha dang /lo tsā ba dpal dbyangs kyisabasgyur pa slar yang ska ba dpal 50ba〉rtsegs kyi 'gyur/rgya cher rol pa/'jam dpal rnam par rol ba/'jam dpal rnam par 'phrul pa/ye shes rgyas pa'i mdo/sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yul la 'jug pa/zung gi mdo/khye'u snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pas bstan pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs/dkyil 'khor brgyad pa/dgongs pa nges 'grel/lang gshegs/ga ya sto ri/rgyan stug po bkod pa/snying rje pad dkar/dam chos pad dkar/yon to bkod pa'i rgyal po/bde ba tso gyi bkod pa/za ma tog bkod pa/dkon mchog gi za ma tog bkod pa/'phags pa rin po che'i mtha'/myang 'das/myang 'das chen po/'da' ka ye shes/chos kyi mdzod/dkon mchog 'byung gnas/gser gyi mdo/gser gyi bye ma lta bu'i mdo/ting 'dzin rgyal po/thams cad la snang ba'i mdo/sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin/ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i ting 'dzin/dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting 'dzin/da ltar gyi sangs rgyasamadzo sum du 'i bzhugs pa to 'dzin/bsod nams thams cad bsdus pa'i ṣi 'dzin/khye'u bzhi'i kho 'dzin/ṣi nge 'dzin gyi mchog dam pa/tog gzungs/sgo mtha' yas pa'i gzungs/sgo drug pa'i gzungs/rnam par mi rtog pa'i gzungs/tshigs su bcad pa gnyis pa'i gzungs/dad pa rab tu goms pa/byang chub sems dpa'i spyod yul thabs kyi yul la rnam par 'phrul pa bstan pa/gzungasakyi dbang phyug rgyal pos zhus pa'i mdo/nam mkha' mdzod kyis zhus pa/spobs pa'i blo gros kyisazhug pa/51na ) blo gros rgya mtshos zhug pa/klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos zhug pa che 'bring chung gsum/klu rgyal ma dros pas zhus pa/mi'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pas zhug pa/tshangs pas zhus pa/tshangs pas byin gyis zhug pa/tshangs pa khyad par sems kyis zhuX/lha'i bu rab rtsal sems kyis zhus pa/dpal

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'dadabyig gis zhug pa/rin cen dra can gyis zhus pa/bde byed sa zhus pa/yul 'khor skyong sa zhusapa/rnam par 'phrul pa'i rgyal pos zhug pa/lha mo dri ma med pas 'od kyis zhug pa/bu mo rin cen sa rgyas zhug pa/bram ze mo dpal ldan gyis zhus pa/bgres mos zhug pa/'jam dpal gyis dris pa/'jig rten 'dzin gyis dris pa/blo gros mi zad par bstan pa/li 〈bye dri ma med par grags pasabastan pa/'jam dpal gyis bstan pa/byang chub kyi phyogs bstan pa/kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i bden pa bstan pa/chos thams cad 'byung ba med par bstan pa/phar phyin snga ma lnga bstan pa/sbyin pa'i phar phyin bstan pa/sbyin pa'i phan yon bstan pa/byang sems spyod pa bstan pa/de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan dang ye shes bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i yul la 'jug pa bstan pa/sangs rgyas kyi stobs bskyed pa'i cho 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pa bstan pa/sangs rgyas kyi chos bsam gyi mi khyab pa bstan pa/mar me mdzad kyis lung bstan pa/tshangs pa'i dpal lung bstan pa/bud med 'gyur ba lung bstan pa/bu mo zla ba mchog lung bstan pa/bde ldan ma lung bstan pa/51bsko mo chen po dpal lung bstan pa/rgyal ba'i blo gros spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo//'jam dpal gnas pa/byamasapa bdud rtsi brjod pa/byams pa 'jug pa/chos kyi rje su mthun par 'jug pa/dad pa'i stobasabaskyed pa la 'jug pa phyag rgya'i mdo/nges pa dang ma nges pa phyag rgya la 'jug pa/cho me kyi phyag rgya/mar me 'bul ba/grong khyer gyi cho ga/zas kyi 'tsho ba rnam par dag pa/glang po'i rtsal lta bu/sgra chen po/seng ge'i sgra sgrags pa/sa lu ljang pa'i mdo/rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba dang po dang rnam par dbye ba bstan pa/rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba/sor mo'i 'phreng ba la phan pa/gzugs can snying por gdams pa/bad sa'i rgyal po 'char byed la gdams pa/ma skyes dgra'i 'gyod pa bsal ba/dpal sbas kyi mdo/las sgrib rnam par dag/las sgrib rgyun gcod pa/tshul khrims 'chal ba tshar gcod pa/gsal rgyal la gdams pa/sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i les lhag bsam bstan pa'i mdo/gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba/srid pa 'pho ba rnam ༷ra 'thag pa sdud pa/sangs rgyas 'gro ba/de bzhin

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()gshegs pa 'gro ba/de bzhin gshegs pa'i dpal gyi dam tshig/dkon mchog sprin/sprin chen mo'i mdo che chung bzhi/byang sems spyod bsdus/dpa' bar 'gro ba'i mdo/bdud kyi le'u nyer 'tshe phyung ba/chos thams cad yang dag par bsdus pa/sa'i snying po 'khor lo bcu pa/phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo/ting nge 'dzin gyi 'khor lo/yongs52nasgo bsngo ba'i 'khor lo/chos kyi rgyal po'i yi ge/chos kyi tshul/chos kyi phung po/chos kyi rnam par rgyal ba/chos dang don rnam par rgyal ba/cho ge dang don rnams par 'byed pa/chos bzhi sgrub pa'i mdo/chos bzhi bstan pa/chos bzhi pa/chos bzhi mi btang ba/bzhi sgrub pa/chos gsum pa'i mdo/chos kyi rgyal mtshan/chos kyi rgya mtsho/chos kyi rgyal mo/mdo nyi ma'i snying po/de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po/yi ge med pa'i za ma tog/nam mkha'i snying po/thabs la mkhas pa'i mdo/sangs rgyas kyi mtshan lnga stong bzhi brgya nga gsum pa/nam mkha'i mdog gis 'dul ba'i bzod pa bstan pa/sangs rgyas yongs su grub pa rnam par bkod pa/phyag 'tshal dang mtshan nas brjod pa'i gleng gzhi/me tog gi tsho gos gyi mdo/dpang sgong phyag brgya pa/bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyal po/phyogs bcu mun sel/sangs rgyas bdun pa/sangs rgyas brgyad pa/sangs rgyas bcu pa/sangs rgyas bcu gnyis pa/sangs rgyas kyi dbu rgyan/sangs rgyas mi spong ba/sangs rgyas kyi sa/dkyil 'khor brgyad pa/bkra shis brgyad pa/dkon chog gsum rjes dran/bslab pa gsum/sku gsum/phung po gsum pa rnams kyi mdo/bsam pa rdzogs par byed pa/'gro ba skyob pa'i bsngo ba dran pa nyer gzhag/sgyu ma'i dra ba/gzugs can snying pos bsu ba/stong pa nyid/stong nyid chen po/rgyal mtshan mchog/rgyal mtshan dam pa/lnga gsum pa/rdo 'phang ba'i mdo/ga cho sgo nu dpe'i mdo/khams mang po'i mdo/gaṇ+ḍi'i 52ba ) mdo/dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa'i mdo/yon
