to bstan pa'i mdo/tshe mtha'i mdo/'chi 'pho ba ji ltar 'gyur ba bstan pa'i mdo/mi rtag pa'i mdo gnyis/'du shes bcu dang bcu gcig bstan pa/yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa'i mdo/mtshan mo bzang po'i mdo/mun gyi nags tshal gyi ༷do/pha ma'i mdo/bden bzhi'i mdo/gdon mi za

sku gsung thugasarten gsar bzhengasadang mchod rdzasakhang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ tanaba'i chosakyi rnam grangs/ don rgyasapa'i chosakyi rnam grangs/ med du byung ba'i chosakyi rnam grangs/ de bzhin gshegasapa'i gzugs brnyan bzhag ba'i phan yon/ mchod rten skor ba'i tshigs bcad/gsal rgyal latshigasasu bcad pa/ brgya pa/ gcig pa/ bzhi pa/ klu rgyal rnga sgra'i tshigasasu bcad pa/ched rngo brjod pa'i tshoms/ skyesabu dam pa'i mdo/ dga' bo rab tu byung ba'i mdo/ lha'i mdo che chung/zla ba khang bu brtsegasapa/ gnasa'ajog /'khar gsil 'chang ba'i mchog /chosakyi 'khor lo/ rnam par smin pa'i 'brasabu bstan pa/ lasarnam par 'byed pa rnamasakyi mdo/ rnam par 'gyur ba'i gzhung / lasabargya tham pa/ 'dzangs blun/ byams pa lung bstan pa/ gang po la sogs pa'i rtogs brjod brgya pa/ sangs rgyas kyi rtogs brjod/ phag mo'i rtogs rjod/ bzang mo'i rtogs brjod/ bsod namasastobasakyi rtogasabarjod/ zla 'od kyi rtogasabarjod/ dpal gyi rtogasabarjod/ rgyal po ser mdog gi sngon gyi sbyor ba bstan pa/ rgyal bu don grub /tshangs pa'i dra ba/ drin lan bsab pa gsum gyi mdo/ legs nyesakyi rgyu 'bras bstan (53na)pa/ dge mi dge'i lasakyi rnam smin bstan pa/ gnas 'jig lung bstan pa/ ri glang ru lung bstan pa/ stagarna'i rtogasabarjod sogasamang du 'gyur bar dkar chag phang thang ma ldan dkar ma sogs su byung zhing / bstan pa phyi dar la dmar g.yo gtsang gsum gyis 'dul ba dre'u la khal du bkal nasamado smad du byon/ de'i tshe bon po'i bu mu zu gsal 'bar gyisagatsang la mkhan po dang g.yo la las slob bcol nas rab tu byung zhing mtshan dge ba rab gsal du btags/ lo dusal slebasapa na gong gi mkhan slob gnyisakyi steng du dmar gyisagasang ston dang /rgya'i ha shang ke wang dang / 'bag gis kha skong byasanasabasnyen par rdzogs/ thugasarab shin tu gsal nas dgongs pa rab gsal du grags/ /bla chen 'di'i mkhan bu lasarim gyis dbus gtsang gi phyogs su 'phel bar bla chen brgyud pa de nas rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍita dha rma pā la las zhang zhung rgyal ba'i shes rab kyis sdom pa bzhes/slob ma mkhasapa swā dhu pā la/ gu ṇa pā la/ bradz+nya pā la gsum la sdom rgyun 'phel par stod 'dul ba/—65—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shākya shrī'i mkhan bu 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa dang / byang rdor rnam gnyis las 'phel bar paṇa chen brgyud pa zhes bstan pa'i rtsa ba tshugs/ paṇ+ḍita smri ti dz+nyā na shrī lnga brgya pa rnams kyis gtsug gi nor bu jo bo a ti sha nas nags kyi rin chen gyi bar gyi nang pa'i tshad thub kyi paṇ+ḍi ta kha yar byon/ khyad par jo bo a ti sha la sgrol mas lung bstan pa'i (53ba〉lhom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byungaganas dang / khu rngog nag tsho lo tsā ba/ ka ba shākya dbang phyug sogs slob ma bsam gyis mi khyab cing /'brom gyis sras sku mched gsum la brten nas bka' gdams pa zhes gnam gyis sa bkab pa lta bu'i bstan pa dar/ rngog lo bstan pa'i nyi ma blo ldan shes rab kyis phar tshad kyi gzhung mang du bsgyur zhing rigs lam gyi sgo nas gtan la phab/ gang gi lugs 'dzin phya gtsang sogs mkhas pa rnams la brten nas dpal ldan gsang bu'i ma dros pa'i mtsho chen po las/ gangs ri'i khrod kyis bshad pa'i chu bo chen po bzhi babs/ rgyud nas sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud/ 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi rtog pa/ ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i rtog pa sogs kha yar zhig ma gtogs bstan pa snga dar gyi dus ma 'gyur zhing / lo chen rin cen bzang po/ gzhon nu tshul khrims/ chag chos rje dpal/ 'bro shes rab grags/ pho brang zhi ba 'od/ sa paṇa sogs skad gnyis smra ba du mas rtsa rgyud de nyid 'dus pa/ bshad rgyud rdo rje rtse mo/ cha mthun gyi rgyud dpal mchog sogs rnal 'byor rgyud kyi skor mang po/ 'brog mi lo tsā ba shākya ye shes kyis gur brtag sam gsum/ mal lo tsā ba blo gros grags dang / mar do chos kyi dbang phyug gis bde mchog skor/ sgra bsgyur mar pa lo tsā dang 'gos khug pa lha ba smyo btsaba'i kyis 'dus pa 'phags lugs/ /gnyal 31 tsā ba dha rma grags kyis ye shes zhabs lugs/ ra skyo zhang gsum/ gnyos mal rnams kyis (54na〉dgra gdong 'jigs gsum/chag lo chos rje dpal dang slo bo lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyis gshed dmar/ rwa 'bro shong ston chen pos rgyud 'grel/ shong dpang nas zhwa lu lo chen brgyud par bcas pa'i bar du byon pa rnams kyis sgra snyan mngon brjod sdeb sbyor zlos gar sogs tha snyad rig pa'i gtsug lag dkar po rnam gsum —66

sku gsung thug rten gsang bzhengs dang mchod jo khang bzang gi dkar chag gleg bam gsum pa/ tanasogs sa skya ba rjes 'brangs dang / bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa yab sras kyis rgyud sde bzhi'i bshad pa smin grol gyi gdams pa/ rje btsun mi la'i sras nyi zla ltar grags pa ras chung pa dang / mnyam med dwags po lha rje sogs las sgrub rgyud kyi bstan pa/ so zur gnubs gsum/ nyang chos dbang sogs kyis mdo sgyu sems gsum gyis mtshon pa'i bka' gter gyi bshad sgrub rgya cher 'phel/ khyad par bdag nyid chen po btsong kha ba blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyi mdzad pa ni/ thub bstan spyi'i bshes gnyen chen po 'gos lo ye bzang rtse pa'i zhal snga nas/ gnyal gyi mo la'i rtsar zhags mdzad pas khyod sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon ba dang 'dra ba zhig 'ong bar shes par gyis shig ces pa'i lung bstan pa brnyes/ yi dam gyis kyang 'dul ba'i bslab pa la brten nas gas la phan pa chen por 'gyur par lung bstan pas thog mar dpon slob rnams kyis bla gos dras shing drubs pa dang lhung bzed dang gding ba la sogs pa'i yo byad rnams bsnams nas gzhan dag gis mthong na rab tu byung pa'i tshul ni 'di lta bu zhig kho na'o/ /zhes yid ches par 'gyur (54ba thar mdzad nas phyis ni lo re'am zla re tsam chos nyan par rtsol ba'i slob ma dag kyang 'dul ba'i kun tu spyod pa la bkod pa mngon sum du gyur pa lta zhog /rgyang ring po nas thos pa dag kyang sbu long g.yo pas phyogs thams cad du snyan pasakhyab ste/ 'gran zla med par gyur/ zhes pa ltar 'dul ba'i sde snod las byung ba'i bcas pa phra mo tshun chad kyis mtha' brten pa dag kyang bshad pa tsam du ma lus par phyag len du btab pas thub pa'i bstan pa rma med par gsos pa'i rtsa ba tshugs/ shing rta chen po gnyis las legs par brgyud pa'i lam gyi rim pa 'chad nyan gyis gtan la phab/ rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang khrid bshad bka' phal mo che dang / gsang ba 'dus pa dang 'khor lo sdom pa gnyis la rtsal du bton cing / khyad par dbu ma'i lta ba dang rim lnga'i sgyu lus kyi skor la sngon med pa'i legs par bshad pas mkhas pa'i dbang po stag tshang lo tsā bas kyang / khyod blo gzhon nu'i nyin mo'i dus kyi tshe/ /mdo dang rgyan gyi pad tshal rgyas mthong nas/ /bdag blo khengs pa'i ku mud lhag par zum/ /zhes dang / gsang spyi sngags dang khyad par pha —67

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)rgyud dang / /pha rgyud spyi dang khyad par sgyu lusal/ /sngon med legasabashad gter chen khyod la 'dud/ /ces dbang rnon chos rjes 'brangs te mkhas pa mkhas pa'i drung na mdzes pa'i bsngags brjod yin no//rgyu mtshan des na bod yul 'dir rgya gar la 'gran par nus pa'i bstan pa ches cher dar bas na/ jo bo chen po rdo rje gdan gyi nub phyogasa'od dpag med pa'i lha khang du byang chub kyi semasal (55na)thugs spyod pa'i tshe spyan ras gzigs kyis zhal bstan nas skyes bu dam pa legs so legs so dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba'i mdzod gang yin pa de khyod kyis shes sam/'di nas byang phyogs na nga'i zhing khams yod/ khyod kyi yi dam jo mo sgrol ma'ang de na semasacan gyi don mdzad cing bzhugs/ khyod kyi gdul bya mang po'ang de na yod pas byang phyogs bod du song zhigacesadang / khro phu lo tsā bas/ be+eḍū r+ya'i tshong 'dusanasakha che paṇa chen la phul ba'i zhu yig tu/ ma gadha sogs rigs 'byung gnasakyang sdig to yis/ /dmag tshogs kyisabacom o rgyan kha che bal yul yang / /log spyod kyis khengasadeng sang bstan srog legasaganas ni/ /bod yul 'dir zad skyes chen byang phyogasazhabasabaskyod zhu/ /zhesadang / bde mchog rtsa rgyud las/ bod kyi yuladang de bzhin du/ ma la ba dang pu li sogs/ nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i yul yin no/ /zhes bod 'di gsung 'khor gyi gnas brgyad kyi zla tshad dang kye rdor gyi gnas dang sa sbyar ba'i sa bcu gnyis par bshad pa sogs gnas dus yon tan bya spyod mtha' dag nasakhyad par du 'gyur zhing / deng sang yang bstan pa'i srog legasapar gnas/ bstan pa'i snying po'ang lung rtogasaganyisalas/ rtogs pa'i bstan pa rgyud la skye ba lung gi bstan pa la rag lusashing / de'i tshad mar gyur pa'i dpang po ni dri ma med pa'i thub pa'i gsung rab yin pas/ sngon gyi mkhas grub dam pa rnams kyisagaces sprasasu mdzad pa'i phyir/ chosakyi rgyal po (55brkopal ldan 'phags pa'i thugs dam du mdo mangs lha mi'i rgyan mchog 'dar phyar bsabazhengasapa'i gtsang chu mig ring mo'i mdo mangs/ gru spang rtsasabazhedasapa'i 'dzam gling rgyan/ dpal snar thang gi mkhan chen mchimasakyi gser gzhung ma/ phyugs—6ཿ—

sku gsung thug rten gsar bzhedas dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag lhags bam gsum pa/ 9)rgyal ma/dgon gsar ma le tshan/zhwa lu gser khang gi mdo mangs/spun gsum gtsug lag khang du bzhugs pa'i mdo mangs so gos rnams grangs shin tu mang zhing /dbus ba blo gsal/lo tsā ba bsod nams 'od zer/rgyang ro byang chub 'bum sogs mkhas pa mang pos snar thang du sher phyogs dang rgyud 'bum 'thor ba rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs shing /mkhas pa'i dbang po ral gyis dkar chag nyi ma'i 'od zer mdzad/ma phyi de dag la brten nas si tu thams cad mkhyen pa dge ba'i blo gros kyisabaka' 'gyur ro cog rdzogs par bzhengs shing /gzhung gi bzhugs tshul rnams kyang phan tshun 'brel btsal ba'i sdebs lugs phun sum tsho gos par grags/ma phyi 'di la brten nas gong du gnam gyi lha yung lo tā ming rgyal pho sku rim du chos sbyin ma zad pa'i bar du bskrun zhing /dbus phyogs su dar ba phal cher mtshal pa bka' 'gyur shas che/phyi mor byas ba la bka' 'gyur ro cog ces56napa'i sgra don tshang phyir mtshal pa bka' 'gyur du bzhugs pa'i snga 'gyur gyi rgyud gsum bsnan te legasabyas rgya mtsho'i snying por spel pa'i bdag po ni/rgya dang mi nyag gi rgyal khams thams cad la dbang byed pa'i tshe ring gnam gyi she mong gi dpung pa las byung ba'i hor gyi rgyal po'i thog ma nag a len la nyi ma dang zla ba'i zer las skyes pa'i phu bo don byu mu gan gyi rigs brgyud las byung ba gnam jing gir gyi rgyal po yin la/de nyid kyi rgyud las rtse kho gan gyi rgya hor/mgo dkar/bod mon glo rdo/rgya gar shar phyogs sogs sa chen po phal cher 'bangs su bcug pa'i sog po'i sde grangs med pa'i nang wo o rod tsho pa bzhir grags pa'i nang nas ho shod kyi dpon po ha na'i la jo mo a 'a ha thun blangs par sras lnga byung ba'i gsum pa rgyal po 'di nyid chu pho rta'i lo la 'brungs mtshan tho rol pa'i hur btags/dgung lo bcu gsum tsam gyi dus dmag dpung gi sna drangs te mgo dkar khri phrag tsam gyi steng du mchongs pas dpa' rtags kyi grags pa thob/o rod kyi sder chos ma dar yang sog bo gzhung drug tu tā la'i bla ma bsod nams rgya mtsho dang /yal than chos kyi rgyal bo gnyis mchode yon du 'brel te rgyal khams thams cad dkar por gyur pa'i la 6 9 tsam snyan gyi bu gar son pas phyogs der yid

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)bstad nas phyag mang du mdzad nas dbu dpral bskrangs pa tsam byung / yum dus kyi chos nyid du gyur par lan dang rnam par smin pa la mi re ba'i sbyin gtong sogs dge (56ba tha rgya cher bskrun pa ni thar pa'i lam ston pa'i bshes gnyen sogs la ma bltos par rang stobs kyis mdzad pa chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i rnam par thar pa'i rjes su 'gro/ de dag gi skabs khal kha o rod gnyis g.yul rlabs po che bshams te/ lha ma yin gyi grong khyer la co 'dri ba'i phan tshun mi sha sogs kyis dogs zon la brten dpon po dang mi bzang skyes phangs can rnams rgyu 'grul mi nus pa'i tshe/ sdig rgyun 'di lta bu chad na ci ma rung snyam pa'i lhag bsam zla ba ltar dkar bas drangs pa'i snying stobs kyis khal kha'i sde khrod du tsham tshom med par byon te gzhung bsgrigs pas phan tshun mnyes gshin par gyur pa la stong 'khor zhabs drung / co ne o chir thu dha ra/ cha gar no mon khang sogs dang g.yas ru g.yon ru'i dpon po rnams kyis ta'i gu shri zhes pa'i cho lo dang bcas rgya cher bsngags/ o rod cig gis mdo sdegaser 'od bzhengs pa thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtshor phyag nas zhus par ming dris pa'i lan du al ta na gi ri le zer zhus pas/ da nas mi lo nyi shu na khyod kyi yul du chos 'di dar bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan/ de yang cha skar rgyal po legs ldan gyis tsho chen drug gi gzhung bshig nas dus kyi chad pa chen pos mnar ba'i tshe/ do long kho sho'u la dngos su dgra ma byung yang / chog thu dpon po me tog gi mdas snying myos shing sngon gyi log pa'i smon lam smin pa'i mthus mtsho sngon por brosathabs kyis 'ongs pa/ dpon po kho lo chi'i sras brgyud (57na)rnams legs byas kyi mthas gtugasapa dang nye ba 'grig ste/ phyogs de'i hor bod thams cad mnga' 'og tu bcug thog mar zhwa dmar ser gyis kun slong byed pa dag la rim gyis bon dang rgya'i dog sri sogs la 'gyur zhing / brlang spyod sor mo'i phreng ba lta bu'i skabs/ ma rungs pa 'di lta bu 'dul mkhan a khas ta'i ching gi dgra sha dang bcas/ ta'i ching kha than pā dur lta bu khal kha'i dpon zhig yong la re ba'i dus/ chos rgyal dri med lhun po'i gter lung las/ spyir yang mtha' dmag lan bdun tha ma laḥ badz+ra pā ṇi'i sprul pa'i rgyal po —70

sku gsung thugasarten gsar bzhengasadang mchod rdzasakhang bzang gi dkar chagaglegasabam gsum pa/ tanazhig: bod khams dar cig bde la sbyor ba 'byung : zhes dang chos rgyal rat+na gling pa'i spyi lung du/ 'bri yi rwa co phag gi mjug ma can gung gi tshang 'arma' sayi zas za zhing: mig bzhi gyen thur dag la lta byed cing : lce gnyis bden rdzun gnyis kyi shan 'byed pa: dbusagatsang thams cad sku yi mnga' 'og 'du: zhes lung bstan dus la babs te sngon gyi smon lam bzang po'i 'brel ba dang / dpa' mdzangasabartul phod pa'i rnam dpyod kyis sdig lto can dang mtshungs par spyod pa de 'dul ba'i sbyor ba la zhugs pa'i tshe/ tsong khar gyis pā dur hung tha'i ji zhes dad stobasakyi dbang phyug des dpung rogs byed par khas blangasate chabs cig par bteg nas chog thu'i dmag khri phrag bzhir nye ba ming gi lhag mar btang (57ba)nas/ rgya mtshams la thug pa'i sachen po kun la dbang sgyur/ me glang gi lo nang der jo shāka mjal ba sogasadage ba'i rtsa ba bskrun par 'byor/ lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang du rgyal phran thams cad kyi gtsug gi nor bur mnga' gsol ba'i lung las kyis gzengs bstod/ /gdan sachen po dga' ldan du byon skabasanyer brgyad kyi nub mo nyin mo ltar dngos po phra mo rnams kyang mig gi yul du 'gyur ba'i 'byung 'gyur gyi ltas ngo mtshar/ slar mtsho khar byon pa'i sa yosalo bod phyogs su dmag dpung btegs pa lam nasabi ri don yod kyi spyod tshul zhib mor byung bas rkyen byasaphyogasader kha 'khyogasate/ shākya seng ge'i bstan pa las phyi rol du gyur pa'i ma rungasapa de dag tshar bcad nasamado khamasasgang gsum mtha' dag chab 'bangasasu bsdus/ lcagasasbrul lor nyang smad bsam grub rtser dpung gi sbyor ba bshamasate/ chu rta'i nang du bod shing sgo can mtha' dag gisabatud nasabaka' 'bangasasu nos/ dar srid rnamasakyis phug ma'i 'og gi chu dong lta bu'i ngan spyod rang thog tu 'khor nas/ nyang kong ral gsum mtha' dag rta rmig gi rdul chen po'i 'og tu mnan te ming gi lhag mar btang / rgya gar bal mon sogasamatha'i rgyal po dang rgyal phran mang posapho nya mngagasate yul lugasadang mthun pa'i skyesaphul/ man ju sbog to rgyal po dang thag ring gi mdza' grogasachen por gyur te/ bdog pa'i skyesaphan tshun du bsring pa sogasayid bdugasabazhin pa'i ngang —71—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)nas sbog rta'i (58na jigs sras gnam gyi lha 'jam dbyangs gong ma shun tsi rgyal pos gser gyi tham kha dang 'ja' sa sogs kyis ches cher bsngags shing / mdor na 'phags yul/ lho bal/ rgya hor sogs nor 'dzin dpal mo'i khyon kun tu khyab par gyur pa de'i rigs sras che ba bā dur tha'i ji/ sngon chad sus kyang bgrod dka' ba'i mgo dkar gyi yul dpung nyung ngu zhig gis bcad de dban rtsa sprul sku bod du 'degs pa'i mthun 'gyur la sngon med kyi sa mkhan lta bur gyur zhing / yab rgyal po chog thu dang g.yul bshams pa'i skabs pha rol po dgra zil shin tu che ba la ya nga med pa'i thog ma nyid nasarta las bzhol nas me mda' 'dzugs pa sogs snying stobs kyi grags pa can slob dpon chen po'i lung bstan du/ tha'i rgyal po ji'i ming can 'byung bar gsungs pa de sog po'i lugs ba'i na sa pho khyi'i lo yab chos kyi rgyal po'i khri thog tu bstan 'dzin rdo rje rgyal po'i mtshan dang bcas te bod ru bzhi'i skye rgu mtha' dag gis bdog pa'i skyes dngo me che ba bstar te/ mnga' gsol rgya cher spel/ lo bcu gcig tsam gyi bar rgyal srid bskyangs pa'i ring mnga' 'bangs rnams la nad zhakhrug mu ge sogs dus kyi chad pa'i zug rngu dang bral bas sum rtsen gyi yul ltar bde skyid la rang dbang du spyod/ rgyal po de'i sras che ba sha mtshan la btags te dpung dmar rgyal por lung gis zin pa rat+na lcags mo phag gi lo rgyal sar mnga' gsol te (58brko ge ba'i mtshan ma phun sum tsho gos pa mnga' bzhin pa nas/ dge sdig gi phung po las gyi srang la btegs pa na lci yang gi khyad par la yid ches kyi nges pa brtan pos drangs te yab rgyal po'i dgongs rdzogs dang / rang gi legs byus kyi ched du dmigs te drug po zhes pa lcags pho spre'u'i lo shar khams kong gis kha gnon 'ol dga' stag rtser legs par bzhengs pa'i do dam ba ri sgo gzims shag pa nang so dkon mchog dar rgyas can dang / ye nas dpon yig che ges gtsos pa'i ye pa yig mkhan mkhas bsgrugs brgya phrag dang bcas bas bsgrubs pa'i dgos don yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyis glegs bam chen po la yi ge gsal ba legs par bris te me rtag dang bdug pa dang dri dang phreng ba dang byug pa dang phye —72

sku gsung thugs rten gsang ba tshe pas dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ (yim dang na bza' dang gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang dril bu dang ba dan dang kho ra khor yug tu mar me'i 'phreng ba dang mchod pa rnam pa mang pos bkur bstir bya/ bla mar bya/ brjed par bya/ mchod par bya/ri mor bya/ bsnyen bkur bya ste/ kun dga' bo 'di ni nga'i rjes su bstan pa'o/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di las thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / 'phags pa sdud pa las/ la las gang ga'i klung gi bye snyed zhing rnams na/ (59na)sems can ji snyed 'khod kun dgra bcom gyis btul bas/ /gang gis shes rab pha rol phyin yig 'di bris te/ /sems can mchog la glegs byin bsod nams khyad par 'phags/ /zhes rgyal ba'i bka' yi ger 'dri ba dang / klog pa dang / bkur bsti ri mor bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyi mtha' nam mkha'i tshad kyis kyang gzhal bar dka' bas/ 'di phyi gtan gyi mdun ma thams cad kyi rtsa ba ste/bsod nams rnam smin bde ster sdug bsngal thams cad sel/ /bsod nams ldan pa'i mi yi bsam pa rnams kyang 'grub/ bdud bcom nas ni byang chub bar du reg par 'gyur/ /mya ngan las 'das zhi ba bsil ba'i dngos po thob/ /ces dang /phal chen las/ su zhig sangs rgyas yul la dad sems pa// de ni chags med thub pa kun gyi dbang yang bskur/ /zhes rgya cher gsungs pa de dag gcam bu tsam min par don la gnas pa ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis zhal gyis 'ches pa yin zhing / rgyal bas legs par gsungasapa ni nam yang mi bslu ba ste/ ji skad du ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ zla ba skar mar bcas pa gnasalhung zhing / /ri dang grong du bcas pa'i sa gzhi la/ /nam mkha'i khams ni rnam pa gzhan gyur kyang /khyod ni mi bden ba yi tshig ma gsung / /zhes so/ /sdob gsung ri mor byas pa'i bsod nams ljid/ /(59ba〉na ser ldan srang gis ma theg bying dogs nas/ bad dkar mig de rus sbas gzugs bsgyur te/ sum rtsen gnas nas 'degs la 'ongasab bzhin/ 'bras bu 'dzad med char gyis sa gsum po/ /rab gsher smon lam drod kyis nyer bskyed —73

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()pa'i//phan bde'i snyem yongs su dar drag pas//'khor 'das dbul ba ma lus drungs na shog/khyad par bod dang bod chen rgya hor yul//chos skyong rgyal po'i legs byas lag pad kyis//yongasabategs blo bzang grags snyan bstan pa'i gdugs//tshangs pa'i yul sa'i bar du 'khor bar shog/'go rtsod rtsom dang thos bsam sgom pa yi//tshul bzhin 'dzin pa'i sgo ldan dge ba'i bshes//'dus sder bcas rnams srid mthar rab 'phel zhing //rdo rje lta bur mi 'gyur brtan par shog/mang bkur khrims gnyis dra bar brlang spyod mkhan//gnyis 'thung sna la dran 'dzin lcags kyu yis//nyer btab dga' ba'i gser gyi rgyan spras nas//bag yod gom stabs lhod por rgyu bar shog/rgyal por gnam gyi gtsug nas dbang bskur lha/srus brgyud sku tshe mnga' thang rab 'phel zhing //dus kyis bdag por che ba'i legs byas kyi//tshor ba 'gro kun snying la sim par shog/dge tshogasarin chen phra yis legs btab pa//dad pa dbang sngon pad rwag gdang bu can//gtong ba'i 60na'agram brtan thar pa'i them skas la//bde chen 'bad kun 'dzegs gi skal bzang shog/phyogasares brtse ba'i sems dang rang nyid kyi//bde 'bras gtso bor brtan min rgyal ba'i bka'//semasacan kun don bsngos pa'i chos dkar rgyun//byang chen rgya mtshor thug min chad med shog/rnam 'dren sras bcas slob mar 'i bcas pa tshogs//lha dang drang srong bden par smra rnams kyis//mgrin pa gcig tu blangs pa'i bkra shis klu//snyan po rna ba'i bcud du dngar bar sheg/6khan ma 'a dang sa sa'i 'dzin da las rgyal pos rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog ba tshe pas pa'i dkar chag smon lam dang sa pa 'di yang shākya'i bzhi pa sha dbang blo r+sāng rgya mchos pho brang dmar po ri'i gas med khang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang pos bgyis pa shrī ye bha snye//e ma dus rnams kun tu bkra shis gdangs snyan glur len do ra sa/zag med bde chen zlos gar yongs bsgyur dkon mchog sku gsung thugs kyi rten//srid pa'i nad brgya drungs nas na byed dge tshogs rtsi sman ljon pa che//'bras bu nam ༷༷ zad pa med 'di dpag yas bsod nams shing

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'dartas drangs//de phyir yid la kun tu dga' ba'i dpyid//thig le'i lang tsho dar drag khu byug gis/ /bsus pa'i dge legs gsos kyi bzhin ras ma//60bang ba ngom phun tshogs nor 'dzin kun khyab shog /bskal bzang sgron me bzhi pa'i bstan pa la//zla med rgyal dbang 'jam dpal snying po yi/ /lugs 'dzin dge 'dun rgya mtsho shes bya kun//mkhyen pa'i zhabs la rab btud mgos phyag 'tshal//theg gsum skye 'phags sku gzugs pu sta ga'i//bzhugs gnas dge 'dun 'du tshogs g.yos khang sogs//rten dang brten pa dkon mchog mchod sprin deb//'bri bar sngon 'gro'i gto gyis rnam par dbye //yar klungs sman ljongs 'phyos dkar 'dzin ma yi//bya 'dabs gzhis kar 'brel mtshungs mdzesargyan du//nyer spos bkra shis bde ba chen po'i gnas/mtho ris grong khyer sa la 'phos pa bzhin//sri zhu'i byed pa bgrangs yas zhi khro'i tshogs//dgyes bskyed bskang bstod longs spyod 'khor lo'i 'bangs//nga ro 'bol ldir snyan brjid 'brol mkhas pa//dbu mdzad blo bzang yon to spun gyisaso//sku rten glegs bam sna tsho gos mchode pa'i rdzas//zeg 'thor chud 'dza' srung byed deb ther gyi//lcags ri shing gi ma ma'i ngos yangs por//brda sprod gzugs mdzes yi ge'i 'phreng ba spel//zhesatshigs su bcad pa sngon du btang nas yar klung 'phyos bkra shis bde chen gyi dri gtsang khang /mgon khang /'du khang rnams rgya bskyed gsar du bskrun 61na ) par sku rten bris 'bur/gsung rten bka' 'gyur/gnam rgyan/rgyal mtshan/ba dan/ting /mchod kong /sbub chol/sil snyan sogasamar rdzas dang cas dbu mdzad blo bzang yon to spun gnyis kyis zang zing gi gtong ba dang sgo gsum tshig dril gyis legs par bskrun pa'i dkar chag drag po zhes pa lcags pho spre'u'i lo gro bzhin zla ba'i yar tshes nas dbu btsugs te bkod pa la//yid dga' chos 'dzin dang mtshudas pa/dpal ldan gzhan phan 'dus gling gi/'du khang rig sngags 'amang rnams kyis//rnam par rol 'di rmad du byung //61bskyol rnams 'gro la rjes brtse'i skya rengs mas//phan bde'i nyi ma 'dren la rtag 'grus kyang //khyad par lnga bdo'i dpung du snyeng stobs

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()go/ches btsan shākya'i skyes mchogo khyod kho na//g.yas su la ri mo gsum pa'i mgrin pa nas//theg pa mchog dman chos kyi dung dkar sgra//skye rgu'i rna bar 'jebs pa bkra shis kyi//snyan po'i brgyang glu mgrin par len rnams spro//khyon yang srid pa'i bre la bsod nams tso//bshar yang ma zad mes po ngal nus pa//thub gsung glegs bam bzhengs pa'i dkar chag dang //'brel ba'i bsngo smon 'dri la gcig tu spro//zhes tshigs su bcad de gleng bar 'os pa/ji skad du/cho ge rnams thams cad bka' dang bstan bcos 62na gi nyis su 'du//legs par gsungs dang de yi dgongs 'grel ba//de yi dbang gis shākya'i bstan pa 'di/'jig rten khams 'dir yun ring gnas par 'gyur//zhes rgyal ba'i bka' dang de'i dgongs pa 'grel ba'i bstan bcos rnams la thos bsam sgom gsum rgyun ma chad pa la brten nas 'jig rten gyi khams su thub pa'i bstan pa yun ring du gnas la/de la brten nas lus can kun la bde skyid phun sum tsho gos pa 'byung ba ni 'phags pa sdud pa las/'dzam bu'i gling 'dir chu klung ji snyed cig 'bab cing //me rtag 'bras ldan sman dang nags tshal skyed byed pa//ma dros gnas pa'i klu dbang klu bdag rten gnas te//de ni klu yi bdag po de yi mthu dpal yin//rgyal ba'i yi thos pa dag ji snyed chos r+sā dang //la ngo dang rig pa dag dang ldan par brjod pa dang //mchog 'phags bde ba byed dang de yi gos thob pa/de dag kun kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i skyes bu'i mthu//zhes pa'i don ltar srid zhi'i dge legs thams cad kyi 'byung khungs gcig pu pa yin pa'i phyir sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon par sgron bskal dang ma byon pa'i tshe mun bskal du grags shing /khyad par bskal pa 'di la sangs rgyas stong dang lnga 'byon pas bzang po'i bskal ba zhes lha rnams kyis ched du brjod la/de'i nang nas 'dren pa bzhi pa mnyam med bu ram shing pas dang por byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed/bar du bskal pa grangs med 62ba ) gsum mam dgur tsho gis bsags/mthar 'og min gyi gnas su mngon par byang chub7 /nga thun mong gi 'gro ba rnams 'dren pa'i ched du

sku gsung thug rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdza khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'damachog gi sprul sku'i rnam par bstan pa ni/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i le'u gsum par/ 'dzam bu gling ni chen po yi/ /dum bu bstoganyis kyi ni dbus/ shar gyi yul na gnas lha mo/ /zhes dang / bzhi par/'dzam bu'i gling na chung ngu 'dir/ /bdag ni shākya'i rigs rjes 'gro/ /zhes dus 'khor dang mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho sogs su 'dzam gling la che chung gnyis su gsungs pa'i 'dzam gling chung ngu 'dir rgyal po'i rigs su srid pa 'dzin pa'i rgyu mtshan/ rgya cher rol pa las/ /dge slong de ltar byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan gyi gnas dam pa na 'dug pa ni rnam par lta ba chen po bzhi la rnam par lta ba ste/ bzhi gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ dus la rnam par blta ba dang / gling la rnam par blta ba dang / yul la rnam par blta ba dang / rigs la rnam par blta ba'o/ dge slong dag byang chub sems dpa' gling la rnam par blta zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' ni mtha' 'khob kyi gling du mi skye/ shar gyi lus 'phags por mi skye/ byang gi sgra mi snyan du mi skye/ lho'i 'dzam bu gling nyid du skye'o/ dge slong dag ci'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' yul la rnam par blta zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' ni mtha' 'khob kyi yul gang na mi rnams dbang po brtul zhing blun la lug ltar lkugs pa'i rang bzhin can legs (63na)par bstan pa dang nyes par bstan pa'i don shes par bya ba'i skal ba med pa dag tu mi skye/ byang chub sems dpa' ni yul gyi dbus nyid du skye'o/ /zhes yul dbus 'gyur gyi rgyal po chen po zas gtsang ma'i sras su bltams nas ma ga dha rdo rje'i gdan du srod la bdud bcos dgung la mnyam par bzhag /tho rangs ma' par rdzogs pa sangasargyas pa'i tshul bstan nas tshangs pa dang brgya byin gyis gsol ba btab ba la brten yul wa ra ṇa sir bka' dang bo bden pa bzhi'i chos 'khor/ bya rgod phung po'i rir bar ba mtshan nyid med pa'i chosa'akhor/ yul yangs pa can du tha ma legs par rnam par phye ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor te zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus pa'i rjes su bka' bsdu rim ba gsum du byung ba'i tha mar/ gsung rab rnams yi ger bkod de 'phags pa'i yul du rgya cher 'phel ba las—77

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)byang phyogs kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir ji ltar dar ba ni/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ /nga yi dus nasalo brgya na/ kha ba can du mtsho bri ste/ /swā la'i nags ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ zhes mtsho bskams te nagasabyung ba'i rjes su mi'i 'gro ba 'phel tshul yang / bod yul 'dir thugs rje chen po dang sgrol mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i spre'u dang brag srin mo 'dus pa las 'phel zhing / se/ dmu/ sdong / stong ste nang gi mi rigs bzhi rnams rigs kyi phyi mo bcu gnyis su bshad/ bka' chems (63ba〉ka khol mar bzhi brgyar 'phel ba tshan pa bzhir 'thabs pa dang mes pos bar mtshams byas te zhing la tshan pa bzhir bgos gcig la gcig 'jigs shing tshan bzhir byes/ drug tu phye na bod mi khri tho chen po bya ba de la dgra 'byu ldong lga dang nu bo dpa' mda' ste drug tu bshad/ rus chen bzhi las gyes pa ye sang dkar po gnam gyi 'ju thag can/ ye smon nag po khro chu'i pha bong 'dra ba/ spyang khrig ye shes lha'i sgron me/mon rdzun ga po khyi'i rnga ljang can dang bzhi byung ba las 'phel ba shas che/ mtshal pa'i deb ther du/ ma sangs spun dgu/ rgyal phran nyer lnga/ bcu gnyis/ sil ma bzhi bcus dbang byas pa'i mthar bod spyi la dbang sgyur ba'i rgyal po gnya' khri btsan po nas bzung gnam gyi khri bdun/ bar gyi steng gnyis/sa'i legs drug lde brgyad rjes su btsan lngar grags pa'i khri thog rje btsan rgyal rabs nyer bdun gyi bar chab srid sgrung lde'u bon gyis bskyangs pa'i nyer bdun par lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan gyis bstan pa'i dbu bsnyengs/ de nas rgyal rabs lnga na mnga' bdag srong btsan sgam pos bstan pa'i srol bstod pa'i thog mar nyang bran pha bong khar rigs gsum mgon po bsgrubs pa'i lung bstan pa ltar mtha' 'dul yang 'dul ru gnon gyi gtsug lag khang bcu gnyis brtsigs rjes phan bde'i snying po ra sa dang ra mo che'i gas la zung du 'brel ba bzhengs par ston pa'i zhal skyin jo shāka rnam gnyis kyis gtsos pa'i brten pa lha'i tsho gis rgya (64na)cher bzhugs su gsol ba ni 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan 'di la/ /rnam pa sna tsho gos bya ba byed/ /byang gi phyogs la brten nas ni/ /de yi tshe na 'byung bar 'gyur/ /lha ldan yul zhes bya ba yi/ /gangs can ri yi nang gnas pa'i/ /rgyal 78

sku gsung thug rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod jos khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'dapo mi yi lha zhes pa/ li tsa bī rnams rigs su 'byung / /de yang sngags kyis don sgrub ste/ /longs spyod tshe dang ldan par 'gyur/ /rig pa longs spyod ldan zhes bya/ /mi yi bdag pos de yang grub/ /lo ni brgyad cur rgyal srid byed/ /ces dang / 'jig rten sgron ma zhes grags dang / /lha mo gos dkar mo dang ni/ /dkar mo chen mo gzhan phan brtson/ /zhes pa'i don dang mthun no/ /de nas rgyal rabs lnga na chos rgyal tshangs pa lha'i me tog gis rgya bod kyi lo paṇa rnams bla'i mchod gnas su bkur/ zan g.yang mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang sogs dkon cog gsum gyi rten brten ba mang du bzhengs/ dge 'dun gyi sde 'dzugs pa/ bka' bstan bcos bsgyur ba sogs bstan pa dar rgyas su mdzad/ mnga' bdag mu khri btsan pos ska cog sogs lo paṇa rnams la brten nas pho brang phang thang du bka' 'gyur ro cog thog mar bris/ sras mnga' bdag khri lde gtsug brtan gyis yab mes kyi dus kya 'gyur dka' ba rnams skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la 'bebs su bcug bar skabs su rgyal po dar mas bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa la shin tu gnod pa byung yang / lam yig (64ba)las/ jo bo chen po rdo rje gdan gyi nub phyogs 'od dpag med pa'i lha khang du byang chub kyi sems la thugs spyod ba'i tshe spyan ras gzigs kyi zhal bstan nas skyes bu dam pa legs so legs so/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba'i mdzod gang yin pa de khyod kyis shesasam 'di nas byang phyogs na nga'i zhing khams yod/ khyod kyi yi dam jo mo sgrol ma yang de na sems can gyi don mdzad cing bzhugs/ khyod kyi gdul bya mang po yang de na yod pas byang phyogs bod du song zhig ces pa ltar sras bcas rgyal ba'i 'phrin las kyi 'jug pa rgyun mi chad pa'i rten 'brel gyis bstan pa'i me ro stod smad gnyis nas bsos shing / jo bo chen po a ti sha /paṇa chen gha ya dha ra/ kha che'i bsod snyoms pa shākya shī sogs paṇ+ḍita du ma dang / 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu mang du byon nas gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas par 'gyur bcos dang gsar du bsgyur ba sogs bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa snga dar las kyang 'phel che ba lta bu byung ba/ khro phu lo tsā bas be+eḍūrla'i tshong 'dus nas kha —79

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)che paṇa chen la phul ba'i zhu yig tu/ ma ga dha sogs rigs 'byung gnas kyang sdig to yi/ /dmag tshogs kyis bcoms skyon kha che bal yul yang / /log spyod kyis khengs deng sang bstan srog legs gnas ni/ /bod yul 'dir zad skyes chen byang phyogs zhabs bskyod zhu/ /zhes pa'i don dang mthun par rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa'i gsung las kyang mthong zhing (65na khos la/ de'ang bstan pa snga dar gyi dus dkar chag phang thang ma dang ldan dkar ma/ phyi dar la dbus pa blo gsal gyis snar thang du bsgrigs pa/ bcom ldan ral gri'i dkar chag nyi ma'i 'od zer/ mtshal pa gi tu dge ba'i blo grosakyis bsgrigs rtsom mdzad par mtshal pa bka' 'gyur/ kun mkhyen bu ston zhabs kyis bsgrigs pa them spangs mar grags pa sogs mang du yod pa la phyi mor byas te 'byor ldan rnams kyi bsod nams kyi zhing du rgya cher spel ba las/ nye char ra sa tshil snang gtsug lag khang chen po'i bya 'dabs kyi byams khang rgyab chos skyong dmag dpon gangs la nyi shar gyi bslab bya bzhin khog pa tshe dbang rdo rje khur 'khur nas bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel ba'i ched du lhag bsam kun+da ltar dkar bas/ bka' 'gyur gyi steng du 'bum tshar gcig lhag dang bcas te legs par bzhedas pa'i phan yon ni/ shesarab gyi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong ba las/ kun dga' bo de lta bsan byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes thob par 'dod pa dag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la spyad par bya'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mnyan par bya/ bzung bar bya/ gcang bar bya/ bklag par bya/ kun chub par bya/ rab tu gdon par bya/ bstan par bya/ nye bar bstan par bya/ lung 'bog bar bya/ kha ton du bya/ bri bar bya/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyis glegs bam chen po la yi ge gsal zhing (65ba)rab tu gsal ba legs par bris te me tog dang bdug pa dang dri dang 'phreng ba dang byug pa dang phye ma dang na bza' dang gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang dril bu dang ba dan dang kho ra khor yug tu mar me'i 'phrong ba dang mchod pa rnam pa mang pos bkur bstir bya/ bla mar bya/ brjed —80

sku gsung thug rten gsar bzheng dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ slonapar bya/ mchod par bya/ ri mor bya/ bsnyen bkur bya/ kun dga' bo 'di ni nga'i rjes su bstan pa'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ba 'di las thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes sogs phan yon rgya cher gsungs so/ /nor 'dzin bu mo mar gad gosakyis klubs/ /sna tsho gis me rtag do shal 'phreng mdzes spel/ /mgrin pa'i khu byug snyan po'i glu len pa/ /gsos kyi dga' ston tshur mthong byis blo 'dra 'drid/ /e ma cung zad 'dri klog bkur bstis kyang / /srid pa'i nad brgya byin pa'i chig thub sman/ /byang chen bar gyi don ldan bsgrub pa'i gtam/ /'di ko dpyod ldan snying la bdud rtsi'i dpyid/ /thub gsung glegs bam seng ge'i nga ro'i sgras/ /bdud bzhi'i snying ga phug nas mkha' mnyam gyi/ /'gro kun thar pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sar/ /nyer 'dren shing rta chen por 'gyur bar shog /mes dbon rnam gsum tshangs pa'i ral klung nas/ /mdo rgyud bshad sgrub yan lag brgyad ldan chab/ /'jig rten gsum gyi phan bde'i chu gter du/ /babs pa'i rlabs 'phreng mkha' la phyur bar shog /nyi ma'i gnyen gyi dgongs don ma lus pa/ /'khrul med ston mdzad kun mkhyen (66na)btsong kha pa'i/ /lung rtogs bstan pa gdugs dkar grib ma la/ /sems can thams cad ngal gsor spyod par shog ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i blo gros kyi/ /bum bzang nyer bltams legs bshad rgya mtsho'i bcud/ /ris med gdul byar stsol ba'i bshes gnyen mchog /sku tshe g.yung drung lta bur brtan par shog /chos nor 'dod thar dga' ston ldan pa'i sgo/ /rnam par phye ba pho brang skyong pa'i lha/ /sa yi dbang phyug sku tshe mnga' thang dang / /mi nor dpal 'byor phyogs bcur rgyas par shog /yon sbyor dmag dpon gangs la nyi shar gyi/ /sdig lhung kun byang dbang thang dar drag cing / /mi khom sdug bsngal mngon sum lta ci smos/ /nying 'byul rmi lam du yang mi 'byung shog /ring min 'khor ba'i gcong rong las thar zhing / /smon 'jug sems kyis sa bcu'i them skas la/ /rab 'dzegs sangs rgyas go 'phang yid bzhin gyi/ /nor bu'i pho brang chen por 'jug par shog /brisa'abur rten bzhedas dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams/ /sgrub pa'i bzo rigs mthun rkyen byed pa kun/ /tshe 'dir —81—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()lha yi bde skyid dang mtshungs shing //phyi mar thar pa'i go 'phang thob par shog/gsung rab bzhengs dang srung ma rang nyid la//'brel ba thogs rnams dal 'byor rten thob nas//zab rgyas chos kyi 'byor bar longs spyad de//don 'i gnyas lhun gyis grub pa'i bkra shis shog/ce da4kha pon gangs la nyi shar gyisabaka' 'gyur rin po che bzhengs pa'i dkar chag smon slob〉pam nor bu'i 'phreng mdzes 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar za hor gyi ban+de sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni mthar rgyas pa blo yong dbang pos bgyis pa dge bar gyur cig/khrims ldan 'dus pa tsho gos su spyan 'dren pa'i//dbyangs snyan pi waṃ rjes 'gro 'bud ba'i dung /khred zhi'i gdung ba sel ba'i brgyang glu'i sgra//'a mi med dbang po'i 'dun sam rga sum bzhin//legs bris dga' tshal rjes 'gro yar klungs char//chos gra wo po dpal gyi rtses dang gi/lnga mchod spyi sor dpal grong sngags rams pa//ngag dbang dge legs lhag bsam gyis phul mthus//skye ba kun tu rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi//tshig don rna bar 'jebs pa tshangs pa'i dbyangs//rtag tu thos nasa'adi phyi'i mdun ma kun/lhun rgyas grub par mchog gsum mthus byin rlobs//kho rtse gong lnga skur snye sor gsol dpon rang 'byams pa ngag dbang dge legs kyis 'bud dung dngul shog srang nyi shu las grub pa cha phul ba'i kha byang dgosatshul ltar za hor rgya bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang po'o//rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling gi rgyun gyi rnal 'byor dang dus kyi mchod par dgos pa'i bzo rgyan 3 dang dgos cha gtan 'bebs su byas pa'i deb ther dngos grub rgya mtsho/bye ba phrag brgya'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa'i/rigs kun bdag nyid dpal ldan rdo rje sems//zhi khro'i rnam par 'phrul pa med po che//mkha' la khu kha' yi rdo rjes shis pa stsol//dngos bshams

sku gsung thugasarten gsar bzhongasadang mja rdzasokhang bzang gi dkar chag glegasabam gsum pa/ khya)yid sprul ma dros mtsho (67na༄na las/ /kun bzang mchod sprin chu gter rnam bzhi'i rgyun/ /tshogs gnyisazla ba'i ma mar byang chub par/ /'phel ba'i rlabasa'aphreng srid rtser phyur 'di spro/ /rang rig mkha' la 'jig rten ye shesalha/ /dbang gzhu lta bur rang byung rang shar las/ /dmigs su med kyang 'phrul dga'i lha bzhin du/ /dgyesabaskyed cho ga'i bsod namasari bo dngos/ /rtsa gsum dngasama'i khamasakyi nying khu kun/ khyud gsum dregasapar shar la phyi nang gsang / /dam skong nam mkha'i mdzod kyi sgo 'phar brgya/ /'byed la dpyod ldan su zhig cis mi rangs/ /mkha' 'gro rnam lngar tshogs kyi 'khor lo yi/ /dga' ston legs brisabadud rtsi gsar pa'i spun/ /rnal 'byor mchog mthun dngosagrub 'chi gsos sman/ /srog gi zungasagyur 'di ko las lhag ci/ /mi 'bral rten dang lo zlar 'pho med 'jog khyun mchod gtor ma'i ri bo lhun por 'gran/ /sman phud rak+ta'i chu gter lusaphra ma/ /chal chil dbu ba'i chabasa'ang gcig tu dngom/ /phyi nang nyer spyod srog chagasago mar+sha dang / /ri rab gling bzhi gling phran rgyal srid bdun/ /phun tshogasalha mi'i 'dod yon bskang rdzasakyis/ /ma dang mkha' 'gro dgyes bskyed yang rtser son/ /bzo dbyibs rgyan sprosamadangasakyi kha bsgyur sogs/ /blos byas sprin bral brgyud ldan bzhed pa'i mkhar/ /phyag len nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od po ches/ /srid zhi'i legasatshogasasnang ba gcig tu dkar/ khyu dang tshad kyi dbye bsanyer mtshon te/ /(67ba)phra zhib brjed ngasa'ajigasapa spong byed pa'i/ /a 'dusaka 'phreng rab ldan dngas ma'i mtshor/ /blang dor bzhin ras gsal ba dngosapo'i gshis/ /de phyir yid srubasasdelasaphyogasakun tu/ /rnam par rgyal ba phan bde'i 'byung gnas che/ /nges gsang theg mchog legs bshad 'dusagling gi /phyag bzhes ri mo mig gsum pas mi dbyi/ /'khrul med deb ther gtan la legs phab pa/ /brjod bya rab gsal don kun cha tshang ba/ /blo ldan rna ba mdzesabyed drug dmar g.yu/ /'dzad med ring por spel ba 'di ko mtshar/ /zhes nyams dang 'gyur ba stong las nye bar drangs pa'i gtam gyis sngun bsus te rnam par —83—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa rnams kyis bgrang yas rgyal ba zhi khro dgyes skong gi rim pa la nye bar mkho ba'i rtag gtor rgyun gtor bskang gtor/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa/ tsho gis kyi 'khor lo sogs rgyun gyi rnal 'byor dang dus kyi mchod par dgos pa'i bzo rgyan gyi tshad dang dgos cha rnams 'phel 'grib spangs te gtan 'bebs su byas pa'i deb ther dngos grub rgya mtsho nye bar bkod pa la/ /sprul kun gdod nas nyer zhi chos dbyings las/ /rigs gsum rigs lnga rigs brgya zhi khro'i gar/ /'gro blo'i do rar bsgyur tshad ga ba'i rdul/ /de snyed grangs kyis bsgrun min tshogs rnams rgyal/ /tshangs pa'i dbyangs snyan yid srubs klad 'gems par/ /rgod dang drag shul 'jigs rung gsung gi gdangs/ /mi bzad gnam lcags cher 'bebs dbyar rnga yang / /snyems pa'i ri bo cig car bsnyil (68nas na nam/ /ma dang mkha' 'gro'i mgrin las rdo rje'i glu/ /snyan 'gyur yid kyi gsos sman nā da'i sgra/ /rab mas dkyil 'khor spro dang mchod pa la/ /'dod 'jo sngon med yongs 'du'i mched po bzhin/ /tshogs gsog bshegs dang byin dbab dam rdzas brlab/ /rten dang brten pa bskyed drangs mchod bstod 'jeb/ /'jigs med seng ge'i rgyud kyi nga ro yis/ /snang srid dregs pa'i ri dwags zil gyis gnon/ /dpal mgon lcam dral dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /'bod bskang bstod bskul las sbyor nga ro'i sgra/ /stag chen smyon pa cher brlams ngar ba'i skad/ /dgra bgegs gcan gzan mtha' dag snying rtsa 'dar/ /de phyir gsang sngags rnying ma'i rigs 'dzin dang / /phyis 'gyur mkhas grub mang por yi dam lha/ /dam can srung ma'i gnang ba legs stsal ba'i/ /gdangs dbyangs dbye ba ngo mtshar pha mtha' yas/ /khyad par rtsa gsum kun gogacig chod pa/ /he ru ka dpal rigs 'dzin drag po rtsal/ /'phrin las phreng po'i gyer sgom rdo rje'i dbyangs/ /gzul med spel legs yi ge'i 'phreng bar 'god/ /ces bkra shis pa'i tshigs su bcad pa sngon du btang ste skabs su gleng bar 'os pa dga' ldan phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i pho brang chen por yi dam chos srung rnams kyi rgyun rigs mi gcig pa mang du yod pa las byang zang zang lha brag mdzod lnga 'dus pa'i zab gter sprul sku gter ston chen —84

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 6)po rgod kyi ldem phru can (68ba)gyis gdan drangs pa'i nang tshan gser mdzod ser po'i chos sde'i sgrub pa sde brgyad dam drug gi dkyil 'khor kun tshang bla ma gsang sgrub rdo rje drag po rtsal gyi 'phrin las 'bring po'i dbyangs rol gyi phyag bzhes gter ston rin po che nas sa ston chen po rin chen rgyal mtshan dang mnyam med nub dgon pa las legs par 'ongs pa chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyi bzhed srol sgrub chen tshe 'phel bzang po'i rnam sprul sku mdun kun bzang dbang po las byung ba/ /bdag nubs brgyud pa'i zab gter/ /gter ston chen po rgya 'ad khrom gyis spyan drangs pa'i nang tshan 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon lcags 'dra'i 'phrin las kyi dbyangs rol/ /gter ston chen po nyid nas nye bar brgyud pa zur spang ston 'jam dpal dbyangs bde legs rgyal mtshan dang / /sgrol ma ba nam mkha'i rnal 'byor gnyis las 'ongs ba mkhyen pa'i spyan ldan se ston chen po dang / /mnyam med rje'i phyag len chos rgyal dbang po'i sde yab sras kyi bzhed srol sku mdun kun bzang dbang po las byung ba/ /lha brag gter byon phur pa lcags khang spu gri'i las byang la gdangs dbyangs rol mo'i gcod mtshams sogs pho brang chen po sne'u sdong rtse'i sa skyong chos kyi rgyal po grags pa 'byung gnas dang /dpal zin kun bzang rtse pa zhal ngor mi brgyud las 'ongs ba sa phur lha khra'i phyag len rgyas bkab chos rje dkon gnyer dpon po dge steng byams pa kun dga' 'byung gnas las 'ongs pa/ ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa/ las gshin (69na5) sgrub kyi gdangs dbyangs stod rgyud dang chim lugs 'dres ma/ dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo dang bstan skyong rnam gnyis kyi gsol ga'i gdangs dbyangasathams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i phyag bzhes stobs 'phrog dbang po gdong bzhi las mkhan beg rtse rgyal po ngal bsos pa rnams kyi gdangs dbyangs dpal ldan kun bzang rtse pa'i gsung rgyun thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtshos zhib gcod gnang ba/ g.yin yang dga' ldan pho brang gi phyag rgyun rnying pa thor bu 'ga' zhig rnams dbu mdzad don grub bkra shis las byung ba/ gur mgon las mkhan gyi gdung dbyangs rigs brgya'i khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan —85

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i gsung las byung ba/mdor na nyer mkho'i che phra sna tshogs lugs srol gang la mkhas pa dag la nye bar gtugs te dbu mdzad blo bzang yon to dang /dbu mdzad blo bzang bstan 'dzin gnyis kyis zhib mor dpyad pa brjed ngas kyi 'jigs pa spang phyir bkod pa'i dang po thugs sgrub drag po rtsal gyi dbyangs yig 'di lta ste/'jam dpal rdo rje 'khor 'das ma lus pa'i/phyag rgya zil gyis gnon par rab khros gar/yongs bsgyur pad+ma'i man ngag rtsa ba'i don/'phrin las rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes mtshar/sgom don ji bzhin gyer la gdangs dbyangs dang //rol tshig gnubs chen rgya zhang dgongs pa'i don/spang ston sgrol ma 69bsgom gnyis las 'ongs pa//mkhyen brtse nus ldan se ston chen pos spel//rje btsun mnyam med zhal lung byang bdag rjes//nyer bzhes phyag len rngam brjid seng ge yi/khyud kyi nga ros phyogs las rnam rgyal ba'i//sgra dbyangs tshangasapa'i yul sa'i bar du sgrogs//'phrin las 'bar ba'i spu gri drag sngags dpal//rtse mor bdud bzhi mi rtag lam 'god pa//jo lugs spros med rnal 'byor lha khra yi//gar 'chams gdangs dbyangs mdzes pa'i rgyan 'di bkra/khungs btsun rigs 'dzin bzhed srol ma 'phyugs shing //yi dam lha yi gnang ba legs thob steng //sngags 'chang gzhan las khyad zhugs phyogs 'di la//mkhas pa'i mchog gyur kun bzang rtse par grags//bzhed srol 'khrul med 'dzin pa'i dkon gnyer dpon//dge steng byams pa kun dga' 'byung gnas kyi//phyag len shing gi ma ma'i ngos yangs por//don tshig brda dag gzugs mdzes spel 'di long //chos kyi dbyings las nyer zhi spyan ras stong//'gror gzigs gru 'dzin la dgyes pa da dkar 'chang //yid srubs gshed du tsan dan ljon pa'i drung //khrag 'thung dbang po'i gar mkhan phyag drug pa//'jam dpal bka' nyan lha chen nyi ma'i bu//rab 'jigs ma he'i zhal can 'khor bcas rnams//spyan 'dren mchod bskang bstod bskul dbyangs rol rgyun//sngon 70na thabs mkhas pa'i bzhed srol nyams pa med//de phyir dam can srung ma'i tshogs rnams kun//dgyes pa bskyed pa'i gnyen gcig du rdzu bhi//rnaX dpyod dbyug gus bskul ba'i sgra dbyangs kyis//

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ tanaphyogs bral yongs kyi rna bar gcig tu 'jebs//'khor lo'i bdag nyid chen mor rgyas 'debs ma//dpal ldan rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug lha//mthun mong snang ngor dbang phyug nyer brgyad gtso//dregs pa'i sde dpon dbus na srid rgyal gyi//sna tshogs sprul bsgyur pha mtha' gzhal dka' ding //ngag dbang dbyangs can dgra bgegs gshed ma sa/rab khros srid gsum dbang sgyur re ma ti'i//dbyangs rol dam pa'i ba ched srol 'khrul pa med//de tshul dbyar gyi rnga chen ltar ldir zhing //snyan 'gyur ta myu ra yi rgyud mang gi/snyems pa 'phrog pa'i dbyangs yig mu sti ga'i//spel legs 'phreng ba 'di ko gcig tu mtshar//'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing gi gtso//rnam par snang mdzad ye shes phrul po che//rdo rje srin po gur mgon lcam dral gnyis//rgyud gsum dregs pa'i yum chen ral gcig ma//gnod sbyin yab yum bsgos sras gshin rje'i rgyal//'chi bdag pu tra gnod sbyin bha tra nag/kha 'bar srin mo dgyes pa bskyed pa'i dbyangs//rdo rje 70ba lko.ang dngos bla ma'i zhal gyi lung //phra sbom snyan brjid mgrin pa'i rgyud mangs las//nyer drangs glu yis bgrang yas bstan srung gi/sdedapon nag po chen po 'khor bcas rnams//dgyes pa'i 'dzum gyis mchog thun dngos grub 'gugs//'gro la brtse ba'i tshad med bzhi yi zhal//ris bral lus can yongs la ches 'dzu 5 yang //dkar min las mnar 'gro la gnam sa ltar//rab gdangs mche bas dgra snying thal mar 'bigs//drag po gzi ldan dbang phyug bram ze'i tshul//bzung nas gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i 'bod pa'i sgra//mi dang gling bu'i skad dang lhan cig par//snyan brjid dbyangs kyi nga ro srid rtser ldir//rig sngags 'chang gtso mkhyen dpyod rab yangs can//dpal ldan kun bzang rtse ba'i gsung ngag rgyun//rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtshos yongs dpyad pa//tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror rna ba lhogs/khrid zhi'i 'dod dgu char 'bebs ngal bsos po//sgrol ging gnod sbyin lcam sring 'khor bcas rnams//'bod mchod bstod ba'i gyer dbyangs snyan brjid glu//mgrin par blangs pa'i gzugs ba deng 'dir shar//ma dag dri 'khrud bsangs kyi cho ga dang /8/༷sa bsgrub zhing ka ra yi tsho gis rnams kyi//mchod

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()bstod nyer bskul sna gos 'gyur khug gdangs//yid 'ong rna ba'i bas len 'di na'o//71nalhag bsam zla bsil 'gro phan sa mos kha//'dzum yang 'dod lha'i pad dkar tsha gdung gis//bcil 'dis ris med mdza' ba btang ngam zhes//sem nyi'i byed po shākya seng ge rgyal//g.yas 'khyil mgrin du dam chos sa dbyangs sgra//snyan po skal bzang rna bar ches 'jam pa/khu stegs sgra 'an la rtsub tsher ma mkhan//dkar nag las kyi byed po gnyis gzhan su//mdzes sku lus phra'i bzhin mthong gas gdung mes//rngul 'dzag ba spu'i rtse rno skal dman 'gar//'byung na mas dpe'i snang bas mthong ba'i mod//grol gtam gzhan 'drid min par gang du bsnyon//'on te ma dag ga hril snang lug pa'i mig/skyon bral 71bsgo dzad pa'i nyi 'od kyis ldongs kyang //lus can gling bzhi'i mun selagashis lugs la/shes ldan su zhig 'khyog tshig smra nus ci//de phyir mkha' mnyam 'gro ched gsungasapa'i chos//phung po'i grangs tshad lce brgyas bskal pa sa/brjod la tshangs pa skyid skyur mal nyal na//smra 'dod byis blo 'ja' la sbar 'dzin bzhi//mtsho las skyogs kyis bcus btungs skoms pa'i nad//sel ltar bka' yi sdud po rim gsum du//byin nas bstan la ri mor mdzad pa'i drin//lan 'jal stongs gsum nor bus bkang yang min//gangs can mtha' 'khor sgo nga'i sbubs rgya nas//bzang po'i bag chags ka la piṅka'i sgra//sgrog pa'i chos rgyal rim byon 'jig rten migazhom thar dran tshe dad pa'i spu long g.yo//snga phyir yongs dar bstan la rgyal ba'i bka'//legs 'gyur brgya phrag nyer brgyal pusta da //'dri 'bri ) klog rnyed bkur thos bsam sgom pa yi//bsod nams bye ba'i zhing la gcig tu spro//deng 'dir ye dbyibs chos lung dkar po mā/rab 'byams smra ba blo bzang mkhas grub kyis//bdog pa a mi za bar bskrun tshul gyi//gleng 'os spro dga'i gto la rnab lhogs//zhes tshigs su bcad pas sngon bsus te//de'ang spyod 'jug las//'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman tshog pu//bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas//bstan pa rnyed dang bkur sti dang //cas te yun ring gnas gyur cig/ces sems༅ thams caX ཿkyi 72nasgo rabs mang por goms pa'i rgyu kun

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'da'abyung bden pa la brten nas 'bras bu sdug bsngal bden pa'i nad tshabs po ches zin pa gso bar byed pa'i sman dang gnas skabs nyi tshe ba'i bde ba tsam du ma zad rgyu lam gyi bden pa la brten nas 'bras bu 'gog bden myang 'das kyi bde ba khyad par can 'byung ba'i sgo dam pa ni bstan pa yin la/ /bstan pa de'i ston pa po su zhig ce na kun mkhyen gnyis pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyis/ resa'aga' rgyal la dmigs pa'i dad pa skyes/ /skabs 'gar shing rta chen po'i sku drin dran/ /gzhan tshe mkhas pa'i bshes la gus pa dang / /nyam chung 'gro la snying nas brtse ba dang / /bstan pa rin cen ring du gnas 'dod pa/ /'di dag phan tshun 'gran bzhin 'phel bar 'gyur/ /zhes mu stegs byed dang kla klo sogs kyi ston pa'i ming du btags pa tsam ma yin par thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam tshul bzhin ston pa po ni bdud bzhi las rnam par rgyal ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das grangs med pa zhig byon pa'i nang nas sangs rgyas stong dang lnga rim pa bzhin 'byon par lha rnams kyis 'di ni bskal pa bzang po'o zhes ches cher bsngags pa'i bzhi pa 'o skol gyi rnam 'dren shākya seng gis dang por byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed/ /bar du bskal pa grangs med gsum mam dgur tshogs bsags/ /mthar rang nyid kyis zhing dag pa rab mas bsgrubs pa'i 'og min gyi gnas su mngon par rdzogs pa sangs rgyas (72ba〉kyang 'khor byang chub sems dpa' sha stag las kun gyi spyod yul du ma gyur pas ma dag pa'i zhing gi 'gro ba rnams 'dren pa'i ched du 'dzam gling gi lte ba rdo rje gdan/legs sbyar gyi skad du mju ga ta dha ra zhes par tsan+d+ra pa ra bṛ kho da ra la sogs pa rnams sos bsdu ba byas pas ma ga dha zhes dbus 'gyur 'chang du 'bod pa'i byang chub shing gi snying po a shwa tā la sku rgyab brten nas sgod la bdud btul/ dgung la mnyam par bzhag /tho rengs mchogo gi sprul pa'i skur mngon par rdzogs pa sangs rgyas pa'i tshul bstan pas/ rgya cher rol pa las/ gnas der nga yisamachod sbyin stong phrag bye ba khrag khrig bzhi bcu byas/ der ni sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig stong phrag drug bcu de dag mchod/ wa ra ṇa si dam pa de ni sngon gyi drang srong rnams kyi gnas/ zhes dang / ngas ni sngon —89

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)chad sangs rgyas bye ba stong phrag dgu bcu rtsa gcig dran/ /de dag drang srong zhes bya nags mchog 'dir na 'khor lo dam pa rab tu bskor/ /zhes yul wa ra ṇa sir slob lam gyi dus mchod sbyin stong phrag bye ba khrag khrig bzhi bcu mdzad cing / sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig stong phrag drug bcu mchod pa dang ston pa nyid kyi thugs kyis dran par sangs rgyas bye ba stong phrag dgu bcu rtsa gcig gis cho me 'khor bskor ba'i gnas su gsungs la/ de yang mngon par rdzogs pa sangs rgyas nas/ zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /bdud rtsi lta bu'i chos shig bdag gis rnyed/ /(73na〉su la bstan kyang go bar mi 'gyur bas/ mi smra nags 'dab gnas par bya'o snyam/ zhes zhag zhe dgu'i bar chos mi gsung par thugs las chung ngus bzhugs tshul bstan par lha tshangs pas gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong pa dang / de'i grogs su brgya byin gyis gser gyi maṇ+ḍal dpag tshad lnga bcu pa zhig phul nas gsol ba btab pas/ mdo rtsa bar/ma gsol par mi bya'o zhes g.yin gyi gsol ba 'debs dgos pa'i phyir lo tsā ba 'ga' zhig gis wa ra ṇa phub dang / a gi ral gri gnyis mtshams sbyar bas phub ral can du grags pa/ drang srong lhung ba ri dwags kyi nags su chu stod zla ba'i tshes bzhi la 'khor lnga sde bzang por bka' dang po bden pa bzhi'i chos 'khor/ gnas bya rgod phung po'i rir 'khor lnga stong gi dge slong pha ma/ dge bsnyen pha ma/byang chub sems dpa' khrag khrig brgya stong la bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i chos 'khor sngar gsungs pa'i bka' dang po dang bar pa gnyis la sgra zin la dngos su 'gal ba ltar snang ba/ don la 'gal spong gi dris lan dang bcas te/ ri ma la ya dang / yul yangs pa can du 'khor theg pa mtha' dag la yang dag par zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tsho gis la tha ma legs pa rnam par phye ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum dang / dgung lo gya gcig pa lcags 'brug nag pa zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi rdzogs pa gsum pa la dpal ldan gos spungs kyi mchod rten chen por ji skad (73ba)du/ 'das pa'i rgyal po nyi ma'i 'od/ /de ni bgegs dgra'i sprul pa ste/ phyag na rdo rje zla bzang khyod/ ces bka' —90

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chags gsab ma gsum pa/ tanastsal yul gyi chos rgyal zla ba bzang po la dus kyi 'khor lo rtsa ba'i rgyud stong phrag bcu gnyis pa gsungs/ de nas zla ba gcig tu nye ba na rtswa mchog gi grong du mdzad pa tha ma ston par bzhed nas dge slong rnams la 'du shes bcu ston pa'i mdo gsungs/ sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i mtshan phyed la zhi ba'i dbyings su gshegs tshul bstan/ lo phyi ma'i dbyar gnas kyi tshe kun dga' bo dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob ste gnas rgyal po'i khab tu 'od srungs chen po sogs dgra bcom pa bzhi brgya dgu bcu rtsa dgu'i dbus su mdo sde'i sde snod/ de bzhi du nye bar 'khor gyis 'dul ba'i sde snod/ 'od srungasachen pos mngon pa'i sde snod rnams 'gor gleng gzhi/ bar du 'brel dang mtshams sbyor/ mthar 'khor 'dus tshul dang rjes su yi rang bcug nas bka' bsdu ba dang po mdzad/ de nas lo brgya dang bcu song ba na dge slong lha chen po sogs kyis mi rung ba'i gzhi bcu bcas pa sun dbyung ba'i ched du yul yangs pa can du dgra bcom pa grags pa la sogs pa bdun brgyas bka' bar pa bsdus/ sangs rgyas gshegs nas lo bzhi brgya na bdud kyi sprul pa dge slong bzang po'i rjes 'brangs kyis chos log la brten sde pa bco brgyad phan tshun du rtsod pa byung ba zhi ba dang / mi brjed pa'i gzungs ma thob pa rnams kyi don du glegs bam yi ger 'dri ba'i (74na ji gos pa dang bcas mnyan yod du byang chub sems dpa' lnga brgya/ dgra bcom pa lnga brgya/ so so skye bo'i paṇ+ḍita khri drug stong rnams kyis bka' bsdu/ ma mdzad/ 'di dag mtshon byed tsam yin gyi/ slob lam gyi gnas skabs su bya dka' ba brgya phrag du ma'i spyod pa mdzad pa/ sangs rgyas nas gsung pa bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i rnam par thar pa mdo sdodang lung las byung ba de dag gi rjes su gongs te/ dpal ldan ma khol gyi 'khrungs rabs so bzhi pa/ chosargyal dge ba'i dbang po'i rtogs brjod rin po che dpag bsam 'khri shing sogs las gsungs pa'i don la bsams na rgyal ba shākya thub pa la dmigs pa'i dad pa lhag par skye/ de bzhin du shing rta chen po'i sku drin ni legs bshad snying po las/ bde gshegs gsung rab tshul gnyis shing rta'i srol/ /legasapar phye nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa mchog /sa gsum 'gro na nyi ltar gsal mdzad pa/ /klu sgrub thogs—91

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)med gnyis la spyi bos mchod/ ces pa ltar shing rta chen po gnyis kyi klu sgrub ni/ laṅkar gshegs pa las/ lho phyogs be ta'i yul du ni/ /dge slong dpal ldan zhes grags pa/ /de ming klu zhes 'bod pa de/ /yod dang med pa'i phyogs 'jigs pa/ /nga yi bstan pa 'jig rten du/ bla med theg chen rab bshad nas/ /rab tu dga' ba'i sa bsgrubs te/ /bde ba can du de 'gro'o/ /zhes pa ltar be ta'i yul du bram ze'i rigs su sku gzungs mtshan (74bsgo khan zhig gis zhag bdun gyi tshe las med zer bar thabs dris pas bram ze brgya la chos ston drangs na zla ba bdun dang / dge slong brgya la drangs na lo bdun thub zer ba thos pas lo bdun du nye ba na grogs dang bcas bzhin du 'khyams bcug pas/ nā lan+dar slebs pa'i tshe mkhan po mda' bsnun zhabs kyi drung du rab tu byung / 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur/ lo bdun 'gro kha'i mtshan thog thag gzungs sngags bgrangs pas 'chi bdag gi g.yul las rgyal nas dgung lo drug brgya mi yul du bzhugs/ mkhan po nyid la bsnyen par rdzogs gser 'gyur gyi rtsi la brten nas dge 'dun gyi 'tsho ba sbyar bas log 'tsho la sbyar zhes nyes pa sel slad gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten bye ba bzheng par gzhan gyis bskul/ klu'i rgyal pos gdan drangs pa bzhin byon nas chos gsungs/ yun du bzhugs par zhus kyang ma gnang bar mchod rten gyi klu 'jim dang / yum chen mo mi yul du spyan drangs/ shar phyogs pa ḍa bhe ka dang / yul ra dar du gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten mang du bzhengs/ sgra mi snyan du 'byon pa'i lam khar byis pa zhig rgyal por 'gyur ba'i lung bstan pa bzhin tshur byon pa na rgyal por gyur zin nas rin po che mang du phul zhing yon bdag tu gyur pa rgyal po bde spyod du grags/ gso ba rig pa sogs phugs kyi gtsug lag gi bstan bcos mang po dang / gtso bor rigs tshogis drug brtsams nasadangos bstan stong nyid kyi rim pa la brten nas theg pa chen ('an sta'i srol rgyas par phye/ thogasamed ni/rma bya chen mo las/ thogs med ces bya'i dge slong ni/ bstan bcos de ni don la mkhas/ mdo —92

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'dasdo drang don nges pa'i don/ rnam pa mang po rab tu 'byed/ ces pa ltar/ mngon pa la dgra lan gsum dar ba'i tshe bram ze ma gsal ba'i tshul khrims kyis bstan pa spel phyir khye'u zhig bskrun par bsams nas rgyal rigs dang 'dus pa las 'phags pa thog med 'khrungs/ des ri bo bya rkang du lo gsum gyi bar byams pa bsgrubs pas ma 'grub par phyir byon pa na rgan po zhig gis shing bal gyis lcags kyi sdong po brdar nas kha ba bzo zer ba thugs su ma shong bar de na re/ snying stobs ldan pa'i skyes bu yis/bsgrubs na mi 'grub gang yang med/ dka' yang brnag pa ma dor na/ ri bo rnams kyang thal bar zlog /zer bar slar lo drug bsgrubs par yang 'bras bu ma byung pas phyir 'thon pa na chu thigs dang bya sgros brag zad pa gzigs pas yang lo gsum ste lo bcu bsgrubs pa'i mthar phyi rol du khyi mo smad khog 'bus g.yeng pa zhig la rang gi sha spu gyis bcad pa'i nang du 'bu rnams 'jog snyam ste spyan btsum ste ljags kyis 'bu blang bar brtsams pa dang khyi mo med par byams pa dngos su gzigs pas/ kye ma yab cig bdag gi skyabs/ ngal brgyas 'bad kyang 'bras ma mchis/ /sogs yus pa'i zhu ba phul par/ nga dang po nas yod kyang sngar phan ma mthong ba 'gog byed kyi las sgrib da lam khyi mo la skyes pa'i (75bsnying rjes sangs nas mthong ba yin/ som nyir gyur na gzhan la ston gsungs pas bstan kyang ma mthong bas the tshom bkrol/ theg pa chen po'i chos dar bar gsol ba btab pa bzhin na bza' la 'a sdus nas dga' ldan du byon/ mi lo lnga bcu rtsa gsum mam zla ba drug gi bar bzhugs nas yum rgyasa'abring bsdus gsum dang byams chos sde lnga sogs theg pa chen po'i cho semang du gsan/ mi yul du phyin nas de ga'i don 'grel par sa sde lnga dang / sdom rnam pa gnyis kyi bstan bcos mdzad/ shing rta chen po rnam gnyis ni bstan pa 'di la nyi ma dang zla ba ltar grags pas lam rim chen mor/ 'dzam gling mkhas ba yongs kyi ga khog gi rgyan/ snyan pa'i ba dan 'gron lhang nge ba/ zhes bsngags brjod mdzad pa yin/ mkhas pa'i bshes la gus dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan legs bshad snying po las/ shing rta chen po'i srol ni legs bzung nas/ /'dzam gling blo gsal bye ba'i mig 'byed pa/ /'phags pa lha dang dpa' —93—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)bo sangs rgyas bskyangs/ /legs ldan 'byed dang zla ba grags pa'i zhabs/ /dbyig gnyen zhabs dang de sras yon tan 'od/ shwakya 'od dang phyogs kyi glang po dang / /chos kyi grags pa'i zhabs sogs 'dzam gling rgyan/ /thub bstan mi nub rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i mchog /ces pa ltar shing rta'i srol 'dzin pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta nam mkha'i skar tshogs ltar byon par ma zad sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje'i 'jug pa la tshad bzung mi nus pas/ lha mo dri ma med pa lung bstan pa'i (76nasgo do las/ nga mya ༅ las 'das nas lo nyis stong lnga brgya na gdong dmar can gyi yul du dam pa'i chos dar bar 'gyur ro/ zhes pa'i don mngon sum du gyur par nye ba'i tshe kha ba can gyi rgyal khams mtshos gang ba bri ba'i shul du stod mnga' ris skor gsum ri dwags kyi gling / smad mdo khams sgang gsum bya'i gling / bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi gcan gzan gyi gling du bshad cing / bu ston chosa'abyung du rgyal po ru pa ti g.yul pham nas dmag stong phrag dang bcas te ri kha ba can gyi yul du zhugs pa las 'phel bar bshad/ mkhas pa stag tshang lo tsā bas rgya bal sogs dang 'dra bar thog ma nas chags zhes bzhed tshul rnam grangs mang yang yongs su grags pa grub thob dngos grub/ mnga' bdag nyang / dbu ru shāka 'od sogs kyis rim par spyan drangs pa'i ma ṇi bka' 'bum dang bka' 'chems ka khol ma sogs su spyan ras gzigs dang sgrol mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i spri'u dang brag srin mo 'dus pa las mi'i 'gro ba 'phel te/ de yang rus chen bzhi dang mi'u gdung drug sogs kyi ngos 'dzin lugs dang po ltar na/ se/ sdong / rmu/ stong dang bzhi/ phyi ma ltar na/ dgra/ 'bru/ sdong / sga'i steng du nu bo dpa' mda' gnyis yin la/ mtshal pa'i hu lan deb ther du ma sangs skrun dgu/ rgyal phran nyer lnga/ bcu gnyis/ bsil ma bzhi bcu sogs kyi mthar bod spyi la dbang ba'i rgyal po gnya' khri btsan po lha ri rol pa'i khar byon pa phyugs skyong ba'i rdzi bo rnams(7ba)kyis mthong ste 'o cag gi rje 'chol lo zhes gnya' bar bteg nas gdan drangs pas mtshan de ltar thogs/ 'di nas bzung bod kyi rgyal po phal cher byang sems 'phags pa bsams bzhin du mi'i srid ba bzung bar bshad pa'i rgyal rabs—94

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'denyi shu rtsa bdun gyi mthar lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan gyis pho brang yom bu bla mkhar btab nas bzhugs pa'i tshe/ gser gyi mchod rten/ tshin+ta ma ṇi'i brkos phor/ dpang skong phyag brgya pa/ yi ge drug pa sogasaya mtshan pa nam mkha' las babs pa gnyan po gsang bar mtshan gsol/ mchod pa phul zhing bstan pa'i dbu brnyes/ de nas rgyal rabs bzhi song ba na/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ lha ldan yul zhes bya ba yi/ /gangs can ri yi nang gnas pa/ /rgyal po mi yi lha zhes pa/ /li tsa bī rnams rigs su 'byung / /zhes dang / dkon chog 'bangs kyi skyes rabs su/ 'di nas skye ba gzhan rgyas ma chod par/ /bod khams mgon med yul du thugs rjes song / zhes pa ltar/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos thu mi sam sto ṭa rgya gar du brdzangs/ mkhas pa'i phul du phyin pa dang / rgyal po nyid chabs cig par skyid shod nyang bran pha bong khar rgya yig las btus te bod yig la mkho ba rnams gtan la phab dge ba bcu'i khrims bcas/ sprul pa'i dge slong ā ka ra ma tis bcu gcig zhal dang / 'jig rten dbang phyug yi dam gyi lhar gdan drangs/ rgya bal nas sgrol ma dang khro gnyer can gyi sprul pa'i btsun mo gnyis bsus pa'i rten skal (77na'i jo shāka rnam gnyis dang byams pa chos 'khor sogs legs byas kyi zhing du phebs/ srin mo gan rgyal du bskyel ba lta bu'i sa dgra gnon byed kyi me btsar mtha' 'dul yang 'dul ru gnon gyi gcug lag khang bcu gnyis brtsigs/ lte bar ra sa 'phrul snang dang ra mo che'i gas la rten brten par bcas pa lus can mtha' dag mthong thos dran dang reg pas rnam par grol ba bzhengs/ thu mis spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo rgyud nyi shu rtsa gcig bsgyur ba sogs kyis bstan pa'i srol btod/ de nas mi rabs lnga na 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam par 'phrul pa mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan gyis mkhan slob gnyis rim par gdan drangs pa'i slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis lha srin gdug pa can rnams btul/ sa gzhi byin gyis brlabs pas lugs gsum mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang o tan pu ri'i dri gtsang khang la dpe byas pa bgegs med du 'grub/ mkhan po zhi ba 'tsho yos da mi mi bdun rab tu byung / bod phyug blo rno ba du mas lo tsā bslabs/—95

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)sangs rgyas gsang ba/ sangs rgyas zhi ba/ dri med bshes gnyen/ pad+ma'i ngang tshul sogs paṇa grub mang po spyan drangs/ chos bsgyur ba dang bshad nyan gyi sgo nas bstun pa rgyas par mdzad/ de sras mu khri btsan pos skar chung rdo rje dbyings kyi lha khang dang phyag rdor gyi sprul pa yang dbon khri lde gtsug brtan gyis 'u shang rdo bkra shis dpe med dge 'phel gyi lha khang brtsigs/ mes kyi chos bsgyur ba rnams(77ba)paṇ+ḍita dzin mi tra/ shi len+d+ra bo dhi/ ska cog sogs kyis skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab/bstan pa phyi dar gyi thog mar dbus gtsang gi mi bcus bla chen po la bsnyen par rdzogs nas bstan pa'i me ro smad nas bslang / pā la rnam pa gsum la brten nas stod 'dul dang / kha che'i bsod snyomasapa chen po'i rjes su 'brangs nas paṇa chen brgyud pa'i rtsa ba so so thar pa'i gzhi btsugs/ mnyam med jo bo chen po a ti shas shing rta chen po gnyis kyi dgongs don sems 'dul ba'i rim pa gtso bor mdzad pa la brten jo po bka' gdams pa/ so thar gnubs gsum nyang chos dbang sogs gsang sngags rnying ma bka' gter gyi bstan 'dzin/ lo chen rin bzang 'brog mi mar mal rā gnyan shong dpang nas bzung zhwa lu lo chen chos skyong bzang po rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu rnams bstan pa spyi'i zhing yin/ 'jam dbyangs bdun sogs rje btsun sa skya ba rjes 'brangs/dwags shangs zhi spyod bu dol sogs grub mtha' sna tshogs 'dzin pa mang du byon zhing / khyad par rgyal ba gnyis pa shar btsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyis bka' gdams nas brgyud pa'i lam gyi rim pa sa skya pa dang bu ston yab sras nas brgyud pa'i rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i srol dar bar mdzad/lhag tu bla ma 'jam dpal dbyangs la brten nas gsung rab kyi dpyad pa mtha' dag yongs su rdzogs pas zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba dang / gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgyu lus kyi skor sogs la (78na〉sdon med pa'i legs bshad snang ba stag tshang lo tsā bas gzigs te bstod bsngags mdzad pa ni rjes 'brangs 'dras a pha'i gsol zhal gtsang ba tsam ma yin pa'i dbang rnon chos rjes 'brangs pa'i nges pa gting tshugs pa yin par 'dug pa phyogs lhung dang bral ba'i bsngags brjod du song / der ma zad 'dul —96

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ ()'dzin mkhas pa'i dbang po nam mkha'i skar tshogs ltar byon/ yang 'dul ba nas ji ltar bshad pa'i bslab bya phra rags mtha' dag gangs can 'dir gtan la phab pa ni rje bla ma 'di nyid kyi bka' drin yin pas/ thub bstan spyi'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dpal ye bzang rtse pa'i zhal snga nas kyis gnyal gyi mo la'i rtsar zhags mdzad pas/ khyod sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa dang 'dra ba zhig 'ong bar shes par gyis shig ces pa'i lung bstan pa brnyes/ yi dam gyis kyang 'dul ba'i bslab pa la brten nas gzhan la phan pa chen por 'gyur bar lung bstan pas thog mar dpon slob rnams kyis bla gos dras shing drubs pa dang lhung bzed gding ba la sogs pa'i yo byad rnams bsnams nas gzhan dag gis mthong na rab tu byung ba'i tshul ni 'di lta bu zhig kho na'o/ zhes yid ches par 'gyur par mdzad nas/ phyis ni lo re'am zla re tsam chos nyan par rtsol pa'i slob ma dag kyang 'dul ba'i kun tu spyod pa la bkod pas mngon sum du gyur ba lta zhog rgyang ring po nas thos pa dag kyang spu long g.yo bas phyogasathams cad du snyan pas khyab sa 'gran zla med par gyur/ zhes gsungs pas mtsho ni te (78bsgom par thar pa bsam gyi mi khyab mod/ mdor na bshad ma thag pa'i rgya bod kyi mkhas grub rnams kyi rnam par thar pa mthong thos dran dang reg pas dad pa gong 'phel du gyur la/ 'gro la brtse ba ni/ 'jug pa las/ dang por nga zhes bdag la chen gyur cing / /bdag gi 'di zhes dngos la chags bskyed nas/ /zo chun 'phyan ltar rang dbang med pa yi/ /'gro la snying rjer gyur gang de la 'dud/ ces las nyone gyi dbang du gyur pa'i sems can gnyis 'dzin gyi 'ching rgya dam pos bcings te srid pa 'dir yang nas yang du 'khor nas nyam thag pa/ bde ba 'dod kyang ma rig pa'i dbang gis sdug bsngal gyi rgyu kho na bsgrubs pa rnams la btang snyoms tshad med kyis gzhi bzung bar snying brtse bas kun nas blangs te 'gro ba'i phan bde 'byung ba'i sgo gcig bu lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa rin po che srid mtha'i bar du gnas na ci ma rung snyam pa phan tshun 'gran pa bzhin du rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen po'i thugs la shar ba'i tshul tshigs bcad du mdzad pa yin la/ de'ang sangs rgyas sa gsungs pa'i bka' dang / de'i —97

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)dgongs 'grel shing rta chen po rjes 'brangs sogs rgya bod kyi mkhas grub rnams kyi mdzad pa'i bstan bcos rnams ni rgyal bstan ring por gnas pa'i thabs kyi gtso bo yin pas/ji skad du/ chos rnams thams cad bka' dang bstan bcos gnyis su 'du/ /legs par gsungasadang de yi dgongs 'grel ba/ /de yi dbang gis shākya'i bstan pa ni/ 'jig rten khams 'dir yun ring gnas par 'gyur (79na tshe sgos gsungs pa'i bka' dang / phal mo che 'phags pa'i yul du legasasbyar gyi skad du yod pa ljongs 'dir lo paṇa gyi 'gyur rnam dag la bltos pas lo tsā bas/ gangs can 'di na tshig la mkhas pa dkon/ /kla klo blun po'i skad kyi brjod don 'chol/ /'ga' zhig skad dod 'ga' res chog par 'dzin/ la las rang gi rnam dpyod tshod lta byed/ /kha cig rang gi khong du ma chud nas/ /tshul 'di phyi rabs gong la nyer mkho'i chos/ /min zhes snang smras tshul gyis rab tu 'dor/ /legs par bshad nas smra ba re re tsam/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bstan pa snga dar gyi dus rlangs kham pa go cha/ sbas/ nyang be+e ro tsa na sogs kyis 'bum bsgyur zhing / gzhan yang paṇ+ḍita sarba dz+nyā de ba/ bi sdi ka ra pra bha/ dha rma ka ra/ lo tsā ba ban+de dpal gyi lhun po rnams kyis la ba lung / paṇ+ḍita bi sdi ka ra sidhi/shi len+d+ra bo dhi/ dzi na mi tra/ lo tsā ba dpal brtsegs/ ye shes sde sogs kyis mdo sdos tsho gos pa/ rma gnyags gnubs sogs kyis mdo sgyu sems gsum sogs lkog chos kyi tshul du bsgyur/ snga dar la ma 'gyur ba'i mdo rgyud rnams lo chen rin bzang man chad kyis bsgyur pa las snga dar gyi dus phang thang ka ba med pa'i gtsug lag khang du ban+de dpal brtsegs can gyis bka' 'gyur phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa la dkar chag phang thang ma/ stong thang ldan dkar du ska cog gnyis kyis bsgrigs par ldan dkar ma/phyi dar la mchims kyis lung (78ba)sde bzhi chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa'i thugs dam mdo mangs lha mi'i rgyan mchog chu mig na bzhugs pa/ gru spar rtsa'i 'dzam gling rgyan zha lu gser khang du bzhugs pa'i gsung rab sogs mang du bsdus nas snar thang du dbus pa blo gsal/ lo tsā ba bsod nams 'od zer/brgyang ro byang chub 'bum sogs mang pos bka' 'gyur phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs par bcom ldan ral —98

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ slonagris dkar chag nyi ma'i 'od zer mdzad/ kun mkhyen bu dang / mtshal pa thams cad mkhyen pa dge ba'i blo gros kyis dkar chag tu bkod pa'i bka' 'gyur gnyis dbus gtsang du dar rgyas che zhing / de dag las 'phros te 'byor ldan rnams kyis bsod nams kyi tshogs rlabs po che bskrun pa'i ched du 'bri klog gi mig ltos dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel ba las sgo mo lcags lung pa'i rab 'byams smra ba blo bzang mkhas grub li thang thub bstan chos 'khor gyi khur len phog nas rang yul du 'byor pa'i tshe zang zing gi dngos dpyad gya nom pa'i steng nas chos bzhed gi dgos cha'i bdog pa mtha' dag lha rigs sa skyong chen po'i phyag tu btab ste lcags pho spre'u nas legs par bzhengs pa'i phan yon ni/ brgyad stong pa las/ kun dga' bo de lta bas na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes thob par 'dod pa dag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la spyad par bya'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin 'di mnyan par bya/ bzung bar bya/ bcang bar bya/ bklag par bya/kun (80na spyo par bya/ rab tu gdon par bya/ bstan par bya/ nye bar bstan par bya/ lung 'bogs par bya/ kha rtan du bya/ bri bar bya/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyis glegs bam chen po la yi ge gsal zhing rab tu gsal ba legs par bris te me tog dang / bdug pa dang dri dang phreng ba dang byug pa dang / phye ma dang na bza' dang gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang dril bu dang ba dan dang kho ra khor yug tu mar me'i phreng ba dang mchod pa rnam pa mang pos bkur ster bya/ bla mar bya/ mchod par bya/ ri mor bya/ bsnyen bkur bya ste/ kun dga' bo 'di ni nga'i rjes su bstan pa'o/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shesarab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /zhesasogs phan yon rgya cher bga' stsal ba ste/ nam yang mi bslu ba'i rgyu mtshan/ ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ /zla ba skar mar bcas pa gnas lhung zhing / /ri dang grong du bcas pa'i sa gzhi la/ /nam mkha'i khamasa'adi rnam pa gzhan gyur kyang / /khyod ni mi bden pa yi tshig mi gsung / zhes pas shes nus so/ /'dis mtsho ni bsags sgo cog gi dge ba'i sprin/ /stug po'i dbus nas byang chub yongs bsngos—8

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)'brug /skad gsang bsgrags tshe gtan bde rma bya mo'i/ /mngal khur stobs bcu'i rtsal gyis lci bar shog /'jig rten gsum gyi dbang phyug ral pa'i rtser/ /zhwa ser bstan pa'i zla ba yongs tshes pa cha shas bskyed du bsrings(80ba lnga'i snang ba yis/ bde skyid gzugs brnyan ma lus mthong bar shog /gnas lnga rig pa smra mkhas mgrin pa'i rnga/ shes rab dbyu gus bskul par 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /rtag tu dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gzur gnas kyi/ /mgon dang gling du nam yang 'pho med shog /rnam dpyod khyab 'jug sgyu rtsal rus sbal gyis/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rgya mtsho'i gos can ljid/ /gyen du 'degs nus sa spyod rgyal po'i zhabs/ /g.yung drung lta bur 'gyur med brtan par shog /e rong lho rgyud ma la ya tshal du/ /lha rigs mi dbang bsod nams tsan+dan ljon/ /g.yur za'i grib mar 'bangasasu gtogs so cog /phan bde'i dri bsung dngar po snar sim shog /li thang bla zur blo bzang mkhasagrub kyis/ /gtso byas sgo mo lcags lung mi nor phyugs/ /che dpal dbang thang rnam mang thos sras la/ /'gran pa'i skal ba bzang por 'gyur par shog /sgo gsum 'bad pa'i dka' thub drag po yis/ /rgyal gsung 'dri bar chu thigs tsam gyis kyang / /phan pa bsgrub pa mtha' brten skye rgu rnams/ /'di phyir sim pa'i tshor ba rtag myong shog /btab pa'i smon lam mtha' dag yid bzhin du/ /re 'bras smin par mchog gsum thugs rje yi/ /'jug pa dus las mi g.yo bkra shis glu/ /snyan po rna ba'i dpyid du len gyur cig /ces bka' 'gyur ro cog gsar bzhengs kyi smon lam che brjod dang yos pa dri za'i rgyud mang 'di ni yon sbyor mkhan (81na)po nyid kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi ban+de tshangs sras bas pa'i rdo rjes lcags bya nag pa zla ba'i nyer gnyis la bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang pos bgyis pa dza ya skyo/ /ga d+ma'i rdul mkhyen grangs kyi cha tsam du/ /bsgrun par mi nus zhi khro'i rten brten pa/ /kun kyang rang rig khyab bdag rdo rje sems/ /gcig las du mar 'char ba 'phrul po che/ /lha sngags ye shesarol pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /yid srubs sde las rnam par rab rgyal ba'i/ /gzhan phan lhun grub zung 'jug bde chen gar/ /legs bsgyur rig sngags 'chang ba'i bshad sgrub gling / /gang de'i rgyun gyi — 100

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod jos khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'danyams bzhes zhal 'don rnams/ /phyogs gcig yi ger nyer bkod pu sta ga: /mchod sbyin 'dzad med par gyi sgo 'byed pa/ /dbyad gsum dag pa'i lde mig deng 'dir bskrun/ gangs ri brgya phrag zla zhun gyis byugs las/ /ches dkar rnam dag bsam pa'i phyogs 'di la/ /sgo gsum 'bad dang mthun rkyen nyer sbyor ba'i/ /byed por gtogs so cog gi lus can rnams/ /rdzogs ldan dus kyi tshe 'byor bde skyid kun/ /mngon sum nyams myong skye bar dal 'byor rnyed/ /nges gsang theg mchog chos la longs spyad nas/ /bcu gsum rdo rje'i sa der nyer bgrod shog /spyi dang khyad par 'jam mgon btsong kha pa'i/ /ring lugs de 'dzin sde rnams phyogs bcur 'phel/ /rdo rje'i slob dpon g.yung drung ltar brtan nas/ /smin grol 'khor lo chad med bskor bar shog /dga' ba (81ba tha rgya pa'i dpal ldan pho brang che'i/ /chos srid gyen 'degs nor 'dzin skyong ba'i lha/ /zhabs brtan mnga' thang rab rgyas lugs gnyis khrims/ /mchog dman phrag par khur du lci bar shog /rang gzhan phan bde'i rtsa lag theg chen lam/ /legs par bshad don nyams su bstar ba'i gling / /srid mtha'i bar du rnam gsum 'khor lo rnams/ /dkar cha'i zla ba lta bur 'phel bar shog /'jig rten spyi dang bye brag rgya hor bod/ /dus kyi chad pa brnag dka'i zug rngu rnams/ /ming mthar byas nas lusang ga yid gsum la/ /sim pa'i tshor ba rtag tu myong bar shog /rtsa gsum byin rlabs dam can mthu stobs rtsal/ /chos phyi dngas 'gyur ba med pa rnam par dag /tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang mthus/ /ji ltar yongs smon 'dod don lhun grub shog /rgyal sras slob mar bcas pas mgrin gcig tu/ /bden tshig dbyangs snyan len dang phyogs mthun du/ /mkha' la 'chi med tsho gos kyis gom bkod de/ bkra shis man+ta ra yi char 'bebs shog /rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i rgyun gyi rnal 'byor du bya ba'i rim pa rnams mi 'chos zhing khungs dag pa'i ched par du 'khod pa zhig byung na zhes gra dmangs(82na skoms gleng brjod mdzad par brten/ sa lug mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyi bskul ma yang yang byung bas rkyen byas sgra mdo chen po bzhi la phul du phyin pa'i 'dar pa lo chen mon mkhar rnam gling paṇa chen/ dge slong 'jam dbyang grags pa gsum gyis dpe khungs thub mang po dang bstun zhing nged rang la dogs dpyad nas—101 —
