rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2)zhus dag par byas pa'i pod 3 du longs pa lcag bya lo sa skyong sangs rgyas rgya mtshos dgos byed mas rkyen gyi bkod pa dang bcasasngags rams pa mkhas bas rgya mtsho do dam du btang nas dga' ldan du phun tsho gis gling par yig gi ma dpe dang mthun mi mas gyi zhus 'a dang do dam pa dge slong blo gros brtan pa/dge slong blo gsal mkhas pa/dge slong smra ba'i dbang phyug gsum dang /yig mkha blo r+sāng dmo chos༅ dgu/par rkos po dbum sgo dgos slebs༅ ba ni zhus pa/shing ba thob das/yo byag sprod mi kha ser ma shes rab dpal bzang dang /ka bzhi smad pa bsod nams nor bu rnams kyis gang dgos kyi mas rkyen sbyar na par du bskosapa'i smon lam gyi tshigs su bar pa 'di ni za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legasakyis bgyis pa dza yas// bdapal phag mo gru pa'i pho brang sne'u sdong rtse khul gyi bogs deb gsar bsgrigs phun tshogs nor bu'i 'dod 'jo//thabs shes ut+pal mda' gzhu bkang ba'i rtser//'jam mnyen mdud pa'i mde'u me rtag kha//'dzum la khams gsum snying gar rab bsnun khrag/rjes chags nyams kyis brtan g.yo de dbang sdus//zhal dang ne'u le'i mgrin nas 'dod rgu'i char//nyer babs nor bu'i phung po mthor brtsegs pa//grib tu bsil bar yid can ngal bsos te//'byor ba'i dga' ston myong par 'gro kun sbyor//gshin po'i zhing sa cher yangs mngal khur du//sna tsho gos sa bon btab smin bskyed bsrings par//grangs med 'bru rigs gzhone nu yongs 'phel ba'i//bre 'jal rtsed 'jo'i dga' ston gcig tu spro//gangs can 'gro ba thog mar chags pa'i sa//ru bzhi'i lte ba yar klungs sman gyi ljongs//(83na jo dang gong po ri yi 'dabs zhol du//'dzam gling rgyan ༷ga pho brang sne'u sdong rtser//sa skyong blo bzang sbyin

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang mar rdza khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 9)pa'i rnam dpyod dang //brtson pas 'bru 'bab grangs la rba shubs bsrungs//cho mes po bsrung pa'i sra brtan lcags ri yi//gtan 'bebs spel legs deb ther deng 'dir 'god//ces tshigs su bcad pa sngon du btang nas 'phags pa'i yul du du rma ti zhes pa blo ga du 'bod cing /rgya nag spor thang dang mthun pa lcags mo bya'i lo nam mthong zla ba'i yar tshes nas dbu btsugs te/gnam gyis bskos pa'i rgyal po dpal phag mo gru pa'i pho brang sne'u sdong rtse khul zhol lding skor/yar mda'/bya sa dang bcas pa'i bogs deb gsar bsgrigs phun tsho gos nor bu'i 'dod 'jo bkod pa la//lcang lo can gyi pho brang chen bo nas//gnod sbyin bye ba'i sde dpon rnam thos sras//rgyal mtshan rtag gi yid bzhin nor bu las//lha mi'i 'dod yon mtha' dag char du phob//sngon bsagasagatong phod ma la ya klung nas//smon lam mtshams sbyor rlung gis nyer drangs pa'i//sna tsho gos thi rigs tsas ljon shing dri//dngar pos bkres phongs tsha gdung rgyang du phul//de phyir sa bon mnya par bkram pa yi//snye ma yongs su dud la drang po'i thig/btab nas rang gzhan ri sgang shas kyi deb/me long gdong gi ngang tshul 'di na spel//zhes tshigs su bcas pas sngun bsus nas 'phags pa'i yul du du rma ti zhes pa blo ngan du 'bod cing /rgya nag spor thang dang mas pa lcags mo bya'i lo83ba ) na ma mthong zla ba'i yar tshes nasadabu btsugs te pho brang sne'u sdong 6khul zhol lding skor/yar mda'/bya sa nang bcas pa'i shas deb gsar bsgrigs mang bkur zhal che'i brjod don bkod pa la/srid pa'i mes po'i gtsug na zla ba'i sras//sa srungs sna zhags kyis bteg bum pa yis//'gro mang spyi bor dbang bskur yod med nor//brgya phrag ga kho sgo legs 'byed tshogs kyi bdag/nyi 'od 'bum gyis rab 'khyud bad rwag gi/lhun po'i snyems ba 'phrog las sa pa'i zer//lcag kyosakhams gsum snod bcud yod do cog/dga' ba g.yas su deng 'dir 'khyil bar mdzod//bur rgyal dang por skyong pa lha wo po/sham snu'i pho brang khyabaX rdul brtsegs857sa//nyer babs klung wo

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)shar nub 'chi med kyi/ /grong khyer mngon sum gser ldan la 'phos bzhin/ /sa bon gcig las 'bras bu brgya phrag tu/ /'phel ba yi tsam ma yin drang po'i gtam/ /ston 'jal chang gis ci dgar rab myos nas/ /tshes snyan rgyang 5rna ba'i gsos su 'jibs/ /mi lus dug sprul lce rkyang 'byog tshig gi /ra thang rje 'bangasal g.yogs rang don nor/ /sbar 'jug 'gog nus deb ther gto tshigs kyi/ /dngul dkar me long gsar pa deng 'dir bskrun/ zhes wo du brjod pa'i tshig sngon du bto nas 'phags pa'i yul du du rba ti zhes pa blo ga du 'bod cing / rgya nag spor thang dang mthun pa lcags mo bya'i lo nam mthong zla ba'i tshes nas dbu btsugs te pho brang sne'u sdong rtse'i chab 'bangs kyi shar kha/ mkhar thog /dgon gser/ btsan thang / yas chags/ legs gling khungs dang bcas pa'i bogs deb dngul dkar me long bkod pa la/ rin wo brag ri spang ljongs ljon shing mtsho/ /me tog rnam bkra dga' ba'i tshal gyi dbus/ /nor bu'i pho brang nang bzhugs gdengs can gyis/ /'dzad med 'dod dgu'i gter sgo deng 'dir phye/ /chu gter rlangs pa mkha' ngos yegs pa'i sprin/ /mthug po'i dbus nas char gyis myu gu'i bskyed/ /bsrings pas snye ma g.yur za 'dzin ma'i gzhin/ /spungs par yid la spro dga' ci yang brtas/ /gangs chu lhung lhung sgrar bcas pak+ṣu la/ /nyer 'bab shar nub khyod gnas skye rgu yis/ /bskrun pa'i 'bru rigs gud med thob thang (84bskon/ /gsal byed deb ther rnyog bral rdzing bur stos/ /zhes tshigs su bcad pa sngon du btang nas 'phags pa'i yul du du rba ti zhes pa blo ngan du 'bod cing /rgya nag spor thang dang mthun par lcags mo bya'i lo nam mthong zla ba'i yar tshes nas dbu btsugs te pho brang sne'u sdong rtse'i chab 'bangs shar kha/ mkhar thog dgon gsar/ btsan thang / yas chags/legs gling khungs dang bcas pa'i shas deb rnyog bral rdzing bu bkod pa la/ sa 'og sa steng sa bla'i 'jig rten kun/ /'gugs byed ā li kā li'i 'khrul 'khor sgra/ /rab sgrog 'dod rgyal gzi yisang ga bcoms kyang / /myos na gzhan dag lta ci dbang du sdus/ /lus phra nu 'bur dkyus ring mig (85na)zur gyis/ /chags bral chags pa slong byed nor rgyun ma'i/ /song mos rab btegs kyi snyem las/ /—104

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 9)'dzad med 'bru yi longs spyod char du snyil/ /g.yo ru yar mthil pho brang chen po yi/ /bya 'dabs ljongasakyi shas g.yul mtha' klas par/ /so nam rtsol bar ma bltos 'bad med du/ /spyod bogs 'dod dgu'i gter sgo phye ba bzhin/ /sa bon chu rgyud drod gsher mthus bskyed par/ /rtag 'grus khur gyisangal ba bsten pa'i 'bras/ /ma lus bang mdzod khengs la nyer spro ba'i/ /yid dga'i tshor ba nyams su ci yang myong / /de phyir brjed ngas 'jigs pa spong byed gtam/ / rab dkar shog bu'i ngos su yi ge'i gzugs/ /rnam dag brjod pa'i nor bu be+eḍūrla'i/ /do shal dpyod ldan mgrin pa'i rgyan du long / /zhes tshigs su bcad pas sngun bsus nas 'phags pa'i yul du du me ti zhes blo ngan du 'bod cing rgya nag spor thang dang mthun pa lcags mo bya'i lo nam mthong zla ba'i yar tshes nas dbu btsugs te pho brang chen po sne'u sdong rtse'i mnga' zhabs tshore g.yul bogs 'khri ba dang phyag 'debs kyi deb gsar du bsgrigs pa be+eḍūrla'i do shal bkod pa la/ sor mos mgul pa btsir bas rin po che/ /lhug lhug kha nas 'bab pa'i ne'u le/ 'dzin mdzad gnod sbyin dbang phyug dzam bha la/ /btso sbyangs mdangs 'dzin 'dzum zhal deng 'dir ston/ /tshong dus sde thang bcad pa'i 'phel 'grib la/ /bltos min rtsi tog lang tsho yongs (85ba)dngom bcud/ /lus kyi gzungs su song 'bras mar phyur sha /'brog pa'i dpya khral gcig tu mkho dgu'i nor/ /ras dkar snum zhugs dbyang byed sa dkar bzhin/ /zhib mor bcad cing brdar ba'i chu lha'i bus/ /don med stong sgra'i dug gi skyon sel ba/ /deb ther yan lag brgyad ldan deng 'dir 'god/ /ces tshigs su bcad pa sngon du btang nas 'phags pa'i yul du du rma ti zhesablo ga du 'bod cing / rgya nag spor thang dang mthun pa lcags mo bya'i lo nam mthong zla ba'i yar tshesanas dbu btsugs te pho brang chen po sne'u sdong rtse'i mnga' zhabs nas mar phyur/ che tshag chung tshag /snam bu sogs 'bab sgo'i deb ther yan lag brgyad ldan bkod pa la/ ris med 'gro ba kun la rjes brtseyang / /gangs can lha gcig 'jig rten dbang phyug gi /pho brang gru 'dzin gnyis pa dmar po ri/ /ye shesasems dpa'i gzi byin 'od du 'bar/ /rgya bal mtshams kyi nags klung stug po'i khrod/ /tsan dan ha —103

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()ri'i ljon shing khog yangs par//bod 'bangs legs byas zhing du rang byung sku//lo ke shwa ra'i snyan pa srid rtser grags/shwakya mu ni'i bzo phud las grub pa//thub dbang rta zur mas mtshone rgya bal bod//ca na'i yul las sa pa'i rten gsum tshogs//phyag skor mchod yul dkon mchog ma' sum bzhin//de phyir dge slong phun tsho gos rgya mtsho yis/sgyu lus don ldan bsgrub phyir skor 'bum gyi//grangs tshad dgos tshul bskul ba'i re stong ched/legs byas 'dzad med ga bla'i chu rgyun spel/de yang bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten 86na tha phyag skor mchod bstod gsol 'debs smon lam byas pa'i phan yon ni/lung gzhi las/mkhas pa gang zhig rab tu sems dang pas//sangs rgyas mchode rten la ni gom 'dor na//dzasbu chu bo'i gser gyi srang tshad na//stong phrag brgyar yang de dang mnyam pa min/zhes dang /mchod rten skor ba'i 3 yon las/mchod rten skor ba byas pas ni//dzam bu gling gi mnga' bdag de//sa steng mtha' dag dbang byed pa'i//chos dang ldan pa'i rgyal por 'gyur//zhes rgya cher bsngags pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung yin pas nam yang bslu bar mi srid pa/lung phran tshags las/zla ba skar ma tsho gos bcas sa la lhung yang srid//sa 'di ri dang nags tshal mkha' la 'gro yang srid//rgya mtsho chen po'i chu ni skams par 'gyur srid kyi//drang srong chen po rdzun gsung 'gyur ba srid pa min//zhes gtan tshigs rnam par dag pa la yid ches kyi nges pa rnyed de/de yang skor ba dngos la 'jug pa'i dus dpe la bstod pa las/khyod sku mtshan sa spras gyur pa//mdzes gyur mig gi bdud rdzini//sprin med lha go gyi nam mkha' la//skar ma'i tsho gos kyis spras pa 'dra//zhes sangs rgyas kyi sku'i yon tan rjes su dran pa'i bsod nams dpag med spel ba'i sgo nas ngag gi gsol 'debs bzlas brjod sogs dang bcas bskor bas mtsho ni te gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las sogs la'ang rgyu mtshan shes nas dad bas yid drangs pa zhig dgos shing /sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs86nab ma zad skor yul gang la'ang yon tan nges par gsal btab nas bskor na bsod nams khyad par can thob cing /lusang ga yid gsum bag yangs kyi dbang du ba/༷ na/zhi ba lhas/bzlas brjod dang ni dka' thub

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chags gsab ma gsum pa/ 'dasogs/ /yun ring dus su spyad byas kyang / /sems ga' na g.yengs pas byas pa ni/ /de nyid rig pasadon med gsungs/ /zhes par mkhas pa rnams don gtan nas med pa min kyang chung bar bshad pas/blo dang ldan pas bsgrims te bya dgos shing / de tsam ma lcogs kyang rten rnams la dad pa sngon du 'gro bas skor ba byed snyam pa'i 'phen pa btang ba la brten rgyun du g.yengs kyang lus kyi sgrib pa sogs la phan yon ni mi 'byung ba ma yin no/ /de yang phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i spyi pa'i las byed dge slong phun tshogs rgya mtshos 'di ga'i khri la tshad pa'i skor 3 dgos tshul zhig byung yang / gtso bor rang byon lo kai shwa ra dang / thub pa rta zur ma sogs li ma rgya nag ma/ bla ma'i sku brnyan gyi rigs sogs ches shin tu mang ba bzhugs par gtso bor dmigs na phan yon che zhing / de yang mchod khang yongs rdzogs kyi skor tshad byas na che chung tshang ma shugs la thon/ rdzong gi zhol gyi shar sgo nas nub sgor thon/ brag sgo brgyud ri la bcar ba'i thag oṃ/ ma rdzo khang dmar po'i phyi skor bcu gnyis rer phyi skor re brtsis pa'i phyi skor brgyad stong sum brgya so gsum rer 'bum ther/ phyi skor rer 'phags pa lo kai shwa ra'i ze'u lha khang gi skor ba lnga brgya gnyis re yong ba phyi skor brgya dang brgyad cus 'bum ther/ des mtsho ni thub pa rta zur ma sogasarten (87na)phal cher de ga'i khongs nas 'thon zhing / 'di ga'i khri la 3 par phyi skor re la khri'i skor thang sum brgya dang nyer bzhi re yong ba/ phyi skor sum brgya dang bcu la 'bum ther lhag bcas 'gro ba don gyi sku gsung thugs rten thams cad la skor ba byas pa'i phan yon 'thob bo/ /lhag bsam gangasakyi rdul brtsegs las 'ongs ba/ /skor ba'i dge tsho gis yan lag brgyad ldan rgyun/ /byang chub mchog gi rgya mtshor rtag babs nas/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro kun sangs rgyas sar 'khrid shog /pe tshos kha sgo sgrongaphun tsho gis rgya mtshos bskul spu ltar tho ho me gyi bzhes lcag mo bya'i los ga zla ba'i rgyal spu gsum pa'i tshes la sbyar ba'i yi ge gni mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dang po'o/ /—107

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()lha sa tshes bcu nub ma ba rnams kyis lcags bya hor zla tshes bcu chen mo'i nyin yer pa lha ri snying po'i mchod khang du 'phan sum cu phul ba'i kha byang rigs 'dzin 'jug ngogs bzhugs rbesto//'phags ma sgrol ma'i sku dbyibs ri bo'i ngos/khrong btsan khab bzhes mong bza' khri lcam gyi//thugs dam yer pa pad+ma thod phreng dang //a ti sha sogs paṇa grub mang po'i gnas//ngo mtshar zhing der sprel zla'i tshes bcu'i dus//rgyal sras slob mar bcas pa'i ga smyo lar//gos 'phan sum bcu'i grangs ldan mchod pa'i sprin//lha lam gzhon nur 'ja' ris lus phras 'byud//dge bas 'di snang bde skyid phun sum tshogs//rim brgyud skye bar zangs mdog dpal ri'i rtser//mtsho skyes rdo rje'i spyan sngar rigs 'dzin gyi//gral du 'khod nas don gnyis lhun grub shog/nam ste klu la sa mā dza mā ra ba ri 3 ya mā ya/kun bzang gdod nas nyer zhi 'jam pa'i dpal/gtum drag rdo rje khro bo'i stang stabs87bgyis//'khor 'das yongs kyi phyag rgya ma lus pa//cig car zil gyis gnon pa tshe bdag nag/gang gi las kyi gshin rjer rigs gsum mgon//yongs 'dus khro chu khol ma'i tsha dbal can//ha la'i dug sdong skye dgu'i bla srog tshe//'phrog byed rab gdangs zhal gyis gnam sa khyab//ban bon rig sngags byed dang sde brgyad kyis//glags lta'i skabs bral bcu gsum sra 'bregs gur//bshed 'bebs rang srog skyob pa rdo rje'i go/pad gnubs rjes 'brangs bzhed srol ji bzhin bkod//bla ma yi dam chos skyong yod do cog/kun 'dus gcig chog mgon po mnyu shrī/'di phyi bar dor slu med gto gyi skyabs//mchog thun dngos grub lag rtser stsol ba'i lha//rdo rje srung ba mkhar rdzong btsan po'i nang //tshe dpag med mgo/ 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bas//srog gi zungs su

sku gsung thugasarten gsar bzhengasadang mja rdzasakhang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'a)gyur pas bskal mtha'i bar//a ti mi shigs 'gyur med ka ba 'dzugs//stobs chen bzlog pa drag po'i 'phrul skyogs kyis//rbad 'dre dmod pa'i mtshon cha rbod gtong mkhan//rang gshed rang la 'bebasanus lasasbyor gyis//'jig rten pha rol ltad mor ga shed song //rig sngags brtul zhugs grub rlom phyi nang gi//log 'dren dmag dpon g.yul du gsod pa'i sgra//bdud bzhi slong ba gnam lcagasathog gi mdas//don snying gtubs kyang srog gi lhag ma 'dar//'chi bdag gdengasacan chu srin mgrin pa'i nang //chud nasabaskal par mi ldang btson khang du//dong rul btong ba mnan pa ri rab mdun//drag po mig gsum pasakyang 'grol nusaci//khro med khrosapa'i mche ba rnon po'i rtser//dmigs med dmigasayul bsam sbyor ga 88na〉yang tshogs//rtogasamed rtogasapas mi rtag lam bkod tshe//spros med sprosapas chosakyi dbyingasasu spor//sna tshogs lasabazhi'i snang ba 'phrul po che//semasanyid ka nasadag pa'i yo lang du/gar tshechu dang rlabasabaṣ+ka chosasku'i zhing //g.yin nasarnyid min 'jam dpal rang la rdzogs//yar la sangasargyasami 'tshol ga song gi/g.yang sar lhung snyam re dogasanyer bral sems//gzhon nu bum skur shar ba'i gdod ma'i mdangs//zhi khro'i 'ja' mtshon gcig tu bkrag po che//de phyir rgyal dbang rnga yab gling pa dang //gdubasabatsun sangasargyasaye shesazabasagater bdag/dum rgya yid khromasabargyud pa'i man ngag bayi//zur go bla ma'i drin lasarnyed 'di mtshar//dge 'dis gnas skabasami bsrun dgra dpung dang //sdobargyad 'byung po khrosapa'i tsha ngar kun//khro chu khol ma ha la nag po yi//dug rlangasadabal gyisarjesashul med par shog/bstan dang de 'dzin 'gro ba'i bde skyid dang //rigasa'adzin dpon slob rgyu sbyor sbyin pa'i bdag/bsrung byar bcug kun tshe dpal bsod namasastobs//dbang thang yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel bar shog/rig rtsal kun bzang mgo sum mthong min par//zab chosa'adi ston rdo rje'i slob dpon gyis//rjesabazung bskyed rdzogasardzogasapa chen po yi//thug mchog lam gyis smin cing grol bar shog/cesa'ajam dpal rigs gsum 'dus pa khro chu dug sdong nag po'i srung 'khor rnams dang 'brel ba'i bris rgyun 09

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)dkon pa tsam snang bar mkhas grub du ma rang grol gyi gsung ngag las byung ba ltar rigs 'dzin ku ma rā dze'i rnam sprul zur gzhon nu don grub kyi gur khang brgyad tshang ba'i phyag bris mar gzhi byas/ gur rim bcu gsum yongs rdzogs shog dril yig chung kha 'thor ba rnams (88ba)dang / mngon rtogs mi gsal ba tshe bdag bka' gter nas len dgos sogs 'khrugs sdebs nag 'gros byed lugs dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags par bslab bya dang bcas bsgrig bcug /dngos gzhi'i khyab 'doms sde pa sangs rgyas rgya mtsho dang / dgos byed sprod pa sogs do dam lding dpon dgon gsar sbug pa ngag dbang rab brtan/ lha bzo ba mkhas pa lcang bsrung khang pa rin chen rdo rje dang / gzhis rtse grang chen bsod nams dbang phyug lag g.yog lhas skyobs/ srog 'khor ('bri )'dri mkhan gzhis ka shar zur gu ru rta mgrin/ gong gsham 'tshem mi rag rtse shag pa o rgyan can yig mkhan rgyal rtse ba 'jam dbyangs dbang pos bgyis te lcags bya hor zla lnga pa'i nang du legs par grub pa'i rgyab yig 'di ni za hor gyi sngags smyon zil gnon drag po rtsal gyis sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon mchog gis bris pa bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyur gyur cig /khro chags mdzes sdug nyams ldan zhal khyim las/ /dkyus ring spyan zur ut+pal nyag phran dang / /lhan cig rgyud las 'phos pa'i srid zhi yi/ /dge legs dngos kun sdus shig rigs byed ma/ /g.yas g.yon phyag gi sor mos ne'u le'i mgrin/ /btsir bas zad mi shes pa nor bu'i rgyun/ /nyer bskyugs rgyal khab chen po'i yol go'i nang / /phyur bur spungs shig rmugs 'dzin dbang gi lta/ /ri sras ma la rtse 'jo'i rnam 'gyur gyis/ /sa 'og sa steng sa bla'i lus can snying / /bskul bas yid la bsams dgu'i 'dod yon gyi/ /gter sgo phye zhig lha chen gtsug na zla/ /dga' ba brgya pa'i legs byas drod ldan gyis/ sdobazhi'i gser sgong smin pa'i pho brang che/ /gnam skos rgyal khab gru 'dzin tshang mang 'di/ rnam thos bu yi g.yos khang mched po bzhin/ /ding phon hor gos pang khebs(yon skol dpyad dang / /gser dngul phud skyogs khebs stir rin po che'i/ /phra tshom tsan dan zo lag rgya sder sogs/ khrid na mtshar 'dzin —110

sku gsung thugasarten gsar 4khotshodang mgo rdzasakhang bzang gi dkar chagaglegasabam gsum pa/ khya)dpya yis phyur bur gtams//the tshom som nyi'i chu bo yod med kyi/kho cosarna ba gtser labaltosamin par//mibaskyud 'phrulagyi deb ther zamamoche//btsugs tshe sgo gsum bde bar bgrod pa'i lam rgya cher dbyibasadang yang lci'i khyad par sogs//dpyad gsum srang la gzhal ba'i brjod don tshig/brda dag gzugs mdzes yi ge spel legasasu//dpyod ldan sor mo'i zlosagar 'di na bsgyur//zhesabakra shi pa'i tshig gisasngun bsusate tshe ring gnam gyi sha mong gi stobasokyi 'khor lo nam mkhar 'phagasapa'i rgyal khab dmar po ri' yi ba khang du gsol dpon dpal grong sngagasaramasapa ༅ dbang dge legasal nyer dpyad kyi rim pa rtsisa'akhrir sbrad pa'i debazer 'phrul gyi gser ma bkod pa la//mtshan dpe'i cha shasardzogs pa yongs 'du'i ljon//mkhyen brtse'i lo 'dab grib tu nyer bsil bar//risamed 'gro kun ngal gso'i mchog sbyin mkhan//zas btsang srasakyi phan bde'i 'brasabazang stsol//5bajastan pa'i mkha' la'adren pa gnyisashar zla//'phel 'grib nyer spangasarnam dpyod kun ras//'dulamacan mdo sdekumud rab bzhad gnyen/khreng rta tshezung rjesa'abrangasabasngagasabya'i gnas//rgyal gsungasamatha' dag 'tshang rgya'i thabasakho nar/shar ba mar memadzad dpalachu lha'i bus//log tog dug bralamado rgyud klung chen bzhi//phyogasabargyar babasapa'i bga' gdamasarin chen 'phreng //mkhyen rab ralagrisargol ga srogabacad khrag/legasabashad yi ger shar ba pu sti da /dpung par mdzesargyan 'jam mgon gangasacan 'dir//blo btagasablo bzang gragasapa'i mtshan gyisasnyan//bka' dang dgongasa'agrel sgra tshad lung rigasakyis//bsgyur ba'i lo paṇa rin chen 'phreng brgyus deng //ma chad 'jig rten mig gcig bsten pa yi//srog yog rnamasal mi dang shesaldan su//de phyir chosargyal mesadabon bkasabacad nas//thamasacad mkhyen ngesazha lu lo chen bar//legasabasgyur gangasacan 'gyur ro cog gi bka'//'gro kun bsod namasamangon sum gzugasacan bzhin//de tshul nyer rtogasa.e dbyingasayul ljongasanas//gzimasashag lho par gragasapa dpa' mdzangs dang //brtul phod mched kyisatshangs pa'i yul samā/legasabyas bsnyems pa'i spobasamatho

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)'di chags so/ /zhes snyan 'gyur tshigs su bcad pa'i 'phreng ba sngon du btang nas gleng bar bya ba ni spyir sangs rgyas rnams ni slob pa lam gyi gnas skabs su rang nyams la dpags te/ khamasagasum gyi 'khor ba 'di/ lung gzhin/ gang na mi gnasalha rnamasami bzang ste/ 'tsho ba thung ba'i mi rnamasami bzang ngo /gang na zhe med srid pa mibazang ste/ /mya ngan 'dasab (90nalochog cesabade gshegasagasung / /zhesasdug bsngal gsum gyis mnar ba'i 'khor bar ma rgan sems can thams cad mnar pa ma bzod cing brnag dka' ba'i sdug bsngal de las rnam par grol ba mya ngan las 'das pa'i lam du shes shing /myang 'das gsum gyi nang nasakyang / rtogasabarjod rin po che dbag bsam 'khri shing las/ 'khor ba chu srin 'byung gnasalas/ /'gro ba gdon pa'i blo grosani/ mthuchen rnamasal 'byung 'gyur te/ /de yang 'di skad rjes su thos/ /zhes bdag gzhan gnyis rka'i don bde blag tu 'grub pa mi gnas pa'i mya pha las 'das pa yin la/ de rang nyid kyis mngon du bya snyam ste dang por smon pa byang chub mchog tu thugasabaskyed pa'ang / spyod 'jug tu/ 'gro ba 'dod dang 'gro ba yi/ /bye brag rim pa shesapa ltar/ /zhes 'gro ba 'dod pa tsam gyis mi chog par nges par lam du 'jug dgos pa'i dpe bzhin smon pa tsam ma yin par don de la ngesapar bslab dgos pa'i phyir/ bskal pa grangs med dgu'am gsum la sogs pa rgyal sras kyi spyod pa rlabs po che'i sgo nas sbyin sogs pha rol tu phyin pa bcu la goms par byas nas tshogasabasags/ mthar rang gi zhing dag pa rab 'byamasabasgrubs pa'i gnas la 'og min zhes ming du btags par mngon par rdzogs pa sangs rgyas ba sha stag yin pas/rnam 'grel las/ tsan+da ste'ur mtshungasapa la/ /chagasabral zhes ni brjod pa yin zhesagayas nasatsan+dan gyi lde gu'i byug pa byed pa dang / g.yon nas ste'u brdog par brtsams pa gnyisal nye ring med par rjes su brtse ba ni thub pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi khyad chos yin pas sems can rjes su mi 'dzin pa'i skabasag la zhig /'on kyang (90bgyido las/ sangasargyasani dusamakhyen to —112—

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'dazhes gdul bya'i khams dang bsam pa la brten nas 'dul ba'i dus la bab ma bab gzigs pa yin pas/ bskal pa bzang po 'di la sangs rgyas stong dang lnga 'byon par bshad pa'i sgron me bzhi pa shākya seng ge 'di nyid kyis thog mar thugs bskyed pa'i tshe/ mched gzhan rnams kyis spangs pa'i lhag par gdul bar dka' ba'i sems can gyi don mdzad par smon lam btab pas/ rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen pos/ /snyigs ma lnga yis ha cang sbags pa yi/ /zhid 'di gzhan gyis spangs dus mgon khyod kyis/ /yongs su bzung la rgyal ba sras bcas kyis/ /pad dkar lta bur bsngags pa'i dgongs pa'ang ci /zhes ched du bsngags pa ltar/ 'o skol gyi ston pa zas gtsang gi sras po nyid longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur sangs rgyas zin kyang lung du/ /gnyan yod gnas bcas tsam pa ka/ /wa ra nā gi yangs pa can/ /rgyal po'i khab dang drug po 'di/ /de dag grong khyer chen por grags/ /zhes rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul dbus grong khyer chen po drug tu grags pa'i lte ba mi 'gyur ba rdo rje gdan gyi spor mchog gi sprul pa'i skur mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul bstan nas/mngon pa mdzod du/ spyod pa rnams kyi gnyen por ni/ /chos kyi phung po mthun par gsungs/ /zhesagadul bya nyon mongs pa la spyod pa brgyad khri bzhi stong gi gnyen por chos kyi 'khor lo de snyed du bskor ba'i mtha' tshad bzung dka' yang yongs su grags pa wa ra nā sir bka' dang po bden bzhi'i chos 'khor/ bya rgod phung po'i rir bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i chos 'khor/ yangs pa can la sogs par tha ma legs par rnam par phye ba'i chos 'khor bskor ba thams (91na༄da/ ji skad du/ gang zhig don ldan chos dang nyer 'brel zhing / /khams gsum kun nas nye zhe mongs spong byed gsung / /zhi ba'i phan yon ston par mdzad pa gang / /de ni drang srong gsung yin ldog pa gzhan/ /zhes 'gro ba rnams kyi rgyud la gos pa'i nyon mongs pa spong zhing zhi ba'i lam du sbyor ba sha stag ma gtogs don log par ston pa gsung pa ni nam yang mi srid cing / thub pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'og rol tu bka' bsdu rim pa gsum la sogs pa'i mthar glegs bam du 'khod cing / bka' rnams kyi dgongs pa 'grel bar byed —113—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()pa'i legs bshad snying por/bde gshegs gsung rab tshul gnyis shing rta'i srol//legs par phye nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa mchog/sa gsum 'gro la nyi ltar gsal mdzad pa//klu sgrub thogs med gnyis la mgos phyag 'tshal/zhes nyi zla ltar grags pa rnam pa gnyis dang de'i rjes 'brangs/ji skad du/shing rta chen po'i tshul ni legs bzung nas//'dzam gling blo gsal bye ba'i mig 'byed pa//'phags pa lha dang dpa' bo sangs rgyas bskyangs//legs ldan 'byed dang zla ba grags pa'i zhabs//dbyig gnyen zhabs dang de sras yon to 'od/'i kya 'od dang phyogs kyi glang po dang //chos kyi gragasapa'i zhabs sogs 'dzam gling rgyan//thub bstan mi nub rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i mchoge mkhas pa'i dbang po rnams la gus phyag 'tshal/zhes pa ltar paṇ+ḍita nam mkha'i skar tshogs bawo byon pa rnams kyis bstan pa nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad pa las/lha mo dri ma med pa lung bstan pa'i mdo las/nga yongs su mya ga las 'das nas lo nyis stong lnga brgyar gdong dmar can gyi yul du dam pa'i chos dar bar 'gyur 91ba kho//zhes gsungs pa ltar/pur rgyal bod kyi rgyal khams 'dir kun tu bzang po dang /rigs gsum mgon po sogs 'phags chen dam pa rgyal po'i tshul bzung ba du ma'i sku ring la paṇa grub mang du byon zhing /khyad par 'jam dbyangs sa skya lo tsā bas//sdom brtson dam pa dpal ldan zhi ba 'tsho//brtul bzhugs grub pa pad+ma 'byung gnas dang //blo gsal dbang po pad+ma'i ngang tshul can//snyigs ma'i rgyal ba gsum la gsol ba 'debs//zhes pas mtsho ni te lo paṇa mang po dge 'dun gyi sde 'dzugs pa/chos bsgyur zhing bshad nyan gyi gtan la 'bebs pa/smin grol gyi gdamasapa ston pa sogs bstan pa nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad pa las mnga' bdag mu tig btsan po'i dus ska cog rnam gnyis kyis thog drangs pas pho brang phang thang du rgyud sde 'og ma gsum dang /mdo 'dul sher phyogs kyi glegs bam rnams phyogs gcig tu mdzad pa bka' 'gyur bsgrigs pa'i thog ma yin/de rjes dkar chags ldan dkar ma gnyis ni bstan pa snga dar dang /de rjes rgyal po sdig can gyis mtho brtsams te bstan pa la 'phel 'grib byung /sa yun ring song ba'i mthar/'dul ba'i bstan pa

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzheng dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 9)stod smad gnyis nas gsos shing / rgya gar nas paṇ+ḍita 'e ti dz+nyā na shrī/ jo bo chen po a ti sha/ paṇa chen ga ya dha ra/ kha che'i bsod snyoms pa chen po shākya shrī/ paṇ+ḍita nags kyi rin chen sogs lta ba bka' btags kyi phyag rgya bzhi nges par 'dzin pa'i paṇa grub du ma dang / lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po nas bzung zha lu lo chen rin chen chos skyong bzang po rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa rim par byon pa'i skad gnyis smra ba rnams kyis thub pa'i bka' rim par bsgyur ba'i dbus pa blo gsal gyis snar thang du bsgrigs par/ bcom (92na skon ral gris dkar chag nyi ma'i 'od zer mdzad/ mtshal pa thams cad mkhyen pa dge ba'i blo gros kyis dkar chag bkod par mtshal pa bka' 'gyur/ kun mkhyen bu ston zhabs kyis bsgrigs brtsoms them spangs par grags pa/ de dag la phyi mo byas nas dad pa'i nor dang gtong phod ldan pa rnams kyis gser dngul snag tshas bzhengs pa/ se ra byams chen chos rje gong ma ta ming gi ti grir bkur ba'i tshe/ bka' 'gyur par du bskrun pa'i mtshal par ma de dang phyogs mtshungasapa zhwa dmar ba drug pas ljangs sa tham du bsgrubs pas mtsho ni/ mchod sbyin zad pa med pa'i rim pa ji snyed gcig gnang ba/ brgyad stong pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyis brlabs kyis glegasabam chen po la yi ge gsal zhing rab tu gsal ba legs par bris te/ zhes glegs bam bris pasabasod nams rgya cher thob par ma zad/ de las kyang khyad par 'phags pa/ de nyid las/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mnyan par bya/ bzung bar bya/ bcang bar bya/ bklag par bya/ kun chub par bya/rab tu gdon par bya/ bstan par bya/ nye bar bstan par bya/ lung 'bogs par bya/ kha ton du bya/ zhesapa'i don ltar lung 'bogs par sher phyogs/ dkon brtsegs/ phal chen/ 'dul lung sogs rgyun cung zad 'bel yang / mdo mangs 'di ches dkon pa chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che dang bag ston gzhen nu tshul khrims gnyis kyis 'bad pa chen pos rgyun 'tshol ba mdzade pa nas bzung / mthu btsun thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' rnam rgyal dpal bzang po'i bar du dar rgyas che zhing / bar skabs su thog mtha' bar gsum gyi lung bklag pa sogs chos kyi gzugs brnyan tsam du gyur pa'i tshe —115

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang gyo4'a gsung 'bum/ (21) rigs dang dkyil 'khor (92ba)kun gyi khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos chig brgyud chad pa med pa'i lung khungs rnam par dag pa sa phug gnam brtol gyi tshul gyis btsal ba'i 'phrin las kyi rgyud la brten/ dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i rgyal khams kun tu bka' 'gyur ro cog gi lung rgyun rgya cher 'phel ba gzur gnas rnams rjes su yi rang ba'i yul yin no/ /dngos don e rig pa'i 'byung gnas su gsol dpon rab brtan zhes ya rabs dra ma'i rigs can lugs gnyis kyi rnam dpyod phul du byung bas rgyal ba gnyis pa shar btsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa'i bstan pa la mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang ldan pa gzims shag lho pa dkon mchog bstan 'dzin gnyis kyis dkar nag gi gos bu las kyi srang la gzhal ba'i dzi lci yang gi ngang tshul shes pa'i blo gros kyi mig yangs par brten lhag bsam kun da ltar ches cher dkar bar ma zad sgyu ma'i nor la 'jungs pa med par snying por len pa'i snying stobs che zhing / le lo brgyang du bsrings pa'i brtson ba chen po'i mthus 'phags pa'i yul du du rma ti zhes lo paṇa tu 'bod pa lcags mo bya lor bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' 'gyur ro cog yig gzugs brda dag zhal khebs gdong dar bsgril chas glegs shing glegs thag sogs sri zhun bskrun pa'i chos phun sum tshogs par legs par 'i bsgrubs pa phan yon ni/ 'phags pa sdud pa las/ la las gaṅgā'i klung gi ji snyed zhing rnams na/ /sems can ji snyed 'khod kun dgra bcom nyid btul bas/ /gang gis shes rab pha rol phyin 'di yig bris te/ /sems can mchog la glegs byin bsod nams khyad par 'phags zhes dang / sri zhu bskrun pa'i phan yon ni/ brgyad stong pa las/ me rtag dang bdug pa dang dri dang 'phreng ba dang byug pa dang phye ma dang rol mo dang na bza' dang (93na bdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang dril bu dang ba dan dang khor yug tu mar me'i 'phreng ba dang mchod pa rnam pa mang po dag gis bskur stir bya/ bla mar bya/ brjed par bya/ mchod par bya/ ri mor bya/ bsnyen bkur bya ste/ kun dga' bo 'di ni nga'i rjes su bstan pa'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di las thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yongs su rdzogs par —116

྾//slobazhu dang gru gu btul zhing sman rtsisablangs//'do ba cang shes rnyed cing 'phung g.yag sha//lhung ba'i rkyen gyis tshwa kha thog mar rnyed//gnamari srong btsan rje la gsol ba 'debs//bcu phrag 'jug ming mig sngon gcig pu'i 'phrul//phan

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()bde'i nga//94)srin mo gan rgyal dbyibasal mebatsa' btab //yi ge'i srol btod jo shaka pho brang bskrun//dge bcu'i khrims bcas thub bstan srol 105babatad pa//lha gcig srong btsan sgam por gsol ba 'debs//bcu phrag 'jug ming mig sngon gcig pu'i 'phrul//phan bde'i nga//65)rtsal chen blon po bdun gyisakhrims pa bsgyur//ja dang dkar yol dpyad pa'i gsar srol gasko//rnam dkar la brtson phan bde'i rgyun bzang bskyangs//'dusasrong mang rjer gragasal gsol ba 'debs//bcu phrag 'jug ming mig sngon gcig pu'i 'phrul//phan bde'i nga//66)dkor mdzod zangs byang lung bstan la zhabrul nas//garnyol lnga mchod rten sum cu bzhedas//mdo sde'aga' dang sman dpyad slar yang bsgyur//khri lde btsug brtan zhabasal gsol ba 'debs//bcu phrag 'jug ming mig sngon nga//slonamakhan slob gnyis sogasalo paṇa thod du bkur//zan g.yang gtsug lag khang bzhengasarab byung dang //mdo sngagasa'achad nyan bstan pa dar rgyasamadzad//khri srong lde btsan rje la gsol ba 'debs//bcu phrag 'jug ྾//6shegasar bcad skad kyisachos rnams dag ther mdzad//dge 'dun re la mi khyim bdun phul zhing //bkra shisadape med dge 'phel lha khang bskrun//mnga' bdag khri ral zhabasagasol ba 'debs//bcu phrag 'jug ྾//kho9)mi dge'i ngan spyod na bun dang bralazhing //rab dkar lhag bsam kha ba'i rdul brtsegasalas//bsod namasatshogasachen chu klung rtag 'bab pa//chos rgyal dge ba dpal la gsol ba 'debs//bcu phrag 'jugaza//60skotum po gos sngon can gyis rjes su bzung //gnod sbyin sde dpon rnam srasabran du 'bol//dngos grub mchog brnyes rkasmi ra ba yi//mkhas grub dgon pa ba la gsol ba 'debs//bstophrag 'jug nga//9)sri paṃ kwa ra'i 'phrin las spel ba la//rje btsun 'phags masalung bstan dge bsnyen che//'phrin lasam drosamatsho lasabaka' gdamasaklung //'bebs 106nalodzad 'brom ston rje la gsol ba 'debs//bcu phrag 'jug ming ྾//9/khril 'byor dbang phyug dngos kyis rjes su bzung //bdun cu rtsa gnyis rgyud sde mkhyen pa rgyas/khrub pa'i mtha' snyogasazung 'jug mngon 4

sku gsung thugs rten gsar tsongs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar sha glegs bam gsum pa/ 9)du gyur//brtse wo ༅ dga' kho por gsol ba 'debs//stso phrag 'jug ming ྾//9she sto wo phyag rgya'i gnas lugs gcig gi ngang //kun rdzob 'khrul pa'i rdzun phug yongs brdib nas//sku gsum yon tan sems la rab rdzogs pa//g.yu brag 'gro ba'i mgon por gsol ba 'debs//bcu phrag 'jug ming ྾//94)gsang bdag lha sngags ye shes mthar phyin pa//drang srong khyab 'jug gus pas 'bangs su bsnyen//dug can nad las 'gro khyab g.ya' bzang pa//chos kyi smon lam zhabs la gsol ba 'debs//bcu phrag 'jug ྾//9zhe tshogs gnyis zab mo'i gter gyi sgo 'phar phye//mkha' 'gro'i bka' babs don sgo nag po'i sgor//rgyal yum 'tsho rgyal ma yis dngos su gtad//nyi ma 'od zer zhabs la gsol ba 'debs//bcu phrag ྾//kho na klu bdud lto ba'i zab chos snying nor sogs//bco brgyad gter gyis sgo 'phar gegs med phye//khyad par bla ma'i bsgrub skor bka' babs pa//gu ru chos dbang zhabs la gsol ba 'debs//bcu phrag 'jug ming ྾//97)rigs 'dus sman pa'i rgyal po g.yu thog pa'i//'chi med tshe yi rig byed gdams pa'i bcud//thugs gsang dpal gyi be'ur yongs 'khyil ba//sum ston me shes gzungs la gsol ba 'debs//stso phrag 'jug ming ྾//9sheganam gyi she mong dpung pa'i 'khor lo yi//dbang sgyur shar phyogs gong ma'i rigs kyi bdag/'khon 106bskon 'jam mgon blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal//'phags chen chos kyi rgyal por gsol ba 'debs//bcu phrag 'jug ming ྾//99)'khrul snang gdengs can yul 'dren sngon 'gro'i sgo//bzlog phyir rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ri rdo tso//klungs mu ragasakyi bod yul bde skyid sogs//'tsho mdzad dge ba 'bum la gsol ba 'debs//bcu phrag 'jug ming ྾//(7ba)ni pa la yi yul lha gungs sgra dang //bzog sonang don phamathar yongs ga pas//mkhas pa'i snyan grags nor 'dzin kun khyab pa//pad+ma badz+ra zhabs la gsol ba 'debs//brgya phraga'ajug ming ྾//9cho pa'i phamatha' mi ma cane yangs pa la//paṇa chen 'jigs med grags ba thugs phyogs nas//thams cad bye par mas gsol ji bzhi du//don ldan dge 'dun grub la

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()gsol ba 'debs//bsto phrag 'jug ྾//'a 'tshad ma bzhi ldan snyan brgyud slob bshad bstan//spel la sa skya'i bla wo ngur smrig gar//legs bsgyur bdag wo rdo rje 'chang la po//blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal la gsol ba 'debs//bcu phrag 'jug ming ྾//9pe kun mkhyen bu yis yid dga' chos 'dzin nas//rnal 'byor rgyud kyi bstan pa spel ba la//nyer mngags khri dpon sku spyo rigasa'abyungs pa//mkhyen rab chos kyis rje la gsol ba 'debs//ban phrag 'jug ྾//(4pe rnam dpyod gzhon nur dbyangs can lus phra ma//rjes chags ba 'ad pas bgrang yas gtsug lag la//mi 'jigasardo rje'i spobs pa gzengs mtho ba//dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dpal la gsol ba 'debs//bcu phrag 'jug ming ྾//9zhe'od gsal lha rigs brgyud zhakhrungs chos kun gzigs//rnam snang klong sgrom mchog zung lhung bzed nas//yongs 'dus rnam gsum spyan drangs glo bo pa//gter wo pad+ma 07na po bang la gsol ba 'debs//bcu phrag 'jug ming ྾//9'a stong khun mi nyag brgyud 'khrungs zab mo'i gter//spyan drangs sde brgyad bran bkol dmag dpung tshogs//phyer btagasamakha' 'gro 'phrin las yongs grub rtsal//cho ge rgyal dbang po'i sdol gsol ba 'debs//bcu phrag 'jug ming ྾//rdzo3༄1/ gas lhung grub mtha' bral ba'i ris med chos//lam du 'gro ba'i lung bstan nyer thob cing //mtha' 'khob mun gling dkar por bsgyur mdzad pa//bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dpal la gsol ba 'debs//bcu phrag 'jug ming ྾//9)jing gir gnam gyi rgyal po'i brgyud las 'khrungs//rtsol med 'phrin las nyi ma'i gzi byin gyis/khregs ldan 'byung po'i bya tsho gis zil gnon pa//yon to rgya mtsho'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs//bcu phrag 'jug ming mig sngon gcig pu'i 'phrul//phan bde'i nor 'dzin 'degs pa'i sgyu thabs bzhin//gdul bya'i blo brid tsam du sna tsho gis gar/khog car rim brgyud dbye ba'i go skabs phra//'on te kun 'dus 'jig rten dbang phyug gi/spyan ras rtag tu gzigs pa mu thi la'i//'khri shing gsar pa'i spel legs byang chub par//'dzad med mdzes pa'i rgyan du 'gyur bar shog/'a/ ga'i rtogs brjod kyi ṣ+ka bkod shin tu rgyas pa

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chags gsab ma gsum pa/ 9)gtso bo rnams bka' gdams glegs bam sogs du mas kha bkang pa'i bris thang sa skyong sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i lhag bsam gyis kun nas blangs te drag po zhes pa lcags spre lor bzhengs pa'i dbu btsugs/ /lcags mo bya'i lor legs par grub pa'i shog dpe gzhis ka shar pa zur gu ru rdo rje/ /'phrin las rnam rgyal ngag dbang 'phrin las/ / ngag dbang rgya mtsho bzhis byas skabs rtogs(107na〉rjod kyi snying po spud pa'i tshe dpal grong sngags rams pas yang nas yang du bklags shing /chad lhag gi dogs glengs/ snga phyi'i zhugadag pa 'dar pa lo chen ngag dbang phun tshogs lhun grub/rnam gling paṇa chen dkon mchog chos grags/ dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ do dam 'bog gong chos mdzad blo gros rgyal mtshan/ ri mo ba sman thang nas mgon po tshe ring / dbu 'bring pho brang phun tshogs dang / rags kha 'jam dbyangs dbang po/ dbu chung 'o rlon 'jam dbyangs dang stag lung bkra shis/ byings gras sum cu so bdun/ /phogs dgos byed sogs sprod mi dar rgan bka' bcu dang skrus srang pa gnyis/ /nang gi zhal byang dang / /gtso bo rnams kyi kha byang rnam gling nas/ /yig mkhan rgyal rtse 'jam dbyangs dbang po dang / /ngag dbang phun tshogs/ /lcags bzo do dam bya sgo pa blo bzang dbang phyug dang / /'tsho byed ngag dbang rin chen dbu mdzad ra phyi shag pa phyon dang bsod namasasogs bgragacig /rtag bzo ba bkra shis rnams kyis bgyis skabs/ /phan bde legs bshad gling pa/bde chen rab brtan pa/ byang gling pa/ 'brang rgyas shag pa/ zur khang pa/ spus srang pa/ mgron gnyer nor bu/ bsnyen gnas ma spyi/ ri mo ba'i bye brag dang bcas pa rnams kyis ston mo ster cha sogs sna tshogs/rta dpon rnam 'joms kyis grang gser srang gang gi zhal 'debs bgyis pa gegs med grub bar nye skabs gsol 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa 'di za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge ba ni gtsug lag mang por blta ba'i blo mig can mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang pos bgyis pa dza yas/ /(108na)srid zhi'i sgrib gnyis cha rnams rdzogs pa las rlung nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor zung / /'gyur med dbu ma ye shes/ ti seng ge mo'i bus nyer bzas bas/ /rnam kun mchog ldan phyag rgya chen po mkha' —137

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()khyab mkha' yi rdo rje'i skur//macan par bzhengasapa dang po'i sangasargyasakā latsakrasartag tu skyongs//ma gadha yi lho phyogs mdzes rgyan 'bras spungs mchod rten cher//lag na rdo rjes dbang tshul bzung so ma bha dral//dpal gyi mgur nasartsa ba'i rgyud gsungasashākya seng ge yi//'khor losamatshan pa'i phyag mthil bdag sogs 'gro 'di'i gtsug tu khyongs//legs pa'i cha bsagasagrong khyer chen po sham+bha lar//'dren mchog de srasami yi bdag por rnam sprul ba//chosargyal bdun dang rigasaldan nyer lnga'i zhabs pad rdul//dmar po lusacan yongasakyi gtsug tu lhung bar mdzod//dusa'akhor zhabasapa rwa 'bro shong 108brkobang bu//rjesa'abrangasa'aphagasabod lo paṇa mkhasarnams kyi//rnam dpyod shing rtasaphyi nang gzhan gsum nor//'dren pa'i mdzad pa mchog la su mi dad//'on te zla dkyil ri dwags gzugasabarnyan dang //dkar ba'i gangasarir na bun 'khor ba bzhin//zhabrul rtog rnyog masasbags klung dngas byed pa//dpyad gsum dag pa'i ke ta ka yi rang //de phyir smra ba'i nyi ma chosakyi grags//lam 'disazung 'jug mngon gyur nor bu bzang //rtsisarig mthar son lhun grub rgya mtsho'i zhabs//phyag na pad dkar sa'adir byon pa bzhin//gsar rnying phugapa'i ringalugasamatho risachab//rnam dpyod hub kyisa'athung mkhasadzaḥ//dpalaldan thog ma'i mgon gyi 'phrin lasargyun//man ngag gaṅgāsalog rtog dri rnamasa'akhrud//zur chen kun mkhyen smon 'gro paṇ+ḍita //gnyagasaban nang ra gzug po gzhon nu'i marga//ldum po don grub dbang gi rgyal po sogs//masasamed yongasa'adzin bka' drin pha mtha' yas//rnam dag brjod pa'i lusal mang thosargyan//sngon rabasamakhasamang glang r+sha phra mo'i rtsis//tsha gdung ma bzod 'byog bshad gom 'grosakyis//rigasaldan bzhad pa'i pad tshal 'dam ltar brdzis//phyi nang gzhan sbyar stong gzugasaphyag rgya che//mngon gyur lta shog gza' skar 'phrod sbyor kyang //nongasapasa'ajig rten bde skyid snying phug pa'i//khrag dron 'jib la khepasapar snying po ci//'char dusasprin dkar lang long 'khrigasapa'i dbus//dbyar rnga'i sgra thosarma bya mo yi mngal//stesadabang tsam gyisabazung la'akhrigasapa yi//mngon 'dod rtsedaga'i dga' ston la'akhrul ཿ

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ tanamang //gser ri'i sbubs nas ri bong 'dzin pa'i gzugs/shar tshe ut+pal 'dab ma bye ba la//'dzum phreng tshems dkar gyis bsus ze'u 109na〉khru'i mig/mtshar 'dzin bsnyems pa rang mtshang gzhan ngom bzhin//lcags la rngul chus za ltar sbyangs gzhi'i lus//lnga ldan ye shes skur 'gyur smon yul tsam//kye ma 'gro 'di langs pa'i blangs dor gnas//bstan pa des kyang byang chub mi ring nye//de tshul tshon ris lhag bsam man shel ngos/shar bas pad+ma dkar po'i zhal gyi lung //ma bur bcas pa mi zad mchod sbyin gyi//par du spel ba'i snying stobs phrag par blangs/'i kya seng ge'i gzhung lugs mdo sngags sbyi//bye brag dpal ldan dang po'i sangs rgyas sa//smin grol rgyud 'grel man ngag 'chad nyan rgyun//'dzam gling wo ngu'i tho kun tso par shog/dus kyi 'khor los zla bzang dang mas sa par//gsungs par ma bltos bden gnyis ma lus kun//mngon sum gzigs pa blo bzang grags pa yi//ring lugs 'khor mtha' rdzogs min dar bar shog/gang 'di'i chos srid bstan pa bla nas blar//gyen 'degs dga' ldan pho brang rgyal khab che'i//khrims gnyis rtsibs stong 'dzam gling chen po'i gzhir//gnam gyi she mong dpung pas 'khor bar shog/sangs rgyas de'i gsung dge 'dun bden pa'i mthus//sa dbang sku tshe rigs brgyud mnga' thang gi/rgya mtsho'i rlabs phreng dus las mi yol par//bde skyid 'dod dgu'i nor bu 4 'bebs shog/'jig rten spyi dang khyad par rgya hor bod//nor 'dzin dpal mo'i mngal du rdzogs ldan dus//gsar pa'i khur lci sim pa'i tshor ba yis//rngulaba'i chu rgyun chad pa med par shog/mi zad chos kyi sbyin pa'i sgo 'phar brgya//'byed pa'i zhug chen yigamakhan rkos pa dang //gnyer gyi las 'dzin byed por ga rta gos so09bsog/'di phyi'i legs tshogasathams cad lhun grub shog/mkha' la 'khrul med gza' skar 'phrod kyis dge/sal sdebazhi'i dga' ston g.yang du chags//mchog gsum bden tshig lha dang drang srong gis//ba po shis glud byangs phyogasabacur sgrog par shog/de'ang tshe gcig lus gcig la stong gzugs phyag rgya chen po mchog gi go 'phang mngon du byed pa la thams cad mkhyen pa btsoX kha pa chen pos kyang //rgyud sdogs nga/nga bshad

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)srol mi 'dra ba/ mang rta'i srol chen dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud/ /gsal byed dri ma med pa'i 'od la sbyangs/ /zhes bka' stsal ba ltar bla na med pa'i rgyud sde g.yin rnams las kyang khyad par du 'phags pa yin na'ang gzhan dus kyi 'khor lo shes pa la nang dus kyi 'khor lo shes dgos/ /nang dus kyi 'khor lo shes pa la phyi dus kyi 'khor lo shes dgos/ de la dkar rtsis kyi yan lag 'di nyid shin tu gces kyang mkhas pa shong dbang bu dol/ stag tshang lo tsā ba sogs mang pos gza' 'das par bzhed pas mtsho ni log rtog gi bshad pa sna tshogs dang / 'gos ye bzang rtse bas zla ba'i skar ma'i gong sol skar thog mar 'char ba sogs la 'khyog bshad yig cha mang po mthong bas dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi bzhed pa'i zab mo rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i don mngon sum du rtogs/ kun rdzob kyi bden pa la mi bltos kyang tshur mthong gi skye dgu rnams ma dag 'khrul pa'i snang ba dgag tu mi nus pas gza' skar log par bstan nas sems can mang po 'phang pa rnams nyes pa de dag las ldog na snyam pa'i lhag bsam gyis kun nas blangs te pad dkar zhal lung ma dang bu yig gsal sgron skor zhal lungamadzes rgyan dang bcas le tshan rnams 'phags pa'i yul du du rma ti zhes blo ga du 'bod cing / mahā tsi na'i yul du zin ye'u lte lcags mo bya'i lo par du brko ba'i sta gon du sa skyong (110longs rgyas rgya mtshos gang ci'i mthun rkyen gyi khyab bya dang / pā ṇi sogs sgra rig rgya mtsho'i pha mthar son pa 'dar pa lo chen ngag dbang phun tshogs dang bya nag rigs las rnam gling paṇa chen dkon cog chos grags gnyis kyis zhugadag /par zhug pa/ par rkos pa yig mkhan gnyer pa sogs che shes byas te bsgrubs pa'i tshe par byang du smon lam tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni za hor gyi rigs las tshangs srasab 'ad pa'i rdo rjes sbyar pa'i yi ge ba ni sgra snyan sdeb sbyor rtsis sogs la blo mig yangs pa'i 'phyong rgyas lkog bsam mthong lo tsā ba phun tsho gis dbang po'o/ /ngag dbang gis 'bra spung gling bsre'i du ge yang ga tshang du bla bre phul ba'i kha byang dgo tshul ltar bkod pa nges legasashing rta/ rgyal dang de sras rang rgyal mtha' klas pa'i/ /snang bas ga smyo la yi mchod sdong cher/ /bla bre —140

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar sha glegs bam gsum pa/ 'dalhag bsam gyis phul gru rdzings kyis/khrod pa 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho wo po las//pad+ma rdo rje rta mgrin rdo rje spun//nyer bsgral mdzo mtho nges legs rten thob cing /khyu sbyar byed tsho srid sto yon to kun//yar ngo'i zla ba lta bur 'phel bar shog/nabla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems chos srung rnams dang gtsug lag khang sogs rten brten pa la snyan shal 'phan bla bre sogs phul ba'i zhal byang bsod nams ma dros mtsho chen bzhugs/ba kho ldan zhes pa sa yos lo gsar dus 'dod khas dbang phyug mar mar pa'i tshe phul ba'i snyan dar zhal yig lon la rnam sto lhun grub/stobs bcu mnga' ba'i phul byung yon to kun//kun nas ma lus rab bsdus ngag gi lha//lha mchog rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma//mas sa lo go 'dren dag dang bgegs kyi tshogs//2na 'ab brjid mdzo spyod las kyis gdul ba'i phyir//wo sngo in+d+ra ni la'i sa 'dzin la//rab 'bar bskal pa'i me dpung gyon 'dra ba'i//rab gas mi bzad khro tsho skur bstan pa//dpal ldan 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma//ma lus bgrod byed zung gtso'i bstan srung mchog/mchog gsum dngosagyur skyon rje tshod kyi yum//yum mgo dmag zor sto mo gang de la//6 med dang pho rdul phywa grangs med kyi//bzhi gyi puṇ+ḍa ri ka zum byed pa//dbang phyogs gan mdzod las 'ongs tshe bdag dang //legs mtshudas dkar 'jam snyan shal 'di phul bas//snying dbus thig le'i sa bzang mdun sa sa/sngon nas bsams pa'i las bzhi'i skabs gsum bdag/mi mthun bcud bral dpung tsho gos rab bcom nas//phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i dge legs stsol//ga mi chubasgo sgo kha lcang lo༅gyi dpalas lha mo 'dod /yas kyi dbas rtsa kha shal350 kha2ba mig dngos

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)grubs 'bebs/ /mdzes sdug rnam par spyod pa'i dga' tshal du/ /legs bris sked med brgya byin rkang 'thung tshogs/ /pham mdzad tshangs sras yongs 'du dpag bsam shing / /lugs zung 'dod rgu'i 'bras ster ngag gi lha/ /nyi ma'i gnyen gyi bstan pa pad+ma dkar/ /bskal mtha'i nyin byed dus 'dir bsil zer las/ /'grub nus dman tshe mngon spyod 'od rnon can/ /'dren mdzad rab khros dbang mo'i skur bstan la/ /sna bdun rin chen sngon 'gro la 'gran khab/ /gan mdzod las 'ongs lha rdzas sprin lam dbus/ /bdag lus longs spyod dge tshogs chu khur can/ /mchog thun dngos grub zung gi gru char tshogs/ /'bebs phyir rab dkar dad pa'i byed po yis/ /legs par phul ba'i thugs rje'i sgyu rtsal mthus/ shwakya'i ring lugs nor 'dzin khyon yangs par/ /blo bzang bstan pa'i sa 'dzin dbang po'i spor/ /'dus sde 'chi ba med pa'i skyed tshal du/ /sde snod gsum gyi legs bris rnga bo che/ /phyogs bral thog ma'i rdul can thos 'dzin gyi/ /kā ṇi ka yi dpal du gyur pa dang / kha mchog khang steng yid kyi rgyal mtshan rtser/ /gsol 'debs la gyi thugs rje'i yid bzhin nor/ /ster por bkod las 'dod don 'phrin las bzhi/ /thogs med 'grub pa'i dga' ston rgyas par mdzong / /dpal ldan lha mo g.yul rgyal mar phul ba'i snyan dar zhal yig las bzhi char 'bebs/ /rgyal kun 'phrin lasashel gyi rtsig ngos la/ /mtha' yas gzugs sku'i sprul sgyur rtag 'char ba/ /yid 'ong tshangs(3na)pa'i na chung 'chi med gtso/ /gang 'tsham rtsub 'gyur tshal gyi byed po des/ /rab khros yan lag rnam bzhi'i 'brul 'khor gyis/ /dgra bgegs sbyin skyes gzho me par mdzad gang la/ /dkar mdzes ke la sha yi mdangs 'phrog pa'i/ /legs bris rdzas kyi snyan shal 'di phul bas/ /gang gi 'gog med thugs rje'i chu khur mthus/ /rnam mang rab mas las bzhi'i char chen gyis/ /lugs zung 'dod don yongs 'du dpag bsam shing / /legs smin 'bras bu'i dga' ston rgyas par mdzod/ /sa bos hor zla bas pa'i nyer lnga 'grub sbyor gyi thog rtser theg 'a gling gi pad+ma dbang ོ yang gsang khros par snya shal phul pha kha yig yongs la du'i ljon pa/ /pad+ma'i rigs bdag chos sku'i lha lam ngos/ /khro rgyal dbang chen — 142

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'damakha' glang legs 'khrigs pas//phul byung sna tsho gis 'phrin las gru char gyis//lugs zung yongs 'du'i ljon pa rgyas par mdzod//lcags thig gnam lo gsar du tshes pa'i nyin srid gsum bdag mo mchod pa'i dus ston gyi thog phul ba 'a snyan dar zhal yig nges ga4 gzha pa rgyas pa'i ru mar//gu ru tshung ram de wa badz+ra ṅgā tī shwarā shan+ta kro : nas ba dwa5di gi pa dza yu nī sre ya byu/'dren byed dga' ston mchog gyur mdzes sdug gi/lang tsho rnam par rgyas pas zla gzhen yang //yid kyi shing rtas legs drangs zur phud rtser//mngon par 'god pa'i byed po dbyangs can ma//ma lus phan dang bde ba'i si rgyu'i bdag/bdag nyid chen po'i lung rtogs bdud rtsi'i phul//phul byung zhing gi bsod nams ge lu sha/sha mchog la 'khu dgra bgegs sngon gyi lha//'joms phyir stang zil brtsegs pa'i gyen 'phyur dbang //3bgrangs med tsha zer rgyan gyis legs spud cing //dusamatha'i 'od kyis shing rta'i gos gyon na//gang sku'i cha shas la 'gran mkha' 'gro'i gtsor//smin legs bzhin lamatha' yas rnam 'gyur gzugs//sor rtse'i gar las byung snyam 'phyang mo nyug //ster byed shel dkar rlung gi grogs po yis//lan brgyar bzhu ba'i mdangs 'dzin gan mdzod dar//phul bas bdag yid sgyu stsal spyod gang gi/'phrin las rnam bzhi'i 'dod don skye ba spel//deng khyod thugs rje'i ri dwags mig can gyis//thogs med 'grub pa'i dga' ston rgyas par mdzod//lcags la rtsa chol rdzus ༅ dus rdzo bog po' snya shal rdzu po pho kha yig byang chus kho por 'bab ༅ nyal lo/pa ra ma nā yo shrī ma shākya mun mi dhi tsho kurba skyo//phun 'dres༅zung yā/tsho gis bsod nams stobs las legasa'ongs mig stong stong gsum kun la dbang sgyur dbyig gi snying //snying khar ngo mtshar dpal gyi be'u'i dbyibs mdzes mdzes sdug lang tshos khengs ldan ri skyes ma//ma lus legs sbyar gter gyur smin drug bu gang gang de skyed par byed po gaṅgā 'dzin//'dzin ma'i spo sogs khams gsum dregs can tshogs kun kun nas rab tu dang pas yan lag mchog/mchog rkang bsto bar na yod pa ra pa' zung ldan dang mtha' thog spyar ra po gnyis 'dres pa//gi spyi bor bsten paXphan bde'i dpal stsol dpal ldan nyi ma'i gnyen

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()zhes nor ldan khyon//khyon 'di phul byung yon tan bsil zer tsho gos rnams tshogos gnyis zla 'phel lasa'ongs grags pa'i sgra//sgra yis char ldan rnga yang pham phyir 4na po byangs kyis dbyangs snyan tshangs pa'i glu yi snyems pa yang //yang dag brjod bral stobs las btang zhes rab 'geng rab 'byams dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi mchog/mchog 'di ra mtha' thog sbyar ③zung ldan/der gnam bskos mi rje lha yi rgyal//rgyal phran grangs med zur phud pad+ma dkar//dkar dmar mdangs 'dzin zhabs sen sbrang rtsi 'dod//'dod ldan sgeg mor rol 'dra chu 'dzin lam//lam ngos rgyu skar dbus na mtshan mo'i mgon//mgon de'i bdud rtsi'i zegs ma gos ldan dus//dus kyi las ma dang bral 'tshams gzugs //cha kun rdzogs la 'gran pa stobs kyi dbang //dbang phyug brgyad kyi 'jig rten yon tan gter//gter mdzod migaci skyar 'khu ba shar gyi phyogs//phyogs bral zil gnon khyab las legs 'ongs dar//dar dkar rdzas kyis kai la sha yi 'od//'od gzi mngon par 'dzin dang bsil ba'i ljongs//ljongasakyi phun tshogs 'dod rgu'i dpal 'byor kun//kun bzang mchod sprin lhan cig lha lam mtha'//mtha' klas tshogos rnams ji snyed lhag pa'i sems//sems can kun la gcig tu dkar ba'i blo//blo gros stobs kyis phul pa bgrang yas dge/dge tsho gos mthu las rnam 'dren zas gtsang sras//srasabacas bstan pa dkar phyogs rdzogs pa'i tshes//tshes bdag ltar rgyas skye rgu'i bde legs dpal//dpal 'bar bdag yid 'dod don zil mngar bdud//bcud ldan tshig gi dmod pa lta bu'i mthu//mthu stobs gang des legs 'grub mi mthun dpung //dpung tsho gos lus pa med pa she la'i ri//ri rnams sprin 4bgyi gzeg ma'i rdul gyi cha//cha tsam gyur ltar phyogs rnams thams cad las//lasabazhi'i byed pos rnam par rgyal gyur cig/smon lam chen mo'i dus dpal ldan lha mo dung skyong mar snyan shal phul ba'i kha yig 'dod don snye ma g.yur za//shan+ta su de phyi kha pā la le he ma ma ga lha lha sirnya kurba skyo//shel dkar 'bar ba'i ro 'dzin sa bzhu ༷//lan brgyar byugs min bsil sbyin mkhan po

sku gsung thugasarten gsar 4khospodang marna rdza kha bzang gi dkar gaglegasabam gsum pa/ 'ayi//bdud rtsi'i gzig masa.ut+pal dkar po'i tshal//mngon par bawa la rab 'gongasalang tsho'i dpyid//legasabris mchog gi na chung marga bzang gis//ster por bam na yid 'ong gang gisku'i//mtshungasazlar ma tshig rig byed dpe ma du//'osasnyam yid la 'chang byed rgyal ba'i yum//gang der rab dkar dad pa'i chu 'dzin las//snyan shal dar gyi gru 4 legasaphab cing //pad dkar 'dzin pa chosargyal mesadabon dang //bstan rtsa mkhan go mtsho skyesardo rje yis//gsung gi dam bsgragasadabyar gyi rnga gsang sogs//sna tshogasargyu lasa'adod don snye ma rnams//thogasamed 'grub cing smin pa'i legs tshogs kun//mthu stobs dus kyi byed pos 'byung gyur cig/dung skyong dbang mor phul pa'i ma dar khayig 'dod don sgrin gyi myu gu//rab 'byamasargyal ba'i bstan srung lha lam ngos//ma shalarma gi shing rta legasadrangasapas//rje 'bangs lugasaganyisa'adod don dbyar gyi 'bras//'phrin lasasprin gyi myu gu grub par mdzod//lcagasolngas dpalaldan la sbungasakyi byamasago/dngulagadung go mogar+ṣa/ja sh+kagasamago rten bam/dporaldan dmag zor ma'i brisasku rnamasal ma shal phul lo khayig dgomasayod 5nardzi shesapa'i chu ma//gser lcangachen/sa lan brgyar byugasa'adra gang gi skus//sa mtshamasamadzesasdug 'phrog pa ngesapar rdzun//bden na phan tshun yid gcugasarab 'byud pa//gtsug lag gzhung lasabashad 'di su yisa'agong //de 'dra rgyal ba kun gyi srasagacig pur//'chi med rdzas kyi snyanashal 'di phul bas//gnasaskabasamathar thugs kun gyi 'dod pa'i don//thogs pa med par 'grub pa'i dge legs stsol//rab dkar kai gang khanubadangugosang /la sha yi sa'adzin gyi//rab mdzesamadangasa'aphrog rgyal ba'i mno sdong la//rab mnyen dbang phyogasagan dar 'di phul bas//4'byasasostos0mas bathobaparashog/lasarnam thar sgog4gyidanguwosnyung /bzang sor rtse'i r+sha gyisarnam bkra'i gzugs//pham byed bsod namasago du sum rtsen nas//'ongasasnyam lung mo'i dra bar 'ching byed 'dis//'gro la phan dang bde ba'i dpal stsol cig/jagagasatshadarten bam/'gro 'di'i go du bu ram shing pa yi/ṣām mang 4

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho gsung tshom/ ()sprul pa'i gar las thugs kyi rten//mchog gsum sab po shis grangs si 'dis//phasargya rmetsho'i dus tsor go/ dam gzo bris sku/ khang lcang lo can pa tha ldand shal7〉sol//r+shar+sha ka'adren mun rnyas 'joms la ring khros kyang //lus can pa' phro la byams brtse'i 'od//mdzo par spro mdzad lha mar rta ljang dbang //yid ngor rgyu ba'i 'dod don sgrub par mdzod//dpal ldan mkha' 'tsho dbang phyug mthu stobs kyis//srid gsum 5ba thun las rgyal ba lha yi rnga//sgrog mdzad legs bris bu mos bsams pa'i don//thogs med yid bzhi tshib par mdzad du gsol//skya kha bar na go po ri bod lta 0gyi dasad+kung si po'i ha lta pos sne kha god ne'i rtse da lto 4 mi//dpal ldan sto kun lung rtogs lha lam dbus//cho yangs blo gros bzang pho gnyis bdag/mdzo par 'ongs pa'i gos spyod 'od rnon gyis//dpal stug bska pa sbrang rtsi'i sams slo//rab rgyas grags pa dbyar skyes rnga g.yo gis//phyogs bral gtsug phud ༅ gyi thos4na du//khosapar ho pa sngon med dga' ston mkho/slomadzad phul byung byed po rtag tu tso//ri dwags mig mā bzhi ras ma sgo ṣ+ka //bcu zer dkyil wor lha yi snyo yangs par//bgrod bi rgya mtsho zla ba pham byed pa'i//dkar 'jam zung tshol lha rdzas snya shal dar//gcu ldan rgo 'dir 'gran lathugs kyi rten//sto ba'i mar rdzo gang der phul ba'i dges//gnas skabs mthar a kun du phan bde yi//dga' bde'i dpal la spyod pa'i dge legs sngo//lcags tsā ga gi lo lnga mgo r+sā tsho thog dga' ldan gyi dngul gdung rin po cher phul ba 'a a dar khi yig lhag bsgopa//su sti//rab stims rgyal dbang mkhyen brtse'i blo mtsho las//rnam dkar bzang phi mdzad pa yid bzhi nor//tso bstan sams rtser bkod grags pa'i sgra/khrid gsum tso sgo 6na ) rgyal ba gnyis par bod//rin ོ gtso lhun po rta ljang gis//lan brgyar lkod pa'i mdangs 'dzin gan mdzod dar//rab dkar lhag bsam dag pa/ 6byed po yis/a byung mar sdong dam par phul

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'daba'i mthus//sa lon dbang po ji srid gnas kyi bar//thub pa'i lung rtogs bstan pa rab rgyas shing //grangs med 'gro ba kun gyi bde skyid rnams//'phel zhing brtan pa'i dpal 'di 'grub gyur cig/lcags sprul gnam lo gsar tshes kyi nyin srid gsum dbang phyug ma dgyes byed mchod pa'i dus snyan shal phul ba'i kha yig nor bu dbang gi rgyal po//oṃ su:pra tsho:/mkhyen pa'i gter gyur zur phud lnga pa gang de dgyes dgur spyod la mchog gyur ngag dbang dbyangs can lha//mi mthun dgra sde'i dpung tshogs 'joms shing mchog thun dngos grub stsol phyir srid gsum dbang sgyur drag mo'i skur//legs ston lhag pa'i lha mchog dam par kai la sha yi sa 'dzin 'ongs 'dra 'jam mnyen bkra shis dar//mi 'gyur gcig tu rnam par rab dkar dngas pa'i yid kyis phul ba'i dge tshogs rgya mtsho che de las//gnas skabs mthar thug yid la bsams pa'i don//phul byung nor bu dbang gi rgyal po che//srid gsum rgyal mtshan rtse mor legs bkod pas//mchog thun phun tshogs 'dod rgu 'grub par mdzod//bi ri smad rta don yod kyis mdo khams kun rang gir tshong ste tshan 'a tso bde skyid 'joms(6bto'i 'ad ma r+pā por gyur pa'i dus//de'i ga 'a por bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal pos g.yul bshams te khams phyogs su sde gzar yun ring la dar drag pa byung skabs thus rim du 'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i mnan bsreg 'phang gsum 'chi bdag zhal dbye ba sogs kyi las sbyor dang /dam can srung ma' tshad bskul bgyis pa gnad du song pa'i g.yul rgyal ba'i gtam snyan byung skabs lcags sprul hor zla gnyis par phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i tsho gis su yi dam chos srung spyi bye brag la gtang rag phul ba'i snyan dar zhal yig bdud las rnam par rgyal pho khan//phyags gyi 'khon //rab 'byams rgyal kun yab gyur 'jam dpal dbyangs//log 'dren gdug pa gdul phyir khro bo'i dbang //dpal ldan bshan pa chen po dus dgra/phyag rgya zil gnon las gshin 'khor bcas kyis//sngar bcol mngon spyod las rnams hrūb pa dang //'byung 'gyur las kun thogs med bsgrub pa'i ched//phyi nang gsang ba rab mas mchod pa'i sprin//legs 'bul brtse bas bzhes la don rnams sgrubs//zil dpal ldan dam gajo ra ma gnon bka' nyan srid gsum kun gyi bdag/lhag pa'i lha mchog dmag zor re ma ༵//mchog thun 'dod rgu'i dpal stsol dbang gi

rgyal dbang lnga pa pag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung ri bu pa/ (21)rgyal/ /dus bzhi'i lha sogs 'bor dang bcas rnams kyas/ /sngar bcol mngan spyod las rnams grub pa dang / /'byung 'gyur las kun thogs med bsgrub pa'i ched/ /phyi nang gsang ba rab mas mchod pa'i sprin/ /legs 'bu pa brtse bas bzhes snye pa 'dod don spyi/ /(7na༄nga par bdag yid mchad sbyin brgya pa yi/ /bsam/ don 'chi med phun tshogs dpal 'byor rnams/ rab rgyas dgra bgegs bcud bral 'joms pa sogs/ thogs med lhun gyas bsgrub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /mi gon po lta pa/ zhing skyong stobs 'phrog dbang po 2khrer bcas 'a / /sngar bcol snyer sa grub slad mar bsgrub pa'i ched/ /mthun pa 'i dam rdzas rgya ma/tshos /legs mchod na/ /'gal rkyen kun sol mthun rkyen ma lus sgrubs/ /lcags sgrul dpa cir lngan 'bras skrungs kya sngags lang du bsten rdzobs pa ba 'a rab 'byams sogs rags ba rdzas lnga bcu bskor bsdus te bskang rgyun btsunas skabs nag po skor gsum la phur0ba'i snan sha ra la yig thub bsngan dkar cha 'phel ba'i zla tshas/ /skyes swasdi/ rdo rje 'jags byang/ brgya phrag mkha' dbyangs bzhu ba'i lang tsho la/ /byin za'i 'phreng bas rab spud bkod le gas kyi/ /nams ldon srid gsum za ba dus kya dgra /khyab bdag 'jam dpal gshen rje gshed kyi drung / /phun tsho gis dge mchan rgya mtsho'i yon tan kun/ /byed pos chag tu pa rī ṇa'i yul/ /gnam bskas gong ma'i rgyal /bab gan mdzod las/ /legs 'ongs dar gyi snyan shal 'di phul bas/ /rnam 'dren rgyal ba'i lung rtogs bstan pa zung / /dkar cha 'phel ba'i tshes kyi zla gawo ltar// yar ldan 'gyur zhing lus can ma lus pa/ /phan dang bde ba'i dpal la spyod par mdzod/ /(7bsko' po phyagadru yo/ 'jigs rung khro bo'i dbang po nag po che/ /zhing skyong spubar tsho gos rgya mtshor bcas rnams kyis/ /rgya mtsho'i gas can gzhi 'dir rgyal ba'i bstan/ /ji srid bskal brgyar gnas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /srid gsum skye 'gro'i srog la dbang sgyur ba/ /las gshin bstan dgra'i gshed ma bshan pa che/ /log par 'dren pa gdug can dgra bo'i tshogs/ /mngon spyod 'a sa kyas sgrol ba'i 'phrin las las gon mdzod/ /gnas chung ltog tā gsol khu chad brgya tshar btsugs skabs phul ba'i snan dang /0yas ba smo don lhun grub/ /rab 'byams— /48 — —

sku gsung thugs rten gsar stongs dang mchod jos khang bzang bi dkar sha glegs bam gsur pa/ (pe wa wargyal kun 'khor lo'i dbang phyug mchog /snang ba mtha' yas thugs rje'i ste zlas gar la sa/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas mtsho skyes rdo rje'i zhabs/ /thugs rje'i gzi byin 'gro 'ji rtag skyongs shig /brgya phrag phur tshogs dge bcu ldan pa'i yul/ /byang phyogs bsil ras bskar ba'i sman ljongs 'jir/ /chas rgya nya tshangs pa lha yi me tog gi /thugs dam chas gar dang la gyi bsam/ yas sa/ /gdul ba'i za du pad+mā ka ra yis/ /sna tshogs sprul pa'i zlos gar legs bstan tshe/ /log rten mchod bstod dregs pa'i dkyil 'khar du/ /legs bas chas 'khar kun gyi srung ma cher/ /mnga' gsol spru pa pa'i rgyal ngo/ pe na ra/ /bka' snang dregs pa'i tshogasadang bcas rnams kyis/ /dam tshig gzhen po ma g.yel rab dgongs myos//bsam don yid bzhin 'grub pa'i dge legs ma dzod/ /g.yo sogs g.yul 'khrugs pa bstan 'dzin chos rgyal rnam par rgyal te chu rta gtsang bsam grub sme 'bangs ('a /bcas thob pa 'i dus jus rim rnams lus lngan du grub par brten phro ba nge 'e g.yog da pa pa'i tshogs su yi dam ches srung rlar sa la gang nga rag phu la ba'i ri ngar zhal yis ngab pa tshi mi ga gi re/ dpung / /'jam dpal khro bo'i rgyal po tshe bdag snyem/ /skang rkang dmar nag mtha' sngod ti pa ca/ /'dod /bams dbang phyag dmag zor sel me sogs/ /bston sangs / / ru rang ba / ra tsho / ra midam can rgya mtshor bcas pa'i drung / / brnag pa'i sem sa yong dam bems dgra bgegs dpung / /gnam lcags thag gas brag ri bcas pa ltar// pas sbyar snyes grub g.yo rag mar pa'i tshogs/ /dngosabashags yid sprul 'bul na dgyes par ro pa/ /chu rdzo rta'i lo pho brang cho pyogang ri dkar pa ra sle spo skas sto ma 3gro sgo tsham pho dngu rog dung /ras lngo rtse nga lo༅ sgu rgo pa/mganagocho mor phyag cha pa / sal rnams su tso dang phur ci /0yis tso lis 'jod sgo/ /phun dngu po gdu pa tshog rin byu gnyis pa'i mchod sdong che/ /mtha' sgo tso bsod nams 'ar 'tsho'i dpyid/ /rta bdun /r+sha sgol ma/ bgrod pa de srid du/ /3 bde'i oṃ gyis 'gro 'di skyong gyur cig /rigs tsang lo 4 bar 'byu /khyab bdag na gā rjun dang / /pad+ma khrung gnas ri su ra/ rnal 'byor ma/ /lo za g.yi dang dpal /ldan byu pa /sngags 'chang chas ku chul ngo/ mtshar chen sogs/ /dngos bsed (8ba/rigs 'dzin dab snyem ma/ri shol / dpa tsho dang tsho /sdiXji / / — pa rin ra ri ru // ma

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)can/ /mthu stobs drag rtsal dbang phyug bram ze che/ /ring na / sa bsde na cing lags bsgrubs srung ma mchag /thugs rje nus pa dpung tshogs rab skyed la/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde rgyas pa dang / /brgyud ldan rigs 'dzin bdag gi 'dod pa'i don/ /thogs med 'grub cing mi mthun bdud sde'i g.yu la/ kun las rla sprus par rgyal ba'i 'phrin las ma/dzod /mgan lang chan mor/ dpal ldan ye sheb/mgon po 'khar bcas kyis/ /rgyal ba'i bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyong ba dang / /mi mthun bdud sde'i tshogs rnams tshar bcad nas/ /'dod pa'i don kun ma lus sgrub par mdzod/ /rgyal /bang 'jig rten dregs pa'i dbang phyug pe ta ra/ /mtsho skyes dam chog gnan po snyer dgongs la/ /ji ltar smon pa'i sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan che/ /'phrin pas nyin slong byed pas skyong bar ma/dzod/ /chu sngag sgar pas dbus gtsang du skyar ci sgang stobs cher bslang pa'i dpung rgyab tā tong pe mar srid kyi dar ka khri phrag tu snye ba ltas ngan g.yang lon gyi chos skyong srung ra/yo bsdug sde 'o snye pa dga' dang tsher 'byor ba bstan 'dzin chos hūṃ rgyal po'i dngu nga gis me lce dang phye 7 leb kyi ngang spyo pa du gyur tshe phan bde les sa bshad gleng pa/'i tshogs su dri dam chos srung rlams la khag dang rag phul ba'i snyan dar dzi pa leg srad gsum ḍa rnam rgyal/ srid gsum zil gnon la bshakya mtha' sdud bcas/ /srid gsum bdag mo chos srung rgya mtsho snyel/ srid gsum snyelas rgyal gtang rag (9na)mthun pa'i rdzas/ /srid gsum khyon kun bkang nas 'bu la gyis bzhes/ /chu thug dor zla bcu sa cag par ches 3/sngong rgya rī sdo phyi na stabs gtsang khang chen mor rgyal ba mi par pa ra phur ba 'i man shal g.yas kya /spa yig bde re gas zad me shes pa'i rma jod/ /thus yoms ri das gzugs kye shis brjod/ rje'i chu 'dzin 'phreng ba las/ /phan bde'i rkang 'thung rab ba/ber pa/ /mi pham mgon po kun gsal gyis/ /dus rlams kun du dge bar ma/dzod/ /byams zur gye phra mo brtse'i/ 'od snang ka shi mdzes dgar yid kyi shing rtas legasadrangs pas/ /mtshams spron g.yi nu snye pang che'i zil dngar g.yo ba'i bde ba na bum phrag gi /mtshan dpe'i bzhin ras ci ya nga (9bcum pa gsal byed be+eḍūr mthing kha'i skra/ /'gro la rjesachags yon ngo ra 'phyang snyer 'dren byed dag kyang cung zad zur/ /de phyir mir wo pa 'i gzugs can snyel cha nge ri dzer gyis bas — /5(1 —

sku gsung thus sa rten gsar bzheng gang nga mchod rdzas khang bzang rge nga kar chag glegs bal gsum pa/ 'ad pa / ngo ma tshar dpyid kyi ma ma'i mngal gyi khur las 'ongs pa na/ /phra rgyas nam mkha'i ske rags ring spang bzod ldan grang reg dus kyi shing / /slar skyes 'bab ldan 'dod khur gyis: dga' bde'i yal 'dab g.yur za can/ /e ma srid 'dir snang ba'i mtha' bral ston pa'i byed pa 'phags mchog kye/ /stong 'bun g.yon mig sor mo'i pad+ma dkar/ /dkar 'jam 'phrul gyi thags grub gan dar mchog /mchog tu mngon mtho dbang phyogs gnam bskas la/ /lha dbang stobs 'a tsho ba'i rgyal khab nas/ //legs 'ongs mkha' dbyings lus phra 'od dkar can/ /skyengs te be kra'i grong du yib byed pa/ /snyan shal sked med bawo gyi 'od ma/dngas ltar/ /chu shel zhan ma byugs 'dra spung pa'i dges/ /nyi ma'i 'od kyis legs bskyangs khungs ldan brgyud/ /sa spyad dam pa'i rigs las stobs bcu'i rtsal/ /yangs rdzogs ma 'dres 'gro ba'i gcen gyur pa/ /zas gtsang sras che kho/snyan pa'i grags 'bar mchog /rgyal bstan rgya mtsho'i gos can sa srungs la/ /rta ljang dbang po gser sbyangs zhun ma 'i rgyan/ /ji srid ༄ da pa'i mdza' gcugs gtad min nga/ra/ /grangs med 'gro ba'i nyer 'tshor rab rgyas shing / /phun tshogs snge bzhi'i lus bu dar ba bsang/'i/ /bde legs zad mi shes pa nam mkha'i mdzod/ /longs su spyod (10na tha'i dra rā 'a 'phang 'gro'i dbyangs/ /mtho ris rgyud du mngar ba'i dang/la du stsol/ /rgyal g.yo sa 'e tso sha pa g.yan gyi /spu yag pha na ge'i phros spyang pa gso/ /be+eḍūr rdul brtsegs sgyu rtsal spyad/ /rta ljang dbang po lus phra mas/ /'khyud pa'i yid kyi shing rta'i ro/ /stsal cig mgon mchog gser mngal kye/ /legs byas dbyid kyi lang tsho sgeg mo'i mngal /zur las/ /chas dang srid kyi ma rgyad zhun ma 'i 'og pags kyis/ /klubs pas in+d+ra nī la'i sa 'dzan khengs pa'i rgyud/ /'gugs byed ri skyes lor lo'i shing rta gser ldan 'dir/ /(10bsgom yang thogs med spyod la mi 'gong zheng / /mchag dman skye rgu'i yid kyi phrag pa snyel/ /lugs zung khrims kyi gnya' shing 'dzin ri yis/ /g.yo med srid mthar lci ba'i shis pa snye5pa/ /chos 'khor rgyal mthal gyi mgon khang dang dga' tshal dbang drag rol pa'i mgon khang rnams su gtor gsas thag phu pa ba'i — da/ —

rgya ra dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)zhe ldanang ra zhal yag phan bde le tsan+dan dri bsung / /mi mji ri gyi ma gom /bang chen mo/ 'gyur bde chen rang bzhin stong pa'i dbyings/ /zung 'jug rin chan rdul ba rtsegs /bor yug la/ /rnam mang gzugs skur shar ba la sko'i bdag /mi zad stobs ldan chos srung rgya mtsho yis/ /blo gsal rkang drug gzhan nur bzang pa'i bcud/ /ro mchog zad mi shes pa'i legs bshad rnga/ /phyogs bral sna lung skud pa grags pa' dbyangs/ shwakya 'a bstan la mdzes byed rgyan kyi phul/ /phul byung ma/khyen sgo rab yangs 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /dbyangasabadan bed 'gags 'gag bed blo gras mchag /mchog dman 'gro kun lan mkhyen rnam 'dren sa/ /sarig ra ji cig di/ ra sna / no mi sku mibadu' 'a ma na byas bgrad mkhas ma/bas dbang bstan/ /lnga brgya'i phreng ba phyogs kyi srad bu la/ /mngan pa/ra snar brgyus dus kyi bskal pa'i mtha'/ /rdzogs min de srid sa byung sde bzhi'i dpal/ /dkar phyags kun phan /snar rgyas /'phrin las mdzod/ /de sgyu rkan rmad byung mdzes sdug lang tshod ra babs dpyid/ /ngag dbang tshangs pa'i bu mo lus phra ma/ /ma bsrun dgra sde'i gshed du srin mo'i gzugs/ /(11na srid 'ji'i me long ngos su rtag 'char des/ /rdo zlar bral ba dge ba'i dngos po mchag /mchog dman kun la /legs lam grub pa'i dpal/ /dpal sdug bstan pa rta ljang dbang pa'i 'od/ /'od gzi srid pa'i rtse mor 'phyur ba dang / /deng 'dir yangs sman be+eḍūr dpal be'i gzugs/ /rnam par grub pa ngo mtshar bsil sbyin ma/khan/ /yid kyi rin chen /khrung gnas 'bum phrag ngos/ /legs brgyan re ba'i 'dod pa rab 'jo zhing / /sems kyi lhug phran mi phyed phyag rgya'i mdud/ /nam yang 'jig bral mdza' na'i a shwa ma'i/ /dga' ston ma la ya yi dri ba 'be can/ /'dzad med nam mkha'i mdzod du dar gyur cig /bal pa tsā po gye gar mgon stang zil rdul brtsegs rgod ma kha yi gos/ /lan brgyar klubs la 'gong ba ye shes/lhas/ /phun tshogs chas srid 'byor pa ut+pal la'i/ /legs lam 'dab stong tshal kun rgyas bar mdzod/ /bsal ba tshal gye r+sha la rgyal kun ye shes chu gter chen po'i klong/ /sgyu ma'i snang brnyan 'gro la chags pa'i gar/ /stobs ldan bram ze'i nyal 'gro ā dar+sha cir/ /thub bstan chu skyes ldopa gyis bsusapa'i mgron/ /gang gi mthu dpung zla shelaXn ma'i thigs/ /'bum du 'dzag pas nyer 'tshe'i tshogadung — 152

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhangasadang mchod rdzas khang bzang thi dkar chag glegasobam gsum pa/ 9 )kun/ /lhag mar rab bcil dngosagrub sbrang rtsi'i bcud/ /mi nyamasadaga' ston dpalal spyod par mdzod/ /pota la shod kyi yoyorigasasngagasagrub pa'i brtul zhugasabla med kyis/ /(11bangopho lashod kyi rwa hu ྾/ srid gsum dregasapa bran 'kholamatshoskyesarje'i/ /bka' rtagasardo rje'i cod pan zur phud rtser/ /rtag brtan sprul pa'i rgyal po 'khor bcas kyis/ /chosarmor srid sde'i 'khor lo su wa r+ṇa/ /rab yangs 'dzam gling gser ldan mkhar 'phagasang sa/ /bde legs 'gog med 'khor lo rtsibs stong 'od/ /nyi ma ji srid gnasapar brtan par mdzod/ /srid gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /dus kyi me lcesadagra dpung phye ma leb/ /lhag ma ltar mdzad stobs ldan khyab lajug ches/ /las bzhi'i don kun thogasamed bsgrub par mdzod/ /po ta la shod kye go rtse wo byed gosagyon byu ru'i 'khri shing la/ khro ga tso gar gyi nyamasachags srid pa 'dir/ /'phyang mo'i ngal pa ster byed srog bdag gis/ /thub bstan chosa'akhor sder bcasartag tu skyongs/ /pota la shod kyibaza'agadongadamawog/lhan cig 'gran tshe mdog lnga'i shugasaskyeng ba'i/ / khyu mchog steng 'gying 'jug pa bcu pa yang / /rang gi bzhen pa phrogasasnyam phag gzugasakyis/ /nor 'dzin 'og sprugs byed pos rgyal bstan srungs/ /po ta pa shod kyi darmakhayo/ rnam par bkra ba gzha' tshon gur gyi dbus/ /sngo bsangasasgeg mos 'khyud pa'i 'bod grogs kyi/ /zlosagar sgyur mdzad rdo rje'i dam tshig can/ /bsam don ma lus legs par lhun grub mdzod/ /jo bo ༅ ma4 par pad rag lang tsho dar babasakhrus kyi rdzing / /dri bral ngos su gnod sbyin 'khor lo'i lag /mthu stobasamagrin pa'i rdza rnga sgrog (12naskobyod kyis/ /don gnyis 'grub pa'i lus 'degs gar gyis rol/ /shing sprel dusakyi dang por 'dod khayodabang ༅ re ma ti mgo ༅ dus phul ༅ sa dar kha yigadabyid kyi rgyalamo'i dbyang ma/ /grangasamed 'gro larjesachagasakyis/ /ri dwagasamig can gzugasa'achang ba'i/ /gser mngal sras mo mtsho byung mas/ /dusarnamasakun du dge bar mdzod/ /kun dga' gsar pa'i bgrang bya rin chen snod/ /bkra shis rdzogasaldan zil mngar 'khyil ba'i 'od/ /rab 'bar margad a shwa twa yi gos/ /rab klubasazlosagar sgyur ba'i dga' ston tshe/ /med byung zur mig dbang gzhu'i ri mo (12ba)— 153 —

rgya pa dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)rlam bkra'i lus phra rgya mtsho' zla 'bum lang tsho'i ba/ced/ /gcig bsdus dpal mo'i snyems 'phrog nam mkha'i steg bur thor tshugs rgyan gyi zol las cer 'dud na/ /mtshan dpe'i gzi yis srid 'di'i dregs ldan ngas kya spyi bor gang bi 'bas pad mtsho par g.yo/ /e ma ngag dbang tshangs pa'i bu mo bdud sde gdu pa phyir 'dod pa khams kya dbang phyug ma/chog /ma chog gi skal par spyod la legs dbang dbang phyug brgyad kyi yon tan kun/ /kun gas pa ngos su 'ja ri tshon ltar mdzes mdzes sdug tshogs rngams bsdus pa'i dpal/ /dpa/la/ stug bstan srung drag mo'i gzugs 'dzin 'dzin ma'i spo las rnam par rgyal / /rgya pa ba'i yum gcig dngas grub ma lus lus pa med par stsol cig kye/ /kha ba'i rdul brtsegs gsar du ma bskrun ching / /bde 'byung gcug rgyan lan brgyar bzhu mi na pa'i/ /dkar 'jam ri mo/'i cha shas yongs rdzogs pa/ /sngon med zla sazhin thos 'dzin rgyan du spud/ /dga' ba'i rang bzhan rgyas pa rtsed 'jo'i grogs/ /phan bde'i u dur/ wā ra ba'ad pa'i 'dzum/ /legs byas char gyi dus ston skyed pa'i rme / /dpyid kyi rgyal cho/'i dbyangs 'ji rna bar snyan/ /phun tshogs sdo bak+ṣa be+eḍūr la sa grub pa/ /g.yung drung 'gyur ba med pa 'i mor lngan mar/ /yid kyi re ba'i yol go su war+ṇa ra/ /'dong pa'i dngos kun 'jo ba'i shas pa stsal/ /chu rā lor ya r+sha thog tu sa spung ma ga r+pā (13na ji pa lang song kyang 'grobu bom byung 'ing snor bu rim cher dpa' brtu sda mi bsrun pa 'i byed ngo sa/ rlung du me sngag yar ba tshe bus bsam/ shes rnams blo 'byog par brngen chu lug las sbyor byas mas zla ba drug gi /thong gsu me nan ju nang gis gtsos pa'i dpung sgos ming med du btang ba'i dusagashan rje bshad ngo mnan pa'i rnga cha car lagatang rag phu la ba'i lha' dar kha ma ga gshin rje khros pa' tang zas// gnyer gtad dgra bo zla ba drug gi khongs/ /tshe yi 'du byed bkums pa 'a gtang rag tu/ /sman gtor rak+ta phyi nang mchod pa'i tshogs/ /skang mang las kyis mtha' sdud bcas la 'bul/ /shengs pa nang zla lnga ya' nang du 'ol dga' sngag rtse nas da shod byo gas su 'de gag dong chos 'khar rgyal dud pa la snan dmag zor mar las bcal du phu pa ba'i snan dang /ba yig gdung ba 'a wo sol/ /dbyangs can dgra sde'i gshed du srin mo'i sbur/ /rab ston 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug mas/ /'gal rkyen mi mthun phyogs kun rab zhi zhi nga / /— /54

sgu gsung thugs rjer gsar bathengayongang mchad rdzas lang bzang gi dkar chagasnegasobam gsum pa / 1 )'phrin las rnam ba'i lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod /'ol dga' naso4 yur za dam du phyin pa'i tshe zings pa rta mga'i khyaba'ajug gi dam shing la 'phrer lasabacol za'e tha shar khayigaragra dpung 'dzomasapa 'i thog mnga'/ /dpal ldan gsang ba kun gyi gan mdzod las/ /theg mchog yid bachin dbang gi rgyal po ches/ /mchog thun dngos grub char du 'bebasamajad nga// /gsang bdag thod 'phreng rtsa'/ gyis rtag tu skyongs/ /gang gi bstan srung mi 'da'i dam tsheg can/ /theng bcu'i dgra sngesgrol la rdo rje'i thog /khyab 'jug dug gi (13bar+yā gri rā hu la/ /phyi nang gza' brgyad gdong mo 'bor tshogasakyis/ /kun du bzang ngo/ lag na rdo rje dang / /mtsho skyes rdo rje pad+ma ri ga'abrel rtsal/ /ku mā ra dzadri med 'od zer sogs/ / dngos brgyud bla ma'i dam tshig snyer dgongasal/ /rgyasaba'i bstan skyongasarigasa'adzin bdag cag gi /mi mthun nye bar 'tshe ba'i tshogs kun zhi/ /tshe dpa' rab rgyasamathun rkyen dbang du sdus/ /log 'dren dgra bgegs tshogs rnams thal bar rlog /mdor na ye shesaspyan gyisarab gzigasal/ /yid la ji lder 'dod pa'i rdon rnamasakun/ /thogs med lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las de/ /nam yangagayel ba med par lhun grub mdzod / /shing sprel ngapa pa lngan 'bras sngangs kyi sngags 'ang du gra rgan rags bsdusaba'i babyuskor gyisobaskang so btsugasapa 'i tshe dpa ‘pha rdorje chagayobyed 5྾ba'i tha dar lgo5yigadusokyimedapung / /in+d+ra ni la'i sa 'dzin dbang po lta bur rab brjid bzod par dka' ba drag po'e skur/ /lhab lhab dus kyi me dpung 'khrug pa'i dbus na rab 'gying khro rgyal dbang po gshin rje'i gshed/ /bka' sdod mngag gzhug bcas pa'i tshogasakyisablo ldan yongasakyi dpal gyur bzang po'i 'phrin lasacan/ /gragasapa phyogs kun khyab par 'geng ba'i bstan pa srungs la nag phyogasabadud sde'i tshogs kun choms/ /'bralospungasomachod khang gi dmag zor ma'e bris skur phul ba'i snan dar zhal yig thubabastan rin chen sheng rta / /(14na〉dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus kun/ /kun gyi bstan srung mthu dang stobs/ /stobasaldan yongasakyisazla bral ma/ /ma mo chen mo re ma tis/ /rgyalaba'i bstan pa thosabasam sgom pa yis/ /ri mor — 155 —

rgyal dbang ji pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)bgyid pa khrims ldan la dus pa' sde/ /zhwa ser 'chang ba'i ring lugs grags snyan rnga / /nam mkha'i nor bu ji bzhen ches 'bar zhing / /'chad mkhas gtam gyi sbyor ba'i rin cen khrir/ /rtsod ngag gzhom bral rdo rje rab bzung nas/ /rtsom pa'i rgyud mang legs brdung dbyangs snyan can/ /mdo rgyud 'chi med dga' ston rgyas gyur cig /sheng bya lo gsar dus srid gsum bdag mor phul ba'i snan dar zhal yi ga 'phren la mo gza 'bar/ /nam sur su ste/ /dus gsum rnam 'dren yongs kyi lung rtogs bstan/ /bsrung phyir tshangs pa'i bu mo dbyangs can ma/ //ri jigs rung khro cho 'i skur bstan dmag zor lha/ /gang gis legs byas rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas mchog /phan bde'i dpyid gyur rgyal bstan yangs rgyas shing / /chas dang srid kyi yangs 'du' ljon shing dag /dkar phyogs chu shel dbang po'i dkyil 'bor ltar/ /rdzags ldan gsar pa'i cha shas yongs su gang / /deng 'dir bsam pa'i 'dod don rta bdun can/ /mi mthun chu 'dzin dgra las rnam rgyal zhing / /las bzhi'i 'phren las 'od stong 'bar ba'i gzi/ kun tā ches cher rgyas pa' dge legs stsol/ /(14ba)sheng bya gzha yod mchod pa'i dus jo bo shwakya mu rir phul ba ri sa khi kha yig phan bde'i lo gos khu dud/ /ldan pa 'i gzugs ga/ legs pa'i rang bzhen dbyar gyi pad+mo can/ /'gugs pa'i bsod nams ye shes dpyid kyi nor/ /'di nas snying stobs gan mdzod la 'chang ba/ /rnam 'dren dbang po bu ram shing pa kye/ /byung shadape da0'gas༅ ra yogs grangs nge yi'i pab tso snyen byed kyas 'khyud lhun po'i mdzas pa rnams/ /'phrog byed lang tsho'i dpa mnga' mtshan dpe'i gzi/ /sgyu 'phrul trob 'a rol gar gyo mtsho yis/ /rtsod ldan mun pa ring du bskrad dam snyam/ /le'u dang po nas bshad pa'i lho mas sgo ro la grags pa' rangadangs gya ༅/ zad pa'i mtha' 'bral dbyangs kya (15na)rgyal mo mchog khred ma lus can so sor snang ba'i skad/ /yan lag drug cur grub pa'i ngo mtshar 'dis/ /thos 'dzin bzang pa'i skal bar cisami spyod/ /rmongs bzugs yo tshog chen 'khor mun dra ba ma lus pa/ /gcod pa'i shes rab rlon po gzas

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang spe dkar chags gas bam gsumakhang / (napa yis/ khri bral thugs kya kun tu gsal ba'i mdangs/ /'tshe med dbang pa'i lam der dzom pa byin / /mtha' bya cha rang las brjod pa yas lce yis drang por brjod pa'i tshig /yun du ngal bsten dka' thub drag po yis/ /drang srong chu lha'i bu yi skyid pa yang / /bskyur na gzhan dag byis sa ngang tshul can/ /'on bya borang bas da pa/te chas kya rjes su 'brang ba yi/ /mi phyed dad pas cung zad gsol bgyid na/ /ris med 'gro la bsnyen bsring mi mnga' ba'i/ /dmigs med thugs rje'i mthu yis nye bar dgongs/ /ris bral srid 'dir chas dub 'gro ba kun/ /bde ba'i ngal stegs mi yi seng ge'i bstan/ /rab rgyas legs 'dzin chos ldan rgyal po yi/ /sde bzhi yongs 'phel ba ched don 'grub par shog /swā 'dzil ba 'a
