gzugs can la'i ljongs 'dir nad 'khrug nyer 'tshe'i sprin/ /nus pa' 'thor rlung drag pas mthar bskrad nas/ /phan dang bde ba'i yongs 'du ljon pa yi/ /yal 'dab 'bras bu' khur gyas dud gyur cig /(15ba)rang byon lnga tso la phul ba'i khi shal la yan tsho skyid srid ye rtser skur/ /rab brtse'i dba' rlabs chang gi dri/ /thugs kyi 'gram par legs bro ba/ /'phags mchog gnyis 'thung dbang po des/ /skye rgu'i bung ba rgyas par mdzod/ /(16na〉o yon wa brjong pa thog rme gsal byed du byung de lus phra' gdong par mig /mgrin sngon ral pa'i rtse na 'od dkar can/ /khyab 'jug lag par 'khor lo'i ri mo sde/ /grangs med rgyal sras dbus na snying rje'i gter/ /dus mang ba ri dpe kyi me lce 'bar ba'i tsha ba dang / /'thor byed drag po'i rlung gis 'tshub pa'i rdul/ /yongs 'du'i dri bsung mngar por 'thul ba yis/ /'gran pa'i zla bral gang gi thugs rje'i mthu/ /bsdus shang ma bsdus pa' gzugs can mi bzad du kha gsum gyi dra ba ru /nyen mongs zas la sred pas yongs chud pa/ /'khrul pa'i shā wa ri yi dga' ston can/ /mkhyen brtse'i dpung gis skyobs shig bad dkar 'chang / /bde legs myu gu bskrun pa rgyal ba'i bstan/ /rtag pa'i rdo rje lta bur gnas gyur cing / /bsil0ldan ljongs 'dir bde skyid dbyar mtsho ltar/ /srid pa'i rtsemor rab 'phyur dpal stsol cig /gang zhig ches smon gdugs dkar gyis/ /grib bsil 'khor yug — 157

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()kun khyab pa//don kun 'grub pa'i rnga yab dkar//yid kyi ngal gsor mdzes gyur cig/rgyal ba btsong kha pa ོ po'i sku bas la snyan shal phul ba'i kha yig srid zhi'i thod du 'ja ba'i cod pan//16brgyal ba'i gsang gsum dbyig 'dzin las//zhabrungs pa stobs bcu'i rkang 'thung 'phreng //blo gros bzang po'i 'bras bu can//grags pa'i dri yis srid pa 'dir//ches sags mā le'u gsum pa'i5byed kyi gang miga'adres0'geng zur phud lnga yi sgra dra'i gar//mtshams sprin mdzes mar chags pa bral ba'i rdzu//mkhasabatsun bzang po'i yol ba stong bres par//dgyes rgur spyod 'di 'jam dpal snying po yi//ngang chosa'agogs pa tshul gsal ba'i rten 'byung snyan pa'i glu//mgrin par len pa phyogs bral gan+dhar bha'i//kun gyis sgrog pa'i skal ba ches thob na//mi smra'i skyes bu gang zhig sa 'dir ci//rab ldan pa'i ga khugasawo mang lung gi 'khri shing ldem pa'i rtser//ches zab rtogs pa'i 17na skong bu g.yur za ba/zung 'jug sgrub pa'i ro brgya 'jo ba 'di//rdo rje la4 gi rang bzhi gsal bar pho//thub mtha' dgagazugs༅ gyi shis brjod bstan chu gter mi zhakhrug cing //'gro ba'i don gnyis gzings brtan pas//bde legs nor bu'i cod pan gang //thod du 'ching ba'i dpal gyur cig/dung skyong rgyal mor snyan shal phul ba'i kha yig don kun 'grub pa'i gto/lha rab dngas kyi rgyan ldan sprul pa'i khang bzang skye 'gro'i dpal//nyer 'tshor ring du brtan pa'i byed pa po//rnam 'dren kun yum dbang mo dung skyong ma//stobs ldan gang gi thugs kyis legs dgongs shing//17bzas cha shas gzugs༅/gtsang bstan pa'i lam gsum las 'ongs pa'i//mdo sngags chos tshul dri med gaṅgā'i rgyun//kun mkhyen btsong kha pa yi ring lugs mchos//rta bdun ji srid gnas pa de srid du//rab lor brgya che nga brten khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon//da dhi tsa yi rus pa las//legs grub g.yung drung gzhi chen por//ji srid mi g.yo ches brtan zhing //mtha' mar pe/yas 'gro ba'i tsho gis spyi dang //khyad par bsil ldan gangs ljongs 'dir//phan dang bde ba'i legs byas kun//dbyar stsi mtsho ltar 'phyur ba dang /a shāka khugs༅gyi shis pa brjod pa/ched du bsams pa'i lha 8lam las//las bzhi'i chu 'dzin 'phreng 'khregs

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 9)shing //don kun lhun grub char chen po//rgyun mi chad pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa rnams kyis shing bya zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bzhi nas brtsams te dpal ldan 'dod khams dbang phyug ma'i bskang bshag khri tshar bsags pa'i dus grwa tshang gi gos spung bri skur phur ba'o dar tshon sna lnga'i snya dar zhal yig phren las rnam 4sto bdan//rab brjid kha ba'i rdul brtsegs lhun po la//rab dkar chu shel dbang pos 'khrud 'dra ba//rab mdzes ngag gi dbang phyug dbyangs can mas//rab 'byams zhi ba'i 'phrin las tshogs spyi dang //khyad par log dkar 'dren dgra bgegs byad kha zor//18na skod gdon mi mthun nyer 'tshe'i mun stug kun//phul byung mthu stobs 'od kyis mthar bskrad nas//phan bde'i snang ba ches cher gsal bar mdzod//ser bde chen chos dbyings zla ba'i ma ma las//mtshan bzang sku yi 'od stong 'bar ba can//legs lam bye ba'i pad tshal rgyas mdzad pa//stobs bcu mnga' ba yongs kyi yum gcig mas//thub bstan 'phel zhid bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi//tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor legs tshogs rnams//dkar phyogs bsil sbyin mkhan ltar yar ldan du//rgyas shing bsam pa'i don kun 'grub par mdzod//phan dang bde ba'i 'byung gnas rdo rje'i theg/theg mchog legs bshad rin wo gling gi nor//nor mchog lta bur mchog a dngos grub kun//kun nas char du snyil ba'i dge legs stsol//dmar byu ru'i 'khri shing mtshams sprin dmar po'i mchur//rjes chags srid gsum dbang sdud sgeg mo yis//chos srid sgrub la mthun rkyen brtan g.yo'i chos//ji bzhin dbang du 'gyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//mthing khra mig sman brtsegs pa'i ri bo dusamatha'i mes//gos kyis klubs la srin mo'i gzugs 'chang na//'jigs rung khyod sku'i dper bstan dmag zor lha//rig 'dzin yongs kyi srung ma'i gtso khyod kyis//rgyal bstan dgon gnas srid sder bcas kun dang //khyad par rig 'dzin bdag cag 'khor bcas la//bsam ga sbyor rtsub 'chang byed dgra dang bgegs//mthu byad rbod gtong gto zor sri ga nad//dug mtshon ga 18bgi yo'i sbyor ba gshom pa sogs//gnod byed gdug pa'i brag9 ri mtha' dag rnams//drag po'i 'phrin las rdo

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)can/ /mthu stobs drag rtsal dbang phyug bram ze che/ /ring nas bsten cing legs bsgrubs srung ma mchog /thugs rje nus pa'i dpung tsho gis rab skyed la/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde rgyas pa dang / /brgyud ldan rigs 'dzin bdag gi 'dod pa'i don/ /thogs med 'grub cing mi mthun bdud sde'i g.yul/ kun las rnam par rgyal ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /mgon kha r+sā mor/ dpal ldan ye shes mgon po 'khor bcas kyis/ /rgyal ba'i bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyong ba dang / /mi mthun bdud sde'i tshogs rnams tshar bcad nas/ /'dod pa'i don kun ma lus sgrub par mdzod/ /rgyas khang 'jig rten dregs pa'i dbang phyug pe ha ra/ /mtsho skyes dam tshig gnyan po nyer dgongs la/ /ji ltar smon pa'i sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan che/ /'phrin las nyin mor byed pas skyong bar mdzod/ /chu stag sgar pas dbus gtsang du skyar lang stobs cher bslang pa'i dpung rgyab tu kong po dar srid kyi dmag khri phrag tu nye ba ltasag g.yang lon gyi chos skyong srung mas bkug ste 'ol dga' dang yer 'byor ba bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po'i dpung gis me lte dang phye ma leb kyi ngang tshul du gyur tshe phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i tshogs su yi dam chos srung rnams la gtang rag phul ba'i snyan dar zhal yig srid gsum rnam rgyal/ srid gsum zil gnon las kyi mtha' sdud bcas/ /srid gsum bdag mo chosasrung rgya mtsho la/ srid gsum las rgyal gtang rag (9na)mthun pa'i rdzas/ /srid gsum khyon kun bkang nas 'bul gyis bzhes/ /chu lug hor zla bcu gcig par chos 'khor rgyal du phyin skabs gtsang khang chen mor rgyal ba mi pham par phul ba'i snyan shal g.yas kyi kha yig bde legs zad mi shes pa'i mdzod/ /thugs mtha' dag gzugs kyi shis brjod/ rje'i chu 'dzin 'phreng ba las/ /phan bde'i rkang 'thung rab ba 'ad pa/ /mi pham mgon po kun gsal gyis/ /dus rnams kun du dge bar mdzod/ /byams zur gyi phra mo brtse'i 'od snang ka shi mdzes dgar yid kyi shing rtas legs drangs pas/ /mtshams sprin gzhen nu lang tsho'i zil dngar g.yo ba'i bde ba 'bum phrag gi /mtshan dpe'i bzhin ras ci yang (9bcum pa gsal byed be+eḍūr mthing kha'i skra/ /'gro la rjes chags yon por 'phyang la 'dren byed dag kyang cung zad zur/ /de phyir mi mnya pa'i sags mā la to nge lon gyis bas — 150

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ (yipa/ngo mtshar dpyid kyi ma ma'i mngal gyi khur las 'ongs pa na//phra rgyas nam mkha'i ske rags ring spang bzod ldan grang reg dus kyi shing //slar skyes 'bab ldan 'dod khur gyis lci dga' bde'i yal 'dab g.yur za can//e ma srid 'dir snang ba'i mtha' bral ston pa'i byed pa 'phags mchog kye//stong 'khrun g.yon mig sor mo'i pad+ma dkar//dkar 'jam 'phrul gyi thags grub gan dar mchog/mchog tu ma wa rna mtho dbang phyogs gnam bskos lha//lha dbang stobs la 'khu ba'i rgyal khab nas//legs 'ongs mkha' dbyings lus phra 'od dkar can//skyengs te na kra'i grong du yib byed pa//snyan shal sked med bzhin gyi 'od mdangs ltar//chu shel zhun ma byugs 'dra spud pa'i dges//nyi ma'i 'od kyis legs bskyangs khungs ldan brgyud//sa spyod dam pa'i rigs las stobs bcu'i rtsal//yongs rdzogs ma 'dres 'gro ba'i gnyen gyur pa//zas gtsang sras zhes snyan pa'i grags 'bar mchog/rgyal bstan rgya mtsho'i gos can sa srungs la//rta ljang dbang po gser sbyangs zhun ma'i rgyan//ji srid 'byud pa'i mdza' gcugs gtad min par//grangs med 'gro ba'i nyer 'tshor rab rgyas shing //phun tsho gos sde bzhi'i gos bu dar babs pa'i//bde legs zad mi shes pa nam mkha'i mdzod//longs su spyod 0na ) pa'i dri za'i 'phang 'gro'i dbyangs//mtho ris rgyud du mngar ba'i dpal du stsol//rgyal nga byams pa'i snya shal g.yon gyi kha yig phan ge'i khrims kyi ngal gso//be+eḍūr rdul brtsegs sgyu rtsal spyod//rta ljang dbang po lus phra mas//'byud pa'i yid kyi shing rta'i ro//stsol cig mgon mchog gser mngal kye//legs byas dpyid kyi lang tsho sgeg mo'i mngal khur las//chos dang srid kyi ma rgad zhun ma'i 'og pags kyis//klu bas pas in+da ni la'i sa 'dzin khengs pa'i rgyud//'gugs byed ri skyes 'khor lo'i shing rta gser ldan 'dir//10bskom yang thogs med spyod la mi 'gong zhing //mchog dman skye rgu'i yid kyi phrag pa la//lugs zung khrims kyi gnya' shing 'dzin ri yis//g.yo med srid mthar lci ba'i shis pa stsol//chos 'khor rgyal mthil gyi mgon khang dang dga' tshal dbang drag rol pa'i mgon khang rnams su gtor gsos thog phul ba'i

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()snyan dar zhal yig phan bde'i tsas dri bsung //mi mthil gyi mgon khang chen mo/'gyur bde chen rang bzhin stong pa'i dbyings//zung 'jug rin chen rdul brtsegs khor yug la//rnam mang gzugs skur shar ba laṅka'i bdag/mi zad stobs ldan chos srung rgya mtsho yis//blo gsal rkang drug gzhen nur bzang po'i bcud//ro mchog zad mi shes pa'i legs bshad rnga//phyogs bral sna lung skud pa grags pa'i dbyangs/shwakya'i bstan la mdzes byed rgyan kyi phul//phul byung mkhyen rab rab yangs 'jam pa'i dbyangs//dbyangasabadun rgyud 'gugs 'gug byed blo gros mchog/mchog dman 'gro kun kun mkhyen rnam 'dren sa//sa bcu'i lam gyis bgrod mkhas mkhas dbang bstan//lnga brgya'i phreng ba phyogs kyi srad bu la//mngon par star brgyus dus kyi bskal pa'i mtha'//rdzogs min de srid rmad byung sdo bzhi'i dpal//dkar phyogs kun phan ltar rgyas wen las mdzod//de rdzi kos med byung mdzes sdug lang tsho dar babs dpyid//ngag dbang tshangs pa'i bu mo lus phra ma//mi bsrun dgra sde'i gshed du srin mo'i gzugs//11na jid 'di'i me long ngos su rtag 44 des//do zlar bral ba dge ba'i dngos po mchog/mchog dman kun la legs lam grub pa'i dpal//dpal stug bstan pa rta ljang dbang po'i 'od//'od gzi srid pa'i rtsemor phur ba dang //deng 'dir yongs smon be+eḍūr dpal be'i gzugs//rnam par grub pa ngo ma' bsil sbyin mkhan//yid kyi rin chen 'byung gnas 'bum phrag ngos//legs brgyan re ba'i 'dod pa rab 'jo zhing //sems kyi lhug phran mi byed phyag rgya'i mdud//nam yang 'jig bral mdza' na'i a shwa ma'i//dga' ston ma la ya yi dri bzhen can//'dzad med nam mkha'i mdzod du dar gyur cig/bsiladzislo gyi gur mgon stang zil rdul brtsegs rgod ma kha yi gos//lan brgyar klubs la 'gong ba ye shesalhas//phun tshogs chos srid 'byor pa ut+pal la'i//legs snyo 'dab stong tshal kun rgyas par mdzod//bskul ba phro spya khi rgyal kun ye shes chu gter chen po'i klong//sgyu ma'i snang brnyan 'gro la chags pa'i gar//stobs ldan bram ze'i nyal 'gro ā dar+shar//thub bstan chu skyes 'dzul gyis bsusapa'i mgron//gang gi mthu dpung zla shelas ma'i /gas//'bum du 'dzog bas 'tshe'i tshag dung

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ tanakun//lhag mar rab bcil dngos grub sbrang rtsi'i bcud//mi nyams dga' ston dpal la spyod par mdzod//go la shod kyi rgyal po rigs sngags grub pa'i brtul zhugs bla med kyis//1ba kho ta la shod kyi rwa hu lar/srid gsum dregs pa bran 'khol mtsho skyes rje'i//bka' rtags rdo rje'i cod pan zur phud rtser//rtag brtan sprul pa'i rgyal po 'khor bcas kyis//chos nor srid sde'i 'khor lo su wa r+ṇa//rab yangasa'adzam gling gser ldan mkhar 'phags pas//bde legs 'gog med 'khor lo rtsibs stong 'od//nyi ma ji srid gnas par brtan par mdzod//srid gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i rdzu snyul gyis//dus kyi me lces dgra dpung phye ma leb//lhag ma ltar mdzad stobs ldan khyab 'jug ches//las bzhi'i don kun thogs med bsgrub par mdzod//po ta la shod kyi ben rtse smi byed gos rgya ne byu ru'i 'khri shing la/khro gtso gar gyi nyams chags srid pa 'dir//'phyang mo'i ngal pa ster byed srog bdag gis//thub bstan chosa'akhor sder bcas rtag tu skyongs//go la shod kyi gag dong dmar nag/lhan cig 'gran tshe mdog lnga'i shugasaskyeng ba'i//khyu mchog steng 'gying 'jug pa bcu pa yang //rang gi bzhen pa phyogs snyam phag gzugasakyis//nor 'dzin 'og sprugs byed pos rgyal bstan srungs//po ta la shod kyi dmag/rnam par bkra ba gzhan tshon gur gyi dbus//sngo bsangs sgeg mos 'byud pa'i 'bod grogs kyi//zlos gar sgyur mdzad rdo rje'i dam tshig can//bsam don ma lus legs par lhun grub mdzod//rdzo bo yi mas par pad rag lang tsho dar babs khrus kyi rdzing //dri bral ngos su gnod sbyin 'khor lo'i lag/mas stobasamagrin pa'i ga rnga sgrog 12na khyod kyis//don gnyis 'grub pa'i lus 'degs gar gyis rol//shing sprel dus kyi dang por 'dod khas dbang byug re ma ti mar ༅ dus phul phe snya dar kha yig dpyid kyi rgyal tsho ril//grangs med 'gro la rjes chags kyis//ri dwags mig can gzugs 'chang ba'i//gser mngal sras mo mtsho byung mas//dus rnams kun du dge bar mdzod//kun dga' gsar pa'i bgrang bya rin chen snod//bkra shis rdzogs ldan zil mngar 'khyil ba'i 'od//rab 'bar margad a shwa twa yi gos//rab klubs zlos gar sgyur ba'i dga' ston tshe//med byung zur mig dbang gzhu'i ri mo 12ba

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)rnam bkra'i lus phra rgya mtsho'i zla 'bum lang tsho'i bcud/ /gcig bsdus dpal mo'i snyems 'phrog nam mkha'i steg bur thor tshugs rgyan gyi zol las nyer 'dud na/ /mtshan dpe'i gzi yis srid 'di'i dregs ldan yongs kyi spyi bor gang gi zhabs pad mngon par g.yo/ /e ma ngag dbang tshangs pa'i bu mo bdud sde gdul phyir 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug mchog /mchog gi skal par spyod la legs dbang dbang phyug brgyad kyi yon tan kun/ /kun gsal ngos su 'ja' tshon ltar mdzes mdzes sdug tshogs rnams bsdus pa'i dpal/ /dpal stug bstan srung drag mo'i gzugs 'dzin 'dzin ma'i spo las rnam par rgyal/ /rgyal ba'i yum gcig dngos grub ma lus lus pa med par stsol cig kye/ /kha ba'i rdul brtsegs gsar du ma bskrun zhing / /bde 'byung gtsug rgyan lan brgyar bzhu min pa'i/ /dkar 'jam ri mo'i cha shas yongs rdzogs pa/ /sngon med zla gzhon thos 'dzin rgyan du sbud/ /dga' ba'i rang bzhin rgyas pa rtsed 'jo'i grogs/ /phan bde'i u dum wā ra ba 'ad pa'i 'dzum/ /legs byas char gyi dus ston skyed pa'i ma/ /dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i dbyangs 'di rna bar snyan/ /phun tsho gis sde bzhi'i be+eḍūr las grub pa/ /g.yung drung 'gyur ba med pa'i nor ldan mar/ /yid kyi re ba'i yol go su wa r+ṇa ra/ /'dod pa'i dngos kun 'jo ba'i shis pa stsol/ /chu rta lor sha pho thog tu sto dmag phywa (13na〉nga lang i kyang 'grokhyab ma byung zhing nor bu rin chen dpa' brtul mi bsrun pa'i byed pos/ khrod du me stag yar ba lta bus bsam shes rnams blo 'khyog par brten chu lug las sbyor byas na zla nga drug gi khongs su mi rgan ju nang gis gtsos pa'i dpung gis ming med du btang ba'i dusagashin rje gshed po mnan pa'i rna cha can la gtang rag phul ba'i snyan dang la yig gshin rje khros pa'i lhag sa// gnyer gtad dgra bo zla ba drug gi khongs/ /tshe yi 'du byed bkums pa'i gtang rag tu/ /sman gtor rak+ta phyi nang mchod pa'i tshogs/ /ging gang las kyis mtha' sdud bcas la 'bul/ /shing sprel hor zla lnga pa'i nang du 'ol dga' stag rtse nas da shod phyogs su 'de gag dong chos 'khor rgyal du dpal ldan dmag zor mar las bcol du phul phe yā dar kha yig gdung phe tso sel/ /dbyangs can dgra sde'i gshed du srin mo'i skur/ /rab ston 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug mas/ /'gal rkyen mi mthun phyogs kun rab zhi zhing / /— 154

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ ()'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod//'ol dga' nas phan yul za dam du phyin pa'i tshe zings pa rta mgo'i khyab 'jug ge dam shing la 'phrin las bcol ba'i snyan shal kha yig dgra dbung 'dzoms pa'i thog mda'//dpal ldan gsang ba kun gyi gan mdzod las//theg mchog yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po ches//mchog thun dngos grub char du 'bebs mdzad pa//gsang bdag thod 'phreng rtsal gyis rtag tu skyongs//gang gi bstan srung mi 'da'i dam tshig can//zhing bcu'i dgra sdo sgrol la rdo rje'i thog/khyab 'jug dug gi 13ba'i gri rā hu la//phyi nang gza' brgyad gdong mo 'khor tshogasakyis//kun du bzang po lag na rdo rje dang //mtsho skyes rdo rje pad+ma las tshol rtsal//kumā ra dza dri med 'od zer sogs//dngos brgyud bla ma'i dam tshig nyer dgongs la//rgyal ba'i bstan skyongs rigasa'adzin bdag cag gi/mi mthun nye bar 'tshe ba'i tsho gos kun zhi//tshe dpal rab rgyas mthun rkyen dbang du sdus//log 'dren dgra bgegs tshogs rnams thal bar rlog/mdor na ye shes spyan gyis rab gzigs la//yid la ji ltar 'dod pa'i don rnams kun//thogs med lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las de//nam yang g.yel ba med par lhun grub mdzod//shing sbrel dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi sngags khang du gra rgan rags bsdus bzhi bcu skor gyis bskang so btsugs pa'i tshe dpal rdo rje 'ag byed la phul pho snyad ra lha bla gdu kyi go pung //in+d+ra ni la'i sa 'dzin dbang po lta bur rab brjid bzod par dka' ba drag po'i skur//lhab lhab dus kyi me dpung 'byug pa'i dbus na rab 'gying khro rgyal dbang po gshin rje'i gshed//bka' sdod mngag gzhug bcas pa'i tshogs kyis blo ldan yongasakyi dpal gyur bzang po'i 'phrin las can//grags pa phyogs kun khyab par 'geng ba'i bstan pa srungs la nag phyogs bdud sde'i tsho gos kun choms//gos sbung mar kha gi dam gzor ma'i bris skur phul ba'i snya dar zhal yig thung gas rin ོ shing rta//14na jus gsum rgyal ba ma lus kun//kun gyi bstan srung mas dang stobs//stobs ldan yongasakyis zla bral ma//ma mo chen mo re ma tis//rgyal ba'i bstan pa thos bsam sgom pa yis//ri mor

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()bgyid pa khrims ldan 'dus pa'i sde//zhwa ser 'chang ba'i ring lugs grags snyan rnga //nam mkha'i nor bu ji bzhin ches 'bar zhing //'chad mkhas gtam gyi sbyor ba'i rin cen khrir//rtsod ngag gzhes bral rdo rje rab bzung nas//rtsom pa'i rgyud mang legs brdung dbyangs snyan can//mdo rgyud 'chi med dga' ston rgyas gyur cig/shing bya lo gsar dus srid gsum bdag mor phul ba'i snya dar zhal yig phren la gzi thur//nam sur su ste//dus gsum rnam 'dren yongs kyi lung rtogs bstan//bsrung phyir tshangs pa'i bu mo dbyangs can ma//'jigs rung khro mo'i skur bstan dmag zor lha//gang gis legs byas rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas mchog/phan bde'i dpyid gyur rgyal bstan yongs rgyas shing //chos dang srid kyi yongs si'i ljon shing dag/dkar phyogs chu shel dbang po'i dkyil 'khor ltar//rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i cha shasayongs su gang //deng 'dir bsam pa'i 'dod don rta bdun can//mi mthun chu 'dzin dgra las rnam rgyal zhing //las bzhi'i 'phrin las 'od stong 'bar ba'i gzi/kun tu ches cher rgyas pa'i dge legs stsol//14bshing bya gzha yod mchod pa'i dus jo bo shākya mu nir phul ba'i snyan zhal kha yig phan bde'i lo 'bras khur dud//ldan pa'i gzug tso/legs pa'i rang bzhin dbyar gyi pad+mo can//'gugs pa'i bsod nams ye shes dpyid kyi nor//'di nas snying stobs gan mdzod la lang ba//rnam 'dren dbang po bu ram shing pa kye//ra byung gi dang gsag ༅ ra shog yo54a'i smrel pho ma nyin byed kyisahrūd lhun po'i mdzes pa rnams//'phrog byed lang tsho'i dpal mnga' mtshan dpe'i gzi//sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rol gar rgya mtsho yis//rtsod ldan mun pa ring du bskrad dam snyam//le'u dang pon shad pa'i lho phyogs sgo sna la grag4pho rabadang gyi ༅/zad pa'i mtha' 'bral dbyangs kyi 15na ) rgyal mo mchoge khrid 'khyam lus can so sor snang ba'i skad//yan lag drug cur grub pa'i ngo mtshar 'dis//thos 'dzin bzang po'i skal bar cisami spyod//rmonges gzug sa lhu༄nga wo 'khor mun dra ༷ ma lus pa//gcod pa'i shes rab snon po gzas

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 9)pa yis//dri bral thugs kyi kun tu gsal ba'i mdangs//'chi med dbang po'i lam der zhus pa byin//mtha' bya phe rang bsto brjod pa yas lce yis drang por brjod pa'i tshig/yun du ngal bsten dka' thub drag po yis//drang srong chu lha'i bu yi skyid pa yang //bskyur na gzhan dag byis blo'i ngang tshul can//'on bya bar ba gi brjod pa/te chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba yi//mi phyed dad pas cud zad gsol bgyid na//ris med 'gro la bsnyen bsring mi mnga' ba'i//dmigs med thugs rje'i mthu yis nye bar dgongs//ris bral srid 'dir ches dub 'gro ba kun//bde ba'i ngal stegs mi yi seng ge'i bstan//rab rgyasalegs 'dzin chos ldan rgyal po yi//sdebazhi yongs 'phel ba ched don 'grub par shog/swā 'gal phe skyags༅ la'i ljongs 'dir nad 'khrug nyer 'tshe'i sprin//nus pa'i 'thor rlung drag pos mthar bskrad nas//phan dang bde ba'i yongs bo ljon pa yi//yal 'dab 'bras bu'i khur gyis dud gyur cig/15b.rang byon lnga sa la phul 'a snya shal mig ne skyid srid ༅ rtser ༅ra//rab brtse'i dba' rlabs chang gi dri//thugs kyi 'gram par legs bro ba//'phags ma ga gnyis 'thung dbang po des//skye rgu'i bung ba rgyas par mdzod//16na〉da yon to brjod pa thog gsal byed du byung de lus phra'i gdong par mig/mgrin sngon ral pa'i rtse na 'od dkar can//khyab 'jug lag par 'khor lo'i ri mo ste//grangs med rgyal sras dbus na snying rje'i gter//dus mang shā dpe kyi me lce 'bar ba'i tsha ba dang //'thor byed drag po'i rlung gis la mi pa'i rdul//yongs 'du'i dri bsung mngar por 'thul ba yis//'gran pa'i zla bral gang gi thugs rje'i mthu//bas shing mo bsdus pa'i gzug ba mi bzad ༷ gsum gyi dra ba sa/nyon mongs zas la sred bas yongs chud pa//zhakhrul pa'i shā wa ri yi dga' ston can//mkhyen brtse'i dpung gis skyobs shig pad dkar 'chang //bde legs myu gu bskrun pa rgyal ba'i bstan//rtag pa'i rdo rje lta bur gnas gyur cing //bsil ldan ljongs 'dir bde skyid dbyar mtsho ltar/khrid pa'i rtsemor rab 'phyur dpal stsol cig/gang zhig ches smo/ gdugs dkar gyis//grib bsil 'khor yug

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtonakun khyab pa//don kun 'grub pa'i rnga yab dkar//yid kyi ngal gsor mdzes gyur cig/rgyal ba btsong la pa r+ṣa po'i sku bas la snyan shal phul ba'i kha yig srid zhi'i thod du 'ching ba'i cod pan//16brgyal ba'i gsang gsum dbyig 'dzin las//stings pa stobs bcu'i rkang 'thung 'phreng //blo gros bzang po'i 'bras bu can//grags pa'i dri yis srid pa 'dir//ches sags mā le'u gsum pa'i 5byed kyi gang tshiga'adres 'geng zur phud lnga yi sgra dra'i gar//mtshams sprin mdzes mar chags pa bral ba'i rdzu//mkhasabatsun bzang po'i yol ba stong bres par//dgyes rgur spyod 'di 'jam dpal snying po yi//ngang mi'agogs pa tshul gsal ba'i rten 'byung snyan pa'i glu//mgrin par len pa phyogs bral gsar bha'i//kun gyis sgrog pa'i skal ba ches thob na//mi smra'i skyes bu gang zhig sa 'dir ci//rab ldan pa'i gzugs༅ mang lung gi 'khri shing ldem pa'i rtser//ches zab rtogs pa'i 17na skong bu g.yur za ba/zung 'jug sgrub pa'i ro brgya 'jo ba 'di//rdo rje 'chang gi rang bzhi gsal bar ngom//tso mtha' dgaltags༅ gyi shi brjod bstan chu gter mi 'byug cing //'gro ba'i don gnyis gzings brtan pas//bde legs nor bu'i cod pan gang //thod du 'ching ba'i dpal gyur cig/dung skyong rgyal mor snyan shal phul ba'i kha yig don kun 'grub pa'i gto/lha rab dngas kyi rgyan ldan sprul pa'i khang bzang skye 'gro'i dpal//nyer 'tshor ring du brtan pa'i byed pa po//rnam 'dren kun yum dbang mo dung skyong ma//stobs ldan gang gi thugs kyis legs dgongs shing//17ba blos cha shas gzugs༅/gtsang bstan pa'i lam gsum las 'ongs pa'i//mdo sngags chos tshul dri med gaṅgā'i rgyun//kun mkhyen btsong kha pa yi ring lugs mchogo/rta bdun ji srid gnas pa de srid du//rab wor brgya che nga brten khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon//da dhi tsa yi rus pa las//legs grub g.yung drung gzhi chen por//ji srid mi g.yo ches brtan zhing //mtha' char pe/yas 'gro ba'i tsho gis spyi dang //khyad par bsil ldan gangs ljongs 'dir//phan dang bde ba'i legs byas kun//dbyar k+ṣa mtsho ltar 'phyur ba dang /a phogazug ༅gyi shis po brjod pa/ched du bsams pa'i lha 8lam las//las bzhi'i chu 'dzin 'phreng 'bregs

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ tanashing / /don kun lhun grub char chen po/ /rgyun mi chad pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa rnams kyis shing bya zla spu ba na gcig pa'i tshes bzhi nas brtsams te dpal ldan 'dod khams dbang phyug ma'i bskang bshags khri tshar bsags pa'i dus grwa tshang gi sa spungs bris skur phur ba'i dar tshon sna lnga'i yā dar zhal yig tshon la rnam bsto bdan/ /rab brjid kha ba'i rdul brtsegs lhun bo la/ /rab dkar chu shel dbang pos 'khyud 'dra ba/ /rab mdzes ngag gi dbang phyug dbyangs can mas/ /rab 'byams zhi ba'i 'phrin las tshogs spyi dang / /khyad par log dkar 'dren dgra bgegs byad kha zor/ /(18na skod gdon mi mthun nyer 'tshe'i mun stug kun/ /phul byung mthu stobs 'od kyis mthar bskrad nas/ /phan bde'i snang ba ches cher gsal bar mdzod/ /ser bde chen chos dbyings zla ba'i ma ma las/ /mtshan bzang sku yi 'od stong 'bar ba can/ /legs lam bye ba'i pad tshal rgyas mdzad pa/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba yongs kyi yum gcig mas/ /thub bstan 'phel zhid bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor legs tshogs rnams/ /dkar phyogs bsil sbyin mkhan ltar yar ldan du/ /rgyas shing bsam pa'i don kun 'grub par mdzod/ /phan dang bde ba'i 'byung gnas rdo rje'i theg /theg mchog legs bshad rin chen gling gi nor/ /nor mchog lta bur mchog tso dngos grub kun/ /kun nas char du snyil ba'i dge legs stsol/ /dmar byu ru'i 'khri shing mtshams sprin dmar po'i mchur/ /rjes chags srid gsum dbang sdud sgeg mo yis/ /chos srid sgrub la mthun rkyen brtan g.yo'i chos/ /ji bzhin dbang du 'gyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /mthing khra mig sman brtsegs pa'i ri bo dusamatha'i mes/ /gos kyis klubs la srin mo'i gzugs 'chang na/ /'jigs rung khyod sku'i dper bstan dmag zor lha/ /rig 'dzin yongs kyi srung ma'i gtso khyod kyis/ /rgyal bstan dgon gnas srid sder bcas kun dang / /khyad par rig 'dzin bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /bsam ngan sbyor rtsub 'chang byed dgra dang bgegs/ /mthu byad rbod gtong gto zor sri ga nad/ /dug mar ga (18bskomo'i sbyor ba gshom pa sogs/ /gnod byed gdug pa'i brag ri mtha' dag rnams/ /drag po'i 'phrin las rdo — 159

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()rje'i thog mda' yis//thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du rlag par mdzod//6khyi cho 'kha4bi phe dus rdzo bo shākya sku ni/4 byon lnga ldan/rgyal geb kha pa/dung skyong rgyal mo rnams la phul snya shal kha yig nges legs grong 'jug/lhun grub chos sku'i lha lam las//gnyis skyes lang tsho'i mtshams sprin can//zas gtsang sras zhes dbyar skyes sgra//skye rgu'i thos 'dzin rgyan der 'dud//9nasgo thong na mi mthun med pa mtshan dpe'i sku//'gro la rjes su chags pa'i 'dzum zhal gyis//phan bde'i ga bur thigs pa legs 'dzag pas//sngon med tsan dan ljon par da gdod nges//cha shas sgras kyang srid pa'i gdung ba kun//pha mthar byed pa 'gag med tshangs pa'i dbyangs//yan lag bcu gnyis rgyud du bkug pa'i glus//dri za'i 'phang 'gror sred byed 'ching ba grol//mkhyen brtse'i rang bzhin kun nasachos yangs pa'i//dri bral gang gi thugs kyi gting mtha'i tshad//mthong bas zla ba'i ma ma ches skrag nas//gnam sngon zhun ma'i mdangs kyis klubs pa 'dra//rta ljang can gyis rab dkar pad+ma'i tshal//lus phra'i gdong gis 'dod ldan yid dga'i dpal//'phel byed rgyal bas lus can phan bde ste//tshangs sras ma des rig byed smra ba'i blo/khung zad kyis kyang nges legs nor bu'i rgyan//thod du tsha'i byed mthu stobs mnga' ba la//mi phyed dad pas bsngags na don gnyis kun//stsol cig brtse ldan kun mkhyen shākya'i tog/dbyar gyi nor 'dzin dga' ma'i bzhin ras la//spang ljongs smin ma'i tshogasarnams gar sgyur tshe//char sprin gsar pa'i gos kyi rdzu bag nas//'brug sgra dal gyis sgrog pa chos nyid lags//sems med ma la ya yi rkang 'thung la//yang yang bsil bus bskul ba'i dri bsung gis//bshul ring zhugs pa'i 'gron po'i tsha gdung rnams//sel zhing dga' ba bskyed pa dgongs lags bsam//9ba tha stan 'gro'i dpyid gyur thogs med thugs rje yis//gang zhig smon pa'i don kun legs hrūb cing /khyad par bstan dang de 'dzin sa dbang gi/chos ldan khrims kyis dbyig 'dzin skyong gyur cig/rang byon lnga ldan snying stobs btsan po'i go cha yis//gdul dka'i 'gro la rjes brtse ba//phyag na pad+ma 'od dkar can//lus can kun la phan bde /rdo//lhang lhang gdung bas gsol 'debs shing //

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'a)snyan snyan tshig gis bstod byed na//'dzum 'dzum zhal sgo'i 'od zer las//chil chil bdud rtsi ster bar mdzod//thib thib dug gsum kun zhi nas//gsal gsal sgrib med kun mkhyen sar//brtse brtse'i gas dbang khur ོ gyis//mang mang 'gro ba 'dren gyur cig/rab dkar phun tshogs tshogs gnyis chu gter las//las bzang spel mkhas mkhas mang yongs kyi dpal//dpal ldan rgyal dbang dbang phyug btsong kha pa//pa sangs ltar gsal gsal mdzad bshes gnyen mchog/rje gzha long kha pa gang gis nyi ma'i gnyen gyi ring lugs rnams//cha shas gong du 'phel ba'i zla ba ltar//rab rgyas de 'dzin gser ldan skyong ba yis//tshe dang bsod nams mnga' thang rgyas par shog/rgyal dpal lha ba'i yum gcig dbyangs can ma//rjes chags nyams ldan dpal lha mos//'phrin las rnam bzhi gang bcol ba//thogs med lhun gyis grub par mdzod//rgyal ba'i bstan pa rab 'phel zhing //sa dbang rgyal po'i mnga' thang rgyas//yid la bsams 20na ) pa'i don rnams kun//g.yel med sgrubs shig brtsegadungs can//dngos brgyud sgo nas gnod byed cing //bsam ga spyor rtsub lang ba'i dgra/gang du 'dug kyang tshar chod la//bdag sogs bsam don thogs med sgrubs//me khyi wom dbyang bla ma dkon mchog chos 'phel snyo 'di'i gzugs sku'i bkod pa yongs su bsdus nas rje gzha 'jam dpal snying po'i drung du gshegs pa'i tshe zhing khams rgya mtsho'i gdul bya 'dul bar bzhed pa'i dgongs pa ji bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i ne du rdzo shāka rnam gnyis/rang byon a rje ོ po/byams spu chos 'khor/rgyal ba btsong kha pa rnams la snya shal phul༅ kha yig 'tshes da spyo sa 4 lo'i chu shas//mtha' rdzo bo gi po tshe yas tshogos gnyis rgya mtsho chen po las//sku gsum cha shas yongs su rab rdzogs pa//zas gtsang sras po chu shel dbang po yis//thugs rje'i bsil zer ci yang ba 'ad par mdzod//gang zhig rta ljang dbang po'i dkyil 'khor dag shar ba tsam gyis smag rum mun pa'i dpung //pha mthar skrod la 'bad med lhun grub tu//'byung ba dngos po'i chos nyid cis ma lags//bzang ngan sems kyi rtog pa dang bral ba//dpag bsam yongs 'du gsar pa'i ljon pa yis//'gro kun re 'dod ma lus yongs /nga ba//byed po med kyang rten cing 'brel 'byung

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)shugs/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i yon tan ma lus pa/ /mngon gyur lnga brgya'i dus su snying stobs dpung / /rnam 'dren gzhan las ches lhag snyan pa'i rnga/ /grags pa don dang ldan las gzhan ci zhig /dkon mchog rgyal ba ma lus 'dus (20ba)pa'i dpal/ /lung rtogs dam pa'i chos kyi mi zad gter/ /ches cher 'phel mdzad yongs 'dzin bla ma mchog /chos sku'i mkha' la dgongs pa'i kun gsal ma/ /dbyer med ngo bo gcig tu gyur pa'i dbyings/ /bgrangs yas gzugs sku'i rnam rol dbang po'i gzhu/ /bstan 'gro'i dpyid du rnam par bkra ba dag /gang du bzhed pa ji bzhin 'grub gyur cig /rigs brgya'i khyab bdag bshes gnyen dam pa yis/ /bde chen chos skur rol pa'i thugs rje las/ /sdug bsngal gsum gyis ches mnar lus can kun/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba'i go 'phang thob gyur cig /lhag bsam rab dkar chu 'dzin phreng ba las/ /rnam par yongs dag smon lam gru char gyis/ /bde legs dbyar skyes gsar pa'i dga' ston kun/ /dkar phyogs zla ba lta bur 'phel gyur cig /rjo bo mi skyod rdo rje/gser zhun rdul mang brtsegs pa'i ri/ /mtshan dpe'i mdangs kyis rab 'bar ba/ /snga na med pa nyi ma'i gnyen/ /thugs rje'i mthu dpung lhag par skyed/ /rigs kun khyab bdag grub pa'i rje/ /ches dkon zung 'jug nor bu mchog /dam chos rgyal mtshan rtser bsgrengs pas/ /bde legs 'phel mdzad bshes gnyen gang / /dag dang ma dag zhing khams su/ /srid bzung g.yin don mtha' klas pa/ /ji ltar ba ched pa bzhin 'grub pa'i/ /smon lam dbyar gyi rnga chen sgrog /thugs rje chen po/ bla med thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis/ /du lta'i mun sdug kun 'joms pa/ /brtse ba'i bdag nyid 'phags(21na tha mchog /lus can kun la nye bar dgongs/ /mtha' klas mar gyur blang dor la/ /dpyod pa'i mthu dman zhakhrul ba'i 'gro /gser ldan lto ba'i mngal khur rnams/ /nye bar drongs shig pad dkar can/ /zur phud lnga pa mkhas grub kyi/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar mkhan ma/ /dag pa'i zhing du bder gshegs tshul/ /nye bar bstan 'di slan chad nas/ /gnas skabs gdul byar 'tsham pa yis/ /gzugs sku'i rnam 'gyur mi na ga yan mi chad pa'i ngo mtshar gnas/ /bzhed pa'i 'bras bu smin gyur cig /byams pa chog lor rab — 162

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ tana'abyams rgyal ba'i gsang gsum kun/ /kun nas gcig bsdus 'jam dbyangs mgon/ /mgon po mchog des smon pa'i don/ /don gnyis lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /rje gzha long kha pa rgyal ba'i snang bas mi yi srid pa'i zol/ /bsil ldan 'gro la ston pa btsong kha pa/ /blo gros bzang po'i gragasa'abar gdugs dkar can/ /rnam 'dren gtso de'i thugs rjes deng 'dir dgongs/ /srid na rab dkon mchog dman 'gro ba la/ /med byung dam pa'i chos kyi legs pa'i lam/ /dbyar mtsho lta bur 'phel mdzad bshes gnyen rje/ /'gyur med bde chen klong du mnal ba las/ /grangs med sprul pa'i zlos gar gdul bya yi/ /khams dang 'tshams par rnam dkar 'phrin las sogs/ /ji bzhin brtse bas nye bar rab dgongs nas/ /bde legs spel ba'i smon gnas grub gyur cig /(21ba)me khyi lha sa nas 'bras spungs su 'gro bar dpal gsol dus phul ba'i snyan shal kha yig dar dkar 'dzum bshad/ /dpal ldan rgyal ba'i bstan srung che/ /dpal mo'i khengs log mdzes sdug ma/ /dpal khyim lta bur rab dkar ba/ dpal 'byor kun stsol lhag pa'i lha/ /'dod khams bdag mo khyod kyis bdag cag gi /zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las ma lus pa/ /yid la ji ltar bsams pa rab sgrubs la/ / bcol ba'i 'phrin las thogs pa med par mdzod/ /me khyi nag pa zla sgyu bas ga 'a r+ṣa mo'i dus mgon po gdong pha par phul ba'i snya dar zhal yig lha rdzas sngon po'i stod g.yogs/ khyab bdag he ru ka dpal mi bzad drag po'i skur/ /sgyu 'phrul rol gar stobs log khrag 'thung nag po yis/ /bsam sbyor ga 'chang dgra dang bgegs rnams tshar chod la/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las ma lus myur du sgrubs/ /zhing skyong gzi ldan dbang phyug gis/ /mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las rnams/ /sgrubs la dgra sdom lus choms/ /chos srid don kun bsgrub par mdzod/ /me phag gnam lo thog mar tshes pa'i 'dod khams dbang phyug ma mchod pa'i dus phul ba'i snyan dar kha yig don gnyis lhun grub/ su sti pradzābh+ya: phun tsho gos bde legs kun gyi chu gter che/ /gcig tu rab 'phyur byed po tshangs pa'i sras//dpal ldan rgyal yum 'dod khams dbang phyug mar/ /mchod cing legs bstod nyin mor byed pa yis//— 163

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()dus gsum rgyal ba kun dngos btso ngo kha pa//bshad sgrub bstan pa srid steng bcas22na tha yi//pad+ma'i tshal kun ches cher yongs 'phel zhing //legs tshogos sbrang rtsi dar ba'i dga' bston stsol//mchod bstod yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po la//phan bde'i 'byor pa char du yongs bsnyel pas//'gal rkyen grang reg ma lus rgyangs bsrings te//don gnyis dbyar gyi dpal mo bzhad par mdzod//me phag smon lam r+sā mo'i dus jo bo shākya mu nir phul ba'i snyan dar kha yig ma 'dris kun gyi mdza' bzhes/oṃ su sti bra dzā sa:dge legs tshogos gnyis 'bras bu yis//rab spud kun mkhyen ljon pa'i dbang //med byung mkhyen brtses 'gro rnams la//dge legs stsol cig shākya'i gtso//srid zhi'i phun tsho gos yongs su rgyas pa'i rtag brtan mi 'jig rdo rje'i sku//gzhom med gsang chen nā da'i sgra dbyangs snyan zhing 'jebs pa tshangs pa'i gsung //lkog gyur chos kun rjen par gzigs pa dri bral kun mkhyen ye shes thugs/e ma rnam 'dren zas gtsang sras khyod rab stims rgyal ba'i bdag nyid che//mthong na mi mthun med pa mtshan dpe'i skus//skal bzang skye bo'i mig gi bdud rtsi dang /me rtag mda' can dpung tshogs bcom pa dag/mnyam du byas pa'i skal bzang 'di med byung /khing zad tsam gyis phan bde'i lo tog kun//rnam par rgyas byed chos kyi sgra dbyangs che//ma smad rna ba'i gas len 'di nyid kyis//dri za'i rgyud mang la yang skyengs pa byin//zad pa'i pha mtha' yongs bral thugs 22ba〉kyi mtshor//mkhyen brtse nus pa'i 'dab brgya cher rgod pa//phan bde'i sbrang rtsi 'bum du bzhad pa des//yid kyi ra yig gnyis pa re ba gang //rtsod dus snyigs mas nyer sbags nags klung na//snying stobasadri bsung mngar ba tsan+dan ljon//ma 'dris kun la mdza' ba'i mgon khyod kyis//thugs rje'i phyag gis lus can dbugs dbyung zhig/gang gi 'gog med mthu stobs kyis//yid la smon pa'i re ba rnams//'bad med lag rtser stsol ba yi//phul byung bka' drin stsal du gsol//me phag cho 'phrul mchod pa'i dus dung skyong rgyal mor 'phrin las bcol ba'i snyan shal kha yig sa mos 'dzum bzhad//rab dkar zla ba zhun mas legs 'khrud pa'i//rab ༷/da lhun po'i dpal la 'gran bzod pa//rab

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chags ga bam gsum pa/ 'da'abyams rgyal kun bstan srung dpal lha mos/ /rab tu ches dkar zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /bstan dang srid sde'i mi mthun bar chad dang / /rig 'dzin bdag dang de yi dmigs yul la/ /nad gdon mthu gtad dbye bskrad la sogs pa/ /mi dang mi min bar chad kun zhi mdzod/ /pahrūl stobs kyis nor 'dzin dbang po yang / /thal bar rlog pa'i nus ldan bstan srung ma/ /'dod khamasadabang phyug sngags 'chang dgra lha che/ /srid gsum kun la dbang sgyur lhag pa'i lhas/ /bstan srid sdel gnod pa spyi yi dgra /rig 'dzin bdag la sdo ba'i sgos dgra sogs/ /nad gdon bgegs dang sgeg sri bar gcod kun/ /mngon spyod drag po'i las kyis sgrol bar mdzod/ /(23na)rang phyogs 'phags pa mgo ༅snya nang tshan mang yul skyid grong gi 'phags pa wa ti bzang por me phag hor zla dang po'i tshes gnyi shu la 'bul rgyu bskur ba'i snyan shal yig thugs rje'i dri bzhon bskul po'i ma la ya rgyud/ dpal ldan rgyal kun gsang ba gsum/ /rab rdzogs 'phags pa mchog gang gis/ /lus can rnams la phan bde dag /legasapar stsol cig thugs rje can/ /nam yang 'gog med mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dri/ /gsol 'debs ma la ya rlung gis bskul bas/ /'gro ba'i tsha gdung kun bcil legs pa'i lam/ /'bras bu g.yur du za ba'i shis pa mdzod/ /me phag smon lam (23ba)chen mo'i dgu gtor thog sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po khog zhugs la snyan shal phul ba'i kha yig gar das kho ldan/rab dmar phrin po drag tu rab khros gzugs/ /res 'ga' khro chags sgeg dpa'i zlosagar can/ /rnam 'gyur sna tsho gis ston mdzad srog gi bdag /dpal ldan sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po yis/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas dam tshig nyer dgongs la/ /kun mkhyen btsong kha pa yi bstan srid spel/ /rig 'dzin bdag gis bcol ba'i zhi rgyas dbang / /drag po'i 'phrin las thogs med sgrubs par mdzod/ /me phag hor zla gnyis pa'i nang du rang byon 'phags pa lo ke shwa rar phul ba'i snyan dar kha yig bod 'bangs bde ba'i 'brasasmin/ su sti pradzā byu: bgrangs yas 'gro la phul byung brtse ldan brtse chen phyag na pad+ma gang / /sna tshogasasprul pa'i zlos gar dag las dag dang ma dag gdul bya'i khams/ /ji bzhin yongs gzigs 'jig — 165

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()rten dbang phyug dbang por 'tsham pa'i mdzad pa yis//phan dang bde ba'i dngos po kun stsol kun gyi gnyen gcig spyan ras gzigs//gzigs pa g.yel ba med pa dri bral spyan//spyan dang mngon shesal sogs gzhan gyi don//don rnams bsgrub pa'i yon tan ma lus tshogos//tsho gis gnyis mthu lasarab rnyed 'phags pa mchog/mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ster ba'i lha//lha sogs 'gro kun skyobs gnas snying rje'i gter//gter ltar mi 'dzad dge legs 'byung ba'i gnas//gnas skabasamathar thug bslu ba med des 24na ) mgon//mgon kye thub pa'i bstan pa rgyas pa dang //dang por khyod kyis skyong ba bod kyi yul//yul kun bde zhing bdag sogs bsam pa'i 'bras//gos bu 'grub cing rab smin dge legs stsol//me phag nag pa zla ba 'a brgyad gtor gyi mgon po zhal la phul ba'i snyan shal kha yig zhing skyong 'dzum bzhad/dpal ldan shākya'i bstan pa srungs ba'i gtso//rnal 'byor bu bzhin legs skyong mthu rtsal can//stobasa'aphrog zhing skyong gdong bzhi 'khor bcas kyis//rdo rje 'amang dbang klu sgrub lo wo yi//sa skya pa dang sngags yong mtshar pa sogs//dngos brgyud bla mas bor rdo rje bzhag/lce steng bdud rtsi blugs te dam btags pa'i//dam tshig gnyan po deng 'dir nyer dgongs la//thub pa'i bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde spel//rig 'dzin sngags 'chang bdag gis bcol ba yi//zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod 'phrin las kyi//sgo nas bsam pa'i don kun lhun gyis sgrubs/wom dbyangs bla ma dkon mchog chos 'phel gyi dgongs pa chos dbyings su rdzogs pa'i go du rje dbon bstan won gyisagasang rne'u thog ga gtsug lag khang du rin chen gnyis pa'i mchod sdong thog sgo gnyis spus pa'i shis pa brjod par 'ong dgos tshus byung ba ltar phyan skabs dngul gdung rin po cher phul ba'i snyan shal kha yig don gnyas 'dzad pa med pa'i gter mdzod//dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi//mkhyen dang brtse ba'i yon tan tshogs//bdag nyid 'jam dpal bla ma yi//pha mtha' kun dang bral ba'i thugs//bde chen mkha' dbyings 24ba〉rus phur rjes chagasa'od//༅ byung chos dbyings klong du nyer sim ro///ngas pa legs byas lhun grub mchod sdong che//

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ tanashel dkar sa 'dzin la 'khru gang 'di yi/ /tshul 'dir sgo gsum la rgya lhur len kun/ /don gnyisa'adzad pa med pa'i ga bur thigs/ /bran pas nyes brgya'i tsha gdung rab bcom nas/ /dus rnams dge legs dpal la spyod par shog /rgyal po bse'i khrab can la 'phrin las bcol ba'i snyan shal kha yig dbang drag rnam rol/ dpal ldan rgyal ba'i bstan srung mchog /gdug can sgrol ba'i dpa' bo che/ /dgra snying za ba'i srog gi bdag /chos 'khor skyong ba'i ngas tshig can/ /rab 'jig pad rag lhun po la/ /rab brjid nyi ma 'bum phrag gis/ /rab tu 'byud pa srin po'i sku/ /rab dmar dbang gi mdangs 'dzin pas/ /rgyal ba'i bstan srung skye 'gro yi/ / phan dang bde ba kun du spel/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las ma lus pa/ /thogs pa med par lhun gyis sgrubs/ /sa byi gnam lo tshes pa'i dus 'dod khams dbang phyug mar mchod sprin spros pa'i tshe phul ba'i snyan shal kha yig las bzhi'i snang ba ra sgegs la/dus dkar gsum rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug mchog /rab bsdusang ga gi lha mo dbyangs can ma/ /'dod khams bdag mor sprul pa'i lha khyod kyis/ /zhi ba'i las kun thogs med sgrubs par mdzod/ /dar ser dge legs yon tan 'dod rgur ster ba'i lhas/ /tshe dpal lung rtogs stobs 'byor phun tsho gos rnams/ /dkar phyogs chu shel dbang po'i dkyil 'khor (25na)ltar/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i dngos grub ma lus stsol/ /srid dmar zhi'i brtan g.yo legs tshogs ji snyed pa/ /thugs rje'i lcags kyus thogs med dbang bsdus nas/ /khams gsum kun du mngon par ches 'phags pa'i/ /don rnams thogs pa med par myur du sgrubs/ /dgra sngo bgegs nad gdon bar chad nyer 'tshe sogs/ /mi mthun mun pa stug po'i smag rum kun/ /mthu stobs nyi ma'i 'od kyis mthar bskrad nas/ /phan bde'i snang bas phyogs bcur khyab gyur cig /— 167

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)sa byi cho 'phrul mchod pa'i dus jo shāka /rang byon lnga ldan byams pa chos 'bor/ rje btsun btsong kha pa/ dung skyong rgyal mo rnams la snyan shal phul ba'i kha yig legs byas rgya mtsho'i rlabs 'phreng /lhar jo bo rin po cher bcas 'gro ba'i tshangs gnas 'dab stong rtser/ /bkra shis 'khor lo'i zhabs pad ze'u 'bru/ /phan bde'i rkang drug bzhad phyir g.yur za ba/ /nyi ma'i gnyen dang dbyer med snang brnyan drung / /zla shel thags su grub pa ka shi ka /byed pos ngo mtshar ri mo'i phreng bkod 'di/ /phul bas gnas skabs don kun legs 'grub cing / /mthar thug byang chub mchog la reg gyur cig /rgyal kun thugs rje ོ po thugs rje gcig bsdus rang byon gyi/ /gzugs sku'i byin rlabasanyin mor byed pa yis/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag mchog gi sgrub pa rnams/ /'bad med lhun gyis 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /byams po chos phreng byams dang brtse ba'i bsil zer gyis/ /'gro kun mi (25bsgo thun mun 'dzoms shing / /dge legs snang ba rab rgyas pa'i/ /thugs rje kun la 'jug gyur cig /'jam rje las ba khang mgon sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar/ /ston mdzad blo bzang grags pa yis/ /bdag sogs gdulabya ma lus pa/ /zab mo'i las la spyod par shog /dpal lha mor dpal ldan rdorje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ /rab mdzes lha mo'i gzugs su ston mdzad pa/ khred gsum bdag mo dpal ldan dung skyong ma/ /'khor bcas rnal 'byor bdag la nyer dgongs kye/ /bstan srung khyod la rtse gcig gsol 'debasashing / /gtan gyi skyabs su gsol ba'i rig pa 'dzin/ /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i gnasaskabs kyi/ /'dod pa'i don kun lhun gyisahrūb par mdzod/ /khyad par nad gdon thams cad rab zhi zhing / /tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor longs spyod rgyas/ /khams gsum dbang sdud dgra bgegs—168

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang ma rdzo rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 9)'joms pa yi//a mong dngos grub ma lusahrūb pa dang //nges don gsang wo rdo rje'i theg pa yi//sngar phyir 'gyur ba'i zab mo chos tshul rnams//bshad dang bsgrub cing spel bar smon pa dag/'bad med lhun gyis 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//sa byi smon lam chen mo'i gtor rgyag skabs sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po khog zhugs la 'phrin las bcol ba'i snyan shal kha yig dregs phog da rgyas/khab dmar byu ru'i lhun po brtsegs pa la//nyin byed 'bum gyis legs da rnam 'gyur can//dpal ldan sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po yis//bcol pa'i 'phrin las ma lus bsgrub pa dang //khyad par nad gdon kun zhi tshe dpal rgyas//khams26na po sum dbang bsdus gnod byed dgra sde'i lis//sgo rdzo mardzo dang thun mong dngos grub kyi//lugs gnyis 'dod pa'i don kun sgrubs par mdzod//mdor na zhi rgyas dbang drag la sogs pa'i//'phrin las ji snyed gnyer du gto pa kun//thogs pa med par myur du legs bsgrubs nas//mthun rkyen legs tshogis ma lus 'phel bar mdzod//sa byin ga pa zla phe snya dar zhal yig mi tsor rdo rjes ma' pa'i stegs//gsal stong dbyings rig dbyer med gdod ma'i mgon/dgra sde'i gshed du bshan pa stobs log nag/sngags 'chang dgra lha mthu dang nus pa'i bdag/drag po gzi ldan dbang phyug 'khor bcas kyis//dkyil 'khor khyab bdag dang po'i mgon po dang //dbyer med bsod nams bye ba'i phung po mchog/rigs ldan bkra shis 'khyil ba kun tu bzang //dga' r+ṣa bdag nyid he ru ka dpal gang //'jig med rdo rje'i rang bzhi bzhu blugs kyi//khams las legs par grub pa'i dga' ston gyis//gsang chen slob bshad bdud rtsi ma lus pa//longs su spyod pa'i skal bzang thob par mdzod//thub bstan 'phel zhing skye rgu'i phan bde rgyas//khyad par bdag gi bsam pa'i 'dod don tso//mtha' dag pod pa med par lhun grub pa'i//wen las rnam bzhi myur du sgrubs par mdzod// byi stob kyi dang sa gas yon chos kyi rgyal por ༷/ra pas sa kyi ga gis 'damathang phrog bsas ba bde 26ba

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)chen gyi mkhar las tshugs skabs bar chad mi 'jug pa'i ched du dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga pa thang lha rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal la 'phrin lasabacol skabs phul ba'i snyan dar kha yig sa dbang bzhed don lhun grub/ /kai la sha yi sa 'dzin rab mtho'i spor/ /chu 'dzin 'ja' ris khor yug lding khang dbus/ /khro chags nyams can lha mchog dri za'i rgyal/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'bar rtsal 'khor bcas la/ /phyi nang gsang ba dgyes pa skyed pa'i rten/ /dngos bshams yid sprul mchod pa'i tshogs 'bul na/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi/ /spyan sngar khas blangs dam tshig nyer dgongs la/ /rgyal dbang 'jam dpal snying po'i bstan rgyas shing / /de 'dzin sa dbang bzhed don lhun gyis grub/ /nor 'dzin khyen kun phan dang bde ba yis/ /yongs gang legs tsho gos rgya mtshos khyab par mdzod/ /khyad par rig 'dzin bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /nad gdon nyer 'tshe'i tshos/sa rnams rab zhi zhing / /tshe dpal stobs 'byor legs pa'i yon tan kun/ /thogs pa med par grub pa'i gnyer mdzod cig /sa byi hor zla lnga par dpal ldan 'bras sbungs kyi byams chen/ gtsang khang nub/rnam thar sgo gsum/ bde gshegs mchode rten brgyad/ dmag zor ma'i bris sku/ nag po skor gsum rnams la phul ba'i snyan dar kha yig li shi'i dri bsung / /byam bang byams chen pa'i yul gyur sems can ma lus pa/ /byams chos yon tan brgyad du nyer bkod nas/ /byams mgon rgyal ba'i go 'phang mngon gyur te/ /byams sems dpung gis bdud sde 'joms par shog /gong kha nub bgrang yas skye rgu'i 'dren byed me long ngos/ /ngo mtshar ri mor shar pa sprul sgyur mkhan/ /(27na tha la shar 'khru lha ba bas mchode stong che/ /dge legs snang ba'i dpyid du dar gyur cig /lhag rnam thar sgo gsus bas ma ma la ya yi skyed tshal las/ /srab 'jam bla na dngar ba dri bsung can/ /'gro rnams sdug bsngal tsha gdung rab sil ba'i/ /rlabs chen smon lam rlung gis 'dren par shog /chu ge gshegs mchod rten brgyad 'dzin gsar pa'i 'phreng ba bsgrigs pa la/ /dbang gzhus legs 'khyud sgyu 'phrul rol gar can/ /bde byed grangs ldan mchod stong phreng ba yis/ /'gro ba'i bsod nams spel slad brtan gyur cig /rab dam gzor ma'i bri sku dkar mdzes sdug ngag dbang dbyangs can ma/ /rab — 170

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ thona'abyams drag po'i 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i ched/ /rab 'jigs khro mo'i skur bstan dmag zor mas /rab tu dgyes pas don gnyis sgrubs par mdzod/ /'jigs 'gas byed med dpal ldan gshin rje dusakyi dgras/ /'jigs bral rdo rje rab 'bar mthu stobs kyis/ /'jigs rung dgra sde'i tsho gos kun rab bcom nas/ /'jigs byed dpa' bo gang gi sku thob shog/phyag mgon po phyag drug pa na pad+mo khro bo'i skur bstan pa/ /phyag drug dpal ldan nag po chen po yi/ /phyag g.yas mtshone gyis dgra bo'i snying phyung khrag /phyag g.yon thod par blug ste rol bar mdzod/ /las las shin kyi shan 'byed dpal ldan ma he'i zhal/ /las kun sgrub la thogs med mthu ldan pa/ /las sbyor mngon spyod dag gis skul byed na//las bzhi'i mthar thug myur du grub par mdzod/ /(27ba)sa byi gdan sa chen po dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling du dngul gdung rin po che/ thub pa tshul khrims ma/rdo rje 'jigs byed rnams la phul ba'i sa dar zhal yig bdud las rgyal ba'i seng ge'i dbyangs/ /dus dngul gdung gsum rnam 'dren thams cad kyi/ /bdag nyid 'jam dpal snying po'i zhabs/ /med byung thugs rje chen po yis/ /grangs med 'gro la dge legs stsole/ /sku gsum zad pa med pa'i rnam thar sgo/ /mtha' bral srid par rab bye lam yangasapor/ /lus can bde bar khrid de zhi ba'i gling / /kun mkhyen khang par 'jug mdzad 'di med byung / /shes bya'i rin chen dngas pa'i rtsig ngos (28na)la/ /blo gros pir gyis mkhas btsun bzang po'i gzugs/ /ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho'i sgyu ma mkhan/ /grags pa srid rtse'i bar du ci yang 'bar /brtse chen spyan dkyus ring por 'chang ba'i rtser/ /mkhyen dpyod smin ma'i ut+pal nags klung gis/ /shes ldan zla ba gsar tshes lus phra ma/ /dga' bas phyogs der yang yang rgyug pa bzhin/ /rnam dkar 'phrin las dpyid kyis nor 'dzin gzhi/ /ma bzod rngul las nyal 'gro'i rgyun babs tshe/ /lha lam skrag ste stong pa'i rang mdang ni/ /ispro ni la'i khu ba byugs pa bzhin/ /dus gsum 'dren pa kun gyi mdzad pa dang / /mgon khyod bsod nams ye shes phung po'i tshogs/ /srang la gzhal tshe lci dang yang ba'i gnas/ /kun mkhyen ye shes kyis kyang rtogs nus min/ /gser sbyangs las grub pad+ma'i skud pa — 171 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()ltar//ches phra thags su bskrun pa'i gan gos kyi//gzi 'od mngon par 'bar ba bzod min zhes//rta ljang can de chu lha'i mkha' la bros//srab 'jam ut+pal 'dab ma la 'khu zhing //kha dog be+eḍūr zhun ma'i khengs pa 'phrog/pha mtha' kun gsal zhags par 'gran bzod pa'i//'chi med dbang po'i reg bya dam pa 'di//dga' bzhi las 'ongs bde ba chen po yi//dga' chen khyab bdag go 'phang brnyes pa'i gnas//dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling mchog na//dga' ston chos su legs spyod btsong kha pas//rab 'byams dus gsum rgyal ba'i yon 24pon kun//rab bkrus pha mtha' dang bral thugs kyi rten//rab dkar rin chen gnyis pa las grub pa//rab mdzes rgyal ba gnyisapa'i mchod stong cher//mi phyed dad pa mchog gis 'bul bgyid na//mi mthun bdud sde'i g.yul las rab rgyal zhing //mi zad phan bde'i 'byung gnas thub bstan dar//mi yi seng ge'i go 'phang thob par shog/dkar thu gong 'jam lha rdzas na bza' 'di//dkar gsal dad pas 'bul bgyid na//dkar mdzes mtshan dpes spras pa'i sku//dkar phyogs zla ltar rgyas gyur cig/khro gtam 'gas byed mi bzad nga ro yis//khro rngams tshogs kyang 'dar byed pa'i//khro rgyal gshin rje gshed po mchog/khro bo'i tshogasakyis 'phrin las sgrubs//sa bya stag lung phyag mdzod ngag dbang bzang ston gyis ra sa 'phrul snang du snyan dar phul ba'i kha yig dgos tshul ltar bris pa bka' brgyad skyed kle yongs spus//mtshan jo bo rin po dpe'i rang bzhin rgyas pa'i be+eḍūr ya//tsho gis gnyisayol gor legs 'khyil phan bde'i dpyid//'gro la ye shes mchogo stsol sgyu dra'i gar//ston mdzad zas gtsang sras po'i thugs rje yis//ngag gi dbang phyug skal bzang kun dga'i dpal//lhun grub nges don chos kyi lung rtogs mkhar//mdzad bzang wo mor byed pas rnam grol tshal//wo bas 'dren pa mchog gi sder gyur pa//thang pa'i bga' brgyud 'chi med skyed tshal du//zhabs pad yongasa'adu'i ljon pa rab tu brtan/r+sām dkar 'phrin las lo 'dab 29na ) g.yur za zhing //don gnyisa'i gos bu dpal la spyod par shog/4 rje ༷po kun snying rje wo po'i zlos gar mkhan//rgyal

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mgo rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 9)sras gzhen nur 'char ba'i 'phags mchogo gis//rgyal ba'i bstan pa yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal//rgyal mas rtse mor 'bar ba'i dge legs stsol//dpal dpal lha mo ldan nyi ma'i gar+sā gyi bka' srung mchog/dpal mo'i snyems pa 'phrog pa'i dung skyong mas//dpal sdug ring lugs dkar phyogs zla gawo dang //dpal gyi dum bu lta bur rgyas par mdzod//sa glang gnam lo gsar tshes kyi dus 'dod khams dbang phyug mar phul ba'i snyan dar zhal yig las bzhi'i gzi 'bar/khyu mchog rang zhal ngoms pa gser ldan khams//phun tshogs bgrang bya thog mar tshes pa'i dus//med byung mchod sprin 'dzad med nam mkha' mdzod//rab spel srid gsum dbang mo dgyes bskyed na//zhwa ser cod pan 'chang ba'i chos srid bstan//bla nas blar 'degs sa pa'i yul sa'i rtser//rab 'bar 'jig rten kun gyi phan dang bde'i//dga' ston gsum rtsen mdun sa'i dpal thob mdzod//khyad par 'khor lo'i mgon zung zhabs pad brtan//rigs 'dzin bdag gi bcol ba'i zhi rgyas dbang //mngon spyod las kun thogs med lhun grub par//mdzod cig 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma//sa glang nag zla'i brgyad gtor dus mgon po zhal la phul ba'i snyan dar zhal mig legs ldan gad rgyangs//gtum chen legs ldan nag po 29na ) drag shul can//rdo rje nag po zhal bzhi 'khor bcas rnams//dam rdzas ba ling rgyan ldan mar gtor gyis//thugs dam gas po skong ngo las kun sgrubs//lcags ga cho 'phrul mar pa'i dus jo shāka rnams gnyis rang byon lnga ldan byams pa chos 'bor/rje gzha btsong kha pa/mgon po rtse sdong ma rnams la phul cu snya dar zhal yig bsod nams ro btso gan skrul//phan shākya mu ni bde'i 'brasabazang smin pa'i ro brgya'i bcud//lus can mtha' dag longs su legs spyod la//lhun grub legasalam rgya mtsho'i ba po shis kyi//ches dkar 'gro la rtsol cig shākya'i tog/da sprul mi ge tshe rdo ldan tshon mchog wo mor byed pa yis//dus kun dge ba'i tshal rab cher rgyas shing //mi 'jig bzhi ldan sbrang rtsi'i bcud ོ por//spyod pa'i skal ba bzang por bdag gyur cig/mig rang byon lnga sa sman ltar gnag 'khor ba'i dusnya tso//dmigs med stong ༷ dag pas rgyas bto ste//rten cing tshol 'byung

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()tsam las don gnyis 'bras//'gro la stsol cig 'phags ma ga 'jig rten mgon//brtse chen byamasapa chog lor thugs rje chen po'i rlabs//dus las nam yang mi g.yel ba'i//rnam dkar yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal//'bad med stsol cig mi pham mgon//e rjebs ba khang ma srid pa'i nags klung na//bstan bde'i dri bsung ches dngar ba'i//mchod sprin sgo 'phar brgya phrag rnams//phye zhig 'jam dpal snying po'i zhabs//khrag mgon po sgos 'thung lha chen mthu bo ches//mi 30na ) mthun phyogs kun thal bar rlogs//bsam pa'i don rnams ma lus pa//lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol//me phag gi rdzus 'gros la rkar srid kyi mdzad khyab ma bde bar lcags stag lo zur 'jam dbyangs bla mar mjo zhe spyod kyi las sbyor mdzad dgos tshul byung 'dug pa bzhin khams gsum 'khrug byed kyi rlung dmar 'dzunas pa gnang skabs rgyab chos su tshe bdag nag po'i rang gshed 'bebs dgos tshul byung ba ltar dang du blangs pas lcags yos zla ba bzhi par 'brug ngag dbang rnam rgyal dus kyi chos nyid du gyur ba'o gnas tshul nges pa byung bar/dngos gzhi gung thang nas gto rag bzag rgyas gnang na'ang/phan bde'i legasabashang gling pa'i tshogs su chos srung dga' ston gyi tshe phul ba 'a snya dar zhal yig yid srubs rtsa ga drung skrun//'khor 'dasaphyag rgya zil gnon dus dgra'i dbang//mi bsrun las gshin ral pa tshar dgu can//srid gsum dbang sgyur dpal ldan re ma ti//snang srid lha srin sde brgyad dang bcas par//dus kyi chad pa'i sna drangs mon bod rnams//mnar byed bdud brlam sgom chen mas bzung ba'i//ra lug 'brug pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyi//bla srog dmar zas snying khrag hub drangs pa'i//sngar bcol drag sbyor grub pa'i gtang rag tu//dmar chen gtor ma ri bo lta bur spungs//khrag chang btung ba rgya mtsho bzhin du skyil//phyi nang dam rdzas 'bul na dgyes par rol/gong du 'degs pa'i sngon 'gror lcags yos lo rgyal 'ol yar klung phyogs su bston skabs thog mar gdan sa chen po dga' ldan rnam par (30brgyal ba'i slong du dngul gdung rin po che/thub pa tshul khrims ma/nag po skor gsum rnams la phul ba'i snyan dar kha ye gamathong thos dran reg rnam grol//rgyal dngul gdung ba rgya mtsho'i zhing khams bye ba'i rdul//lhan cig grub pa'i rang gzugs zlos gar mkhan//sa la nyer ༷nas 'og min sdug po bkod//sku bzhi'i dbang

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ tanaphyug ma lus 'byung gnas cher/ /'jam mgon chu shel zhun mar 'khyil ba'i khams/ /mkhyen brtse'i cha shas yongs rdzogs 'od dkar gyis/ /thub bstan kun+da khong nas ba 'ad byed pa/ /rgyal ba'i tog gyur blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/ /stobs bcu'i rtsal gsum rdzogs pa'i nga ro'i sgra/ /'jigs med gdong lnga'i rgyud las legs drangs glu /srid pa'i rtse mor cher bsgrags snyan 'gyur gyis/ /skye rgu'i phan bde'i thos 'dzin gsos su 'jebs/ /gang gi mchod sdong rin chen gnyis pa la/ /legs grub 'dzam gling 'gro ba'i bsod nams zhing / /mthong thos dran dang reg pas mgo mtho dang / /nges par legs pa'i go 'phang la 'god par/ /stong 'khun sor mo'i sgyu 'phrul rol gar las/ /zla ba zhun mar rab 'khyil ba ā dar+shar/ /thugs kyi ri mo 'char ba'i cho ga dang / /rdzogs pa'i snyan shal zung 'brel phul ba'i mthus/ /med byung bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid kun/ /rnam par 'phel shing rgyas pa'i nyer 'tsho'i gzhin/ /chu gter chen po'i rlabs kyi 'phreng ba ltar/ /(31na skom yang yel ba med par 'byung gyur cig /khyad par nor 'dzin dga' ma'i lto ba na/ /dge bcu'i lam bzang dar ba'i bsil ldan ljongs/ /snyigs ma'i rgud pa ma lus rab zhi nas/ /rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i rtse dga' rgod par shog /blo chen rgyal ba kun gyi tog gyur pa/ /skal bzang 'dren pa bzhi pa'i rgyal tshab mchog /grags snyan dpal 'bar 'jam dbyangs btsong kha pa'i/ /ring lugs srid mtha'i bar du rgyas gyur cig /thub dbang tshul khrims ma mkhyen brtse nus pa'i nyin mor byed pa yis/ /'gro kun mi shes mun las rgyal mdzad pa/ /lhar bcas 'gro ba'i gnyen gyur shākya'i tog /dge legs rgya mtshos nor 'dzin khyab par mdzod/ /in+d+ra 'jigs byed ni la'i lhun po la/ /mun pa bye ba'i gos gyon zhing / /dus kyi me lce'i 'phreng ba can/ /dpal ldan ma he'i zhal can gyis/ /thub bstan 'phel zhing 'gro ba kun/ /phan dang bde ba'i dpal la spyod/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi/ /bsam don lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /thugs phyag drug pa rje'i dbyar skyes 'phreng ba las/ /'jigs rung khros pa'i gnam lcags thog /bdud sde'i klad pa 'gem mdzad pa/ /myur mdzad mgon pos 'phrin las sgrubs/ /las skyon 'chi bdag dus kyi dgra (31bslob —175

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()pos//kun mkhyen 'jam dpal snying po yi//ring lugs srid mthar rgyas pa dang //mi 'gyur brtan pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//lcags bos 'ol dga' rdzing phyir 'byor dus byams pa'i sku me thub ma khyad mtshar/dngul gdung /gnas srung rgyal po rnams la so'i snyad ra zhal yig tho sa nor ba'i dpya//mkha' byams po ltar dag pa byams brtse'i chu gter che//dus las yol ba med pa thugs rje'i rlabs//'dzad med phan dang bde ba nor bu'i dpya//stsol cig 'phags mchog mi pham mgon po kye/zhal dngul gdung dkar rdul mang brtsegs pa'i lhun po la//lus can bsod nams bskrun pa'i mchod sdong che//mthong bas don ldan 'grub pa'i lcags kyu yis//'gro kun bde skyid 'gugs pa'i pho nyar mdzod//byu ru'i rgya po po lhun po byin za'i phung po yis//rnam par 'byud pa 'jigs rung srin po'i gzugs//srog bdag dregs pa'i rgyal po pe ha ra//rig 'dzin yongs kyi dgra lha mthu rtsal can//pad+ma 'byung gnas spyan sngar khas blang ltar//bstan dang dgon gnas 'gro ba'i bde skyid spel//khyad par rig sngags yong ba bdag cag gis//'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyi grub par mdzod//lcags yos chos 'khor rgyal du phyin skabs byams chen la gos kug gi snyan shal phul ba'i kha yig tsho gos gnyi dar dpyang mdzesapa'i dung dkar g.yas lo7//32na〉bas dang shes rab zung du 'jug pa yi//bla med snying po ye shesabadud rtsi'i gter/grub pa'i rang gzugs byams mgon nyin mor byed//legs lam 'bum sde'i snang ba ches dkar shog/dge tshogs ral pa stug po'i nags klung nas//legs byas lang tsho dar babasagaṅgā'i rgyun//srid zhi'i rgyad pa'i dri ma rab bkrus nas//phan bde'i khyab 'jug zhabs bsil sbrengs gyur cig/lung dang rtogs pa'i 'jam mnyen 'dab ma'i kha//'dzum gyis bsus pa bde legs bye ba'i mgron//'gugs byed thub bstan man+ta ra yi 'phreng //lus can 'chi med thod du 'ching gyur cig/blo gsal 'chi ba med pa'i tshogs rnams kun//bzang 32ba ) po'i bskal bar 'gyur byed sngon med kyi//bdud rtsis rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sro/6/'tsho ba'i grags pa srid rtser 'bar gyur cig/

sku gsung thug rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'dagangs ldan ra bas bskor ba'i tshal chen por/ /'gro kun bde skyid dpag bsam ljon shing 'bras/ /legs lam zad mi shes par mngar ba'i ro/ /bgrangs yas skye rgus longs su spyod gyur cig /bkra shis dge mtshan rgya mtshor rab 'khyil pa'i/ /dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor los phyogs kun las/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i khrims ldan bos pa'i gling / /dbyar gyi chu gter che ltar 'phel gyur cig /rnam smin dkar por g.yas su rab 'khyil ba'i/ /tsho gis gnyis dar dpyangs mdzes pa chos kyi dung / /'gro kun rna bar legs 'jebs snyan pa'i sgra /sgrog bzhin dga' ldan gnas su gar byed shog /lcags bos rgyal lhun grub dga' tshal gyi de lti koṭi ra dpal ldan lha mo'i sku brnyan don 'grub mar phul pa'i snyan dar la yig rang dgar gyi rnam rol/ /thun mas gos kyis rab klubs mig sman ri/ /dus kyi byin za'i phung po dang 'grogs par/ /gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan na gang gi dper/ /ston mdzad dpal ldan 'dod khamasadabang phyug ma/ /khyod kyis bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde sogs/ /legs byas rgya mtsho'i rlabs kyi 'phreng ba can/ /nam yang dus las yol med 'phrin las kyis/ /sngon med gsar pa'i rgya mtsho rgyas par mdzod//khyad par bdag gi zhi rgyas dbang la sogs/ /legs sgrubs(33na)dga' ba'i gar gyi rnam rol cing / /mngon spyod gnam lcags 'bar ba'i rdo rje yis/ /log 'dren brag ri phye mar 'thag par mdzod/ /lcag yos rgyal du slebs thog gnas chung nas chos rgyal chen pos 'phrin yig ral gri bkug pa dang bcas te pho nya mngagasanas bstan srid la log par 'thu ba'i dgra bo zhig tshe'i 'du byed bkum bod pas rtags mtshan 'di rnams dga' tshal gyi tsher phung rtsa bar skyol la gtang rag thong gsung ga bzhin dbyug gu zla ba'i tshe brgyad la btang ba'i dus kyi snyan dar kha yig gtu pa drag bshan pa'i gad rgyangs/ /rgyal ba kun gyi mthu stobs nus pa kun/ /zil gnon gshin rje gshed po'i rnam rol can//srid gsum dbang sgyur dpal ldan re ma ti/ /bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i dpung gi tshogs/ /dmar nag mdog can 'jigs su rung ba'i gdong / /nya rgyas zla dkyil 'od la co 'dri zhing / /rab dkar mche ba mdzes sgo 'dzum dang bcas/ /dgra bo'i don snying dmar po lag tu thogs/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i ru mtshon 'phyar bzhin du/ /dam nyams thal bar brlag ces khu sgra dang / /bcas te srung ma kun —177—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)'du'i sgrub khang na/ /rnam 'gyur gar gyi brel ba 'di rmad byung / /sngar bcol bsgrubs par gtang rag gnyan po dang / /da 'chol las kun sgrub par byed pa'i rten/ /'dul na bstan srung dregs pa'i dmag gi tshogs/ /thogs med gnas 'dir byon la dgyes rgur rol/ /lcags yos bsam yas mchims phur slebs skabs grong smad pa 'phrin las rgya mtshos nu bo tshe dpal ba'i don du slob dpon (33ba〉na po'i sku bsnyan lo wo be+e ro'i phyag bzo khyad mtshar la snyan dar phul ba'i kha yig kun phan srid zhi'i gdung sel/ /rig 'dzin gtso bo rdo rje thod 'phrong gi /med byung sgrub gnas gsung gi yang dben gyi/ /sku brnyan ye shes sems dpa' dngos bzhugs par/ /lha rdzas snyan shal phul ba'i dge tshogs mthus/ /lnga pa'i lam gyur tshe rings dpal 'byor gyis/ /las nyen sdig sgrib thams cad legs dag nas/ /nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams su/ /thogs med skyes nas chos la spyod par shog khul tu mchis pa rnams la nad gdon bgegs/ /dus min 'chi sogs bar chad kun bcom ste/ /'chi med pad+ma'i thugs rjes tshe 'phel zhing / /bsod nams rab rgyas 'dod don 'grub gyur cig /bsam yas mchims phu'i o rgyan chen po'i sku bas be+e ro'i phyag bzo mar phul pa'i snyan dar zhal yig bde chen dpal 'bar/ /rgyal kun gsang ba gsum gyis zlos gar mkhan/ /mtsho skyes tshe dbang rig 'dzin thod 'phreng gis/ /bstan 'gro'i phan bde ma lus rgyas pa dang / /bdag cag bsam don 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /chu 'brug gong du 'degs pa'i lam zhor 'dam bsam 'grub bde chen du bsdad skabs hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes bcu dgu'i nyin dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga pa gnyan chen po thang lhar gsol mchod dang bcas phul pa'i dar tshon sna lnga'i snyan dar zhal yig las kun khrub pa'i 'dod lo/ /phun dkar po tshogs lang tsho'i dpal ldan zla bzhin can/ /gar dgu'i nyams kyis rol pa'i sgyu 'phrul gzugs/ /lha yi lam la dbang po'i gzhu ris ltar/ /rnam bkra lha mchog dri za'i rgyal po la/ /(34na)rab dkar pad+ma'i 'dab ma byed po yis/ /rab mdzes thags su bskrun pa lha yi gos/ /rab mnyen lhab lhub snyan shal phul ba yis/ /rab 'byams zhi ba'i 'phrin las lhun grub mdzod/ /kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin la 'gran pa/ /kun dga'i dpal ster nyi ma'i gzi brjid — 178

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ tanakyang / /kun nas 'phrog byed mtshams sprin mdangs 'dzin ltar/ /kun bzang sprul pa khyed la 'bul bgyid na/ /mi sgo po 'gyur seng ge'i gdan la kun dga'i dpal/ /ma lus dkyil 'khor kun gyi mgon po zung / khu mtha' bral ba skal pa rgya mtsho'i bar/ /mi g.yo rdo rje lta bur brtan par mdzod/ /dbang dmar po phyug brgyad kyi yon tan phung po la/ /dbang du legs sgyur mthu stobs nus pa'i bdag /dbang gis rgyal po lta bur re skong ba/ /dbang drag las mdzad lhag pa'i lha mchog la/ /reg 'jam bde ster bde ldan lha yi gos/ /kha dog rab dmar rab 'byams mchod pa'i rdzas/ /rgya cher legs spel legs pa'i phun tsho gos kun/ /thogs med dbang du dbang gi las kyis sgrubs/ /sngon po lha rdzas gnam sngon bzhun mar 'khyil 'dra'i mtshor/ /rab dkar yid kyi gnyis skyes lus dkar can/ /mchod bstod mgrin pa'i rdza rnga legs brdung zhing / /spyan gzigs phur lding rtse 'jor rnam rol na/ /yang yang mchod cing bstod pas mnyes byas shing / /'grig 'grig tshigs tsam lhur len ma yin (34ba thar/ /dung dung snying nas bsten cing mchod byed na/ /'jigs 'jigs drag po'i las kun thogs med sgrubs/ /ljang gu mar gad mdangs kyi rin chen rtsig pa'i ngos/ /sde bzhi'i gzugs brnyan brgya phrag rab 'char ba/ /ma 'dres so sor rab rte ma mkhan/ /rig pa'i rtsal 'di ha nu byu bzhin/ /kun rtogasapir gyis bris 'dra'i snang brnyan la/ /dbang gzhu'i gur khang lta bu'i mdangs bkrag can/ /spang ljongs gos su klubs la co 'dri ba'i/ /mnyen 'jam dar ljang snyan shal 'di phul bas/ /lha chen mthu stobs nus pa yid bzhin nor/ /mchod bstod rgyal mtshan rtse mor rab bkod pas/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub 'dod pa'i don/ /bsam pa ji bzhin lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /gong du 'degs shul hor zla bzhi pa'i gnam gang gi nyin glang ling lar rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa rnams bdud mgon seng ge'i gdong can dang gnod sbyin tse'u dmar po gnyis kyi gsol mchod btsugs skabs bdud mgon la kha btags mthing khra dang rtse'u dmar bar dar tshon sna lnga phul ba'i snyan dar kha yig dngos grub rgya mtsho'i gter/ /zhing 'dir thub dbang bstan pa srung ba dang / /zhing bcu'i dam nyams dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i phyir/ /zhing lpags la — 179

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()sogs drag po'i chas ldan pa//zhing skyongs dbang pos 'phrin las ma lus sgrubs//bstan kha bshasadakar po dang bstan kha spo shas mthing khra 'dzin chos srid 'byor pa'i sder//gnod byed bdud rigs dam nyams dgra bgegs dang //bdag sogs rnams kyi nad 35na ) gdon bar chad kun//ma lus zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol//dar ser thos bsam sgom sogs rnam dkar bya ba dang //tshe dpal bsod nams stobs ra legs tshogos rnams//yar ro'i zla ba ltar bur rab 'phel ba//rgyasapa'i 'phrin las ma lus sgrubs par mdzod//khyad par ngag gi dbang phyug 'jam dpal dbyangs//phul byung bkra shis kun dga'i dpal ster dpyid//dang po'i mgon po skye rgu'i bsod nams kyi//zhing du bskal brgya'i bar du brtan par mdzod//dpag dar dmar po bsam shing dang bum bzang 'dod las ba//yid bzhin nor bu dbang gi rgyal po ltar//'dod pa'i re ba ma lus skong byed pa//rab 'byamasadabang gi 'phrin las ma lus sgrubs//dar nag po bsam ngan sbyor rtsub 'chang ba dam nyams dgra/dngosadang brgyud nas 'tshe ba'i mi bsrun pa//ma lus sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po yis//zhal du bstab po drag po'i 'phrin lan sgrubs//dar ljang gu mchod bstod sa bon mtshar du dngar ba gang //mas stobasanus pa'i nyal 'gros smin pa las//dngos grub lang tsho rgyas pa a shwatā//phan bde'i grib bsil nyer 'tsho'i rgyur gyur cig/gong gi rgyal khab r+ṣa po pe cing gi nye 'dab gzims khang ser por chu sprul lo gsar dus 'dod khams dbang phyug mchod pa'i tshe sol shā snyad ra kha yog 'dang nga dbang tsho shug ldan//rab dkar mdangs kyis mi mthun phyogs35bkun sel//'tshams sprin 'od kyis tshe dpal bsod nams me skyed//dmar ba'i gzi yis khamasagasum dbang du sdud//mthing nag rdo rje'i tsha tshas dgra bgegs 'dul//'phrin las thogs med bsgrubs pa dmag zor lha//dus kun brten cing mchod pa'i srung ma khyod//mi zad thugs rje'i masadapung rab skyed la//bcol ba'i 'phrin las kun sgrub dus la babs//mkhas grub bla ma zung 'jug zhabs brtan cing//bsil ldan bstan dang skye /༷ phan bde rgyas//sa dbang rgyal po'i chab srid

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ tanamanga' thang 'phel/ /legs pa'i yon tan ma lus sgrubs par mdzod/ /rig 'dzin bdag gi lo skeg tshe yi 'phreng / /mi bsrun nag phyogs 'byung po'i bar gcod sogs/ /'dod don sgrub la gnod byed dgra dang bgegs/ /ma lus thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du rlogs/ /tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor snyan grags dang / /thos bsam sgoms sogs chos dang mthun pa yi/ /bsam don 'bad pa med par lhun grub pa/ /yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po lta bur mdzod/ /brang 'gro gos sngon gyon pa bgrang bya yi/ /nang 'dir kha ba'i sman ljongs dbus 'gyur du/ /'dab bzang dbang po ji bzhin bgrod pa yi/ /don 'di lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /mdor na bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /bstan srung dbang mo khyod la gnyer gtod na/ /yid la bsam pa'i bde skyid ma lus pa/ /'bad med lhun gyis grub pa'i (36na〉nyun las mdzod/ /rgya nag gzims khang ser por hor zla dang po'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa rnams la 'dod khams dbang phyug dgyes skyed kyi mdos bskang tshugs skabs phul ba'i snyan dar kha yig 'dod don thogs med sgrub pa'i dbyar rnga/ /bsam pa'i don 'grub dpag bsam yongs 'du'i ljon/ /dran pas srid zhi'i gdung sel dmag zor lha/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi yum gcig ma/ /yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po khyod nyid la/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las gnyer du gtad pa 'di/ /mas stobs nus pa'i dpung tshogs rab bskyed nas/ /skad cig tsam la thogs med lhun grub par/ /dus la bab po 'dod khams dbang phyug ma/ /'gal rkyen byed pa'i dgra bgegs tshogis rnams kyi/ /bsam sbyor bya byed las kun rdul du rlogs/ /'dab bzang dbang po'i bgrod pa dang mtshungs par/ /swā la'i ljongs su thogs med bgrod par mdzod/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas rnams la/ /bshul du nad gdon bar chad kun zhi zhing / /mthun rkyen gang bsams don rnams ma lus pa/ /'bad med lhun gyas 'grub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /chu sgrul tor zla bzhi pa'i tshes brgyad la legs ldan nag po zhal bzhi pa mchod pa'i dus phul ba'i dar tshon sna lnga'i snyan dar kha yig bsnyed dpung snying la dpa ri tsho bro rdungs/ /bla ma dkar po mchog dang khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon/ /dgra —181 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()bgegs gshed du stobs 'phrog srin 36ba ) po'i gzugs//dam nyams srog rtsa bcad pas ma tshims par//da dung snying khar bro brdung stang stabs can//phyi rol 'jigs rung dur khrod brgyad la sogs//dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i gnas kun rab myul nas//thub bstan srung ba'i bka' yi bya ra ba//legs ldan nag po gdong bzhi'i mtshan can khyod//rdo rje'i lus kyi a wa sgru ti'i nang //mi zhig sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i zlos gar gyis//rtsa khams rlung gi 'dab brgya grol ba'i rtser//zung 'jug ze'u 'bru ba 'ad byed nang gi mgon//ye nas dag pa gsal stong rang gi sems//lhun grub gdod ma'i mgon por ro cig pa//brjod bral gnyug ma'i ye shes gsang ba'i mgon//gang der mkha' la mkha' yi sbyor ba bzhin//gnas skabs bar chad mi mthun zhi ba dang //mthar thug sku bzhi'i bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang //'grub pa'i 'phrin las gnyer du gtod byed na//kwa ye mthu dpung skyed cig stobs 'phrog dbang //dar sgo po yid bawo nor dang bum bzang 'dod 'jo'i ba//dpag bsam shing dang masasapa'i nag po ches//tshe dang bsod nams thos bsam sgom pa sogs//yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//gangs dar dmar por/can bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i snang ba 'bum//rab 'bar nyi ma'i mdangs la 'gran bzod par//mthun pa'i rkyen du rab gyur yon to kun//khab len rdo dang lcags bzhin dbang du sdus//37na 'bas zhag go rdo rje 'chang dbang ri sul rnal 'byor gnyan//brtse chen snying po'i zhabs dang mtshar pa rje//drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar byon pas//bka' bsgos dam tshig bsgrags pa nyer dgongs la//'gro ba'i bde skyid bstan dang chos 'khor 'joms//rig 'dzin bdag cag snying nas dam pa'i chos//sgrubs la bar du gcod pa'i dgra dang bgegs//thams cad thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du rlogs//khyad par gangs can sman ljongs dbus 'gyur du//pad 'byung chos rgyal mes dpon ba ched pa'i lhag/bkang phyir bstan 'gro'i phan bde myur sgrub par//bsam pa'i don kun lhun gyi 'grub par mdzod//dang ljang gu thub bstan 'chi med tshal du btsong kha pa'i//dri bral ring lugasamya ngan med ljon shing //'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i 'a/ba ma g.yur za can//grib ma skye rgu'i ngal gso'i

sku gsung thugs rten gsar tsongs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'dastegs gyur cig/ngag dbang dbyangs can mgrin pa'i ba po shis glu//kun nas mi byed mdza' gcugasadaga' bde'i mgon//'gro ba'i bsod nams zhing gyur dkon mchog gsum//'phrin las skal ldan dpal du rgyas brtan mdzod//rgya sog gi lha 'dre'i las 'gyur gyis sgar la nad rim la sogs 'byung bar nye tshe rim gro dgos tshul chos skyong chen po khog tu zhugs nas gsung par brten kha'i tal sgar nged rang gi rdo rje slob dpon byas nas rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa rnams kyi phur pa lha nag gi sgrub pa bzhugs pa'i dus glags lta'i 'byung po mang po'i spyi bor phur 37bkyi pa thebs pa mthong mkhan gyi spyod yul du gyur pa sogs sgrub pa'i mtshan ma ngo mtshar ba 'byung ba'i dus phul ba'i snyan dar kha yig bdud dpung phye mar 'thag pa'i thog ra 'a//gar g.yo shas dgu'i nyams kyis brjid pa'i dbang sngon ri//dus kyi me lce 'bar ba'i gosargyan pa/shes rab 'khor lo rgyas 'debs dga' ma dang //mnyam sbyor wen las dpal kho he ru ka/dran pa tsam gyis nag phyogs bdud sde'i dpung //thal bar rlog cing mchog thun dngos grub kun//'bad med stsol mdzad rdo rje phur pa yi//lha tsho gos rnams kyis dus 'dir dngos grub stsol//mthu stobs dpyid kyi pho lhas legs bskyangs pas//chos dang nyer mthun bsam don a ma'i shing //'dod pa'i re ba legs skong gos bzang dag/myur du stsol cig 'phrin las phur pa'i lha//phur skyong srung mar khas blangs dam ldan rnams//rigs 'dzin pad+ma'i dam tshig nyer dgongs la//deng dusabacol ba'i 'phrin las ma lus pa//thogs pa med par myur du sgrub par mdzod//kha'i tal ra phur sgrub dang 'brel bar lo dus kyi srid gsum bdag mo thug dam stong ba'i mdos bskang gi tshe phul pa'i snya dar dzi po yig rtse las sa gdon sa//mdzes ga4 dkar brjid chags dang gtum rngams rnam 'gyur tshogs//grangs med bstan nas zhi rgyas dbang drag las//thogs med sgrub mdzad rgyal ba kun gyi yum//dran pas srid zhi'i gdung sel lhag pa'i lha//nges pa'i don du rdo rje dbyings phyug ma//mthun 38na 〉 dung gdul bya'i snang ngor dbyangs can lha//dgra bgegs gshed du 'dod khams dbang phyug ma//'khor bcas mthu stobs nus pa'i dpung skyed la//bstaX pa bsrung zhing lus can bde skyid spel//bdag

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon bgegs//bsam ngan sbyor ba rtsub 'chang dgra dpung sogs//bar chad mi mthun phyogs rnams zhi bar mdzod//gangs ri'i dpal ldan dbus 'gyur sman ljongs su//thogs med bgrod nas thos bsam sgom pa sogs//rnam dkar dam pa'i chos kyi bya ba kun//'bad med lhun gyis yongs 'grub 'phrin las mdzod//ngag gi dpal rnyed dbang phyug brgyad ldan zhing //thog mtha' bar du bkra shis chos kyi dung //kun bzang thugs rje'i dga' tshal rab yangs por//phan bde'i srog shing rdo rje ltar brtan mdzod//'gro ba kun gyi skyabs dang mgon gcig pu//thub pa'i bstan pa lus can bsod nams kyi//zhing du srid mthar rab rgyas bdag sogs kun//mchog gsum thugs rje'i dpal dang ldan par mdzod//yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po 'dod 'jo'i ba//gter gyi bum pa dpag bsam ljon shing ltar//gsol pa btab pa tsam gyis bsam pa'i don//'bad med lhun gyis 'grub pa'i dge legs mdzod//gong ma shun tsi rgyal pos nyi ma nub phyogs chos srid bstan pa gcig tu gyur pa'i lung la kyi srid na mngon par mtho ba'i dpal byin ba tshe kho ring por ma thogs par gegs med du bod yul gyi sa'i cha mtsho )shor rgyal mo'i 'gram du ra wo 'byor skabasabla ma yid ma chos srung lagato rags la phe snyad ra zhal yig re shā lo sa du dpa'i a shwatā//skyabs gsum kun 'dus rdo rje drag po rtsal//dngos grub char 'bebs yi dam lha tsho gos dang //'phrin las kun sgrub chos skyongasasrung ma la//sngar bcol las kun sgrub pa'i gtang rag 'bul//myur mdzad mgon bo gur mgon zhal bzhi pa//rnam mang thos sras pu tra beg tse sogs//srung ma dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams la//phyi nang gsang ba'i kun bzang mchod sprin 'bul//dar sngon dran pa tsam gyis srid zhi'i gdung sel cing //'dod pa'i re skong yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal//'dod khams rgyal mo dpal ldan re ma tir//sngar bcol 'phrin las grub pa'i gtang rag 'bul//slar yang bstan 'gro'i phan bde rab 'phel zhing//'khor lo'i bdag ṣ+ka zung 'jug zhabs pad brtan//rig 'jin bdag gi chos dang mas pa'i don//'bad med lhun gyis 'grub par mdzad du gsol/8/༷'a dpal ldan sngags kyi srung ma chen mo sogs//

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 9)bod yul skyong dang zab gter chos srung du//pad+mā ka ra'i spyan sngar khas blangs pa//dam can rgya mtshor dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul//dar dkar dri za'i rgyal po rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal//bod khams skyong mdzad bstan ma bcu gnyis la//phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul byed na//sngar bcol legs grub (39na skor yang 'phrin las mdzod//dar nag drag rtsal mthu stobs ldan pa'i rā hu la//bdud mgon zhing skyong seng ge'i gdong can sogs//pha mes brgyud pa'i bstan srung tsho gis rnams la//mthun pa'i dam rdzas rnams kyi mchod pa 'bul//sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po sku lnga pa//las mkhan btsan rgod gnod sbyin tsi dmar ba//snang srid lha srin sde brgyad tsho gis rnams la//mthun pa'i dam rdzas rgya mtshos thugs dam skong //chu sbrul 'dar pa chos mdzad ngag dbang phun tshogs lhun grub kyis 'dar grang mo che'i mtshar 'a chos kyi rgyal po'i dngul gdung la 'bul rgyu'i snya dar la byang dgos tshul ltar bris pa slong gzha pa rgyas ༅ skal r+sāng //e 〈zung du 'jug pa sgyu dra'i gar//dpal ldan sku bzhi'i rol par yongs shar ba//khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po rdo rje 'chang //gdan gsum tshang ba'i ded dpon mtshar pa rje//brjod bral gnyug ma sems kyi mkha' dbyings su//bde chen lang tsho'i 'ja' lus rnam bkra ba//'gyur med mtshan dpe'i mdangs 'dzin rdo rje'i skur//rdos bcas bem por snang ba byis pa'i
