blo//'on kyang skal bzang 'gro ba'i bsod namasakyi//zhing rdul las bskrun yid bzhin nor bu'i gdung //cha shas gsil bur legs bzhugs mchode sdong cher//'jam mnyen lha rdzas snyan shal phul ba'i dges//lus can phan bde'i gzhin gyur rgyal ba'i bstan//snying po nges gsang rdo rje theg pa'i chos//yang snying kha'u brag rdzong bzhed pa'i srol//zab mo slob bshad phyogs kun rgyas gyur cig/gang gi thugs rje'i 'od kyis legs bzhu pa'i//bdag cag tshe dpal stobs lhor chu bo'i rgyun//nam yang chad med don gnyis rgya mtsho cher//'bab pa'i skal ba bzang por spyod gyur cig/chu sbrul wong dbon blo bzang rab brtan gyis dga' /na dngul gdung lhu po che/mgon kha dang sa bdang /mal dro

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)gzims khang shar gyi phyag bzhi par 'bul rgyu'i snyan dar la kha byang dgos tshul byung ba ltar bris pa dge legs rang stsol/ /dngul gdung blo chen 'jam dbyangs gzhen nu ngur smrig gi /rnam rol skal bzang gdul bya'i gnyen gcig pu/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i snyan grags sa gsum na/ /yongs khyab rgyal ba kun dngos btsong kha pa/ /gang gis zung 'jug bde chen ye shes sku/ /chos kyi dbyings las nam yang g.yo med kyang / /rags pa'i gzugs kyi sku gdung yid bzhin nor/ /'di ko bod 'bangs bsod nams zhing mchog tu/ /bzhugs gnas rin chen las grub thugs kyi rten/ /ngo mtshar bkod mdzes rin chen phra tshomasacan/ /mthong thos dran reg rnam par rab grol bar/ /lha rdzas gos zung phul ba'i dge tsho gos kyis/ /kun mkhyen 'jam dpal snying po'i bstan pa mchog /srid mtha'i bar du 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang / /bdag sogs gang bsams don rnams ma lus pa/ /'bad med lhun gyis 'grub pa'i dge legs stsol/ /mgon go kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i bstan pa srung ba la/ /'jam dpal dpa' bo rab (40nasgo grosagashin rje gshed/ /dngos grub char 'bebs myur mdzad mgon po dang / /las kyi gshin rjes 'phrin las ma lus sgrubs/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i bstan srung phyir/ /dus dgra'i dbang po he ru ka /dus 'dir phyag bzhi'i mgon sprul bas/ /dus kun g.yel med grogs mdzod cig /'o lho po pa gdabang chos dpal gyi myur mdzad mgon po'i mil drog rims khang shar sa dar kha yig dgos tshur ltar bri pa ba4 'phel nor mgo /bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po yid bzhin nor/ /dpal ldan phyag drug ye shesamagon po la/ /'jam mnyen lha rdzas snyan shal dam pa 'bul/ /med byung 'dod pa'i re ba skong du gsol/ /chu sgrul sa skyong bya rgyal po bkra shis kyis pho brang yang rtse'i ga 'a khang du 'bul rgyu'i snyan dar kha byang dgos tshul ltar brisapa lho phyogs nor 'dzin mdzes pa'i dpag bsas ljon pa/ /mas stobs drag rtsal gnam lcags thog mda' yis/ /dgra bgegs brag ri thal bar rlog mdzad pa/ /sde brgyad dregs pa'i dmag dpon rā hu la/ /pha mesabargyud kyi srung ma gnyan po'i drung / /'chi med bu mo'i lag pad gyis bskrun pa'i / /zla ba bzhun ma thags su legs grubs dar/ /ngo mtshar snang bas ri dwags gzugs bkra ba'i/ /'jam mnyen lha rdzas reg — 186

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag hā gas bam gsum pa/ tanabya 'di phul bas/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa de 'dzin skyes bu dang / /lus can kun gyi phan bde'i legasatshogs rgyas/ /'khrug rtsod nad rims dus min 'chi ba sogs/ /mi mthun bar chad (40ba〉khil lasargyal bar mdzod/ /khyad par lho phyogs nor 'dzin yangs pa'i gzhir/ /mnga' 'bangs chos bzhin skyong mdzad mi'i dbang po/ /bya nag gdung gi btsun pa'i chab srid dang / /mnga' thang yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel bar mdzod/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lhun po'i rtser/ /rnam dpyod mig stong rab bkra 'chi med gtso/ /dus kun shis pa'i rdo rje rtse brgya pa/ /legs par 'dzin de'i las kun sgrub par mdzod/ /srid zhi'i dge legs phun tsho gos kun gyi mdzod/ /'dod pa'i re ba skong ba'i dpag bsam dbang / /srid pa'i rtse mor nyer dud 'bras bu yis/ /rigs chos yon to ma lus 'dzin gyur cig /brnag pa'i sems ldan dgra bo'i dpung tsho gis kyis/ /dmar chen snying khrag zhal du gsol ba dang / /gnyen srid mnga' 'bangs sde bcas ma lus pa/ /phan dang bde ba chen pos skyong bar mdzod/ /khyad par sngags 'chang yongs kyi mthu bo che/ /bya nag rin chen 'od kyi dam bzhag pa/ /dran par mdzod la bdag gi 'dod pa'i don/ /'bad med lhun gyis 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /shing rta gnam lo gsar du tshes pa'i dus 'dod pa'i rgyal mo mchod pa'i dga' ston la kha btags wo mo bde legs mar las bzhi spyi khyab dang / gzhan rnams la so so'i mdog dang mtshungs pa'i 'dod gsol bkod de phul ba dus kun dge ba'i ba po shis/ /phun wo mo bde legs tshogos mchogo gi dga' ston rgyas pa yis/ /ngo mtshar bkra shis 'khyil ba shing pho rta'i/ /gsar tshes gnam lo'i dus kyi thog ma'i nyin/ /bsam don re ba yongs skong lhag pa'i (41na)lha/ /dran pas yid kyi gdung sel mdza' na mo/ /bsten pas 'dod pa'i re stong yid bzhin nor/ /bskul bas phyogs las rnam rgyal mchog stsol pa/ /srid gsum bdag mo 'dod khams dbang phyug mar/ /nyin mtshan kun tu bde zhing skyid pa yi/ /phul byung shis pa brjod pa'i tshig gi 'phreng / /ngo mtshar thags su grub pa'i ri mo can/ /'chi med dar gyi snyan shal 'di phul bas/ /lung rtogs chos kyi nyi ma 'bar ba'i gzis/ /bstan 'gro'i snang ba kun nas rab gsal zhing / /rigs 'dzin bdag gi bsam —187

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()don ma lus pa//lhun grub yongs 'du'i dbang po lta bur mdzod//dkar/rab dkar zhi ba'i nyams ldan lha mo yis//nad gdon bgegs sogs mi mthun bar gcod kun//ma lus thogs pa med par rab zhi nas//phan dang bde ba'i dpal la sbyor bar mdzod//ser /gser gyi mdangs 'dzin rgyas pa'i lha mo yis//tshe dpal bsod nams thos bsam sgom pa sogs//lugs gnyis yon tan mtha' dag rab rgyas pa'i//phun tshogs dpal 'byor mchog la sbyor bar mdzod//dmar chags pa'i nyams ldan dbang gi lha mo yis//srid dang zhi ba'i sde bzhi'i dngos po kun//bsams pa tsam gyis dbang du legs bsdus nas//'dzad pa med pa'i 'dod rgur spyod par mdzod//mthing khro zhing rab gtum drag po'i lha mo yis//bsam ngan sbyor rtsub 'chang ba'i dgra bgegs kyi//snying khrag dron mo zhal du rab bzhes nas//mngon spyod las kyi 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod//shing rta mar dpon blo bzang mthu stobs kyis bsam yas su byang tso r+ṣa por 'phan phul ba'i kha byang dgos tshul ltar brisapa don gnyas bongasa'i waṃ shing //tshogs gnyis sa bzang yongs su dud pa las//bla med sku bzhi'i sdong bu rab rgyas pa//thub dbang dpag bsam yongs 'du'i ljon pa yis//'dod pa'i re stong don gnyis lhun 'grub shog/shing rta lo rgyud stod grwa tshang nas dbu mdzad sogs grwa pa brgyad su yod pa la ldan 'bras sbungs kyi sngag khang du mgon po phyag drug pa dang las gshin gnyis kyi bskang gso khri tshar re bsags pa'i dus nag po skor gsum la phul ba'i snyan dar kha yig zhwa ser chos go rtsa 4 shā ru 4bi//dpal rdo rje 'ag byed ldan khyab bdag zung 'jug bde ba che//gdug pa gdul phyir bcom ldan ma sto zhal//dus dgra' dbang po rdo rje 'jags byed kyis//bar gcod bdud dpung chams la dngos grub stsol//med byung mthu stobs rdo rje'i thog mda' yis//bgegs rigs brag gi ri bo thal bar rlogs//dkar phyogs rnam par rgyal pa'i ru mazhi che//srid rtser sgrongs shig 'jam dbyangs gshin rje gshed//rgyal ba kun dngos rje btsun btsong kha pa'i//bstan pa rin chen srid mthar rab rgyas shing //de 'dzin sa spyod sku tshe chaX srid rgyas//bdag sogs ba smo pa'i don kun

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 9)lhun grub mdzod//phyag drug pa gsung gi dbang phyug 'phags mchog snying rje'i lha//dran pas srid zhi'i gdung sel spyan ras gzigs//gdug pa gdul phyir khro bo'i skur stan pa//dpal ldan myur mdzad ye shes mgon po la//bkra shis ri mo thags su legs su la dar//41bskid 'ongs 'jam mnyen 'chi ba med pa'i rdzas//kun bzang mchod sprin phung por legs sprul nas//rab dkar lhag bsam dag pas nyer phul dges//bstan 'gro'i bde skyid 'dab brgya khong nas 'dzub//bdag gi 'dod don 'grub pa'i snang byed gzi//nyi 'od 'bum ltar 'bar ba'i 'od stong gis//mi mthun mun stug tsho gos kun zhi bar mdzod//las gshin mig sman lhun po bskal pa'i me dpung gis//rab 'byud srin po'i gzugs can ma he'i gdong //mthong bas dgra bgegs snying rtsa 'dar nus pa//phyogs las rnam rgyal bstan srung rgya mtsho'i gtso//gang gi mthu stobs 'phrog byed sder mo yis//bstan 'gror 'tshe ba'i 'gro skyobs gser can gyi//mi bsrun bsam sbyor sto ba yongs phral nas//phan bde'i dga' ston rgyas pa'i cho ga mdzod//khyad par bdag gi bsam don yid bzhin nor//'phrin las rnam bzhi'i rgyal mtshan rtser bkod nas//'dod pa'i re skong dpag bsam yongs 'du'i dbang //lhun grub kun tu dga' ba'i dpal stsol cig/shing rta gnas chud lcog tu gsol mchod brgya tshar btsugs bas phul ba'i snyan dar kha yig gdeng can gtsugs na mdzes pa'i si wo//gang zhig bsten pas 'dod pa'i re ba kun//'bad med stsol la yid bzhin dbang gi nor//bstan srung sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen bo la//dngos bshams ting 'dzin las byung mchod tshogs kyis//dgyes pa skyed kyi rig 'dzin 42na thad ga cag gi/zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po'i 'phrin las kun//bsam pa ji bzhin lhun gyis 'grub pa la//klu dbang gtsug gi rin chen lta bur mdzod//shing rta srung ma rang bsto gyi pa'i sa gan rgyal lhun grub dga' ba'i tshal du dpal ldan 'dod khams dbang phyug ma'i bskang nga rdzi 'ganyas bas bas phul phe sa dar dzi 5 yig yi lis brgyarang bye//dung dung 'bral ba med par rtag bzhugs nas/ /'jigs 'jigs nag po'i dpuX tshogs pha mthar skrod/ /yang yang mchog mthun

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()dngos grub char ltar 'bebs//lhub lhub bsam pa'i re skong lhag pa'i lha//lha mchog dpal ldan 'dod pa khams kyi bdag/bdag sogs bsten cing rab bsgrubs srung ma'i mchog/mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus kun//kun nas stsol mdzad byed po ri ma tis//rgyal ba kun dngos kun mkhyen btsong kha pa'i//bshad sgrub bstan dang bstan 'dzin dge 'dun sde//'gro ba'i bde skyid bde legs phun sum tshogs//bdag gi don gnyis don rnams 'grub par mdzod//shing rta pho brang gong ri dkar por gong dkar rdo rje gdan grwa pa sum cu skor gyis phur mgon las mkhan dang bcas pa 'i bskang gso stong rtsa bsags dus phul ba'i snyan dar zhal yig zung 'jug dag pa'i lha zhal//phyi gur mgon rol dregs pa'i sde dpon srin po'i gzugs//rdo rje'i lus la gnas pa nang gi mgon//gsal stong zung 'jug rang sems gsang ba'i lha//khrag 'thung gur gyi mgon po lcam dral gyis//rgyal ba'i bstan dang lus can bde skyid 43na skral//rig 'dzin bdag la nyer 'tshe'i dgra bgegs thul//zhi rgyas dbang gi 'phrin las ma lus pa//'bad med lhun gyis 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//las putra rnams kun sgrub mon pa pho mo'i tshogs//rtsa brgyud bla ma'i dam tshig rab dgongs nas//'phrin las thogs pa med par sgrub pa dang //mi zad mthu stobs nus pa'i dpung tshogs bskyed//shang rta gong dkar du dkon gnyer dpon dge steng pas gtsos pa'i dge gnyer nang ba rnams kyis mgon po zhal gyi bskang ba stong rtsa mugs du phul phe snya dar kha yig bas ro r+yā 7 pho bas sgra/rtsa zhal mi ro chem chem zos pas kyang //ma tshim bam ro'i steng du bro rdung ba'i//stobs 'phrog dbang po lha chen gdong bzhi pas//bcol ba'i 'phrin las ma lus grub par mdzod//shing rta ra sa 'phrul snang du gser chab mchod pa 'phar ma phul skabs rdzo bo shākya mu ni'i snyan shal kha yig nges legs rin chen them snas//mthong bas phan bder sbyor ba mtshan dpe'i sku//thos pas srid zhi'i gdung sel tshangs pa'i gsung //dran pas thar par 'dren nus kun mkhyen thugs//gsang gsum sgyu 'phrul dra ba bsdomasapa'i dngos//nyi ma'i brgyud zhabrungs bdud rtsi'i rdo 0ma rtag/las nyon nad kun ma lus drungs phyung

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ tananas/ /bla med ye shes rin chen them skas la/ /'gro rnams 'dren pa'i dga' ston stsol bar shog /shing rta mchod dpon blo bzang mthu stobs dang / dbu mdzad blo bzang yon to gnyis kyis rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legasabashad gling pa'i 'du khang gi gnam rgyan yongs rdzogs(43ba〉zos pa'i kha yig legs byas 'khyil ba'i chu gter/ rnam par rgyal ba phun tsho gos phan bde'i gzhi/ /nges gsang theg mchog legs bshad mtshor 'khyil ba/ /rig sngags 'chang ba'i gling gi kun ra ru / /gos bzang las grub gnam rgyan bzhi phul dges/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin dge 'dun sde rnams rgyas/ /bdag sogs nad gdon bar chad kun zhi zhing / /bla med rnam mkhyen ye shes mchogo thob nas/ /rang gzhan don gnyis ma lus khrub gyur cig / khyad par rdo rje'i slob dpon zhabs brtan cing / /gsang sngags theg pa chen po'i 'dus sde 'di/ /nyi zla ji srid gnas pa de srid du/ /yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel zhing rgyas gyur cig /shing lug gnam lo gsar tshes kyis dus dpal ldan re ma ti mchod pa'i dar tshon sna lnga'i snyan dar kha yig kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar/ /ljang khu/ shrī ma ji ldi da ma ṅgā to ni shwa re ṇa ma ma sa ba ṅgā'i rba ni rwa ston kurba skyi /shel dkar gser zhun bad rag be+eḍūr+ya'i/ /mdangs 'dzin sna tsho gos las grub lhag pa'i lha/ /srid gsum bdag mo 'dod khams dbang phyug mas/ /dus kun dge ba'i dngos grub char du phob/ /bkra shis 'byung ba lnga ldan shing mo lug /med byung gnam lo gsar du legs tshes pa/ /kun tu dga' ba'i dus ston 'di nyid nas/ /yongs bzung bsam don ma lus lhun grub mdzod/ /bstan 'gro'i legs tshogs kun nas rab 'phel zhing / khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon rnams zhabs pad brtan/ /bsil ldan (44na〉(ngas 'dir nad rims zhabrug rtsod zhi/ /bdag gi chos mthun 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /dkar po/ ma ma sa rba ro ga gra ga shi rnya ku rba n+tu / /byin rlabs bum bzang las 'ongasabadud rtsi'i rgyun/ /nam yang chad pa med pas bdag sogs kyi/ /nad gdon bar chad dri ma kun bkrus te/ /bde skyid dpal la spyod pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /ser po/ ma ma sa rba yu rbu༄pu3 ku rba — /tshe dpal nyi ma stong du 'bar pa'i gzis/ /rgyas pa' las kun lhun grub 'od snang gis/ /chos srid —191 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)'dod pa'i don rnams dbyar mtsho ltar/ /'phel bar mdzod cig srid pa gsum gyi bdag /dmar po/ dhame bha wa sa rba ) ya wa ku rba / / /thugs rje'i 'od zer rnon po'i lcags kyu yis/ /thosabasam sgom dang srid kyi 'byor pa kun/ /khab len rdo dang lcags kyi snang tshul ltar/ /thogs pa med par dbang du bsdu bar mdzod/ /sngon po/ ma ma sa rba rog gra ha sha /bi sna 0 ta / ku rba n+tu / /dgra bgegs la khros kha gdangs mche gtsigs ma/ /mthu stobs skyed la rnon po'i mtshon cha yis/ /gnod byed tsho gos kyi srog rtsa dmar po chod/ /snying khrag 'thung la drag po'i las kun sgrubs/ /shing lug cho 'phrul mar pa'i dus jo bo rin po che/ rang byon lnga ldan/ byams pa chos 'khor/rgyalas btsong kha pa rnams lakhabatags dang / dung skyong rgyal mor dar tshon sna lnga phul ba'i snyan dar kha yig 'gro kun ngal gso'i steg bu/ /sku jo bo rin po che gsum mi zad dpal gyi be'u yi/ /ngo mtshar ri mo snying khar (44ba)legs bkra ba/ /sngon med 'jug pa bcu pa zas gtsang sras/ /ma 'dris 'gro ba kun gyi gnyen gcig pu/ /kun la byams brtses ma par gzigs pa'i spyan/ /'khor ba'i pha mtha' rdzogs min nyer rtsa'i dkyus/ /ma dag brgyud lnga'i 'gro ba zad min bar/ /chos rnams gsal ba'i me long 'di ko dngas/ /ma smad thugs rje'i lho phyogs dri bzhen gyis/ /srid pa'i tsha gdung rab 'joms cho ga mkhan/ /phan dang bde ba'i reg bya yongs bsil ba/ /lus can kun gyi ngal gso'i stegs su mtshar/ /gser mngal can gyis gdong bzhi legs sprul nas/ /bskal par brjod kyang rdzogs min yon tan gyi/ /phung po lcid kyis gser ldan rngul byed pa/ /gang des 'gro rnams rtag tu dge bar mdzod/ /thugs rje ོ po khro chags zhi ba'i nyams can snying rje'i lha//'dzum ldan zhal las 'ongs pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /phan bde'i 'chi med ro brgya'i dpal stsol ba'i/ /dga' ston mchog des ring du skyong bar mdzod/ /rab dkar mche ba gtsigs pa'i sprin gseng nas/ /mthu stobs mi zad rdo rje'i thog mda' yis/ /nag phyogs bar gcod rtsom pa bdud sde'i dpung / /thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du rlag par mdzod/ /byam yo rjes brtse'i mdangs 'od mtshams sprin mchu sgros kyi/ /'dzum zhal stegs kyi sgo las nyer 'phags pa/ /mi brtan 'phel dang 'grib 'gyur skyon bral bar/ /—192 tsho

sku gsung thug rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 9)zhal bzhes dam bca'i nyi 'od gsal bar mdzod/ /rje bla mo blo chen tshangs(45na bo bang bde 'gyung khyab 'jug sogs/ /kun gyi gtsug na zhabs sen ngal gso ba/ /bskal bzang 'gro kun gnyen gyur grags pa'i dpal/ /'jam mgon btsong kha pa yis dge legs stsole/ /dpal lha mor dar dkar po chosabazhin sgrub la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs/ /nad gdon dgra dpung mun pa'i smag rum rnams/ /dung skyong rgyal mo'i thugs rje'i nyi 'od kyis/ /mngon par rab zhi phan bde'i snang ba stsol/ /ser po dpag bsam ljon pa'i lang tsho rgyas pa'i 'bras/ /tshe dpal bsod nams khur gyis nyer dud pas/ /phun tsho gos 'dod don re stong yid bzhin nor/ /rgyas pa'i 'phrin las lhun gyisahrūb par mdzod/ /dmar po srid dang zhi ba'i dge legs ma lus pa/ /'bad med lag rtser stsol ba dbang gi rgyal/ /khamasagasum brtan pa rab 'phrog kun dga'i dpyid/ /lhag pa'i lha kye 'gugs pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /nag po mi bsrun log par 'khru ba'i mthu byed dang / /dzi brgyad 'byung po'i gdon dang bgegs la sogs/ /bar du gcod byed gzugs can gzugs med kun/ /thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du rlag par mdzod/ /ljang khu thub pa'i bstan pa srid mtha'i bar du rgyas/ /khyab bdag bla ma dam pa'i zhabs pad brtan/ /'gro ba spyi dang khyad par gangs can gyi/ /lus can ma lus phan bder sbyor ba mdzod/ /shing lug smon lam gtor rgyag dus chos rgyal chen po khog zhugs la 'phrin las bcol pa'i (45bskon dar kha yig bsod nam zla ba yar r+yā/ /khro chags ni dang rgyas pa'i rnam 'gyur can/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag las la thogs med pa/ /bstan srung sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po yis/ /rig 'dzin bdag gis bcol pa'i las kun sgrubs/ /gnod byed dgra dang bgegs rnams thal bar rlogs/ /chos bzhin sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen tshang ba dang / /bstan dang bstan 'dzin skye rgu'i bde skyed 'phel/ /legs tshogs yon tan ma lus lhun grub mdzod/ /gangs can ljong 'dir mi nad phyug nad dang / /'thab rtsod mi mthun nyes tshogis kun zhi zhing / /bsod nams rab tu brtan pa'i mi yi rje// tshe dpal mnga' thang ma lus rgyas par mdzod/ /shing lug nag pa zla ba'i brgyad gtor gyi dus gur zhal las mkhan dang bcas par phul ba'i snyan dar zhal yig bka' rtags —193

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)rdo rjes ma' pa'i cod pan/ /mig sman dang mtshungs char sprin ltar gnag zhal/ /dmar zlum spyan gyis slog 'khyug legs nyes gzigs/ /dgra bgegs srog la rngam pa'i kha gdangs pa/ /srin po'i gzugs can dpal ldan nag po che/ /bstan srung rgya mtsho'i dbang phyug rdo rje gur/ /gnas srung mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo dud sol ma/ /mthu chen stobs 'phrog nag po gdong bzhi pa/ /brtse gdung byams ldan yum chen mkha' 'gro bzhi/ /srog gcod gnod sbyin pu tra ming sring dang / /gnod sbyin bshan pa beg rtse lcam dral sogs/ /mthu stobs rdzu tshil dpag par dka' pa yi/ /bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /(46na lda rje 'chang dbang mchog sred klu sgrub zhabs/ /mal lo gnyan dang bla chen sa skya ba/ /mtshar chen chos kyi rgyal po nas bzung ste/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar gyi dam tshig rnams/ /dran par mdzod la rigs 'dzin bdag cag gis/ /bcol ba'i zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po'i las ma lus thogs pa med par lhun grub pa'i/ /phun tshogs dge mtshan phyogs bcur rgyas par mdzod/ /me sprel lo gsar gyi tshe srid gsum dbang mo mchod pa'i dus phul ba'i dar tshon sna lnga'i snyan dar zhal yig 'dzad med gter gyi bum bzang /dkar po kai la sha yi ri bo zla ga cho zhe gyis/ /lan brgyar 'byud 'dra'i dkar 'jam mdzes sdug can/ /rgyal ba kun yum dpal gyi lha mo khyod/ /bdag snying pad+ma'i ze'u 'brur rtag bzhugs nas/ /srung ba'i rwa bar bcug dang bcas pa la/ /sngon las 'phral rkyen nad gdon bar chad kun/ /rab tu zhi ba'i 'phrin las legs sgrub par/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i mthu dpung skyed du gsol/ /ser po gser bzhun brtsegs pa'i lhun po ltar brjid cing / /nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi 'od mdangs la 'khu/ /dbang phyug yon tan brgyad la mnga' 'byor ba/ /rdo rje dbyings phyub /dpal ldan lhag pa'i ltas/ /rig 'dzin bdag dang srung bar bcug rnams kyi/ /tshe dpal stobs 'byor mnga' thang longs spyod sogs/ /chos dang srid kyi legs tshogs yon tan rnams/ /ma lus 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /bsams pa tsam gyis 'dod (46ba)pa'i re ba kun/ /legs skong yid bzhin nor dang rab mtshungs pa'i/ /lha khyod rtag tu bdag gi grogs mdzad de/ /gang bsams dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ /—194

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'a)dmar po khro chags dbang gi nyams ldan srid gsum la/ /dbang sgyur 'dod khams bdag mo khyod nyid kyi/ /med byung thugs rje'i badz+ra e ku shas/ /yid la bsams pa'i sde bzhi'i legs tshogis kun/ /in+d+ra ni la ltar sngo'i rdzing bu la/ /gnyis skyes lus dkar dbang med 'du ba dang / /pad+ma'i dri yis bung ba sdud pa ltar/ /rig 'dzin bdag gi dbang du 'gyur par mdzod/ /sngon po shugs drag dus mtha'i dri bzhon ltar 'tshub nang / /bskal pa'i me dpung rab 'bar klong dkyil dbus/ /srid gsum za byed rngam pa srin mo'i gzugs/ /dmag zor lha mo re ma ti khyod la/ /bstan 'gro'i phan bde 'joms pa spyi yi dgra /bsgral ba'i zhing gyur gzugs can gzugs med rnams/ /gtod na bla srog tshe la hab zas gyis/ /las kyis shi dang nam mkhar tshad ma 'dzugs/ /lo zlar ma 'gyang mi rabs rtsad nas cho de/ /shul tsam ma 'jog rjes med rlung la skur/ /drag po'i las sbyor myur du 'grub par mdzod/ /ljang khu zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las rnam pa bzhi/ /bsam pa ji bzhin lhun gyis grub pa la/ /'dod 'jo'i ba dang gter bum dpag bsam shing / /dbang gi rgyal po lta bur mdzad du gsol/ /(47na)shing lug hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshe bdag gshin rje rol pa'i gtor zlog gi sprul pa'i du mon 'brug pa'i blon po g.yul sar bar dmigs kyi bkar ba dgos tshul thong ba ltar zor kha bsgyur pas me sbrel gyi dbyar sos g.yul sar pa slo bur du 'jig rten pha rol du song pa'i gnas tshul byung pa'i tshe gtang rag phul pa'i snyan dar zhal yig bshan pa rnam rol/ /bstan 'dzin 'brug grags gshin rje'i dmag tshogs kyis/ /srog bcad sha khrag tshogs su legs rol pa'i/ /'phrin las thogasamed grub pa'i gtang rag tu/ /phyi nang nyer spyod sman gtor rak+ta 'bul/ /gser 'phyang gi lo hor zla lnga pa'i nyer gnyis kyi nyin srid gsum bdag mo mdos kyi mchod pa'i 'phrin las btsugs skabasasnya dar zhal yig dgyes zhal 'a zla rgyas༅dkyil 'bor/ /mchog tu dgyes pa skyed pa zhal gyi sgo/ /ston dus zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa ltar/ /bde chen chos dbyings mkha' las nyer bstan nas/ /srid gsum snang ba stsol cig re ma ti/ /gsang gsum mi nge 'phrul rdo rje'i gar/ /gzhen med nā da'i dbyar rnga thos pa'i mod/ /sems kyi rma bya dad dungs sgro sa ga gdugs/ /dga' spro'i gur khyim mdangs— 195

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)bkrag 'od du 'tsher/ /dpal ldan rdo rje dbyings phyug gsang ba'i yum/ /bde chen 'khor lo chen por rgyas 'debs ma/ /las kun bsgrub phyir dbang phyug nyer brgyad gtso/ /skabs 'gar 'dod khamasabadag mo'i mtshan gyi snyan/ /lha gcig nyer dgongs brnag pa'i sems 'chang ba/ /bgegs rigasanus stobs srog dang lhan cig par/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i snying khrag (47ba〉dun mo'i rgyun/ /nal bu'i thod par blugs nas zhal du gsol/ /de tshe gzugs can gzugs med nag po'i dpung / /sdedang bcas pa'i g.yul las rnam rgyal rtags/ /bdan dkar po srid pa'i brtser bsgrengs nas/ /lha khyod zhal bzang mthon po'i dbyings su gtod/ /srid dang zhi ba'i phun tshogs dngos po kun/ /cig car brtan pa rab 'phrog thun mtshams mdangs/ /dbang phyug yon tan grub pa'i lcags kyu des/ /nor 'dzin bu mo'i mngal khur lci bar mdzod/ /bsod nams sa srung na tshod dar babs steng / /'chi med tshe yi 'dren byed stong ldan pas/ /bde skyid 'byor pa'i dpal la bskal pa sa /gzigs mor mtshar cing spyod pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /thugs rje'i gser ri'i sbubs nas mthu stobs kyi/ /nyi ma 'bum phrag 'char ba'i 'od dpung gis/ /nad gdon nye bar 'tshe ba rgud tshogs mun/ /ming gi lhag mar gtang nas nyer zhir mdzod/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs rje'i rgya mtsho las/ /las kun sgrub la thogs med yongs 'du'i ljon/ /thub bstan tshal du 'khrungs pa'i lha khyod kyis/ /bsam pa'i re skong dbang gi rgyal por mdzod/ /zur chen khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol pad+ma 'od kyi zhing du sku'i bkod pa bsdus pa'i tshe sku gdung rin po cher phul pa'i snya dar zhal yig rdor sems4'a lus rang zhal/ /rigs kun khyab bod ga rje btsun bla ma mchog /zhid khams bye ba phrag brgyar sku'i bkod pa/ /sna tshogs bstan nas mkha' mnyam 'gro 'dren pa'i/ /bzhed (48na)pa ji bzhin lhun gyis 'grub pa dang / /mgon khyod snying dbus ze 'brur rdo rje sems/ /rang sems dag pa'i ngo bor rtag bzhugs kyang / /gangs can ljongs 'dir nges gsang rdo rje'i theg /spel phyir sprul pa'i zlos gar myur ston shog /—196

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'dazur chen 'khor lo'i mgon po gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus pa'i tshe mkha' khyab kyi 'gro ga sgrol ba'i 'phrin las ji bzhin 'grub pa'i bden tshig mchims phugasang phug gi o rgyan rin po che'i sku brnyan la phul ba'i snyan dar kha yig 'od gsal sgyu 'phrul dra ba/ /kun khyab dag pa'i dbyings nas lhun grub pa'i/ /med byung thugs rje'i snang ba 'jam klas pa/ /bgrang yas zhi khro kun 'dus pad+ma 'byung / /mi zad gsungs mchog gnas kyi rten 'brel mthus/ /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho spro bsdu'i byed pa po/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i dpal 'byor bang mdzod can/ /dag dang ma dag zhing khams rdul rnyed du/ /rnam dkar 'phrin las rab tu rgyas gyur cig /rnga yab gling dbus zangs mdog dpal ri'i rtser/ /pad+ma'i pho brang dbang gi grong khyer du/ /gnyag ban rang gi gdan khri ga la bar/ /ngo mtshar dag pa'i snang ba 'phel gyur cig /chos dbyings kun gsal ngos su rig pa'i rtsal//rang grol 'od gsal ka dag klong yangs nas/ /sgyu 'phrul mtshan dpe'i 'ja' tshon rab bkra'i mdangs//sprul pa'i 'od zer mkha' la khyab gyur cig /sa khyi gnam lo gsar tshe kyi nyin srid gsum bdag mo mchod pa'i dus kyi snyan dar zhal (48ba)yig rnam par rgyal ba'i dbyangs snya/ /rgyal bar gyur cig su sti'i dbyangs snyan pos/ khres brjod tshig gi 'phreng ba nyer spel na/ /srid gsum dbang sgyur lhag pa'i lha mo yis/ /bsam don lhun grub dpag bsam yongs 'dur mdzod/ /zla rgyas zhal gyi 'dzum 'phreng bsil zer gyis/ /nad gdon rgud tshogs mun stug rab zhi ste//bde skyid snang ba dkar pos yongs khyab pa'i/ /dga' ston mchog la spyod pa'i dpal stsol cig /tshe dang dpal 'byor stobs kyi rgya mtsho cher/ /legs byas bye ba'i chu klung kun 'dus te/ /phan bde'i rlabs 'phreng srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar/ /rab 'phyur bla nas blar 'degs 'phrin las mdzod/ khugasadrag bsod nams rta bdun gyis drangs las/ /dbang thang 'bum phrag nyin mor byed pa'i gzis/ /brtan g.yo'i chos kyi dro 'jam yongs bkug pas/ /dga' ston sos kyi lang tsho dar babs mdzod/ /mi bsrun dgra bgegs bung ba'i 'phur lding kun/ /mthu stobs byin za 'bar ba rnon pa'i lces/ /phye mar btags te srid gsum ma lus las/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /— 197

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()ri gnod sbyin beg rtse la bskang ba khri tshar gyi sgo nas sger gsol byas skabs phul ba'i snyan dar zhal yig mthu stobs nyi 'od 'bar ba//mthu stobs nyi ma'i gzi brjid 'od po ches//legs byas pad dkar bshad dang lhan cig par//srid gsum bung ba'i brtan 'phrog rgyad pa'i mun//mthar byed las rnams ma lus 'grub 49na ) par mdzod//rab khros bshan pa khyod zhal gdangs pa'i nang //brnag pa'i dgra rnams zasasu gtod byed na/sha khrag rus pa nang khrol bla tshe srog/myur du bzhes la thal ba'i rdul du rlog/sa khyi chos 'khor rgyal mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang du mchod 'bul dang mgon khang rnams su gtor gsos skang bshags byed par mchod dpon blo bzang mthu stobs kyis gtsos pa'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i grwa pa kha shas btang dus byams 'a la phul pa'i snyan dar zhal yig rnam par rgyal pa'i cod pan//byams pa chen pos bdud kyi sde dpung las//rnam par rgyal ba rin chen cod pan gyis//mdzes pa'i khyad par can gyur mi pham mgon//dngos po kun gyis btud bya'i rgyal tshab mchog/sdig to'i nad kun rab zhi sman gcig pu//pha rol phyin bcu'i chos tshul zab brling bas//'gro rnams phan dang bde ba'i sa chen por//sbyor mdzad drang srong khyod min gzhan na su//chos kun gzigs pa'i sa bon rab smin pa//tsho gis gnyis myu gu yongasasu dar babs dpyid//mtshan dpe ro brgya'i dpal du dngar ba'i 'bras//yongs 'du'i mched zla khyod kyi khur du lci//'char nub spangs pa thugs rje'i 'od po che//ris med kun la 'jug pa snang ba'i gter//lhag bsam rlung gi shing rtas nyer drangs tshe//bstan 'gro'i lha yi lam der cis mi rgyu//ut+pal mthing kha ltar mdzes spyan ras kyi//dkyus ring 'gro ba kun la rjes chags pa//g.yel med rtag tu rtse ba'i gzigs pa yis//dge dang 49bsdig chos gos gcig tu dkar//khro dang sdang ba nag po'i dri ma kun//dag pa'i tshems kyi ze'u 'bru zhal gyi sgo'i//'dab stong 'dzum ldan dbus nas nyer bstan tshe//nges legs khang bzang dam par 'gro rnams su//kwa yi srid 'khor tsha gdung yongs gzhil slad//bshad dang sgrub pa'i thub bstan gdugs dkar po//sdo bzhi'i rin cen yu bas legs btegs nas//rab mtho'i kun gaX 'gram par 'khor gyur cig/snyigs mar spyod

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ (yipa'i ma dag rnyog ma kun//drungs byed chos srid nor bu ke ta gas//rdzogs ldan dus kyi chu klung dngas pa'i ngos//bde skyid zla gzugs 'bum phrag 'char gyur cig/rgyal mthil gyi mgon khang chen mor chos skyong spyi la phul ba'i snyan dar zhal yig dbang phyug drag por khros pa'i me dpung //chos dbyings kun gsal lus phra'i mngal yangs las//ma smad snying rje'i char sprin rab sbrum pas//khro gtum drag po'i thog ser 'phro ba can//dus dgra'i dbang po 'jam dpal ma he'i zhal//khyod gsung rdo rje'i tshig gi mdud pa'i rgya//'grol min phyi nang gsang gshed las gshin gsum//skye 'gro'i srog 'phrog 'chi bdag bye ba 'khor//grangs med gnam sa'i khyon yang dog por 'god//phyag na pad+ma'i thugs rje'i rang gzugs gar//dpal ldan nag po chen po phyag drug pa//gsang yum bka' sdod bcas pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis//gtsug na zla ba khengs pa thung ngur byed//lusang na dug gis lha min nyer bcom zhing //lha rnams bde 50na ) bar ngal gso'i dpal ster ba//rnam mang thos pa'i sras zhes 'jig rten na//grags pa'i mtshan snyan gyis kyang dbul phongs sel//srid zhi'i gdung ba'i mun pa kun 'phrog pa//'jam dang rtsub 'gyur zung 'jug nyi zla'i gzugs//gang skur rab 'char 'phrin las sgyu ma mkhan//srid gsum dbang mo'i mthu stobs mkha' ltar yangs//ma rung dgra sde'i nus dpung cig car du//'phrog byed dpa' bo gtum chen bram ze'i gzugs//bka' stod bshan pa'i dbang po beg rtse can //bstan srung dam can rgya mtshor bcas pa kye//brnag pa'i sems 'chang gzugs can gzugs med dpung //nag phyogs rtsa lag g.yin 'phrul bdag po'i lus//mthu stobs chen po dbang phyug mig gi mes//phye mar 'thag byed drag po'i 'phrin las sgrubs//thugs rje'i chu gter chen po las 'ongs pa//zhi rgyas dbang gi 'phrin las zil dngar can//dus kun longs su spyod dpa'i dga' ston gyis//legs bris dbang po'i spun zlar grub mdzod cig/mgon kho wo 0rdo me 'bar ma'i snyan dar zhal yig bskal pa'i byin ma rang 'bar//drag shul stobs kyis srid gsum ma lus pa//'dar mdzad zhing skyong wo po gdong bzhi pa'i/// nga bas bskal pa'i byin za rab 'bar bas/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()'phrin las ma lus lhun gyis grub par mdzod//rgyal mthil gyi cing sgra khang gi shod kyi mgon po ko 50ba ) gtu pas ma'i snyan dar zhal yig mi'u zung drag por khros pa'i srin po//khyab bdag he ru ka dpal che//mi'u thung srin po'i gzugs 'chang ba//ma hā kā la 'khor bcasakyis//bcol pa'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod//rgyal mthil mgon kha bar gyi dpal ldan dam gzor ma'i snya dar zhal yig 'dod don yongs bo'i phros bzang //dpag bsam shing dang 'dod 'a rnga'i ba//bum bzang yid bzhin nor bu ltar//'dod pa'i re ba skong mdzad pa//dmag zor lha des 'phrin las sgrubs//rgyal lhun grub dga' ba'i tshal gyi de wī rko ṭir dpal ldan 'dod khams dbang phyug mar phul ba'i snyan dar zhal yig rdzogasaldan ldom spyo dgod pa'i dga' ston//khyab bdag he ru ka dang mnyam sbyor ba//bde chen 'khor lo chen por rgyas 'debs yum//gnyis med gnyis su snang ba'i zlos gar can//srid gsum dbang sgyur dpal ldan re ma ti//dbang po'i gzhu yis rab dkris kai la sha'i//ri bo'i khengs pa bstol nus mdzes sdug can//yid 'ong mig gi bdud rtsir zla med pa//dung skyong ma sogs rnam 'gyur ci yang ston//bsod nams nyi ma stong du 'bar ba'i gzi//yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po 'dod 'jo mkhan//'dzam bu'i gser sbyangs las grub lhun po yi//spun zlas gaṅgā'i rdul grangs bag la zha//'gro la snying rjes chags pa'i 'od mdangs dang //brtan g.yo'i snying gi bcud khrag gis myos pa//lhan cig rgod ma kha ltar dmar ba'i mdog/grangs med spros tshe srid gsum 'dar zhing 'dud//dus mtha'i me rlung 'dres mar 'tshub pa'i 51na rko bus//mig sman mdog can rab khros srin mo'i gzugs//rkyang ser dre'u'i steng na phyed skyil can//gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo dmag zor lha//nad gdon sgrib gnyis 'jil pa'i sman gcig pu//rab dkar 'phrin las gser mdog rnam par rgyal//'di phyi'i bde skyid srog 'tsho'i cho ga mkhan//lhun gyis grub pa'i nus dpung skyed du gsol//bskal par 'gran pa'i tshe dang bsod nams kyi//phung pos kun bzod ngal pa'i rngul chu'i rgyun//dbang thang rgya mtshor babs kyang dog min pa'i//legs tshoXbla nas blar 'degs 'phyur bar mdzod//'gro

sku gsung thug rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ slonaba'i yid 'gugs dmar 'od lcags kyu'i rtse/ /sems bral 'dzin mar btab kyang zung rngu yis/ /'dar par nus phyir brtan g.yo'i chos rnams kun/ /khab len rdo yis lcags kyi phye ltar drongs/ /zas su nyer gto dgra dang bgegs kyi dpung / /bdun brgyud tshun gyi bla tshe stobs 'byor dang / /mthu dang nus pa nyams shing brlag pa la/ /dug sprul sgong khyer rjes su bsnyeg ltar mdzod/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i dga' ston dpal ldan zhing / /chos srid zung du nyer 'jug pho brang cher/ /rdzogs ldan dus kyi sa dbang ji bzhin du/ /bsams pa tsam gyis don kun 'grub par mdzod/ /de wī ko zhi'i lha mo dmag zor ma'i gser sku'i snyan dar zhal yig 'chi med bdud rtsi'i dpal ster/ /'chi med bu mo bdud rtsi'i 'byung gnas can/ /rgud pa'i gdung pa rab 'phrog yongs (51ba〉du'i dbang / /'dod don re skong khams gsum dbang sdud pa/ /dbyings phyug lhag pa'i lha des bsam don sgrubs/ /de rdzigoṭir ba'i ma lhoganyis kyi snyan dar zhal yig gnas gsum mkha' 'gro 'bod pa'i 'phyar dar/ /dang por g.yung drung gshen gyis mchode pa'i lha/ /bar du rigs 'dzin pad+ma'i gter skyong ma/ /da lta dgon gnas yongs kyi srung ma che/ /bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis dang / /khyad par dpal ldan rdo rje g.yu sgron ma/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gror bcas pa'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /gangs can bod kyi bde skyid spel ba dang / /rig 'dzin bdag gis bcol ba'i las kun sgrubs/ /dga' tshal gyi bsil ba tshal du ye shes mgon po gur la phul pa'i snyan dar zhal yig dkar po'i ba dan 'phyar pa'i gto snya/ /mkha' ltar dag pa chos kyi dbyings nyid las/ /ye shes 'od lnga'i 'ja' tshon yongs shar bar/ zhom snang sgyu dra'i rol gar nag po che/ /bstan srung rgya mtsho'i sde dpon rdo rje gur/ /dmar zlumaspyan gyis legs nyes kun gzigs nas/ /bdud sde'i snying khrag shub kyis 'thung ba dang / /lhan cig dgra srog bcad kyang ma tshim par/ /bam chen 'dam ltar brdzis pa'i stang stabs can / /lha mchog dkar pa'i ba dan mkha' la phyor/ /nag po bdud kyi ru mtshon sal stol/ /ngan pa'i glags lta gzugasacan gzugs med sgrol/ /gnas skabs mthar thug don gnyis lhun grub mdzod/ /—201—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()bsil pa tshal du 52na〉gon po zhal yig bzhi par phul pa'i snyan dar zhal yig dam tshig rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs//'gro la tshad med bzhi ldan 'dzum pa'i zhal//bdud bzhi'i snang ngor rab khros srin po'i gdong //chem chem mi ro gsol yang tshim min par//khams gsum cig car za la rings pa bzhin//nges pa'i don du dpal ldan he ru ka/gdug pa gdul phyir zhing skyong stobs 'phrog dbang //rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i bran du bram ze'i gzugs//gcig las du mar sprul pa'i gar mkhan can//rdo rje 'chang dang klu sgrub lo chen gnyan//sa chen yab sras bdag chen rdo rje 'chang //kun spangs chos rje mtshar chen mkhyen brtse'i dbang //brgyud pa'i bla ma rim par byon rnams dang //khyad par rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam gnyis kyis//sngags 'chang bdag gi grogs dang bran tshul du//rdo rje'i bka' nan drag pos gnyer gtad pa'i//dam tshig dgongs la bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrubs//bsil pa tshal gyi bu ḍā snyan dar zhal yig bram ze'i dmod pa grub pa'i bshan pa/rab khros bram ze'i dmod pa grub pa'i 'bras/skye rgu'i bla srog tshe la dbang sgyur ba//mon pa pu tra ming sring bcas pa rnams//rtsa brgyud bla ma'i dam tshig nyer dgongs la//mi mthun log par 'khu ba dgra sde'i dpung //steng 'og phyogs mtshams bar gsum gar gnas kyang //myur du khug la snying khrag zhal du gsol//'phrin las ma lus thogs med 'grub par mdzod//dga' tshal gyi chos 'byung steng gi mgon khang du chos skyong spyi la phul pa'i snyan dar zhal yig dgyes 'dzu pa bco lnga'i zla khi//dam can sprin ltar 'du ba'i gnas mchog 'dir//phyi nang gsang gsum kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin//dngos bshams yid kyis sprul te 'bul lags na//dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal bco lnga'i zla ltar ston//thub dbang bstan dang dge 'dun ༈skyong wo //'gro ba'i bde skyid spel mdzad srung ma spyi//khyad par rigs dang brgyud la 'go ba'i lha//kun gyis rigs 'dzin bdag gi bsam don sgrubs//chos yang steng du tsa ri ṣ+ka skyong bdud mgon seng gdong gi snya dar zhal yig gdong lnga'i dbang pho gad rgyangs//char sprin 'brugs pa'i dbus nas gnam lcags ze//02/'phro zhin glogs lkog dbyar kyi rnga bo che//ldir

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ thona'adra'i bdud mgon nag po mthu stobs dbang / /seng ge'i gdong can stong gsum rab bskor la/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs kyi dpung / /ma lus gnam sa gdangs 'dra'i zhal nang du/ /bzhes te mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las kyis/ /mi mthun phyogs kun ming gi lhag mar mdzod/ /dga' tshal po ta la'i shod kyi mgon khang rnams las gnod sbyin beg rtse lcam sring la phul ba'i snyan dar zhal yig thogs med 'phrin las snang pa'i rgyal rnga/ /bstan pa'i mel tshe dus kun g.yel med du/ /sgrub pa'i 'phrin las g.yar dam 'khur lci ba/ /dbang drag rdzu snyul thogs pa (53na)med mnga'i lha/ /gnod sbyin bshan pa beg rtse lcam dral gyis/ /dgon gnas dge 'dun srid sdoganyer gtad rnams/ /dus drug g.yel med bsrung zhing skyob pa dang / /yid la brnag pa'i dgra dang bgegs rnams kun/ /tshar chod drag po'i 'phrin las myur du sgrubs/ /'chi med tshe dang 'dzad med stobs lhor nor/ /gto gyi bde ba nges par legs pa'i chos/ /bsod nams phung po dbyar mtsho ltar 'phyur ba'i/ /bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sar snyegs mdzod/ /yum rig pa'i lha mo'i snyan dar zhal yig ma tsho gis dbang du sdud pa'i gar mkhan/ /rig pa'i lha mo mthu stobs nusartsal bdag /gar gyi dbang mo ma mo'i sdod pon gyis/ /skad cig tsam gyis stong gsum rab bskor nas//dbang drag 'phrin las ma lus sgrub par mdzod/ /po ta la'i shod kyi khyab 'jug rwa hu la'i snyan dar zhal yig gnam lcags thog ser/ /gnam lcags rdo rje'i thog gi gzegs ma dang / /mthong reg dug rlangs na bun ltar 'tshub pas/ /skye 'gro'i dbugs len gza' bdud rā hu la/ /snang srid dregs pa yongs kyi dmag dpon che/ /rang gzhan srung ma zha cig pa'i g.yul ngo na/ /zhe sdang drag pos bskyod pa glog dmar lces/ /rab brdar mche ba rnon po'i dpal gyi rtser/ /dgra bgegs dpung rnams mi rtag lam du 'god/ /mngon gyur 'tshe ba'i mi dang mi ma yin/ /mi zad rnon po'i mtshon gyis phye mar gtubs/ /lkog gyur bag la zha ba'i ma rungs pa/ /stong (53ba)phrag spyan gyis gzigs la rtsad nas chod/ /—203

rgyal dbang lnga pa pag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)po ta lo shod kyi rtsa lo sku lnga'i snyad ra dzi po yig mas stobs byin ma'i phung po/ /gnyis 'thung gdong lnga pa dang drel rta sogs/ /sna tsho gis bzhene pa stong gsum skad cig la/ /bskor nas thogs med 'phrin las sgrub mdzad pa/ /sprul pa'i chos rgyal mched lnga blon por bcas/ /khyad par skye 'gro kun gyi tshe srog la/ /dbang sgyur gnod sbyin chen po tsi dmar ba/ /mi bzad gtum drag rab 'bar dbang phyug che/ /dregs pa'i dmag dpung bcas pa dgongs shig kye/ /nag po'i rtsa lag bsam sbyor brtsegs pa'i shing / /mthu stobs byin za'i phung pos rab bsregs nas/ /legs byas snang ba dkar po'i dga' ston la/ /spyod pa'i 'phrin las ma lus sgrub par mdzod/ /go la shod kyi gnod sbyin gomar phe snyad ra lha blag sdeb yo kha lo sgyur pho byed po/ khon tshe li yi yul nas smon lam mthus/ /skye 'gro'i srog bdud gnod sbyin rigs skyes nas/ /lha srin dregs pa'i sde dpon cher gyur pa/ /bka' sdod bshan pa tsi'u dmar po khyod/ /snang srid zil gnon rigs 'dzin pad+ma'i bka'//nye bar dgongs la zhi rgyas dbang drag gi /las rnams thams cad thogs med rab sgrub par/ /dpag bsam yongs 'du'i dbang po ltar mdzod cig /po ta la'i shod kyi rdor legs kyi snyan dar zhal yig tshon la lhun grub/ /rigs 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi/ /pho nya dge bsnyen dam tshig can/ /snying nye dam can rdo rje legs/ /'phrin (54na)las rnams bzhi sgrub par mdzod/ /po ta la'i shod kyi ga 'a gdong dmar nag gi snyan dar zhal yig srid gsum myul pa'i pho nya/ /mkha' lding dbang po'i 'phrul gyis srid pa gsum/ /myul byed gza' gdong dmar nag srog gi bdud/ /kwa ye snying la nag po'i thig le yis/ /mtshan pa'i dgra rnams sgrol la 'phrin las sgrubs/ /jo bo rgya yo4zha phe snyad ra zhal yig ༅ zhis 'dod lo/ /sngon tshe laṅka'i bdag po'i pho brang gi /sgo srung rab dkar yid kyi sems 'chang ba/ /smon lam mthu yis sbas yul dkar po'i ljongs/ /srung ba'i lha chen dge bsnyen rgyal mtshan pa/ /phun tsho gos 'dod pa 'jo ba mchod pa'i sprin/ /sgo lngar bde ba skyed 204

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzheng dang mchod jo khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ thonabyed khyad par chos//rab spel gos bu bsams pa'i don rnams kun//lhun grub yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal por mdzod//rnam 'phyang zhes pa sa khyi srid gsum bdag mo mdos kyi mchod pa'i skabs kyi snyan dar zhal yig bde skyid 'od stong 'bar pa'i dga' ston/dkar ser dmar mthing mdangs dang rnam 'gyur gyis//'phrin las don kun ma lus sgrub mdzad pa//srid gsum dbang mo gnas 'dir thogs med du//tshur spyon kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin phung bzhes//bsam skyor ga pas nyer 'tshe'i mun pa kun//mthu stobs 'thor rlung drag pos rab gtor nas//bde skyid 'od stong snang gter dga' ston la//spyod pa'i zhi rgyas dbang drag las54bsgrubs mdzod//sa phag lo gsar gyi dga' ston dus srid gsum dbang mor dar tshon sna lnga'i snyan dar phul ba'i zhal yig dpag bsam snye ma//dkar byin rlabs mtho ris chu rgyun gyis//nad don nyer 'tsho re dri ma kun//rnam par bkrus pa'i dga' ston nor//rgyal mtshan rtse mor 'god par mdzod//ser 'phrin las rnam par dar pa'i tsha drod kyis//tshe dpal gser gyi sgo nga legs smin pa'i//bsod nams mi yi 'chi med rtser son nas//chos nor 'dod dang thar pa'i gdong ldan mdzod//dmar snying gar legs byas dpal gyi be'u'i gzugs//'khyil ba'i sgyu thabs stong gi goms pa yis//brtan g.yo'i sa chen ma lus cig car du//thogs med dbang du bsdus ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//nag khro med dug gsum la 'bu'i zhe sdang gis//rab myos nyi ma 'char ga'i mig bgrad nas//dgra bgegs srid 'dir mngon sum lta ci smos//bag la zha ba rnams kyang nyer gzigs la//chu gter rlabs 'phreng dus las mi yol zhing //dug can sto 'gro sgong nga'i rjes bsnyeg ltar//drag shul las kyi dam bca' gnam lcags thog/zhing bcu'i brag ri bsnyil la g.yel med mdzod//rdzos ma chos kyi dbyings nyid nas//med byung bde ba'i nyams ldan pas//thabs dang shes rab zung 'brel ba'i//'khor lo rgyas 'debs lha mo'i gzugs//dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong ba'i tshe//dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad gtso/0/'dod khams kun gyi 55na thad ga mo mā/mnga'

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)bsgyur dpal ldan re ma ti'i/ /lha snyan ut+pal dkar po'i tshal/ /mchod bstod snar ma'i bdag po'i 'od/ /lan brgyar spros pa'i gzigs ma yis/ /rnam par phye bar rab dgongs te/ /'byung ba lnga yi gos ldan pa'i/ /nags kyi pha lam gos ser can/ /phun tsho gis dus kyi thog ma nas/ /phan dang bde ba'i dpal 'byor stsol/ /sgyur byed kyi lo dbo slar lha ldan/ zan yang / khra 'brug yum bu bla sgang rnams su gser chab snyan shal rgya mchod 'bul bar glang bu ba dgra 'dul tshe ring bto skabs jo shāka yid bzhin nor bur phul ba'i snyan dar zhal yig srid zhi'i rgud pa bcom pa'i skal 'dzin ma'i lto bar legs smin pa'i/ /bla med ye shes sdong po dar babs pa/ /sku gsum gos bzang mi zad 'khor lo'i mdzod/ /nyi ma'i gnyen gyur yongs 'dra'i dbang po yi/ /gzugs sku mthong thos dran dang reg pa las/ /srid zhi'i rgud pa kun bcom phan bde'i bcud/ /longs su spyod des dbang rnon chos rjes su/ /legs 'brangs dad pa'i sgo 'phar brgya phye nas/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin/ /lhag bsam 'chi med lam rnams rab dkris te/ /gsol 'debs thugasarje bskul ba'i dbyar rnga yis/ /byin rlabs 'dzad med char 'babs dngos po'i gshes/ /de phyir pha mtha' mi mngon mar gyur 'gro /'di (55ba)dang gto gyi 'dun ma kun sgrub par/ /bde zhing nyer skyid skal pa bzang po la/ /rtse dgar spyod pa'i dga' ston stsal du gsol/ /bde legs 'od brgya'i dpal gyur nyin mor byed/ /dngos po bye ba'i lus 'dzin thub pa'i bstan/ /mngon mthong nges legasasnang ba'i gter chen pos/ /yangs pa'i 'dzin rten ma lus dge gyur cig /bsam yas kyi jo bo byang chub chen po'i snyan dar zhal yig bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i bod na/ /sa de wa kasha〉 ṇi rta ma ha ཿdha le ba ba rna ka mi me sa ba si d+dhi kra ya ts+tsha: a ha stir 〉wa ku rba( / /byams pa chen pos bdud bzhi'i g.yul ngo las/ /rnam par rgyal pa'i stobs bcu mi 'jigasabazhi'i/ /ba dan dkar po srid rtse'i khong brgal ba/ /nyi ma'i rigs gsangs rnam 'dren shākya'i gtso/ /mtshan dpe'i snang brnyan rab bkra thugs kyi mtshor/ shes bya'i gzugs kun sgrib med yongs shar —206—

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 9)gnad//zab rgyas chos kyi dbyings su g.yas 'khyil ba//gcig tu dkar ba'i bkra shis dung 'di snyan//sku gsum gsang ba rab 'byams dbang gi rgyal//bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i 'dod rgu 'jo ba'i char//gser ldan sgeg mo'i mngal du lci ba'i rdul//rgya mtsho'i rlabs kyi do zlar nyer 'grub shog/khra 'brug gi rgyal ba rigs lnga'i snyan dar zhal yig rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i dga' ston//sa mā dwa na ma ha t+pa ruṇatri su la bu rbu nā ma shra yu kā ya pra ṇa skye e ā yuḥshrī da dwa tokru ru a ha nyir〉lelha dha)naḥdus gsum dri med gzigs pa'i spyan gyi dkyus//ring por 'gro la 56na rjes brtses rab bskyangs ba'i//lnga ldan ye shes gsal pa'i ā dar+shar//thugs rje'i gzugs kun yongs 'char rnam 'dren gtso//gdul bya'i mig shes yul du gzugs kyi skur//tshar du dngar ba'i bye ba phrag brgya'i zhing //rdul snyed sangs rgyas mthu dpung kun 'dus pas//rdzogs ldan dga' ston deng 'dir 'gro la stsol//'jig rten kun du 'dus kya chad pa'i mun//thugs rje chen po'i nyi mas rab bsal te//phun tshogs bkod pa rgya mtsho'i gzugs snang kun//'dren byed yul gyi gzigs mor mtshar gyur cig/yum bu bla sgang gi snyan dar zhal yig phan bde'i dpal 'bar//su sti pradzābh+yaḥkun bzang rigs gsum sgyu dra'i thugs rje'i gar//gangs can 'gro la rjes chags sprul pa'i zhing //bye ba phrag brgya'i yon tan kun tshang ba'i//phan bde dpal gyis sa gsum khyab gyur cig/sa phag hor zla gnyis pa 'a tshes bcu gcig nas rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling par dpal ldan 'dod khams dbang phyug ma'i bskang mdos 'bum ther btsugs skabs phul ba'i snyan dar zhal yig 'chi med 'dud rtsi'i bum bzang //g.yas su 'khyil lo phun sum tsho gos pa'i dung /med byung snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs sna ba'i bcud//lusasems kun dgar spyod pa'i bde skyid kyi//rdzogs ldan sgo 'phar phye zhig dmag zor lha//ri rab gling bzhi nyi zla 'dod yon gyi//zag med mkho rgu'i gter mdzod 56ba ) mchod pa'i sprin//srid zhi'i dpal 'byor yon to kun tshang ba//sgo lnga dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bul byed na//'jigs chen brgyad sogs brtan g.yo'i nyer 'tshe'i mun//mthu stobs 0ldan byed bye ba'i gzi byin gyis//pha mthar bskrad

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)de phan dang bde ba yi/ /rab dkar snang bas kun tu khyab par mdzod/ /bskal par 'gran pa'i tshe dang bsod nams kyi/ /sa bon gser sgong thugs rje'i mngal yangs por/ /smon pa'i chos nor 'dod pa thar pa'i sde'i/ /zhal bzang khong nas dgod pa'i 'dzum ldan mdzod/ /mchog thun dngos grub rin chen 'byung ba'i gnas/ /rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las yol med rlabs phreng can/ /srid gsum bdag mo zla ba'i ma ma las/ /'dod don bdud rtsi'i bum bzang thob gyur cig /sa phag nag pa zla ba'i brgyad gtor gyi dus zhing skyong dbang por phul pa'i snyan dar zhal yig khrag las rol gar/ /mi bzad dug lnga za la nyer rngams pa'i/ /byams dang snying rje dga' ba btang snyoms zhal/ /chos kyi dbyings nasagadangs pa'i he ru ka/ dgra bgegs gshed du zhing skyong stobs 'phrog dbang / /'jigs rung dur khrod myul ba bram ze'i gzugs/ /rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi dbus gdong bzhi pa/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes nag po che/ /rang sems mgon po'i rang zhal mjal las su/ /'on te kun rdzob snang ba'i lha lam ngos/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rab 'khrigs las/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod char r+ṣa pos/ /'dod don (57ru gu'i 'bras bzang rab smin mdzod/ /sa skyong phyag mdzod bsod nams rab brtan dus kyi chos nyid du gyur pa'i tshe ra sa 'phrul snang / ra mo che/ rang byon 'phagasangamached/ bsam yas/ khra 'brug ra sgreng / dga' ldan/ rgyal tshe tog thang rnams su bla bre/ snyan shal sogs phul ba'i zhal yig thar pa'i khang bzang sngag pa'i them skas/ shwakya mu ni bsnyen srid med pa thugs rje'i dri bsung gis/ /'gro 'di'i rgud tshogs tsha gdung rab bcil ba/ /sku bzhi'i sdong bu dar babs nyi ma'i gnyen/ /sngon med tsan+dan ljon pa shākya'i rgyal/ /mtshan gyi gzis kyang 'khor mun mib(sman mdog /mthar byed phan bde'i snang ba 'od /'khor ba'i pha mtha' 'ching nus spyan gyi dkyus/ /ring pos khams dang bsam pa legs gzigs nas//kun 'jug 'phrin las phyag gis nges legs grong / /sems can mtha' dag 'khrid pa'i gtam de snyan/ /de phyir phan bde'i dbu ba dkar po yi/ /bdog pa mu tig phreng mdzes lus phra'i mngal/ /'di dang gto gyi 'dun ma'i khur chen pos/ /dud pa'i 'bras bzang yongs su smin par mdzod/ /bsod 208

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 6)nams rab brtan grangs med skye ba sa /dkar min las ngan ma dag rnyog ma kun/ /dmigs med thugs rje nor bu ke ta gas/ /rab drung gtan bde'i gzugs brnyan gsal gyur cig /ra mo che bzang po'i bskal pa 'di la grags can gyi/ /rnam (57ba)'dren gsum pas ye shes gzi chen 'od / /'bar mdzad zas gtsang sras kyi sku'i snang brnyan/ /gangs can skye rgu'i bsod nams zhing gi dpyid//kun khyab thugs rje che ldan dngar pa'i dri/ /gcig tu dad pa'i ma la ya rlung gis/ /drangs tshe nyam thag mkha' mnyam 'gro kun gyi/ /las nye zhe gos bur bcas pa'i gdung sel shog /mi dge'i lasalam bsto yi ra ba sa /sgo gsum 'bad pas bsod nams min pa'i gar/ /rab bsgyur sdig lhung mkhyen brtse nus pa'i chus/ /yongs ga gid mtho ris klung chen 'dren du gsol/ /go la g.yas dang nyi zla g.yon 'khor ba'i/ /ngang tshul 'di las cung zad mi g.yo na/ /sems can 'dren par thugs bskyed sangs rgyas kyi/ /dam bca' las 'gong nam mkha'i pad+mo bzhin/ /zhi bder gzhol nas btang snyomasalhur len na/ /nyan rang dag las rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams kyi/ /lhag pa'i 'phrin las gzhung lugasamang po mā /bshad pa gzhan blo 'brid pa'i gtam du zad/ /chos rnams mtha' dag gzigs pa'i spyan ras kyis/ /ches cher snyigs pa'i 'gro rnams rab btsa' bas/ /sngon byas dge tshogs sa bon legs smin pa/ /bde skyid 'khri shing lo 'dab 'phel bar shog /bsod nams phung po mngon par 'du byas bas/ khrims gnyis rab tu brtan pa mi yi bdag /byin rlabs mtho ris chu bos las nyen kun/ /sbyangs te thar pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser 'god shog /rang byon lnga ldan sangs rgyas rnams kyi brtse (58na)ba kun/ /phyag na pad+ma'i gzugs can du/ shar ba 'phags mchog snying rje'i lha/ / thugs rjes rgyud lnga'i 'gro rnams drongs/ /ma dag snyigs pa'i lnga brgya pa/ /khyad par swā la'i yul ljongs kyi/ /dpung la nyen lha gcig 'jig rten dbang / /khyod las gzhan pa dmigs su med/ /bstod dang gshe la chags sdang gi/ /kun rtog 'ching ba nyer bcad kyang / /snying nas mos pa lhur len rnams/ /rjes 'dzin sangs rgyas kun gyi gshis/ /rang byon lnga ldan spyan gyi mes/ /rgud pa'i mda' lnga pa bsregs nas/ /skye rgu'i las lam —209

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)ri sras mngal/ /legs byas bcud kyi khur lci mdzod/ /dus gsum bsags pa'i bsod nams kyi//nor bu'i them skas rab brtan par/ /nye bar 'dzegs te gru 'dzin gnas/ /'dab stong dbus su skye bar shog /skye bsam yas byang chub chen por rga na 'chi chu srin 'byung gnas che/ /'khor ba'i mtsho las 'gro ba rnams sgrol khur/ /rab dkar lhag bsam mthu las nyer bskrun pa/ /sangs rgyas zhes bya'i mtshan gyi pi waṃ rgyud/ /dad pa'i gzhu yis bskur las snyan 'gyur sgras/ /nges par legs pa'i chu gter chen po'i klong/ /mi zad nyam thag 'khor ba'i gzings bshig tshe/ /myang 'das klu dbang grong du bde bar 'jug /sems can kun sgrol dam bca' rdzogs min na/ /lcags g.yas rang za 'khrul ba'i skye bo rnams/ /sdug (58ba)bsngal gsum gyis mnar las dbugs dbyung ste/ /bde skyid dga' ston la sbyor zas gtsang sras/ /zla ba gcig gi snang brnyan chu yi snod/ /kun la 'char ba ji bzhin thugs rje che/ /sems can rnams la 'jug pa mtho dma' dang / /nye dang ring ba'i go skabs ga la zhig /de phyir thugs rje chen po'i lcags kyu yis/ /bsod nams dpung pas nor 'dzin skyong ba gang / /thar pa'i khang bzang dam par legs drangs te/ /rlabs chen spyod mdzad rgyal ba'i sras gyur cig /khra 'brug sangs rgyas dngos su blta la skal ngan can/ /'gro ba'i mig la 'char ba'i sgyu ma'i gar/ /rten dang brten par bcas pa'i zhing sa la/ /bsod nams myu gu dar babs 'bras bus dud/ /dge ba'i chu thigs byang chub rgya mtsho dang / /ro gcig zad mi shes pa'i gan mdzod kyis/ /srid zhi'i dbul phongs ma lus drung 'byin pa/ /bla med ye shes 'dod rgyar spyod gyur cig /'dod khro gti mug bud shing gis sbar pa'i/ /gnas ga byin za'i phung po cher 'bar ba/ /rnam smin bcos su dka' zhes yal 'dor na//rlabs chen spyod pa'i dam bca' ming du zad/ /bla med ye shes sman gyi ljon pa yis/ /srid pa'i nad brgya ma lus rab sel ba/ /stobs bcu mnga' brnyes kun gyi gnas lugs te/ /'di la mtshar du 'dzin pa byis pa'i blo/ /dag pa'i smon lam gom pa gcig gis kyang / /sku (59na sko sum sa chen rang gir byed nus pa/ /bde legs dpal gyi be'u snying kha sa /'khyil pa'i ri mo rtag tu gsal gyur cig /—210

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 9)byin rlabs ma dros yangs pa'i mtsho chen las/ /mi bdag skye bar sdebazhi nyal 'gro'i rgyun/ /legasababs ma rig dri ma nyer 'khrud pa'i/ /skal ldan shing rta'i khengs pa thung ngur shog /rwa nga jo bo g.yodapal rdo rje 'jam dpal mkhyen pa'i rdo rje'i mtshon rnon pos/ /sgrib gnyis srog rtsa bcad pas dmar ba'i khrag /mtshams sprin gzhen nu'i mdangs su shar ba'i sku/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mgon po nyer dgongs kye/ /grib ma ltar ngas dkar nag las lam gyi/ /bde sdug sgyu ma'i snang bas nyer bslus 'gro /'khrul med rang ngo 'phrod nas nges legs lam/ /ngo mtshar gtan bde'i khang bzang dam par drongs/ /gnyis 'dzin las rlung nyi ma zla ba'i 'gros/ /dhū tī sgra gcan lam du legasabacug ste/ /lnga ldan 'khor lo'i mdud grol zung 'jug pa/ /'ja' lus rdo rje'i 'od skur smin gyur cig /rnam 'dren kun gyis gsungs min theg pa'i rtse/ zhan tu rnyed dkar gsang chen nye ba'i lam/ /mtha' dang tshad du gzhal dka'i skye ba sa /mi 'bral snying gi thig ler skyong bar shog /gnas skabasasu yang jo bo yab sras kyi/ /ring lugs bka' gdams dri med bstan pa la/ /mi rje bsod nams rab tu brtan pa gang / /legs zhugs (59ba)thos bsam sgom la gzhol bar shog /dga' ldan dngul gdung rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgya mtsho che/ /brtse chen lhag bsam ri dbang gis bsrubs las/ /bslab gsum gser sbyangs dra bas legs spras can/ /sngon med bshes gnyen sa srung btsong kha pa/ /ma dag dman blor chags bral ngur smrig 'chang / /nges don yab yum zung 'jug sgyu ma'i skur/ /bzhengs gnas dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling / /sal brten pa'i 'og min gnyis pa bzhin/ /rlung sems 'od skur smin pa 'khor lo'i mgon/ /bzhin lag rnam par shar la mtshar ci re lnga brgya'i gnyen du sbyangs gzhi'i yid bzhin gdung / /legs bzhugs mchod sdong bsod nams rgya mtsho'i zhing / /kun bzang mchod tshogs sprin phung spro ba'i blo/ /phung po gcig tu dkar ba'i legs byasakyi/ /mkha' mnyam lus can phan dang bde ba la/ /rab sbyor skal pa bzang po thob par shog /med byung bkod pa'i zhing du mgon po khyod/ /bde gshegs seng ge'i nga ro'i skur bstan pa'i/ /drung du bsod —211 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()nams rab tu brtan pa gang //skyes te theg chen chos kyi tshim byed shog/rgyal ga mi wo ris med kun labyams pa'i dpung chen pos//bdud bzhi'i g.yul ngo pham mdzad mi pham mgon//rnam 'dren dam pa tog dkar rgyal tshab tu//dga' ldan chos kyi khri la legs bzhugs kyang //dge bcu rdzogs60naldan 'dzam gling brgyad khri'i tsher//byang chub shing drung mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i//theg chen chos kyisasrid 'khyams skye rgu'i srog/gtan bder 'tsho ba'i bdud rtsis tshim par shog/mgon khyod yid dam bcas pa'i gzung sngags dag/kha brtan byas dang rna bar thos tsam yang //rjes 'dzin zhal mches ri mo rdo ba'i ngos//legs bris dam pa'i ngang tshul su yis 'god//khyod zhal 'dzam bu'i gser sbyangs rdulabartsegs ri//nyi 'od 'bum gyis 'byud pas bsgrun min pa//mngon sum lta ba'i skal pa bzang po la//grangs med lus can mtha' dag spyod par shog/theg chen rigs sad dbang rnon gdul bya la//sgos pa'i dbyangs kyis chos 'khor bskor ba yi//'khor du bsod nams rab brtan rdzus skyes te//'dren mchog khyod kyi sras su 'gyur bar shog/rang byon 'phags pa mgo mgon khyod thugs rje'i skya reng gis//drangs pa'i bde skyid nyin mor byed/shar tshe snyigs mar spyod pa yi//smag rum bsangs pa chosanyid de//'dren byed gzigs pa lhung tsam gyis//srid pa'i 'khor lo cha lnga pa//bdar bar byed na rjes bzung tshe//zhi ba'i lam der cis mi bgrod//de phyir rang byung 'phags pa mched//mthong bsadon dang ldan pa yis//mkha' mnyam mar byung sems can kun//bde ba can du 'khrid par mdzod//bkod mdzes rin chen las 60bsnyib pa'i//'od dpag med mgon zhing khams su//'dab stong bzhad pa'i ze'u 'bru las//bsod nams rab brtan skye bar shog/grwa tshong 'dus kyi gos 'phan zhal yig bdud las rnam rgyal//bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal pa'i rang rtags kyi//ba dan srid pa'i rtse mor rab bsgrengs pas//lha chen dgyes pa'i zla zhal 'char bzhin du//rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las dga' ston lhun gyis grub//phun sum tshogs pa'i 'dod pa ma lus pa//'jo pa'i yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po che//dpag bsam rdongs 'du'i snye ma g.yur za ba'i//bde skyid ro

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 9)brgya'i dpal la spyod par mdzod//sa phag sto zla brgyad pa'i nang du mchod dpon blo bzang mthu stobs bsam yas su gnod sbyin chen por spyan gzigs 'bu yir bar skabs bsgo 'phag smug gi dar zhal yig bcu na lhun 'grub/ji med rab gsal spyan kyi rasasagazigs la//lha chen snyan gyi dbang po legs par gson//bcol pa'i las rnams rgya mche'i rlabasaphreng ltar//dus las yol ba med par mdzod cig kye//sngon tshe dmu dang gnod sbyin bsgos pa'i sras//sde brgyad dbang phyug pe har sde lnga po//'ba' ta hor gyi yul nas gangs can 'dir//gtsug lag srung mar rigs 'dzin pad+mas bskos//ma g.yel dam tshig gnyan po thod chings la//dgra dang bgegs kyi mthu stobs nus pa choms//bdag sogs tshe ring nad med mthun pa'i rkyen//bsam don 61na〉 lus lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod//rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag 'a snya rdo rje yon pa mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan zhing 'di'i sku'i bkod pa bsdu pa'i tshe sku gdung rin po cher gos kug gi snyan shal phul ba'i zhal yig dgyes mdzad sgyu 'phrul gar mkhan//mkha' ltar mtshan ma kun gyis yongs dag par//mi dmigs chos sku bde ba chen po'i klong //gzugs sku'i bkod pa dbyer med ro gcig pa//brjod bral gdod ma'i rang zhal ngang nyid nas//phroṃ med rnam bzhi'i lha mos bskul ba las//dgyes mdzad rdo rje zhal brgyad he ru ga'i//dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mgon por rab bzhengs te//sgyu 'phrul gar gyis bsod nams zhing spel shog/mkha' spyod gnas kyi lha mos 'og min du//gshegs par bskul yang bye ba phrag brgya'i zhing //dag dang ma dag 'gro ba 'dren pa yis//mas li spyod pa'i bawo pa yongs tsā ba shog/smin grol zab dang rgya che dam pa'i chos//legs ston rigs kun khyab bdag rdo rje 'dzin//bshes gnyen dam pa'i mgon gyis skal bzang gi/gdul bya mtha' dag rjes su 'dzin gyur cig/gdod nas dag pa'i rang gi sems nyid 'di//rdo rje'i slob dpon ngo bor yongs shes nas//sgo ma bzhi ldan snyan brgyud lam zab mos//zung la jug bde chen dpal la spyod par shog/2

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()'phyong rgyas rdzong ri ba blo bzang pad+ma bro tshal pa'i dus phan bde legs spyod gling du 61ba tshe ja'i thog 'bul rgyu'i snyan dar kha yig dgos tshul ltar bris pa zug snam grol//'dod khams bdag mo beg rtse lcam dral sogs//bstan srung dam can rgya mtshor bcas pa yis//blo gsal skal bzang pad+ma'i ming can gyi//nad gdon kun zhi tshe dpal rgyas par mdzod//sa phag lo zhang sgo zhang tshan gnyis kyis ma rung pa'i bsam sbyor brtsam pa'i sgos 'gro bkras snang pa so gos gtsang pa'i drung gzims kha yar gyis btegs nas gzar lang pa'i tshe ma' spyod kyi las sbyor bgyis pa rnams don ldan grub pa'i tshe phan bde legasabashad gling pa'i tsho gis su yi dam chos srung spyi bye brag la gtang rag phul pa'i snyan dar zhal yig g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i ru mardzo//'jam dpal dpa' bo dus kyi dgra chen por//'khor 'das phyag rgya zil gyis gnon pa'i gar//bcom ldan gshin rje'i gshed por rnam rol pa'i//tshe bdag nag po dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mgon//bka' sdod zor dang mnan pa'i rna cha can//'joms byed wo po 'char ka nag po dang //zhing dang dmar nag las kyi mtha' sdud pa//klu bdud chen po nag po ti pa tsa//khyad par lho phyogs rim pa bdun gyi 'og/gshin rje'i grong khyer lcags mkhar sgo med nas//'chi bdag las gshin pe wa sa tā che//srid gsum bla srog 'phrog pa'i pho nyar bcas//dpal ldan sngags srung thang lha 'bar ba rtsal//khyab 'jug stag zhen bdud mgon seng ge'i gdong //rdo rje legs pa mthu chen sdebazhi sogs//chosadang gter 62na gyi srung ma'i tshogs rnams la//sngar bcol grub pa'i gtang rag gnyan po dang //da 'chol 'phrin las sgrub par byed pa'i rten//dam rdzas rgyan ldan gtor ma ri ltar spungs//sman phud rak+ta rgya mtsho lta bur bskyil//dngos su bsham sti dang yid kyis sprul pa yi//kun bzang mchod sprin nam mkha'i khyon 'geng na//log 'dren bsgral bas rab dgyes 'dzul zhal gyi//ngo so zla bzhin lta bur gsal byas nas//g.yul las rnam par rgyal pa'i dga' ston du//dbang po sgo lnga tshims shing dgyes par rol//chu srin rgyal mtshan can gyi sdebaco me pa'i//rgyal rnga brdung zhing ru mtsho ni mkha' la sgrongs//ming rus bris pa'i dam nyams dgra bo rnams//bdun ba/da tso gyi tshe srog dbang thang choms//dmar r+ṣa

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag gleg bam gsum pa/ 9)snying gi khrag don hub kyis drongs//ma pha spyod drag po'i 'phrin las myur du sgrubs//ma he'i zhal can dpal ldan gshin rje gshed//bla mgon dbyer med thugs rje'i bdag nyid can//rnam mang thos srasalas kyi gshin rje gshed//bstan srung rgya mtsho'i sde dpon rdo rje gur//stobs log lha chen drag po gdong bzhi pa//bka' sdod pu tra ming sring dang bcas par//dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dga' ston gtang rag dang //slad nas drag sbyor 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i ched//phyi nang gsang gsum 62bamachod sprin rgya mtshor bcas//sa dang bar snang khyon kun rab bkang ste//dngos bshams yid kyis sprul nas 'bul byed na//zag med dgyes pa chen po'i dbyings su rol//sman raka gtor gsum mthun pa'i dam rdzas rnams//ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas rab spel nas//mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin lasabasgrubs pa dang //slar yang sgrub pa'i rten du 'bul byed na//srid gsum bdag mo 'dod khams re ma tis//bsam ga sbyor rtsub 'chang byed dgra bo rnams//bsod nams mnga' 'thang bsnubs la tshe srog chod//thal ba'i rdul du rlag pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/༈/khrag gi a lha dbang po'i me tog dang /ga chen dud pa tshil chen mar me sbar//mkhris pa'i dri chab sha rus zhal zas bshams//rkang gling rol mo dam rdzas gtor ma dang //bdud rtsi'i gas ba spyan gzigs mthun rdzas rnams//ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs nas//beg rtse lcam dral las mkhan bshan pa'i tshogs//sprul pa'i chos rgyal gnod sbyin tsi dmar bar//drag sbyor 'phrin las sgrub pa'i dga' ston dang //slar yang las sbyor 'grub pa'i rten du 'bul//phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i zhal gyi khyim//grub mchog sngags 'chang bdag la dgyes par ston//srung ma khyod la gnyer du gtad pa yi//dgra bo snga dgra 63na sgog bdar phyi dgra sems//da lta gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa rnams//ming tsam brda tsam med pa rdul du rlogs//kun ldan zhes pa lcags byi'i lo gsar dus 'dod khams bdag mor phul ba'i dar tshon sna lnga'i snyan shal gyi zhal yig las bsto a khrub//kha po mi shigs sku gsum btsan po'i go cha yis//bdud bzhi las rgyal rdo rje dbyings

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2)phyug ma//dpal ldan lha mchog dung skyong dbang mo yis//zhi ba'i las rnams thogs med lhun grub mdzod//ser po bsod nams nyin byed stong du rab 'bar gzis//bsam pa'i re skong dpag bsam yongs 'du'i ljon//'dzasbu'i gser sbyangs mdangs 'dzin lhag pa'i lhas//rgyas pa'i las rnamasathogs med lhun grub mdzod//dmar po srid zhi'i chos kun 'gugs pa'i sgyu thabs kyis//khams gsum brtan pa cig car 'phrog byed pa'i//'dod khams dbang phyug dmag zor re ma tis//dbang gi lasarnams thogs med lhun grub mdzod//nag po snga dgra'i khrag gis ches cher myos pa'i zhal//da lta'i dam nyams sha zar rings pa yis//rab gdangs khro gtum mthu stobs dpal 'bar las//drag po'i 'phrin las thogs med lhun grub mdzod//ljang khu phan dang bde ba ma lus khrung gnas che//rdo rje 'dzin pa'i lam mchog snying po'i don//nyer spyod bsam don chos bzhin lhun grub 63ba par//phun sum tshogs pa'i dga' ston rgyas par mdzod//lcags bya nag pa zla ba'i brgyad gtor gyi nyin mgon po zhal bzhi par phul ba'i snyan dar zhal yig chos kyi dbyings nas dgyesapa' tshal phu//byams dang snying rje dga' ba btang snyoms bzhi'i//dgyes zhal chos kyi dbyings nasa'adzum pa yi//gsal stong rang sems lhan skyes gdod ma'i mgon//gsang ba'i lha chen stobs 'phrog nag po che//ro rkyang dhu ti'i 'khor lo rnam bzhi'i dbus//rtsa khams rma gi rang mdangs zhing skyong sku//zag med bde ba chen po'i zlos gar gyis//zung 'jug rang zhal lta ba nang gi mgon//te segru 'dzin dur khrod ha ha dgod//dar lung kha'u la sogs gnas mang por//khro gtum srin po'i tshul dang bram ze'i gzugs//ston mdzad phyi yi mgon sto gdong bzhi pa//blo 'das brjod bral sems nyid snyag bu'i gshis//rang ngo 'phrod nas skyong ba'i sto 'byor dang //rtsam dud rgya dril rang sems dbu ma'i lam//'jug pa'i nang gsang mchod pa 'di med byung //rdo nag maṇ+ḍal g.yag lugazhwa phod nag/gri snying srog 'khor phyi nang gsang ba'i rten//gtor ma'i ri bor rak+ta'i rgya mtsho so gos//mthun pa'i rdzas kyis thugs dam skong byed na//bstan dang ba/na 'dzin slob bshad bos sde spel//'jig rten

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ tanakhams kun bde skyid dpal la dgod//bsam ga sbyor rtsub 'chang byed dgra dang bgegs//gnam lcags thog gis brag ri bsnyil ltar 64na sbra mes//klu sgrub gnyan dang rje btsun sa skya pa//khyad par mtshar chen yab sras brgyud bcas kyi//dam tshig dgongs la 'phrin las rnam pa bzhi//lhun gyis 'grub pa'i dga' ston rgyas par mdzod//lung ba'i snga phyi dang /sgos pa sto po dung thod tso gyi bskul ma sogs lan nas lcags byi'i lo ra sa phrul snang du lha rdzo gsar bzhengs bgyi pa'i du go 'bangs bde thabs la dmigs te sgrub mchode cho ga g.yi srong bar phan bde legs bshad gling pa tsho gis pa'i rdo rje slob dpon nged rang gis byas nas na las phur pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye ste rab tu gnas pa'i tshe snya shal phul ba'i nang ga gon lha kha dzin dar lha thag med rdo rje'i srog shing//mkha' khyab sangs rgyas kun gyi sgyu ma'i 'phrul//6 ba'i dngos po 'joms pa rdo rje'i srog grub pa'i ngo ma sgo mas dpe'i rang sags gar//legs sgyur bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med//bye ba phrag brgya gaṅgā'i rdul rnyed kyi//gsang gsum bkod pa'i rnam rol bstan pa las//rnam 'gyur mtshan gyi dbye ba gter gyi grangs//ma smad lhag bsam byed pos bskrun pa'i mthus//kun mkhyen gzigs pas mtha' dang tshad bzung bar/zhus min ma rgan brgyud lnga'i 'gro ba rnams//mngon par mtho dang nges par legs pa'i lam//bla med byang chub mchog gi rgyur gyur cig/khyad par gangs can ra ba dkar po yi//khor yug gcig tu gyur pa'i rgyal 4ba〉yas 'dir//dkar min 'bras bu'i ming yang mi grags par//phan bde'i myu gu g.yur du za bar shog/bshad dang sgrub ba'i bstan pa dar ho rgyas//nor 'dzin skyong ba'i mnga' thang dzo srid 'phel//rdzogs ldan dus kyi tshe dpal 'byor pa la//'gro rnams spyod pa'i skal ba bzang por shog/mas bas lha go gi snya dar zhal yig bsam pa lhun gyis grub ༅ bden gto//bde bar gshegs pa zhi khro kun bos pa'i//bdag nyid rig 'dzin bla ma he ru ka//srid pa gsum na che ba'i rig sngags kyis//brtul zhugs grub mchog dbang po pad+ma 'byung //gdul bya'i khams dang bsam pa'i me long ngos//gzugs sku'i bkod ba gcig la du ma'i gar///༷ bas ma 'dres 'char pa mas gyi sgra/grags

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)pa don ldan ji bzhin bskrun pa'i mthus/ /'gro kun 'di dang gtan du bde ldan zhing / /de'i rgyu thub dbang bstan pa rin chen dar/ /lugs gnyis khrims kyi nyi zla zung 'jug pas/ /rgud pa'i mun pa drung nas 'byin par shog /khyad par gangs can ljongs 'di'i phan bde'i nor/ /'phrog byed chom rkun 'gong po dam sri'i dpung / /phur thogs drag por khros pas rab bcom ste/ /nad mtshon mu ge'i ming yang med par shog /dpal gyi mgur nas tshangs pa'i dbyangs snyan pos/ /bod 'bangs rjes su 'dzin par zhal bzhes bka'/ /lha sras rgyal por bsam pa (65na〉skrun grub ma/ /gsungs pa'i re ba don dang ldan par shog /spyan ra gzigs lha khang gi snyan dar zhal yig bde skyid wo mo'i snang ba/ /'gro kun rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sar/ /bkod min rang nyid ma' 'tshang mi rgya zhes/ /'od mtshan stong du 'bar pa'i spyan snga sa /thugs bskyed dam bca'i khur ldan 'jig rten dbang / /mtha' klas gdul bya'i khams dang 'tsham pa'i sku/ /gting mtha' mi ma wa zhe dpag dka' chu gter spun/ /'on te cha shas tsam gyis skom pa'i nad/ /sel snyam snang brnyan 'ga' zhig bzhengs pa yis/ /ma dag 'khor ba chu gter chen po'i nang / /ma rig zhabrul pa'i dbang gis nyer 'khyams 'gro /ma lus lha mo'i them skas la 'dzegs nas/ /ma smad thar pa'i grong du 'jug gyur cig /lha gcig thun mong min pa'i gdul bya'i zhing / /swā la'i ljongs 'dir 'thab rtsod nad mug sogs/ /rab zhi bde skyid nyin mo'i snang ba yis/ /kun tu khyab pa'i dga' ston rgyas gyur cig /zas gtsang sras kyi bstan pa lung rtogs cho me/ /de 'dzin thos bsam sgom pa'i sde rnams 'phel/ /skye rgu rnams kyang dge ba bcur spyod cing / /rnam smin dkar po'i gos bus dud par shog /chos rgyal lha khang gi snyan dar zhal yig bde leg nor bu'i rgyal mtshan/ /sgrib sel kun bzang rigs gsum sgyu dra'i gar/ /gangs can rgyal po'i rnam par shar ba yis/ /thub bstan kun bzod 'degs pa'i snying stobs kyis/ /pad dkar mig gi khengs pa thung ngur byed/ /de'i phyir 'phags chen dam pa gzhan don —218

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'dadu/ /mi skyo'i lhag bsam khyogs la rab brten nas/ /chos srid zla ba lta bu'i dkar mdzes kyis/ /spur rgyal yangs pa'i sa kun byugs pa bzhin/ /slar yang thugs rje chen bo'i 'jug pa ni/ /gaṅgā'i klung ltar chad pa med pa yis/ /ma dag nyes brgya'i dri ma kun bkrus te/ /bde legs nor bu'i rgyal mtshan sgreng par mdzod/ /sems kyi glang po bag yod lcags kyu yis/ /nyer dul sgo gsum mi dge las gdams pa/ /mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug khrims kyi srol/ /sa zla'i gnya' shing rab lci brtan gyur cig /rtsod ldan dus kyi mun pa pha mthar bskrad/ /dge tsho gos zla ba'i dkyil 'khor cha shas gang / /legs byas ri dwags gzugs kyis rnam par mdzes/ /sde bzhi'i rgyu skar 'phreng ba 'khrig gyur cig /dga' ldan lha khang gi snyan dar zhal yig chos srid gdugs dkar gcig khyab/ shes rab ral gri rnon pos bdud bzhi las/ /rnam par rgyal bas sangs rgyas ma lus pa'i/ /yab tu gyur kyang gzhen nu zur phud kyi/ /lnga ldan sgyu thabs lhur len 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /blo dman gdul bya'i mngon sum spyod yul du/ /khrims ldan ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i zlos gar can/ /khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa'i/ /ngo mtshar mtshan gyi dbyangs snyan srid rtser ldir/ /mgon (thun sgo gid slob mar bcas pa'i gzugs kyi sku/ /dkar nag rgya dang hor bod skye rgu yi/ /'dren byed yul dang bsod nams zhing gyur pa/ /ma smad phreng bar spel ba'i legs byas kyis/ /dzu ti'i dri bsung 'thul ba'i gur khyim nas/ /dar zab thagasasu thags pa'i yul gru'i bar/ /gang gi 'dzad med phul byung 'phrin las kyi/ /chos srid gdugs dkar gcig gis khyab gyur cig /ji srid nyi zla'i 'od kyis gling bzhi'i mun/ /sel ba de srid mnyam med dga' ldan pa'i/ /dri med bstan pa mi 'gyur rdo rje ltar/ /rab brtan lus can kun gyis dpal gyur cig /rab gnas kyi tshe rjo shāka/ byams pa chos lor/ rang byon lnga ldan/dung skyong rgyal mo rnams la phul pa'i snyan dar zhal yig phan bde'i snang ba/ 'i kya mu ni tsho gis gnyis rlung gi shugs ldan rta bdun gyis/ /drangs pa'i bu ram shing pa nyin mor byed/ /thugs rje 'od stong 'gro blo'i 'dab brgya'i dbus/ /'jug mdzad ma 'dris mdza' bshes—219

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()rgyal ba'i tog/mgon khyod snyigs ma'i dus la ches brtse bas//lnga brgya'i ga tshe du zhing 'dir rnam sprul gar//legs bstan pad+ma lta bur rab bsngags pa//don ldan mkhyen brtse nus pas 'gro rnamasaskyongs//'di dang gto 'dun 'grub byed sdebazhi'i zhal//'dzum pa'i bde skyid gser sgong thabasashes zung //lhan cig mnyam 'jug drod kyis legs smin pas//chos srid slob ) byed po'i dbang phyug thob par shog/ga a la byams brtse'i brlan gyis lhag bsam sa bon tshogs//smin pas semasabaskyed sdong bu dar drag pa//ma pham yongs 'du'i ljon shing thugs rje'i 'bras//grangs med 'gro rnamasalongs su spyod gyur cig/sa rje mu po 'dren byed me yis nag po'i dpung bcom pas//sngon med gtsug na zla ba 'jig rten dbang //srong btsan rgyal po'i dus bzhi gangs can ljongs//'phrin las rnam bzhis rjes su won par mdzod//da45phyi ltar dri za'i bu mo yid 'ongs ma//nang du chos 'khor skyong ba'i dung skyong lha//gsang ba dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad gtso//yang gsang 'khor lo ོ por rgyasa'adebs yum//rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i dam tshig nyer dgongs la//lung rtogs bstan dang gtsug lag sde rnams skyongs//kha ba'i ljongs 'dir 'thab rtsod nad mug sogs//rgud pa kun zhi bde zhing skyid par mdzod//khyad par rig sngags 'chang ba bdag cag la//log par 'khu ba'i dgra sde'i dpung lis chas//skyabs yul mi nor dgon gnas srid sde rnams//wo mas dus kun bsrung wo skyong bar mdzod//lcags byi 'phyong rgyas sgong bzhi bang sor sman lung pa shāka gzhon gyis bas pa'i dpal mgon gning nag por gsolatshang gzang rgyas67na sko4tso pho sa dar lhas rig du yo kyi wa'i phag po//mig sman ltar gnag srin po khrosapa'i gzugs//gar dgu'i nyams ldan dgra bgegs 'dam ltar brdzi//dus mtha'i me yi gos kyisanyer klubs pa//legs ldan dbang po dpal mgon ma ning cher//sman ra kagator ma phyi nang gsang ba yi//mchod tsho gos dngos bshams yid kyis legs sprul pas//thugs dam gzha bo dbyings su skong byed na//zag med bde ba'i klong du dgyes pa/ rol//dus gsum 4sa rgyas sa dngos pad+ma

sku gsung thugs rten gsar stongs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar sha glegs bam gsum pa/ 'a'abyung //gto ston chos kyi dbang phyug la sogs pa//rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i dam rdzo nyer dgongasal//wen las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub par mdzod//lcags byi bod 'bangs bde thabs su dmigs pa'i bsam yas su gser chab brgya mchod phul ba'i dus byang chub chen po'i snyan dar zhal yig phan bde'i skya rengs dang po sogs//brtse chen lhag bsam gsher gyis sbran pa las//tshogs gnyis sa bon smin pa'i chos gzugs kyi//yongs 'du'i ljon pa dar babs thams cad ji//ma 'dris mdza' bshes zas gtsang sras po kye//'khor mun rgud pa'i smag wo stug po'i lam//ma rig gnyid las g.yur ba'i skye rgu kun//la'i nub spangs pa as rje'i nyi 'od kyis//blangs te phan bde'i skya rengs67bal4 bar mdzod//khyad par gangs༅ ljongs 'dir bstan 'gro yi//bde skyid srog gi ka ba gzhom med mā//nam yang mi gyur rdo rje'i rang bawo du//mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dpung gis grub par mdzod//lcags gyil yos nes sa su dmigaci4khral rtsa khug4brgya sku di phul༅ dus sa snang snyad ra zhal yigasdo7tsho wor khe dam ldeg/thabs shes zung du 'a lcag pa'i gru gzings kyis/khrid zhi'i chu ga kho tshelasarab brgal te/tso ma' nor bu'i rna ban gtso/lang ba//4sa rgyas zhes bya'i mas gyi dbyangasasnyan can//dri med spyan gyis skye rgu ma lus pa'i//khams dang bsam pa bag la nyal gzigs te//sna sa thabs kyis gnas skabs mthar sa ༅//phan dang bde ba'i dpal la sbyor bar mdzod//a par spur rgyal bod kyi rgyalas 'dir//nad mug 4ba rtsod nyer 'tshes zhi nas//chos nor 'dod pa thar pa'i sdebazhi la//spyod pa'i skal pa bzang por byin gyis snos//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)lcags byi bod 'bangs bde thabs su dmigs pa'i yum bu bla sgang du gser mas brgya mchod phul ba'i snyan dar zhal yig rdzogasaldan 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu sogs/ /rigs gsum sgyu dra'i thugs rjes gangs can 'dir/ /bde legs thog mar rab phye'i rten 'brel sgo/ /'grig pa ji bzhin chos srid nyi zla yi/ /'od snang (68na〉skal pa'i bar du khyab gyur cig /lcags byi mchims phu'i lha mo rig 'dzin mar phul pa'i snyan dar zhal yig 'dzum zhal bsu ba'i lcags kyu/ /mkha' khyab don dam chos sku 'gyur med las/ /snang srid zil gyis rab gnon sprul pa'i gar/ /o rgyan sangs rgyasaganyis pa'i bstan srung che/ /gangs can bod yul skyongs pa'i rigs 'dzin mar/ /rab dkar lha rdzas gos dang snyan shal dar/ /gser skyems mthun rdzas dngos bshams yid sprul nas/ /dgyes bskyed thugs dam gnyan po skong byed na/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las ma lus sgrubs/ /khyad par gangs can ra ba dkar bo yi/ /khor yug gcig tu gyur pa'i rgyal khams 'dir/ /nad mug 'thab rtsod rgyad pa kun zhi zhing / /bde skyid dga' ston dpal la spyod par mdzod/ /lcags glang lo gsar gyi dus 'dod khams dbang phyug mar phul ba'i dar tshon sna lnga'i snyan dar zhal yig 'phrin las rnam bstod ga' 'a/ /phun dkar po tsho gis sde bzhi 'dzum pa zhal gyi sgo/ /dkar mdzes mche ba'i myugu las 'khrungasapa/ /ngag dbang dbyangs kyi rgyal mo'i rgyud mang stong / /rna ba'i bcud du len pa lhag pa'i lhas/ /dung skyong ma sogs grangs med sgeg mo yi/ /gzugs su sprul te sgrib gnyis nad gdon dgra /mdor na srid zhi'i rgud pa'i mun stug kun/ /ming gi lhag mar bcas te zhi bar (64sgodzod/ /'dzam ser po bu'i gser sbyangs zhun ma'i lhun bo yis/ /nyi ma'i snang ba 'bum gyi lus bzung na/ /dper 'os srid pa gsum gyi mnga' bdag ma/ /'dir spyon kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin bzhes/ /lung rtogs yon tan tshe dang bsod nams stobs/ /'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das legs tshogos kun/ /nyer stsol bsam 'phel nor bu dbang gi rgyal/ /dgos 'dod re ba bskong ba'i char chen phob/ /dmar po khro chags dkyus ring mig gi zhags pa yis/ /sems med nor 'dzin ma yang 'dar byed na/ /srid gsum 'gro 222

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzheng dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ slonakun 'gugs par sgyu thabs kyi/ /ngal khur 'dzin la 'phya bas rgod 'dra'i lha/ /sum rtsen bdag posanyer mtshon lus can rnams/ /bsod nams gos bzang dud pa'i dngos por bcas/ /mngon 'dod gas bas cher myos zlos gar gyis/ /zur phud cod pan dpung pas rkang 'degs mdzod/ /nag po mthu stobs rdo rje rtse brgya gdengs tsam gyis/ /nag po'i sder bcas lha min mo yi mngal/ /lhung mdzad dpal ldan dmag dang zor gyi lha/ /bstan srung rgya mtsho'i dbang mo gang de yis/ /snying gi me long ngos su ngan sems kyi/ /sna tshogs ri mo'i gzugs brnyan rab bkra ba/ /dgra bgegs sde dang bcas pa'i dpung tsho gis rnams/ /lhag ma med par thal ba'i rdul du rlogs/ /ljang khu thub dbang dri med lung dang rtogs pa'i (69na)bstan/ /de 'dzin skyes bu mdo dang sngags kyi sde/ /mthun rkyen legs sbyor sbyin pa'i bdag po sogs/ /'jig rten kun gyi phan bde rab rgyas shing / /khyad par spur rgyal bod kyi rgyal khams 'dir/ /mi nad phyug nad 'thab rtsod 'khrug long sogs/ /mi 'dod dus kyi chad pa kun zhi nas/ /bde skyid dpal gyi dga' ston rgyas par mdzod/ /lcags glang nag pa zla ba'i brgyad gtor chen mo'i nyin mgon po zhal la phul ba'i snyan dar zhal yig dung dkar g.yas su sul pa'i dbyangs/ /phun tsho gos sde bzhi'i 'dod pa legs 'jo ba/ /tshad med rnam bzhi'i khro chags zhi ldan zhal/ /sna tsho gis las bzhi sgrubs la thogs med pa'i/ /zhing skyong gdong bzhi lha chen stobs log dbang / /nges pa'i don du bcom ldan he ru ka/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir 'jigs rung srin po'i tshul/ /rig 'dzin bran dang grogs su bram ze'i gzugs/ /sna tsho gos sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar mkhan khyod / /lo chen gnyan la rnal 'byor dbang mo yis/ /bka' bsgos nas bzung brgyud ldan bla ma la/ /gnang ba'i byin rlabs mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs rgyun/ /rtsa ba'i bla mas bdag la nye bar stsol/ /de'i phyir dam tshig gnyan po nyer dgongs te/ /bstan dang 'gro la 'tshe ba spyi yi dgra /sngags yong bdag la sdob sgos kyi dgra /gdon bgegs nag po'i sdodapung tshar wo (69ba)cig /chos nor 'dod dang thar pa'i dung dkar po/ /bsams don ri mo g.yas su legs 'khyil ba/ /ji bzhin 'grub pa'i sgra dbyangs srid rtse'i —223

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)bar/ /khyab pa'i ngo mtshar skal bzang stsal du gsol/ /dam nyams shad tshan rjes 'brang rnams dmar phyogs kyi zla ba ltar gyur par brten lcags glang hor zla bdun pa'i nang du pho brang po ta'i tshoms su phan bde legs bshad gling pa rnams kyis gnod sbyin beg rtse la gtang rag gzab rgyas gtang ba'i dus snyan dar phul ba'i khi yig
