dbang drag grung pa'i dga' ston/ /ljon dmar btsan po'i go bgos rab sna'i mtshon/ /gzasapa tsam gyis mi bsrun dgra sde'i dpung / /dbugs dang lhan cig lkog mar snying 'byin pa/ /gnod sbyin lcam dral bka' sdod bran 'khor gyis/ /dam nyams rjesang srid sder bcas pa rnams/ /thal bar brlag pa'i sngar bcol gtang rag dang / /me tog mda' can tshogs kun gzhom pa'i ched/ /da 'chol 'phrin las gnyan po bsgrub pa'i rten/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin gaṅgā'i rdul/ /grangs med dngos bshams yid sprul 'chi med lam/ /dog por bkod de 'bul na zhi rgyas dang / /dbang drag las kun ma lus grub par mdzod/ /lcags glang lor gor ghas glang po mkhar du tshur rgol byas skabs dus rim rnams gnad du song ba'i gtang rag gi snyan dar spyo yig dpa' pho gad rgyangs/ /chad la mi rtsi mna' zan gor gha'i dpung / /stobs nus bsod nams rlung rta kha sbub tu/ /(70na)gtod byed tshe bdag nag po bka' sdod dang / /sdo brgyad tshogs rnams gtang rag mchod pa bzhes/ /chu stag lo gsar gyi nyin srid gsum bdag mo mchod pa'i dus phul ba'i snyan dar zhal yig bde skyid snang ba'i dpal ster/ /e ma srid zhi'i rgud pa smag rum mun/ /mthar byed 'di phyi'i bde skyid snang ba'i gter/ /'chi bdag bu mo dpal ldan dung skyong mas/ /zhi ba'i 'jin las thams cad lhun grub mdzod/ /legs byas rgyal mas rtser spung yid bawo nor/ /tshe dpal stobs wor lung rtogs 'dod rgu'i char/ /yid kyi 'dod 'jo dpal ldan re ma tis/ /rgyas pa'i 'phrin las thams cad lhun grub mdzod/ /'khor 'das chos kyi brtan pa cig car du/ /phyogs nas legs tshogos 'gugs pa'i sgyu thabs mkhan/ khrid gsum bdag mo 'dod khams dbang phyug mas/ /dbang gi 'phrin las thams cad lhun grub mdzod/ /dgra bgegs 2 24

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 9)g.yul las rnam par rab rgyal nas//ru mtshon srid pa'i rtse mor bsgreng bzod pa//mas stobs dbang phyug dmag zor lha mo yis/khrag po'i 'phrin las thams cad lhun grub mdzod//chu dar gos rgya zhe dpa' bo stag gi lo//gsar tshes bgrang bya'i rin chen za ma tog/phun tsho gos sde bzhi'i dpal gyi bdud rtsi'i bcud//yongs su 'khyil ba'i skal pa bzang por mdzod//chu stan mchod dpon blo bzang mas stobs dang /dbu mdzad blo bzang yon rtan gnyis kyis bsas yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lagago rnam su dar 'a3 dang70bskokar tshes dar/gnod sbyin r+sā por khrab na phul ba'i zhal yig bsas don i grub//thugs rje'i gdugs dkar srid zhi'i grib bsil du//nye bar 'khor ba nyi ma'i gnyen gyi skur//gser sbyangs ri mo bkra ba'i bzang gos 'phan//rab dkar dang ba'i yid kyis legs phul mthus//deng nas byang chub bar gyi rgud pa'i tshogs//'og khang byang sa mu shor rab zhi blo gsal skal bzang chos nor tshe//mthu stobs yon tan legs tshogs ma lus pa//nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi byin ltar 'bar shog/thub bstan 'phel zhing de 'dzin tsho gos rnams rgyas//mkha' mnyam sems can bde skyid dpal la spyod//dge ba'i phung po zad mi shes pa'i rgyun//bdag gzhan 'gro rnams sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo//bar khang du thags bzang mnyen 'jam 'chi med gos 'phan la//lnga ldan ye shes rigs kyis rab bkra ba//phul bas deng nas kun mkhyen de srid du//bsams pa lhun gyi grub par bdag byin rlobs//steng khang dang gling phran rnams la bsod nams rgya mtsho'i zhing la mchod sprin 'phan//phul bas 'di phyi'i bde skyid lhun grub cing //bdag sogs nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam ma gyur 'gro/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa thob phyir bsngo//chos skyong la srid gsum dbang sgyur dpal ldan gnod sbyin cher//sra brtan rdo rje'i go cha khrab kyi gdan//dbang gi mdangs ldan g.yu 'brug ri mo can//phul bas 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub mdzod//chu stag brgyad gtor 'a mo snga bsnur te hor zla gnyis pa'i nyar gsum la bgyis skabs zhing skyong gdong bzhi dbang por phul ba'i snyan shal kha yig bsam pa'i re ba yongs 71na skong /22/sgrib gnyis 'bras bur bcas la zhe sdang ba'i//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)mtshams sprin zlum 'khyil mig gi lta stangs kyis/ /dgra sde'i don snying gas kyang ma tshim par bam chen 'dam ltar brdzi ba'i bro rdung mkhan/ /gnag pa'i mdog can rdo rje srin po'i sku/ /chem chem mi ro za ba'i mche gcigs kyang / /tshad med rnam bzhi'i zhal gyis lus can kun/ /skyong ba'i brtse ldan thugasarje che 'di mtshar/ /phyi ru bram ze'i gzugs kyi pho nya mkhan/ /nang du rtsa khams dag pa'i zhing skyong dbang / /gsang ba sems nyid gcig pu'i rnam 'phrul kyang / /rtag tu snying gi thig ler 'bral med lha/ /rmi lam yul gyi rol ba ji lta bar/ /med bzhin snang ba'i dgra bgegs dpung tshogs rnams/ /sgyu ma'i seng shes glang po bsad pa ltar/ /legs ldan nag po khyod kyis thal bar rlogs/ /srid na phun sum tshogs pa 'dab brgya'i dbus/ /zhi ba'i yon tan sbrang rtsi ro bda' ba/ /myang pas dpal gyi rtse dga' rtag rgod par/ /bsam pa'i re ba yongs su skong bar mdzod/ /don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mkhan rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan zhing 'di'i sku'i bkod pa bsdug pa'i tshe sku gdung rin po cher 'phul pa'i snya dar zhal yig zhing khams rgya mtsho'i rol gar/ /'jam dpal rdo rje gas ldan grags pa'i lha/ /blo bzang chos kyi khri la ngur smig gi /rgyal mtshan bsgreng phyir mi yi zol brten pa/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kun 'dus pa dge ba'i bshes/ /ljongs 'dir gzugasasku'i bkod pa yongs bsdus nas/ /(71bsrid lam dub pa'i 'gro kun sgrol slad du/ /zhing khams rgya mtshor sna tsho gos sprul pa'i gar/ /sgyur pa'i bshed pa ji bzhin lhun grub shog /'og min zhing khams zhing gi gtso bo na/ /nges pa lnga dang ldan pa'i long sku sa /bzhengs nas theg chen dbyangs bdun rab rdzogs glu/ /las snang dag pa'i gdul bya'i rnga snyan mod/ /legs nyes blang dor bag la nyer zha ba/ /ches cher snyigs pa'i dus kyi skal ngan 'gro /'dren la mchog gi sprul skur ma bstan na/ /rab dkar lhag bsam khyogs la 'phyang des ci/ /dkar mdzes me tog char dang 'ja' 'od kyi/ /ri mo mkha' la bla bre ltar phub kyang / /bsam bzhin skyes rabs tshar du mi dngar na/ /de 'dra byis pa 'drid pa'i rnam 'phrul tsam/ /'char nub spangs pa thugs rje'i 'od kyi zer/ /phyogs lhung bral bar 'jug la dmigs —46

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'damed gshis/ /'gro kun phan bde'i rtsal ga rgyal ba'i bstan/ /yul gzhan phal du med phyir bod 'dir dgongs/ /sems med kun bzod ma 'dis 'jig rten khams/ /'degs na thar pa'i lam mkhan gcig pu par/ /grangs med bskal par tshogs gnyis yongs bsags pa'i/ /'phags mchogo zhi ba'i dbyings su mnal lam ci/ /byang phyogs ka lā pa yi grong khyer cher/ /drag po'i 'khor los sgyur pas kla klo'i dpung / /'joms pa'i dus kyis bskal pa ring de srid/ /sa 'dir thugs rje'i 'jug pa chad med shog /mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i nyon mongs sdong po yi/ /rtsa ba drung 'byin bdag tu med pa'i mtshon/ /byang chub sems kyi khu bas (72na lor bsdams pas/ /mtha' gnyis dra ba ma lus gcod gyur cig /chu stag gnod sbyin chen po tsi'u dmar pos 'phrad dgos tshul byung ba dang / /sde pa tha'i ji rdo rje rnam rgyal gyis gtsun lag khang gi zhig bsos phal cher grub pa'i rab gnas la 'ong dgos tshul dang bcas rgyal khams bde thabs su bsam yas kyi rab gnas la phyin skabs dbu rtse rigs gsum gyis gtsos pa'i rten brten par bcas pa la dngos ldor yid sprul gyi mchod pa bgyis skabs snyan shal phul ba'i kha yig ring por phan bde'i srog lo / /dbu rtse 'og khang mkhyen brtse'i ri bo brtson pa'i nor rgyas kyis/ /rab bcings tshonas gnyis rgya mtshor bsgril ba las/ /'gro kun la 'jug dam chos bdud rtsi'i sman/ /ring por phan bde'i srog 'tsho nyi ma'i gnyen/ /(72bsnyigs mar spyod pas ches dka' gdul bya rnams/ /'dul la thugs bskyed dam bca' yongs 'du'i ljon/ /gtong min brtan pos rab dud 'brasabu'i bcud/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro 'dis myang bya las gzhan ci/ /de phyir srid lam dub pa'i skye rgu rnams/ /gdung skyob mi lus zol brten shākya'i tog /gang gi mkhyen brtse nyi ma brgya yi lus/ /'bar bas sdig chos de 'bras mun drung phyung / /don ldan ring por 'tsho ba bskal pa'i tshe/ /bsod nams gser sgong smin pa tshangs pa'i spun/ /rmugs 'dzin mdzod kyi g.yang chags dpal 'byor du/ /brgya byin gtsug nor thob ltar gnas 'gyur shog /thabs shes zung 'jug shel gyi them skas la/ /risamed lus can ma lus rab 'dzegs nas/ /thar pa mchog gi khang bzang la zhugs te/ /stobs bcu'i rtsal gyis don gnyis lhun grub shog /gangs can ra bas yongs bskor ma la yar/ /bstan dang 'gro —227

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2)ba'i legs byas sa mchogo skyes//bde skyid dri bsung byams mgon dbus 'gyur du//'byon min de srid rab 'phel ldang gyur cig/dga' ldan chos srid bstan pa'i gdugs dkar po/khrid rtse'i bar du 'khor ba'i grib bsil la/kun bzod snod bcud bcas pa ngal gso'i stegs//bsod nams gzugs can bzhin du 'grub par shog/bar go mkha' ltar kun khyab rigs kun bdag po'i dpyid//dbang po'i 73na gi zhu ltar gcig las du ma sa/mngon par bkra ba ye shes rnam lnga yi//bdag nyid srid zhi'i dngos kun gas bya'i gnas//zhi ba'i 'dab brgya rgod kyang srid bde yis//kun+da zum min thugs rje'i rta ljang can//nye ring med pa kun la 'jug pa'i rdzas//sngon med nam mkha'i nor bu khyod kyi gshis//de phyir lus can kun dang khyad par du//bod yul bstan dang skye rgu'i legs tshogisarnams//rtsod dus khengs pa 'phrog byed rdzogs ldan gyi//dga' ston dpal la spyod par bdag byin rlobs//blta bas mi ngom mtshan dpe gsal rdzogs pa//'dren byed yul du 'char byed sangs rgyasadangos//mthong bas skal bzang la sbyor gangs wo mtsho//ṣ+ka med zhal gyi 'dzum 'od phyogs bzhir 'phro//zla nyir ltos min phan bde'i ba kū la//thugs rje lus phra'i 'gram chang dngar po'i brlan//chags che cig car ba 'ad pa'i 'phrin las rgyun//skye rgu'i rgya mtshor 'bab 'di chos nyid lag/ring nasabasags dang deng bskrun dge ba'i tshogs//rnam smin dkar po'i mu tig 'khri shing char//rnam pa thamasacad mkhyen min de srid du//'bab pa'i skal ba bzang por 'gyur bar shog/nyi 'ang bde zhing skyid pa rab dkar snang ba'i gter//'phel dang 'grib pa med par rtag gang ba//nyi mas sa chen mun sel de srid du//bstan 73bskong bstan 'dzin ster bcas gnas gyur cig/thugs rje zla shel bcu drug cha gang ba//byin rlabs bsil pa'i gzigs ma 'bum 'dzag pas//legs byas chu gter chen po bla nas blar//gyen du 'phyur pa'i skal bzang bdag la stsol//lkog sgo yang rnam dpyod dpung pas yongasabategs ut+pal steng /shes rab ral gyis rmongs pa'i dra ba kun//bcad de ji lta ji snyed chos kun la//smra ba'i dbang phyug grub par bdag byin /༷sa//ār+ya pa glang sngon goms sgo gsum do rar mi

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'dadage'i gar//sgyur pa'i sdig tshogs nag po'i gos bu kun//dri ma chu yis 'khrud bzhin yongs dag par//brtse ldan pad dkar can des rjes gzungs mdzod//byams pa — po'i to won zad med wo//'jig rten bas por spyod pa'i bdud bsto me//chal nas mgon khyod byang tso shing drung du//ma rnga zhe sangs rgyas tshe 'khor du lung ston shog/sgos da gling srid zhi'i 'dam la ma chags yos tsang pad+ma yi//thugs rje'i spyan dkyus ring po 'gro kun la//zhugs pas rgyal sras spyod pa'i tsan+dan dris//rang bde dman lam tsha gdung zhi bar shog/6mo kha phung ( sko gsum r+sā chas glang po wo bolab//bag yod khrims kyi lcags kyu rnon bo yis//mdzo mtho'i 'am du bde bar bgrod nus par//blta pa'i gtso des rtag tu thugs rjes skyongs//nga sbyor64lha r+sās gtsang sras dang de'i gsung slob mar bcas//dngos bshams yid kyis sprul pa'i ma rdzo tsho gos sprin// kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa ltar//spyod pa'i bsod nams rgya mtshor bdag gyur cig/skud bol sngags pa gling drang nges bka' dang dgongs 'grel bstan btsos kun//thos bsam sgom par byed la 'tshe ba'i gegs//byang chub mchog gi mthu stos kho po yis//rab bcom rdo rje'i gur du byin gyis lhos//gsar ra gling rgyal gsung dgongs 'grel legs sbyar lha yi skad//brda sprod gzhung je nus 'jig rten mig/lo paṇa rnamapar thar pa'i rjes zhugs nas//bstan la bya ba byed par bdag byin rlobs//bai tsa gling //so so thar nas a ti yo ga'i bar//theg pa'i rim pa ma nor nyams blangs te//rnam mkhyen thob pa'i thabs su thub bstan kun//gdams par 'char ba'i byin sa sa snying 'jug mdzod//ba4gtogleng rnam rtog wo mongs 'khrugs pa'i bud shing kun//bsam gtan zhugs kyis ma lus bsregs byas nas//tshangs pa lha yi me tog ji bzhi du//g.yo med sto 'dzin brtan po thob par shog/rin 〉glang kun la snyoms par 'jug pa'i zhing sa la//rin r+ṣa sems kyis sa bon brtse ldan chus//bas pas bde skyid ro brgya bda' ba'i g.yang //gangs can ra ba dkar por chags par mdzod//4ba〉kor mdzod gling mthong bas yid la rab dga'i dpal ster ba//'dre/ pa mchog gis swā la'i sman ljongs 'dir//rnam

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)mang thos pa'i sras kyi bang mdzod ltar/ /phun tsho gis lhor pa'i dpal la spyod gyur cig /khrus kha gling bskal par goms pa'i dug gsum dri ma rnams/ /thos bsam sgom gsum chab kyis dag byas pa/ /bzang po'i skal pa can gyur za ma tog /gtan bde'i bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis gang bar shog /sgo mang ke ru:nga nam yang gzhal dka'i drin gyis spur rgyal bod/ /legs bskyangs mkhan slob zung la bsnyen bkur ba/ /sngon byon sprul pa'i rgyal blon mdzad pa bzhin/ /rtag tu theg mchog bshes dang mi 'bral shog /mthu rtsal klu gling gsang 'dzin lag na rdo rje'i mthu stobs kyis/ /gdengs can nag po'i nus pa zil mnan cing / /dkar phyogs stong bas char chu dus 'bebs sogs/ /'jig rten kun la bde skyid spel bar shog /mar rten dkar po zla bas lan brgyar byugs pa gaṅgā'i yab/ /te se'i mdzes pa rab 'phrog mchod sdong che/ /'jigs med gdong lnga'i rgyud kyi dbyangs snyan pos/ /rgud pa'i glang chen spyi bo 'gems par shog /ma rdzo rten dmar sna yil dmar po'i 'dab stong yongs grol ba'i/ /rgyan gyi khyad 'phags pad rag rdul brtsegs kyi/ khengs pa 'phrog dang lhan cig brtan g.yo'i dngos/ /kun gyis btud bya'i gnas su 'gyur bar shog /(75na〉rdzo rten nag po mig sman ltar gnag stang zil nyer brtsegs ri/ /dam pa'i gzugs brnyan rgyan gyis rab dpa' ba/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i mchod sdong gzi byin gyis/ /dgra bgegs dpung tsho gos ming gi lhag mar shog /4 ༄ rten sngon po bkra shis sgo mang lha yi khang bzang gis/ /mngon par spud pa'i ispro ni la ltar/ /rab mdzes bde bar yongs gshegasathugs rten gyis/ /chos nor 'dod pa thar pa'i sgo 'byed shog /khas gtso gling / mi dge'i zong gisabade nor bsgrub 'dod pa'i/ /'brul pas rang nyes mya ngam thang yangs por/ /mnar pa'i 'gron rnams mngon mtho'i grong khyer du/ /ma 'dris mdza' bshes khyod kyis dbugs phyung zhig /sgyu ma'i phrul ltar bzo khyad bcu gsum gyis/ /ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho'i gsal/ /dbang gzhu ltar bkra rigs lnga'i lha tsho gis kyis/ /mthong thos dran reg don ldan rlab tu gsol/ /dge rgyas gling 'og min zhing nas thugasarje zhun ma'i lugs/ /me long ye shes bzhin lag gzugs 'khyil ba/ /gtso dang 'khor du btags —20

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'dapa'i rgyal rnams kyis//bsams pa'i re skong dpag bsam yongs 'dur mdzod//pe ko sangs rgyas kun dngos pad+ma thod phreng gis//snang srid lha srin yongs kyi dmag dpon du//rgyal mtshan rtags kyi dbang bskur phyogs75ba spun las//rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal chen pe ha ra//gsang yum sprul pa yang sprul blon por bcas//gtum drag rab 'bar gzi brjid nyi ma brgya'i//dpal las lhag par 'bar ba'i mthu stobs kyi//nam mkha'i rdo rjes dgra bo'i snying ga 'bigs//lha khyod bstan pa'i mel tshe'i g.yar dam gyis//g.yul ngor mas pa'i dmag gi sna 'dren pa/khro gnyer smin mtshams bsdus te srid pa gsum//rdzu snyul shugs kyis skor ba'i tsi dmar pa//mi bsrun dgra sde'i dpung rnams mi rtag pa'i//lam du 'god la 'chi bdag gshin rje'i kha//gdangs 'dra'i lha chen mngag gzhug bcas rnams kyis//bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i rdza rnga rdungs//dga' ldan chos srid zung ldan nyi zla'i khams//yid grubs sgra gcan lam las rtag ldog nas//sdig rta'i mun stug phyung sto srid dang zhi'i//legs tshogos snang ba'i dga' ston 'bar bar mdzod//gomar pa byu ru'i lhun po nyi ma 'bum gyi gos//klubs pa'i brjid ldan gnod sbyin dbang po la//phun tshogs 'dod rgu'i dpal gyis tshim byed na//bsam don lhun rgyas grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//mchos phug4 phug /snyan 'gyur nyams dang ldan pa tshangs pa'i gsung //yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs kyis gdul bya'i rnar//theg mchog zil dngar babs pa gsang ba'i phug/rtsa gsum rnam rol gzhal yas khang chen por//lo chen be+e rkon ya'i phyag sor gyis bskrun pa'i//dus gsum sangs rgyas ma lus gcig bsdus pa//pad+ma ka ra'i snang brnyan yid bzhi nor//mthong thos dran reg don dang ldan pa yis//snang srid chos kun rig pa'i rang rtsal du/shar bas mchogo dang mthun mong dngos grub kun//bsams pa ji bzhin lhun gyis yongs grub par//pad+ma thod phreng dang mtshungs bdag byin rlobs//lha mo rigs 'an ma/gangs can bstan skyong rigs 'dzin dbang mo yis//mi mthun nyes pa'i dri ma kun khrus la//tshe dpal dbang thang rlung rta yar skyed dar//srid pa'i rjer sen bar du 'phyar bar mdzod//dge yo gyid4khor mar/mthu stobs rlabs

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()'phreng tshangs pa'i yul sa cher//rab 'gongs 'dod khams dbang mo'i chu gter nas//las bzhi'i zla nyi sa srung bdud rtsi'i gter//'bad med lag rtser stsol ba'i skal bzang mdzod//gar dbang pad+ma'i rigs ldan dbang r+ṣa lha//rta skad drag por bzhad pa'i sgra dbyangs kyis//bar du gcod byed gdon bgegs kun choms la//snang srid dregs pa'i tshogs la mnga' sgyur mdzod//ārla pa gling gi rta mgrin bod shing sgo can gyi rgyal srid mi skas pa'i rten tshol du ra sa 'phrul snang gi srung ma dung skyong rgyal mo la chu stag zla ba drug pa'i tshes gcig nyin gser zang las grung pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs stong phul ba'i dus snyan shal kha yig bsod nams nyi mong dun 'as//7ba phyi ltar lha klu bdud srin gnod sbyin gyi//mo srin chung ma'i rnam rol 'jig rten tshul//bstan kyang nang du dbang phyug nyer brgyad gtso//gsang ba 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ḍā ki ma//e ma de kun sems nyid gcig bu'i zhabrul//sna tshogs 'char sgo'i rang mdangs 'gag med pa//dpyad tshe gnyis 'dzan 'grul pa'i pha rol du//rig pa'i rang rtsal rdzogs pa'i lha gcig pu//'on te dag gsal dbyings kyi lha lam na//dbang po'i gzhu ris bkra ba'i ltad mo bzhin//rgyal kun bstan srung dbang mo dung skyong ma'i//mas snyan dri za'i rgyud mangs rna ba'i dpyid//nag phyogs mun pa'i smag rum mthar byed pa//gser sbyangs snang ba rab 'bar 'od po che//bsod na mas rtsibs stonge 'khor lo cher 'phags pa//phul ba'i 'bras bu don bzhin smin par mdzod//swā la'i nags kyi ljongs 'khod yid can rnams//brgyad khri'i tshe ldan 'dzam bu gling pa'i mi//ji bzhin gdung bas gcos min bde skyid kyi//rtsed ga' khong nas rab rgod dga' sa stsol//don ca grub pa'i gsung rab bdud rtsi'i bas//mkhyen yangs blo yi za ma rtag 'khyil ba//mkha/btsun bzang po'i grags pa don ldan can//bstan pa bla nas blar 'degs 'phrin las sgrubs//yangs pa'i sal mang pos yongs bkur ba//mchod yon nyi zla zung du 'jug pa'i 77na)khrims//spur rgyal bod kyi rgyal khams chen po yi//mchog dman lusacan gnya' bar rab lci mdzod//gtum drag kun khyab 'jug pa bcu ldan pa//mas stobs mi yi seng ge'i ster mo'i dbal//dgra bgegs gser can / ba yongs phral nas//gsod pa'i mngon spyod

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod jo khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ tanalas sbyor myur du sgrubs//ut+pal ze 'bru'i bcud bzhu thig le'i mchog/rna gong rgyud las 'phos pa'i mig dkyus mdas//tshangs pa mi mjed zhing gi mnga' 'bangs bcas//kun yid brtan pa phyogs te dbang du sdus//chad med mtho dma' kun 'bab yang srid klung //nad gdon dbul zhakhrug sgrib gnyis kyis sbags dug/mthong bas rnam grol byin rlabs chu lha'i bu//rab gsal phan bde'i yan lag brgyad ldan mdzod//rnam smin rab tu chos dkar mu ghi ka/dge legs 'khri shing rtse mor dud pa'i char//'dzad med rtag 'bab bsod nams spungs pa'i 'od//nyi ma bdun ltar 'bar ba'i 'phrin las sgrubs//mdze byed ces pa chu yos gnam lo gsar tshes dus srid gsum bdag mo mar skabs dar sna sna lnga'i snya dar phul ba'i khegal47zhi sa grub//dkar po chos nor 'dod dang thar pa'i zhal gyi sgo'i//mche ba las gsangs tshangasapa'i bu mo zhes//yid 'phrog dbyangs kyi rgyal mo'i rgyud mangs glu//sgra 'dzin bcud 77ba'i len pa'i lha khyod dgongs//dug gsum des bskyed srid zhi'i gdung ba'i mun//mthar byed zhi ba'i 'phrin las rta ljang can//bde skyid snang ba dam pa 'od po che//mi 'dzad rtag tu 'char ba'i dpal gyisaskyongs/khyad par byin rlabs mtho ris chu bo yis//bod yul bstan 'gro'i nyes brgya'i dri ma kun//rab bkrus ches dkar dag pa'i snod yangs por//legs byas 'bras smin zil dngar 'khyil bar mdzod//ser po srid zhi'i dge legs na tshod dar drag por//tshogs gnyis bcud kyis bskyed du bsring pa'i gzugs//gzi byin nyi ma'i dngos po brgya yi lus//legs 'dzin 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma//sgo gsum brtas byed sim pa'i tshor ba yi//ro bda' legs myangs tshe dpal stobs 'byor g.yang //rab chags 'chi med gtso dang skal mnyam par//spyod pa'i 'dod pa yongs su 'jo bar mdzod//kha ba'i ljongs 'dir mtha' bzhi'i yul gyi dpya//mi 'dzad 'du ba'i longs spyod sgo khed g.yang //rtsi bcud 'bru sogs snod kyi yon to kun//rdzogs ldan dus kyi rtse dga' dgod par mdzod//dmar po/baṃ yig thabs mchog dpal /na he ru gar//ye yig shes rab 'khor lo rgyas

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()'debs ma//rjes chags sgra yis rgyal kun dbang bsdus nas//zhu bda'i mdangs kyis srid gsum brtan 'phrog ma//rkang sen zla ba tshes pa phra mo'i cha//srid gsum dbang phyug kun gyi 78na dzel pa yi//mdzes byed cod pan rtag tu yongs sba bas//phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i dpal de stsol//gangs can mang bkur yangs pa'i rgyal khab na//srid zhi'i phun tsho gos dngos kun rang dbang du//gyur te tshangs gnas yul sa'i rtser son pa//dus kyi bdag po'i las shugs 'thob par mdzod//sngon po bstan srung dregs pa'i dbus na srid pa'i rgyal//dbang phyug nyer brgyad kun gyi gtso mo'i tshul//phur stong srung ma'i dbang mo re ma ti//mthu stobs drag shul rtsal la 4 dmag zor ma//gawo srid sde dpung gya gyu'i sgyu thabs kyis//bstan 'gro'i bde legs log pa'i chom po dang //ring 'khon slo bur bka' 'das dam log sogs//rigs 'dzin sgos dgra'i snying khrag zhal du drongs//sad ser than pa mi phyug nad mug dang //zhakhrug rtsod gtong zhing snod bcud nyams byed pa'i//bod khams phung 'dre dam sri 'gong po sogs//nag po bdud sde'i ru mtshon sal stol//ljang gu ring nas mchode bsten bsgrubs pa lhag pa'i lha//srid gsum mnga' bdag dpal ldan nam gru ma//res 'ga' dung skyong rgyal mo'i mtshan snyan can//zhal khyim ston zla ltar dkar ngom zhing spyon//dam rdzas gtor ma'i ri bo mkha' la bsnyegs//sman phud rak+ta'i btung ba rgya mtshor bskyil//phyi nang gsang mchod dngos bshamasayid sprul na//78ba8gyes par rol la 'phrin las rnam bzhi sgrubs//mchod bya mchod byed mchod pa'i ngo bo kun//sems nyid gcig pu'i rnam par 'phrul pa ste//bla ma yi dam chos skyong srung ma rnams//dbyer med mchod pa'i mchog 'di ngo mtsha glud//kun khyab dzā ti'i dri bsung 'phro ba nas/shar phyogs rgya mtsho'i mthas gtugs nor 'dzin la//zhwa ser cod paṇa legs 'chang chos srid kyi//bstan pa'i gdugs dkar gcig gis khyab par mdzod//brtse gdung thugs rje'i dpag bsam yongs bo las//dngos grub rnam gnyis yid bzhin nor bu'i gter//dam ldan rig 'dzin slob mar bcas pa la//stsol ba'i bsam don lhun gyis grub par maX///

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'dakhams ba mdo'i khur len zhi ba bzang po dang /kong po phan bde sku skye spun khongs gcig pa'i khams kong lag sbrel gyisa'abangs gyen log bya skabs mkha' 'gro blo bzang bstan skyong gis thog drangs slebs ra stod 'gron po sogs 'dzom thog zhi ba bzang po dkar yang ma thon pas khams phyogs rang zhir song //kong po'i sa 'gag la 'dra bzung gi dmigs rnam byas pa bstan 'dzin dwa yan rgyal pos gtsos pa'i bod sog gi dpung khri khrag tu nye spub teg pas mang thal du gyur cing //jo mo rdzong khra khul la dmar bshal/mkhris pa rtsa rgyugs/smyo 'bon sogs nad sna tshogs kyis mi bzhi brgya lhag tsam ga rten tsho rol du song ste wo' ltar yal//rang phyogs na da med sa gtsang ba byung ba'i tshe bsrung zlog mnan sregs 'phang gsum mdun bzhig khri 'bebs sogs rdzus rim 79na〉sa pa rnams gnad du song ba'i tshe phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i tsho gos su chos srung rgya mtshor gto rag phul ba'i snya dar kha yig bdud tsor ma par rtsa spu'i dar ོ//dar ser zhi khro rab stims lha tsho gos kun 'dus pa//dngos grub gto gyur rdo rje drag po rtsal//rig 'dzin bla ma mchog mar byin chas kyis//bsams pa'i don kun lhun gyis grub 'di spro//dar ljang kun khyab 'phrin las 'khor lo'i bdag nyid can//dpal ldan rdo rje phur pa'i lha tsho gos kyis//bdud dang des brlams dgra bo tshar bcad pa'i//dga' ston kun bzang mchod sprin mkha' khyab 'bul//dar mthing sangs rgyas kun gyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gter//'jam dpal dpa' bo dus dgra'i dbang po'i gar//rnam rol snang srid zil gnon he ru ka/de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs mchogo tshe bdag lha//'gro la rjes chags rab dmar zhal gyi sgo/chos kyi dbyings nas gdangs pa'i hom khung du//mi bsrun dgra dpung tshe srog stobs lhor kun//dgyes rol 'khor ba'i gzhi rtsa drung nas tshwan//bsgral bya sgrol byed thams cad sems nyid kyi//rtog tshogs ri mor bris las ga' na min kyang //kun rdzob tsam du phyi nang gsang mchod tshogs//sngar bcol legs pa'i gtang rag gnyan por 'bul//dar dkar bcu gsum 'khor lo'i bdag nyid bka' sdod bcas//79bgrong khyer sum brtsegs 'jig pa myur mdzad mgon//rnam mang thos pa'i srasagyur rgyal po ches//'phrin las lhun grub dga' ston mchod sprin spro//dar dkar legs ldan nag po gur mgon stobs log zhal//gshin rje pu tra gnod ྅sbyin beg tse sogs//dam can rgya mtshor bcas pas

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()'phrin las rnams//bsgrubs par phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul//dar dmar gnyer gtad dgra dpung chu srin mgrin pa'i nang //bskal par thar med rgyas btab btang rag tu//sman gtor rak+ta'i mchod pa nyer 'bul na//bzhes shig zhing gang las kyi mtha' sdud bcas//dar mthing zhi rgyas dbang drag mngon spyod las bsgrubs par//dkar ser dmar nag rol gar 'ja' r+pā ltar//rnam bkra ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho'i rdul//de snyed grangs ston dpal ldan dmag zor ma//rtsal ldan nags kyi dpa' bo ga rgyas rtser//ru mtshon nam mkhar bslangs te mdzo phyogs nas//mdzes zhal 'dzum par byed tshe mgo bo'i phreng //kun bzod rgyan du ring skyong ngo mtshar ra//nad dang rims kyi rlang pa na bun ltar//'tshub pa'i rkyal pa dgra la kha phye nas//mi rtag lam du 'gro mang nyer khrid pa'i/khrag sbyor 'phrin las legs bsgrubs gtang rag tu//phyi mchod yid 'ong lha yi mdun sa bzhin//nang mchod srin po'i bshas ra'i rjes 80na ) su 'gro/gsang mchod bcu drug cha rdzogs dga' ba bzhi//kun kyang bde stong zung 'jug ngang nas 'bul//rang rigs gdod ma'i rdor sems 'dod khams mar//ngo 'phrod rang ngo shes nas legs skyong ba//rtag tu 'du 'bral med pa'i rnal 'byor gyi//lo byung mchod pa'i mchog 'di e ma ho//dar mthing chos sku ye dag 'jam dpal kun bzang klong //sgrib gnyis dri ma ma lus nyer zhi yang //'gro ba'i gnyis 'dzin zhabrul ngor tshe srog bla//to za rkan sgra rdeb pa 6 bdag gis//bsam ga sbyor rtsub 'chang ba dgra bo yi//snying khrag shub kyis drangs pa'i gtang rag tu/khrag chang skyems kyi btung ba mtsho ltar bskyil//dmar chen gtor ma ri ltar spungs 'di bzhes//dar dkar mdzes sdug 'jo sgeg nyams ldan yid 'o lha//dran pas 'dod rgyas dpal ster dpag bsam dbang /khred zhi'i gdung sel dpal ldan dung skyong ma//nya rgyas zla wa'i zhal khyim 'thus ldan tso//khyod 'khor bod skyong bstan ma bcu gnyis zhes//res 'ga' srin mo'i cha lugs 'jigs rung ston//phal d+ku dar zab gos dang rin r+ṣa rgyan//rjes gas zhi dang rgyas pa'i rtse 'jor rol//kwa ye gangs can ljongs kyi bde skyid nor//'phrog pa'i chom rkun mi bsrun dgra sto dpung //rtsad nas26

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'dabacad pa'i dga' ston mchod tshogs sprin//dngos bshams ting 'dzin sngags80brgyas mang por spel//dar dkar kong btsun de mo sman skyong yongs kyi gtsor//'phrin las gnyer gtad ji bzhin grub pa yi//dbang po sgo lngar dgyes byed mchod pa'i tshogs//'chi med lam kun khyab par spros te 'bul//dar ljang sngags srung thang lha stag gzhen bdud mgon nag/khyab 'jug chen po skyes mchog rdo rje legs//phur skyong dkar bdud mthu chen sdebazhi sogs//dregs pa lha srin sdebargyad dmag tsho gos kye//zasakyi skal bar gtad pa log 'dren dgra/dpung bcas srid sde mya ngan khang bu mā/bcug pa'i sngar bcol legs pa'i gto rag tu//sman gtor rak+ta phyi nang mchod pa 'bul//dar dkar nyi ma 'char ga'i mdangs ldan mig zlum dgrar//blta ba'i shugs kyis don snying tshal pa brgyar//'gas nus sprul pa'i chos rgyal sku lnga po//yum chen pho nya blon por bcas pa dang //sdo brgyad dregs pa'i dmag gi dpung tsho gis kyi//las kyi kha lo sgyur byed tsi dmar ba//gnod sbyin bas rgod wo po 'khor bcas kyis//sngar bcol 'phrin las bsgrubs pa'i dga' ston du//steng na dam rdzas gtore ma 'phyur bur spungs//'og tu khrag gi rgya mtsho rba slong zhabrug/nyer spyod lnga bsgreng rol mo 'brug stong ldir//gzugs sgra dri ro reg byar bcas pa spel//dar dkar sho dbang phyug gshin rje ma bdud pe ha ra//tshangasapa rdor legs khyab 'jug gnod sbyin srin//mgon nag 81na tham chen dmu dang gu lang na gag ma po brag btsan gnam the dkar po dang //yam shud bgegs rgyal klu bdud nag po sogs//drag po'i las mdzad dregs pa'i sdod pon che//'khor dang bcas la phyi nang gsang mchod kye//sngar bcol gtang rag 'bul lo dgyes par rol/chu mas nag bzla ba'i bas gtor gyi smi gdong sto mgon por phul ba'i snya dar zhal yig tha pas shes da 'dun/e yig stong chen chos sku'i mkha' dbyings las//waṃ yig bde chen gzugs sku khro bo'i gar//gling bzhi ri rab bting pa'i gdan steng na//gyad kyi dor stabs tshul 'gying stobs log dbang //e ma phyi rol sde brgyad dmag dpon du//legs ldan ga// bzhi las byed pho nyar bcas//rnam rtog 'khrul

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)ngo'i sems kyi chu mtsho'i nang / /kun rdzob rdzun pa'i snang ba 'byams su klas/ /'on te rtsa khams rlung gi ngo bo sa /gzhi lam 'bras bur lhun gyis grub pa'i lha/ /de yang rang sems gsal stong zung 'jug tu/ /ngo 'phrod gdod ma'i mgon po las gas su/ /ma rdzo bya ma rdzo byed ma rdzo pa'i ngo bo kun/ /byar med blo 'das mkha' las 'ja' tshon ltar/ /phyi nang gsang rdzas kun tu bzang po yi/ /med byung mchod pa'i sprin phung 'di ko mtshar/ /rgyal ba'i bstan dang lus can phan bde'i nor/ /dbyar mtsho lta bur bla nas blar 'deg cing / /sngags 'chang bdag gis bcol ba'i 'phrin las bzhi/ /bsam pa ji (81ba〉bzhin lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /mdzes byed kyi lo mchod dpon blo bzang mthu stobs dang/ dbu mdzad blo bzang yon to gnyis kyis gsang sngags pho brang kagling ga gi gnam ༅ phul ba'i kha yig dngos grub ga mdzod/ rnam par rgyal ba'i dngos grub bye ba'i gter/ /phan bde'i dge legs spel pa'i bshad sgrub ste/ /khrims ldan 'dus pa'i rig 'dzin gling gi mchog /gsang ba sngags kyi pho brang gnam rgyan du/ /rgya gram rtags brgyad ri mo'i bum gdan dang / /bar snang sa gzhi mdzod ris gos bsgrigs 'di/ / dam rdzas ngo mtshar rgyan gyis mchode sprin dang / /rngamasabarjid snyan 'gyur dbyangs kyi byang 'dren pa/ / gtong phod blo dang lhag bsam bzang po dag /brtson pa'i mthu las snying stobs yon tan gyis/ /phul ba'i legs byas sa bon yongs smin pa'i/ /'di dang gtan 'dun snye ma g.yur za shog /zhwa ser cod pan 'chang ba'i lung rtogs kyi/ /bstan pa spyi dang khyad par phan dang bde'i/ /'byung gnas rdo rje theg pa'i legs bshad gling / /srid pa'i mtha' can de srid rgyas gyur cig /bsod nams rgya mtsho'i zhing la ri mo mā /bgyis pa'i dge tsho gos dbyar gyi chu gter che/ /mngon par 'phel gang mkha' mnyam mar gyur 'gro /kun mkhyen ye shes thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /dbu mdzad mchod dpon gnyis kyi phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i spyi rdzas su 'phan sum cu dang phye phur gcig phul ba'i kha yig lto gi gyo mtsho/ zham mkha' bar snang sa gzhi mdzod ris sogs/ r+sām par ba po ba'i gan (82na)gos bzang bsgrigs las/ /legs grub sum cu'i grangs ldan 'phan phul dges/ /bdag g.yin 'gro —238

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 9)kun bde skyid la spyod shog/phye phur/kha dog rnam par bkra ba'i dar dpyangs tshogos//tshar du legasadangar bkod mdzes mchod pa'i sprin//dkon cog rin chen rnam gsum spyan snga sa/'bul na srid zhi'i legs tshogs lhun grub shog/chu yos rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i tsho gos su 'dod khams dbang mo dgyes pa bskyed pa'i mdos bskang 'bum ther btsugs skabs snyan shal phul ba'i kha yig zhing khams rgya mtsho/sra brtan lcags ri'i khor yug gshig gyur nang //rin cen lhun po gling bzhi gling phran dang //lha mi'i 'dod yon mkho dgu'i 'byor pa kun//legs spungs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo phye'i mdos//rgyal yumang ga gi dbang phyug dbyangs can lha//'dod khams bdag mo'i rnam rol dmag zor ma//'khor yos zag med dbyings nas dgyes pa'i zhal//'dzum byed tso bzang ma rdzo sprin 'di spro na//dga' ba'i dpal dang ldan pa'i pho brang tsho//chos srid 'bangs dang bcas pa'i bde skyid srog/'phrog byed gzugs can dgra dang gzugs med bgegs//sdebams phra rag rdul phran bzhi du rlog/dkar min gos ga de bskyed sgrib gnyis mun//byin rlabs nyi ma'i gzi yis mthar bskrad cing //brtan g.yo dbang sdud tshe dpal stobs 'byor dang //lung rtogs yon tan dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel mdzod//82ba thams med yid bzhin nor las khyad par du//sku gsum mngon gyur 'khor lo rgyas 'debs lha//thun mong snang ngor srid gsum dbul sel mas//bsam don lhun gyis 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod// chu yos lo dpal grong shag pa blo bzang rnam sto gyis lha sgyu mi dpon byed ring lo lo 4r+sā dung skyong tso mor gsol mchod 'bul ba'i dus kyi mda' dar kha yig dgos tshul byung bltar bris po 'dod las 'bras bzang yongs 'du//phra ldem mdzes sdug gzugs sku'i 'khri shing rtser//phun tshogs 'dod 'jo'i gos bzang yongs dud pa//srid gsum dpa' mo dpag bsam yongs 'du'i ljon//dung skyong rgyal mo lha snyan tshig 'di gson//rang sems sgrib bralagadod nas dkar ba'i mdog/sna tshogs rtog pa'i 'phro 'du 'char sgo'i thags//mi phyed dad pa'i ri mo rnamabakra'i dar//tsho gos ma rdzo bkang ba'i rdzas yos leXs 'bu pon//blo ldan skal bzang mi nor cas pa

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)rnams/ /nad chos gdon bgegs mi dang mi min gyi/ /nyer 'tshe 'jigs pa'i smag rum mun pa las/ /rnam par rgyal pa'i 'od stong 'bar bar mdzod/ /rdzogs ldan dus kyi tshe dang rmugs 'dzin 'byor/ /'khor los sgyur rgyal stobs sogs bsod nams gyi/ /phung po nor 'dzin mngal du lci ba'i khur/ /rnam smin dkar po'i rngul chu 'bab par mdzod/ /nongs rnams snying nas bshags na sgrib med par/ /rgyal ba kun yum khyod kyis byin rlob cing / /bla med ye shes thob min de srid du/ /mgon skyabs mdzod la bsam don lhun grub (83na slog ga /chu yos ho me zla brgyad pa'i nang du bod khams bde thabs la dmigs te bsam yas/ khra 'brug/yum bu gla sgang gsum du gser chab brgya mchod 'bul bar lha khang pa blo bzang dbang rgyal btang skabs phul pa'i snyan dar zhal yig thabs shes zung du 'jug pa'i dkyil 'bor/ /bsam yas/ /'gro rnams mar shes bcu drug cha 'phel ba/ /snying rje'i dkyil 'khor yongasargyas lhag bsam zla/ /'phrin las zad mi shes pa'i bsil zer gyis/ /phan bde'i ku mud rab ba 'ad zas gtsang sras/ /ring bskal dus nas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen/ /mtha' med ma rgan skye rgu'i mched bsgrubs na/ /ches cher snyigs pa'i dus 'dir thugs rje'i dpung / /bskyed nas rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i sgo 'phar phye/ /khyad par rgya hor kha ba'i sman ljongs su/ /nad mug rtsod sogs sdig rta'i 'bras zhi zhing / /phan tshun gnyen gshin yun 'tsho mkho dgu'i 'byor/ /rab 'phel bde skyid dpal la spyod byin rlobs/ /thos don bsams nas nang du mnyam bzhag pas/ /rnam par grol ba'i lo 'bras g.yur za ba/ bu ram shing pa'i ring lugs yongs 'du'i ljon/ /skal bzang 'chi med dpal du dar gyur cig /zhwa ser rin chen cod pan thod bcings nas/ /lung rtogs gling bzhin 'khor bye ba'i dpal/ /blo bzang grags snyan bstan pa nyi zla yis/ /'jig rten mun sel de srid rgyas gyur cig /khra 'grug nyen mongs dag pa'i rang mdangs ye shes lnga/ /rnam snang mi bskyod rin 'byung snang mtha' yas (83ba)don yod grub pa'i gzugs shar nang tshan gsum/ /lus can bsod nams byed po'i thong gis bsgrubs/ /bla med ye shes mchog gi bum bzang las/ /srid zhi'i dngos grub 'khyil ba bdud rtsi'i —240

sku gsung thug rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ tanargyun/ /gtong ba'i sgo 'phar brgya phrag rab phye nas/ /mkha' mnyam skye rgu kun la stsol cig kye/ /bsil ldan ljongs 'dir rnam smin dkar po'i 'bras/ /rab dud de'i rgyu thub pa'i bstan pa dar/ /khyad par mnyam med ri bo dga' ldan pa'i/ /ring lugs 'jig rten gsum gyi rgyan gyur shog /yum bu glasgang /rgyal dang de sras thugs rje chen po'i dpung / /mu tig 'khri shing grib tu nyer bsil ba/ /bde skyid snang ba dkar po'i rtse dga' la/ /'gro rnams spyod pa'i byed por bdag byin rlobs/ /chu yos dpal zha lu gser bkang gi ma he mchod pa'i dus las gshin yab bum gyi zhal 'bags phul ba'i snyan dar kha yig phren wor tshi zhi bdan/ khang ma dpal rdo rje khros pa dus dgra'i dbang / /bka' stod 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje yis/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin 'gro ba'i bde skyid rnams/ /rgyas byed 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub mdzod/ /dpal ldan ma he'i zhal can gsang ba'i yum/ /snang srid ma mo'i sdod pon tsa muṇ+ḍi sa//spyi dang khyad par kha ba'i sman ljongs 'dir/ /bstan 'gro'i bde legs dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel mdzod/ /gtsang stod bkra shis lhun po'i gdan sa bco lnga pa mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal po blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i sku gdung rin po che'i bzhugs khang lha babs mchod rten la bla bre/ brgya mchod sogs 'bul bar gdong kha ba blo bzang bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal bto skabs gos kug dmar ser gyi snyan shal kha yig 'og min zhing ras 'char ba'i wo byed/ /(84na skom ra/gang thugs spang rtogs dpal gyi be'u'i gzugs/ /rdzogs par 'khyil ba'i snying po rgyal kun gyi/ /yon tan phung por gtams pa'i za ma tog /phan bde'i sa chen rab 'degs nye ba'i dbang / /lha dang bcas pa'i skye rgu'i bsod nams kyi/ /zhing du phu dud yongs spel snyan grags rnga/ /srid rtser brdungs la nges pa'i gto tshigs su/ /'dab brgya'i char gyis dbyig 'dzin 'geng 'dir ltos/ /rnam 'dren sras bcas gaṅgā'i rdul snyed pa/ /nyer bkod dag pa'i zhing du yid bzhin gdung / /'dren pa'i sngon 'gror 'ja' tshon gsar pa'i lam/ /shā gi ma tshogs gom stabs ci yang bsgyur/ /'on te gangs can dpal mo'i mngal sbrum par/ /dus su bder btsas legs byas lus phra mas/ /skal bar thob pa'i byin mas (84ba 'dod 'jo'i rten/ /rten byed rin r+ṣa mchod sdong 'di rmad byung / /'gro 'di'i ched —241 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)btab tshogs gnyis sa bon 'bras/ /smin pa'i sku gsum snye ma g.yur za ba/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bzhad pa'i gzhan phan khur/ /mgon khyod phrag par byed lamachogo tu lci/ /de phyir rnam 'dren du mas ring sngags pa/ /snyigs mar cher spyod gdul dka' sems can gyi/ /don byed byang phyogs su la'i sman ljongasasu/ /ngo mtshar sprul sku'i rol gar myur ston gsol/ /dkar por byas pa'i las kun cung zad tsam/ /chud mi 'dza' bar mkha' mnyam skye rgu rnams/ /bla med byang chub snying po gzugs can bzhin/ /ma ho sum nyams su myong ba'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /mtha' bral stong chen sa bon dri ma med/ /phyin drug drod gsher gyis smin skyed bsrings pas/ /chos gzugs myang ngan med pa'i ljon pa che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi 'byung gnas gcig pu pa/ /(85na skra1na bral yon tan rdzogs par rgyal ba kun/ /mtshungs las mchog dman shesabyar mi srid kyang / /deng dus lnga brgya'i gnyen du mgon khyod kyi/ /mi zad thugs rje che 'di gang gisabaskrun/ /zhing 'di'i bkod pa nyer bsdus 'og min na/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku'i nyi ma 'od po che/ /gangs can 'gro ngor gdugs gcig mngon sum du/ /phul byung mtshan dpe'i dkyil 'khor 'char du gsol/ /ngal brgyas 'bad nas don ldan snying po mā /sgrub 'dod 'khor ba mtha' med chu shing la/ /thar pa'i snye ma g.yur du legs za bar/ /mkha' khyab yid can ma lus spyod gyur cig /sems can bsam pa'i khyad par de nyid dang / /mthun par rab 'jug chos phung rgya mtsho'i sgo/ /phye ba'i snying po brgya phrag thabs mkhas kyis/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sar bkri shog /mngon par rab bkra dge mtshan bla na med/ mas pa brjod pa su sti'i dbyangs snyan can/ /lhun po'i spo ltar ches mtho khrims ldan sde/ /thos dang bsam pa'i ba dan ring rkyong shog /mkha' khyab kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin/ /phung por 'khyil las gcig tu dkar ba'i char/ /'jig rten gsum gyi 'dzin ma gsher ba'i rgyun/ /kun mkhyen ye shes rgya mtshor 'jug gyur cig /shing 'brug gnam lo gsar tshes kyi dus srid gsum bdag mo mchod pa'i tshe 'phul ba'i snyan shal kha yig rang sems gcig pur nges pa'i sgyu 'phrul rgya mtsho/ /dkar/ bkra shis dbyangs snyan mgrin par 'brol ba'i 'brug /bzhi (85ba)—242

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'daldan 'byung ba'i gnam lo'i rang zhal 'dzum//bde legs nyin mtshan sbrel bar bsus pa'i mgron//phun tshogs thog mar tshes pa'i dga' ston 'dir//tshangs pa'i bu mos brdungs pa'i pi wang sgrar//srid zhi'i gdung ba ma lus bcil pa'i gtam//rab snyan rna bar 'khrol dang lhan cig par//kun dga'i mdza' ba yid kyi grogs su stsol//'jigs chen brgyad sogs mi mthun nyes brgya'i mun//thugs rje'i cha shas nya gang zla 'od kyis//pha mthar rab gzhil bde skyid ku mu da'i//chun po bskal brgyar rnying med thod 'ching mdzod//ser/mchog gsum byin rlabs lha khyod mthu stobs su/grub pa'i snang ba nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi//legs byas bsil ri'i sbubs nas 'dzad med du//yid kyi 'dab brgya bzhad la rtag 'char mdzod//bsod nams phung po'i ma dros mtsho chen las//'chi med tshe dang 'dzad med stobs 'byor sogs//sde bzhi'i chu klung dbang thang rgya mtsho cher//'bab pa'i rmad byung skal bzang deng 'dir stsol//'dzam bu chu bo'i gser sbyangs brtsegs pa'i ri//yid 'phrog 'chi med bu mo'i sprul sgyur mkhan//deng nas byang chub bar du lhag pa'i lha//mnga' gsol rtag tu brtse bas rjesa'adzin mdzod//dmar/rjes chags dmar 'od zhags pa gcig gis kyang //tshangs pa'i yul sanasabazung 'jig rten kun//bcings nas rjes su 'brang ba'i sgyu thabs mkhan//srid gsum mnga' sgyur dpal ldan re ma tī//dbang byed 'phrul gyis gzugs can gzugs med snying //gser 'gyur bzhin du glags lta'i 86na lngas ma sbyor rnams//rang srid bstan la dga' bas gtsug tor rtses//rkang stegs 'khur la gus pas lhur len stsol//dga' ldan phyogs las rnam rgyal pho brang che//dus kyi bdag po'i las shugs dar drag pas//gnam sa'i dkyil 'khor kun la bar med du//stobs kyi 'bor los dbang du sgyur bar mdzod//sngo/mthu stobs rdo rje 'bar ba'i mardzo rnon pos//yid srubasasder bcas lha min mo yi mngal//cig car lhungs pas bdud las rgyal ba'i rnga//srid pa'i rtse mor brdung ba'i re ma tī//rang srid bstan 'gro'i bde skyid sī ta ma//'phrog byed chom rkan dgra bgegasalaṅka'i mgo/khengs pa'i gtsug tor dang bcas dra/ rtsal mdas//chod cing 'dod khams dbang phyug

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()dga' byed lha//mthu byad dug mtshon ngan gros gzhom pa sogs/zhal 'byor sgos su 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs rnams//sbyin za'i phung por mchonges pa'i phye ma leb//ji bzhin lhag ma med par tshar chod cig/ljang phyi ltar dri za'i bu mo mes po'i sras//nang du spyan ras gzigs dbang tshems las sprul//gsang ba 'jam dpal rdo rjer mnyam sbyor ma//sprul pa'i rnam rol mkha' ltar 'byams su klas//dbang phyug nyer brgyad gtso dang phur srung ma//sde dpon sum cu'i nang na srid pa'i rgyal//gcig pu nyid las du ma'i gar mdzad kyang //nges pa'i don du 'khor lo rgyas 'debs lha//e ma sna tsho gos sprul dang sprul pa'i gzhi//kun kyang sems nyid gcig pus btags pa'i 'phrul//don dam rang rig bla ma yi dam lha//dbyer med dag pa'i rang zhal mjal de spro//nyi ma'i zer la zhen pa'i ma mo che//las bzhi'i 'phrin las sgrubs la 'ja' tshon ltar//ma 'dres so sor bkra ba'i 'dzum ldan zhal//nya rgyas zla ba lta bur ngom zhing spyon//lung dang mdzo par rtogs pa'i yon to gter//dpag med tshe dang phun tshogasa'adod dgu'i mdzod//mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus pa//char du snyil ba'i 'dod 'jo'i bum bzang stsol//shing 'brug dbyar zla dang po'i nang du chos 'khor rgyal mi 'gyur lhun nga ci rgyas grub pa'i gtsug lag khang 'a por mi pham mgon po' sku bas gyi drung du brgya mar/mgon khang so sor gtor gso spyan gzigs dang sa thugs dam skong bar mar dpon blo bzang mthu stobs kyas gtsos/phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i grwa pa kha shas btang pa'i tshe phul ba'i snyan shal kha yig dngos gruba'adod pa lo ba'i gter//byams pa'i snyan g.yas//'og min zhing khams zhing gi gtso bor longs spyod rdzogs skur sangs rgyas kyang //rdo rjes nyer btegs rtswa 'jam gdan steng mnyam gzhag ting 'dzin thun gcig gis//mchog gi sprul 87na khor mngon par 'tshang rgya rgyal tshab mi pham mgon po zhes//grags snyan srid 'di'i 'gro ba'i gdung sel bla med gtan gyi skyabs gnas drung //mtshan dpe'i gzi ldan 'dren byed dga' ston dpyid//rna ba bdud rtsir byed pa tshangs pa'i gsung /shes bya thams cad mkhyen thugs zab brling bar//chos rjes gongs pas nyuXg pad snying gar zum//'gro la gcig tu dkar

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'daba'i rang sems dar/ /ma smad dad pa'i ri mo rab gsal pa/ /'chi med du kū la yi gos bzang por//mos blos sprul te sgra 'dzin rgyan du sbud/ /'dzad med dge ba'i nyi ma 'od po ches/ /mtha' dang tshad bral lus can sdug bsngal mun/ /mngon sum lta theg ming yang grag min par/ /thar pa'i (87ba)snang ba rab tu 'bar gyur cig /'dzam gling mi rnams tshe lo brgyad khri'i dus/ /mgon khyod dbus 'gyur la 4 du nyer byon pa'i/ /'khor gyi thog mar skyes nas dam chos ro/ /brgya phrag bda' ba'i bas bzang 'thung bar shog /snya g.yon/ dam pa tog dkar mes kyis cod pan gang gi dbu la nyer bcings nas/ /chos kyi 'khor ༷ pa'i rgyal tshab rang rigs thu bor dbang bskur bas/ /(88na jig 'a ldan 'chi med zhing gi 'dun sar theg chen las sad gdul bya la/ kher phyin lam bzang rgya cher ston mdzad rgyal sras tshul 'dzin mi pham mgon/ /bsnyen srid med par rgyud lnga'i 'gro ba la/ /rtag tu rjes brtse pad 'dab ltar rgyas spyan/ /btsa' ba'i dkyus ring nam mkha'i khongs brgal ba/ /mgon khyod 'phrin las pha mtha'i tshad du 'khums/ /'gro la rjes chags mdangs ldan mchu sgros 'dab/ /'dzum dbus lhag bsam tshems 'phreng ze'u 'brus/ /lus can bung ba nges legs sbrang rtsi'i bcud/ /myang par rings nas mgron du bsu ba bzhin/ /dam bca'i gzungs sngags thos dang kha tan du/ /bgyid rnams gnas ༅ blangs kyang mgon khyod kyis/ /(88bsgo tho ris thar pa'i skas la nyer 'dren par/ /zhal gyis 'tshes pa'i gos bu mngon sum stsol/ /bod dang rgya hor yangs pa'i rgyal khams su/ /zhwa ser 'chang ba'i bstan pas legs khyab cing / /khyad par chos 'khor rgyal gyi 'dus pa'i sde/ /srid mtha'i bar du dar zhing rgyas par shog /mgon khang shod kyi rdo rje 'jigs byed/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi yab gcig 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /dus kyi dgra bor khros pa ma he'i zhal/ /rab 'bar rdo rjes yid srubs 'jigs byed pa'i/ /'khor lo'i 'khor gyis mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /phyag drug pa/ /rgyal kun thugs rje chen po'i sgyu 'phrul gar/ /mi'u thung drag por khros pa srin po'i gzugs/ /stobs ldan ma hā kā la phyag drug pas/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las ma lus sgrubs/ /las gshin/ /thod pa'i pad skor lcags khang —245

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)'bar ba'i nang / /skye rgu'i bla srog tshe la dbang sgyur ba/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i las kyi gshin rje yis/ /bstan la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs tshar chod cig /rnam sras/ /gdul dka' mu stegs nyi ma grub pa sogs/ /thal bar rlog pa'i mthu stobs rtsal ldan zhing / /lha min tshar gcod lha rnamasang la gso ba'i/ /bde ster rnam thos sras kyis las kun sgrubs/ /dmag zor mo rgyal ba kun yum ngag gi dbang phyug ma/ /srid gsum bdag mo'i skur bstan re ma tī/ /dmag dang zor gyis dgra bgegs dpung 'joms ma/ /lhag pa'i lha kye dus kun rjes brtser mdzod/ /khi/ gling bzhi ri rab gdan btings stobs ga dbang / /rigs 'dzin sgrub po'i bran du (89na)bram ze'i gzugs/ /rtsa khams dngas ma'i ngo bo zhing skyong che/ /rtag tu snying gi thig ler 'bral med bzhugs/ /beg rtse/ /byang shar dbang drag rol pa'i bse mkhar nas/ /srog gi gshed ma gtum po gnod sbyin che/ /sring mo rig pa'i lha mo gdong dmar ma/ /bka' sdod bshan par bcas pas 'phrin las sgrubs/ /rdo sku me 'bar/ sra mkhregs rdo bar nyer zhugasaye shes sems/ /mngon sum grub pa'i me dpung rab 'bar bas/ /dgra bgegs dpung bcas bsregasapa bram ze'i gzugs/ /gtum chen dpa' bo khyod kyis dngos grub stsol/ /kyis kho / /'khor 'das khro kun gyi phyag rgya che/ /ma lus zil gnon 'jam dpal tshe bdag lha/ /bka' nyan lho phyogs sa 'og rim bdun na/ /las kyi gshin rje pe wa sa twa'i ming / /dmar nag me rlung 'tshub mar 'khyil ba'i dbus/ /stag chen spyon pa zhen pa'i mon pa nag /lha btsan bdud dang klu mo drag rtsal can/ /gter srungs mthu chen sde bzhi bcas pa la/ /sman gtor rak+ta tsho gos kyi 'khor lo sa /nyer spungs mchod pa'i sprin phung 'bul byed na/ /log 'dren dgra bgegs thal bar rlog pa dang / /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub char chen phob/ /rtsis kha ni gong dang 'dra la/ /legs ldan nag po khyod zhal bstan tsam gyis/ /mi bsrun log par 'khru ba dgra sde'i dpung / /sbyin za'i phung por phye ma leb ji bzhin/ /thal bar rlag byed gang des wen las sgrubs/ /mgon khang bar/ rtag tu rna bar 'a rje bas pa phang 'gro'i (yo bskyor/ /don kun grub pa'i gtam snyan nyer drangs nas/ /'brol mdzad dbyangs can 'dod khams dbang phyug —246

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 9)mas/ /yid la kun dga'i bde ba chad med stsol/ /de wī ko ṭi/ljang /oṃ yig thog mar bkod pa bkra shis dbyangs/ /rab snyan su sti'i rgyud las drangs pa'i glu /med byung dga' ba'i nyams ldan gar stabs su/ /bsgyur dang lhan cig mgrin par len 'di gson/ /'jam dbyangs dgyes dgur spyod pa'i dbyings phyug ma/ /'phrin las 'khor lor thabs shes zung 'jug lha/ /dbang phyug nyer brgyad gtso dang srid rgyal ma/ /sprul pa'i rnam rol phur skyong re ma ti/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi yum gcig dbyangs can ma/ /nag phyogs bdud sde'i gshed du dmag zor lha/ /rnal 'byor 'dod pa'i re skong yid bzhi nor/ /zhi rgyas dbang gi sgyu 'phrul cir yang ston/ /e ma 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug gtso/ /rtag tu bsten cing mchod yul lhag pa'i lha/ /dgyes zhal ston zla ngoms ltar 'dir spyon la/ /dngos bshams yid sprul mchod pa'i tsho gis 'di bzhes/ /rigs 'dzin bdag dang bsrung bar bcug rnams la/ /dus min 'chi dang dug mtshon nad rims gdon/ /zhi zhing tshe dpal bsod nams zla ltar rgyas/ /khams gsum dbang sdus dgra bgegs tshar chod cig /'jig rten spyi dang khyad par gangs can 'dir/ /g.yul 'khrug 'thab rtsod nad yams mu ge sogs/ /dus kyi chad pa'i ming yang mi grag cing / /bde skyid dga' ston dpal la spyod par mdzod/ /deng nas byang chub bar du re ma ti/ /(90nasgo la 'byor dgra lha'i gtso bor mnga' gsol na/ /mi 'dzad gter bum dpag bsam ljon pa bzhin/ /bsam don lhun gyis 'grub pa'i dga' ston stsol/ /dkar/lta bas mi ngom yid 'phrog sgeg mo'i gzugs/ /'chi med bdud rtsi'i gter gyis mchode sbyin mkhan/ /snying la kun dga'i dga' ston skyed pa'i ma/ /mdza' ba'i rtse dga' nam yang gtong min mdzod/ /ser/ nyin byed bye bas dpal 'dzin gser zhun ri/ /rab brjid 'jo sgeg gar gyi nyams ldan ma/ /bsam 'phel yid bzhin nor bu khyod nyid kyis/ /yid la 'dod pa'i re ba ma lus stongs/ /dmar/dmar 'od lcags kyu gcig gis 'jig rten gsum/ /'dar bar byed dang lhan cig srid dang zhi'i/ /snod bcud lha chen dbang phyug ral pa'i rtser/ /rkang sen zla ba'i me long mdzes par mdzod/ /mthing /mun ltar tshes gnag sems kyi kun slong dang / /rtsub sbyor lag tu bstar —247

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)pa'i dgra dang bgegs/ /dpung bcas snying gi khrag dron sbu 'phreng can/ /tshems dkar 'dab stong 'dzum pa'i ze'u 'brur mdzod/ /lha mo wo' 'a ma/ rlung gi shugs 'chang rkyang ser dre'u'i steng / /'jigasarung srin mo'i gar gyis rnam rol kyang / /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro yongs kyi dbang phyug ma/ /sangs rgyas kun yum khyod kyis rtag tu skyongs/ /bska ma ༅ gnyis/ /dang por gangs can bod kyi rgyal khamasakun/ /skyong bar gshen rabs mes po'i g.yar dam 'dzin/ /bar du rgyal dbang pad+ma'i bran g.yog ma/ /da lta rnal 'byor srung (90bsgo mthu rtsal can/ /bdud dang gnod sbyin sman mo'i tshul 'dzin pa'i/ /ru bzhi skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis po/ /bye brag gangs kyi yum mchen bkra shis ma/ /tshe ring dngos grub ster ba mched lngar bcas/ /khyad par mi 'gyur lhun grub chos 'khor rgyal/ /rten dang brten par bcas pa'i srung ma mchog /dpal ldan lha mo rdo rje g.yu sgron mas/ /mthu stobs dpung skyed las bzhi ma lus sgrubs/ /bsil tshal gur/ /bstan srungs dam can rgya mtsho'i sde dpon du/ /rnam par snang mdzad rdo rje srin po'i gzugs/ /stobs ldan nag po chen po gur gyi mgon/ /gar dgu'i rol pas 'dir spyon mchod gtor bzhes/ /e ma kun rdzob 'khrul ngor phyi rol nas/ /gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i blo brid sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ /dpyad na rang lus rtsa rlung thig le'i gdangs/ /'gag med dpal ldan mgon po'i zlos gar mkhan/ /kun kyang blo 'das brjod bral gdod ma'i gshis/ /gsal stong zungs 'jug rang sems nag po cher/ /nges rnyed mchog gi mchod pa dam pa 'dis/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyong pa'i mthu ldan shog /spyo/ /sems nyid gdod nas dag pa'i nag po che/ /rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi dbus srin po'i gzugs/ /byams dang snying rje dga' ba btar lha mes zhal/ /chos kyi dbyings nas gdangs pa'i zhing skyong dbang / /rnal 'byor lus dang grib ma ltar 'grogs nas/ /bsrung skyob mel tshe mdzad pa'i bram ze che/ /byang chub bar du nam yang mi 'bral bar/ /snying gi ze'u 'brur bzhugs pa lhag pa'i lhas/ /(91na8 rgyas dbang gi dngos grub ma lus pa/ /bsams pa tsam gyis yid bzhin stsol ba dang / /dgra sde'i snying la 'dam ltar brdzi ba'i bro/ /brdungs te mngon spyod las kyis myur du sgrol/ /0/ /skye —248—

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ tana'agro'i lus la srog gi bdud po sa /bran ze'i dmod pa'i las kyis nyer grub pa/ /pu tra ming sring gnod sbyin yab yum rnams/ /lha srin sdebargyad dmag gi ru 'dren mkhan/ /nang du ro rkyang dngas ma snang stong lha/ /phyi rol rlung ltar 'tshub pa dregs pa'i dpung / /kun kyang rang gis sems nyid rol pa'i rtsal/ /'bral med gsang rten hūṃ dang ro gcig lha/ /klu sgrub pad+ma badz+ra sa skya pa/ /mtshar chen brgyud par bcas pa'i bka' bzhin du/ /dam las ma 'da' sngags 'chang bdag cag gi /zhi rgyasadabang drag las kun thogs med sgrubs/ /chos tshang steng gi ga kho mgon/ /che mchog he ru ka dpal phyag bzhi par/ /rnam rol dpal ldan ma hā kā la sogs/ /bstan srungs dam can rgya mtsho'i tsho gis rnamasakyis/ /mchod gtor 'di bzhes mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /'ang / dregs pa pho brgyud mo brgyud gnyis med kyi/ /ngo bo dpal dgon ma ning nag po che/ /bstan srungs yongs rdzogs bran dang pho nyar bcas/ /rigs 'dzin dgra lha khyod kyis wen las sgrubs/ /cha stong / /rlung gi shugs ldan rta mchog sga srab can/ /zhen nas stong gsum myul pa'i seng ge'i gdong / /bdud mgon yab yum bam ro pho mor bcas/ /pha mes brgyud nas bsten pa'i srung ma che/ /snyan pa'i (91ba po byangs dang rngams brjid rol mo'i sgra/ /gsur chen dud 'thul dmar gyi a ji sbreng / /mi lag dar gyis g.yabs te khyod 'bod na/ /chos 'khor gtsug lag stong la thugs ma g.yel/ /steng na gtor ma'i ri bo ma nyil spungs/ /'og tu sman dang rak+ta'i mtsho ma bskams/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod tshogs 'di bzhes la/ /dusagasum g.yel ba med par stong grogs mdzod/ /chos lto shod kyi beg rtse/ /'char ga'i thun 'tshams ltar dmar bgrad pa'i mig /dgra la zhe sdang shugs kyis blta ba dang / /lhan cig rnon po'i mtshon gyisasnying phub nas/ khrag dron zhal du gsol ba'i beg rtse che/ /rgya gar li yul byang shar ma ru tse'i/ /dgra lha chos dang gnas kyi srung ma khyod/ /da lta dga' tshal dbang drag rol pa na/ /bstan dang dgon gnas skyong ba'i bshan pa che/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung rnams/ /sngags rgyas 'dzad med nam mkha'i mdzod chen por/ /rgya cher spel ba dgyes dgur legs spyad de/ /las kun sgrub la —249

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtonaganod sbyin thugs ma g.yel//rig pa'i lha mo/dred mo mi zan steng na 'gying bag gi/gar gyi dbang phyug ma tsho gis mkha' 'gro'i gtso/khrung mo rig pa'i lha mo gdong dmar mas//thub bstan de 'dzin sdodang bcas pa skyongs//khyab gcig rlangs na bun lta bur 'tshub pa yis//dgra rnams mi rtag lam du rab 'god kyang //bskal pa'i me stag lta bur 'phro ba'i spyan//legs nyes so sor 'byed la zlum por gzigs//klu srin gshol pa'i drang srong mthu rtsal can//srid 92na ) gsum rnam par rgyal pa'i stobs ldan kyang //nges pa'i don du khyab bdag kun tu bzang //bde stong zung 'jug thugs kyi rol pa'i gar//pad+ma thod 'phreng tshul khrims rdo rje dang //dri med 'od zer la sogs rtsa brgyud kyi//rigasa'adzin rim byon dam las ma 'da' bar//'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub par mdzod//dpe ko//rta mchog gsang bdag pad+ma ka ra yi//spyan sngar srog gi snying po rab phul ba//dgra lha khyung chen 'bar ba'i gsang mtshan can//sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po sku lnga po//gnyis med yum chen sprul pa blon po lnga//ru 'dren sde bzhin bcas pa'i dregs pa'i dpung //log 'dren dgra la rngams pa'i mche gtsigs kyang //bdag so gos sgrub por dgyes pa'i 'dzun zhal ston//gtor ma'i ri bo gas ba rgya mtsho ltar//bskyil nas lha khyod rtag tu mchod byed na//nyin gsum bya ra mtshan gsum mel tshe la//ma g.yel mthu stobs nus pa'i dpung tshogs skyed//tsi dmar ba//dregs myos dgra dpung glang po'i mgo 'gems par//dpa' chen gdong lnga'i mche sder rnon po can//g.yel med g.yar dam 'chang ba'i dgra lha che//dpal ldan gnod sbyin chen po tsi dmar ba//li yul khrims ldan dmod pa'i las kyi shugs//dar drag skye rgu'i bla tsher dbang sgyur yang //bstan 'gro'i bde skyid spel ba'i snying stobs kyis/khur chen phrag par khyer ba'i srung ma mchog/gnod cing 'tshe ba nag po bdud kyi sde'i//ru mtshon sa la stol dang lhan cig par//rang srid rnam par rgyal ba'i ba 92bdan lce/tshangs pa'i yul sar khyongs la lha rgyal skun//rdo rje le skyal/gtsug na dam tshig gnyan po'i rdo rje yi//ri mo rtag tu ma yal legs bkrab//rnam sprul cir yang ston pa'i dge bsnyen che/2/༷ched 'khor sum brgya drug cur bcas pa rnams//

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'dawo mthong pha wang long bu'i sku mkhar la/ /dngos don thod ra rdo rje'i dra ba dang / /me rma zhabrug dbus 'ja' tshon gur phub pa'i/ /yid 'phrog pho brang chen por rtag bzhugs la/ /dngos bshams yid kyi rgya cher rab spel ba/ /sgo lnga dgyes skyed 'dod yon lnga ldan pas/ /lha khyod thugs dam gnyan po skong gyur te/ /bsams pa'i don kun 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /gza' gdong dmar nag /gdug rtsub me rlung mtshon char 'byug pa'i dbus/ /yak+ta dzol klu mo dmar sham gnyis/ /bsgos pa'i sras po gnod sbyin dmar nag che/ /gsang bdag lag na rdo rje'i pho nya ba/ /yang le shod du rigs 'dzin pad+ma'i drung / /sngon gyi mched zla'i lo rgyus dang bcas te/ /bka' yi srung mar khas blangs mthu rtsal can/ /gter bdag chen po smug po spyan mang khyod/ /he chen dha na'i dur khrod chen po nas/ /tshur spyon bdag sogs dgon gnas 'khor bcas srungs/ /gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs rnams/ /thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du rlag par mdzod/ /jo bo sto mas pa/ /sngon tshe laṅka'i pho brang sgo srungs mkhan/ /bar du rwa sgreng gzhi bdag phying dkar ba/ /da lta dkar mo'i ljongs kyi dgon gnas sde/ /g.yel med skyong ba'i jo bo rgyal mtshan pa/ /rta mchog (93na sko srab mdzes pa'i rgyan ldan steng / /dar thod lhab lhub gos can ru mtshon 'phyar/ /res 'ga' lha btsan drag po'i rnam 'gyur sogs/ /grangs med sprul pa'i rol gar cir yang ston/ /pad 'byung a ti sha dang 'brom ston rje/ /rgya mtsho'i mtha' can dge 'dun bsod nams mtshan/ /spyan sngar khas blangs g.yar dam ma 'da' bar/ /bde skyid dpal la spyod pa'i 'phrin las sgrubs/ /rta rgod shel lcags/ /e ma dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gling / /chos 'khor rgyal gyi sgo srungs rdzul can/ /gnod sbyin chen po rta rgod shel lcags khyod/ /dngos bshams yid sprul mchod pas mnyes byed na/ /rab dkar rta mchog zhen nas thogs med du/ /bka' nyan 'khor tshogs dam can rgya mtshor bcas/ /'dir spyon 'dzum zhal rdul bral ston gyi zla/ /nya rgyas lta bur rnal 'byor bdag la ston/ /phyag g.yas mdung dmar rnon pos dgra bgegs dpung / /thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du brlag ba dang / /phyag g.yon bsam 'phel yid bzhin nor bu yis/ /'dod pa'i re ba yongs skong —251 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()'phrin las mdzod//shing 'brug chos 'khor rgyal du gtor gsol ma rdzo dpon blo bzang mas stobs pa to skab snya dar 'bul rgyu zhi kha yig dgosatso cung ba bca bris po 'dod don yongs5'i snyem//byams brtse'i dpung gis bdud kyi sdo chen las//rnam par rgyal pa'i mi pham mgon po'i drung //'chi med du kū la yi gos bzang gi/rjes 'gro lha rdzas snyan shal phul ba'i dges//rgyal bstan dar zhing de 'dzin skyes bu rnams//zhabs pad rab brtan 93bakhrims ldan 'dus pa'i sde//dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel mkha' mnyam 'gro ba kun//bde zhing skyid pa'i dpal la spyod par shog/bdag sogs bskal par 'tsho ba ring po'i tshe//mchod sbyin brgya pa'i legs byas dpal thob cing //deng nas byang chub bar du mgon khyod kyis//rjes su bzung ste don gnyis lhun grub shog/de wā ko ṭi/rgyal ba kun yum 'dod khams dbang phyug mas//deng nas bzung ste byang chub snying po'i bar//gtan gyi skyabs gnas mdzod la bar chad kun//zhi zhing mthun rkyen dngos grub stsal du gsol//bgyis 'a/bstan srungs dbang po rdo rje gur gyi mgon//legs ldan nag po lha chen gdong bzhi pa//pu tra ming sring dam can rgya mtsho yis//'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub par mdzod//mgon kha mthil/dpal ldan ma he'i zhal can bka' sdod bcas//bla mgon dbyer med rnam mang thos pa'i sras//srid gsum bdag mo stobs ldan bram ze'i gzugs//beg rtse lcam dral bcas pas 'phrin las sgrubs//lcam sring /dbang gi skyes bu zangs kyi beg rtse can//sring mo rig pa'i lha mo gdong dmar ma//las mkhan srog bdag bshan pa'i dmag tsho gis kyis//zhi rgyas dbang drag las rnamasagrub par mdzod//tso lo//dpal ldan chos rgyal chen po sku lnga dang //sprul pa sras yum blon por bcasapa'i tshogs//bka' sdod gtso bo gnod sbyin tsi dmar ba//'khor dang bcas pas rnal 'byor stong grogs mdzod//gza'//dpal ldan kun bzang thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul gar//gdug pa 'dul phyir klu srin 94na tshe yasgos pa'i sras//lha chen khyab 'jug drang srong rā hu las//'gal rkyen kun sol mthun rkyen legs tshogos spel//po'i gdor mar nag/khyaX ༷jug chen po'i sras po gnod sbyin rigs//khyung

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ tanadamar zhon nas srid gsum kun myul ba//gza' gdong dmar nag dregs pa'i 'khor tsho gos bcas//bdag sogs rnams kyi mgon skyabs dpung gnyen mdzod//rdor gos//dam ldan snying nye mthu stobasardo'aphrul can//rdo rje legs pa ched 'khor tsho gos bcas kyis//nyin mtshan g.yel ba med par grogs mdzod la//mthun pa'i dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol//de wī ko gis sgron/chos 'khor gnas skyong rdo rje g.yu sgron ma//lha rigs jo bo chen po rgyal mtshan dang //gnod sbyin rta rgod shel lcags la sogs pa//gzhi bdag srung mar bcas pas 'phrin las sgrubs//shing 'brug nag pa zla ba'i brgyad gtor gyi dus stobs 'phrog dbang por phul ba'i snyan dar zhal yig ri bo ma' sum rgyu ba'i bsod nams phung po//dkar//bde chen 'khor lo'i dbus na 'dzum ldan zhal//rigs 'dzin sgrub por ston pa'i zla zhun skur//rnam rol gdong bzhi mgon po tshe 'phel lhas//'chi med srog gi ka ba deng 'dir tshugs//dmar//longs spyod 'khor lo'i dbus na rjes chags su//khams gsum brtan pa 'phrog pa'i zlos gar mkhan//dmar zlum spyan zur gzigs pa lhung tsam gyis//srid zhi'i legs tsho gos ma lusadabang du sdus//mthing //chos kyi 'khor lo'i chu skyes ze'u 'bru'i dbus//rang sems dag pa'i mgon po srin 94ba ) po'i gzugs//ye shes mtsho ni gyi gnyis 'dzin 'ching rgya dang //lhan cig dgra bgegs dpung tsho gos rtsad nas rdzo//sgo/sprul pa 'khor lor wo byed dngos brgya'i lus//rab 'dzin phyag gi rin chen zad pa las//tshe dpal stobs 'byor lung rtogs yon to kun//yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyasapa'i dngos grub stsol//spyod nyer bzhi'i yul kun myul ba'i bram ze che//gsal stong zung 'jug mgon po'i zlos gar gyis//rang lus rtsa rlung dngas ma'i theg le rnams//zung 'jug rdo rje'i sku ru 'grub byin rlobs//'khrul ngor shar ba'i dgra bgegs phung po la//gdod nas grub pa'i mgon po 'khor bcas rnams//gshed gyur srog bcad sha khrag dgyes rol nas//rnam shes mi bskyod rgyal ba'i zhing du spor//rnal 'byor bdag sogs dgon gnas sde bcas la//chos srid bsod nams phung por cher spungs ba//mngon sum rgyu ba'i ri bo ji bzhin du//thob pa'i skal bzang dga' ston deng 'dir stsol//2

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)shing 'brug hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes gcig nas rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i tsho gis su 'dod khams dbang phyug mar mdos bkang 'bum ther gnyis btang ba'i dus phul ba'i snyan shal kha yig bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ /dkar/ /ma lnga sgo gyur bag zha gdung mtshor mi zad dug /drungs tshwan dkar mdzes lha'i zhal ston la/ /sgo gsum bde skyid yan lag brgyad ldan chur/ /sgyur zhing tshangs pa'i bu mo dung skyong ma/ /ser/ /mtho ris lha mi'i legasabyas gter gyi dpya/ /gcig tu bsdus pa'i phung po gzugs can bzhin/ khyu ba lta bu'i skal ba legs thob par/ /mdzod cig 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug (95na〉/ /dmar/srid zhi mgrin sngon gnag snum ral pa'i rtser/ /dngos kun gyis 'dud dbang thang rgya mtsho las/ /rkang sen zla ba'i cod pan sgyu thabs kyis/ /drongs shig khams gsum yongs la mnga' sgyur ma/ /mthing / /gnod byed lta shog ngan sems mun khung du/ /sdig gos 'khyil ba'i dgra bgegs dug sprul srog/mthu stobs 'dab bzang dbang po'i mchu sder gyis/ /chod cig dmag zor rgyal mo re ma tī/ /ljang / 'jig rten khams kyi dpal 'byor yod do cog /mdos mchod nam mkha'i mdzod kyi sgo 'byed na/ /yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po ji bzhin du/ /'dod pa'i re ba skong zhig lhag pa'i lha/ /shing 'brug lo yar klungs rgyal 'ol dga' rnams kyi gtsug lag khang dang mgon khang kha shas la snyan dar phul ba'i kha yig dgos tshul stag ru ba nor bus byung ba ltar bris pa gser gzhung phan bde'i lang tsho/ /bsam yas/ /ches cher gdul dka'i 'gro 'dren dam bca' yis/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi bla nas blar mtho ba/ /bu ram shing pa'i snang brnyan byang chub che/ /mthong thos dran reg don ldan la sbyor kye/ rgyal kun mchod cing smon lam legs btab las/ /rnam smin gcig tu dkar por 'dzag nus can/ / nam yang bslu med rten cing 'brel 'byung ba/ /bden pa'i che ba phul du byung ba'i mthus/ /ma rig thabs mun khung 'khyil nyes brgya'i lus/ /bder sems mar gyur nyam thag dug sprul tshogs/ /thugs rje'i phyag gis dbugs dbyung lha mi'i rten/ /legs brgyud thar pa'i grong du myur 'dren mdzod/ /ngag gi dbang phyug 'jam mgon mi lusazol/ /nyer brten blo bzang grags pa'i chos srid bstan/ /dzuti'i me tog bkra nas rgya mtsho'i mthar/ /—254

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'daspel mdzad rje btsun bla ma zhabs brtan shog /bdag sogs 'khor 'khyams de srid mtho ris kyi/ /phun tsho gis bde ba'i dngos por longs spyod cing / /ring por mi thogs sgrib gnyis drungs phyung nas/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa thob par shog /khra phrug /sal ma yon tan 'bras smin grong khyer che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi 'byung khungs 'og min nas/ /de bzhin gshegs rigs ye shes zhun ma'i khams/ /sa 'dir dngos mthong rnam snang gtso dang 'khor/ /bsod nams sa bon tshogs kyi zhing sa sa /btab 'bras byang chub cher bsngo'i smon mthu yis/ /nam mkha' mdzod ltar 'dzad med dge ba'i gdugs/ /phan bde'i grib mar 'gro rnams ngal gsor shog /rang gzhan lus ngag yid gsum dge ba bcu'i/ /dbang byed blo ldan mkhas btsun bzang po'i gar/ /rgya cher rnam dpyod mtsho byung dgyesapa'i bshes/ /'gyur med g.yung drung lta bur rtag brtan shog /gser gzhung bde chen khang bzang gsar pa'i bdag /nor bu'i ming 'dzin gnyen 'dun 'bangs bcas kun/ /rnam thos bu yi nor dang rdzogs ldan mi'i/ /ring 'tsho'i tshe yi skal bzang 'thob gyur cig /lus can log rtog rnyog ma'i yid kyi mtsho/ /dpyad gsum dag pa'i ke ta gas sbyangs par/ /dkon mchog yon tan gzugs shar ma ga dha/ /bzang mo'i rnam thar kun gyi 'dzin gyur cig /yum bu'i jo bo/ /'og min zhing gi gtso bo'i skur bzhengs kyang / /rdo rje'i gdan la ku sha'i shā 'jam steng / /skyil (96na spung gcig gis bdud dpung nyer btul te/ /mchog gi sprul skur sangs rgyas zas gtsang sras/ /snying stobs phrag par rgyal kun sems bskyed khur/ /len khyod thugs rje bskul bar ltos min kyang / /nyam thag skye rgu ma bzod gdung shugs smreng / /chu yi lcid ldan dbus kyi dbyar rnga bzhin/ /gang gi snang brnyan thugs gsang dpal be lnga /yid bzhin nor bus gtams pas mthong thos dang / /dran reg ma lus khyod mtshan ji lta bar/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro kun 'dren pa'i don 'grub shog /dge bcu rdzogs ldan gos smin 'dzam gling mis//ring 'tsho'i tshe dang bsags pa'i bsod nams gter/ /mngon sum nyams myong bstar pa'i dbang thang la/ /spyod pa'i skal ba can du bdag byin rlobs/ /gangs can su la'i nags kyi sman ljongs 'dir/ /thub bstan —255

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)mya ngan med ljon grib bsil la/ /lus can mtha' dag bde bar ngal bsos te/ /skyid pa'i nyi ma gung nas 'char bar shog /'ol dga' rdzing phyi'i byams pa/ /gang sku ste 'us gzhogos pa'i 'tshe ba dang / /sa mchogo tsan+dan byugs pa'i sri zhu la/ /bsnyen sring med pa tshad med btang snyoms mthu/ /ma 'dres kun la byamasaldan mi pham mgon/ /dam pa rtag dkar cod pan nyer bcings nas/ /'chi med gdul byar chos ston gyis brel kyang / /'dzam bu'i gling nas dad pas gsol bde bas na/ /ma g.yel lhang lhang sgra 'dir snyan dbang gtod/ /phul byung thugs rje chen po'i nyi ma'i 'od/ /bdag snying 'dab stong dbus su nyer zhugs te/ /'di phyi'i legs tshogs (96bskyong rtsi ro bda'i bcud/ /myang nas kun tu dga' ba'i glu len shog /mgon khyod dam bcas gzungs sngags bklags pa dang / /thos rnams dmyal sogs gnasangan gar skyes kyang / /nges par btsal nas brtan te 'dren no zhes/ /zhal 'tshes bdag gi yang srid dus su stsol/ /'dis mtshon skye bar goms pa'i bsod nams kyi/ /phung po gzugs can bzhin du spungs pa kun/ /lus can kun gyi skyabs dang gling gyur pa'i/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /sto gyi byams 'a/ /'gro kun yid mkhar 'ong ba'i rjes brtse'i spyan/ /dkyus ring 'khor ba'i pha mthar de srid las/ /brgal bar brkyangs te ma rgan skye rgu rnams/ /thar pa'i grong du 'khrid mdzad byams mgon kye/ /bdag sogs 'di dang tshe rabs yongs bsags pa/ /legs byas mu tig 'dzad med shes pa'i char/ /deng nas byang chub bar gyi dbang thang snod/ /bla nas blar brtsegs ra bur 'geng par shog /phan bde'i nam mkha' 'bubs nus nag po'i las/ /sdig 'bras mthor brtsegs sngon med 'bigs byed ris/ /bsnyal te lus can dbang phyug ral pa'i rtser/ /bsod nams zla ba rtag tu tshes par shog /gangs can gser ri'i sbubs nas thugs rje'i nyi/ shar bas nad mug 'thab rtsod duḥkha'i mun/ /mthar byas bde skyid snang ba'i gter mdzod kyi/ /brgya phrag sgo 'phar 'byed pa'i bka' drin stsol/ /nor 'dzin dpal mo'i mngal du smin pa'i khur/ /gnam bskos mchode yon nyi zla zung gi khrims/ /mchog dman kun gyi phrag par (97na sko ser sbyangs kyi/ /gnya' shing 'dzin ri rtag tu lci gyur cig /—46

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'dasto mgon khang mthil 'jigs mdzad rdo rje bka' nyan las gshin dang //bla mgon dbyer med rgyal chen ngal bsos po//re ma twe dang gdong bzhi bshan par bcas//bdag so gos rnams kyi skyabs dang dpung gnyen mdzod//dga' tshe' rdzi sgo shi/bde chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs bcom ldan ma/khred pa'i rgyal mor yongs grags dmag zor lhas//bdag sogs dgra bgegs g.yul las rab rgyal te//'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub par mdzod//dga' tshes bcu po ba//dgra srog gcod la ha la nag po'i dug/dam ldan 'dod pa 'jo ba'i dpag bsam shing //rdo rje gur mgon gdong bzhi pu tra yis//dus drug mel tshe mdzod la bdag sogs srungs//dga' lke beg rtse/'char ga'i 'thun 'tshams ltar dmar bgrad pa'i mig/bdud sde'i dpung la g.yel med nyer gzigs nas//thal bar rlag mdzad beg rtse lcam dral gyis//byang chub bar du bdag cag 'khor bcas skyongs//dga' slo chos 'cho steng shod//sbas yul chos 'khor rgyal gyi gtsug lag khang //dga' tshal dbang drag rol ba'i pho brang che'i//chos srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kyis//dngos grub char chen 'bebs pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//dga' phro lamaspur dgos//snang srid lha srin dregs pa'i dmag dpung gi/sna 'dren sprul pa'i chos rgyal sku lnga po//gsang yum blon po las mkhan dang bcas pas//bsam don ma 97ba〉yus lhun gyis grub par mdzod//yo gyis/dkar mo'i ljongs kyi ri mtsho gnas bsrung ba'i//rta rgod shel lcags jo bo rgyal mas sogs//mdor na yul lha gzhi bdag tshogs rnams kyis//gzhis lam byes gsum kun tu stong grogasamadzod//ri bos wo//dge stso kun sgo yar klungs nub kyi char//glang wo ri bo'i ngos na 'dus pa'i gling //phun tsho gos bde ba chen po'i 'byung gnas kyi//bstan srungs gzhi bdag ma g.yel stong grogasamadzod//srid pa'i lha chen sham po la sogs pa//yar klungs shar nub mthil gsum nor 'dzin ma'i//yul lha gzhi bdag rigs dang brgyud la 'go/pha mes dgra lhar bcas pas rtag tu srungs//shing tsog lo gling stod chos rje blo bzang rgya mtsho phyi rten du sman sgom gong rgyas pa ngag dbang don 'grub kyis do dam byasanas gsang phung zhengs pa'i rgyal ba sman gyi lha'i sku bas la 'buX /'i snyan dar kha yig 'tsho byed ngag dbang lhag bsam gyis dgos

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)tshi byung ba ltar bris pa'i be+eḍū ya ṣ+ka sa dngos mthong / /rgan po'i blo 'chang rnam dpyod ma dros las/ /tshe yi rig byed chad med chu bo'i rgyun/ /skal bzang gdul bya rgya mtshor legs babs pa'i/ /byed po bshesaganyen drang srong chen po khyod/ /be+e ḍūr 'od snang 'byam klas zhing khams su/ /'ja' lus sgyu 'phrul gar gyis las dag 'gro /'dren pas ma g.yel 'di na gsol 'debs tshe/ /ma smad thugs brtses rtag tu rjes 'dzin mdzod/ /chos dkar bskrun las mtha' med ma rgan rnams/ /sman gyi bla ma'i go 'phang nyer thob cing / /phan dang bde ba'i rtsi sman ljon pa che/ /gso rig bstan (98na tha dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas shog /shing 'brug lo dpal ldan dmag zor mar dus rim gyi mdos bskang thog tu phul ba'i snyan dar zhal yig bsam pa lhun grub/ /gdan gsum tshang ba'i mgon rnams zhabs brtan cing / /rig 'dzin bdag cag slob 'khor sbyin bdag tshogs/ /bar gcod las rgyal chos srid legs tshogs 'phel/ /bod yul 'gro kun phan bder longs spyod mdzod/ /shing 'brug lo lho brag mkho mthing lha khang du 'bul rgyu'i snyan dar kha yig dgos tshul lha khang pa blo bzang dbang rgyal gyis byung pa ltar bro4tabang gzhu ris/gar gyi dbang phyug tshe mtha' yas pa'i mgon/ /grangs med gdul bya'i bsam pa lha lam ngos/ /dbang gzhu ltar bkra rigs lnga nye sras brgyad/ /legs byas zhing du sa bon smin pa'i 'bras/ /gangs kyi ra bas bskor pa'i sman ljongs 'di'i/ /'gro kun rdzogs ldan skye rgu ltar bde zhing / /gang de'i 'byung gnas zas gtsang sras kyi bstan/ /'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan du rgyas gyur cig /chos dkar 'dis mtsho ni dus gsum dge tsho gos rgyu myo/ /byang chub snying po'i rgya mtshor rtag 'bab cing / /nges par legs min de srid mngon mtho la/ /spyod pa'i skal pa bzang por bdag gis byin rlobs/ /shing 'brug lo 'phyong rgyas rab 'byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin gyis chos skyong spyi bye brag la snyan dar 'bul ba'i kha yig dgos tshul byung bltar bris yo 'di phyi'i legs spel pa'i sgo 'phar / /chos skyong spyi/ /gdod nas dag pa'i chos dbyingasamakha' klong las/ /gtum drag rdo rje'i tsha tsha cher 'bar bas/ /nag phyogs bdud dpung phye mar 'thag —258

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ tanamadzad pa/ /bstan srungs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams la/ /lha rdzas snyan shal 'dis mtsho ni dngosa'abyor dang / /rnam sprul 'dzad med nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo/ /rab phye mchod bya mchod byed dang bral ba'i/ /bde stong mchog gi mchod pas dgyes skyed na/ /zhwa ser 'chang ba'i chos dang srid kyi bstan/ /tshangs pa'i yul sar rab bsgreng 'gro ba kun/ /rdzogs ldan ltar bde bdag cag bsams pa'i don/ /lhun grub 'phrin las dbyar gyi mtsho ltar spel/ /dam gzor ma/ ji za'i bu mo yid 'ongs mdzes sdug ma//nges pa'i don du rgyal yum dbyangs can lha/ /nyi ma'i gnyen gyi bstan pa bsrung ba la/ /'jigs rung srin mo'i gzugs can re ma tī/ / gaṅgā'i yab gcig la 'gran lhag pa'i sems/ /mtshon byed rab dkar thags kyi ri mo can/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho cher/ /mi phyed dad pa'i mos slosaphul pa'i mthus/ /'gro ba'i phan bde 'byung — pa'i bstan/ /dkar phyogs zla gzhen lta bur rab 'phel zhing / /'di phyi'i legs tshogis nor bur bdag cag gi/ /yid kyi yol gor rab dga' g.yas 'khyil mdzod/ /dpos/ /dmu dang klu srin bsgos pa'i srog gi bdag /snang srid dregs pa yongasakyi sdod pon che/ /bod yul gtsug lag khang srungs bi hā ra/ /bka' nyan 'khor tsho gis rgya mtsho bcasarnams la/ /dbang phyogs gan mdzod las 'ongs 'jam mnyen dar/ /ne'u le'i mgrin sgyu ba'i 'dod dgu'i gter/ /phun tshogs lhor ba'i dngos kun dang bcas te/ /spyan sngar mthun pa'i rdzas su legs spel bas/ /'jigs chen brgyad sogs mi mthun rgud (99na lnga'i dpung / /mthu stobs nyi ma'i 'od kyis rab bsal nas/ / rtag tu phan bder spyod pa'i byed pa po/ /bsod nams snang ba'i dpal gyis skyong bar mdzod/ /shing 'brug gnam lo gsar tshes kyi thog dpal ldan dmag zor gyi rgyal mor snyan shal dar tshon sna lnga phul pa'i kha yig 'chi ba med pa'i dga' ston/ /dkar/ /nya rgyas zla bzhin 'dzum pa'i 'od dkar gyis/ /srid gdung mun pa'i smag rum gzhil ba dang / /lhan cig bde skyid ga bur gzegs ma 'bum/ /snying la sim pa'i rtse dga' dgod par mdzod/ /ser/ /bsod nams nyi ma'i dngos brgya 'dzin pa'i gzi/ /rab 'bar 'char nub spangs—259

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)pa'i 'od po ches/ /brgyad khri'i tshe ldan 'dzam gling skye rgu yi/ /skal bzang mngon sum myong ba'i dga' ston stsol/ /dmar/ /kun bzod pha mtha' 'ching nus sgyu thabs can/ /rjes chags dmar 'od gcig gis srid dang zhi'i/ /brtan g.yo phun tsho gos bye ba'i gtsug tor gyi/ /rtse mor rkang rdul rin chen phragamadzes mdzod/ /mthing / /mas stobs brgya byin rdo rje gdengs tsam gyis/ /nag phyogs lha min lkog mar snying phyung zhan/ /ngan sems sbrum ma'i mngal yang phyir lhung ste/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i dpal thob mdzod/ /ljang /u ma srid rgyas phur stong re ma twe/ /dbang phyug nyer brgyad gtso sogs tshul bzung nas/ /las bzhi sgrub la dbang po'i gzhu ris ltar/ /ston mdzad 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ /nges don shes rab rdo rje btsun mo'i gzugs/ /'khor lo'i mgon por mnyam sbyor rgyas 'debs ma/ /stong nyid snying rje'i (99ba)rang gzugs rgyal ba'i yum/ /e ma de kun sems nyid gcig bu'i 'phrul/ /'on te rig pa'i rtsal gyis ma 'gags gdangs/ /dmag dang zor gyi lha mor yongs shar bar/ /kun bzang rnam 'phrul las byung phyi dang nang / /gsang mchod nam mkha' mdzod gyi sgo phye 'bul/ /spyi dang khyad par gangs can sman ljongs 'dir/ /nad mug zhakhrug rtsod dus kyi chad pa'i mun/ /mthu stobasanyin byed kyis bsal bstan dang 'gro'i/ /phan bde'i 'od snang ches dkar khyab par mdzod/ /rigasa'adzin sgrub par glags lta yid srubs lus/ /'phrin las mig med rab bsreg ring 'tsho'i tshe/ /stobasa'abyor rgya mtshor spyod pa'i dbang phyug che/ /lhun grub 'chi ba med pa'i dpal thob mdzod/ /shing sprul nag pa zla ba'i brgyad btor gyi dus drag po gzi ldan dbang phyug la snyan shal dar tshon sna lnga phul ba'i kha mig 'khor 'a mo bsto ye shes rang ga4/ /dkar/ /bde chen tshangs rnga 'i gnas su tshad med bzhi'i/ /rab dkar 'dzum zhal 'od sa dus mun dpung / /mthar byed dpal ldan mgon pos 'chi med tshe'i/ /bdud rtsis snying gi bum pa dgeng par mdzod/ /dmar/ /longs spyod 'dab stong grol dbus rjes chags sku/ /'khor 'das kun gyi brtan pa 'phrog pa'i gar/ /sgyur mdzad legs ldan chen pos srid dang zhi'i/ /phun sum tsho gos pa'i dpal kun dbang du sdus/ /mthing / /snying ga'i chu skyes ba 'ad pa'i ze'u 'bru'i rtser/ /mig
