sku gsung thug rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ tanasman lta bur gnag pa srin bu'i zhal//dgra bgegs zar rngams stobs 'phrog dbang po yis//yid srubs sde dang bcas pa'i dpung tshogs100nasgo gros//ser/sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i dbus na 'bar ba'i gzi//brjid ldan nyi ma 'bum gyi dpal 'dzin lhas//lung rtogs yon tan bsod nams stobasa'abyor kun//dbyar gyi chu gter lta bur 'phel bar mdzod//ljang /phung khams skye mched sbyong byang lam gyi mgon//drag po gzi ldan dbang phyug rang sems dang //gdod nas dbyer med dag pa'i rnal 'byor gyis//mchog dang thun mong dngos grub char wo phob//shing sprul gung thang lha mo lcags phur ma la drung yig 'jam dbyangs dpal bzang gas snyan dar 'bul ba'i kha byang dgos tshul ltar bris yas cho mi yod smral das po//sprul pa'i snang brnyan mkha' ltar 'byam klas kyang //'di na gtum drag srin mo'i zlos gar mkhan//ma mo chen mo dpal ldan lcags phur can//dgyes zhal ston mtshan zla 'dra'i zhal gyis gzigs//dngos 'byor mar pa yid kyis rnam sprul pa//'dzad med nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo 'phar las//legs thon kun tu bzang po'i sprin phung gis//bstan srungs dbang mo'i thugs dam rab stong na//srid na mi mas nyes brgya'i mun pa kun//mthu stobs nyi ma'i 'od kyisamathar byas te//tshe dpal stobs wor rigs brgyud phun tsho gos kyi//pad dkar wo po gtsug tu rtag 'ching mdzod/shing sbrul 'ol dga' drung yig dar rgyas ba po shis kyis dung skyong rgyal mor snya dar 'bul ba'i kha byang dgos tshul ltar bris pa nyesams bas mdangs pho chu klung ji bral dang ba'i yid kyi rgyal mtshan rtser//srid gsum bdag mo yid bzhin dbang rgyal mar//rang blos sprul pa'i kun bzang 100bsgo cho de sprin dang //lhan cig srid zhi'i legasatsho gos kun 'bul na//dug gsum gyis rmonges nongs pa'i dri ma yis//khyod thugs chu klung rnyog par byas pa kun//snying nas bshags pa'i nor bu ke ta gas//legs drungs dgyes pa'i snang bas 'char du gsol//bsod nams phung po dar ba'i zhing sal//ring 'tsho'i tshe yi snye ma rab rgyas shing //rtag tu phan bde'i bkra shis dga' ston cher//spyod pa/ dngos grub sto shig dung skyong ma//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()me rta lo gsar gyi 'dod khams dbang phyug mar snyan shal dar tshon sna lnga phul ba'i kha byang dpag bsam ljon pa'i 'bras smin//ljang //yid srubs sdodang bcas pa ma lus pa//rnam par gnon pa'i mthu stobs rtsal kun gyi//pha rol phyin pa'i bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das//dpal ldan rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma//'jam dpal dus dgrar mnyam par sbyor ba'i yum//phur skyong srung ma'i dbus na re ma ti//dregs pa'i sdodapon nang tshan srid pa'i rgyal//'das dang ma 'das sprul pa bsam mi khyab//e ma mkha' la 'ja' tshon glog sprin bzhin//kun kyang rnal 'byor sems kyi cho 'phrul te//rang rigs dag pa'i rdo rje gtso mo'i gar//stong nyid snying rje rol pa las gzhan ci//lhag pa'i lha kye zhi rgyas dbang drag las/grub chen brgyad dang mchog gi dngos grub kun//bsams pa ji zhin dpag bsam yongs 'du'i 'bras//dus su smin pa'i dga' ston 'grub par mdzod//dkar/rdul bral ston zla ltar dkar dung skyong mas//nad gdon dbul phongs 'khrug rtsod mun pa'i dpung //101nasgo thar byas bde skyid snang bas swā la'i ljongs//yongs khyab bsams pa ji bzhin lhun grub mdzod//sgo/tshe yi g.yung drung 'khyil ba'i snod yangs por//bsod nams gyen nas gyen 'phyur phung po yis//mes po tshangs pas bsgrubs pa'i dbang thang dang //mnyam por longs su spyod pa'i skal bzang stsol//dmar//'jig rten gsum gyi ral pa'i cod pan rtser//rkang sen zla ba tshes dang lhan cig par//srid zhi'i khongs na gnas so cog kun gyi//phun tsho gos yon tan dbang du 'du bar mdzod//mthing //dngos bstan bag la zha ba'i dgra dang bgegs//gang du gnas kyang dmar zlum spyan ras kyis//gzigs nas sde dang bcas pa rab bcom ste//rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan srid rtser sgrongs //rdze rta na gag zla pho bas gtor gyi dus stobs ga dbang pol snya shal dar zhi sna lnga phul phe zhal yig rtsa khams skyong da sme lor shar ṣ+ṭhasmon da//ljang /srid zhi'i dgra tsho gos bcom pa'i zung 'jug sku//'og min zhing du bzhedasapa'i mtshan dpe'i gar//sgrib pa'i yid can snang ngo'i me long du//gtum drag srin po'i gzugs shar stobasa'aphrog dbang //byams dang snying rje dga' ba btang 2/mas zhal//'gro kun thar par bsu la 'dzum ldan

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhongs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 9)kyang //sdig 'bras mngone sum myong ba dgra bgegs kyi//snying khrag shub kyis 'dren la gdangs pa bzhin//ma rig 'khrul ngor grub pa dregs pa'i dpung //rang sems dag pa'i dbyings su he ru gaḥ/sgyu ma'i phrul ltar myong tshe 'phrin las kun//logs nas mi 'tshol lhun 101bgyis grub 'di mtshar//'on te kun rdzob chos kyi rol rtsed du//gtor ma'i ri bo btung ba rgya mtshor bskyil//phyi nang gsang rten mchod sprin dngos bshams dang //rnam sprul nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo 'byed na//lung rtogasabastan pa bde ba chen po'i dbus//zla shel ltar 'tshor zhi ba'i nyams ldan lhas//'chi med bdud rtsisa.a tsho ti'i lam//rab dkar mi shigs srog gi snab tshugs//dmar//bsto drug 'dab grol longasaspyod 'khor lo cher//khro chags nyams kyi gar brgya yongs brtsen pas//kun yid brtan pa cig car 'phrog pa dang //lhan cig srid zhi'i phun tshogs ma lus sdus//sngo//rtsibs brgyad chos kyi 'khor lo'i lte ba na//mig sman ltar gnag rab khros gtum po ches//dgra bgegs brdzis pas ma tshim rdul phran ltar//brlag pa'i g.yul du zhugs kye dpa' bo che//ser/drug cu rtsa bzhi'i 'dab ldan sprul 'khor nang //nyi ma'i dngos brgya 'dzin pa'i gzi brjid kyis//tshe dpal stobs lor gyen nas gyen 'phyur ba//'jig rten mes po'i mnga' thang rjes 'gror mdzod//me rta hor zla brgyad pa'i nang 'phan yul phyogs la phyin skabs srung ma rang bzhin gyi bzhugs gnas dpal ldan rtser ngosakyi bgrod de mchod gtor go dkar ldem gnyis snyan shal nyi shu skor sogs phul ba'i gur zhal pu tra rnams kyi snyan dar zhal yig zhi rgyasadabang drag byu gur/khyud gsum dregs pa spro bsdur la gcig ma//sring cig 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug gtso//gnod sbyin yab yum pu tra ming sring tshogs//phyi rol dur khrod brgyad myul srin po'i 26

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()gzugs//rtsa khams dngas ma'i ngo bo nang gi mgon//rang sems gsal stong zung 'jug dag pa'i lhar//gnas lugs rang ngo shes nas mchod pa kyi//ring lugs srid mtha'i bar du 'phel bar mdzod//rigs 'dzin bdag gi las bzhi lhun grub cing //'khor lo gsum gyis bstan la ri mor byed//ma dag 'khrul gzhi lam gyis rab sbyangs nas//was bu zung 'jug 'chang dbang nā ga rdzun dang //gnyan lo 'khon rigs 'jam mgon rim par byon//khyad par mtshar chen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug nas//rim brgyud drin can bla mas bka' bsgos ltar//'jig rten kun bde chos srid bstan pa rgyas//snyan brgyud slob bshad chos kyi sgron me gsal//sngags 'chang bdag gi 'di dang gtan 'dun gyi//las rnams bsams pa ji bzhin sgrub par mdzod//pu3//tshangs spyod gnyis skyes bden spyon//'jigs gzugs mig sman lhun po lta bur sngon//dmar zlum spyan gyis legs nyas gsal bar ltos//dgra bgegs thog gis brag ri bshig ltar choms//srid zhi'i dpal 'byor khab len rdo bzhin sdus//chos sriX yon to yar ngo'i zla ltar spel//drungs pa'i chu

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 9)bzhin nyes tshogs kun zhi sogs//'khor 'das kun gyi phun tshogs lhun grub mdzod/mchod dpon blo bzang mthu stobs kyis ri bo chos gling gi 'du khang du gnam rgyan phul ba'i kha byang phan dang bde ba'i gter mdzod/lda tsho gos tshone ba po mkha' la yongs bres pa//rgyal sras slob mar bcas la nyer phul bas//deng nas byang chub bar du phan bde'i gter//'dzad med longs su spyod pa'i skal bzang shog/zilaganon gyi lo hor zla bas pa'i nyer dgu'i 103na ton chos sde 'a po dpal ldan gos sbungs kyi sngags khang du dpal rdo rje 'jigs mdzad la bsam yas dang yos pa dang myur mdzad mgon po gtso 'khor rnams la khrom gos dmar po yug tshang gi snyan shalaphul ba'i kha yig 'jig rten gsum gyi mdzes rgyan//ches 'dod 'jo dpag bsam ljon//thun mong dngos grub zhar byung ster ba la//mtshar 'dzin byis pa'i mig rgyang thung ngur lus//thub bstan srog gi zungs gyur mdo rgyud bstan//kun mkhyen blo bzang grags pa'i ring ga lugs mchag/byams mgon dbus 'gyur 'chang du sprul sku'i gzugs//bstan min de srid 'dzam gling rgyan gyur mdzod//dus kyi byed po'i las shugs dar drag pos//sa la stobs kyis dbang sgyur mchod yon bzhi ldan dpung tshogs bshams tsam gyis//mi bsrun rgol ga gdong dmar 'dul bar mdzod//gangs can legs byas dpal mos bsus pa'i //na//bde skyid tshems dkar 'phreng mdzes 'dzum

tshal//bde stong ye shesadakyil 'khor gcig gi gzhin//bye ba phrag brgya'i zhing khams rgya mtsho'i gtsor//dpal wo khrag 'thung sna lis zlos gar mkhan//srin tsho gzugs44 myur mdzad gur mgon zhal//rnam thos bu dang 'dod khams dbang sgyur ma//beg tse lcam dral sde dpon sum cur yos//kun kyang ka dag rig pa'i rtsal snang du//ma bcos gdod nas grub pa'i kun tu bzang //ma rig gas sdang 'khrul ngor khro gtum can/khyud gsum dregs pa'i rnam pa 'byams su klas//steng na dam rdzas gtore ma'i ri ma snyil//'og tu sman rag btung ba'i mtsho ma bskams//phyi nang gsang mar lha lam pha mtha'i tshwa//'jal ba ji nga dngos bshams yid kyis sprul//sgyu ma'i rol rtsed mar rdzas ma rdzo 104bapa'i yul//ye dag rang ngo 'phrod pa'i gnas lugs kyis//bla ma yi dam chos skyong srung ma dang //rtag tu 'du 'bral med pa mchod pa'i mchog/mthu stobs mkha' lding dbang po'i mchu spyo gyis//bstan 'gror 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs dug sprul snying /khyung lta gtsug gi yid bzhi nor bulas//bde skyid 'dod dgu'i sa wo mi zad sku gsung thug rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag gleg bam gsum pa/ tanargyal po'i mnga' thang rgyas 'gro zhing //chab 'bangs yongs la nad zhabrug 5ge'i ming //grag min sumartsen 'dun pa lta bur mdzod//phyogs las rnam rgyal phan bde'i legs tshogis gzhi//theg mchog bshad dang tshul bzhi sgrub pa'i gling //chos srid yon to ma lus rab rgyas shing //sdang dgra gnod bzang tshe 'dir mngon 'gyur shog/zil gnon gyi lo hor zla cu gcig pa'i tshes bzhi la gnas sa lcogs tu sprul pa'i chos rgyal wo por sku mas snya shal gser skye mtsho go phyi nang ja khrab sogs phul ba'i snya dar kha yig bsam don lhun grub//snang srid dregs pa'i sde dpon mthu rtsal can//dpe har rgyal po gsang yum blon po sogs//pho nya yang sprul mngag gzhug bcas pa rnams//dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal rdul bral zla ltar ston//sgo lnga'i yul kun bde stong zung 'jug gis//legs tshim dgyes pa skyed par byed pa'i ched//'dzad med nam 105na7kha' mdzod kyi sgo phye nas//dngos bshams yid sprul mar sprin 'bul byed na//pad+ma thod phreng rtsal sogs rig pa 'dzin//rim byon dam tshig gnyan po nyer dgongs la//sngags 'chang bdag gis bcol ba'i 'phrin las bzhi//bsams pa ji bzhin thogs med lhun gyi sgrubs//spre'u zhes pa me lug gi lo gsar du tshes pa'i srid gsum bdag mo mchod dus phul ba'i snyan shal kha yig mchog mthun lhun grub//dar dkar/zhal khyim zla rgyas shar ba'i mod nyid las//sgrib gnyis mun pas sangs na de bskyed pa'i//srid gdung nyes brgya gzhan yang bcil ba'i lha//zhi ba'i las kun lhun gyis sgrubs shig kye//ser//nyi ma'i dngos brgya 'dzin pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis//zag med bde stong zung 'jug skyed nus na//tshe dpal 'byor ba'i 'od zer 'bum spros nas//bde skyid snang ba'i dpal des rtag khyab mdzod//dmar/rjes chags nyams kyis bla med ye shes kyang //'gugs par nus na brtan g.yo'i phun tsho gos kun//'bad med sdus la bsam pa'i 'dod pa rnams/26//ba 'jo dpag bsam yongs 'du'i mar slar

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)mdzod/ /sngo/ dug gsum dgra la dbyings nas khros pa'i zhal/ /rno dbal mche bsam rig rgya 'bral na/ /'khrul ngor shar pa'i dgra bgegs dpung tshogs rnams/ /rtsa sbur zhugs su bsregs ltar rdul du rlog /ljang / /bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i 'tshe ba'i smag rum zhi/ /chos nor 'dod dang thar pa ches cher rgyas/ /'khor 'das yon tan rang gir dbang du sdus/ /gnod byed yid (15babs sde bcas drag pos sgrol/ /gra bsam dar bas gra nang du zhang blon la mda' dar phul ba'i kha yig rdzogs ldan dga' ston/ /gnod sbyin sde dpon zhang blon chen po yi/ /spyan sngar gra nang bsam grub dar rgyas nas/ /nag zla'i tshes brgyad dus su ji srid bar/ /mda' dar mchod gtor 'phrin las bsgrub rten du/ /phul nas mi nor bcas pa gnyer gtod na/ /kun dga' dbang chen chung sri las thar zhing / /pha ma gnyen 'dun rtsa lag bcas rnamasal/ /nyin gsum bya ra mtshan gsum mel tshe mdzod/ /byams mgon dbus 'gyur 'byon pa'i 'dzam gling mi'i/ /tshe dpal 'byor ba'i bde skyid ma lus la/ /mnyam por longs su spyod pa'i skal bzang du//mthu ldan srung ma'i dbang po khyod kyis sgrubs/ /me lug nag pa zla ba'i brgyad gtor gyi thog gur zhal las mkhan gnyis dang bcas par phul pa'i snyan shal kha yig brgyud gsum dgyes pa'i dga' ston/ /zur/ /sngon rnam par snang mdzad ye rte ma'i gar/ /'gro blor rgyud gsum dregs pa'i sde dpon du/ /bsgyur yang gsal stong zung 'jug dag pa'i mgon/ /rang zhal mngon sum bsgrub bya'i rigs kun bdag /gzhi lus rdo rje'i grong du gdod ma nas/ /lhun grub gur mgon lcam dral 'khor bcas rnams/ /rtsa khams dngas ma'i bzhings su mi bral bar/ /logs nas spyan 'dren 'byul pa'i rang snang tsam/ /'on te sgyu ma'i glangs seng ji bzhin du/ /thugs dam skong ba'i phyi nang gsang ba'i rdzas/ /bshams na 'dir spyon dgyes par legs rol nas/ /bcol ba'i las kun thogasamed sgrub par mdzod/ /ljang / mig sman brtsegs pa'i lhun ngo ltar brjid (106na'i/ /dus mtha'i zhugs phung po'i gos gyon nas/ /dgra bgegs snying khar rngams pa'i bro brdungs mkhan/ /stobs—268

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'da'aphrog zhing skyong dbang po gdong bzhi kye//smin byed dbang gi chu bo ma nub cing //mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs na bun ma yal ba'i//tshad ma bzhi ldan snyan brgyud 'dzin mdzad pa//rtsa rgyud bla ma'i dam tshig nyer dgongs la//bstan 'gro'i bde skyid 'phrog pa spyi yi dgra/sngags 'chang bdag la 'tshe ba'i sgos dgra sogs//mi dang mi min bsam ga sbyor rtsub can//mi lus snying gi khrag rgyun dron mor 'thungs//kun mkhyen blo bzang grags pa'i bstan srid kyis//yongs khyab gdugs dkar gcig gi grib bsil la//brten pa'i 'gro kun rdzogs ldan dga' ston du//longs spyod rtsod pa'i smag dras zhi bar mdzod//mkhas dang grub brnyes tshangs pa'i ral klung nas//chad pa med 'bab snyan brgyud gaṅgā'i rgyun//kha'u brag rdzong bzhed srol ma nyams par//srid mtha'i bar du rgyas pa'i 'phrin lasasgrubs//dkar po nan cing rtags brgyad ma//rab dkar lha chen nus mthu ā ga sdu//mi bzad gdung ba'i dug kun yongs bcil nas//yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chu klung la//bde ba'i gzugs brnyan rtag tu gsal bar mdzod//ser//byin rlabs gzi byin rab 'bar bum bzang nas//med byung bdud rtsi tshangs bug lam brgyud de/ /snying gi za ma tog tu yongs 'khyil bas/ /tshe dpal bsod nams nyi ma bdun char mdzod/ /dmar//chags med kun la rjes chags brtse ldan zhal/ /rab 'dzum thugs rje chen po'i rgya mtsho las//brtan 106bskoyo'i chos kun 'gugs pa'i rlabs kyi 'phreng //nam yang yol ba med par nyer lha sgos mdzod//4 bdagra bgegs lus kyi rtsa khams 'khor lol//dug gsumalas kyis grub pa dregs pa'i tshogs//rab bdud srog gis gyi rnon po yis//bsgral nas rnam shes byang chub zhing du spor//la lta na kha/dgra srogs la gdangs zhal sgor mtshe ba'i dbal//khrag gis cher sbagasa'agro kun srog gi gshed//gnod sbyin yab yum pu lha ming sring rnams//las bzhi sgrub lamathu stobs rtsalaphyu pas shig/yo cha/dbang gi skyes bu ming sring bshan pa'i gtso//dmar zlum 'khyil pa'i ye shes spyan mig gis//bsam ga sbyor rtsub 'chang ba'i dgra bgegs rnams//rab gzigs sha khrag srog dbugasagos su rol// 69

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ smyoname lug sag zla ba'i nang du dpal ldan dmag zor mar mdos bkang 'bum ther btang dus phul ba'i snyan dar kha yig srid wor phung po//dkar sra brtan lcags ri gling bzhi gling phran gyis//yongs bskor lha mi'i 'dod yon phung tsho dbus//sna bzhi rin r+ṣa las grub ri rab steng //yid 'ong lta na sdug pa'i grong khyer can//nam rgyang mda' 'phang ngar mi mthun pa'i rdzas//ṣi 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas rab spel ba'i//phyi nang gsang ba kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin//nam mkha'i mdzod ldan mdos mchode 'di 'bul na//ston mas zla rgyas 'dzum zhal las 'phros zer//mthu stobs ches dkar snang ba yongs khyab pa'i//bstan 'gro'i bde skyid 'phrog pa'i smag tso dpung //gzhil bar mdzod cig 'dod khams dbang phyug ma//bdag so gos slob 'bangs sbyin bdag sdebacas107na ji//chos dang srid kyi phun tsho gis yon to kun//bla nas blar 'phel la la tsho zug rngu rnams/khrungs won sman gyi ljon pa wo por mdzod//bsil ldan ljongs 'dir nad 'khrug dbul phongs dang //khyad par rdo rje'i lko ma'i nad rnams ca//mngon sum lta ci ming yang mi grag pa'i//las bcol 'phrin las gos bu mchis par mdzod//ser/a ha mā sdi tsā rma shi rtso)rdzo gyis klo〉rtsa rtsa lho zhes /dar nag/ a sku〉tsār+sha shi⑩ tu yo gye sbyospyokā snosarba tshos lha ti/kurba skyo//dmar/a sma ka mā sto9 ṭī rtsa ka dwan pa ti bh+yobha ba sha r+sā su gaṇa sa pho rle sa mā sa tu//mthing /a ha 2diñtsar+sha no yuk+ta paXtor su shatrukhri brgya༄rdi dzi ya smin sdu pi ni gro skru//sde//lo ka glo sa༅: bi she lha ma do shā sde khus kyil ཿdha bi yas/ljang //bi yorwa men rma a rā ston kus/zangs kha ya nod ya glo d+dha hrī puXkā da ya pad+ma ti gro mnas2las khye kurba skyo//skyar po ba blo bzang legs ldan gyis dga' gdong chos skyong 'phul phe snya shal byang sgra lon mdzes pa'i dar dpyangs//bkra shis srad bu thags su nyer btags gos//dkar 'jam kha tshar ldan pa'i du kū la//rna ba mdzes par byed pa'i dar dpyang su//ma smad dang ba'i sems kyis legs 'bul na//lus༅ dga' bder spyod pa rgyal ba'i bstan//srung la gdong pa ston mas zla ba ltar//ston mdzad dpal ldan rgyal po wo po yis//dbyings nas dgyes pa'i 'dzum ༷༷ lhug par ston//lha khyod ma cu stobs nus pa'i

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'danyin byed (107ba〉tres/ /bdag sogs mi nor 'khor 'bangs bcas pa yis/ /nad gdon nyesabargya'i smag rum drungs phyung nas/ /phan bde'i snang bas rtag tu khyab par mdzod/ /me lug mchod dpon blo bzang mas stobs kyis ri bo chos gling gi 'du khang la zhig gsos byas skabs dmag zor mar snyan dar phul ba'i kha yig 'dod pa'i re skong / /'dod khams bdag mo ma gcig srid pa'i rgyal/ /dbang phyug gtso dang phur skyong re ma ti/ /grangs med mtshan ldan rnam 'gyur ston mdzad ma/ /rgyal ba kun yum dmag zor lhag pa'i lhas/ /'gyur med ri bo'i spo la chos spyod bcu/ /tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i khrims ldan dge 'dun rnams/ /nye bar 'du gnas kun dga' ra ba'i gling / /gsar du bskrun pa'i byed por gtogasakun la/ /glo bur rkyen gyis gegs byad nad gdon sogs/ /mi mthun nyer 'tshe mtha' dag rab zhi zhing / /ring por mi thogs lhun gyi grub pa yi/ /'dod pa'i re ba ma lus skong bar mdzod/a pa la dka' bcadakon cog rgya mtshos sgo mang grwa tshang gi dge skos kyi dus 'du khang du rgyal mtshan 'phan phye phur sogs phul ba'i kha byang phun tshogs ma rdzo sprin/ /rgyal mas/ /phun tshogs dge ba'i tog mdzes sham bu can/ /rnam dag lhag bsam yu bas nyer btegs pa//bla med byang chub mchog gi srid pa'i rtser//bdag sogs lus can kun gyis sgreng bar shog /'a3rnam bkra za 'og thags bzang dbang gzhu'i 'phan/ /yid mkhar rab sprul kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin/ /mchog gsum spyan sngar phul bas bdag gzhan kun/ /'di phyi'i 'dun ma lhun gyis 'grub byin rlobs/ /gyen ra/ sna tsho gis dar gyis cod pan phang phung du/ /'god mdzesanam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo (108na)'phar brgya/ /phye ba'i dge tsho gos yan lag brgyad ldan chu/ /kun mkhyen rgya mtsho'i dbyings su ro gcig shog /me lug lho 'brug pa'i srid kyi khur len pa mngon bla ma/ nang blon gsol dpon pad dkar rab rgyas/ /gros dbang byang chen ste se sogs kha shas dang / khams bde dge'i bla dpon phun tshogs rnams 'jig rten pha rol gyi ltad mor song ba'i tshe bla ma yid ma chos srungs rnams la gtor ma'i ri bo/ sman rag gi rgya mtsho sogs mchod pa'i bye brag spya rnam pa dang bcas gtang rag gi thog phul pho sa dar dzi5byang ma par sto chad ra r+ṣa/ /rgyal kun mkhyen brtse nus zhun khol ma'i chu/ /rab khros srin —271 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ smyonagazugs par du nyer blug pas//drag gtum mi bzad rdo rje'i tsha tsha yis//srid gsum sreg byed 'jam dpal dus dgra'i dbang //gang thugs ye khro ma'i rol gar las//gshin rje gshed po zhing dang dmar nag gis//log 'dren klu bdud nag po ti pa tsa'i//zas su gtod byed mnan pa'i rna cha can//'khor 'das zil gyis gnon khyod bka' rtags rgyas//spyi bor rab brgyan bhe wa satwa zhes//rim bdun sa 'og lcags mkhar sgo med na//las gshin rje bla tshe srog gi bdag/gsur dud me rlung drag por las pa'i dbus//gza' rgod ngo bo stag r+ṣa smyon pa la//zhen nas stong gsum myul te dgra bgegs rnams//thal bar rlag byed legs ldan nag po che//zab gter skyong ba'i lha btsan bdud nag klu//glog 'gyu ltar myur mthu chen rnam pa bzhi//snang srid lha srin sdo brgyad yod do cog/'dus pa'i dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu kye//mon yul dbus gtsang mdo khams sa phyogs na//bsam ngan sbyor rtsub 'chang 'ga'i snying dron khrag/108bldob kyis drangs la dgyes skyed gtang rag dang //slad mar 'phrin las myur bar bsgrub rten du//dam rdzas gtor ma bza' bca' ri ltar spungs//bdud rtsi khrag chang btung ba mtsho bzhin bskyil//phyi nang spyan gzigs nam mkha'i khamasabakang na//tshim par rol cig dam can chos srungs tshogis//zhi khros pa'i mthu stobos bya ba kun//lhun grub ye shes rtsal shar khragatsong dbang //'phrin las rigs rnams kun gyi bdag nyid che//dpal chen rdo rje'i gzhen nu phur pa'i lha//lte bar legs bris kun gyi srog gi mkhar//bcas te bcud bral sde bcas spa bkong pa'i//dpal ldan 'dod khams gtso mo re ma tī//dbang phyug sras mo shugs drag rdzu 'phrul can//lha khyod mdzes sdug khro chags brdzing pa'i skus//zhi rgyas dbang gi las sgrub dung skyong ma//pho nyas su la'i ljongs 'di skyong byed pa//bstan ma bcu gnyis bdud sman gnod sbyin ris//theg pa'i yang rtse'i bka' skyong ral gcig sogs//lho brag gter srungs pho rgyud mo rgyud sde//khyad par zur phud lnga ldan 'bar ba rtsal//dkar bdud lcam dral phur skyong srung ma'i tshogs//mon khamasadabus gnas zhing bcu 'ga' zhig gi/bla srog rte/ ༷nga phral ba'i gtang rag dang //slar yang bcol

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'daba'i 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i ched/ /phyi nang gsang mchod nam mkha' mdzod ltar sgo/ /rtag tu zhi ba chos sku'i slong yangs las/ /'jam dpal rang bzhin longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /dus kyi dgra bor sprul pa'i gar mkhan can/ /mi bzad sgra dbyangs sgrog pa'i khro bo'i dbang / /gru 'dzin (109na ponas nas 'gro la gzigs pa'i spyan/ /mdzes sdug dkyus ring snyigs ma lnga bdo'i gshed/ /dmar zlum sdang mig gzi byin yid srubs kyi/ /snying la 'chi ba'i 'jigs ster myur mdzad mgon/ /gser sbyangs lhun bo nyi 'od 'bum phrag gis/ /byugs 'dras lha rnamasang la gsor byed pa'i bu/ /res 'ga' dbang drag sku yi rnam 'gyur gyis/ /gnod sbyin bye ba'i dmag sna 'dren pa bzhin/ /thod pa lcags kyi grong khyer yangs pa'i dbus/ /yi dwags bye ba'i sdod pon ma lha'i zhal/ /'chi bdag dregs pa'i pho nya grangasamed pa/ /dus me'i tsha tsha ltar 'phros srid gsum 'geng / /sdebargyad yongs kyi dmag dpon rā hu la/ /sprul pa'i chos rgyal bka' nyan tse'u dmar/ /kun dga' gzhen nu rdo rje legs pa sogs/ /mthu ldan dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams la/ /mi bsrun dgra dpung bsgral dang sgrol 'gyur gyi/ /ched du bshams dang sprul pa'i mthun pa'i rdzas/ /sa gzhi bar snang khyen kun bkang ste 'bul/ /'og min dag zhing mgon po rnam snang mdzad/ /bdud sde'i gshed du rdo rje srin po'i gzugs/ /srid gsum bdag mo dud pa'i sol ba can/ /lcam dral bstan srungs rgya mtsho'i sde dpon che/ /tshad med bzhi zhal 'gro la 'dzub bstan yang / /srid bzhi zhing skyong bam rig 'khrul ngor mche ba'i rno dbal rtses/ /dgra snying thal mar 'bigasapa'i stobs log dbang / shan pa'i dmag gi tshogs/ /lho phyogs bas mtha'i bram zes dmod pa'i 'bras/ /gnod sbyin yab yum bsgos (109ba lnga'i sras gyur pa/ /dam can pu tra ming sring snang srid 'gro'i/ /srog dbugs bla tshe yongs kyi gshed ma che/ /rdo rje'i thog gi rjes 'gro'i drag shul gyis/ /phas rgos phye mar 'thag pa'i gnod sbyin che/ /srog bdag gri thogs ro bshan nyer gcig sogs/ /gtum drag rngams brjid dregs pa'i dmag tshogs rnams/ /gnyer gtad sdang dgra srog dang rab phral zhing / /de bzhin bcol ba'i las rnams myur bsgrub ched/ /dam rdzas gtor ma khrag gi a lha sogs/ /—273

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)spyan gzigs mchod pas thugs dam gnyan po skong / /se ra chos mdzad blo bzang dge 'dun bro 'tshal ba'i dus phan bde legs bshad gling gi mgon khang du snyan shal dbul ba'i kha byang dgos tshul ltar bgyis pa gdung sel zla ba/ /tshangs pa'i sras mo srid gsum ma lus la/ /dbang sgyur dpal ldan dmag dang zor gyi lhas/ /thub bstan 'phel zhing de 'dzin bskal brgyar brtan/ /'jig rten khams kun bde skyid dpal la sbyor/ /khyad par blo gros lang tsho na dar ba'i / /skal bzang dge la 'dun pa'i nad gdon mun/ /lha khyod thugs rje'i 'od kyis bsal byas nas/ /chos srid legs tshogs dngos grub snang ba stsol/ /rtsa lag gnyen bshes mi nor bcas pa yi/ /bsod nams phung po yongs su legs smin nam/ /gcig tu rab dkar 'bras bu 'di dang gtan/ /kun tu spyod pa'i skal ba can du mdzod/ /sa sprel logs ra gyi gtor chen thog po ta la'i dbang phyug lha mo re ma tir mtshon sna lnga'i snyan shal phul pa'i kha byang dza lha'i snyem/ /dar ljang / /chos kyi dbyings nas sems can yongs ye'i don/ /bsgrub slad rdo rje khro mo'i (110na khor bstan nas/ /bde chen dga' bzhi'i ye shes them skas las/ /drangs te zung 'jug grong khyer sar 'khrid kyang / /yid srubs sde bcas 'dul la rngams pa'i kha/ /gnam sa lta bur gdangs pa'i re ma tī//rkyang ser rlung gi shugs 'chang drel rta la/ /zhen nas dgyes zhal jom bzhin gnas 'dir spyon/ /bkod legs dngos bshams rin chen rtsig ngos la/ /ting 'dzin pir gyis ri mor yongs bris pa'i/ /phyi nang gsang ba de nyid mchod pa yi/ /ngo mtshar sgyu 'phrul rol pa'i dgyes skyed na/ /dga' ba'i dpal ldan sde'i bzhi'i pho brang che'i/ /chos srid nyi zla zung du 'jug pa'i bstan/ /byams mgon dbus 'gyur 'chang du 'byon min par/ /rab brtan dbyar gyi mtsho ltar gyen 'byur mdzod/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las rgya mtsho cher/ /'dod don dzasbu'i 'bras bu nyer lhungs pa/ /bsams pa ji bzhin 'grub pa'i gser sbyangs/ /snye ma g.yur du za bar mdzad du gsol/ dkar/ /zhal khyim rdul bral ston zla las 'phros zer/ /'bum phrag 'od kyis nad gdon sdog grib sogs/ /nyes brgya'i mun pa mthar —274

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang mchod rdza khang bzang gi dkar glegs bam gsum pa/ tanabyas bde skyid kyi//snang ba gsar pa'i dga' ston rtag 'bar mdzod//ser/zad mi shes pa'i 'phrin las yid bzhin nor//dbang gi rgyal po las 'ongs tshe 'byor stobs//lung rtogs srid zhi'i legasabyas ma lus pa'i//phung po smo nas gyen du 'phyur bar mdzod//dmar/shes byar srid pa'i brtan g.yo'i lcags kyi rdul//rjes chags khyab len rdo 110ba〉sku 'khrul 'khor gyis//bkug ste dbang phyug sras po bgegs rgyal dang //skal mnyam 'dod pa 'jo ba'i sgyu thabs mdzod//mthing /ngan semasasbyor rtsub lce gnyis rkyong byed pa'i//dgra bgegs dug sprul sde dang tsos pa'i snying //mthu stobs khyud sder gyis phyung bgrang bya'i mkhar//phyogs las rnam rgyal gzhon pas nam 'phang chod//rtse dang nga 'od zer rgya mchos 3 tswa legs3da gling phe mas kho du snya dar tso skabs kha bya pa dgos tshul byung bltar bris yong r+sāms 4yi nyi 'od/'khor 'das phyag rgya thams ga zil gnon pa'i//dus dgra'i dbang po'i thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis//lus med khrung po'i gnod 'tshe rbod gtong byed//rgya mtsho'i pha mthar skrod la rdul du rlog/yun du 'tsho ba'i tshe dang dpal 'byor sogs//'di dang yang srid phreng ba legasa'aphel ṣ+ka //rang rig don gyi 'jam mgon kun tu bzang //rin wo mdzo du 'gyur bar bdag byin rlobs//sa sbrel brgyad gtor dus mgon po che sa mkha rnam pa gnyis dang cas par phul pa'i snyan dar zhal yig yid srubs sal 'dar gtso sgo gad yos//legs ldan wo po rdo rje gur mgon gyis//chos dang srid kyi phun tshogasam lus pa//dkar phyogs zla ba'i cha shas ltar 'phel zhing //nyes brgya'i smag rum drungs nas 'byin par mdzod//chos dbyings mi 'gyur mthing nag srin po'i zhal//yid srubs sdes la gdangasamache ba yis//dgra bgegs snying la bsnun pas ma tshim par//bam steng stang stabs tshul gyis bro brdung mkhan//rnal 'byor mngag gzhug pho nya bram ze'i gzugs//rdo rje'i 11nabs la gnas pa'i kho skyong dbang //gsal ston zung khrug don gyi nag po che//kun kyang rang sems gdod ma'i cho 'phrul tsam//dngos bshams yid sprul kun bzaX mchod sprin gyis//thugs dam gto po dbyings

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)su skong byed na/ /bod 'bangs phan dang bde ba'i dpal 'bar zhing / /bstan srid rdo rje'i srog gi ka ba tshugs/ /khyad par rigs 'dzin bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /mtho 'tsham dgra bgegs bdud dpung tshar chod la/ /zhi rgyas dbang gi 'phrin las ma lus pa/ /bsams pa ji bzhin lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /dug mtshon g.yul zhabrug rbod gtong la sogs pa'i/ /ngan sbyor gzhom byed kun gyi snying khrag rgyun/ /gnod sbyin yab yum pu tra ming sring gis/ khung kyis drongs la thal ba'i rdul du rlog /gnod sbyin chen po zangs kyi beg tse can/ /rig pa'i lha mo gar gyi dbang phyug ma/ /srog bdag gshan pa btsan dmag stong sde yis/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /sa sprel skyong phyag mdzod 'phrin las rgya mtsho dus kyi chos nyid du gyur pa'i tshe lha sa/ ra mo che/ bsam yas/ khra thig ri bo dga' ldan dang yos pa'i brten rten par snya shal/ /phye phur/ snam sbyar/ /'phan bla bre sogs mchod jos phul ba'i kha byang mtho risathar par bgrod pa'i rin wo them skas/ /phye phur thong gos skyer gser ma'i mthar 'ja' gos sngon gser mthong ldeb su dngul ljang brdung kyi ba po le'i gong pa rdo rje'i bum pa/ /g.yu dang spos shel sogs kyi phra bod stod gos ta khung gi stang stong skud tshon lnga'i ba po shisartags brgyad dang rgyal srid sna bdun tshem drug bcad gser skud/ de'i gsham gos nag steng se'u'i me tog /stod hor kyi tshos tshogos sna tsho gis kyi lte le brtsegs bcu re yod pa'i (111bsko so sor byu ru dang spug shel sna tshogs kyi rgyan dang stong skud kyi rdzob/ laganyi shu rtsa gsum re bod pa nang sha sman rtse byas pa'i lcags kyi 'dogs thag dang bcas pa cha gcig rdzo bo shākya mu nir phul ba'i zhal byang //bsnyen sring med pa kun la brtse ba'i spyan/ /'gro rnams byang chub brnyed min de srid du/ /gzigs pa'i dam bca' mi gtong snying stobs can/ tha kya'i gtso kye dri bral thugs kyis dgongs/ /mi bdag 'phrin las rgya mtsho lnga pa'i lam/ /deng zhugs bzod nga spu'i gnas ga len kun las/ /legs thar mtho ris rten bzang nyer bzung nas/ /phun tsho gis bde ba'i dpal la spyod byin rlobs/ /lha mi'i srid pa'i them skas la 'dzegs te/ /nges legs thar pa mchog gi ba gam rtser/ /son nas rang g.yin don kun lhun grub pa/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba'i go 'phang 'thob par shog /mtha' 'jag dang tshal bu rnams ma bas gser gyi me tog zlum rngos mā hor gos ser po'i rnam sbyar rdzo pog po'i cher —276

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'dartsa yo'i sa byang //thun 'tshams lang tsho'i dpal 'dzin thags ris ngos//gser sbyangs gzhi mdzod ris zlum skor gyis//legs btegs ba po shis rtags brgyad ri mo can//hor gos las grub dge sbyong na bza'i mchog/sa dbang 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i phan bde'i rgyur/shākya mu ni'i drung phul bsod namasakyi//phung po srid pa'i rtse mo las brgal rgyun//chad med byang chub rgya mtshor 'bab gyur cig/sto gos ding phon gser thag kyi bla bre jo bo kya ku nir phul ba'i kha byang //dbang po'i gzhu ris mkha' la bla bres pa//sna tshogs ri mo'i bkod pa khyad par can//don kun grub dang mtshungs112ba lnga'i snang brnyan la//lhag bsam dag pas sri zhu'i ched spel bas//sa dbang 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i skye 'phreng du//sum rtsen bdag po'i bde ba ltar myong ṣ+ka //ring min rang gas don gnyis lhun grub pa'i//dpal ldan stobs bcu mnga' ba mngon 'gyur shog/lha sar thugs rje wo po bas stog khi la tsho ba'i rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()gcod gnam lcags thog/dran pas yid kyi gdung sel zhal bzhi pa//snying dbus 'dab brgya'i ze'u 'brur rtag bzhugs mdzod//mgon po kog khas ma la men dmar po khagasum/lha khyod g.yar ngo 'phyar ba'i mod nyid la//gnag pa'i bsam sbyor 'chang ba'i dpung bcas rnams//phye mar 'thag pa'i legs ldan nag po ches//bstan dang bstan 'dzin sde dang bcas pa skyongs//tshe bgal khyab khas 'do mor/gang gi mthu stobs nus pa'i dpung r+ṣa pos//'khor 'das phyag rgya ma lus zil gnon phyir//'jam dpal dus dgrar khros pa tshe bdag nag/ban bon byad kha rang gshed rang la phob//tse ro ka la go po ga mi a wel//'khor 'gro srid do cog gi gnya' ba na//gdod nas grub pa'i 'chi bdag yab yum gyis//gnam sa lta bur gdangs pa'i kha nang du//dgra bgegs gnod byed bstab bo kha gi khāhi//stag wo la la bshas 'dom lor/snang srid sdo brgyad rba klong 'khrug pa'i dbus//stag r+sā spyon par zhen nas dgra bo'i bla//'gugs mdzad dpal mgon legs ldan nag po yis//gnod byed gdug ba'i tsho gis rnams tshar chod cig/ma cu' sgeg la lnga ba kho 'dom lor/zab gter bstan skyong lha bas bdud kyi bu//klu bdud rdo rje spyan gcig mar bcas pa'i//mthu chen sdo bzhi 'khor bcas khyed rnams kyis//'gal rkyen kun sol mthun rkyen ma lus sgrubs//mgon kho bar dam gzor mar ling kug gsus la/dbyangs can nges pa'i don du dbyings phyug lha//ma mo'i gtso mor rab sprul re ma tis//bstan dang bstan 'dzin rnal 'byor legs skyongs la//yid srubs sde bcas ba dan sal stol//de r+sā 'i dam gzor mar gosastor ༅ tso phal/kun la btang snyoms spros bral nyer zhi'i gdangs//chos kyi dbyings nas yongs la rtag 'char yang //dgra bgegs gshed du khro gtum srin mo'i gzugs//ston mdzad dmag dang zor gyi sna 'dren ma//khyod sku dkar ser dmar mthing dbang gzhu'i mdog/gcig las du mar sgyur ba'i gar mkhan gyis/sgyu 'dod 'phrin las sgrub pa rig pa'i rtsal//mkha' la 'ja' 'dra'i tshul du ngesapa rnyed//dregs pa'i tshul 'dzin ma mo srid pa'i shul//sgos pa'i bu mor dbyangs can lus phra'i

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chags gsab ma gsum pa/ 9)tshul//'khor lo'i gtso mor rdo rje dbyings phyug ma//mchog dman bar par 'dzin pa zhabrul pa'i blo//e ma dang pa'i mtsho la snang brnyan bzhin//gang gang thabs kyis 'dul ba'i sgyu ma mkhan//nges pa'i don du kun tu bzang mo 19na 〉 ga/bcos min yid kyis gsol ba gdab byed na//rgyal bstan de 'dzin srid dzi bod 'bangs bcas//bsod na mas dzasbu'i snye ma zad mi shes//rtag par longs spyod sems la gdung ba'i tsher//mngon sum lta shog ming yang med par mdzod//khyad par rig sngagasa'achang ba bdag cag la//sa bya lcags khyir rtsub pa'i bar gcod mun//thugs rje'i skya rengs kyisadrangs mthu stobs nyis//mthar byas phan bde'i snang ba 'bar bar mdzod//dgra sde'i dpung chomasasrid gsum dbang du sdus//tshe dpal 'byor rgyas nad gdon nyer lce dang //r+sā mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa kun zhi ba'i//'phrin las sgo phye dmag zor lha mo kye//lha tsho gser skur khyabs dkar po/lha khyod bsten pa'i mod la yongs bo dang //bum bzang 'dod las ba mo ji wob du//sngon ho btsosadon lhun gyis grub pa ltar//byang chub thob med de srid sgrub par mdzod//bstan la khyabatags 'dom 'khor legs//gnas srungs mkha' 'gro'i dbang mo bsko/ sgron ma//gtsor gyur bod skyong bstan ma bcu gnyis tshogis//rigs 'dzin pad+ma'i dam tshig nyer dgongs la//deng 'dir bcol ba'i 'phrin las yid bzhin sgrubs//sil pa i gur mgon po la kha bas 'dom wor/rnam snang thugs kyi klong nas nag po che//mi'u thung srin po'i zlos gar sgyur pa la//bstan srungs rgya mtsho'i sdod pon gur mgon zhes//'phags bod kun tu nyi zla ltar grags lha//mchog sred la sogasapaṇa grub bgrang yas dang //rin bzang mal lo 'jam dbyangs sa skya pa//rim par byon 119bapa'i dam tshig rdo rje'i thod//'chang ba ji bzhi thub pa'i bstan pa srungs//khyad par rnam dag dbang gi rgyun ma nub//man ngag mkha' 'gro'i kha brlang ngad ma yal//snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan 'dzin bdag gis//bcol ba'i 'phrin las ma lus myur sgrubs mdzod//zhal la gas thas 'dom wor/dag pa'i snang bar byed med bzhi yi sgo//log 'dren dgra bo'i 'khrul

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()ngor gdangs pa'i zhal//chem chem bam ro bzas kyang ma tshim par//zhing bas steng du bro rdung stobasa'aphrog nag/klu sgrub rnal 'byor dbang mo lo chen gnyan//'khor rigs 'jam mgon gdung gsob rim byon dang //khyad par kun spangs bla ma mtshar pa rje//yab sras brgyud pa'i dam tshig nyer dgongs la//bstan 'gro'i legs tshogs yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas//rigs 'dzin bdag gi cho so srid yon tan spel//gnag pa'i dgra bgegs ma lus rdul du rlog/phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i 'phrin las sgrubs//pu tra la kha btags 'dom 'khor//gnod sbyin yab yum pu tra lcam dral rnams//klu sgrub pad+ma thod 'phreng sa skya pa//rtsa brgyud bla ma'i dam dgongs deng gi dus//bdag gis bcol ba'i labs bzhi ma lus sgrubs//chog yang steng du chos skyong spyir gos nag ༅ tso phul/khro chags 'jo sgeg la sogs rnam rol gyis//bstan pa skyong la dpag dka'i rdzu phrul can//dam ldan srung ma rgya mtsho'i tsho gis rnams kyis//bsams pa'i don kun lhun gyis grub par mdzod//4skyong la dar mthing /pha mes rigs kyi srung ma bdud kyi mgon//seng ge'i gdong can lcam dral 'khor bcas kyis//bdag (120na〉 mtho 'tshams dgra bgegs ma lus sgrol//chos srid legs tshogis bla nas blar 'phel mdzod//beg rtse masrang la kha bas 'dom sgyur/kyi zangs khrab can skyes bu dbang gi mdog/lcam dral srog gshed bshan pa nyer gcig sogs//'khor bcas mthu dpung bskyed la bdag cag gis//bcol ba rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las myur du sgrubs//rig pa'i lha mo la kha btags 'dom 'khor//rig pa'i lha mo mi zan dred zhen te//stong gsum skad cig myul nas bas / ga dang //sbyor ba rtsub ston dgra bgegs gar 'dug kyang //snying khrag 'thung la pags rlon gos su gyon//rā hu lar kha bas 'dom 'khor//lus la khrag gi mig stong rab gsal bas//gzigs nas steng 'og phyogs mtshams gar gnas pa'i//gnod byed gzugs can gzugs med bdud kyi sde//thal bar rlog cig gza' bdud rā hu la// 88

sku gsung thug rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'dargyal po lnga la khyab khas 'dom snyor/khyod kyi mthu stobs yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal//'phrin lasargyal mtshan rtse mor bkod pa'i tshe//bsams pa lhun gyis grub pa'i 'dod dgu'i char//phob cig sprul pa'i chos rgyal sde lnga po//gos bar khyabaskas sa mi kha/li yul khrims ldan dmod pa 'grub pa'i 'bras//gnod sbyin chen po ya ba skya bdun gyis//sde brgyad dmag gi kha lo nyer bsgyur nas//dgra dang bgegs kyi dpung tsho gos phye mar rlogs//rdor legs la khyabaskas zang kha/mched 'khor sum brgya drug cur bcas pa yis//pad+ma'i bka' rtags gtsug na nyer bstan bzhin//ma g.yel ma g.yel bcol pa'i las rnams kun//myur du 120ba tshe skrubs shig dam can thig le rtsal//gza' gdong dmar na galakhayo shas 'do yong/gza' rgod mig dmar bshan pa'i dbang po khyod//pad+ma thod phreng tha tshig nyer dgongs la//rigs 'dzin bdag la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs snying //thod par blug nas zhal du chem chem gsol//rdzo bo rgyal4zha par kha pa khas 'dom lor/sngon tshe laṅka'i yul du dkar po'i phyogs//skyong ba'i mthu ldan jo bo rgyal mas pa//mar gtor snyan shal rdzas kyis nyer stong na//bar gcod kun sol mthun rkyen sgrubs par mdzod//rta rgod shel lcags la khabs 'dom lor/te se'i mdzes pa 'phrog pa'i gangs ri la//gnas bcas gnod sbyin rta rgod shel lcags la//dngos 'byor yid sprul mthun pa'i rdzas 'bul na//gzhi lam byes gsum kun tu stong grogs mdzod//ma 'dag 'a lcog gi rgyalapor khabs 'dom lor/chos rgyal chen po gsang yum sprul pa lnga//pho nya blon po bka' stod bcasarnams kyis//'gro kun bde zhing 'dren pa'i bstan pa rgyas//rigs 'dzin bdag gi bsams don lhun grub mdzod//won pa lag mang gi dar lcog la tsho rgyu/yid bzhin 'dod pa 'jo ba'i gdengs can dbang //'dzad med rin r+ṣa gter gyi sgrom bu las//bsam pa'i re ba ma lus yongs skong zhing //// /phyug dbul phongs nyes brgya zhi bar mdzod//sa bya zla ba7kha'i 7lnga nas gong wo snyun gyi bar ba smo bom bu gla snang gsum gyi rten brten pa'i tshogs la brgya ma// sna lnga phul zhing gser chab spyan 'byed bgyis pa'i dus phul ba'i

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)snya dar zhal byang 'di phyi'i 'dun ma lhun grub/ /bsam yas su byang chus 'a por/spang rtogs mtho dma' med mnyam sangs rgyas kyi/ /rang bzhin mtshungs (121na thar thugs rje cher snyoms kyang / /snyigs ma'i 'gro 'dren snying stobs khyod gcig pus/ /khur ba'i dam bca' gtong min shākya'i rgyal/ /mtshan dpe'i snang brnyan dngos lta'i skal phra rnams/ /mthong thos dran reg don ldan la sbyor ba/ /khyad par 'byed pa'i skabs bral byang chub che/ /legs byas rgya mtsho'i zhing mchog nyer dgongs kye/ /phan bde'i gzugasasgrib nyon mongs shes bya'i mun/ /bsags kun gang byin mthu yi nyi 'od kyis/ /rab bsal sim par tshor ba'i snang ba la/ /deng nas byang chub bar du spyod par shog /'gro rnams dkar min las skyes zug rngu'i tsher/ /thugs rje'i bcad kyis dbyung nas rtag bde zhing / /de rgyu rgyal bstan rin chen mu ku ṭa/ /'jig rten gsum gyi thod du mdzes gyur cig /khyod kyi byams pa chen po'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /ljongs 'di'i yid srubs ma lus gdong smad de/ /dkar phyogs skyong bar zhal 'tshes rnams kyi mthu/ /'phel ba'i thugs rje'i 'jug pa nyer stsol zhig khyatso ga /som nyi dang bral dad can 'gro rgyud la/ /byin rlabs 'dug par chags thogs mi mnga' ba/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi thun mong yon tan te/ /thugs rje bskul bar gsol la nyer dgongs shig /bdag sogs mkha' mnyam skye rgyas nyer spyod pa'i/ /nag po'i las kyi rtsa lag drungs phyung nas/ /byang chub bar du sgo gsum bde skyid la/ /rtag tu spyod pa'i skal bzang mchog sbyin stsol/ /bod yul phung byed nag po'i ris kyi stobs/ /'joms par dkar phyogs la 'dun lha rnams kyi/ khyud las sras bcas rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i mthu/ /(121ba〉da med myur du 'jug par mdzad du gsol/ /yom bu bla nga / bsnyan sring mi mnga' byams pa'i go cha yis/ /sems can spyi dang khyad par ldan gangs ljongs 'gro /bdag sogs mos par ldan rnams yid srubs mdas/ /nam yang 'bug pa med par byin gyis rlobs/ /sa bya zla ba bzhi pa'i sangs rgyas sku ltams pa'i dus chen tshes bdun nas bzung bdud btul te sangs rgyas pa'i du tshes bco lnga'i bar ra sa 'phrul snang / ra mo che/ po ta la dang 'i bcas pa gnas rten khyad par can rnams la brgya mchod sna lnga phul zhing zhal 290

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 9)gser spyan khed bgyis pa'i dus snya shal phul ba'i zhal byang ༅ lis phan bde'i dpal ster//jo bo rin po che/dran pa'i mod la srid zhi'i nyes brgya'i tshogs//yongs bcil lus can rnams kyi ma 'dris bshes//don tso grub pa'i bgraganyis bgrang bya yi//zhal skyin shākya mu ni'i snang bas mchog/'gro ngor rin chen zhun ma'i skur shar yang //nges par dus gsum bde gshegs kun 'dus lha//phul byung bsod nams zhing du nges brnyed nas//nam mkha'i mdzod kyi mchod sprin stobs la spro//sngon bsags las nye zhe 'brasabu'i ba mo rnams//thugs rje'i nyi shar mod la nyer dag ste//sgo gsum gcig tu bder gnas bstan 'tsho don//sgrub pa'i 'dod 'jo yongs bo'i dper byin snos//'bor 'byams 'gro ba'i zug rngu zhi ba'i sman//lung dang rtogs pa'i rgya mtsho cher rgyas stor//'gro bsngo'i bsod nams chu klung 'dusaso cog/byang chub snying po'i klong du ro gcig shog/lag na rdo rje 'chang bas mu stegs sde//btul ba ji bzhi ljongs 'di'i nag po'i dpung //bdud ris ming tsam lhag byas dkar po'i phyogs//skyong rnams mthu dpal 'bar par khyod byin 122na tshos//bas snyig spyo/lha gcig ba'i da las nyer 'phros dus mtha'i mes//gdug pa'i lha srin btul ltar deng gi dus//gzengs mtho'i nag phyogs ma lus rab bcos ste//dge ba'i dar chen srid rtser bsgreng bar mdzod//yos lha mi ge gro//kun la btang snyoms byams pa chen po'i rtsis//bdud ris rtsub sems lcags khams gser sbyangs su//legs sgyur rab dkar phan bde'i snang ba yis//gangs can swā la'i ljongs 'di gang bar mdzod//mar me mdzad/srid 'khyams yid can kun gyi ma rig mun//gang gi byin rlabs mar me cher spar nas//gsal mdzad bde skyid snang bas kun mthong bar//slar yang mgon po thugs rje'i mthu dpung skyed//bla ma lha khang du rje rin po cher//blo gros yangs pas mkhas btsun bzang po'i gar//legs sgyur grags pa kun khyab btsong kha pa//'jam dpal dus dgra'i ngo bor thugs bskyed nas//nag po'i rtsa lag ma lus zhi bar mdzod//dpal lhar/he ru gar sbyor rdo rje bas tsho sku//ṣ+ka gas tshod du dmag dang zor gyi lha//zhi rgyas dbang gi las sgrub dung skyong ma//daX ba'i yid kyis gsol ba ma g.yel dgongs//nyer

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()'tshe'i nad gdon de bskyed dug gsum bcas//rab bsal tshe dang bsod nams dbang thang rgyas//'khor 'das legs tshogos ma lus sdud byed pa'i//'phrin las smon pa ji bzhin lhun grub mdzod//kha ba'i ljongs 'dir nad rims dbul phongs dang //g.yul 'byug dus kyi chad pa kun zhi zhing //deng dus nag po'i rtsa lag lus med dpung //cher chod dkar phyogs rgyal 122ba lnga'i ru mar sgrongs//'phagatso los sha ra/khyud lnga'i lus can rnams la nyer brtse yang //bod yul khyod sa 'dul ba'i zhing yin pas//nag po'i lha srin 'tshub pa'i sbyor ga kun//khrag 'thung rta mchog skur bzhengs tsho gcod cing //sngon gyi smon lam thugs bskyed bden pa'i mthus//ljongs 'di'i 'gro rnams sum rtsen lha yi tshe//rmugs 'dzin 'byor bar spyod pa'i skal bzang du//legs bsgyur nyes brgya'i zug rngu drung 'byin mdzod//snying nas gus pas gsol ba nyer gdabs rnams//lusang ga yid kyi gdung ba kun zhi zhing //deng nas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen min par//mgon skyabs bshes gnyen mdzod cig 'jig rten dbang //lags pa rta bsgo po//gar dbang mgon po'i spyan sngar 'gro ba spyi//khyad par bod yul skyong bar zhal 'tshes pa'i//ba ched pa ji bzhin 'grub pa'i snying stobs khur//brtson pa'i 'phrag par longs shig wa ti bzang //ra rdzo tsho jo bor//sa spyod kṛ zhi'i bsod nams mar stong d+ku//bskal bzang 'dren pa gsum pas byin bsas pa'i//mthong thos dran reg mi bskyod rdo rje zhes//don grub brgyad pa'i sku yi snang bas drung //dngos 'byor yid sprul kun bzang/mar pa'i sprin//spyan sngar yongs bstar thugs rje nyer bskul na//dbus 'gyur 'chang du lus med btul ba bzhin//nag po bdud sde'i tshogs rnams zhi bar mdzod//byams thugs te se'i gtsug tor las babs pa'i//byin rlabs yan lag brgyad ldan chu bo yis//bdag sogs kha ba'i sman ljongs 'gro rnams kyi//nyes brgya'i dri ma ma lus123nabakru byin rlobs// 9

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 9)sa bya hor zla bzhi pa'i nang du rnam par rgyal pa'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa rnams kyis nyin bdun gyi bar dri za'i rgyal po rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal gyi gsang ba'i spyan gzigs dang bcas pa zabs gsol bgyis pa'i thog phul ba'i snyan dar zhal byang dngos gruba'adod pa 'jo phe bum bzang / /mi bsrun sdebargyad 'dul ba'i gnyen po sa /byang chub sgos dpa' nam mkha'i snying po gang / zhal ging gnam lha dkar po'i skur bstan pa/ /zur phud lnga pa rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal/ /gsang yum rdo rje g.yu sgron gnam mtsho'i rgyal/ /mched 'khor gtsang ma'i ris kyi tshogs rnams kun/ /pad+ma thod 'phreng ga kho ston rgod ldem sogs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i dam tshig nyer dgongs la/ /nad rims g.yul gzug byad phur sde brgyad kyi/ /nyer 'tshe bar du gcod pa'i phyogs rnams kun/ /lha khyod zhi rgyas dbang drag zlos gar gyis/ /mthu stobs gnam lcags 'bar bas phye mar thogs/ /tshe ring longs spyod rgyas zhing rigs brgyud spel/ /bsgrub bya dbang sdus pha rol zil gyis gnon/ /legs nyes bra ston lus dang grib ma bzhin/ /'bral med bsrung skyob sba ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /nag po'i sems 'chang mtha' dbus 'dre gdon dpung / /gang gi 'jigs rung sna tshogs zlos gar gyis/ /thal bar rlog ste nam yang sbyor rtsub rnams/ /ldang du med pa'i 'phrin las gnyan bo mdzod/ /lha chen khyod kyis bsrung zhing skyong ba'i yul/ /gangs ri'i 'phreng mdzes bod kyi rgyal khams 'di'i/ /mi mthun nyes pa'i tshogs rnams kun zhi zhing / /ma smad bde skyid dpal la spyod par (123bsgodzod/ /yid bzhin nor bur yongs 'du sa brtol dang / /bum bzang 'dod pa 'jo ba'i ba mo bzhin/ /dpal ldan dri za'i rgyal mo khyod nyid kyis/ /rigs 'dzin bdag gi bsam don lhun grub mdzod/ /sa bya mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyis phan bde'i legs bshad gling pa'i mgon khang du dmag sgor lha mo/ beg tse/rdor legs/ rgyal btsun rnams la snyan dar zhal yig 'bul skabs kha byang zhig dgos tshul byung ba ltar bris pa 'dzad med nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo khed/ /'dod khams bdag mor kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin/ /gaṅgā'i rgyun ltar chad pa med 'bul ba'i/ /re ba ji bzhin 'grub par byin brlabs nas/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /gnod sbyin beg rtse lcam dral bka' sdod bcas/ /rigs kyi srung ma rdo rje legs pa la/ /—293

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()lha rdzas dar gyi snyan shal 'di 'bul na//deng nas byang chub bar du bsrung zhing skyobs//chos rgyal sku lnga gsang yum blon por bcas//sdebargyad dmag dpon tse'u dmar po yis//gnod byed dgra bgegasadapung tshogs tshar chod la//zhi rgyas dbang gi 'phrin las thogs med sgrubs//lcags khye gnam lo gsar tshes kyi gtor chen thog dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mor dar tshon sna lnga'i snyan shal phul ba'i 'byang phan bde'i snang g.yod med//dar dkar/gang thugs rab dkar bh+yo be+e ga las sha pa'i//'od gzisabadag sogs rnams kyi nad gdon mun//zhi dang lhan cig ljongs 'di'i yid can la//'tshe ba'i rims 'khrug nyes brgya'i mun sangs mdzod//ser/khyod thugs dpal gyi be'ur zhun ma'i gser//'khyil 'dra'i bh+yoḥyig las los zer 'phreng gis//tshe dang 124na bsod nams lung rtogs yon tan kun//'phags chen dam pa'i tsho gos dang skal mnyam mdzod//dmar/thugs ka'i bh+yoḥyig dmar po las 'phros pa'i//lcags kyu lta bu'i 'od kyis srid dang zhi'i//snod bcud kun gyi phun tsho gos ma lus pa/khab len rdo yis lcags phye len ltar drongs//mthing /mthing nag bh+yo 'ag las 'phros pho nya dang //rab 'bar me lce mtshon cha'i tsha tsha yis//chos srid tshe srog la 'khu'i dgra bgegs tshogos//rtsi sbur zhugs kyis bsregs ltar rdul du rlog/ljang /mi 'gyur chos dbyings mkha' klong yangs pa las//sna tshogs sprul pa'i nyin byed mtha' klas pas//yid srubs smag rum drungs chun phan dang bde'i//snang ba mi 'dzad 'dod dgu'i gter gyur lha//ston mtshan zla ba dzam+bha chu bo'i gser//pad+ma rā ga mig sman khu ba'i mdangs//'ja' tshon bzhin du ma 'dres skur bstan nas//zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod 'phrin las rnams//thogs med sgrung tshe mdzad 'dod khams dbang phyug ma//nor skyong gos dkar 'dzin pa gnam lo'i zhal//ngom pa 'di nas bskal pa ji srid bar//bstan 'gro'i chos srid legs byas rab 'phel zhing //rnal 'byor bdag gi bsams don lhun grub mdzod//lcags bya nag pa zla ba'i brgyad gtor thog mgon po che chung las mkhan gnyas dang bcas par phul ba'i snyan dar zhal yig dpag ba4 'dod pa' re skong //'og min zhing khams zhiX gi gtsor bzhugs pa//rnam snang thugs rje'i

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ tanazlos gar nag po che//phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod 124ba ) sprin nyer 'bul na//zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las thogs med sgrubs//dkar/ston mtshan nya rgyas zla ba'i 'dzum zhal gyis//nyer bkug 'chi med bdud rtsi bum thod du//rab 'khyil bcud kyis lus brtas mi shigs pa'i//rdo rje'i srog gi ka ba tshugs par mdzod//ser/yid bzhin nor bus yongs gtams thod pa las//'dzad med mchog thun dngos grub char chen pos//srid zhi'i yon to myu gu g.yur za ba'i//bde skyid snye ma gos bus lci bar mdzod//dmar/kun gsal pha mtha' 'ching ba'i zhags pa yis//'gro kun yid dbang rab 'phrog gtsug tor rtser//nyer bkod gom pa'i sor mo'i rjes gsal ba//rdo ba'i ri mo ji bzhi brtan par mdzod//mthing /sna tsho gos mtsho ni gyis dgra snying 'bigs pa dang //mtshungs par zhugs kyi phung por bgegs dpung rnams//bsregs nas dga' rab dbang phyug mya ngan gyi//khang bur chug cig legasaldan nag po che//ljang /mig sman ltar gnag srin po'i zhal gdangs nas//log 'dren sder bcasachem chem gsol na yang //zhi dang brjid chags sna tsho gis zlos gar gyis//las rnams kun sgrub stobs 'phrog gdong bzhi pa//dri bral dmar zlum spyan ras nyer bgrad nas//mngon gyur bag la zha ba'i dgra bgegs kyi//snying khrag long long thod par khol ba'i rgyun//gsol la sdodapung srid bcas thal bar rlog/thos bsam sgom pa'i bstan pa rin r+ṣa spel//nyi 'og 'gro rnams phan dang bde la sbyor//rnal 'byor bdag gi 'dod pa'i re ba kun// 25na༄sams pa tsam gyis 'bad med lhun grub mdzod//yo/gnod sbyin pho mo bshos nas sprul pa'i sras//gshin rje pu tra ming sring 'khor bcas rnams//tshur gshegs khrag chang mchod gtor 'di bzhes la//dgra bo'i mgo 'phreng dpa' rtags rgyan du chongs//beg tse/rigs 'dzin bdag cag mi nor dgon gnas bcas//gnyer du gtad na nyin mtshan dus drug tu//ma g.yel srungs shig beg tse lcam dral kye//phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i ru mardzo sgrongs//lcag byi skyid shod pha bong khar rdo rje la ya dpal 'byo/mi lhun grub kyi dngul gdung rin po cher mchod tshogs snyan shal phul

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho gsung 'bum/ ()phe lta byang gling mtsho sgrol 'gru 'a//gzod ma nyid nas spang rtogs yon to kun//rdzogs sangs rgyasakyang tso mthong byis pa'i blo//brid phyir slob pa'i lam gyi zol bsten pa'i//mgon kye dag pa'i wo nas nye bar dgongs//bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon chos kyi 'byor pa'i mdzod//lhun grub gdan gsum sgo ba'i ded dpon gyis//byang sa snying ༅ bar du gos mdzad de//theg ma sto chos la rtag tu longs spyod shog/kun gsal 'i lus phra gom pas 'jal ba'i mthas//rnyed min ma rgan skye rgu bgrang yas rnams//srid mtsho thugs rje'i gru yis rab bsgral te//༅ byung thar gling bgrod par byin gyis sa sa//lcags khyi skyid shod gung thang du khyab bdag bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi dngul gdung rin po cher ma rdzo pa snya dar tso po'i sa byang //ma' brtse nus pa'i tshwa ris rab bkrab//gdul bya'i man shel lang i shis pa'i dngos//kun dga' dge legs dpal 'byor yongs stsal ba'i//tshon las srid mthar rab rgyas rdo rje 'dzin//laṅka'i rgyal khab zhi khro'i gzhal yas su//gnyag ban rang gi khri la ngal gso yang //da dung phyogs 'di'i gdul bya rdzogs min pas//ngo mtshar skye ba'i phreng ba gzung du gsol//khyod zhabs gtsug tu bsnyen pa'i rnal 'byor gyis//rtsa gsum ma lus rang rig dag pa'i ngor//rang ngo 'phrod nas 'gro 'dren sa mkhan du//'gyur bar byin gas snying la sim par mdzod//lcags khyi yar klung bkra shis chos ra rigs kun bdag po mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan gyi dngul gdung rin po cher 4 ra rdzu4r+sha gi la byang tshe 'a pa'i bden tshig /gra ta blo/med gdu po bya'i mgon po he ruka/tso smrig gar bsgyur bgo nams kho gi mchog//skal ldan yongs kyi gtsug tor mthon dzi'i rtser//zhabs sen zla ba nyer tshes dge ba'i bshes//'og min zhing khams zhing gi gtsor bzhugs kyang //'gro mgon mi gtong thugs bskyed zhal 'tshes pa //dam pa'i pyo tshul gas du 'gyur min phyir//ma smad thugs rje'i spyan gyi dkyusang khyongs//bstan 'gro'i phan bde bla nas blar 'phel zhing //bdag sogs snyan brgyud r+ya ma bzhi ldan chos//skye baX /mas pas grub pa'i mtha' stogs te//ring min

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'dardo rje 'cha dbang 'grub byin snos/ /lcags khyi lhag bsam dge ba'i dbang pos rten la na bza' phul ba'i kha byang mu tig gnyi shing / /mchog zhing bkur 'bras gtam gyis yid drangs nas/ /dar zab thags bskrun pañtsa li ga'i gos/ /sras bcas rgyal ba'i ye (126na/zhes dngos zhugs sku/ /nyer phul 'dzad med sa bon legs btab pas/ /gdan sum tshang ba'i bshes gnyon rdo rje 'dzin/ /'jig med seng ge'i khri la rtag brtan shing / /sa spyod mi dbang sku tshe chab srid rnams/ /dkar phyogs zla ba'i cha bzhin 'phel bar shog khyu sbyor byed po 'di snang rtag bde zhing / /skye bar lha mi'i rten rgyud ring min du/ /ye shes mchogo thob mkha' mnyam lusacan tshogs/ /stobs bcu'i rtsal mnga' thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /lcags khyi se 'bras dge gsum lha ldan bkra shis lhun po rnams kyi rten la dbul ba'i snyan shal kyi tshigs bcad skyid shod sprul sku ngag dbang bstan 'dzin 'phrin las kyi dgos tshul byung ba ltar bris pa phan bde'i shing rta sogs/ /jo bo shākya waṃ/sras bcas rgyal ba'i thugs rje mngon sum bzhin/ /'gro la rab snang mthong bas don ldan skur/ /rab mdzes mu khyi ka yi do shal rgyan/ /lhag bsam zla ltar dkar bas phul ba'i 'bras/ /nam yang 'dzad mi shes pa'i 'khri zhing char/ /yang srid kun tu 'bab pa'i bsod nams la/ /'gro kun byang chub mchog la reg min bar/ /bdag dang lhan cig mnyam por longs spyod shog /rdzo jo mi skyod rdo rje/phul byung thugs rje chen po'i zla snang gis/ /skye rgu'i dug gsum tsha gdung drungs phyung nas/ /nges legasabasil ba'i bde chen nyams myong bar/ /mgon pos bdag sogs byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /rang byon lnga ldan/ khyod zhal zhugs kyis sngon tshe yid grubs sde/ /pha mtha' bskrad ltar ding yang bstan dang 'gro'i/ /—297—

rgyal dbang lnga pa nga gci dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()nyer 'tshe'i smag 16ba'i ma ma lus yongs skrod pa'i//byin rlabs nyi ma'i dngos brgya 'bar bar mdzod//ga khol mi phreng/gshe dang bkur bar bto snyoms byams pa'i chus//'gro rgyud khro sdang me lce'i tsha reg kun//yongs bcil mtha' dag mnyes gshin ngang tshul gyis//rdzogs ldan kyi dus rnam thar 'dzin par shog/lha sgyu rje bla ma'i sku bas/mthon mthing zur phud dor nas 'tshams sprin gos//legs 'chang bstan pa'i gdugs mdzes khor yug gi/grib mar rgya mtsho'i mtha' klas skye rgu rnams//ngal gsor mdzod cig kun mkhyen btsong kha pa//lha 'a sgrol ma/mas stobs gdong lnga'i dbang po'i gad rgyangs kyis//'jigs pa brgyad sogs nyes brgya'i glang po'i srog/rab phyog bdag sogs mkha' mnyam ma rgan kun//srid pa'i chu gter las sgrol tā re ma//'phags pa lo ke shwa ra/'gro kun 'dren par dam bca'i khur po che//snying stobs phrag pas nyer btegs 'jig rten dbang //zhal 'tshes yol ba med par rdo ba'i ris//lnga brgya'i 'gro la che ches gsal bar shog/chos rgyal thong bar rnam po/sdig rta'i sems 'chang sa spyod yid kyi lcags//zhi ba'i gser 'gyur rtsi yis lus can rnams//legs ldan thar pa'i grong du 'khrid byed pa'i//lha gcig srong btsan rnam thar 'dzin par shog/gos spungs yosa'/dbus 'gyur la4 du mchog gi sprul pa'i skur//sngon sangs rgyas tshe 'dus pa dang po sa/bdag sogs 'gro rnams gyur te dam chos kyi//bdud rtsis thar pa'i srog 'tshor thugs rjes gzigs//rnam 27na〉ra sgo gtso/sras bcas rgyal ba'i bkod pa rgya mtsho'i zhing //ngo mtshar mig gi bdud rtsi gsal//mthong bas rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum po//rab phyed mkha' mnyam 'gro kun 'dren gyur cig/chu mag sgrol ma/mi bzad 'jigs chen brgya na las dug sprul gyis//rnam par 'tshe ba'i 'jigasarung chu gter grong //thugs rje'i gzings kyis sgrol ba'i 'phags ma kye//da dung rgyud lnga'i 'gro la spyan gyis gzigs//dga' ldan dngul gdung si po che/rmad byung mkhyen pa'i dpung pas bteg pa'i rtser//dpyad gsum rnam par dag pa'i ral gri yis//mi shes rmongs pa'i dra ba nyer bcad de//bdag blosashes bya'i khyon kun 'jal nus shog/thugang aX/ma/brgya phrag dpag tshad khyen dngar tshul khrims

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ tanadri//yang srid kun tu 'thul ba'i bag yod par//sgo gsum nye bar bsdams pa'i ngang tshul gyis//nye bar 'khor gyi rnam thar 'dzin byin rlobs//ba po shis lhun pho dngul gdung /rin chen phung por spungs pa dbang po'i gzhu//ri mo tshar du dngar ba'i gzigs mo la//tshur mthong 'gro ba'i mig gi bdud rtsis/spyod pa'i bgo skal nyams su bstar bar shog/ngur ga sgrol ma/rnam 'dren kun gyi 'phrin las gzugasacan bzhin//sked phra nu 'bur mngon mtho'i 'jo sgeg can//rgyal yum 'phags ma'i byin rlabs bdag snying la//legs zhugs srid zhi'i mtha' las rnam grol shog/thub pa bod khrulas/bye ba phrag brgya'i dga' rab dbang phyug dpung //mnyam gzhag ga/cig 127bgis g.yul ngor pham mdzad pa//zasagatsang sras kye ring po'i phyag khyongs la//bdag sogs dbugs dbyung thar pa'i zhing du drongs//byamasasku/ris su ma chad sems can mtha' dag la//brtse ldan byams pas rjes su nyer skyong ba'i//thugasarjes yid dga' chos 'dzin zhing khams su//mtha' yas skye rgu ma lus drang du gsol//lcags byi phan bde legs bshad gling du dmag zor ma dang dpe har rgyal por snyan dar gyi zhal yig blo bzang dge 'dun kyi 'dod pa ltar bri4 dngos grus dpal 'bar//'dod pa khams la dbang sgyur re ma ting//'dod yon lha rdzasasnyan shal 'di phul bas//'dod don bsams pa bzhin du lhun grub nas//'dod dgu'i dngos grub bdag la char bzhin stsol//sprul pa'i rgyal po che khyod dpag dka' ba'i//mthu stobs nyin mor byed pa'i 'od brgya pas//bdag gi nad gdon gnod pa kun zhi nas//phan bde'i snang ba rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//lcag phag lo gsar gyi tshe 'dod khams dbang phyug mar snyan dar phul ba'i zhal byang phan bde'i nyi ma gung shar//dkar/yid 'phrog tshangs pa'i bu mo'i phyag sor gyis//nyer btag bum bzang las 'ongs bdud rtsi'i chus//nad gdon sdig sgrib dri bkrus bde skyid kyi//snang ba rab gsal zhi ba'i las kun sgrubs//ser/dzaskru'i gser mdangs ltar brjid 'dzum zhal las//'phros pa'i zer gyis tshe dpal stobs 'byor dang //lung rtogs yon tan ma lus nyer bsdus nas///༷pa'i 'phrin las ma lus sgrub par mdzod//dmar/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)yid 'ongs mig gi zur mda' gcig gi rtse/ /bsnun pa'i mod la brtan pa kun phyogs te/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das(128na)pa'i legs tshogos kun/ /ma lus thogs pa med par dbang du sdus/ /mthing / rab khros gdangs pa'i zhal las 'bar ba'i mes/ /nag po bdud kyi sdebacas kun bsregasadang / /lhan cig dgra dpung phye mar yongs 'thag pa'i/ /drag sbyor dpa' bo'i lag rtags ma' sum ston/ /rdzo/ngo bo 'jam dpal gshin rjer sbyor ba'i yum/ /phyi nang a mong snang ngor dbyangs tso lha//thub pa'i bstan pa bsrung phyir re ma ti/ /gcig pu nyid las du ma'i gar mkhan khyod/ /spyi dang khyad par blo bzang grags pa yi/ /chos srid dkar cha'i zla ltar rab 'phel zhing / /gangs can ljongasa'adir nad rims dbul phongs sogs/ /duḥkha'i smag rngam pha mthar bcil bar mdzod/ /'gro rnamasaphan bde'i nyi ma gung nas shar/ /bshad sgrub lung rtogs 'dab brgya mngon par ba 'ad/ /bdag gisabacol ba'i 'phrin las rnam bzhi sgrubs/ /phun tshogs dga' ston sum rtsen rjes 'gror mdzod/ /lcags phag rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling par rgyas dar gong pa mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyi snyan dar sum brgya skor bcas phul ba'i zhal byang legs byas dkar cha'i zla 'phel/ /bzang gos spel legs bsgrig bang pa'i gong ba la/ /lha rdzas 'ja' tshon ltar bkra'i snyan shal 'phreng / /rtsa gsum dgyes bskyed kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin/ /'dzad med nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo phye nas/ /mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab brtson pa dang / /ston zla ltar dkar bsam pas nyer phul dges/ /thub pa'i bstan 'phel de 'dzin skyes bu rnams/ /legs brtan 'gro rnams bde skyid (128ba)dpal 'bar shog khyu sbyor mthun rkyen sgrubs par gtogs so cog /deng nas byang chu ba bar du 'khor ba yi/ /nyes brgya'i gdung ba kun zhi chos srid kyi/ /yon tan yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel byin rlobs/ /lcags phaganag pa zla ba'i brgyad gtor gyi du mgon po tshe chung rnams la phul ba'i snyan dar gyi zhal byang 'phrin las ma dro klung ོ/ khur/lnga ldan ye shes bzhu blugs nag po che/ khrid gsum dregs pa'i 'byung gnas ral gcig ma/ /srid gsum dbang sgyur dud pa'i sol can gyis/ /bstan 'gro'i phan bde bla nas blar spel mdzod/ /—300

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ tanadakar/thugs rje ga bu ra yi gzegs ma yis//nyon mongs dug gsum nad dang des bskyed pa'i//bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i zug rngu ma lus pa//drungs nas phyung ste nye bar zhi bar mdzod//sgo//lung rtog tshe dpal srid zhi'i yon tan rnams//dkar po'i phyogs kyi zla ba'i cha shas ba'i na//'phel ba bsod nams phung por spungs pa'i gzi//nyi ma'i lus brgya mngon sum 'dzin par mdzod//dmar/tshangs pa'i bskal pa yin no cog kun la//mnyam por spyod la dbang thang rab 'bar yun//skye rgu'i bdag po'i tshe yi tshad kyis kyang //gzhal dka'i bskal chen brgya phrag 'phreng spel mdzod//mthing khra/steng zil lhun po dus kyi me dpung gos//nyer klubs srin po'i zhal gdangs log 'dren snying //chem chem za bar rngams kyang 'gro kun la//3 med rnam bzhi'i ngo bo mi gtong 'dzum//bde wo 'khor lo'i lha tshogs sdom pa'i gtso//mi bsrun gshed mar zhing skyong stobs 'phrog dbang //rang sems gsal stong dag pa'i rdo rje sems//gcig las du 129na sgo'i rnam par 'phrul de mtshar//nyer bzhi'i yul du rgyu ba dpa' bo'i gzugs//phyag na mi rkang gling bu'i sgra snyan pos//chos srungs dam can rgya mtsho nyer bos nas//kun bzang mchod pa'i tsho gos kyi 'khor lor rol//ma rungs bsam sbyor 'chang ba gdug pa'i dgra/de'i grogs yid srubs gnyen srid sdodapung bcas//stobs 'byor tshe srog nus pa kun mas la//bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i nyi ma gung 'char mdzod//rdo rje 'chang dngos rtsa brgyud bla ma yis//bka' bsgos dam tshig rgya las ma bsgral par//deng 'dir bcol ba'i zhi rgyas dbang drag gi/las rnams thogs pa med par lhun gyis sgrubs//ljang /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i ma dros klung chen las//rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las chu bo bzhi 'bab pa//byang chub snying por mchis min de srid du//srid zhi'i legs byas rgya mtshor ro gcig mdzod//las mgon/zhe sdang nyi ma 'char kha'i dmar zlum spyan//rab gdangs khros pa'i gom stabs shugs drag pos//dgra dpung gar gnas sar song khrag dron rgyun//'thung zhig pu tra ming sring yab yum kye//gnod sbyin/chos bzhin sgrub la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs//thal par rlog byed beg tse lcam dral che//mi zan byed la zhen nas stong gsum kun//myul nas las

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()kun sgrubs shig gar dbang ma//lcags phag phan bde legs bshad gling par dri za'i rgyal po rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal gyi 129ba〉dos bskal zhag bdun gyi bar ba lis pa'i yā shal kha yig nad sol sman gyi ljon pa//gangs can bod kyi lha chen dri za'i rgyal//g.yung drung zhing gi srung ma gnyan chen lha//rgyal dbang pad+mas dam btags ya zhur zhes//yongs grags thang lha gsang mtshan 'bar ba rtsal//gnas dgur sku yi zlos gar sgyur ba la//sna tshogs mtshan gyi brda skad ma 'dres gsal//ngo bo byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying //gdod nas dag pa'i rang rig kun tu bzang //ma rdzo bya ma rdzo byed mar yul spros pa'i mas//gnas lugs rgya mtsho'i dbyings su ro gcig pa'i//ye dag lhun gyis grub pa mchod pa'i mchog/zung 'jug rnal 'byor lam bzang 'di ko mtshar//'on te tshon brgya myul ba'i shing bzhin du//las kun ma 'dres 'char phyir rgyal srid dang //dam sri la sogs gnod byed gdon bgegs kun//sprul pa'i lha g.yag dkar pos thal bar rlog/bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad sel rtsi sman ljon//srog gi ka ba nyer 'dzugs bdud rtsi'i bcud//bsamasapa'i re ba kun skong dpag bsam dbang //mdzod cig lha chen btsun mo sras 'khor kye//sku 'bag srog sngags rgyan gos phyag mtshan sogs//bsten pa'i dam rdzas de la rtag bzhugs te//las kun thogs med sgrubs shig 'bar ba rtsal//rtsa brgyud bla ma'i dam tshig gnyan po dgongs//130na ḍi gas kun khyab bdag khra sgo pa 'a po blo gros mchog gi rdo rje zhing 'dir sku'i bkod pa bsdus tshe sku gdung rin po cho phul phe snya shal byang dag cha la kho po rgya ge'i gar mag//blo gros rab gsal gdul byar mchog gi lam//thun mong dngos grub stsol ba'i rigs brgya'i bdag/rdo rje'i slob dpon gzugs su yongs shar ba//zhing 'dir tha ma'i mdzad pa mngon sum bstan//'od gsal gzhen nu bum snod za ma rtag//nyer spangs gang thugs rang byung rig pa'i sgron//bde chen zhi ba'i klong du ro gcig pa//kye ma gzhan 'drid sgyu ma'i rol rtsed bzhin//'on te chu nang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ltar//dag pa'i zhing gi bkod pa gaṅgā'i rdul//de snyed zlos gar sgyur ba'i mig la/༷ gyis//'gro kun 'dren pa'i 'phrin las gcig

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 9)tu che/ /kunas dag pa'i rang gi sems nyid 'di/ /lhun grub 'od lnga'i 'ja' lus rdo rje sems/ /btsal tshe gzhan min dpal ldan bla ma yi/ /ngo bor nges rnyed rnal 'byor la gzhol spro/ /de phyir pad 'byung rang snang rig ma dang / /mnyam sbyor rdo rje 'chang dang mgon po khyod/ /dbyer med gtsug tu bzhugs la gsol 'debs na/ /dbang bzhi'i byin rlabs snying la 'bab par shog /gang gi thugasarje'i grib tu nyer bsil bar/ /mkha' mnyam yid can mtha' dag ngal gso zhing / /dag dang ma dag gdul bya'i dbang po dang / /'tsham par sprul pa'i rnam rol ston par shog /pho brang ge ra ba blo bzang dge 'dun gyis phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i chos srung spyi bye brag la snyan (130bskor phul ba'i spyo byang ba4 don re skong / /phyag drug pa/ma rungs gdul dka'i gnyen por pad dkar 'chang / /rdo rje srin po'i gzugs kyi nyer khros pa/ /dpal ldan myur mdzad ye shes mgon po cher/ /rab dkar lha rdzas snyan shal 'di phul bas/ /thub bstan 'phel zhing de 'dzin tshogs rnams rgyas/ /yangs pa'i 'jig rten kun tu bde skyid dar/ /bdag sogs nad gdon bar chad kun zhi zhing / /bsams pa'i don rnams lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /las skyon/ /dus kyi dgra bor khros pa'i dpa' bo che/ /dusamatshan ma sogs 'khor gyi rab bskor nas/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i bstan srung mthu bo ches/ /dusadeng bcol ba'i las rnams thogs med sgrubs/ /lha mo/srid lam dub pa'i skye rgu'i ngal stegs gnas//srid zhi'i mgon po shākya'i chos skyong che/ /srid pa'i rgyal mo dpal ldan re ma tis/ /srid mtha'i bar du mgon skyabs dpung gnyen mdzod/ /rnam sras/ rnam kun mchog ldan rgyal ba rin chen mang / /rnam thosasras zhes gnod sbyin sde dpon ches/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa thob min par/ /rnam mang chog thun dngos grub ma lus stsole/ /chos skyong snyi/ /rab 'byams rgyal kun mthu stobs gcig bsdus nas/ /rab khros bstan skyong rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /rab mang nyes brgya'i smag rum ma lus pa/ /rab dkar zla rgyas shar ltar zhi bar mdzod/ /lcags phag hor zla brgyad par mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyis chos (131na〉khor rgyal gyi byams chen dang —303

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()chos skyong kha shas la snyan dar phul phe kha byang las pha sa grub//ma smad bzod pa'i char gyis khro ba'i me//grangasamed skye bar rab gzhil gshin pa'i sar//brtse chen bskyed bsrings yongs 'du thugs rje'i gar//bsil bar 'gro kun dbugs dbyung ma pham mgon//lha gcig byams pa'i stobs kyis bdud bzhi'i tshogs//deng nas byang chub bar du nyer srungs la//dgyes pa'i spyan ras gzigs pa lhur mdzad de//rtag tu hrū dang bde ba'i lam la sbyor//de gyis/dpal ldan rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug gar//dbyangasacan lha mo'i rol par yongs sgyur yang //thub bstan srungs mar dpal ldan re ma tī//'dod khams dbang mo'i thugs dam rgyud bskul na//dkar ser dmar mthing ljang 'phrul nyin byed kyis//mi mthun nyes brgya'i smag rum sangs pa dang //lhan cig phan bde'i snang ba 'od po ches//kun khyab 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis sgrubs//rgyal po/nad gdon bar chad g.yul las rnam rgyal zhing //tshe dpal lung rtogs yon tan dkar phyogs kyi//yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel ba'i 'phrin las tshogs//thogs med sgrubs shig sprul pa'i chos rgyal che//rdor gos/rgyal dbang pad+ma'i dge bsnyen dam tshig can//rdo rje legs pa mched 'khor bcas pa yis//bdag sogs mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa rnams//rtag tu srung skyob 'phrin las ma lus 131ba〉sgrubs//'gal byed ces pa lcags phag hor zla brgyad pa'i nang du dzi pa blo bzang mthu stobs chu phywa dang sgrogs chos 'khor rgyal gyi gtor gsol la bteg skabs ga rje la dang mgon khang rnams la snyan shal phul ba'i zhal byang kun bzang rnam par 'phrul ba'i zlosagar//byams 'a/gang gi zhal gyis 'tshes pa'i dam bca'i 'bras//lus can yongs kyis ma sum nyams myong ba//khyod kyi khyad par ma lags dam pa kun//ngang tshul de las 'gyur med rang gi gshis//'on te nam mkha'i khyen gyi mtha' dang tshad//gzhal dka'i skye rgu ma lus ring min du//mgon po thugs rje'i them skas la 'dzegs nas//bla med byang chub khang par 'jug byin rlobs//rdo rje'i gdan du mchog gi sprul pa'i skur//mngon sangs rgyas tshe bdag sogs 'dus pa'i 'khor//132na rkong por skyes nas chos kyi bdud rtsi'i ro//myong ba'i ༷༷ ba bzang por rjes zungs shig/mgon khang r+ṣa mo/

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdza khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ thonanyin mtshan g.yel ba med par thub bstan la/ /mel tshe mdzad pa'i chos srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin gyis mnyes byed na/ /zhi rgyas dbang gi 'phrin las ma lus sgrubs/ /rdo sku me 'bar ma/ /rab tu 'bar ba byin za'i phung po'i rtser/ /dgra bgegs phye ma leb rnams mi rtag lam/ /'god mdzad stobs 'phrog dbang pos log 'dren gyi/ /snying ga 'dam ltar brdzi ba'i bro chen rdungs/ /kospyos ma/gang zhig g.yul ngor shar ba'i mod nyid la/ /phas rgol dus mtha'i rlung gis sbur ma bzhin/ /mthar byed dpal ldan ma hā kā la yis/ /dgon gnas sdodang bcas 'di rtag tu srungs/ /tsis kha zil gnon las tshon dang 44/'khor 'das phyag rgya zil gnon thog ma'i mgon/ /bka' nyan gdod nas grub pa'i 'chi bdag zhal/ /gdangs pa'i mgrin par dgra rnams khyur mid du/ /btang nas srid pa'i grong du srog dang phrol/ /stag thog kho srung dang 4sa pa/ stag chen smyon pa zhen pa'i mon pa nag /legs ldan dbang po mthu chen sdo bzhi'i tshogs/ /dam rdzas mchod gtor spyan gzigs 'di bzhes la/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las dus las ma g.yel zhig /mgon khang bar gyi dmag zor ma/srid zhi'i gdung ba'i nad brgya ma lus pa/ /sel ba'i sman gcig rnam rgyal re ma ti'i/ /byin rlabs zil dngar snying gi za ma rtag /phyur phur gtams pa'i skal bzang ma rga sum stsol/ /de rdzi ko ṭi/ gang la brten na bsam pa'i re ba kun/ /'grub (132ba)phyir yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po'i mched/ /dran pas snying gi gdung sel dbyangs can ma/ /log 'dren gshed du dmag dang zor gyi lha/ /gtor ma'i bza' bca' sman rag bdud rtsi'i skyems/ /phyi nang gsang mchod nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo/ /ting 'dzin sngags brgya' lde mig gis phye nas/ /thugs dam gnyan po dbyings su skong byed na/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi ched du gnyer gtad pa'i/ /dgon gnas mi nor sde dang bcas pa skyobs/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las kun sgrubs la/ /bsams pa'i don rnams lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /dmag zor ma'i gser sku/ gcig pu nyid las khro chags rgyas dang zhi'i/ /sna tshogs gar mdzad 'dod khams dbang phyug mas/ /rig 'dzin bdag gi bsams pa'i don rnams kun/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i mthu stobs dpung tsho gos skyed/ /gci sgron —303

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()ma/bod khams bsrung mdzad rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong //la sogs bdud dang gnod sbyin sman mo'i tshogs//mthu rtsal skyed la gangs can yul khams 'dir//'thab brtsod nad rims mu ge ma lus gzhi la//bsil phro gyi gur mgon/rnam snang ye shes bzhu byugs mthu stobs chu//rab khol rdo rje srin po'i phyag bzung dbus//rnam 'phrul gaṇ+ḍi'i sgo gsum phye ba las//legs spros sprul pa'i dmag gis dgra dpung choms//spyo/gtum chen ha ha'i gad rgyangs drag po'i sgras//log 'dren snying ga 'gas dang lhan cig par//byin rlabs bum bzang las 'ongs bdud rtsi'i chus//lusang ga yid rnams brtasapa'i 'phrin las mdzod//yo/bram ze'i dmod pa btsan po'i mthu stobs kyis//bsam ga sbyor rtsub 'chang ba nyams pa'i mgo/133na ) bregs pa'i thod rlon nang du snying khrag rgyun//lang long khol ba hub sgras zhal du gsol//chos lnga ga mi gi cho long /dpal ldan dam can rgya mtsho'i tsho gos rnams kyis//shākya'i bstan dang bstan 'dzin sder bcas ljon//srid mtha'i bar du rgyas pa'i grib bsil la//lus can mtha' dag ngal gsor spyod par mdzod//wo skyong /rta mchog rlung gi shugs can la zhon nas//stong gsum skad cig myul te dam nyams tshogos//phye mar btags pa'i sha khrag rus pa rnams//seng zhal gdangs pa'i nang du kha raṃ khāhi//beg tse lcam sring /'jam dpal thugs sprul gnod sbyin dbang gi mdog/bka' nyan bshan par bcas pa'i 'khor tsho gos kyis//thub bstan 'joms rnams myur du tshang chod la//gtsug lag gnas dang sdo bcas ma lus skyongs//rig pho lha mo/rig pa'i lha mo'i dmar zlum spyan ras gyis//lkog tu gyur pa'i gzigs na mngon sum du//bstan dang 'gro la nyer 'tshe'i dpung tsho gis kyi//srog dbugs sha khrag rus rnams tshogs su rol//rā hu la/pad+ma thod 'phreng brgyud par bcas pa yi//bka' dang dam las nam yang ma 'das par//rig 'dzin bdag la 'khru ba'i log 'dren rnams//kha mig ltag par skyol la rdul du rlogs//rā phung rgyal po sku lnga/mtsho skyes rdo rjesagangs can gtsug lag khang //bsrung bar gnyer gtad li byin ha ra che//mched lnga gsang yum blon po bka' sdod rnams//mchod gtor 'di bzheXphrin las ma lus sgrubs//mu dmar ba/zab mo

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'dagater gyi srung ma mthu rtsal can/ /'bar ba skrun bdun btsan rgod bshan pa'i (133ba)gtso/ /thugs dam skong na las kun bsgrub pa'i ched/ /rlung gi shugs can rtar zhon stong gsum myul/ /rdor legs/rdo rje'i tho bas dgra dpung phyer btags lhag /sbud mchu'i rlung shugs kyis sbar me lce yis/ /bsregs pa'i thal ba tsam yang rjes med du/ /mdzod cig dam can dge bsnyen rdo rje legs/ /gza' gdong dmar nag /sngags 'chang bdag gi chos srid dpal 'byor la/ /'bu bar byed rnams steng 'og phyogs mtshams gar/ /bros kyang bshan pa mig dmar bya khyung la/ /zhen nas rjes sgogs rtsa ba drung nas phyungs/ /rdzo bo rgyal4zha pa/laṅka'i bdag po'i sgo srungs mas bo che/ /yang srid dkar mo ljongs kyi gnas skyong du/ /nyer bzung gzhi bdag jo bo rgyal mtshan pas/ /g.yel ba med par mthun pa'i lasarnams mdzod/ /rta rgod shel lcags/yid 'ongs kha ba'i rdul mang rab brtsegs shing / /chu klung phyogasabazhir 'bab pa'i pho brang la/ /nyer brten gnod sbyin rta rgod shel lcags kyis/ /mthun pa'i rkyen rnams bsgrub pa'i stong grogs mdzod/ /ma' dga' lcog gi sto po/ dam pa'i rigs las gdengs can dbang po'i tsha/ /dpe har rgyal po sde lnga 'khor bcas kyis/ /chos 'khor rgyal gyi rten dang brten pa rnams/ /bsrung skyob spel pa'i 'phrin las ma lus sgrubs/ /'dzin pa lag mang gi dar lcog la 'bri rgyu/nor bu'i thod mdzes sbrul gyi gdengs ka can/ /'dzin pa lag mang klu yi sde dpon gyis/ /gnas 'dir phun tshogs 'dod gu'i longs spyod char/ /'dzad med 'bab pa'i sgo 'phar rtag tu phye/ /chu lha'i nags klung rgyu ba'i rgya stag klad/ /'gems nus (134na)gsang 'dzin 'phrog byed sder mo'i dbal/ /rno ngar rtsal gsum rdzogs pa'i dam tshig par/ /ye shes sems dpa' dngos su zhugs pa bzhin/ /bsod nams btsan po'i las rlung shing rta'i shugs/ /dus kyi mkha' la rgyu ba'i stobs 'byor nyi/ /rab 'bar pha rol smag dras brtan 'phrog pa/ /'jug pa bcu pa'i ngang tshul rjes su 'gro /sangs rgyas kun gyi 'phrin las nam mkha'i mtha'/ /skal bzang gdul bya'i rgya mtshor phan bde'i rlabs/ /'phreng ba dusalas mi yol nor bu'i dpya/ /'byung gnas nam mkha' mdzod kyi mched zla dngos/ /blo chen tshangs pa'i —307

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()yul sar 'khor ba'i gdugs//bzang po'i lhag bsams yu bas nyer btegs pa'i//grib tu bsil ba'i stegs la lus can kun//ngal gso'i grags pa phyogs kyi rna bar 'jebs mi bzad lag na 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i mtshon//gdengs pas yid srubs drungs na stobs po che//sgeg dpa' mi sdug gar bskyod rkang sen rdul//dregs can ral pa'i khrod du 'thul ba bzhin//blo gsal 'dusasdes gang ba'i spur rgyal yul//gcig tu bzang po'i skal ldan 'jig byed gdon//mthu chen gsang bdag khyod zhal gdangs tsam gyis//'joms nus dpa' ba'i nga ro gcig tu brjid//dge tshogasa'ajam mnyen dkar ba ut+pa la'i//chun po ma rnyings rna gong mdzes pa'i rgyan//kha 'byed bsod nams zla ba tshes pa'i cha//nya rgyas snang ba'i dpal de 'bar bar shog/ce4 'di yang k+ṣa 2sngar yong gshosapo ta lar gsang bdag gi sku bzhengs zhes bskul gdang lhan du nang bzhugs dang snyan 134bdar kha yig 'di lta bu zhig brisashag pa ltar za hor gyi ban+de sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni lcang gseb pa 'jam dpal lo//lcags phag zla ba ༅ par bstan 'dzan da la'i rgyal pos dung skyong dbang mor snyan shal phul ba'i zhal byang phan bde'i rta bon gung lang//dpal ldan dung skyong lha mo dgyes zhal zla//'dzum 'phreng bsil pa'i zegs ma 'bum phrag gis//bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i dbang phyug gnam bskos rgyal//thugs kyi kun+da rgyas pa'i 'dab mo phye//gos ser yal ga'i ri dwags bgrang bya'i sri//smag rum mthar byed mthu stobs rta ljang can//phan bde'i gung nas 4 4 ba'i snang ba yis//bod sto skye rgu'i yid kyi ngal gsor mdzod//lcags phag zla ga bcu pa'i nang du rgyal po yul 'khor bsrung la snyan shal phul pa thog med drags rtsal//yangs pa'i yul 'khor chen po ma lus pa//rnam par skyong pa'i dpal ldan rgyal po che//btsun mo sras blon dzi brgyad dpung tshogs rnams//dpa' gtum thogs med drag rtsal brtul zhugs kyis//swā la'i sman ljongs bde skyid bdog pa kun//'phrog byed chom rkun bsam ga sbyor rtsub ldan//gang gnas khyod spyan dmar zlum sgrib med kyis//nyer gzigs bzlog bsod bskrad rmongs rengs par mdzod// 08

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bldengs dang mchod rdza khang bzang gi dkar chag gleg bam gsum pa/ 'dalcag phag dge slong 'jam dbyangs grag pas ri bo bde chen gyi byams chen/dmag zor ma/pe dkar gsum la snyan shalaphul shā kha byang dgos tshul ltar bkod pa tso r+sāng mar sprin//byams r+sā/khyod thugs kun la byams pa'i brlan gsher gyis//yid srubs sde bcas snying la gdung ba'i me//'bar mdzad mi pham mgon kye bdag sogs 'gror//theg chen chos 'khor rgyun chad 135na ) med skor gsol//dmas zor ma/rdo rje dbyings phyug srid pa'i rgyal mo'i gzugs//nyer bstan dmag dang zor gyi dbang mo yis mchog thun dngos grub spel ba'i 'phrin las bzhi//bsam pa'i re ba ji bzhin lhun grub mdzod//rgyas po/dmu rigs klu tsha stobs ldan dge bsnyen che//chos dang srid kyi mthun rkyen ma lus pa/grub pa'i dpag bsam yongs 'du mdzod cig kye//lcags phag dge slong 'jam dbyang grags pas rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i 'du khang du bka' brgyad srung mar bcas pa la snyan shal phul ba'i tshe 'dod gsol dgos tshul byung ba bzhin bri pa sgo gsum dag pa'i snang ba//bka' bas /bde gshegs zhi khro gaṅgā'i rdul snyed klung //dkyil 'khor gcig 'dus sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi//ma smad thugs rje snying dbus la zhugs nas//lha sngags ye shes dbang por bdag 'gyur shog/tshong /'gro 'di'i sdang dang chags pa'i zhabrul snang gzugs//dregs pa pho mor shar ba gti mug dbyings//gnyis med rgyud gsum bdag po ma ning
