nag/mthu dpung skyed la dgra bgegs rdul du rlog/dzi da'/sngon gyis las smon shugs drag rno ngar mar//'khor bas dgra srog dum bur gcod mdzad pa//mnga' bdag dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu yis//zhi rgyas dbang gi 'phrin las lhun gyisasgrubs//yongs 'dzin ces pa chu byi'i gnam lo gsar tshes kyi bskang ba'i dus 'dod khams dbang phyug mar snyan shal dar tshon sna lnga phul ba'i kha byang srid zhi'i legs sa rabargyas//ljang /mdzes sdug dri za'i bu mo 'jo sgeg mkhan//dgra snying 135ba ) che ma chem za ba srin mo'i gzugs//mig 'phrul lta bur snang ba tshur mthong blo//dpyad kyin sems kyi 'char sgo'i kun rtog tsam//'on te dbyings rig dag pa'i nam mkha' la//'dod 09

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)khams dbang mo'i kha rlang yongs 'khrigs las/ /byin rlabs 'dzad pa med pa'i char rgyun gyis/ /mchog thun dngos grub snye ma smin par mdzod/ /sgrib gnyis srog rtsa bcad nas zhi ba'i lam/ /bgrod tshe srid zhi'i legs tshogis rgyas pa dang / / dbang du sgyur la nges pa rnyed de'i phyir/ /sgrubs shig rgyal ba kun yum dbyings phyug kye/ /dkar/ thugs rje rtsi sman ljon pa bdud rtsi'i thigs/ /bran pa'i mod la bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad/ /drung phyung sgo gsum bde ba'i ngal stobs la/ /rtag tu sbyor zhig zhi mdzad dung skyong ma/ /ser/ tshangs pa'i bskal ba dang mnyam bsod nams gzi/ /'bar ba nyin byed dngosabargya'i lus bzung ste/ /bsam pa'i re 'bras 'bad dang rtsol ba la/ /bltos min sgrubs shig rgyasapa'i lha mo kye/ /dmar/ lha mi'i bsnyems pa ches cher sra ba'i gzhu/ /chags myos brlang po'i rgyud kyi nyer bkug nas/ /tshangs pa'i yul sa tshun gyi 'jig rten rnams/ /'gugs par mdzod cig dbang mdzad lha mo che/ /mthing / mi dang mi min log 'dren lha min mo'i/ /ngan sbyor mngal sbrum mthu stobs rdo rje'i mtshon/ /gdengs pa'i mod la lhung ba mngon spyod las/ /sgrubs shig dmag dang zor gyi rgyal mo che/ /chu byi hor zla dang po'i nang du rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling par nyin lnga'i bar srid gsum bdag mo'i bskang spu btsug skabs dar ra sna lnga'i snyan shal phul ba'i zhal byang sgos dri bsung / /las nyon de 'bras smag dras gnyid g.yur las/ /(136na)nyer slong gang sku las 'phros snang ba'i 'od/ /bla nas blar 'bar skya rengs mas drangs pa'i/ /bde skyid nyi ma gung du 'char bar mdzod/ /ser/ legs byas dzasbu'i 'bras bu chu gter dang / /dkar/ro gcig gser sbyangs ste ma zad mi shes/ /deng nas skye bar spyod la gro bzhin skyes/ /rnam thar ma rga sum myong ba'i 'phrin shā /sa mdzod/ / dmar/ sngon goms bsod nams shugasadrag dbang thang rdos/ /srid zhi'i dngos po kun gyi lcags kyi zong / /dbang med rjes su 'brang ba nga las nu/ /gcig bu'i grogs kyi mched zla deng 'grub mdzod/ /nag /gnam lcags tsha tsha 'phro ba rdo rje'i mtshon/ /gdengs pas gzhan sde lha min mo yi mngal/ /lhungs dang lhan cig yid srubs mchis brang bcas/ /mya ngan khang bur brgyal ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /ljang / khyod mtshan thos pa'i mod la 'khor —310

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'da'adas kyi/ /nyes brgya'i tsha gdung kun sel sim pa'i dri/ /mngar por 'thul ba sngon med tsan+dan gyi/ /rjes 'gror mdzod cig 'dod khams dbang phyug kye/ /chu byi nag pa zla bar chos 'khor rgyal ri mthil gyi mgon khang tshor 'brum nad las grol ba'i gtang rag bskang ba gzabargyasage'i pa'i dus phul ba'i snya shal kha byang 'dod las dpag bsam/ /de ra ko ṭi/ dkar po/ston mtshan zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang zhal/ /dgyes 'dzum lhug par ston la sgrib gnyis dang / /lhan cig nad gdon nyesabargya'i mun pa kun/ /zhi bar mdzod cig 'dod khams dbang phyug kye/ /ser po/ gser sbyangs zhun ma'i lhun po'i rjes(136ba)'gro skur/ /nyi ma'i dngos po brgya yis gos klubs gzi/ /tshe dpal bsod nams mnga' thang rnam thos bu'i/ /mched zlar mdzod cig 'dod khams dbang phyug ma/ /dmar po/ brgya phrag rnam 'gyur mthong ba'i mod nyid la/ /srid gsum yon tan thams cad dbang sdud pa'i/ /'phrin las bsams pa ji bzhin thogs med du/ grub par mdzod cig bsams 'phel yongs 'du'i ljon/ /mthing khra/ tshe 'byor chos dang srid la mtho 'tsham pa'i/ /yid grubs dgra dang bgegs kyi dpung tshogasakun/ /rdul du rlog las phyogs las rnam rgyal ba'i/ /ba dan srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar du phyor/ /ljang gu/rgyal ba kun yum dbyangs can ngag gi lha/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir dpal ldan re ma tis/ /zhi rgyasadabang drag 'phrin las ma lus pa/ /'dzad pa med par lhun gyis grub par shog /dkar po chos khrung steng /bstan srung rgya mtsho'i spyan sngar mthun pa'i rdzas/ /kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin phung ltar spro na/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus pa/ /'dzad pa med par lhun gyis grub par shog /nan cing kha bshas/bsil06/ gur gyi mgon po stobs log nag po che/ /bka' nyan dam can rgya mtsho'i tsho gos rnamasakyis/ /zhi rgyas dbang gi 'phrin las ma lus pa/ /'bad med lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /be gtse/ dbang drag lhun grub zangs kyi beg tse can/ khreng mo rig pa'i lha mo gdong dmar ma/ khrog bdag bshan pa nyer gcig dmag dpung gis/ /bdag la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs thal bar rlog /dkar po/ mgon kha mthil/ dgon (137na)gnas 'di nyid bsrung zhing skyob mdzad pa'i/ /chos skyong srung —311 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ༅ dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)ma'i tsho gis kyi spyan lam du/ /dngos bshams yid sprul mchod pa 'bul byed na/ /'gal rkyen zhi zheng mthun rkyen grub par mdzod/ /dkar po / ma' dga' lcog sprul pa'i cho rtse rgyal chen po sku lnga po/ /gsang yum sprul pa blon po las byed tshogs/ /gnod sbyin btsan rgod 'bar ba spun bdun gyis/ /zhi rgyasadabang gi 'phrin las lhun gyi sgrubs/ /chu byi zla ba'i yar tshes brgyad kyi dus gtore mgon po che chung las mkhan dang bcas la phul pa'i snyan shal kha yig lasatso thogs med ga phreng /gus 'ang/'og min zhing khams gtso bo'i thugs ga nas/ /ye shes sems dpa' bzhu blugs na ga po che'i/ /rnam 'phrul gaṇ+ḍi las spros pho nya yis/ /yid srubs sdodang bcas pa thal bar rlog /dkar/ bde chen 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dab dbus/ /legs ldan dkar po tshe bum 'dzin/ /'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis/ /lus zungs srog gi /ba tshugs/ /dmar/ longs spyod 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dab nang / /legs snang dmar po lcags kyu 'dzin/ /brtan g.yo'i phun tshogs ma lus pa/ /rang dbang med par dbang gis sdus/ /sngo/chos kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dab dbus/ /legs ldan nag po gri gug 'dzin/ /gnod byed dgra dang bgegs rnams kyi/ /srog rtsa dmar bo myur du chod/ /thi/sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dab dbus/ /legs ldan ser po rin chen 'dzin/ /tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor dang / /lung rtogs yon tan rgyas par mdzod/ /ljang /phyi (137ba)nang gsang ba'i sgyu 'phrul kun/ /rang shes dag pa'i nag po cher/ /nges rnyed dpal ldan he ru gas/ /byang chub bar du bsrung skyob mdzod/ /das/ mi sdug gnod sbyin yab yum bsgos pa'i sras/ /pu tra bha tra sring mo ral gcig mas/ /bsam sbyor ngan 'chang dgra dang bgegs rnams kyi/ /lang long khol ba'i snying khrag zhal du rngubs/ /dkar/ gnod sbyin beg tse sring mo gar gyi dbang / /srog bdag dmar po bshan pa'i tsho gos rnamasakyis/ /gnod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs gar gnas kyang / /rtsa sbur me la bsregs pa bzhin du thong / /yongs 'dzin gyi lo phag zla ba'i tshes bdun gyi dus 'a la 'phrul snang dang ra mo cher brgya mar sna lnga'i thog snya shal phul phe kha byang thugs rje'i nyi ma gung shar/ /thugs rje'i nyi ma gung du shar ba'i 'od/ /snang ba dam pa'i gzi byin —312

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdza khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 6)cher 'bar bas//sgrib gnyis nges bskyed srid gzug rngu tso//gzhil shā mgo sbyin stsol cig ma rgyal//jo bomi shod rdo rje/jo bo shākya mu ni/zas gtsang sras sku bltams pa'i mod nyid la//don kun lhun gyis grub pa'i mgon khyod kyis//srid zhi'i gdung ba ma lus thar mdzod nas//phan bde'i dga' ston mchog la sbyor byin rlobs//rang byon lnga sa/mkha' ltar tshad bzung gral ba'i 'gro ba kun//mi bzad srid pa'i grong mkhar las bsgral nas//thar pa'i rin chen gling du nyer khrid de//gto bde'i yid bzhin nor la longs spyod shog/byams pa chog lor/dgra gnyen bar mar chags snang sgang ga gongs dang //bral ba'i byams pa chen pos1357dud kyi dpung //legs bcom rnam par thar pa bdag sogs 'gros//'dzin pa'i skal pa bzang por 'gyur bar shog/rje rin po che/rnam dpyod dpung pas btegs pa'i ut+pal rtser//mkhyen pa'i ral gris log rtog dra ba kun//gcod mdzad 'jam dbyangs bla ma btsong kha ba'i//'phrin las srid pa'i pha mthar rgyas gyur cig/chu byi sto zla pha pa'i nang du chos 'bor tso gyi dmag zor ma dang las skyon gyi mtshor dga' gdong sngags rma la pa dang dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gnyis gos dar gser dngul sman sna sogs mtsho rdzas phon che ba 'bul bar btang skab byams chen las shal lam dzigo byang nge spos la sbyor//'gro la gcig tu brtse ba'i mtho ris chus//yid grubs 'dab ldan gyis sbar zhugs kyi dpung //gzhil mdzad mi pham mgon kyi rgyud lnga'i 'gro/nges par legasapa'i lam la sbyar du gsol//ge ra chos mdzad blo bzang dge 'dun tshe'i dus byas skabs gsol dpon blo bzang mkhyen brtses jo shāka/rang byon lnga ldan/'phags pa lo ke sha ra rnams la snyan shal phul ba'i kha yig dgos tshul byung ba ltar bkod pa byang chub mchog la spyod pa'i thugs rje bskul ba/rdzo bo rin po che/gdul dka'i 'gro la ched du brtse ba'i thugs//rab bskyed nyi ma'i gnyen zhal lta ba'i snal//dman la mgon khyod byin rlabs ma' sum du//'jug phyir nyid las ga' na min nyer dgongasakye//lnga pa'i lam gyur dmigs yul bar ma do'i//dang pas skrag du las drangs dal ba'i rten//thob pa don ldan bsgrubs pas yid can kun//'dren phyir byang chub mchog gi sang snyeg shog/a rje tsho/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()dmigs bya'i rgyud la dgos pa'i dug lnga'i me//byams brtse ga t+pā ra yis zegs138bsgo yis/rab gzhom nges legs bsil ldan reg bya'i bder//spyod pa'i bsod nams ri bo dngos rgyur shog/losarwar/'jig rten dbang phyug lhag bsam spyan gyi zur//dkyus ring nam mkha'i mtha' snyed de srid du//'gro rnams mi 'dod dam bca'i khur khyer don//ji bzhi thugs rje bskul ba'i smreng 'di gsol//byin rlabs mtho ris chu pos mi khom pa'i//'jigs rung zhugs kyi phung po yongs bcil nas//blo bzang dge 'dun mngon mtho'i lam bzang du//nyer khrid thar pa'i grong du 'jug byin rlobs//'di'i ched dmigs so cog gi chos dkar rdul//bsags pa'i phung po mthor brtsegs ri rab spor//gto bde rnam par rgyal ba'i pho brang du//chos kun gzigs pa'i mig stong ldan gyur cig/dge slong phun tsho gos rgya mtsho me 'phru〈snang gtsug lag dang 4thong 'phags par 'a3 phul ba'i kha byang byang chung mchog la ngesasbyor/sna tsho gos ri mo bkra ba'i gos 'phan 'dis//nyer mtshon dngos bshams yid sprul mchod pa'i tshogs//sras bcas rgyal bar phul bas lus can kun//bla med byang chub go 'phang 'thob par shog/bye ba phrag brgya'i klung gi rdul snyed grangs//rnam 'dren sras dang slob mar bcas pa rnams//gcig bsdus 'phrul snang lha tsho gis thugs rje yis//bdag sogs 'gro kun nges legs sar 'khrid shog/lag na bad dkar lang ba rang byung du//gzugs bas skye rgur dngos ston 'ag rten dbang //byin rlabs snying la zhugs te mkha' mnyam gyi//ma rgan sems can mtha' dag 'dren par shog/'byug na da la grol skab phan ge legs 9na tog da gling pa'i gral du chos skyong :ra bto rag bto du snyan dar kha byang tshon 45mo sto sa grub//dkalo/rab dkar thugs rje'i bdud rtsi mtho ris chus//las nyon des bskyed nad gdon nyes tshogos kun//legs bkrus srid zhi'i bde chen zil dngar gyi//snying gi bum bzang rtag tu 'geng par mdzod//sgo po/byin chas gzi brjid yid bzhi nor bu las//lung rtogs yon to tshe dpal stobs lhor 'od//brgya phrag nyi ma'i mdangs la 'gong nus pa//bla nasabla ru wor ba'i wen las mdzod//dmar po/dkyuXring spyan gyi zur mnga' phog pa'i mod//'khor

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ tana'adas phun tshogs brtan pa cig car du//phrogs te khams gsum dbang phyug gtsug tor rtser//legs byas zla ba'i cha shas nya gang mdzod//sngon/lha bus yid zhugs brlang spyod gom pa'i rjes//bstan 'gro'i bde skyid pad mtshor 'jog byed kun//drag shul srab med seng ger rab 'phyo ba'i//sder mos phug pa'i snying gi khrag dron gsol//ljang gu/'dod pa'i man shel rdul mang brtsegs pa'i ngos//'phrin las sna tsho gos 'ja' ris yongs shar nas//don rnams grub pa'i yongs khru sa brtol gyi//dge legs ro brgya bda' ba'i 'bras myong mdzod//he shrī sman tse/lus /stodagos/mji ldim ma ga mi ni rā stog yurla skyo//chu glang gnam lo gsar tshes kyi srid gsum dbang mo mchod pa'i dus dar tshon sna lnga'i snyan shal phul ba'i kha yig rang byung lus kyi rdo rjer 'a lhas bar pa'i gto snya//dkar po zhi ba'i 'phrin las 'bum phrag zla dkyil cha//nya gang 'od kyis sdig dang de 'bras139bson//mthar byed tshangs pa'i bu mo yid 'phrog ma//bde chen 'khor lor rtag rol bsams don sgrubs//ser po/rgyas pa'i 'phrin las stong phrag nyi ma'i gzi//chos srid 'khor lor rtag rol bsams don sgrubs//dmar po/dbang gi 'phrin las zur mig dkyus ring mda'//phog pa'i mod la 'khor 'das brtan 'phrog pa'i//chom rkun lag na pad dkar sras mo khyod//longasaspyod 'khor lor rtags spyod bsams don sgrubs//mthing kha/drag po'i 'phrin las gnam lcags rdo rje'i rtse//babs dang lhan cig yid srubs sder bcas drag/mthar byed dbang phyug bu mo phur pa'i lha//chos kyi 'khor lor rtag rol bsam don sgrubs//ljang gus tshogs 'phrin las dpag bsams yongs 'du'i ljon//'dod pa'i re ba stong ba'i gos ster ma//rol gcig lha mos rjes bzung re ma tī//bde skyid 'khor lor rtag rol bsams don sgrubs//chu glang cho 'phrul mchod pa'i dus rdzo bo shākya mu nir lcags ri dang tshal bu rgya mu tig gi bskor ba'i gos tā khung gi snam sbyar/lha khang so sor 'i shal spyir slong gos kyi bla bre/'a3 cha gsum/de nas mi ring bar nged rang la dmigs nas gas gyisabyin pa'i ser gan go tshon khra/gos sgril btags//bkras btags so gos bzang gos la grub pa bstogasum skor nang sha yang

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)gos sngo ljang las byas pa maṇ+ḍal ra ba'i bla zer phul ba'i snam sbyar sogs kyi kha yig nam mkha'i mdzod kyi sgo brgya 'byed pa/ /bskal mang sngon nas goms pa'i thugs bskyed kyi/ /dam bca'i phung po mkha' mnyam sems can mtha'/ /ma zad de srid rdzogs min snying rje yis/ /ches cher (140na snyigs ma'i tshul 'dir lhag par dgongs/ /'gro rnams thogs med dus nas gnag pa'i las/ /nyer bsags 'bras smin rang gi thog babs pa/ /sras bcas rgyal bar yus chen byar med kyang / /nyam thag 'dren khur khyod min lasagazhan su/ /de phyir brgyud lnga'i lam 'khyams ma rgan kun/ /mgon khyod mkhyen brtse nus pa'i phyag khyongs la/ /phan dang bde ba'i mngon mtho nges legs grong / /'dren pa'i bka' drin bla na med de stsol/ /༈rdzo bo/ mgon po rtag tu gsal pa'i spyan ras kyis/ /nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam 'gro la nyer gzigs te/ /sdug kun bden las rnam grol 'gog lam gyi/ /gtan bde'i mchog sbyin sgo brgya 'byed par gsol/ /ge rtsa snyag zhal/ nam yang khro ba med pa snying rje can/ /bdud snying zar rngamasagatums pa'i mche gtsigs pa/ /sngon tshe 'byung po'i dpung tshogs tshar bcad bzhin/ /deng yang dbang drag rol gar ci yang ston/ /dpal lha/ khyod kyi 'bangs min srid 'dir ma mchims na/ /bar gcod smag rum mthar byed mthu rtsal gyis/ /nyin byed thugs rje'i dgung las yongs 'char bar/ /bskul na 'dod don sgrubs shig dpung skyong lha/ /lha khang gas/ ma hā kā ru'i snye — ba rā nu : ba gya si : ya ts+tsha / chu glang 'dar pa lo tsā ba 'khor zhag gi skabs thub bstan dge 'phel gyi tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i sku brnyan la snyan shal phul ba'i kha byang dngos grub rol mtsho/ /mgon khyod rdo rje'i lus la gdan gsu4lha/ /tshang ba'i nges pa lnga ldan mtshan dpe'i sku/ /tshur mthong 'gro ngor bshes gnyen dam pa'i tshul/ /'dzin mdzad rigs kun bdag po tshar pa rje/ /dag pa'i ye shes (140ba)mkha' la spyod pa'i zhing / /rdo rje btsun mo'i grong khyer nyams dga' bar/ /zung 'jug sgyu dra'i rol rtsed mngon bsgyur kyang / /ljongs 'dir gdul bya'i tsho gos la gcig tu brtse/ /de phyir thugs rje chen po'i nyi zer gyis/ /bdag blo'i 'dab brgya yongs su rab bzhad nas/ /mchog 316

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'dathun dngos grub bdud rtsi dngar po'i ror//spyod pa'i skal ba bzang por rjes su zungs//'dar los thub bstan dge 'phel mgon khang gi gur mgon la phul ba'i snyan dar zhal byang bde skyid 'dzad pa med pa'i mdzod/sangs rgyas kun gyi mthu stobs nus pa'i khams//rdo rje srin por bzhu blugs nag po che//gnas srung mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo dud sol ma//las sgrub 'chi bdag gshin rje pu tra nag khugs drag thogs med byin rlabs gru bo ches//bdag sogs nyes brgya'i chu gter las bsgral nas//bde skyid rin chen gling du dngos grub kyi//'dzad med nor la spyod pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//'dar los dge 'phel mgon khang gi mgon po zhal la snyan shal phul ba'i kha yig dngos grub yid bzhin char snyil//gdong bzhi mgon po'i rtsub 'gyur drag po'i rtsal//mthong ba'i mod la lha chen khrag skyug na//yid srubs sde bcas don snying dum bu sa/gas la mtshar 'dzin byis pa'i blo gros tsam//gang gi lasamakhan beg tse lcam dral sogs//'khor tsho gis dregs pa'i dmag gi dpung chen pos //gnod byed dgra dang bgegs rnams tshar bcad de//mchog thun dngos grub yid bzhin char du snyil//chu glang zla tshes la 'dar lo r+ṣa 'khor bzhug la 'degs skabs zhar byung du mang mkhar thub bstan dge 'phel gyi rdo rje 'chang 141na〉nga pa chos rje'i sku bas la 'bul rgyu bskur ba'i snyan shal nan cing kha btags bkra shis rtags brgyad ma'i kha byang 'di phyi'i gto bon sa grub//dhiḥyig dmar ser sa bon zhu ba las//'jam mgon gos dkar 'chang ba snying po'i zhabs//tshad ma bzhi ldan snyan brgyud slob bshad chos//'dzin mdzad rgyal kun ngo bo tshar pa rje//smin grol khron pa'i nang du khengs pa'i snying //zab don rgya mtsho mthong tshe 'gas byed pa'i//sabardzus phal gyis ma thos gong ma yi//gser cho sogadams pa'i 'dzin mkhas blo gsal zhabs//mgon po drug cu par grags zan rlon gyis//nor skyong rngan la mthu stobs cher rlom dang //mtshungasamin bsnyen sgrub las sbyor tshad ldan gyis//rdo rje chos stong bran bkol grags pa'i mtshan//rtag tu 'khor mas bdag gi nying 'byul ngor//zhing skyong bram ze'i gzugs can bka' gtad de//zab chos stsal ba'i brda thabs bstan pa bzhin//mngo/ sum nyams su myong ba khyod kyi drin//deng nas

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()dgyes mdzad rdo rje he ru rka'i//rang zhal rang ngo 'phrod min de srid du//dam pa'i bshes gar+sā khyod kyis rjes bzung nas//'di phyi'i gto mdun 'grub par bdag byin rlobs//'dar lo 'khor zhag skabs zhan thong du bse 'bag nag po 'phur shes la gzhi gos nag thog bar snang mdzod kyi ri mo can yug ring gi snyan shal phul ba'i zhal byang bdud snying 'thigs pa'i gnam lcags thog mda'//gtum drag 'bar ba'i dur khrod chen po'i dbus//bstan srung yongs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba che/khugs chen gnam lcags thog gis bdud sde'i snying //'bigs mdzad gtum drag srin po gur gyi mgon//rdo rje 141ba tshe rus kyi rtsa 'khor dngas ma'i khams/khyud gsum dregs par shar ba'i zlos gar gyis//las rlung dhu tir dag nas rnam grol te//las kun thogs med grub pa nang gi mgon//kun kyang dngas ma'i mtsho la zla gzugs bzhin//gsal stong zung 'jug brjod bral rang gi sems//rang zhal macan sum mthong nas tshe 'di la//bcu gsum rdo rje'i sa brnyes gsang ba'i mgon//deng nas grub mtha' rnyogs min de srid bar//zhi rgyas dbang drag smin grol sal ma gyi//lung rtogs legs tsho gos yon tan ma lusapa//dkar cha'i zla ltar rtag 'phel 'phrin las mdzod//'dar lo 'khor zhag skabs zhan byung kha'u skyes lhas su gos nag sprin ris skug gi snyan dar phul ba'i kha yig mchog mas sgrub pa'i nye phro//chos kyi dbyings nas tshad med rnam bzhi'i zhal//ris bral 'gro kun 'dzum gyisanyer bsu yang //ma rig 'khrul ngor rno ngar mche ba yis//chem chem mi ro za ba stobs log dbang //gsal stong sems kyi gdangs las rtsa khams rlung //dag pa'i mgon por shar ba'i cho 'phrul gar//te se gru 'dzin ha ha dgod sogs na/khyud gsum dregs pa'i dmag dpung nag po che//bsam ngan sbyor rtsub 'chang ba'i dgra bgegs steng //brdungs pa'i bro yis snying dbug lkog ma sa/thon la mtshar du ma 'dzin khrag dron rgyun/khung drongs bdun brgyad tshun gyi rtsa ba chod//tshe 'dir mchog gi snying po zung 'jug lam//nye bar sgrub la mthun pa'i grogs mdzad zhan//nad gdon nyes tshogs kun zhi tshe dpal rgyas//khams gsum dbang du bsdu ba'i shā las mdzod//

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ tana'adar lo 'khor (142na/lhan skabs zhan byung pu tra khang du gos nag 'dom gang gi snyan dar phul ba'i kha yig dkar phyogs rgyal phe ru mar+sā/ /bram ze'i dmod pa bor ba'i 'bras bu las/ /skye 'gro yongs kyi bla srog tshe gsum la/ /dbang sgyur 'chi bdag gshin rje pu tra nag /lcam dral gnod sbyin yab yum 'khor bcas kye/ /bstan bde'i phan bde 'phrog pa'i chom rkun spyi/ /rnal 'byor chos bzhin spyod la sgos kyi dgrar//mthu stobs gnam lcags rdo rje drag phob la/ /dkar phyogs rgyal ba'i ru mtshon mkha' la phyor/ /'dar lo 'khor zhag skabs zhar byung brag ram mgon khang du gos dmar 'dom gang gi snyan shal phul ba'i kha byang lasasgrub snang bsas khyab/ /dbang drag skyes bu lcam dral mas stobs gzi/ /brgya phrag nyi ma'i 'od kyis dgra bgegs mun/ /mthar byas phan bde'i snang bas kun khyab pa'i/ /las rnams sgrubs shig beg tse lcam dral lha/ /nyi 'od grags pa gnyan lo 'dar phyar zhabs/ /mus srad pa dang tshar chen chos kyi rgyal/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma'i 'khor lo'i mgon rnams kyis/ /bka' dang dam la btags pa nyer bar dgongs/ /khyad par rtsa ba'i bla ma gnas gsar ba/ /mgon des rjes bzung chos dbyings rang grol gyis/ /rig 'dzin bdag gi srung mar gnyer gtad pa/ /ma g.yel bcol ba'i 'phrin las ma lus sgrubs/ /chu glang nag pa zla ba'i brgyad gtor gyi mchod pa'i dus chos skyong che chung las mkhan dang bcas par snyan shal phul ba'i kha byang mkha' 'gro'i zhal drod legs myang / /bkras btags/'og min nyid khams gtso bo'i rnam sprul (142ba tshe pas/ /ma hā kā la yongs kyi sde dpon du/ /mi'u thung srin po'i gzugs can gur gyi mgon/ /yum mchog srid gsum dbang sgyur dud sol ma/ /rtsa khams yul gyi rgyud gsum dregs pa rnams/ /skyed mdzad kun gyi yum gcig ral gcig dang / /lcam dral dam can rgya mtsho'i lha yi tshogs/ /phyi nang mchod pas thugs dam stong byed na/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid rgyas pa dang / /rnal 'byor bdag gi zhi rgyas dbang drag gi /las kun thogs pa med par nyer bsgrubs te/ /bsams pa' re ba ma lus skong bar mdzod/ /ling ljang /stang zil brtsegs pa'i lhun po dus mtha mes/ /klubs kyang lha khyod cha tsam bsgrun min pas/ /dpe zla ma rnyed tshangs pa rgan po des/ /'chol ba'i mod la zag bcas gnyid la g.yur/ /bstan dgra'i —319

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)gshed du bcom ldan he ru gaḥ /mi'u thung srin po'i lus 'dzin stobs log nag /rang lus nyer bzhi yul gyi zhing skyong ba/ /rnal 'byor las sgrub khol po bram ze'i gzugs/ /rgyal kun ye shes zla ba gdul bya'i mtshor/ shar ba'i thub bstan bsrung ma ches mang yang / khugs drag mthu stobs 'bar ba'i thog mda' yis/ /srid gsum cig car 'gems nus khyod nyid tsam/ /de phyir 'phags yul mkhas grub kun gyi gtso/ /klu sgrub ta thā ga ta ri sul ma/ /gangs can mig gcig gnyan lo sa skya pa/ /'khon rigs 'jam mgon rim byon srung ma mchog /khyad par tshar chen yab sras byin rlabs drod/ /ma yal gnas gsar zur chen zha lu pa/ /khyab bdag rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam gsum gyis/ /rig 'dzin bdag la bka' bsgos gnyer gtad dgongs/ /gnod byed gzugs can gzugs med snying gi khrag /hub drongs sha khrag (143na〉rdus pa chem chem zo/ /yid srubs sdobacas las rgyal rnga bo che/ /khamasagasum kun la thos par drag tu rdungs/ /ma dang mkha' 'gro'i zhal drod ches dngar ba'i/ /snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan 'dzin bdag gi /tshe dpal bsod nams sa lam yon tan tshogs/ /yongs 'du ltar rgyas 'gro ba'i re skong mdzod/ /kha bshas/ bum thod las babs rab dkar bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /bde chen 'khor lo'i lam brgyud rtsa khams kun/ /gang bsa' med tshe dbang dngos grub rnams/ /stsol bar mdzod cig sku yi mgon po kye/ /4dmar/dmar 'od glog stong 'byug 'dra'i lcags khyo yis/ khrid dang zhi ba'i phun tshogs yin no cog /brtan pa 'phrog pa'i sgyu 'phrul thabs chen pos/ /dbang du mdzod cig gsung gi mgon po kye/ /ling sngon/ gnam lcags 'bar ba'i gri gug gdengs tsam gyis/ /log 'dren sdodang bcas pa sha khrag rus/ /dum /kur gcod pa'i gtum chen drag shul ches/ /mngon spyod las mdzod thugs kyi mgon po kye/ ling ser/ rin chen gyis gang thod pa las 'ongs pa'i/ /srid zhi'i phun tshogs dngos grub char chen pos/ /tshe dpal lung rtogs yon tan ma lus pa/ /rgyas par mdzod cig yon tan mgon po kye/ khyabashas/ /tshangs spyod bram ze'i smon lam btab pa'i 'bras/ /gdug pa'i gnod sbyin pho mo bgos pa las/ /srid gsum skye 'gro'i srog bdag pu tra nag /gnod sbyin bha tra —320

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ tanasring mo ral gcig kye//glog ltar 'byug cing myur ba'i rdzu hrūl dang //sus kyang mi thub thogs med stobs rtsal mthus//'jam po'i las gsum 143ba〉byad par mngon spyod kyis//dgra dpung thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du rlog/ling dmar/snad pa'i mig chu kha sna'i khrag rgyun 'bab//dbugs bral bam myags rul pa'i dri 'thul ba//bse mkhar thod pa'i kha bad ma ru rtse'i//gnod sbyin lcam dral las mkhan 'khor tsho gos kyi//nyi 'od grags pa gnyan lo 'dar phyar zhabs//tshar chen yab sras rtsa ba'i bla ma zung //brgyud par bcas pa'i dam tshig gnyan po rnams//nye bar dgongs la ma g.yel mthu dpung skyed//sngar byas phyis 'byung da lta mngon gyur dgra'i//don snying dron mo phyungs la zhal du gsol//mi nor srid sder bcas pa rdul du rlogs//rjes shul ming tsam brda tsam med par mdzod//chu glang dar mo sman sgos pas ga4 ne'u thog gi dbyar chos 'a mor 'di ga'i ring le'i rten khrung du mang du bskul ba'i tshe sgrol ma rtsod rgyal ma dang chos skyong brtse khrab pa gnyis la sa dar 'bul ba'i kha byang dgos tshul byung ba ltar bkod pa 'jigs 'a bas wor ma sto//'phags ma khyod zhabs bsnyen pa'i mod nyid la//mnyen 'jam phyag sor spyi bor nyer bkod de//'jigs chen brgyad sogs nyes brgya kun zhi ba'i//thugs rje byin rlabs bdag snying 'jug par shog/dpal ldan skyes bu'i mthu stobs nus pa'i gzis//dgra bgegs smag rum mthar byas bstan dang 'gro'i//phan bde'i snang ba rgyas pa'i mchod sbyin sgo//'byed pa'i 'phrin las lhun grub thogs med mdzod//chu glang nag pa zla ba'i nang du nged ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung du dmigs dge slong 'jam dbyang grags pas phan bde legasabashad gling par gra dar bzhes thug gi thog sa dar brgya dang bdun sto144na khon lnga phul ba'i tshe/tshe dpag med/bka' bas/tshe bdag/dmag zor ma/chos skyong spyi rnams la 'phul ba'i kha yig dgos tshul byung bltar bkod pa 'dod don yongs 'du'i 'brasayong //tshe dpag med/srid zhi'i dngas ma'i bcud kun thabs shes kyis//srog gi zungs su 'dren mdzad tshe mtha' yas//byin rlabs gzi yis 'chi med 'pho ba che//'gyur med rdo rje'i sku ru deng 'grub mdzod//btso bas/bgrang yas dkyil 'khor kun 'dus sgrub sdo brgyad//byin rlabs 'dzad pa med pa'i chu

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)rgyun gyis/ /gnas skabs 'phrin las bzhi 'grub bskyed rdzogs dang / /rdzogs chen lam gyis tshe 'dir grol byin rlobs/ /tshe bdag /lhun grub kun bzang 'jam mgon gzhon nu de/ /'khor 'das phyag rgya zil gyis gnon pa'i ched/ /dus dgra'i gar bsgyur tshe bdag nag po yis/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal pa'i las mdzod cig /dam gzor ma/ /tshangs pa'i bu mo ngag gi mchod sbyin mkhan/ /dgra bgegasagashed mar khrag 'thung srin mo'i gzugs/ /dran pas gdung sel 'dod khams dbang phyug mas/ /bsam pa'i re ba ma lus stong bar mdzod/ /chos skyong spyi/ sum brtsegs grong khyer 'jig pa legs ldan lha/ /myur mdzad rdo rje gur dang stobs 'grogs dbang / /gnyis med ma ning nag po la sogs pa/ /bstan srung dam can rgya mtshos 'phrin las sgrubs/ /chu glang phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i gnyer dge slong phun tsho gis rgya mtsho/ dge slong yon to dpal bzang / 'jam dbyangasargyal mtshan gsum gyis gtsug gtor rnam rgyal mar snyan shal phul ba'i kha byang 'chi med mchod sbyin/ /gang gi 'khas sen me long dngas (144ba)pa'i ngos/ /'chi med rdo rje'i srog gi gzugs shar bas/ /lha chen nyi ma'i bu yi ā dar+sha/ /'dzin pa'i ngal ba gtong mdzad bcom ldan ma/ /khyod zhal dran pa'i mod la 'khor 'dasakyi/ /mi bzad gdung ba mtha' dag rab gzhil tshe/ /mchod bstod gsol ba mdzad par 'dod pa'i don/ /'grub na yongs 'du'i ljon pa dmigs su med/ /de phyir gar dbang 'od dpag med mgon gyis/ /legs bsngags rnam par rgyal ma lha dgu yi/ /thugs rje'i phyag ring brkyangs nas bdag sogs 'gro/ dbugs dbyung phan bde'i dpal la sbyor bar gsol/chu glang zla ba dgu pa'i tshes bco lnga la dar mo sman rams pa blo bzang chos grags kyi rdzo shāka rnam gnyis/ rang byon lnga ldan/ rje bas bcong kha pa/ lo ge shwa rwa rnams la snyan shal phul ba'i kha byang gzhan phan sgo 'byed/jo bo shākya mu ne/ mgon khyod spyan sngar gsal byed sgron me'i 'phreng / /sbar bas srid pa'i sdug bsngal smag rum dpung / /mthar byas bde skyid snang ba 'od po ches/ /khyab pa'i skal pa bzang po bdag la stsol/ /rdzo bo mi da rdo rje/ ma rig gnyid du g.yur ba'i lus can kun/ /rmongs mal las slong dge ba'i skya rengs kyis/ /blang dang dor bya'i —322

sku gsung thugs rten gsang 4khos dang mchod rdza khang slong gi dkar chags ga bam gsum pa/ 'dagazugs kun mngon sum du//mthong ba'i dga' ston deng 'dir stsal du gsol/༄ snyag spyo//rtag tu snying rje'i chu yis rab gsher yang //yongs 'gros rdo rje'i tsha tshas nag po'i sde//sngon bzhin chomasal gangs can sman ljongs 'dir//phan bde'i legs tshogis phyur bur spung par mdzod//mugs po losarwarwa/dgyes pa'i 'dzum gyi zhal sgo'i zer 'phreng gis/khyud lnga'i sems can yongs kyi zugs rngu'i nad//gzhil ba'i sman pa 145na ) chen po 'jig rten dbang //ring po'i phyag gis bdag sogs dbugasa'abyin mdzod//gyos gong sto kha pa/rgyal ba'i yab gyur blo gros rgan po yi//bzang po'i brtul zhugasa'achang yang gzhon nu'i gzugs//zur phud lnga ldan dge slong tshul 'dzin pa//grags pa'i mtshan can khyod kyis 'gro 'di skyongs//chu glang zla 7tshes7la ri rgya bdabang rgyal rdo rje phan bde'i leg gad gling du snya dar brgya dang bon stodon lnga phul phe zhal byang las da45wor//dkar po/las nye zhe des bskyed lusang ga yid mnar dri//rtsa gsum thugasarje'i klung gis rab bkrus nas//myang 'das grong khyer chen por bdag sogs 'gro//'jug phyir zhi ba'i sal ma sgo 'phar phye//ser po/rlung sems tir chud pa'i bde ba ches/khrid pa'i legs byasarnams kyang zhar rgyas pa'i//gnyis med thabs shes lang tsho dar drag ste//'di phyi'i gto mdun myur du grub par mdzod//dmar po/rang rig mtshan dpe'i ngo mtshar dpal 'bar la//mdzes sdug srid zhi'i bu mo rjes chags pas//snang ba dbang du sdud la mi ngal bar//kun yid brtan pa ngang gis 'phrog par mdzod//nag po/mi bsrun dug gsum cher rgyas dmar po'i snying //nyer phyungs slar yang ldang du med byas pas//phyi rol dgra bgegs brtse ba'i gnyen bshes su/shar ba'i mngon spyod las kyi sbyor ba sgrubs//rdzogu//dngos bshams yid sprul mchod pa'i rgyal mas rtser//byin chas nor bu dbang gi rgyal po che//gsol gdab bkru yi sri zhur byas pa'i 'bras//mchog dang thun mong dngos grub char du 145ba〉bsnyil//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2)shing stag nag pa zla ba'i brgyad gtor gyi tshe mgon po che sa las mkha dang sa par snya dar phul ba'i kha byang phren lasabye sgo sgo khed//lnga ldan snang mdzod thugs gsang dpal be'ur//rdo rje srin po'i gzugs shar gur gyi mgon//'phrin las ma lus sgrubs zhes bskul byed na//mahā kā li'i 'khor ༷ rgyal dgongs//dkar/gangs ri'i phung po zla ba zhun ma yis//'byud 'dra zhi ba'i las mdzod zhal bzhi pa//gang gisathugs rje'i 'od zer spros pa'i mod//nad gdon nyes brgya'i smag rum chal bar mdzod//ser/ri chu bo'i gser mdangs la 'khu ba'i//rgyas pa'i 'phrin las yongs mdzad zhal bzhi pa//khyod kyis tshe dpa la bsad nams lung rtogs kun//brgya phrag nyi ma'i phung po ltar 'bar mdzod//dmar/pad+ma rwa ga'i lhun po'i khengs 'phrog pa'i//dbang gi 'phrin las rab mdzad zhal bzhi pa//gang gis srid zhi'i yon to ji snyed kun//thogs pa med par 'gugs pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//skur/stang zil brtsegs pa'i ri bo du mtha'i mes//klubs 'dra drag po'i las mdzad zhal bzhi pa//khyod kyis bsams sbyor ga lang dgra bgegs kun//zhugs rtser phye ma leb bzhi tshar rdzo cig/ljang /zhing bcu'i gshed du dpal ldan he ru daḥ/ches cher rab khros lha wo stobs 'phrog dbang //gang gis bstan dang bstan 'dzin sbyin pa'i bdag/legs skyongs bcol ba'i 'phrin las ma lus sgrubs//yi/gnod sbyin yab yum pu tra ming sring dang //'bangs bcas dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kyis//phyi nang 146nagasang ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la//zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las ma lus sgrubs//beg tse/gnod sbyin yongs kyi mnga' bdag beg tse dang //bsam ga sbyor rtsub 'chang ba'i dgra bgegs kyi//lang long khol ba'i snying gi khrag dron 'thung / /shang stag zla nga lnga pa'i tshes bcu la phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i chog grwa stor dge slong 'jam dpal dbyang grag pa sa rgya sa dar nyer ga ṇi ga rtsa po 'byang spyan a sku ne i//tshed sha ṣ+ka/'jam mnyen pañtsa li ga'i gos zungasakyis//'od tsho stong 'bar sku la nyer klubs pas//gshin rje'i pho nya me long 'dzin pa'i khur//bto nas 'gro kun 6 med grong 'jug shog/rdo / gro lod/phyag na 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i tsha tsha yis//

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chags gsab ma gsum pa/ ()gnod byed 'byung po bsregs dang lhan cig tu//gnam lcags phur bus dam sri'i tsho gos kyi snying //zang thal phug ste lus med las rgyal mdzod//yang ga4drag po/lha bu phung po nyon mongs 'chi bdag gi/bdud bzhi'i 'dam ltar brdzis nas 'phung byed gdon//'dri srin 'byung po'i cho 'phrul stug po'i smag/shugs drag nyi ma'i 'od kyis sangs par mdzod//dregs pa mas byed/log smon bdo ba'i gzugs can lus med kyi//ga pa'i bsam sbyor mthu stobs rab bcom khi//ban bon gdug pa'i rbod ga kho rang gshed du//phob la srid gsum kun las rgyal bar mdzod//shing stag zla ga lnga pa'i tshe nyer drug la yar klungs phyos kyi srung ma rnams la 'bul rgyu'i snyan dar zhal yig dbu mdzad blo bzang yon to gyis gos4ltar bris pa ldan ba44'i re snang //'dod pa khams la dbang sgyur re ma tī//btsan rgod yang le ber sogs srung ma yis//chos ldan bsam pa'i bya ba mthar phyin mdzod//srid pa'i lha chen mthu stobs rgyas la can//'phyos lung skyong ba'i drang srong dkon pa dang //ga kho srung khan pa rdzong btsan dgra lha yis//'gal rkyen kun sol re ba ma lus skongs//bal glang sna ring la zhen srid pa gsum//myul mdzad sprul pa'i chos rgyal brgya byin che//bka' nyan bas rgod bshan par bcasarnams kyis//bsams pa'i don rnams lhun gyis grub par mdzod//shing stag zla nga drug pa'i tshes brgyad la lha spob ngag dbang dkon mchog gis ring le'i rten yang phags pa'i tshe rtsa ba gsum las dar brgyadang nyi shu rtsa tshwa gtso shā zhal yig byin sla46na phung //skyabs ma ga rig 'dzin bla ma rdo rje 'chang //ngo mtshar sgyu dra'i dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i gar//legs bsgyur khyab bdag pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal//sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las byin chen phob//zhi dang khro bo'i lha tsho gos ma lus pa//kun 'dus sgrub pa wo po sdo brgyad kyi//med byung thugs rjes mchogo dang a mong gi/dngos grub char gyis phan bde'i gos smin mdzod//bde chen nyer zhi'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang //gnam gsum mkha' 'gro bye ba'i dbang phyug gtso//yid grubs gshed du rab khros dmag zor lhas//log par 'dren pa'i dgra bgegs dpung bcas choms//srid zhi dngas ma'i bcud kun 'dren nus pa//'chi

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()med grub pa'i 'ja' lus 'od 'bar ba'i//snang ba gsar pas 'gro rnams rdzogs147na skon gyi//skye rgu'i tshe dang skal mnyam thob par shog/phul byung zhi ba'i 'phrin las ge ta gas//'khor 'das nyesabargya rnyog mas sbags pa'i klung //rab bgrungs bde legs gzugs brnyan 'char byed pa'i//dpal ldan dung skyong dbang mos rtag tu skyongs// shing stag zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes bco brgyad la rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde leg bshad gling du 'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i las byang zor las dang bcas pa dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyi phyag len dge sbyor srol btod pa'i tshe phul ba'i snyan dar zhal yig srigasug mas//kun bzang 'jam dpal chos sku'i klong yangs nas//dus dgra'i dpa' bo longasaspyod rdzogs sku'i gar//sdebargyad sprul skus dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa//'khor 'das phyag rgya zil gnon tshe bdag nag/'gro la rjes brtse'i dmar mdangs 'khrul ngo sa/log 'dren snying khrag khol mas ngo mes pa'i zhal//khams gsum za bar gdangs pa'i gad brgyangs kyis//mas byed byad ma'i rang gshed rang la phob//mi bsrun gzugs can gzugs med dmag tsho gos cho mes//rang skyob btsan po'i rdo rje'i gur khang phub//rnam par rgyal ba'i ga rnga srid rtser sgrogs//bkra shis dpal gyi dar chen phyogs kun phyor//shing stag zla rga༅ par dri za'i rgyal po rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal la bkang mchod shin tu rgya pa nyin bdun gyi bar bto ba'i snyan dar lhar yig bongs5'i ljon pa//mchod tsho gis sa bon thugs rje bskul gsher gyis//legs bskyed mthurtsal mngon phyungs yongs 'du'i ljon//las bzhi'i 'phrin las ro brgya bda' ba'i 'bras//dud pa'i dga' ston dpal la rtag spyod mdzod/shing stag hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes lnga la 'phyong rgyas pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin gyis rnam par rgyal pa'i phan bde legasabashad gling du dung gos dang snyan dar sna tshogs bdun stodon bdun phul ba'i kha byang rig 'dzin ba po shis g.yas 'khyil//au ṇ+ḍi yā na gnyis pa nges gsang gi/theg mchog chos mdzod kun dga' ra ba sa/gsum ldan rig pa 'dzin rnams 'du ba'i brdar//rab snyan bkra shis 'khyiX ba'i dung gi gos//sna tsho gos dbang po'i gzhu

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag gleg bam gsum pa/ 9)mdangs rjes 'gro ba/ /za 'og thags su btags pa bab le'i dbyibs/ /'phyong rgyasang ga dbang bstan 'dzin dang ba'i sems/ /ston zla lta bus bskrun pa'i legs byas 'bras/ /thub pa'i ring lugs 'phel shing lus can bde/ khyu sbyor las byed mtha' dag skye ba'i 'phreng / /mngon mtho'i them skas la 'dzegs ring min bar/ /byang chub mchog gi gling du 'jug par shog /sna tsho gos dar gyi lda ldi spel legs 'phreng / /kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin du mos pa'i blos/ /yongs sprul mkha' 'gro lha yi spyan lam du/ /ngag dbang bstan 'dzin snying stobs kyis phul bas/ /rnam mkhyen ye shes thob min de srid bar/ /rtsa gsum thugs rje'i 'jug pa rab shar nas/ /'di phyi gtan mdun pad+ma dkar po'i tshal /legs rgyas phan bde'i ge sar ba 'ad par shog /shing yos gnam lo gsar tshes kyi thog 'dod khams dbang phyug mar snyan shal sna lnga phul ba'i kha byang las bzhi lhun grub/ /dkar po / zla bzhin 'dzum 'od spros pa'i sgrib gnyis dang / /de gos nad gdon nyes mun sel lhan cig /spyi dang khyad par (148na〉stan dgra'i pad dkar 'dab/ /zum ste dmigs su med par rgyasathob cig /ser po/ sku gser gyi snye ma'i gzi 'od kyis/ /lung rtogs tshe dang bsod nams zla tshes pa//bla nas blar 'phel phun tsho gos rnam rgyas pa'i/ /snang bas phan bde'i kun+da bzhad par mdzod/ /dkar po/pad rwag mdangs zer rnon po'i lcags kyo yis/ /mtho ris gnas so cog 'gro'i snying phug nas/ /lung las nam yang mi 'da'i yi dam dar/ /thod du bcings pa'i cod pan mdzes par mdzod/ /mthing kha/bzod dka' srin mo drag khros ral klung nas/ /grangs med pho nya spros pa'i zhags pa yis/ /yid grubs sde bcas bsdams te thar med pa'i/ /gnam lcags 'bar ba'i bsdun khang nang du chug /lnga bku /rdo rje lang dbang paṇa wo dmar po'i zhabs/ /zhang ston rim par byon dang dge 'dun grub/ /dbyangasacan bzhad pa bsod nams rgya mtsho sogs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i dam tshig nyer dgongs nas/ /spyi dang bye brag thub bstan rin chen la/ /gnod pa'i gzugs can log 'dren dgra bo dang / /de rgyud zhugasapa'i gdon bgegs 'byung po'i tshogs/ /tshar chod thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du rlog /chos dang srid —327

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()kyi ring lugs rma med pa//rdzogs ldan dus bzhin ches cher rab rgyas shing //yid la re ba'i dpag bsam ljon pa'i 'bras//smin pa'i skal ba bzang po lhun grub mdzod//shing yos nag pa zla phe brgyad gtor kyi tshe dpal mgon che wo bka' stod dang tsos pa'i thugs dam rgya cher skong ba'i dus sa shal phul phe kha byang tso sang dpa' bo'i gad rgyangs148bskor/bder gshegs kun gyi 'phrin las khol ma'i zhun//rdo rje srin po'i gzugs su rab smugs pa'i//drag shul tsha tsha 'phros pas yid grubs sde//phye mar thogs shigs ma hā kā la kye//ko/rdul dral ston zla bzhus ma byugs pa'i bzhin//dkar/khro 'dzum 'dab brgya grol ba'i snang ba yis//nyes brgya'i dpung tshogs stug po smag gi rum//rab sangs zhi ba'i 'phrin las lhun grub mdzod//ser/ri rgyal gling bzhig dan du bting ba'i gzis//'khor 'das rtsal stobs 'phrog pa'i zil chen pos//legs byas bla nas blar yang 'bar ba'i 'bras//yongs dud rgyas pa'i 'phrin las lhun grub mdzod//dmar/pad rwag sa 'dzin la 'gran g.yon gyi zhal//ha har ba 'ad pa'i gad rgyangs thos pa'i mod//srid zhi'i phun tsho gos brtan pa ma lus pa//nyer bkugs dbang gi 'phrin las grub par mdzod//nag/chem chem mi ro za ba mche ba'i 'phreng //khrag dron chal chil g.yo ba srin po'i zhal//gdangs pas dgra bgegs don snying dum bu sa/rab bkas drag po'i 'phrin las lhun grub mdzod//ljang /rtsa khams dngas mtsho ri rang sems gsal ston gzugs//yongasashar rnam 'phrul dur khrod brgyad myul mgon//gcig las du ma'i rol pas mchogo thun gyi//sna tshogs skrun las ma lus lhun grub mdzod//yo/ser /gnod sbyin yab yum bsgos sras gshin rje'i gtso//pu tra ming sring ru 'dren sdo bzhing bcas//'phral bsad 'dar ba'i dbang po sna lnga'i zas//snying khrag dron mo 'thungs la las kun sgrubs//be gtse/brgya phrag gnyis149na)'khyud byu ru'i lhun po'i gzi//'phrog mdzad gnod sbyin lcam dral 'khor tsho gis rnams//stong gsum skad cig myul la gnag pa'i dgra'i//byang khog gzhags nas don snying dmar zas mdzod//shing stag ljangs rgyal thang du rgyab byas gtso kar dgon /༷ skya ser du mo sku chir ga thur tha'i jig thog drang bod sog gi

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bldengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag gleg bam gsum pa/ tanadabung 'byor pa 4 nas dmigs med du song ba'i tshe lhan srung dam ༅ rgya mtshor gto rag bto ba'i dus snya dar zhal yig srid gsus mas/khus kyi dgra bor phyag rgya zil gnon gar//rab bsgyur bka' nyan ma hā kā la dang //'dod khams ma sogs pho rgyud mo rgyud kyi//dregs pa'i sde dpon dam can rgya mtsho kye//bsam sbyor ga 'chang log par 'dren pa'i dpung //bsod nams mnga' thang tshe srog mi rtag pa'i//lam du nyer bkod snyan grags dbyar gyi rdzas//yid kyi rma bya dga' ba'i zlos gar sgyur//de phyir dngos bshamasayid sprul gtang rag gi/phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin legs spel na//slar yang stod smad phyogasamatshams mi bsrun dgra'i//don snying khrag dron hub kyis 'dren par mdzod//ra bzung bcagacig pa'i srin po zhes pa shing yos kyi lo gdan sa bar pa shab dge sding bkra shis bsam grub tu sa skya khri chen ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug dang khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba'i dpon gnas gsar ngag dbang bsod nams sogs la mkhan ོ chos kyi rgyal po zha lu ba slob bshad snyan brgyud bzhi ldan stsal ba'i tshe/sgo sum mgon khang du bzhugs pa sangs rgyas dngos kyisar sgeg nas mdzad pa'i brtse 'bag nag po 'phur shes la bzang gos mu min mdog lug gi snyan shal phul ba'i kha byang bongs 'du'i lā na//brgya phrag nyi mas 'gyud pa'i stang la ri//mi'u thung srin po'i gar mkhan nag po che//bstan srung yongs kyi 'khor wa ba'i lha//mthu stobs dbang phyug gur gyi mgon po kye//'phags bod rtsa rgyud bla ma'i dam tshig bzhi//'jig rten kun bde tso pa'i lung rtogs dang //de 'dzin skyes bu 'dus pa'i sdos sa rnams//dbyar gyi char sprin lta bur cher 'phel zhing //khyad par bdag med mkha' 'gro'i gsung ngag chos//snyan brgyud slob bshad spel la 'tshe ba'i gegs//rab gzhil tshad ma bzhi ldan 'chad nyan rgyun//srid mtha'i bar du chad med 'phel bar mdzod//ra go byud bcagacig pa'i zin po zhes pa shing bo kyi lo gdan sa bar pa shag dge sding ba po shis bsam grung tu sa skya khri 'a ngag dbang bsod nam dbang phyug dang /khyab bdag bka' 'gyur pa'i dbon gan gas rang ga dbang bsod nams sogs la mkhan wo chos kyi rgyal po zha lu pas zlog da snya brgyud sto ldan stsal phe tshe dam ༅ srung ma sprin bsto bo phe gnas mcho/kha'u brag rdzong du leg ldan gdong bzhi par bzang gos wom saX ༷ga gis shal phul ba'i kha yig bdud sde 'joms pa'i gad

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung tshom/ ()brgyangs//gsal stong sems nyid gcig bu'i rnam sprul mgon//rtsa khams rlung gi dngas mar grub pa'i rtsal//phyi rol 'khrul mtshor shar ba dregs pa'i gzugs//drag po gzi ldan dbang phyug gdong bzhi pa//rnal 'byor dbang mo g.yi lo sa skya pa//tshar r+sā yab sras rnams kyi 'da' dka'i (150na)dam//nyer bzhags ma bsnyel slob bshad 'chad to la//'tshe ba'i bdud rigs sdebacas thal bar rlog/gsung ngag gser chos brgya bzhi mgon zung gi/zab don rang bstan kha'u brag rdzong srol//nyi ma'i dngos brgya won pa'i 'od po tsho//snang bas yid kyi 'dod pa kun 'jor mdzod//rab byung bcagacig pa'i srin po zhes pa shing yos kyi lo gdan sa pa bar pa shab dge sdings ba po shis bsam grub tu ra khri wo ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug dang /khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba'i dpon gan sar sha dang bsod nams sogs la mkha wo chos kyi rgyal po zhwa lu ba slong ga snya brgyud sto ldan bas ༅ tshe pu tra kho du la kyi gshin rje pu tra ming sring la rtags brgyad kha ba74dom lor ma'i snya dar phul ba'i kha byang rnam par yi ba'i ru 4zha//bram ze'i dmod pasaganod sbyin yab yum sras//sems can las la grub pa nyi ma'i bu//pu tra ming sring gtum rngam 'chamasa'agros kyis//tso spyon sngon gyi dam si nye bar dgongs//khyad par mchog sred rnam 'phrul kun spangs rje//tshar wo ma' brtse'i zhabs sogs bla ma yi//spyan sngar zhal bzhes ri bzhin slob bshad rgyun//spel bar mtho 'tsham dgra bgegs snying khrag 'thung //tshad ma bzhi ldan snyan brgyud go rim ltar//mi 'chol rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i sgo//legs 'grig de 'dzin rnams kyi ba lko pa'i don//thogs pa med par lhun gyis grub par mdzod//rang ca bcagacig pa'i srin po zhes pa 0bshing yos kyi lo gdan sa bar pa shang dge sdings ba po shi bsam grub tu sa skya khri ོ ngag dbang bsgo nam dbang byug dang /khyab bdag bka' tsor phe dpon gan gsar sha dbang bar namasagos la mkha mu chos kyi sto po zha lu pa zlog nya snya bas sto ldan :yo phe tshe/bla brang sto las bas gas pa'i yang gan rin ོ nga mgon kho du blta zung rgya mcha cha bon kha bshas 'dom 'khor ma'i snya shal phul phe kha mig snyan bas lto ca'//rgyal kun mthu stobs bzhu bluXkhol ba'i sa//gtum brag rdo rje'i tsha tsha wo

sku gsung thug rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 6)'bar ba//gur gyi mgon po legs ldan gdong bzhi pa//bka' sdod 'khor tsho gos rgya mtshor bcas pa dgongs//'jam dbyangs bsod nams rgyal mas mchod la sogs//bla brang rin wo sgang pa'i gdung brgyud las//nyer 'ongs slob mar bshad pa'i smin grol rgyun//thub bstan ji srid gnas pa spel bar mdzod//zab mo'i chos 'di 'chad nyan sgrub pa la//gnod byed dgra bgegs klad khrag shub kyis drongs//de 'dzin sdo bcas yar ngo'i zla ba dang //dbyar gyi chu gter bzhi du 'phel bar mdzod//rab byung bcagacig pa'i srin po zhes pa shing yos kyi lo gdan sa bar pa shab dge sdings bkra shis bsam grub tu sa skya khri chen ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug dang /khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba'i dbon gnas gsar ngag dbang bsod nams sogs la mkha byu chos kyi rgyal po zha lu pa slong shad snya brgyud swo ldan stsal phe tshe/'a ོ chos kyi rgyal tsho ge gan 'dar stod rmug shong dge ba'i tshal gyi bla brang mgon khang du gnod sbyin 151na〉ga tse lcam dral la cha bdun kha btags 'dom 'khor ma'i snya shal phul phe 'dod pa'i yid bsto re stong //zangs khrag ral pa gsig pa'i gnod sbyin dang //srin mo bsgos sras zangs kyi beg tse can//rig pa'i lha mo gar gyi dbang phyug ma//bka' sdod bshan pa'i dmag tsho gos snyan gson cig/pad+ma thod 'phreng grub dbang 'dar 'phyar zhabs//chos kyi rgyal po blo gsal rgya mtsho sogs//dngos brgyud bla ma'i dam dgongs thub bstan srungs//mi bsrun dgra bo'i snying la rjen zas rgyob//khyad par gsang chen slob bshad man ngag mdzod//'chad nyan thos bsam bgyid par bar gcod pa'i//gnod byed nag po'i bdud sde tshar rdzo la//rnam par rgyal ba'i ba dan srid rtser phyor//shing yos hor zla bzhi par chos 'khor rgyal zhig gsos kyi skabs dge slong phun mas rgya mtsho dang blo bzang bzod pa/pad rdor gsum bto pa'i tshe mgon khang rnams su 'dod don gsol ba'i snya dar kha byang lon las lhun grub//de ri ko ṭi srid gsum dbang phyug dmag dang zor gyi lha//g.ya' ma skyong sogs bstan ma bcu gnyis dang //jo bo rgyal mtshan rta rgod shel lcags gis//nyer mtshon gzhi bdag rnams kyis bsam don sgrubs//bsilang tshes stobs ldan gur gyi mgon po zhal bzhi pa/33/bka' sdod pu tra dam can rgya mtsho yis//zhi rgyas

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()dbang drag las rnams ma lus pa//'bad med lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol//chos yang shod/beg tse lcam dral bshan 151ba pa dmar po dang //khyab 'jug pe har sku lnga yang le ber//rdor legs la sogs dregs pa'i sdod pon tshogs//deng 'dir bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod//he ru gaḥdapal spyan sngar bdud sde'i dpung //'joms shing dkar po dam pa'i chos skyong bar//zhal 'tshes bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tsho gos rnams kyis//ma g.yel bcol ba'i 'phrin las thams cad sgrubs//mi ngas//'jigs mdzad rdo rje bka' sdod nyi ma'i bu//legs ldan phyag drug mgon dang ngal bsosapo//srid pa'i rgyal mo stobs 'phrog gdong bzhi pa//beg tse lcam dral rnams kyis las kun sgrubs//shing bos mchode yul du gyur to cog gang la 'bul kyang mi 'gal ba'i snyan dar gyi zhal byang ba po shi kha btags la thags su bsgrun rgyu zhig dbu mdzad blo bzang yon to gyis dgos tshul ltar bkod pa yod med ga kho mdzod//mgon khang mthil/kun bzang mchod sprin g.yo ba'i lha rdzas kyis//bla ma rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas/khyud sde bye ba'i 'khor lo chos srung sogs//yongs 'dus rnam lnga'i mkha' 'gro dgyes bskyed mthus//blo bzang grags bstan rgya hor yul spel ba'i//bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dpal gyi 'phrin las rgyun//mkha' khyab 'gro rgyud rtog 'jug lus༅ rnams/khrid zhi'i bde skyid grib mar ngal gsor shog/drin phywa rtsam bla mkhyab bdag chos dbying rang grol gyi rnam par sprul pa gsang dar ma sgang gi bla ma bsod nam dpal 'byor gyi rigs su zhakhru pas pa'i yid ches kyi 152na〉'a ma rnyed pa'i dus yar klung bkra shis rtse chos sder mgon che wo las ma ga gnyis dang bas par bskang bshags gzabs rgyas btang ba'i tshe dgyes mdzad rdo rje/mgon po yang yum zhal/pu tra/beg tse rnams las shal phul ba'i kha byang dpags sa lha ma//dgyes mdzad rdo rje gur mgon zhal bzhi pa//las mkhan bcas pas khyab bdag pad+ma dbang //sprul pa'i gar la bgegs rigs mi 'jug cing //sku tshe 'phrin las 'phel ba'i lasamadzod cig/gyo bod rkya yig rigs la blo byang ba lcang gsebawo ma dbyang dpal bzang gi gung thang lha mor snya dar kha byang dgosa.abs god po 'dod pa'i re skong //dpal ldan lha mo ༷cudang rtsal gyi bdag/sna tshogs 'phrin las

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 1)bsgrub pa'i pa phrul gyis/ /ma mo yongs kyi rje mor dbang sgyur ba'i/ /spyan sngar snyan shal mchod sprin legs phul bas/ /mtha' klas yi ge'i 'du byed spel ba la/ /yangs pa'i blo gros spobs pa dge ba can/ /'jam dbyangs dpal bzang zug rngus nyer gtses pa/ /sgra gcan las grol zla bzhin rab gsal zhing / /mi nor bcas la 'tshe ba'i nad gdon bgegs/ /mkha' glang lta bur 'khrigs rnams lha khyod kyi/ /mthu stobs mi bzad rlung gis yongs bskrad nas/ /'dod don nyi ma'i gzi byin 'bar bar mdzod/ /shing yos dpal zha lu gser bkang gi chos sa chen por bstan pa spyi sgos kyi sku rim du 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje yag yum mchod cing bskul ba'i dus chen nam babs kyi tshe ma he yang yum la 'phrin las bcol ba'i snyan shal (152ba/) kha byang seng ge'i nga ro/ khrid gsum za ba'i zhal dgu cher gdangs pas/ khro gzhan lag cha stabs cig mchor mdzad pa'i/ /bka' sdod thod pa lcags kyi grong khyer na/ /skye rgu'i srog bdag las gshin yab yum kye/ /dang po'i mgon po kha sbyor bdun ldan nas/ /lā li ltas mtsho ni 'phags bal paṇa grub dang / /rwa skyo zhang mal gnyos te lo chen lnga/ /khyad par mas stobs dbang phyug rdo rje grags/ shes bya thams cad gzigs pa bu ston rje/ /rigs kun khyab bdag tshar chen yab sras sogs/ /dpal ldan dus dgra grub pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /bka' bsgos dam tshig gnyan po nyer dgongs la/ /gangs ljongs bshad sgrub bstan dang de skyong ba'i/ /dbang phyug dam pa'i lugs bzang chos srid khrims/ /mnga' 'bangs skye rgu'i bde skyid 'phrog byed pa/ /bdud rigs nag po'i rtsa lag drungs nas phyungs/ /yang sgos lho rong gnas la brten byas nas/ /ma rungs brlang por spyod pa 'brug srid sde/ /'chi bdag yab yum gtsor gyur sdebargyad kyis/ /tsho gis la rol la rjes shul rlung la skur/ /mgal du mang bar spel ba'i dri ma dang / /yongs bral smin grol rgyud bshad nges gsang theg /gzhung lugs brgal brtag lung rigs thos bsam dang / /rnam dag tshul ldan bstan pa dar bar mdzod/ kha ba'i ljongs 'dir chos nor 'dod thar te/ /sdo bzhi'i sgo 'phar rdzogs ldan ltar phye nas/ /gnam sa'i dbang phyug (153na)sa spyod rgyal po —333—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()yi//khrims kyi gnya' shing rab tu lci bar mdzod//sde 'dir bsam sbyor ngan 'chang dgra bgegs kyi//snying gi khrag dron zhal du gsol ba dang //ma byon sangs rgyas gsum par 'tshang rgya ba'i//bu ston chos rje'i ring lugs dar bar mdzod//gong 'og rgyud sde'i rgyun bzang rin chen 'phreng //mkhas grub dam pa'i bzhed pa dri med dang //tshad ma bzhi ldan slob bshad lung rtogs bstan//srid mtha'i bar du 'phel ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//na gshog kho/rim bdun sa 'og bshas ra chen po nas//ral pa tshar dgu yab yum 'khor bcas kyis//gzugs can dgra dang gzugs med bgegs kyi dpung //mthu stobs gnam lcags 'bar ba'i thog mangs chams//lcags khang me rlung 'khrul pa'i grong khyer nas//bhe wa sa twa dug hrul gtum mo yum//lha srin sdebargyad dmag gi dpung tsho gis kyis//dmigs bya'i bla srog tshe gsum zhal du rngubs//me 'brug gnam lo gsar tshes kyi dus 'dod khams dbang phyug mar snyan shal dar chen sna lnga phul ba'i kha byang 'dod pa'i gos smin//dkar zla bzhin rjes 'gro khyod zhal dran pa'i mod//gus pa'i zug rngu phyung dang chabs cig par//sim pa'i snang ba 'dren pa'i zhi ba'i las//lhun gyis grub pa'i rlung gi shing rtas drongs//ser//dzaskru chu bo'i lhun po ltar brjid sku//'od kyis srid zhi'i bsod nams bla nas blar//mthor brtsegs 153thagatsug tor tshangs pa'i yul sa nas//yongs brgal rgyas pa'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod//dmar rjes chags ut+pal dmar po'i zhags pa yis//brtan g.yo'i dngos kun bcings pa'i ral pa'i rtser//mdzes byed rkang sen zla ba yongs tshes pas/khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i 'phrin lasamadzod//mthang gtum drag rnon po'i mtshon mas dgra bgegs kun//mi rtag lam du 'god pa'i drag shul gyis//me tog mda' can sdebacas lkog mar snying //thon pa'i drag po'i 'phrin las lhun grub mdzod//rdzo grangs med dngas mtsho ri snang bas 'bum 'char yang //nam mkha'i zla ba gcig pu'i rnam 'phrul bzhin//gzugs sku bkod pa'i bye brag mtha' klas kyang //stong nyid snying rje'i rang gdangasadabyings phyug ma//bstan 'gro'i bde legs spel ༷'i mel tshe la//rtag tu ngal ba med mod thugs

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhedas dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 9)dam rgyud//bskul na zhi rgyas dbang drag mngon spyod kyi//'phrin las thogs pa med par sgrub tu gsol//thugs rje'i chu 'dzin lang long 'khrigs pa las//'dzad med bkra shis char gyis nyer brlan pa'i//'dod don g.yur du za ba'i snye ma yi//ro bda'i gos bur spyod pa'i skal bzang stsol//me 'brug cho 'phrul mchod pa'i dus dar mo sman rams pa blo bzang chos grags kyis ra sa/ra mo che po ta lar brgya mchod gyi dus dang /gra tshang du mkha' 'gro lnga rnams las shal kha byang dgos tshul ltar bkod pa'i dpag bsam ldon shing //thugs rje'i 154na khod kyis srid zhi'i gdung mun kun//rab bcil rdo rje'i khri la bshes gnyen mchog/zhabs brtan 'gro kun bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad//'byen par zas gtsang sras pos bdag rjes bzung //bstan 'gro'i bde skyid sgo 'phar phyogs bcur phye//dpal ldan bla ma bskal brgyar mi 'gyur zhing //ro nus zhu rjes sman gyis lus can srog/'tsho bar mi bskyod rdo rjes byin gyis rlabs//mthu stobasathog gis nag phyogs brag gi ri//byer btags bstan pa yongs dar de 'dzin bstan//'jig rten khams bde skye rgu'i bro nad rnams//gzhil bar cho 'phags ma ga thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs//lag na pad dkar 'amang khyod zhing khams 'dir//rdo rje slob dpon tshe dpag med mgon skur//rab bzhengs gso rig 'chad nyan gzhan phan gyis//yangs pa'i 'jig rten bde la 'god par shog/rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i tsho gos rnams kyis//rigs 'dzin slob dpon g.yung drung ltar brtan cing //tshe yi rig byed lag tu nyer bstar bas//'gro kun bde skyid dpal la sbyor bar mdzod//me 'brug nag pa zla ba'i brgyad gtor gyi tshe mgon po che chung las mkhan dang bcas par phul ba'i snyan dar zhal yig yongasabo'i waṃ shing /khro med 'og min zhing gtso'i thugs ka nas/khro gtum srin mo me'u thung gel ba'i gzugs/khro 154brgyal yongs kyi ded dpon nag po che//khro zhal gra nas dmar chen khrag rgyun 'dzag/rang byung rdo rje'i lus kyi pho brang nang //las bzhi bsgrub pa'i rnam 'gyur 'phrul po ches//ro rkyangs rgya bkrol rlung sems: ti'i lam/khrid nas zung 'jug bde r+ṣa bskyed pa'i ma//skyabs yul ma lus 'dus pa mkha' 'gro lnga//gsal stong sems kyi rol par nges rnyed nas//gnas lugs rang

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)ngo 'phrod pa mchog thun gyi/ /dngos grub stsol zhig ma hā gur kā la kye/ /gaṅgā'i yab gcig mdzes pa 'phrog pa'i sku/ /phyag mtshan bdud rtsis gtams pa'i bum bzang gis/ /dus min 'chi sogs brgya phrag nyes pa'i dri/ /nyer bkrus zhi ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /dkar/ rgyu chu bo'i ser gser ri nyin byed kyis/ /'byud 'dra'i lha chen rgyas pa'i las bsgrub par/ /bskul na nor bus yongs gtams ka pā las/ /tshe dpal bsod nams lung rtogs 'phel bar mdzod/ /dmar pad rwag 'od kyis klubs pa'i nyams 'gyur gyis/ /gzhan yid brlang po'i smag rum mthar byas nas/ /chags myong gdung bas srid zhi'i gtsug tor rtser/ /rkang rdul reg pa'i dbang gi 'phrin las bsgrubs/ /mthing bdun phrag zhag la gsod pa'i rtsal chen po/ /rdzogs byed gri gug 'bar bas dgra bgegs kyi/ /srog rtsa dum bur gcod pa mngon spyod las/ /myur sgrub (155na)mthu stobs nus pa'i dpung chen bskyed/ /rdzo grub dbang ḍā ki ni yis gnyan lo la/ /bran du gtad pa'i dpa' bo bram ze'i gzugs/ /sna tsho gos las bsgrub so so'i gar mkhan can/ /nges pa'i don du bcom ldan he ru gaḥ /bdud sde'i nus stobs ga la ches dpa' bas/ /dgra bgegs snying gar drag po'i bro brdung yang / /tshad med rnam bzhi'i zhal gyisa'agro ba rnams/ /thar par 'dren pa'i sgyu thabs rmad po che/ /klu sgrub de bzhin gshegs srung ri sul ma//dar ma grags dang rje btsun sa skya pa/ /tshar chen brgyud par bcas pas bka' bsgos bzhin/ /rigs 'dzin bdag gis las bcol ma lus sgrubs/ /pu tra gnod sbyin yab yum bsgos las gshin rje'i rgyal/ /ming sring dmod pa'i mthu yis ru 'dren sogs/ /'khor tsho gis stobs ldan zhing ka ra rnams kyis/ /dgra dang bgegs kyi dpung tshogs phye mar thogs/ /beg tse gnod sbyin dbang gi skyes bu zangasakhrab can/ gar gyi dbang phyug sring mo rig pa'i lha/ khrag bdag las mkhan bshan pa'i tshogs rnamasakyis/ /gnod byed gzugs can gzugs med sde dpung choms/ /me 'brug sa ga zla ba'i phyogs phyi ma'i bzang po gnyis pa zla ba gro bzhin gyi 'grub sbyor dus mdos bkang 'bum ther btsugasapa'i snya dar zhal byang las ga lhun grub/ /chem (155ba)chem mi ro za ba'i tshems dkar bar/ khrag dron lha —336

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'da'aphreng 'khrigs kyang ma ngoms par//rkyang ser rigs gnyis zhe ne nas stong gsum gyi//log 'dren srog la rngams pa'i re ma ti//res 'ga' zla bzhin smin legs mdzes sdug gzugs//la lar gser zhun pad rā ga kha dog 'dzin//ma nges sprul bsgyur pha mtha' rnyed dka' ba//sems nyid gcig bur 'char sgo'i rnam 'phrul tsam//thub bstan dar gnas thugs rje'i grib bsil zhan//lus can sim pa'i tshor ba rtag myong zhing //ljongs 'dir 'brum nag rims gzer dbul gzug sogs//dkar min gos bu nam yang mi smin mdzod//dge bcu rdzogs par ldan pa'i skye rgu yi//ring por 'tsho ba'i tshe dang 'byor pa'i nor//rjes 'gror spyod pa'i dbang thang bla nas blar//'dren pa'i legs byas shing rta lhun grub mdzod//lha mi'i 'dod yon dngos bshams yid sprul pa//nam mkha' mdzod kyis thugs dam bskang ba'i mthus//bdag sogs mi mthun kun las rnam rgyal zhing //bsam don 'grub la dbang gi rgyal por mdzod//me 'brug hor zla brgyad pa'i nang du mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab chos 'khor rgyal gyi mgon khang rnams su gtor gsol la rdzong bda' byas skabs phul ba'i snyan shal kha byang dngos grub bye 156na〉'i rol mtsho//sems can kun rgyud nam dang bgegs kyi sde//skal par gto na dmar zas rkan sgra gtogs//beg tse gang la rbad kyang snying khrag mngon sum du//'byin nus byu ru'i skyes bu zangs khrab can//rig pa'i lha mo srog bdag bshan pa'i tshogs//rings par song la log par 'dren kun choms//sto 'brug pa phyogs na ge gzar rim slong la par kha nye rim par bto bdang /rkang por bskyar langs byung bar dga' ldan dar rgyas dang dge 'dun gyis gtsos bod sog gi dmag dpung bsngon pa gag po gsang rnying na babs 'bul dang /gas bzung byed mkha rnams bcom te dus 'ang ga su gyur ba'i tshe la sbyor rnam dmig su song ba'i gto rag tu me sprul sgro ba gsum pa'i tshes bcagasum na bzung be gsum gyi bar rnam par rgyal shā phan bde'i leg gad gling pa cho zung rnam kyi thug dmoshong ba'i snyan dar khi yig rnam par sto shā 5dbyangs/be ge/dkar mthong ba'i mod la bgrang yas khro bo'i tshogs//164na skyobs cig lag cha 'tshor ba ma lha'i zhal//srid gsum za bar gdangs pa dusadagra'i dbang //zag med bde chen mchod pa'i dbyings su rol//mthing khya sgrib gnyis nyer zhi 'jam dpal kun tu bzang //dus kyi dgra bor bzhengs pa tshe bdag nag/'khor 'das phyag rgya thams cad zil gnon che//chos dbyings klong nas khros pa dpa' gas can//mi shig rdo rje ba 'a po'i mkhar rdzong du//rang sde 'jigs med srog gi ka ba btsugs//phyir bzlog sbyor ba'i stobs shig rang gshed phob//bsad mnan sreg zor las kun yongs grub par//bam chen skongs dang phyi nang mchod pa'i tshogs//mi zad nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo 'phar brgya//phye na slad mar srid pa gsum po las//rnam par rgyal ba'i mas stobs nus dpung bskyed//mthing khra/bskal pa'i me dpung dbus na mig sman ri/khro gtum dgra la zhal gdangs srin po'i gzugs3/4//ra mdzad mgon po lcam dral gnod sbyin bzhi//

sku gsung thug rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod jo khang bzang gi dkar chags gsab ma gsum pa/ 'dadam can rgya mtsho'i dmag gi dpung tsho gos kyis//sngar bcol grub dang slad mar bsgrub pa'i rten//nyer spyod dam rdzas rgyan ldan ba ling che//dngos bshams yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod tsho gis rnams//zag med bde chen klong du dgyes par rol//'a po/dom nag spyon pa 'on nas ma rungs dgra'i//snying gi khrag dron hub kyis 'thung byed pa//snye tra pā las slar yang log 'dren gyi/sha rus nang khrol lha ba rkang mar rol//164ba〉nga po/gser zhun lhun po zil gnon rnam thos bu//res 'ga' dbang gi skyes bu gtum drag can//slar yang mdung dmar dgra snying la bsnun par//nyi ma'i dngos grub btul ltar dpa' bar mdzod//ljang /ma he'i zhal can 'jigs mdzad rdo rje yi//bka' sdod 'chi bdag gshin rje'i rgyal po cher//ba kla bza' bca' ri bo ltar spungs shing //mtsho ltar bskyil ba'i khrag chang 'bul gyis bzhes//das/gnyis med ma ning gnam lcags 'bar ba'i thog/dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cur bcas pa rnams//snying khrag dron mos myos la legs sodang //dgra srog gcod phyir rngan du mchod tsho gis dbul//sngon po/rim bdun sa 'og thod pa lcags mkhar nas//bhe wa satwa srog dbugs bla tshe'i gshed//rang bzhin las grub 'chi bdag kha gdangs nang //gnyer gtad dgra bo mi rtag lam bkod par//khrag chen a: sha rus zhal zas dang //gsur dud zhun gyi sgron me rkang gling sgra//mchod tsho gis las rnams grub pa'i gtang rag tu//dbul na mche bas snang dgra'i don snying phug/dmar/stong phrag dmar zlum spyan gyi me long nang //'jig rten kun gsal dkar nag ma 'dres par//'byed mdzad sdebargyad dmag dpon khyab 'jug che//phyi nang gza' chen brgyad dang gdong mo bzhi//'khor tsho gos rgya mtsho thugs dam stong byed na//slar yang brnag pa'i dgra sde'i mi 64ba khor steng //mthong reg dug rlangs thog ser nad mtshon sogs//mi rung sna dgu'i than ltas char phab la mngon spyod las kyi 'phrin las myur du sgrubs//sto tswa/dkar mi 'gyur rdo rje drag bo 'bar ba'i rtsal//zhi khro bka' brgyad lus kyi dkyil 'khor che//yongs tshang rigs 'dzin bla mas mchog thun gyi//dngos grub char gyis 'dod pa'i re ba skongs//rtag yas/bla ༷ 7rigs 'dzin yang dag gshin rje gshed//dbang

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()chen rdo rje gzhen nu mngon rdzogs rgyal//dregs 'dul stobs ldan la sogs zhi khro'i tshogs//yongasa'adus khyab bdag che mchog he ru gas//mi bsrun dgra bgegs sdodapung gdong dmad cing //rang sdorgyal rnga srid rtser nyer brdungs par//gto rag kun bzang ma rdzo pa'i sprin spro na//slar yang tshon las rnam bzhi 'grub byin rlobs//rkyang ser mtheng khra dre'u rta zhen nas stong gsum kun//thogs med myul ba mthu ldan re ma tī//bam ro chem chem za ba'i dmag zor lha//snang srid dregs pa'i 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho yis//dgra bo dpung bcas shor phab khram la btab//byang dmar dkyus bcug mtshon gyi dru gu brkyang //nad rkyal kha phye tshe khos srog rtsa bcad//bsod nams stobs ra mnga' thang nyer brlag par//mkha' la rab brnyeg gtor tsho gos phyur bur sbyangs//nor 'dzin khyab pa'i khrag chang rba klong 'khrug/phyi nang nyer spyod thugs dam skong ba'i rdzas//rgya cher spel 165na〉 slar yang mthu rtsal bskyed//rtags bas/dung skyong dbang mo bstan ma bcu gnyis kyis//bod khams rang sder gtogs so cog rnams la//'tsho ba'i nad rims dal yams phyir bzlog la//phas rgol dgra bo'i steng du char ltar phob//sgo/sngags srung rdor legs las pho rgyud dang //mo rgyud gter srung dkar bdud phur skyong lha//stag zhen zhing skyong mthu wo sdo bzhi sogs//mchod tsho gis la rol slar yang las kun sgrubs//bod skyong rgyal po'i sku lha 'bar ba rtsal//sprul pa yang sprul 'khor dang bcasarnams kyis//rgyal 'gong dam sri spyo 'dre tshar bcad nas//dgra bo'i yul du bsgyur cing bzlog par mdzod//das/chos rgyal sku lnga sprul yum blon por bams//las byed bsdo rgod ོ po yang le ber/'khor bcas mthun pa'i rdzas kyis stong byed na//dgra bgegs dpung bcas slad mar cham la phob/mthang khra/'og min zhing las g.yo ba mi mnga' yang //dgra srog la rngams mgon po lcam dral zhes//bgrang yas bstan srung dbang pos zhi rgyas dang //dbang drag 'phrin las ma lus lhun gyis sgrubs//rdzo gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla'i gdan steng na//log 'dren 'dam ltar ba rdzoba'i stobs log nag/gri gug gis bregs mgon rlon thod pa'i nang //༷༷nga rnon gyis phug khong khrag blugs la gsol//sngo/

sku gsung thugs rten gsar ba tshe pas dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'daganod sbyin bgos sras pu tra lcam dral gsum/ /ru 'dren sdebazhi lha (165ba)srin dmag gi dpung / /rings par dgra bo'i yul song tshe srog dang / /bsod nams dbang thang rma rta rjes med thong / /dmar/gnod sbyin beg tse gar gyi dbang phyug ma/ ga bdag bshan dmar btsan rgod dpung tsho gos rnams/ /log 'dren 'dul bar chas pa'i dga' ston du/ kha khrag tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor 'di bzhes/ /khe gsum pa ngag dbang skal ldan bro nad kyis bto pa'i dus gnas chung chos skyong chen por snyan shal phul ba'i kha byang dgos tshur ltar spyod pa dbang gtso ri mo/ /mthu stobs rdol dpag par bka' ba yi/ /sprul pa'i chosargyal chen po'i spyan lam du/ /lha rdzas snyan shal la sogs dngos bshams dang / /yid 'ongs mchode pa'i sprin phung phul ba'i dges/ /gso rig 'dzin pa ngag dbang skal ldan gyi/ /nad gdon 'gal rkyen bar chad myur zhi zhing / /tshe dpal bsod nams yar ngo'i zla ba ltar/ /'phel ba'i 'phrin las thogs med sgrubs par mdzod/ /srid gsum zil gnon tshangs pa ris kyi lha/ /dri za'i rgyal sogs sna tsho gis sprul bsgyur mkhan/ /rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las grub dang slar bsgrub par/ /mchod tsho gis rgya mtsho spel na dgyes par rol/ /me sprul sag zla ba'i nang du rmi ltas shig la brten chosa'akhor rgyal gyi srung ma rnams gtor gsos bskang bshags bgyis skabasas shal phul pho kha byang rnam par rgyal phe dri bsung / /byams pa/ mgon khyod bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam rgyal ba/ /phul byung byams pa' phyag gis(166na〉kha' mnyam 'gro /dbugs dbyung phan dang bde ba'i lam yangs por/ /'god par mdzod cig 'phags ma ga ma pham pa/ /dran pas gdung sel dbyangasacan ngag gi lha/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir 'dod khams dbang phyug skur/ /sngar bcol legs dang slad mar 'phrin las rnams/ /bsgrung go dngos nyam yid sprul skar pa 'bul/ /de wī koṭi/ gas mas ge smo/ gangasacan nor 'dzin dpal mo'i mngal yangs po/ /bsrung ba'i bdud sman gnod sbyin mthu rtsal can/ /spyi dang khyad par bra ston g.ya' ma skyong / /mtshan gzhan g.yu sgron ma yis las rnams sgrubs/ /chos lngang steng /bgrang yas mas ldan sdod pon rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /dbyar gyi chu 'dzin lta bur 'du ba la/ /kun —349

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()bzang mchod pa'i sprin gyis dgyes bskyed na//bsams pa'i re skong yongs 'du'i ljon par mdzod//ṣ+ka skyong gnas mchog tsā ri'i sprul 'khor la brten nas//zab gter bdag po bdud mgon seng ge'i gdong //pha mes brgyud la 'go ba'i lha khyod kyis//dam bca' ma bsnyel mthun pa'i rkyen rnamasasgrubs//be gtseganod sbyin gtso bo zangs kyi beg tse can//rig pa'i lha mo gar gyi dbang phyug ma//las mkhan srog gi bdag po 'khor bcas kyis//dgra bgegs ma lus thal ba'i rdul bzhin rlog/gza' gdong dmar nag/khams gsum skye rgu'i bla tshe za ba'i bdag/bshan pa mig dmar bya 1slob ) khyung la zhen nas//bsam sbyor ngan pa'i gzugs can gzugs med dpung //gang du gnas kyang snying gi khrag dron 'thung //rwa hu la lus la khrag mig stong shar me long ngos//lkog gyur legs nyes mtha' dag mngon sum du//rab gsal srin po'i rgyal po rā hu las//log 'dren me la phye leb bzhin sregasashig/rgyal po/chos rgyal sde lnga yum blon sprul 'khor dang //las mkhan dmag gi sna 'dren tshe'u dmar ba//dam can rgya mtshos zhi rgyas dbang drag gi/las kun thogs pa med par sgrub par mdzod//rdor legs/rigs 'dzin pad+ma'i spyan sngar khas blangs par//nam yang g.yel ba med pa'i dam ldan pa//rdo rje legs pa mched 'khor sum brgya dang //drug cur bcas pas bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//gur/'og min zhing gtso'i khyab bdag rnam snang mdzad//bstan srung yongs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba sa/rdo rje srin po gur gyi mgon po yis//mchog dang thun mong dngos grub char ltar phob//tshad med rnam bzhi'i zhal gyis 'gro ba rnams//thar par 'dren yang dgra bgegs 'dam bzhin du//rab brdzis stobasa'aphrog dbang po 'khor bcas kyis//byang chub snying po'i bar du bsrung zhing skyobs//yo 'chi bdag gshin rje'i rgyal po pu tra nag/yab yum ming sring ru 'dren sdebazhi sogs//sa dang bar snang gang ba'i rdzu tshil can//slog ltar 'byug 167na〉sa las kun thogs med mdzod/mkho khang shod kyi 'gasabyed/'jam pa'i rdo rje dpal ldan ma sto zhal//dngos grub rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas yid bzhin nor//dran pas srid zhi'i gdung ba sel khyod kyis//'a/da pa'i re ba ma lus skong du gsol//phyag drug gru

sku gsung thug rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ tana'adzin la dgyes lag na pad dkar 'chang //bstan srung rgya mtsho'i gtso bo nag po che//legs ldan myur mdzad mgon po 'khor bcas kyis//'di dang gtan gyi mdun ma thams cad sgrubs//dmas chosas/rim bdun sa 'og thod pa lcags mkhar nas//skye 'gro'i bla tshe srog la dbang sgyur ba//'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje 'khor bcas kyis//dga' rab dbang phyug sdodapung rdul du rlog/rnam sras/khyod zhabs brten pa'i mod la srid dang zhi'i//dbul sel phan bde'i 'dod dgu bsnyil mdzad pa//lha rnams ngal gsor byed pa'i rnam thos bu//rta bdag brgyad kyis 'phrin las ma lus sgrubs//rtsid co go gi thod pa/mnan sreg bsad pa'i las kyi mtha' sdud mkhan//ral pa tshar dgu gtum mo dug hrul ma//'gro kun ltag pa'i bdud sgor gnas 'cha' ba//khyod kyis log 'dren rtsa 'khor khrag rgyun 'jibs//rdo sku me 'bar ma srid gsum cig car bsreg pa byin za'i dpung //rab 'bar dbus na dpa' bo bram ze'i gzugs//rtsa brgyud bla ma'i dam tshig nyer dgongs la//nyin mtshan dus kun mgon skyabs stong grogs167ba ) mdzod//mgon tswa bar rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug log 'dren gshed//srid pa'i rgyal mor bstan pa dmag zor lha//'khor 'das nyes brgya 'joms pa'i rtsi sman gyi//ljon pas 'gro kun phan dang bde la bkod//kogs sam nyi ma'i gnyen gyi spyan sngar lung rtogs cho me//bsrung bar zhal bzhes legs ldan nag po ches//bstan dang bstan 'dzin dge 'dun sde rnams kun//nyin mtshan g.yel ba med par mel tshe mdzod//ma' dga' lcog brtul zhugs grub dbang pad+ma thod 'phreng gis//gtsug tu rdo rje'i ri mo nyer bkod par//bstan srung sprul pa'i rgyal po 'khor bcasakyis//mchod gtor 'di bzhes bcol pa'i las rnams sgrubs//rta rgod shel lcag gi dar lcog te se'i gangasal 'gran pa'i ri bo'i ngogs//gnas bcas sbas yul chos 'khor yongs bsrung ba//gnod sbyin chen por rta rgod shel lcag gis//legs tshogos yon tan yar ngo'i zla ltar spel//gtsug na nor bu 'chang ba'i klu'i sdod pon//'dzin pa lag mang spyan sngar 'o chol dang //klu sman bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul byed na//'jig rten kun tu bde zhing skyid par mdzod//jo boms pa'i dar lcog khren yul laṅka'i sgo

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)srung smon lam mthus/ /rwa sgreng gnas skyong jo bo phying dkar ba/ /phyogs der rgyal mtshan ming gi mtshan snyan can/ /khyod kyi dam bca' ma g.yel sder bcas skyongs/ /(168na sing skyong dkar phyogs dga' ba'i klu chen por/ /'o chol sman gyi mthun rdzas 'bul byed na/ /'jig rten khams su char chu dus 'bab cing / /bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa 'byung bar shog /me jil rdo pa bstan pa dar rgyas kyis rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling par grwa ja bzhi dang tsha ba gnyis kyi bsnyen bkur ba'i thog ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung bsgrigs pa'i tshe bstan zung rgya mtsho'i spyan gzigs su snyan dar brgya dang brgyad phul ba'i dus kha byang dgos tsos ltar 4kho pa phun rdzas bongs5/ zhi khro rnam par rol pa'i grong khyer che/ /rgyal ba'i nyan thosakhrims ldan 'dus pa'i sde/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas nges gsang legs bshad gling / /kun dga' ra ba mdzes byed mchod pa'i sprin/ /brgya dang brgyad kyi grangs ldan lha yi dar/ /sna tsho gos dbang gzhu ltar bkra'i lda ldi'i phreng / /bstan pa dar rgyas lhag bsam ston zla bzhin/ /rab dkar yid kyis phul ba'i bsod nams 'bras/ /deng nas mi khom skyon kun yongs bral zhing / /dal 'byor rten gyi them skas la 'dzegs nas/ /thar pa'i grong khyer chen por bdag sogs 'gro /ring min 'jug par dkon mchog mthus byin rlobs/me sgrul sbun bdun pa bon to dar rgyas 'ad pa'i dus rigs brgyud 'dzin pa lhun grub rgya mtshos jo shāka rnam gnyis dang khra phrug tu snya dar 'bul snya la byang dgos tshul ltar 4kho pa thar pa'i rus sa/ /thub dbang dngos sku 'gror ston zhal bskyin la/ /thugs rje bskul phyir snyan shal lha yi gos/ /phul bas(168ba)yon tan dar rgyas srid mtsho las/ /nyer drangs nges legs lam du bkri bar gsol/ /don kun grub pa bgrang bya brgyud pa'i tshad/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i byin rlabs lo po ches/ / yon to dar rgyas mi khom 'jigs pa las/ /rab bsgral dal 'byor rten la sbyor du gsol/ /ma dag dug lnga bgos pa'i phung po lnga/ /ye shes ngo bor bcom ldan rigs lnga yis/ /bsgyur byin brlabs te bcu gsum rdo rje'i sar/ /dgod pa'i skal bzang deng 'dir stsal du gsol/ /—352

sku gsung thugs rten gsar stongs dang mchod rdzas khang tshong gi dkar chags gsab ma gsum pa/ tanayar 'brog pa blo gro legs bshad kyis rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde'i legs bshad gling du snyan shal gyi dar yug rnams la tho kha su sgo yong sgotswa〉khul ba'i kha byang tso bang tshang gi/rnam kun mchog ldan rigs brgya'i khyab bdag cher//mag par bzhengs pa rgyal sras slob mar bcas//dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i rten dang brten pa la//'ja' ris lha rdzas lda ldi rab phul dges//'gro la phan bde'i 'byung gnas thub pa'i bstan//nges gsang legs par bshad pa'i 'dus pa'i gling //dkar cha'i zla ltar yongs 'phel 'jig rten rnams//phun tsho gos dga' ston ro bda' myong bar shog/'a pungs pa'i lcags bkrol gtong ba'i sgo 'phar brgya//mngon par phye bas rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag/deng nas skye bar 'chi med dbang bo yi//tshe dpal 'byor ba rtag tu spyod par shog/chos kyi dbyings nas 'phrin las rnam pa bzhi//bsgrub la sprul pa'i rol gar 'phrul po che//169na snyan mdzad dam can cho se srung rgya mtsho yis//bar chad kun zhi 'dod pa'i re ba skongs//mtha' klas skye rgu yongs la sman pa'i ched//legs bsngos gaṅgā'i byang wo chu gter cher//rol gcig 'dzad pa med par sangs rgyas kyi//zhal 'tshes nam yang mi bslu e ma ma sgo//pad+ma thod phreng so zur gnubs sa kho //gto ston sngags 'chang sogs kyi spyan snga mā/bstan 'gro'i bde skyid spel bar zhal bzhes pa//rdo rje kun grags gas nang lung pa mda'i shar phyogs la phyi'i nus kyi 'am su 'tsho mo ri zer ga gangs ri shin tu che ba'i mdun du 'gram mtsho phyug mo zer ngab la bod mon pad tsa ra glang bu mkhar sog phal cher nas mthong phe ri mtsho gnyis sgo sor dar lcog re 'dzugs//gsol mar dgun dus phyug tsho mtsho dkyil ri de'u dang la tsā nu0iphro yig cher rten mtsho bod pos byed/ting ting dkar mo sa/ga/gangs can bod kyi yul 'dir nad rims dang //dbul phongs4ba rtsod nyer 'tshe kun zhi snyo //chos dang srid kyi dpal 'byor legs tshogos rnams//bla nas blar yang 'phel ba'i las sgrubs shig/tshig rkang gzhan rnamasa'adra ba la bzhi pa//ha ri g.yu sgron phag ri gling pha pa dro gram dang 4sa pa'i 'dzoms jo mo lha ri zer bar dar lcog 'dzugs/gas skyabs dgon phag ri lha phud gangs ri nas gsol mar byed cing brgyags rngan ltar dbu ru ka lke du'ang 'dzugs/rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong //rdo rje tso la phyi'i mchod khang gi nub tu nag po tshom ri zer ba rtsa ba brag 169bsta nag po/rtser gangs

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshogasung 'bum/ (2)bod pa'i shar du dkar po tsom ri/de rnams kyi shar du mtho lding gangs zer brtsabar mtsho yod yo gangs ri shin tu che phe rtser ldogs/ga sgos sku ne sa sa khang 'o pos byed/bzang tshe ring mched mo bzhi//'brog wo 'khor 'dul rdo rje dril bu ma//gangs dkar sha med khor ga gi gang ri che shā sa yul gang 'os dang gsol mchode gang bde na byed//yar log ga ku mtsho'i ri pe ru lta bu g.yul 'o sang 'dzunas zhing gsol mchod byed/spya la lha bu shog bu la bcas 'dzom pa'i jo mo gangasadakar gyi sar 'dzunas gsol mchod gnas nang mar rten nam zhi sgrub phug gang sa na byed cing lha 'dre bka' thang ltar mtsho srin mtsho bar du'ang ldogs//rdo rje 'od 'bar ma//kha rag rdo rje khyung mdog dpal gyi yum/dmar//gser chen mkha' lding jo nang gi rgyab ri jo mo nags0 lha tso sgrub khang gi rtser ldog shing gsol ma rdzo kyang de ga na byed/rdo rje dpal 'bar shog/ser mo las dge 'phos gzims gi lho nub kyi ma' zla mkhar gyi steng du 'dzug shing gsolamago kyang byed/mkhan rdo rje drag mo rgyal//kong btsun de mo rta thog mkhar dang byas kyi 'og yul gsum du kha pa dkar po zhig laganas bod zer/de dang ri bas rtag pa'i be lam snyan tsam na bre gas dgon/de'i 'og na bre zer ༅ grong ṣ+ka bod 'dug pa chag 'gros la dpags na bre sna zer ba de g.ye yin snyam pa khungs gzhan mchode na de ga'i ri sna zhig tu 'dzug shing ga sgomar byed//rdo rje 'od 'bar ma//rdo rje rtsal mo pa nam bsgo sding kyi rgyal ri jo mo lha ri ra brgyab sdodang 5na spang gshong bod pa'i rtser gas shing gsol mar gang ge nas byed/ kun grags la rog ma/ /sman btsun 170na)khug chos rdo rje g.yar mo rgyal//rta nag thub gzha gyi sto gad kyi shar lung pa shar zer shā phur smad ga ri dang stod gangasari byas pa jo mo tsha r+sha sa yul gang bder ldog shing gsol ma rdzo kyang de dang gsas/rdo rje ye shes dril bu gzugs legs ma//rag dang yer pa rnams kyi 'dzoms rdzo mo gi zer bde gar 'dzugs shing gsol mchod kyang byed//ri gsum bosapa'i lom su mar byed ston zer g.yod lo bog pa cag/zhes kha spos nas 'dri'o//'di'ang dmar ser can gyi lo mgo zla'i nang du bod khams bde thabs kyi ོ bstan ma bcu gnyis gnas sar bsangs gsol mchod dang chabs cig par dar lcog btsugs pa'i kha byang du za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i ye ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o//ha pha'i zhes pa sa pho rta'i lo gsar gyi 'dod khas dang phyug mo ma rdzo pa'i du phul phyo yā shal la byang log medag dong sgra dbyangs/rtag tu sgo gsum nyer bde tshor ba'i ro//ches bda' 34

sku gsung thug rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 9)brgya phrag myong bas snying gi dbus/ /kun dga'i bdud rtsi sbyin pa'i cho ga mkhan/ /dung skyong zla bzhin dngom pas bdag rjes bzung / /phongs 'chi rgud tsho gis 'gro skyabs ser can lto/ /dbral nas mi yi seng ge rdzogs ldan gyi/ /gsar pa'i mdza' ba 'dzums la su waṇi'i/ /g.yar ngo phyor zhig lha mchog mig sngon kye/ /'dod myos drod kyis cher gdungs ba spu'i rtse/ /rnon po gyen du ldang byed ga bur rdul/ /'bab par pad rā ka lhun po la 'khu'i gzugs/ /'bum phrag rta ljang gos kyis da klubs(170ba〉deg/nag khra/bsad khrag dron mos nyer brgyangs rgyu ma'i zhags/ /ga shar byas pa mig sman mdangs 'dzin 'od/ /rab dkar mche ba'i rtse mor dgra bgegs rnams/ /mi rtag lam du 'god phyir chem chem zo/ /ljang bcu gnyis go la'i rgya lam thang yangs por/ /sdebazhi'i gsar 'gros dbang gi goms stabs kyis//dkyus thog gcod pa'i cang shes gser sbyangs gos/ /yongs klubs 'dren byed zil dngar bgrang bya 'dir/ /kun 'byung des bskyed sdug bden nyer zhi'i 'bras/ /chos dkar g.yang long srid zhi dpal po che/ /rab khugs lha dbang rdo rje rnon po'i rtses/ /log 'dren sbyin skyes sder bcas cham la phob/ /dga' ba brgya pa'i she mong dpung shugs kyis/ /legs ldan rtsibs stong nor 'dzin stor gyur pa/ /mang bkur pho brang chen po'i lugs zung khrims/ /rgya hor bod kyi gnya' ba rab lcir mdzod/ /gser mdog zhwa yi cod pan 'chang ba'i bstan/ /thos ba 4 rin chen yu bas nyer btegs pa'i/ /gdugs mdzesagrib mas kun bzod mtha' bcings nang / /'khod do cog gi bde skyid rtag myong mdzod/ / gcan gzan dus min ngar
