skad sgrog pa'i srog /'phrog byed las bzhi 'jigs med seng ge'i rgyud/ /yongs bdungasasgra dbyangs sa 'og sa steng dang / /sa bla'i 'jig rten ma lus khyab par mdzod/ /snyan shal gyi kha byang 'dus gang che zhig dar mo sman rams pa blo bzang chos grags kyis sa rta cho (171na)'phrul gyi dus 'a thog ra sa phrul snang du mchod pa sna lnga phul ba'i tshe dgos tshul ltar bkod pa bsam pa lhun grub/ /rgyal dang de sras slob mar bcas pa la/ /nyer spyod mchod sprin phul ba'i bsod nams las/ /blo bzang chos gragasakyis bskrun sman dpyad mthus/ /'gro rnams bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad 'joms shog /tshor ba drag po'i —355

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()sdug bsngal dmigs su med//lo brgyar 'tsho ba'i tshe yi dpal 'bar zhing //'dod pa'i longs spyod 'phel ba'i dbang thang rgyas//chos skyong srung mas bar chad sel bar shog/ngag dbang 'jam dbyangasadaga' ba'i bshes gawo gyis//deng nas brtsams te yang srid thams cad du//rjes bzung mjo zhe par mtho dang nges sa sar//rab bkyis ring min byang ོ sang sbyor shog/skye ba kun tu dal 'byor rten bzang rnyed//dpyod ldan slob dpon mkhas mjal gso rig gi/gtsug lag rgya mtsho ri legs sbyapasamakha' mnyam 'gro'i/khug rngu'i sdug bsngal drungs nas 'byin nus shog/tshe rabs mang bsags sdig pas ngan song du//skye ba'i sa bon btab pa'i phung po rnams//bsod nams nyi 'od kyis bsregs myong bya'i 'bras//rmi lam na yang smin pa'i skabs bral shog/byang chub bar du bslu med mchog gsum gyis//mi 'bral rjes bzung thos bsam sgom pa sogs//dam chos bsgrub pa'i mthun rkyen ma lusakun//bsams pa ji bzhin lhun 17bgyis grub par shog/'jig rten bde zhing thub pa'i ring lugs 'phel//de 'dzin tsho gos rnams zhabs pad yun du brtan//bdag sogs be+eḍūr snang ba'i zhing khams der//sman gyi bla mas rjes su 'dzin par shog/sa rta nag pa zla ba'i brgyad gtor dus chos skyong che chung la yā dar phul ba'i kha byang dam mā dgyes pa'i mchod sprin//gur phyi nang gsang ba'i brag rdzong rnal 'byor gyis//bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha//zung 'jug don gyi rdo rje srin po'i skur//grol ba'i dngos grub mchog de myur thob shog/dkar bum bzang las 'ongs bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis//srog mthar byed gegs la sogs nad gdon dri//nyer bkrusazhi ba'i 'phrin las kā rgya ra'i//zegs mas nyes brgya'i tsha gdung bcil bar mdzod//ser rin chen phyur bur gtams pa'i bde skyong nas//srid zhi'i dngos grub 'dod pa 'jo ba'i sgo//'byed pa'i mthu stobs lde mig 'phrul po che//gser gyi 'khri shing sor mos nyer bteg cig/dmar sa steng sa bla'i 'gro yid rab 'gugs pa//pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs 'tsher lcags kyu yis//dregs can yongs kyi ral pa'i rtse mo mā/rkang rdul dmar 'od chags pa'i las mdzod cig/sngo dgra bgegs snying khrag drod

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 6)rlangs ma yal ba//tshad med bzhi ldan zhal gyi nyer drangs te//rnam shes mi bskyod zhing du 'dren (172na)pa dang //lhan cig sha rus stobs 'byor tsho gos su rol//ljang dur khrod brgyad dbus srin po'i zlos gar gyis//ri rab gling bzhi nyi zla'i gdan steng nas//log 'dren dpung tshogs steng du drag po'i bro//rdungs mdzad legs ldan dbang pos las kun sgrubs//dregs pa pho mo'i rnam 'phrul mtha' klas pa//chos kyi 'khor lo'i 'dab steng ze'u 'bru'i dbus//nam yang mi g.yo byang chub snying po'i bar//'bral med dngos po'i rten 'byung 'dis byin rlobs//rtsa khams rlung gi dngas ma rgyud gsum gyi/khregs par shar ba a wa sne ti'i mdud/khri bzhon 'gro 'ongs gis sprul zung 'jug gis//grong khyer chen bor myur du 'jug nus shog/kun kyang sems nyid gcig pu'i sgyu 'phrul du/shar tshe 'khor 'das dbyer med dngas ma'i mtshor//rang sems sku bzhi'i bdag nyid gdong bzhi pa//mngon sum ngo 'phrod dga' ston rtag myong shog/bu༄ bram ze'i dmod pa grub pa'i rdo rje'i thog/gzugs can gzugs med log 'dren me lce'i rtser//phye leb ltar choms gnod sbyin yab yum dang //pu tra lcam sring mthu stobs nus dpung skyed//beg tse bstan srung bye ba'i sdod pon dbang gi rgyal//sring mo rig pa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas//'jam po gsum dang mngon spyod ma lus kun//thogs med 'grub pa yongs 'du'i ljon par shog/(172ba〉lhan srid la bsam ga sbyor rtsub 'amang ba'i sman pa sangs rgyas 'byung gnas me 'brug gi lo khong khrag khodang srin sgo na 'grim bzhin du 'jig rten phyi ma'i ltad mor song ba las sbyor thog tu khel ba'i gtang rag tu rgyal po sku lnga spyi dang khyad par bye mas ke ru la sa rta hor zla ban pa'i tshes lnga'i nyin gsol mchod rgyas par btang pa'i tshe gos mchin la bkod pa'i zhal byang dpa' pho rgyang glu//khams gsum skye rgu'i bla tshe srog dbugs la//dbang sgyur rgyal po sku lnga blon po'i tshogs//khyad par byes chas ke ru 'khor bcas kyi//spyan sngar dngos bshams yid sprul mchod pa 'di//sa'og srin po'i lus la khyab 'jug blo//ngan sems mun gtibs tsher ltar rtsub sbyor can//sangs rgyasa'abyung gnas khrag dron skyug bzhi du//nyi bu'i mche /ga song ba'i dpa' bo'i dar//dmar wo gtor

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()ma'i ri bo mkha' la bsnyeg/khrag chang btung ba rgya mtsho lta bur bskyil//za 'og go mtshon tsho gos kyi 'khor lo cher//dgyes par rol la dar wo phyogs bcur phyor//dus kyi pho nya'i lo lcang ra zil gnon tshe dbang sdong mkhar du mag par 'gro skabs dpal ldan dmag zor ma dang lcang ra'i rgyal po gnyis la snya dar kha byang dgos tshul ltar bris pa 'dod sku'i snyem//long long rlung nag 'tshub ma legs 'khyil dbus//gsal gsal ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i nang //'jigs 'jigs srin mo'i gzugs can dmag zor mas//yang yang dgyes pa'i spyan gyis deng 'dir gzigs//kun yong ma rdzo sprin dang stongasarang mas pa'i//mthun rdzas173na〉gis kyis thugs dam nyer skong na//lcang ra zil gnon tshe dbang mi nor la//'gal rkyen kun zhi dngos grub stsol bar mdzod//drag shul 'jigs rung srog bdag rgyal po cher//phyi nang mchod pa'i sprin phung rab spro na//bdag sogs rnams kyi nyer 'tshe kun zhi zhing //bsam don lhun gyis 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//sa rta zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nang du grong smad nas ring la'i rten 'byung rgyas par sgrigs pa'i tshe rnam par rgyal pa'i phan bde legs bshad gling du rtsa gsum chos srung rgya mtshor snyan shal rgyas par phul ba'i kha byang yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po//dmar 'chi med gzi byin 'od kyi snang ba 'bum//snga tsor gyi bla ma yi dam la blo /sto/rab 'bar gos dkar ma dang snyoms 'jug pa'i//bdud rtsi tshangs bug lam zhugs rdo rje'i srog grub pa'i skal pa bzang por bdag byin rlobs//bde gshegs zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor bgrang yas zla//gang sku'i dwangs mtsho me shar ba pad+ma 'byung //yi dam kun 'dus rdo rje drag po rtsal//byin wo sprin las dngos grub char phob cig/dkar srid dang zhi ba'i phyag rgya ma lus pa//mthu stobs nus pas zil gnon tshe bdag nag khugasadrags gnam lcags thog gi mda' bo ches//ban bon byad ma'i rang gshed rang la phob snang ser/dpal chen 'phrin las 'khor lo'i lha tshogs rnams//nag khra gar dgu'i nyams kyis rol ba'i zegs 173bsgo yis//yid srubs sder bcas mthar byed srin po'i gzugs//rdo rje gzhen nus mchog thun mtha' dag stsol//phyi 'gyur gyi bla ma yi dam la 〈 kugaXm mtshams sprin bla gos dkar kyis klubs btsong

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'dakha pa/ /nges don 'jam dbyangs gzhen nu ma he'i zhal/ /legs bstan 'jigs mdzad rdo rje la sogs pa'i/ khyud sde rnam bzhi'i lha yis shis pa stsol/ /ting 'dzin gzungs sngags bzlas na smos ci dgos//mtshan tsam thos dang dran pas 'chi bdag mun/ /'joms mdzad rnam par rgyal ma zla ba'i bzhin/ /rab dkar snang bas dus kun khyab par mdzod/ /dkar mi 'dzad tshe yi mchog sbyin phyag mthil nas/ /chad med zil dngar babs pa snying dbus su/ /rab bskyil bskal par 'tsho ba'i yid bzhin mdzod/ /sgo 'byed 'khor lo rtag tu bskor gsol 'debs/ /zang kha rdo rje snga gyur gyi chos skyong la blo /sto dbyingasaphyug thun mong gdul bya'i ngor/ /dbyangs can lha mor bstan kyang bdud sde'i gshed/ /'dod khams dbang phyug dmag dang zor gyi lhas/ /nyin mtshan dus drug kun tu g.yel med srungs/ /sngon po/khro chags zhi dang rgyas pa'i rol gar gyis/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub mdzad dung skyong mas/ /srid zhi'i phun tshogs yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/ /'dod pa'i rgyal mtshan rtse mor 'bar bar mdzod/ /ma ning li byin ha ra mched lnga dang / /(174na〉mar btsan rgod gnod sbyin bstan ma bcu gnyis sogs/ /dregs pa'i sdod pon sum cu'i tsho gos rnams kyis/ /log par 'khru ba'i dgra bgegs ma lus sgrol/ /byang sems nam mkha'i snying po 'gro ba'i don/ /tshangs dbang skur bstan rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal/ /zur phud lnga pa gsang yum sprul 'khor gyis/ /nam yang mi 'bral bsrung bskyob 'phrin las mdzod/ /mthing khra/ phyag na phyi ༅ra gyi chos skyong la blo ka pha pad+ma myur mdzad mgon po'i gzugs/ /rnam snang rdo rje srin po gur gyi mgon/ /stobs 'phrog dbang po las kyi gshin rje sogs/ /chos srung rgya mtshos mchoge thun dngos grub stsol/ /ser nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi ldan ngal bsos po/ /res 'ga' gtum drag dbang gi mdangs 'dzin pa/ /rnam mang thos pa'i sras kyis srid dang zhi'i/ /phun tsho ges 'dod dgu'i re ba ma lus skongs/ /byu ru'i lhun po nyi ma 'bum gyi gos/ /nyer klubs zangs kyi beg tse gnod sbyin gtso/ /sring mo rig pa'i lha mo gar dbang mas/ /log par 'bu ba'i dgra bgegs tshar gcod mdzod/ /rgyal bas tshogis chen bsags pa'i gtan tshigs su/ /mi bslu'i bden gtam brjod pa sa'i lha mo/ /gtsor —359

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho gsung tsom/ ()gyur gangs ljongs yul lha gzhi bdag gis//bkra shis dga' ston dpal gyis deng khyab mdzod//don grub ces pa sa mo lug gi lo'i rta wo zla ba'i dga' ba dang por 'dod las ba ) dbang phyug dus gsol gyi thugs dam rgyas par bkang ba'i tshe snyan shal kha byang dpag ba4 ljon pa//dkar mdzes sku rab dkar tsas 'khri shing las//mtha' klas zug rngu'i gdung sel ga bur ngad//thugs rje'i rma gis drangs nas bde skyid la//sbyor zhig gangs ri'i mdangs ldan dung skyong ma//rnam thos bu yi legs byas gcig bsdus gzi//brgya phrag nyi dngos legs 'dzan tshe dpal gyis//sum rtsen bdag por bsnyems nus dbang thang 'bras//stsol zhig sgos pa'i sras mo ngag gi lha//dmar dregs ldan yongs kyi ral rtser rkang rdul dmar//lhungs ba'i mod la yid 'phrog u t+pala'i//gas pas 'ching ba'i sgyu thabs 'bad med du//stsol zhig srid gsum gsum dbang bsgyur lus phra ma//mthong ba'i dgra bgegs snying rtsa 'dar ba dang //lhan cig lkog mar thon byed re ma spyo//yid srubs sder yos rdul phran ltar bcoms te//rnam par rgyal ba'i ru mardzo srid rtser phyor//gdod nas 'gyur med kun tu bzang mo'i klong //zhi khro'i rnam 'gyur 'phrul po che yi gar//rdzo brgyar nye ba'i shel ltar mtha' klas kyang //rig rtsal snyag las chu nang zla gzugs ba//ljang kun rdzob snang ngor srid rgyal 'dod khams kyi//dbang phyug ma mo dmag dang zor gyi lhar//yongs shar 'khor tshogs rgya mtshor bcas pa la//phyi nang gsang mchod nam mkha'i mdzod sgo phye//zhi rgyas dbang dgug mtho 75na〉da tshon las kun//thogs med yid bzhi stsol bar gsol bto 'bras//brgya phrag ro bda' dngos su smin pa yi//yongs 'du gnyis pasa'adod pa'i re bskongs// /ga mi skyid kyis go6khegasum lo byed nang sgo dbasgo yalas lta dus shal rtsa4shā kha bya gos tshul mi0stodaspudon mdzes sa/mthong thos dran reg la thogs tsam gyis kyang //'khor 'das gdung nal la snang rten gyi gtso//tso dbang yos li 4 byon lngan gos/srus dang slob mar bams pa'i zhi masamathus//skyid skyid la sogs khe gsum 'tsho byed kyi//rigs brgyud tsho gis rnams skye bar lta mi'i lus//6)

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ tanawo thob 'di dang phyi ma'i yang srid ca//rdzogs ldan dus bzhi bde skyid khos myong shog/mgon rna thugs rje'i rdzings kyi 'khor mtsho las//rab bsgral rnam mkhyen ye shes rin chen gling //legs bgrod nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam sems can rnams//'dren pa'i ded dpon mchoge tu 'gyur bar shog/sa lug nag pa zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i dus chen la nyang bran grong smad pas zan g.yang lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang du gser byu snyan shal phul ba'i kha byang dgos tshul ltar bkod pa tso khyab phan bde'i nyi ma//byang chen 'og khang byang tso byu po/thugs rje'i gzi yis 'khor ba la//sdug mun mthar byas bstan 'gro'i phan dang bde//kun khyab snang ba'i 175bsko dugs dkar grib bsil du//brgyad khri'i tsher spyod lus can rjes 'gror shog/ngag dbang blo bzang grags pa'i ring lugs srog/rgya mtsho'i pha mthar mi 'gyur chos srid kyi//legs bris pho brang rin wo brtsegs pa'i khrir//'chi med bdag por g.yung drung ltar brtan shog/yon sbyor rigs brgyud rnams kyi ring po'i tshe//dbang thang rnam thos bu yi rjes 'gro ba'i//yang srid them skas bla nas blar 'dzegs mthar//sku bzhi ye shes lnga ldan ma cane 'gyur shog/bar khang 'das dang ma 'ongs da lta'i skye rgu rnams//'dren la thugs bskyed sa bon dar drag pa//byang chub mchog gi yongasa'adu'i 'khri shing rtser//phan bde'i 'bras smin dus gsum sangs rgyas kye//rgyud lnga'i lam 'khyams spyi dang khyad par du//kha ba'i sman ljongs sems can cher snyigs kyi//duḥkhar spyod las dbugs dbyung sum rtsen lha'i//dga' ston mchog la sbyor bar bdag byin rlobs//'jam dpal snying po'i bstan dang bstan 'dzin sde'i//chos srid dkar cha'i zla ba ltar 'phel zhing //bdag sogs 'di phyi'i mdun ma ma lus pa//'grub pa'i yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal por shog/'og min zhing khams bye ba'i dbang phyug tu//rgyal ba rnam par snang mdzad gangs can mtsho//'khor ba'i pha mtha' rdzogs min ye shes spyan//sems can kun la gzigs pa'i mgon po mchog/phyogs steng go 17na7tsha mos gang nas gsal ba'i zhal gyi khyim//phyi nang rgyab mdun med par zang thal du//mtshon phyir mi bzhi rgyab sprod lta bu'i sku//mkha' la 'ja' ltar dbyings su ngo bo gcig/bo/ khams bstan 'gro'i legs byas lha phyis khog/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)bdag sogs bde skyid mu thi la'i phung po/ /byang chen bar du sbrel ba'i srad bu la/ /chad pa med brgyu'i skal bzang thob par shog /byang sems mdzad pa nyi ma gling /nyi ma'i 'od ji bzhin/ /gling dgu'i rgyal khams yongs khyab ma rgan rnams/ /bde ba'i drod kyis rab smin snyem yis/ /ro bda'i zas la rtag tu spyod par shog zla ba gling / /sems bskyed zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang las/ /smon lam gtu ra yi zegs ma'i rdul/ /'dzam gling yid can sdug bsngal tsha gdung rnams/ /ming gi lhag mar rjes su 'dzin par shog /lus can rnams kyi rgyud la ma shar sgo wom dmu zhwang rig pa'i/ /dra ba mkhyen pa'i ral gyis yongs bcad de/ shes bya'i gnas lugs tshogs la lta ba'i mig /stsol zhig zur phud lnga pa rgyal kun yab/ /sems can yongs la rtse yang gangs can 'gro /sna tsho gis sprul bas 'dul mdzad 'jig rten dbang / /cher snyigs dus 'dir lhag par thugs rje'i ma/ /bskyed nas rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i mgron de khug /lho sgo lha r+ya mā nga / / nubasgo da spyo sa byams mā pa/ /rlang spyod bdud bzhi'i me dpung tsha ba'i dbal/ /(17ba)byams brtse nyal 'gro'i rgyun gyis rab bcil nas/ /mgon khyod ma ga dha ru mchog sprul gar/ /bsgyur min 'dzam gling mi rnams bde la sbyor/ /byang sgo sgos da gling 'khor ba'i bde la ma chags pad+ma'i steng / /mtshan dpe'i gzi byin rnam bkra thub pa che/ /sems can mtha' dag 'khor ba chu srin gyi/ /'byung gnas che las sgrol ba'i gru rdzings mdzod/ /rnam dag khrims kyis rang rgyud rnar ga li kha gling 'dul khang na/ /ting 'dzin shes rab bslab pas yin can rnams/ /byang chub chen po'i gling du nyer 'khrid par/ /mkhyen dang brtse ba'i shing rta'i kha lo sgyur/ /3sbyor sgo 48nga sna tshogs skad kyi dbye ba la sogs pa/ /brda don sbyang nas dam chos 'khor lo gsum/ /thub dbang dpal gyi mgrin pas legs bskor bas/ /nges pa'i don la rab tu sbyor nus shog /nag po bdud kyi dpung rnamasa'adul ba'i ched/ /rdo rje'i slob dpon khro bo'i gar 'chams la/ /rab bzhengs sngags2da 2sa sngagasapo gling / sde tshogos pa'i gling chen po/ /smin grol lam gyi dga' ston myong bar shog /nyi ma'i gnyen gyi chos rnams spru ta'i/ /5skur rgya gar gling /skad las gsungs ltar lo paṇa mkhas rnams kyis/ /sgra —362

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang mar rdzas kha bzang gi dkar glegs bam gsum pa/ thonabasgyur sdosnod rgyud sde'i bshad to rgyun//lnga brgya phrag bcu'i pha mthar 'phel bar shog/lung lhan spe phung gti mug lcags khams dag 77na ) pa chos kyi dbyings//ye shes dngas mtsho ri srid zhi'i zlosagar rnams//'char ba'i lung bstan ji bzhi rgyal ba yi//tshe rabs kun tu ston par byin gyis rlobs//migayo ba tshogato gling mi g.yo bsam gto gcig gi shel dkar ngos//nyon mongs lnga dag phung lnga gnas gyur pa//ye shes 'ja' ris gling gi gur phub pa//gzigs mor skye ba kun tu tshar dngar shog/mtha' med lhu mu sna li'ang 'khor mtsho thugs rje'i gru rdzings kyis//nyer brgal gto bde'i rin wo sna tshogs gling //ris med lus can wod pa'i sde dpon che//zas gtsang sras pos byang chub bar du skyongs//ma rig gnyid las nyer sangs shes bya yi//blo gros rab rgyas dga' ba'i dpal yon la//nges par sbyor mdzad rnam par 'dren pa yis//'jigs rten mtha' dag bde legs 'a por 'khod//sa kha gling nang gi dug gsum sbyor ba'i rten 'brel du//lus kyi dri ma 'brud pa'i khrusakyi khang //dag byed gtsang ma'i gling bzhin 'gro rgyud la//gos pa'i sgrib gnyis bag chags dag par shog/tshamang zhes pa lo paṇa ma rdzo rdzas g.yos sogs rab sbyar nas//rgyal blon bsod nams zhing sabaskrun pa ltar//skye bar sras sa sangs rgyas thams cad la//bkur sti ri mor bgyid pa'i skal thob shog/lo rtsal klu nga klu gnyan 77ba ) sa bdag kha rlangs tsha gdung kun//mthu rtsal tsan+dan dri yisamathar byed gling //lag na rdo rje 'bar ba'i gzi byin gyis//gangs ljongs duḥkha ming gi lhag mar shig/khabs bangs gling tsho gos gnyis tshogis kyis bsgrubs pa rdzogs sangs rgyas//go 'phang don gtso gzhan phan r+pā yin phyir//yal yol bko snyoms bor nas rgyu ba dang //mi rgyu'i yid ༅ mtha' dag rjes su bzung //ga tshe kha khas pa kun la byams brtse ma dros mtsho chen las//ye shes sna lnga'i 'phrin las chu bo bzhi//'khor ba ji srid skye rgu'i dbang po dang //'tsham pa'i zla ba'i ma mar 'bab byin rlobs//dgoyo sku ā+o tha ldan mgon po gar dbang 'od mtha' yas//bod 'bangs bsod nams mas du mgo sum pa//legs byon byin sa zil dngar bdag snying gi/dpal gyi be'u'i nang du 'a kyil bar shog/6

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ smyonabadud rtsi rab 'khyil dkar me go 'khor 'das dbyings su sgrol//gnod sbyin dbang po dpal ldan ngal bsos bus//gsal byed dkar me phreng ba rgyu skar ltar//tshar dngar zug rngu'i smag sum zhi bar shog/mar rten dkar po 'gyur med thugs mchog chos kyi sku yi rten//man shel ri bo ston mas zla ba yis//byugs 'drar rjes su yi rangs legs byas sa//mya ngan med kyi mched po thob par shog/mar rten dmar po rgod ma kha yi me dpung sa 'dzin 'dir//mdzo sum 'bar 'dra'i thugs kyi rten bzang por//178na〉sko gsum dang bas 'dud pa'i 'bras bu yis//sgrib gnyis des bskyed sdug bsngal kun bsreg shog/rten nag po bstan 'gro'i bde skyid 'joms pa'i dgra bgegs rnams//bskal bar ldang mi nus par gnon byed pa//sku gdung nag po'i mas rtsal gnam lcags thog/log 'dren gnyen por rtag tu 'bab nus shog/tshad rten sngon po be+eḍūr tso ma'i mdangs 'an mthong thos dang //dran reg rnam par grol nus chos kyi sku//ri mor byas 'dra'i zhing khams rgya mtsho'i rdul//khyab pa'i rten la bya ba byed nus shog/pe yo lcog gi chos rgyas 'a po dregs pa'i sde dpon gtsug lag srung ma che//rgyal po li byin ha ra mched lnga dang //gsang yum blon po 'khor tsho gos rgya mtsho la//dngos bshams yid sprul thugs dam bkang ba'i mthus//gangs can bstan dang de 'dzin skyes bu'i tshogs//skye rgu'i bde skyid bla nas blar 'phel zhing //nad yams 'thab rtsod mu ge g.yul 'khrug sogs//dus kyi chad pa zhi ba'i 'phrin lasamadzod//bdag sogs mi nor rigs brgyud bcas pa yi//bar ho nyer 'tshe'i dngos po bzlog pa dang //tshe dpal bsod nams stobs ra legs tsho gos kun//dkar cha'i zla ltar 'phel ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//tsi dmar pa gnod sbyin kun khyab rdo rje drag po rtsal//gsang bdag rta mgrin pad+ma thod 'phreng gi/spyan sngar 17ya 〉 lta bzhes ji bzhin bstan pa dang //de 'dzin sdebacas ru bzhi'i rgyal khams skyongs//bdag sogs rigs dang mi nor bcas pa la//'tshe ba'i gzugs can gzugs med ma lus cho mes//tshe dpal legs byas dbang thaX snyan grags sogs/khrad zhi'i yon tan thams

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'dacad rgyas par mdzod/ /yid bzhi nor dang yongs 'du sa brtol dbang / /bum pa bzang po 'dod 'jo'i ba lta bur/ /ji bzhin smon lam re ba ma lus kun/ /thogs pa med par lhun grub stong grogasamadzod/ /o ༅ si po tsho tso rjes 'khor lo'i ri mo rnam bkra ba/ /pad+ma ka ra'i zhabs kyi mthil/ /bdag sogs gtsug tor rtser bkod nas/ /mchog mthun dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /pi tsho phyag43 rta mgrin dran pas bar chod g.yul las rgyal/ /bsams pas byin rlabs char bzhin 'bebs/ /dpal chen rta mchog yi dam lhas/ /tshe rabs kun tu rjes bzung zhig /mkha pho dbu thod/bstan rtsa dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sde/ /bod yul khyab mdzad zhi ba 'tsho/ /byang chub sems kyis lus can rnams/ /'dul bar mdzad des bdag byin rlobs/ /'i sgrol ma dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ //yum mchog 'phags ma sgrol ma yis/ /'jigs chen brgyad sogs nyes kun las/ /bdag sogs 'gro rnam skyob tu gsol/ /don grub ces(179na to sa lug nag pa zla ba'i brgyad gtor dus mgon po che chung las mkhan rnams la snyan shal phul ba'i kha byang rtsibs stong gser gcor/ /gur mgon rdo rje brag ri pad ma bam ro'i gdan/ /mig sman lhun po gtum rngam srin po'i gzugs/ /gri thod bsnol 'dzin steng na gaṇ+ḍi las/ /nyer spros sprul pas yid srubs sde bcas cho mes/ /rang byung lus 'khor lo lnga ldan dbus/ / rgyud gsum dregs pa'i rnam 'phrul 'phrin las bzhi/ /yongs grub dhū ti'i rgya bkrol bde ba che/ /don gyi mgon po tshe 'dir mnyesapar shog /phyi nang 'char sgo'i kun rtog rol rtsed rnams/ /gsal stong zung 'jug sems nyid gcig bu'i gshis/ /mngon sum ngo 'phrod bdud rtsis snying myos par/ /a ho dpyid kyi glu dbyangs rnar snyan shog /lha mo mchoge sred sa rngog brgyud pa'i rdo rje'i bka'/ /mi 'da' srid gsum dbang sgyur dud sol mas/ /zhi rgyas dbang gi las rnams ma lus pa/ /thogs med bsgrub pa'i mthudapung bskyed du gsol/ /zhal gyi dar 'asna lnga'i dkar po thugs rje'i cha gang chu shel dbang po'i las/ /byin rlabs ka t+pā ra yi zegasama'i rdul/ /'dzags pas mi mthun nyes brgya'i tsha gdung kun/ /rab bcil zhi ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /ser po legs byas rgyal mtshan 'od 'bar rtag gi rtser/ /mthu rtsal yid bzhin nor las—363—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()'dod dgu'i char//ci bsams re ba skong ba'i yongs 'du'i ljon//rgyas pa'i 'phrin las lhun gyisagrub par mdzod//dmar po bto pas brtan g.yo mtha' dag rang dbang dang //bral te cig car 'gugs byed pahrūl zhags//rab dmar glog gi 'od zer 'byug 'dra yis//khams gsum ma lus bsdu pa'i las mdzod cig/nag po//ro sreg lang long dud pas sna yi dbang //ma tshim lhung lhung 'bab pa snying khrag rgyun//nyer gsas log 'dren sdebacas mthar byas te//mag spyod drag po'i 'phrin las myur du sgrubs//ljang /rkang gling sgra yis gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs//'bod pa'i pho nya sngo bsang bram ze'i gzugs//nang gi rtsa khams nyer brlab zhing skyong che//'phrin las bzhi bsgrub rnam 'gyur cir yang ston//gsang ba stobs log zhabs sen dang ge'i mchu//dgra bgegs snying la 'dam ltar bro brdung yang //rtsa zhal bam ro za ba'i khrag gi rgyun//dmar po'i lha 'phreng tshems dkar gsal byed bzhin//'khor lo'i sdom pa rdo rje srin po yi//rol gar snying po'i rnal 'byor yum bzhi'i tshul//nam mkha'i mtha' khyab bka' nyan 'khor tsho gis kyis//zhi rgyas dbang gi las rnams sgrub par mdzod//gnod sbyin yab yum pu tra ming sring rnams//bram ze'i dmod pa 'grub gos deng gi dus//bstan 'gro'i bde skyid 'joms pa'i dgra bgegs kyi//'og chod pags shus dmar po 180na gos su gyon//byu ru'i mdangs 'dzin gnod sbyin zangs khrab can//rig pa'i lha mo bka' sdod srog gi bdag/bshan dmar btsan rgod bgrang yas 'khor tsho gis kyis//dus kun mel tshe mdzod la las kun sgrubs//sa lug nag zla'i nang du dge slong thi mas rgya mtshodang blo gros rgya mtsho gnyis chos 'thor rgyal gyi mgon go g.yas kyi gtor gsos la btang skab snya shal phul ba'i kha byang bdud las rgyal pa'i sa dbyangs/rgyal byams 'a gyi i dar zhal yig/gang gi byams pa'i ting 'dzin nyi ma yis//bdud rigs 'byung po'i mun pa mthar byas nas//mkha' mnyam 'gro ba mtha' dag bde skyid kyi//snang ba dam pa'i dpal la sbyor bar shog/de la koṭi'i dpalas 50 sa dar lha blag/rgyal ba kun gyi yum gciX /bya pas can ma//'dod khams dbang phyug dmag

— sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'dadang zor gyi lhas/ /'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad rab zhi zhing / /bsams don lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol/ /mthil mgon kha ོ mo'i chos skyong spyi'i snya dar spyo yig dkar mo ljongs zhes chos 'khor rgyal gyi gnas/ /bsrung mdzad dam can rgya mtsho'i tsho gos rnams kyis/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las gang bsams pa/ /re skong yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal por mdzod/ /srid gsum bdag mor mdos bskang 'bum zer gyis thugs dam skang ba sa lug hor zla lnga pa'i (180ba〉sa gcig nasabatsugs pa'i tshe snyan shal phul ba'i kha byang las kun bsgrub pa'i pho nya/ /dkar gdung shugs nor rgyas kyis bsnams gsol 'debs ri/ /thugs rje'i mtshor bsgril byin rlabs bdud rtsi yis/ /yid srubs 'khor los gcod min gtan bde'i srog /don ldan 'tsho ba'i mchog sbyin dkar mdzes ma/ /ser legs byas ljon shing rtse mor 'dod 'jo'i gos/ /yang srid 'bum phrag lces myang zad min ro/ /dngar por spyod la brgya byin skal mnyam pa'i/ /dbang thang nyer stsol gser zhun mdangs 'dzin kye/ /dmar tsher rtsub ba spu gyen ldog chags myos sems/ /rkang sen 'degs la mid pa'i gtsug gtor rtse/ /'gugs par yid can lta ci chos kun brtan/ /'phrog byed pad rwag gis byugs cho me kun ma/ sngo/ /phra mo'i sha za dgra dpung mi rtag lam/ /bkod la mtshar ci dga' rab dbang phyug snying / /lkog mar thon pa'i rtsal rjes mig gsum pas/ /dbye ba'i nus bral skabs phye srin mo'i gzugs/ /ljang bstan 'gro'i mkha' la bde skyid wo mor byed/ /rtag tu shar ba kun dga'i mdza' na mo/ /yid kyi gas nur rol rtsed snang ba'i sgo/ /'dzad med phye zhig 'dod khams dbang phyug ma/ /sa skyong sangs rgyas rgya mtsho khri 'don grub pa'i sa lug zla ba drug pa'i tshes dgu la chos 'khor rgyal du srung ma rang bzhin gyi bzhugs gnas mgon khang yas phyin du snyan shal phul ba'i kha byang (181na)lha thor los sgyur ba'i gtam snyan/ /ris med skye rgur rtag tu gzigs pa'i spyan/ /zur mdas yid grubs snying bsnun brgyal ba dang / /chabs cig 'jig rten gsum du bde skyid kun/ /khyab par mdzod cig byams mgon thugs rje'i gter/ /bod yul 'dzin ma'i lto bar zhwa ser bstan/ /gser zhun lhun por ljid kyis legs byas klung / /srid —367

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)mthar chad med 'bab pa'i zhabs bsil gyis/ /nyes brgya'i dri ma mtha' dag zhakhru da par shog /lugs gnyis khrims kyi do rar mchog dman glang / /bcug nas bag yod pad tshal mi brdzi bar/ /bde skyid rin chen rgyan spras ya rab kyi/ /bzang spyod gom stabs lhod por brgyu bar shog /dkar brgya phrag zla zhun byugs pa'i bzhin ras can/ /rab gsal 'dzum gyis rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i mgron/ /'bod mdzad 'dod khams dbang mos nad gdon dgra /dbul phongs nyer 'tshe'i mun pa pha mthar mdzod/ /ser/ mtshams sprin mdangs kyi dpal 'dzin lus phra ma'i/ /gzi byin snying gi za ma tog 'khyil bas/ /rnam thos bu yi bsod nams phung po dang / /rab mnyam mi 'dzad gter la spyod par mdzod/ /dmar/ rjes chags pad rwag 'od 'bar 'dod khams mas/ /rgya hor bod sogs dzam bu tri sha yis/ /nyer mtshan gzhir 'khod yid can bde 'byung gi /ral par rkang sen zla ba 'char (181ba)bar shog /nag stang zil kha dog gtum drag srin mo'i zhal/ /gdangs pa'i mche ba rnon pos dgra bgegs kyi/ sha khrag chem chem gsol nas phyogs kun las/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i ba dan srid rtser sgrengs/ /ljang gcig las du mar bsgyur ba 'phrul po ches/ /'jig rten gsum du khyab kyang nges pa'i don/ /rdo rje dbyings phyug dmag zor lha mo'i skur/ /bstan des zhi rgyas dbang drag thams cad sgrubs//mgon khang shod 'jigs byed ma he'i zhal can myur mdzad mgon/ /ngal bsos po dang las gshin re ma tī/ /tsa tu rmu kha beg tse g.ya' ma skyong / /bstan srung rgya mtshos bsam don mtha' dag sgrubs/ /gur zhal ma hā kā la'i 'khor sgyur rdo rje gur/ /drag rtsal mthu stobs rtsal ldan gdong bzhi pa/ /gnod sbyin yab yum pu tra lcam dral gyis/ /mi bsrun log 'dren sder bcas spa bkong mdzod/ /beg rtse gnod sbyin bye ba'i dmag dpon zangs khrab can/ /gar gyi dbang phyug ma mo kun gyi gtso/ /srog bdag dmar po la sogs bka' nyan pa'i/ /bgrang yas kiṅka ra yis las rnams sgrubs/ /bstan ma bas gnyis gangs can bsod nams rgyal mtshan tog gi rtser/ /bde skyid yid bzhin nor las 'dod dgu'i char/ /'bebs par pad+mā ka ras gnyer gtad pa/ /bstan ma bcu gnyis g.yel med gtong grogs mdzod/ /ma' dga' —368

sku gsung thug rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdza khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ tanalcog bod yul ga rjo la 182na〉kyin srung ma sa/mtsho skyes rdo rjes dam sgrags bka' nyan che//sprul pa'i chos rgyal sku lnga 'khor bcas kyis//yongs 'du'i ljon pa ji bzhin don rnams sgrubs//sa skyong sangs rgyas rgya mtsho khri 'khod grub pa'i zla ba drug pa'i nyer gnyis la jo shāka rnam gnyis kyis gtsos ra sar mo che'i mar khang yongs su rdzog par snya shal phul phe kha byang dpag bsam ljon shing //jo bo rin po cher/mtshan dpe'i mdzes sku mig gi bdud rtsi'i dpyid//tshangs gsung chos sgra rna ba rgyud mang glu//rnam mkhyen ye shes gzigs pas 'gro ba rnams//phan bde la sbyor don kun grub pa'i dpal//mgon khyod dngos las g.yin min bcu gnyis lo'i//sku tshad lha mi'i rin chen bzhu blugs pa//mthong thos dran pas rnam grol dbang gi rgyal//srid zhi'i 'dod dgu bsnyil la gcig tu dad//de phyir 'khor lo'i ri mos mtshan pa'i phyag/bdag cag yid can kun gyi spyi gtsug tu//bkod de 'di dang gtan gyi mdun ma kun//smon pa ji bzhin grub par dbugs dbyung zhig/skor gsum ru bzhi sgang drug rgya hor sogs//gser mdog cod pan 'chang bstan gyis khyab par//brgyad khri'i bgrang byar spyod pa'i bsod nams tshe//dbang thang mngon sum myong bar deng byin rlobs//chos srid zung 'brel rigs kyi bdag po yi//'phrin las chad med 'jug pa lugs gnyis khrims//rtsibs 182bstong 'khor lo dzam+bha sa legs mtshan gzhin//mang bkur rgyal po'i ngang tshul ltar bsgyur shog/༅ga rdzis spyo zhal nas sbar ba'i zhugs kyis 'byung po'i sde//rab bsreg srong btsan bzhed skong ji bzhin ding //thugs rje nyis bskyangs bde skyid snye ma'i 'bras//smin par mdzod cig phyag na pad dkar kye//gangs can legs byas srog 'tsho'i sman pa cher//rtsa gsum zhal rlung dngar pos nyer 'thul ba//'khor 'das zil gnon 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i zhal//bzhad pa'i bshes gnyen mi g.yo rtsal ldan shog/sangs rgyas gnyis pa blo bzang grags pa'i bstan//chos srid rgya mtsho'i mtha' klas rab spel ba//gnam sa bar med dbang phyug lhun grub tshe//mnga' thang mchod sbyin brgya pa'i mched por shog/byams pa gtum drag gzugs dang rno mtshon gzas min par//ris braX /na la legs 'dzum 'jam mnyen mdas//yid

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()srubs snying 'bigs ma pham mgon po yis//dkyus ring spyan gyi zhags pas 'khor mtha'i chings/dam bca'i gzungs sngags mthong thos dran reg pa//sim pa'i tshor ba la sbyor zhal bzhes 'bras//cher snyigs skye rgu'i sdug bsngal brgya phrag nad//legs 'joms sman mchog rnam rgyal char du phob//'dus pa dang por bgrod bya'i nyer bsdogs par//'gro rnams mtho ris yon to bdun sgo rten//brgyud mar rnyed 183na nas theg chen dam chos dang //mjal te rgyal sras spyod la 'jug par shog/sto bstong kha pa thub gzhung yongs kyi bka' gnad dam po'i rgya//mkhyen dpyod ral gri rnon pos rab gcod par//'jam pa'i rdo rje thun mtshams bla gos can//rgyal kun 'dus pa'i ngo bo btsong kha pa//dzā ti'i 'khri shing tshal nas za 'og thags//legs bskrun bar khyab nyer 'dzin mchod yul sde//yongs bkur zung 'jug bsod nams phung po'i gter//gro bzhin skyes bstan ci 'dra 'dzad med shog/thugs bskyed sngon goms 'phrin las rab dkar gdugs//srid pa'i rtse mor 'khor ba'i gser sbyangs tog/'od gzi nam mkha'i nor bu'i rjes 'gro bas//'jig rten gsum gyi mun pa sel bar shog/da4lha/dkar tshangs pa'i sras mo dbyangs can ngag gi lha//dung skyong rgyal mo'i gar mkhan zla zer gyis//mi mthun smag rum sangs dang chabs cig par//bde skyid u t+pal dkar po'i tshal bzhad mdzod//sar gser sbyangs lhun po stong phrag nyin byed kyis//'byud pas sgrun min rgyas pa'i mdangasagazi yis//lha dbang bsod nams phung po ri bo dngos/khyu 'dra'i nga tshul 'dzin nus skal thob mdzod//dmar mthong ba'i mod la 'dzam gling skye rgu'i lus//ba spu'i rtse mo zings te rkang pa'i rdul//gtsug tu len la nyer gdungs dbang gi las//mdzod cig bad rā ga zhun ma'i mdangs183ba'adzin kye//nag dgra bgegs srog rtsar yongs btab mche ba'i rtsal//rnon pos sa gsum 'dar byed nam gru yis//bsam ngan sbyor rtsub 'chang ba gzugs can dang //gzugs med sder bcas khrag dron hub kyis 'thung //ljang zas gtsang sras bstan skyong bar lhan cig tu//btab pa'i smon lam deng 'grub g.yar dam bzhin//dga' ldan chos srid ༷nga 'jug bla nas blar//'phel ba'i 'phrin las

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhongs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ ()rnam bzhi lhun grub mdzod//'od dpag go 'od zer dpag med 'phros pas bskal pa'i bar 'tsho ba'i mchog sbyin tshe mtha' yas mgon gyis//srog rtsa rdo rjer brlabs pa'i ka ba yis//a hang g.yung drung lta bur mi 'gyur shog/yos pa khrus mdzod med byung thugs rje chad med chu klung gis//skye rgu'i sdug bsngal kun 'byung dri ma rnams//te bkrus 'gogs lam bden gnyis la 'god par//khrus mdzad mtshan ldan byams pas rjes gzung zhig/rdo rje'i gdan spor mchog sprul skur bsgyur tshe//rnam gsum 'dus sde'i 'khor mtshungs rten 'brel du//ra sa'i gtsug lag khor yug gdan 'dren pa'i//ma pham mgon pos 'gro tsho gos thar par drongs//dga' ldan lha kha seng ge'i nga ro'i skur bstan ngo mtshar gyi//bkod pa rgya mtsho'i zhing gtsor legs bzhugs kyang //gangs ljongs bshad sgrub 184na〉nga lugs spel ba la//ye shes gzigs pa dus las mi g.yel shog/mas bas lha kha snang ba mtha' yas srid gsum 'byung po'i gshed//rang byung sprul pa'i sgyu 'phrul thod 'phreng rtsal//gcig las du mar bsgyur pa mtshan brgyad kyis//bod yul phan bde'i srog gi ka ba tshugs//gti gyur kho rnam 'dren 'gro la rab sman mdzad pa'i grangs//gaṅgā'i klung gi rdul gyis mar min gtso//mdo 'dul sher phyogs rgyud sde'i pu sta ka/bsod nams rgya mtsho'i zhing gis bdag byin rlobs//spyan ra zigs kyi lha kha lus can yongs la nye dang ring med par//rjes su 'dzin par rgyal rnams nyer mas sa kyang //'dul ba'i zhing 'dir spyan gyi ras ma yis//nam yang mi lhod gzigs gsol byin gyi rlobs//yo ༅ lha rdzogayo pas4khos po khri srong lde'u btsan smon lam rlung shugs kyis//drangs pa'i pad+ma sam bha rta bdun pas//bde skyid pad dkar sngar bzhad ji bzhin du//slar yang sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan rgyas par mdzod//tshe dpag med bla med lha kha waṃ yig 'chi med grub pa tshe mtha' yas//e dbyings shes rab ma dang mnyam sbyor ba'i //bcu drug dngas bca srog gi zungs gyur te//grangs med bgrang bya'i bar du 'tsho byin rlobs//sman bla lha khang sman mchog rnam par rgyal ba phyag sor gyis//bzung las nyer 184bab bas bdud rtsis 'gro rgyud la//gos pa'i kun 'byung gis bskyed bro na/ kyi//sdug bsngal ma lus drungs nas dbyung bar

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()shog/byams gogs pa mi khom gnas su bzod dka'i zug rngu yis//mnar ba'i yid can mtha' dag smon lam bzhin//dam bca'i gzungs sngags lcags kyus legs drangs nas//sgo gsum bde bar sbyor zhig byams pa mgon//tshe dpag lha go lha chen nyi bu'i las me long du//dkar nag 'char yun sgug la bskal pa'i bar//ngal bsten tshe mtha' yas pa lha dgu yis//'chi bdag bdud dpung 'joms par byin gyis rlomes//bar kha gi chos rgyas lha tswa 'jig rten dbang phyug sgrol ma khro gnyer can//yab yum rgyal pa'i tshul gyis gdong dmar yul//dam pa chos kyi dbu bsnyengs phan bde'i gzhi//btsugs ltar 'phrin las chad med 'jug byin rlobs//o ༅ phug 'dzam gling brtul zhugs lhun grub pad 'byung gis//dam sri dregs pa sdo brgyad ma lus kun//zil gnon sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rol gar gyis//'phung byed 'gong po'i tshogs rnams spa bkongs shig/sman bla lha khang ches drag dug lnga'i shugasakyis mi dge'i las//bsags mthu lhag par bde ba snyigs dus 'dir//sman bla mched bdun mdo gsung shākya'i rgyal//thug rje'i mthu dpung skyed la rjes bzung gsol//tswa tshan lta kha sku gsung thugs185na 'khor drug cu rtsa gnyis lha'i//rigs kyi bdag po tsakra saṃ bha ra//rang snang shes rab ma dang mnyam sbyor ba//bde chen ye shes 'gro ba'i rgyud 'jug mdzod//rtsarang nye sgra lta kha log lta'i sde dpung gcan gzan dus min du//'byin pa'i ngar skad zil gnon seng ge'i sgra/shwakya'i rgyal po gsang gsum mi zad pas//lus can mtha' dag sim pa'i tshor bar sbyor//rgyas po lcog/li byin ha ra mched lnga blon po dang //mngag gzhug kiṅka ra yi tshogs rnams kyis//o rgyan slob dpon spyan sngar khasablangs bzhan//zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las thog med sgrubs//chos rgya po lha go /mtha' bzhi'i rgyal khams ma lus zil gnon par//srong btsan 'khor los bsgyur ba'i cha byad kyis//rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa'i sgo 'phar brgya//'grig par sras bcas rgyal bas byin gyis rlomes//chos rgyal mesadabon lha khang bod khams 'dul bar 'phags mchog rigs gsum mgon//chos kyi rgyal po'i skur bzhengs mes dbon gyi//bstan pa dbu brnyes sroX btod dar rgyas su//mdzad bzang srid pa'i pha

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chags gsab ma gsum pa/ 9)mthar zhabs brtan shog /spyan ras gzigs thub drug lha khang dmyal ba yi dwags byol song lha min mi/ /skabs gsum par bcas so so'i sdug bsngal gyi/ /gnyen por rigs drug thub pas yongs bskor ba//pad dkar 'chang bas 'gro kun grol bar mdzod/ /gto rabs lha khang rnam bzhi'i 'khor gyi pha mtha' bgrang yas kyang / /'khor sgyur rigs sras gtso bo rgyal po'i khrir/ /'don ltar bstan pa'i gtad rabs dgra bcom bdun/ /thugs rjes shākya'i ring lugs spel bar shog /sman bla'i pho brang sman mdo brgyad brgya par gsungs pho brang gi /lha tshogs mig gi bdud rtsi bkod legs pas/ /so sor zhal gyis 'tshes pa'i smon lam gyis/ /don kun lhun gyis grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /rtse tsho snan bla lha kho thub dbang ljags kyi dbang po las gsungs pa/ /sman rgyal mngon mkhyen chos bsgrags mya ngan med/ /gser bzang rin zla mtshan legs mched bdun gyi/ /mdo nas byung ba'i smon lam deng grub shog /mdzad 0lha khang nyi ma'i gnyen gyi bkod pa rgya mtsho'i rdul/ /snying por gyur pa'i mdzad bzang bcu gnyis tshul/ /legs bstan rjes su nam mkha'i mtha' snyed kyi/ /ma rnams nyer 'jug brtson tsos lhur len shog /bla ma lha rdzogadan gsum tshang ba'i lha tsho gos thams cad kun/ /rdo rje slob dpon lus kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /yongs shar dad pa'i shing rtas nyer drangs nas/ /mchog thun dngos grub char du bsnyil bar shog /gnas bas lha go thub dbang ring lugs ji srid gnas kyi bar/ /dngos bzhugs nyan thos chen po bcu drug tshul/ /nges pa'i don du spang rtogs mthar phyin (186na)pas/ /bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas par byin gyis rlomes/ /rnam thar sgo gsum rnam 'dren thug pa med pas grangs kyi tshad/ /bzung nus min kyang byon zin 'byon gyur dang / /da ltar legs bzhugs dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi/ /phul byung mdzad pa ji bzhin rjes slob shog /sgros ma lha kha seng ge glang chen chom kun ma dang sgrul/ /lcagasasgrog sha za rgya mtsho la sogs pa'i/ /'jigs chen kun la sems can ma lus pa/ /skyob par mdzod cig rgyal yum 'phags ma'i zhabs/ /rmi su nga pa/ zangs mkhar 'jig rten yongs kyi mig gcig pur/ /stsol pa ji bzhin rin chen 'dod dgu'i gter/ /sgo 'phar brgya phrag phye nas ngal bsos po'i bang —373

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()mdzod gnyis pa deng 'dir grub par mdzod//ra smo 0 rdzogasdog gnas su 'khor ba ji srid bar//g.yo med bzhugs kyang zhing khams rgya mtsho mā/tha dad 'gro ngor rnam par phrul po che//ston mdzad bskal bzang bzhi pa shākya'i rgyal//'gro ba'i mtha' nyid de srid 'phrin las rgyun//ma la yar skyesang da 'thuladangar po'i dris//sgrib gnyis des bskyed dkar min tshaba'i gdung //rab bcil nyer bsil bde skyid rtag myong shog/don kun grub pa brgyad pa'i sku yi 3//gangs ro bsod nams rgya mtsho'i mchod sdong du//nyi zlas gling bzhi'i mun sel de srid bar//186ba tha zhugs nas 'gro rnams phul byung thugs rjes bzung //ra mo che sman lha khang ma 'dris skye rgu yongs la ches sman pa//'jig rten gsum gyi bla ma be+e ḍūrla//'od mtshan stong 'bar bde bar gshegs brgyad kyis//rtsod ldan nyes brgya'i nad rnams drungs 'byin shog/ra mo tsho steng kho lha gos klu yi dbang phyug rgyal po seng ge'i sgra/rnam 'dren sras slob bcas pasagadengs can tshogs//ches rags dug lnga zhi nas sgo gsum la//mi 'dzad bde ba'i bdud rtsi rtag sbyin mdzod//mgon po bsgo gdong ma thub pa'i bstan pa nam mkha' gnas kyi bar//bsrung bar zhal 'tshes legs ldan lha yi sras//bka' nyan 'khor tsho gos rgya mtshos ma wa zhe spyod dbang //zhi dang rgyasapa'i las kun lhun grub mdzod//sa lug sto sgo chos rje blo bzang chos skyong gis tre pho yul gyi gur mgon dang dmag zor ma'i mgon khang du snyan shal tshol rgyu'i kha byang dgos tshul ltar bris pa hrū bde'i sa bon//mig sman phung po brtsegs pa'i sa 'dzin la//dus mtha'i me dpung 'bar 'dra'i gos gyon pa//rdo rje gur mgon ma hā kā la yi//dbang phyug lha chen dpal 'bar mthu bo ches//tre bo hor tshang mi nor rigs brgyud dang //mnga' 'bangs srid sder bcas la nyer 'tshe ba'i//dgra bgegs kun zhi tshe dpal stobs 'byor rnams//yar ngo'i zla ba lta bur 'phel bar mdzod//187na khrid pa'i rgyal mo 'dod pa'i khams yongs la//dbang sgyur dpal ldan lha mo re ma ti//nges pa'i don du dbyangs can ngag gi lha//dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi yum gcig ma//gang la skyabs gsol tre bo hor tshang gi/mi nor sde /nga bcas pa'i bar chad tshogs//nyer zhi chos dang

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ ()srid kyi dge tshogs rnams//bla nas blar 'phel 'dod pa'i re bskong mdzod//sa lug lo dga' ldan tshe dbang dpal bzang gi dpung gis mnga' ris la dwags pa'i dpung la kha nyas tshabs 'a bto ba'i tshe rtsa gsu0kyil 'khore rgya mtshor snya shal phul ba'i kha byang yid grubs mig phug pa'i lhag phran//mtha' klas rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor tsho gis spyi dang //khyad par 'jam dpal tshe bdag las gzhan tshogs//myur mdzad mgon po dregasapa'i sdod pon sogs//dam can rgya mtsho pho nyar bcas rnams kyis//mi bsrun dgra dpung 'chi bdag lam r+pā por//wo bkod sngar bcol gto rag gto po dang //slad mar bsgrub ho phyi nang gsang ba yi//mchod tsho gis rgya mtsho spel la dgyis par rol/khrad gsum dbang sgyur dpal ldan re ma tī//pho rgyud morgyud dregs pa'i dmag tsho gis la//log 'dren bsgral ba'i gtang rag mchod sprin tshogs//rgyas par spel na dgyes dgur rol zhig gu/gur mgon stobs 'phrog dbang po las mkhan sogs//bka' nyan 'khor dang 187ba ) bcas pa'i spyan snga sa/dgra dpung phye mar btags la mchod tsho gis sprin//nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo 'phar phye ste 'bul//sa lug hor zla gnyis pa'i sri gnon la sdo pa sangs rgyas rgya mtsho bteg skabs mchod khang tshor snyan shal phul ba'i kha byang bde tshe 'od snang na khug mu/byams pa wo po'i dpung gis bdud sde'i g.yul//pham mdzad bskal bzang sgron me bzhi pa mchog/don kun grub pa'i phyag mthil 'khor lo yi//ri mo rnam bkra 'gro rnams gtsug na khyong //'dzum zhal zung nas rab spros 'od zer gyis//mtha' klas lus can skye rgu'i smag gi dras//mthar byas bde skyid snang bas yongs khyab pa//dmigs med thugs rje'i mthu dpung deng bskyed gsol//khyod bstan mya ga med pa'i ljon shing gi/grib mar bcud kyi 'gro ba kun brten nas//mdzo par mtho dang nges par legs pa yi//zad mi shes pa'i ro mas myong bar shog/bde ldan zhing gtso'i dbang phyug snang mtha' yas/grub rigs rgya mtsho'i shing rtar ngur smig gar//nges pa'i don du 'khor lo sdom pa che//bla ma ༈ shad ston 'gro ba'i mgon po g.yu brag rje//rma sems: tir 'dus pas rtsa mdud rnams//yongs grol ye sheXchos sku'i mkha' dbyings su//rab shar kun rdzob

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()rdo 'phrul rmad po ches//ljongs 'dir bstan 'gro'i dga' ston spel bar shog/chos kyi dbyings su rang sar 188na sgom rje chos dbyings rang grol gyi dngul gdung /grol ba//mkha' khyab mkha' yi rdo rje'i sgyu 'phrul gar//bgrang yas zhi khro'i gtso bor che mchog lha//thun slong gdul byar gdan gsum tsha ba'i mgon//dpal ldan lung rtogs 'byor pa'i bang mdzod la//dbang sgyur 'phrin las 'khor ba ji srid bar//rab rgyas thugs rje'i 'jug pas bdag sogs 'gro//phan bde'i dga' ston mchog la sbyor bar shog/he ru gaḥdapal bdud bsto gawo po mā/gas drag rdo rje srin po'i gzugs la 4 ba//las kun bsgrub la bya rog gdong pa can//bka' sdod dregs pa'i dmag gi dpung gi tshogs//rdo rje gung thang mgon khang wo mo 'chang dbang klu sgrub g.yu brag pa//rtsa rgyud bla ma'i dam tshig nyer dgongasanas//swā la'i ljongs 'dir bstan 'gro'i legs tsho gos rnams//yar ro'i zla ltar 'phel ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//ma mo lha rmo lcags phur ma 'bum sde'i gtso mo lcags phur mas//nad yams 'thab rtsod mu ge rab zhi ṣ+ka //sgo gsum bde skyid la sbyor bdud rtsi'i rgyun//rtag tu go pa med pa'i tshon lasamadzod//ma' yang dgon mgon khang thub bstan skyong ba'i dam can yongs kyi dpal//legs ldan phyag bzhi mgon po 'khor bcas kyis//mnya med chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa'i//bstan pa phyogs dusakun tu rgyas par mdzod//188ba khrig po zhes pa lcags sprel lo gsar gyi dus dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo mchod pa'i tshe dar r+sā sna lnga'i snyan sha po rtsa go zhal byang sa ran 'grub//dkar po 'bum phrag zla zhun byugs pa man shel gyi//lhun po'i snyemasa'aphrog waṃ med na chung gi/gtsug tu thu 'gying sgos pa'i bu mo khyod//'dzum ldan zhal khyim dngom la deng 'dir spyon//chos srid phun tsho gis sgra rnams rgyud mangs las//nyer drangs lhan cig gdub sil 'brol ba'i skad//snyan po rna bar lhang lhang thos pa'i 4 //snying dbus kun dga'i mdza' na sbyin zhig kye//grags gtam rjes 'gror brjod mod mtha' gcig tu//ma nges zhi ba'i 'phrin las bsgrub pa la//sna tsho gos sprul pa'i gar gyis re ba rnamaX/6/skong phyir bde chen 'khor lo'i dbus bzhugs

sku gsung thug rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 9)shig/ser po bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po phyur bu sa/rab spungs yol go btegs nas 'khor 'das kyi//dgos 'dod gru char phab tshe rmugs 'dzin grong //mngon sum ston pa 'jo sgeg lus phra'i gzugs//brgya phrag nyi gos klubs pas dza mu'i gser/khrud pa'i rtse mor bsnyeg kyang khyod rjes su//bgreng khur rngul gyis 'gram par mu tig 'phreng //'dzin byed gzi yis 'jig rten gsum snang bzhin//rgyas pa las kun rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs ltar//nam yang yol ba med par legs bsgrub ched//sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i dga' tshal yid 'ong bar//15na skyog tu mi 'bral bzhugs shig mdza' na mo//dmar po phra rgyas rab spangs dgra bcom thugs kyi brten//'phrog na srid 'dir che dgu cog gi yid//'gugs byed 'jam mnyen lcags kyo gzas pa'i mod//rdos bcas snod kyi 'jig rten g.yo ba bzhin//rgya skyegs dngas ma'i bkrag 'tsher byu ru'i shing //phyag sor yal 'dab 'byug pas khams gsum rnams//ched du btab pa min par rang gir du//yongs bzung dbang gi sgyu thabs 'di med byung //yid srubs brnag mun sel na dregs ldan gzhan//sdang sems 'dab zum grol te dad pa'i blo//ge sar dgong las legs tshogs sbrang rtsi'i bas//'bab ched longs spyod 'khor lor g.yo med bzhugs//nag po mig sman mdog can rab dmar zhal gdangs nas//ches dkar mche ba'i rtse mosadagra bgegs gzugs//chem chem zos pas ma tshims khrag mtsho'i dbus//'jigs rung srin mo'i rdzu 'phrul gar gyis rtsen//bsam ga sbyor rtsub gzugs can gzugs med dpung //khram thob sho khye nad rkyal mtshon dru yis//log 'dren lha min mo rnams brlang spyod mngal//cig car lhungs ba'i sgra de phyogs bcur snyan//drag sbyor rdo rje'i thog gi mda' bo che//'phang pa'i ched du sprul bsgyur mtha' klas pas//nyin mtshan mi g.yel mel tshe mdzad pa'i phyir//chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus15ba〉kyi 'gyur med bzhugs//ljang khu sgrib gnyis las dang des bskyed nad gdon sogs//rab gzhil lung rtogs tshe dpal dbang thang rgyas//srid zhi'i yon tan kun sdud dug gsum dang //'khrul pa'i dgra bgegs 'joms mdzad re ma tī//'jig rten dreXtsho gos rje mor srid pa'i rgyal//dbang phyug nyer

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)brgyad gtso mor thod rlon 'chang / /gser mngal sras tshul bzung yang zhi dang khro'i/ /'khor lo'i dbus na rab snang shes rab ma/ /nyi ma'i gnyen gyi lung rtogs legs stong bar/ /zhal 'tshes dam bca'i ri mo yal min pa/ /mngon sum bstan na don bzhin 'bad med du/ /yongs sgrubs phyogasalas rnam rgyal dzornga rdungs/ /'jam dpal snying po'i ring lugs de 'degs srid/ /nyer spel sa spyod sku tshe mnga' thang dar/ /'bangs rnams sum rtsen yul gyi dga' ston che/ /myong ba'i skal ba bzang po deng 'dir stsol/ /rig 'dzin bdag gi ji ltar las bcol kun/ /thogs med bsgrub phyir bde skyid 'khor lo'i dbus/ /dbang gzhu ltar bkra sku mdog phyag mtshan gyi/ /rol gar sgyur cig 'dod khams dbang phyug ma/ /lcags hor zla dang po'i tshes dgu nas zhag bdun gyi bar dri za'i rgyal po bzabs gsol gyis mchod pa'i tshe snyan shal ci ba4sa 'dod 'jo/ /dmar/ /snang srid dregs pa ma lus dbang bsdus nas/ /zil gnon dbang chen rta skad thengs gsum gyis/ /'jigs med (190na〉seng ge'i nga ro cher bsgrags te/ /nag phyogs lha srin sder bcas phyer 'thag mdzod/ /nam mkha'i snying po dri za'i rgyal po'i skur/ /legs bstan lha mchog rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal/ /bod skyong rgyal po'i sku lha chen po khyod/ /pad+ma thod 'phreng dam tshig nye bar dgongs/ /sngo bcu drug dga' bzhi'i bde chen bskyed pa'i yum/ /gnam mtsho'i rgyal mo rdo rje g.yu sgron mas/ /mi nor longs spyod gaṅgā'i chu rgyun ltar/ /rtag tu chad pa med pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /gangasaljongs yul grur nad rims g.yul 'brug dang / /dbul phongs sdug bsngal mun pa mthar byas te/ /bde skyid nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bkrag po che'i/ /snang bas 'jig rten gsum du khyab par mdzod/ /thub bstan 'phel zhing sa dbahrūl po yi/ /sku tshe mnga' thang chab srid rab tu rgyas/ /rig 'dzin bdag gis bcol ba'i dbang drag dang / /zhi rgyas las rnams thogs med sgrub par mdzod/ /dkar tshig thub sman gyi dri bsung mngar po mā /'thul bas bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rigs kun/ /drungs nas phyungs la mi mthun phyogs mtha' dag /zhi ba'i 'phrin las thogs med sgrub par mdzod/ /ser /lha klu gnod —37

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 9)sbyin mir bcas nor lha'i tshogs//dgos 'dod phyur bur spungs pa'i dpal 'byor gyis//rnam mang thos sras bang mdzod rjes 'gro ba//rgyas pa'i 'phrin las ma lus90bsgrubs shig kye//dmar bskal brgyar mi shigs srog rtsa g.yung drung gi/khams su byin rlabs 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bcud//rtag tu 'thung ba tshe yi dngos grub kun//re gos ji bzhin stsol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//nag sna tsho gos mtsho ni rnon dbal rtses dgra bgegs kyi/sha rus dum bur ga khubs nas snying gi khrag yi kha kyis drangs te drag po'i 'phrin las rnams//thogs pa med par lhun gyis grub par mdzod//dkar mthong bas mi rngams yid 'phrog lha bu'i gzugs//rin cen g.yu yi thod dang zur phud can//khri srong lde'u btsun sku lha chen po yi//lus dang grib mar 'grogs nas srung skyob mdzod//dkar/gnam lcags rwa dang rmig pas rgyal 'gong sogs//sdebargyad lus srog mthu stobs kun brdzis nas//cho 'phrul dug rlangs mgar gyi sol mal du//rtsa sbur bsregs pa dang mtshungs thal bar rlog/dmar dmar 'od lcags gyo lta bu khams gsum du//yongs spros 'jig rten skye 'gro chags myos kyis//brgyal te dbang med spyi bor rkang sen zla//tshes nas 'gugs pa'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod//ser tshangs pa'i rgyal po srid pa gsum po la//mnga' sgyur lha mchog mi gzugs gzi byin gyis//steng 'og phyogs mtshams ma lus zil mnan te//rnam par rgyal ba'i dga' ston sgrub par mdzod//191na tsheg spre zla ba dang po'i nang du bod khams bde thabs su mkha' rag khyung bas mar dar lcog phul ba'i kha byang ge skyid dpal ra//pad+ma thod 'phreng so zur gnubs rlangs nyang //gter ston sngags 'chang yongs kyi spyan snga sa/bstan 'gro'i bde skyid spel bar zhal bzhes pa//mkha' rag rdo rje khyung mdog dpal gyi yum//gangs mā bod kyi yul 'dir nad rims dang //dbul phongs4ba rtsod nyer 'tshe tso zhi zhing //chosadang srid kyi dpal 'byor legs tshogis rnams//bla nas blar yang 'phel ba'i las sgrubs shig/badz+rabha ra dha dme swā : ku sa/lcag sprel nag pa zla ba'i dpa' bo dga' ston gyi tshes la/༷sa 'phrog dbang po gang ba'i dus chos skyong che yo las mkha

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()dang tsos par snyan shal phul ba'i kha byang legs ldan dgyes pa'i bas sgra//gur mgon bde chen mkha' dbyings gar dgu'i rnam 'gyur thabs//stong nyid 'ja' ris bdag med shes rab 'khril//cir yang 'char ba'i mig 'phrul zung 'jug sku//snying dbus 'khor lo'i mgon po kye rdo rje'i//mi bsrun bdud sde'i gshed du ye shes mes//gtum drag khro chu khol rgyun bzhu blugs pa//'jigs rung srin po'i gzugasashar nag po ches//yum chen ral gcig sring mo 'dod khams mas//bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyes bu 'dus sde dar//sa spyod sku tshe mnga' thang chab srid rgyas//'khor 'bangs mtha' dag 191ba tha de skyid dga' ston la//spyod pa'i 'phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub par mdzod//dkar byin rlabs zla 'od 'bum 'dzag ga bur rdul//phyogs brgyar spros pa'i dri ngad 'thul ba yis//sgrib gnyis de 'bras nad gdon tsha ba'i dbal//nyer bcil bsil pa'i reg byas tshim par mdzod//sgo yid bzhin rin chen sprin rum stug po nas//'phrin las char rgyun babs pas lung rtogs dang //tshe dpal bsod nams myu gu dar drag rtser//srid zhi'i yon tan 'bras bu smin par mdzod//dmar ma btab dmar 'od lcags kyusabakug pa'i 'gro/myos yid bstan pa rang dbang dang bral ba//'phrog pa'i chom rkun tsa tu rmu kha yis//mgrin sngon skal ba dang mnyam mchog sbyin zhig/sngon/dgra bgegs khog pa mtshon gyis gshags pa'i khrag/drod rlangs ma yal thod par blugs pa'i rgyun/khub kyis drangs pas rab dkar mche ba'i ngos//mtshams sprin dbu ba'i do shal 'khrigs par mdzod//ljang /sna tsho gis pad+ma'i mal stan 'jam po la//nyal yang zug rngus mnar pa'i dam nyams lus//'dam ltar brdzis pas ma tshim gling bzhi dang //ri rab nyi zla gdan bting nag po tshe//rtsa zhal chem chem ro za drag khros mdangs//steng zhal dud kha khro gnyer cher bsdus kyang //g.yon zhal rjes chags shugs kyis g.yas ngos nas//rab dkar zhal khyim 'dzum bzhed dngom 192na〉 bzhin//gri gug ral gri rtse gsum mdung thung mtshon//nam mkhar gzas pas bdud dpung 'dar ba'i mod//thod pa dung dkar myos bum rkang gling gis//sgrub por dngos grub char r+pā 'bebs pa bawo/80/zhing glang stag shun mgo 'phreng sbrul rus rgyan//

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 6)stang zil lhun por spras pa srin po'i gzugs/ /dus mtha'i me dpung gyon nas dgra bgegs dpung / /mngon spyod las kyis phyogs kun rnam rgyal mdzod/ /mi mthun yongs zhi khams gsum dbang du sdud/ /chos srid legs tshogs yar ngo'i zla ba ltar/ /'phel phyir bgrang yas sprul gang 'phrul po che/ /mngon sum ston pa'i sgo 'phar 'byed du gsol/ /gdug can gnod sbyin yab yum bskos pa'i sras/ /gshin rje pu tra ming sring ru 'dren tshogs/ /las kun bsgrubs la brngams pa'i stang stabs kyis/ /tshur spyon dam tshig gnyan po dran par mdzod/ /byu ru'i skyes bu zangs kyi beg tse can/ /sring mo rig pa'i lha mo lcams dral gnyis/ /las mkhan srog bdag bshan pa dregs pa'i tshogs/ /dbang drag zhi rgyas las kun g.yel med sgrubs/ /lcags pho spre'u'i lo dbu mdzad blo bzang yon to gyis chos rgyal mes dbon 'ga'i gas lar mchod sprin spros pa'i 'phan dang snyan shal gyi kha byang nged rang gi ming dmigs bsal yod pa dgos tshul ltar bkod pa bsam pa'i re skong / /'phan gyi kha byang rgyal kun ye shes (192ba)rnam par 'phrul po che/ /gangs can bsod nams mgron du gas lar/ /yongasashar ra sa rten dang brten par bcas/ /srong btsan thugs rje'i mtshor shar chu shel dbang / /zas gtsang sras po bcu gnyis bgrang bya sa /slebs tshad zhal khyim mthong pas yongs grol ba/ /rang byon lnga ldan byams pa cho me 'khor sogs/ /ye shes sems dpa' bzhu blugs pha mtha' yas/ /rnam 'dren tshogs kyi spyan sngar bzang gos 'phan/ /gyis mtshon nyer spyod la sogs mchod pa'i sprin / /dbu 'dzad blo bzang yon tan lhag pa'i sems/ /pad rtsa dung ltar ches dkar gyis phul mthus/ /bod dang bod chen gser ldan dga' ma'i stor/ /ci 'dod 'jo ba phan bde'i mngal gyi khur/ /ljid kyis sgo gsum sim pa nyal 'gro'i rgyun/ /gtan mdun zla ba'i ma mar ro gcig shog /tshangs sras bzhad pa'i lung rig rdo rje'i mtshon/ /rmongs chen 'khor ba 'jig la rab gdengs par/ /'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i mgrin 'byud bshes gnyen mchog /ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'gyur med shog /zhwa ser 'chang ba'i bshad sgrub grib bsil du/ /yid can ma lus bde bar ngal 'tsho zhing / /sa spyod rgyal po'i sku tshe chab srid —381—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)brtan/ /mtshan jus mnga' thang bla nas blar 'phel shog khyu sbyor sbyin pa'i bdag po gtsor gyur pa/ /'dir 'bad byed po mtha' dag deng nas bzung / /byang chub bar du rdzogs ldan gcig pu yi/ /ngang (193na sol mngon sum nyams su myong bar shog shākya 5ni shākya seng ge'i dngos zhal mthong ba dang //mtshungs pa'i skyob pa khyod kyis bdag sogs 'gro /rjes bzung 'di phyi gtan gyi mdun ma kun/ /bsams pa ji bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /thugs rje ོ po zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po'i zhal bskyin las/ /'phros pa'i 'od kyis yid srubs mthar byas te/ /chos dkar snang bas 'jig rten gsum khyab par/ /mdzod cig 'phags mchogo nam mkha'i rgyal po kye/ /byams pa chos ge' byams pa'i chu klung ar+gha ris bral la/ /nyer sbrengs bsil pa'i reg byas bdud kyi snying / /tsha bas gdung byed sngon med sgyu ma yis/ /mkha' mnyam sems can mtha' dag rjes su bzung / /rje bla ma blo bzang grags snyan lung rtogs shes bya yi/ /srang la bteg tshe rgyal kun yon tan rdos/ /yo bar nus min rnam dag bstan pa la/ /tshe rabs kun 'jug smon lam lhun grub shog /dpal lha gshin rje'i sbyor yum dbyings phyug dgra bgegs gshed/ /srid pa'i rgyal mor bstan kyang dam ldan la/ /dgyes zhal tshems dkar ze'u 'bru dngom mdzad ma/ /lha mchog dung skyong dbang mos rtag tu srungs/ /ra tsā tshojo bo khyod zhal mthong lami phyed dad pa'i 'bras/ /tshe rabs kun tu sangs rgyas rjes dran pa'i/ /bag chags bzang po'i mtshams sbyor chad med du/ /bdag sogs sems(193ba)can rnams la stsol zhig gu /brtsegadong ma chos kyi dbyings nas zhi yang thub pa'i bstan/ /bsrung bar gtum chen legs ldan nag po che/ /lcam dral bka' sdod bcas pas zhi rgyas dang / /dbang drag 'phrin las ma lus sgrub par mdzod/ /ba4 yas 'phan gyi kha byang ri rab gling bzhi gling phran khor yug rnams/ /gangs can 'dzin mar shong ba'i mig gi 'phrul//byed po mkhan slob chos gsum rnam par thar/ /'phags yul thub bstan khengs pa thung ngur byed/ /bgrang yas rgyal dang de sras nyan rang sogs/ /ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho bris 'bur rten/ /tshon rgyas nye ba'i dngas shel rjes 'gro ba/ /lus can yongs kyi bsod nams bya ba'i zhing / /rnam 'dren tshogs—42

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'dakyi spyan sngar bzang gos 'phan/ man chod gong ltar/ /byang 0'a po tsan dan byugs pas mnye dang ste'u'i kha/ /gzas par gcig tu mnyam pa'i mgon khyod kyis/ /bdag sogs 'gro rgyud dug gsum nad sel ba'i/ /byin rlabs sman gyi chu bos bas par mdzod/ /bar kha sngon byon da ltar bzhugs dang 'byung 'gyur gyi/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis brtse bas nyer gzigs spyan/ /dkyus ring 'khor ba'i pha mtha' rdzogs min par/ khyud lnga'i lus can kun la btsa' bar mdzod/ /steng khang mchog dman dbang shes yul du khyod zhal zla /phyogs mtshams gang gi dngas mtshor (194na 'char mtshon pa/ /rnam par snang mdzad sku yi bkod pa gang / /skye bar snying gi me long ngos gsal shog /nyi ma gling me tog mda' can ne ru ka yi 'phrul/ /mi dge sna tsho gos las kyis ma brdar bar/ /bsod nams nam mkha'i nor bu'i dkyil 'khor gyis/ /'jig rten gsum gyi smag rum gzhil bar shog /zla ba gling chung ngu'i legasabyas cha phra tshes pa'i zla/ /ches goms zhag gis 'phel ba'i tsho gos gnyis kyi/ /dkyil 'khor cha shasardzogs pa'i bdag gzhan don/ /u t+pal dkar po'i 'dab brgya bzhad par shog /wom dpal gling sangs rgyas kun gyi yab gcig 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /mkhyen pa'i ral gri rnon pos mkha' mnyam 'gro'i/ /rmongs pa'i dra ba bcad nas shes rab kyi/ /snang bas blang dor blta ba mig yangs mdzod/ /ā r+ya pa nga nye ring dang bral thugs rje 'gro kun la/ /'jug pa 'phags mchog 'jig rten dbang phyug gis/ /cher snyigs lnga bdo'i 'gro ba 'dren pa la/ /'gyur med dam bca'i ri mo deng gsal mdzod/ /byams pa gling byams dang brtse ba'i dpung gis bdud bzhi'i g.yul/ /bcoms nas byang chub mngon— du mdzad ji bzhin/ /bdag sogs sems can mtha' dag ring min du/ /rje btsun khyod kyi rnam thar 'dzin byin rlobs/ /smos da gling chos brgyad snang ba bkrag (194ba kho che yi brlan/ /nam yang ma gosachags bral pad+ma'i steng / /mtshan dpe'i sman gyi chu bo 'dzad med kyis/ /skye rgu'i nyon mongs nad brgya gzhil bar shog /khrims khang gling skye bar sangs rgyas bstan la rab zhugs nas/ /bag yod lcags kyu rang sems glang po'i snar/ /btab ste rnam dag bslab pa'i tshul khrims dris/ /ma la ya rlung ngad pa'i —383

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)khengs 'phrog shog /3 sbyor tsā mang gling sangs rgyas sras dang slob mar bcas pa rnams/ /rtag tu mchod pa'i snying stobs ma ga dha/ /bzang mo'i khur chen bdag gis 'dzin nus pa'i/ /rnam dag smon pa'i 'bras bu deng 'grub shog /bdud khrul sngags pa gling yid srubs sdobacas snying ga 'bigs pa'i mtshon/ /mthu stobs rdo rje 'bar ba'i lcags ri yis/ /bstan 'gro'i legs byas srid mthar bsrung ba'i go /btsan po'i rin chen pha lam rjes 'gror shog /sgra bsgyur rgya gar:nga 'phags yul gsung rab dgongasa'agrel gangs can 'dir/ /bsgyur zin 'gyur bcos tshig dang don gyi cha/ /thos bsam sgom par byed pa'i skal ldan gyis/ /kun bzod yangs po'i mtha' yang dog por shog /be+e mu gling mtha' klas 'gro ba'i dbang por 'tsham pa'i chos/ /'gal med rtog nas sangs rgyas sgrub lung du/ shar bas rgyal ba'i dgongs don rnyed pa'i 'bras/ /rnam smin nag pos nam yang gos min shog /ba4gto gling dug gsum (195na'i nga mo'i dri tshor rjes bsnyeg pa/ /sems kyi gnyis 'thung dran shes lcags kyu yis/ /rab btab g.yo med zhi nas dngas mtsho'i dbus/ /gnas lugs zla ba'i gzugs brnyan 'char bar shog /rin 'a gling 'jungs pa'i rgya bral bdog pa'i gru char gyis/ /dbul phong sa gsher 'byor pa snye ma'i 'bras/ /yang srid mang por smin pa rin po che'i/ /bang mdzod skye ba kun tu longs spyod shog /dkor mdzod:nga mtha' bzhi'i las sgo ljongs 'dir yongs phye nas/ /srid pa'i dngos kun 'bad med dbang sdud par/ /mes dbon chos kyi rgyal po'i ba ched pa'i don/ /'khor ba mtha' can de srid lhun grub shog /khrus kha gling ya mtha' mi mngon 'khor lkoms rten rnams la/ /bsags pa'i kun 'byung des bskyed sdug bsngal bden/ /dri mab ga yod chu yis bkrus pa'i lhag /nam mkha'i pa khros mtsho ni min 'jam mnyen shog /sgo mang ke 'ang lo paṇa bsod nams zhing du rgyal blon gyis/ /sri zhu rgyal ba khyu mchog skyengs pa'i gtam/ /rlung du ma bskur de yang rkang mgyogs kyi/ /snying stobs phrag par khur du lci bar shog /mthu rtsal klu/nga klu gnyan sa bdag dug mun mthar byas nas/ /sim pa'i tshor ba rab gsal snang ster mkhan/ /gsang bdag nyi ma bod 'bangs dpung gnyen lam/ /bcu gnyis go lar —384

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ tanachad pa med rgyu shog /khams gsum gling mgon khyod sku gsung (195ba)thugs yon 'phrin las la/ /bcos min dad pa rlung shugs kyis bskul bas/ /srid zhi'i tsha gdung 'joms pa'i tsan+dan dri/ /'thul ba'i reg bya snying la sim par shog /bu tshal gling /sgyu ma'i khengs 'phrog khyad 'phags bzo yi 'phrul/ /sprul pa'i khangs bzang sa la mngon sum pa/ /rten dang brten par bcas la ri mo mā /bgyis mtshon tshe rabs kun tu byed nus shog /nges pa lnga ldan tshul la ma bltos par/ /gangs can dpal mo'i mgron byon mchog dman dang / /bar pa'i 'gro rjes 'dzin pa sngon med kyi/ /mgon po thugs rje can kye bdag rjes bzung / /pe spur dregs pa'i dmag dpon li byin ha ra dang / /bka' sdod btsan rgod dmar po tsi dmar bas/ /bod yul bstan dang rje 'bangs ma lus pa/ /pad+ma kā ra'i lung bzhin bsrung skyob mdzod/ khyatso ga gi 'a3 ma rungs gdengs can nag po'i cho 'phrul las/ /rgya khra'i lus bstan mgo lnga 'brug gi skad/ /drag por sgrog pa btul pa'i sa gzhi la/ /skye rgu'i chos dkar bye ba'i zhing gi phul//bgrang yas rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems/ /'khor tshogs kun gsal 'gram par rgyu skar bzhin/ /rab tu bkra ba a ho bdag sogs kyi/ /mgon skyabs gling dang gnyen du byon 'di spro/ /rnam 'dren tsho gis kyi spyan sngar bzang gos 'phan/ /gshong bsto len/ /mi'i kha ji srid 'khor ba mtha' can (196na thams can don/ /gzugs sku g.yo med longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /sems dpa' bcur bcas 'khor tsho gos rgya mtsho yis/ /brtse chen thugs rje'i lcags kyus bzung zhig gu /sgos pa yab gcig tshangs pa chen po gnam gyi lha/ /las bsgrub bshan pa mngag bzhug kiṅka ras/ /rgyal bstan de mchod mi bdag mnga' 'bangs bcas/ /rtag tu skyong ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /yom bu gla snang gi 'phan gyi kha byang rnam 'dren thugs rje'i gzugs brnyan mngon sum du/ /pho brang rtse mor babs pas bstan pa'i dbu/ /legs brnyes rten dang brten pa'i lcags kyu yis/ /'khor 'das yon tan 'gugs pa'i byed po bzhin/ /rnam 'dren tshogs kyi spyan sngar zhes pa man len/ /lcags pho spre'u'i lo sne'u gdong rtse nas sa skyong blo bzang sbyin pas khra 'brug gtsug lag khang gi rten brten pa la na bza' bla bre —385

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()'phan sogs phul pa'i kha byang yongs 'du'i snye ma//khra 'brug mar khang wo po mkha' khyab mkha' yi rdo rje mtshan dpe'i gzi//'bar bas gti mug 'dod chags ser sna'i mun//mthar byed snang mdzad mtha' yas rin wo 'byung //nye sras brgyad kyis bskor ba'i ga rjo lar//dngos 'byor yid sprul kun tu bzang po yi/rnam par thar pa'i mchod sprin nam mkha'i mtha'//rab 'byams rdul gyis mtshon min lhag pa'i sems//pad rtsa lta bur bskrun pa'i dge legs kyis//bstan 'gro 196ba〉thongs bde de 'dzin zhabs pad brtan//sa spyod sku tshe mnga' thang chab srid spel//srid zhi'i yon to gang thob sems can rnams//bla med byang tso r+ṣa po'i rgyu ru bsngo//sis lha kha rigs gsum 'gro la rjes chags chosakyi rgyal//srong btsan sgam po btsun mo blon por bcas//gangs ljongs skye rgu sngar rjes bzung ji bzhin//slad mar thugs rje'i 'jug pa chad med shog/rta mgrin lha kha drag po'i rta skad thengs gcig bsgrags pa'i mod//srid gsum bdud tshogs mthar byed khro gtum yang //byams brtse'i gsher gyis brlan pa'i bde skyid kyi//myu gu gsar pa'i dga' ston bskyed par mdzod//spyan ras gzigs lha kha lkog gyur sgrib bral mkhyen thugs ā dar+sha//mtshon phyir rab gsal spyan stong rigs drug la//gzigs pa nam yang mi g.yel 'jig rten gyi//mgon po'i phyag ring skye rgu'i gtsug tu khyongs//brnyag zhal gtso gyur lha tswa phyag na pad+ma'i rnam par 'phrul po che/khro chags rgyas zhi'i bcu gcig zhal gyi khyim//'gror dngom ga song yid can bde 'gro la//'dren pa'i snying stobs bskyed par bdag gsol 'debs//phyag ga pa'i mgon kha bde mchog 'khor lo dgra bgegs gshed ma mā/bya rog mtshan can khrag 'thung nag po che//tsaṇ+ḍi ka dang gdong bas mkha' 'gro brgyad//dam can rgya mtshos thub pa'i bstan pa spel//mar khang gsar pa snang mtha' 197na thad 'byung 'jam dpal snying po'i zhabs//khyad par snyigs ma'i 'gro la thugs rje'i dpung //mthor brtsegs bde bar bshegs pa mched brgyad kyis//rtsod dus rdzogasaldan gsar par bsgyur bar mdzod//go49kho lha mtshan snyan ma la ya dri sdom tsam gyis//'a mi bdag tsha gdung mthar byed rnam 'dren gyi//byin masaX lha'i sa kyis 'dod dgu'i byu//phab nas

sku gsung thug rten gsar bstos dang mar rdza kha bzang gi dkar ga glegs bam gsum pa/ 'dabul phongs gdung ba pha mthar mdzod//sgo tshe lha go sgos i ma 'dris kun la rab brtsebs//'gro rnams du ga'i thang lasang la gso ba'i/khru 'dzin gnas la dgyes pa lha gcig gis//spyan ra sha rigasapas rtag tu btsa' bar mdzod//sgo tshe ge kha lta kha rgyal sras5khri btsan po'i yi dam lha//sman gyi bla ma bai ri rla yi 'od//mgo por cas pas mdo las zhal 'a rmas pa'i//gos bu ji bzhi mgo sum bdag la stsol//yo yang tsā lha kha sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+ma kā ra yis//nga 'drar zhal bzhes mthong bas rnam grol mas//bur sto bod rje 'dzin par srin yul nas//lhod med dngos dang sprul pa rtag 'byor mdzod//masang mings pas rgyas gyi sku gsung nge rje//wo ma mgon rma ras gsisadabang ga4 ba'i bdag/dngos dang sprul pa'i rgyal blon lo paṇa gos//skye tso khrung zu du ho med shog/97ba tshes khang dpal ldan tshangs pa sprul pa'i rgyal po che'i//las mkhan gser sku dmag tshogs kiṅka ras//bdag sogs rnams kyi bsam pa'i don ma lus//thogs pa med par lhun gyis grub par mdzod//lcags spre sne'u gdong rtse nas skyong blo bzang sbyin pas bo ma bu bla sgang dang ba4 yas su mgo tsholagyi tshe snya shal kha byang gos tswadzes sa phreng /yom bu gla snang tho ri gnyan btsan sku mkhar yang rtse'i steng //rgyal bstan dbu bsnyengs rten tshol thog ma'i sgo/'grig pa'i snying po bshad sgrub legs dar rgyun//byams bstan zla ba'i ma ma dang tshol shog/sa a las byang sa r+sā po/'phags pa'i yul gyi ma hā bo dhi dngos//ljongs 'dir khri srong thugs rje'i lcags kyu yis//nyer bkug bu ram shing pa'i wom mtshe phyag/khyongs la 'jig rten gsum dbu gsang bar mdzod//bar kho 'das dang ma 'ongs da lta'i 'khor ba 'dir//zo a lkod ltar la yos 'gro 'dren pa'i ho//dus gsum stobs༅ mnga' ba'i zlos gar can//kun la skyabs su gsol na thugs rjes gzigs//steng kha rgyal ba'i zhal bskyin phyogs kyi me long du//'char mar mi bzhi rgyab sprod lta bu'i sku//bstan srog zab ga kho snying mdzod dkyil 'khor gyis/kha ba'i sman ljongs bde skyid dpal la sbyor//nyi 'ang brgya phrag nyes pa 9nyalha min sgra gcan gyis//skye rgu'i legs tshogos nyi ༷ bskal pa'i bar//ma bsgribs sim pa'i tshor ba

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2)'dab stong dbus//bgrang yas yon tan sbrang rtsi 'dzag par shog/zla ba gling srid pa'i bde sdug cha shas 'phel 'grib dang //bral ba'i gtan mdun dkyil 'khor dus kun tu//nya gang yang srid 'phreng bar kun ra'i//reg bya'i mdza' mo snying la 'byud par shog/wogos chung rmongs chen 'khor bar 'khyamasapa'i dra ba kun/zhes rab ral gri rnon pos yongs bcad nas//mi gnas mya ga 'das pa'i grong 'jug par//'jam mgon thugs rje'i spyan gyis rtag gzigs mdzod//ā bru skrung sems can yod do cog rnams lor ba las//ma drangs bar du byang chen them skas la//'dzegs min dam bca' ji bzhin dus drug tu/gru 'dzin ri bo'i spo nas gzigs su gsol//byam pa gling bskal mang te me'i gtsug tor mthon po nas//snying rje'i gaṅgā chad pa med babs pas//dug gsum dri 'khrud zhabasabasil lha gos rtser//phan bde'i rgyal mtshan rtag tu dar bar shog/sgos da shā nga rang bder gzhol ba'i dman lam gzhan phan sems//gom gcig gis bgrod rgyal sras spyod pa'i khyung //zhen nasathar pa'i lha lam gcod byed pa //snying stobs 'asdug pa bcu yi mthar son shog/chas kha gling srid pa'i phun 98ba〉shas kun la dug sbrul gyis//tshang ltar nyes brgya'i gnas rig nges chung mthus//sdom gsum rim nod rnam dag bslab khrims gos//lha mi'i rten brgyud nges legs sar 'khrid shog/3 sbyor tsha mang gling srid pa'i 'ching dang bral yang gdul bya rnams//tsho gis chen rdzogs slad mchod pasarab tshim pa'i//sngon byung ji bzhin bdag sogs kyis phul kun//rang gir mdzad nas skye bar 'bras myong mdzod//bdud la sngags po gling dpal chen khros pa'i sku smad phur pa'i dbal//rdo rje'i tsha tsha 'phro ba rnon po'i rtses//dgra bgegs dkar nag snying mtshams thal phyung du//phub nas phyogs las rnam par rgyal bar shog/sgra skur gling legs sbyar lha yi skad las thub gsung rnams//bsgyur dang 'gyur bcos 'chad nyan la brten nas//zas gtsang sras kyi ring lugs 'dzam gling du//khyab pa'i rnam thar bdag gis 'dzin nus shog/pi tsa gling lus can rnams kyi rgyud la thog med nas//zug pa'i sdig lhung las ༅ tsher ma kun//stong nyid snying rje zung la// cha dpyad kyis//dbyung nas sgo gsum dge ba'i

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chags gsab ma gsum pa/ tanalam la khod/ /ba mugato gling rtse gcig zhi gnas rgyud las lhag mthong mda'/ /nyer drangs bdag 'dzin 'ben la rab bsnun pas/ /thar pa'i lam du bkri nus ting nge 'dzin/ /klu sgrub dgongs (199na shon ji bzhin nyams len shog /si mu gling phongs pa'i lus can mtha' dag lang 'tsho'i ched//gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin rlabs po che/ /gtong bar thams cad sgrol sogs dam pa dang / /nyer mtshudas sbyin pa'i pha rol rdzogs par shog /dkor mdzod:nga rgya gar rgya nag bal yul ta zig hor/ /glo rdo lho mon mdo stod mdo smad sogs/ /mtha' klas yul gyi dge mtshan gangs ljongs 'dir/ /rgya mtshor chu rgyun bzhin du 'du byin rlobs/ /khrus khang:nga rten dang sun dbyung slar ldog kun tu spyod/ /gnyen po stobs bzhi'i bshags bsdoms bkru sman gyis/ /dug gsum nad brgya ma lus drungs phyung ste/ /gtan bde'i 'du ba mtha' dag cha snyoms shog /sgo mang ge tsang thub dbang sras dang slob mar bcas pa la/ /mgon med zas sbyin la sogs khyim bdag gis/ /ro bda'i bsod snyoms phul ba ji bzhin du/ /skyabs gnas kun la rtag tu mchod nus shog /ma cu rtsal klu gling nag po klu yi bsam sbyor ngan pa'i dug /drungs nas phyungs te sna tsho gis rin po che'i/ /char gyis 'jig rten dbul phongs kun bsal nas/ /rmugs 'dzin bdag po'i bang mdzod la mgran shog /sa gsum gling sangs rgyas sras bcasabazhugs pa'i gas lar/ /snying nas dad mos gdung shugs drag po yis/ /rtse gcig gsol ba 'debasan bdag sogs rnams/ /sa bcu'i lam la rim gyis 'khrid byin rlobs/ /bu tshe chung gong chen phun tshogs gser gyis yongs brngan pas/ /bzo khyad bcu gsum gyis 'phags gtsug lag khang / /bzhengs pa'i bsod nams ji bzhin lus can gyis/ /mnyam por longs su spyod pa'i skal bzang shog/li ma gling nyi ma'i gnyen gyis phyag sor me tog gis/ /byin rlabs li las nyer grub rnam 'dren skur//'jam mnyen lha gos phul bas skye ba mā /kun rdzob gos dang bcas te btsa' bar shog /dkar chag gter ston legs ldan rdo rjes gdan drangs pa'i/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil ba 'khor ba dbyings grol gyi/ /ma smad byin gyis rlobs las deng nas bzung / /byang chub bar gyi yon tan yar 'phel shog /pe dar lcog —389

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)rgyal chen li byin ha ra shing bya can/ /'bar ba spun bdun gtso bo tsi dmar ba/ /zan g.yang chos 'khor bsrung zhing legs stong bas/ /nyin mtshan dus kun mel tshe stongs grogs mdzod/ /lcags spre mig zla ba'i tshes bas bdun lhag mtshams kyi 'grub sbyor nyin dpal ldan dmar zor mar mdo bkang 'bum ther bto ba'i tshe sa shal phul shā kha byang 'dod las ga kho mdzod/ /dkar byin rlabs ga pur zegs ma 'bum phrag gis/ /nad gdon bar chad tsha gdung kun bcil nas/ /rtag tu bde skyid brgya byin skal mnyam par/ /bdag cag dpon slob mchod yon bcas rjes (200na〉zung / /ser mi shigs tshe yis rgya mdun rdo rje yi/ /ri mo rab gsal bskal bar 'tsho nus pa'i/ /mchog sbyin brgya phrag sgo phar 'byed pa la/ /thugs rje dus las yol ba med par mdzod/ /dmar yangs pa'i sa chen rjes su 'breng ba la/ /'bad med ngang gi lhun grub dbang thang gis/ /nga las nus kyi khengs pa rab bsnyil nas/ /khams gsum legs byas gom gcig gis gnon shog /mthing dgra dpung rgyu ma rlon par bgegs rigs mgo /brgyus pa ga shar byas nas mi bsrun sde/ /ming tsam ma rnyed g.yul las rnam rgyal ba'i/ /ba dan phyar bas lha lam dog por mdzod/ /ljang dga' ldan chos srid yar rgyas de 'dzin bstan/ /dge 'dun sdebacas bshad sgrub bya bas 'da'/ /sa spyod sku tshe mnga' thang chab srid dar/ /lugs gnyis khrims kyi mdud pa mi lhod shog /rang zhabs rjes su 'brang ngo cog gi yul/ /kun tu nad yams4ba rtsod bkres phongs ni/ /sgo gsum bde ba'i tshor ba khor yug tu/ khyun mi chad par nyams su myong bar mdzod/ /rig sngags 'chang ba bdag gis gnyer gtad pa'i/ /zhi rgyas dbang gi 'phrin las ma lusapa/ /yongs 'du 'dod 'jo'i ba dang bu me bzang bzhi/ /'bad pa med par lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /rnam gling chos mdzad pa gad yo blo gsal du kyi (200ba〉la nyid du gyur pa'i tshe rdzo bo kya 5nir snam sbyar dang rang byon lnga ldan dang lo ke shā ra la snyan shal phul ba'i kha byang paṇa chen dkone mchog chos grags kyis dgos tshul ltar bkod pa nge legasathem snas/ /bstan la shi zhugasang ma rdzogs mtha' dag las/ /rtags kyi khyad par snam phran glegs bu sa /legs sbyar ngur smig rgyal mtshan nyi ma'i gnyen/ /mig gzugs bgrang bya'i snang brnyan la phul —37

sku gsung thug rten gsar bzhongs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chags ga bam gsum pa/ 9)dges/ /ngag dbang blo gsal mi khom gnas brgyad dang / /yongs bral dal 'byor tshang ba'i rten thob nas/ /smin byed dbang dang grol byed lam zab mos/ /thar pa'i skas la myur du 'dzeg nus shog /nyan rang lam du mi 'phyan rgyal sras kyi/ /spyod mchog tshegs chud thabs khams kyis rdzogs nas/ /bcu gsum rdo rje'i sar bgrod lus can kun/ /'god pa'i ded dpon chen por 'gyur bar shog /zhi rgyas dbang khro a : de ba'i zhal/ /nyer bstan sna tshogs thabs kyis sems can rnams/ /'dren phyir 'jam mnyen phyag mthil spyan stong gis/ khyud lnga'i 'gro la gzigs pa'i mgon po kye/ /bya nag rigs kyi sdom brtson ngag gi dbang / /blo gros gsal ba'i me long dngas pa'i ngos/ /srid pa bar do gang shar sems nyid kyi/ /'khrul ngor shes rnams rang sar grol bar shog /lho phyogs grong chen dag pa'i zhing khams su/ /'od gsal ngang nas rmi lam rmis pa ltar/ /brdzus nas skyes te phyag na bad dkar gyi/ /sras kyi thu (201na ton ra 'gyur bar bdag byin rlobs/ /ngag dbang blo gsal chos nyid bar do'i klong / /skar mda' lta bur bde ba can zhing du/ /'dab stong sbubs skyes 'od dpag med mgon dang / srus kyi cu bo gnyis kyis rjes 'dzin shog /theg chen chos kyis bdud rtsis sab tshim nas/ /rnam bar rgyal pa'i go 'phang rtser son yang / /bye ba phrag brgya'i sprul pas sems can rnams/ /'dren pa'i snying stobs go cha bskyed nus shog /'dis mtsho ni thog med nas bzung da lta'i bar/ /bsags pa'i rnam dkar dge tsho gis ci mchis pa/ /nam mkha'i mthar thug gyur pa'i skye rgu rnams/ /bla med ye shesathob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /lcag spre zla spu lnga pa'i nang du phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i spyi rim gyi tshe dpal ldan 'dod khams dbang phyug mar snyan shalartsar shā 'byang las lhun grub/ /dmar po 'jig rten gsum gyi brtan pa 'phrog byed bar/ /dbang phyug zla ba gtsug tor rtser mdzes pa'i/ /cha shas nyer 'phel rtag tu nya gang bar/ /dbyangs can rdo rje dbyingasaphyug des byin rlobs/ /nag khra lusang ga yid gsum zug jus mnar byed pa'i/ /gdon bgegs lha srin gdug rtsub sbyor nus stobs/ /mthu rtsal mtshon cha'i 'khor lo rnon po yis/ /rtsibs la skyon nas—391

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()phye mar 'thag par mdzod//das po ri dwags mig zung g.yo ba zla bzhin can//byin rlabs ga bur zegs ma 'bum phrag gis//nad 201ba ) rims du kha'i mun pa mthar byas te//bde skyid snang ba'i dga' ston stsol bar mdzod//ser po phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'dus tshogos rnams//tshe dang bsod nams thos bsam sgom pa sogs//chos srid yon to nyin byed re ma ti'i//thugs rje nam mkha'i dgung nas rtag 'char mdzod//lcags spre chos 'khor rgyal du dbyar chos kyi thog sde pa blo bzang sbyin pas mang ja'i bsnyen bkur ba'i tshe byams 'a mgon khang yas mas tshor snyan shal phul shā kha byang phun mas re skong //byams 'a yid dga' chos 'dzin zhing nas 'dzam gling 'dir//'phos 'dra gser zhun rdul brtsegs brgya phrag gnyis//'byud pa'i dpal mnga' mthong bas rnam grol ba//ma pham snang brnyan mig gi bdud rtsi'i dpyid//zhwa ser 'chang ba'i bstan srid legs 'dzin sde//dbyar mtsho lta bur bla nas blar 'phyur zhing //bdag sogs las nyone de 'bras kun zhi nas//rtag tu sim pa'i tshor ba myong bar shog/srid 'khyams 'gro ba'i sdug kun bden pa'i dri//byams brtse'i gsher gyis bkrus pas bde skyid kyi//rab dkar snang ba yongs stsol thugs rje'i shugs//chu gter chen po'i rlabs ltar yel med shog/mgon kho shod shākya seng ge'i bstan pa bsrung ba la//chos kyi dbyings nas khro bo'i skur bzhengs te//mthu stobs dbang phyug tshogs kyis zhi rgyasadang //dbang drag 'phrin las ma lus sgrub 202na lngar mdzod//de ༷koṭi 'dod pa khams la dbang sgyur dmag zor mas//bstan dang bstan 'dzin dge 'dun chos srid spel//bdag sogs rnams kyi bsams pa'i re ba kun//'bad stsol med par ngang gi lhun grub mdzod//chos2khyi steng rgyud gsum dregs pa'i dam can srung ma yis//log 'dren dgra bgegs dpung tsho gis tshar bcad nas//dkar phyogs rnam par rgyal ba'i ba dan che//tshangs pa'i yul sa'i bar du bsgreng bar mdzod//bcu bo' rnam snang sgyu 'phrul gur mgon lcam dral dang //stobs 'phrog dbang po bka' sdod tshogs rnams kyis//yid grubs sde bcas bcoms nas mchog a /lha//dngos grub char chen 'bebs pa'i 'phrin las

lcags spre zla ba drug pa snga ma'i nang du chos dzi chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs su phyin skabs/ sngags khang / byams chen/rnam thar sgo gsum/ dngul gdung khang / dpal ldan lha mo bas yol snyan shal phul ba'i zhal byang kun bzang mchod sprin sgo 'byed/ /sngag kha 'jam dpal dpa' bo dus kyi dgra chen po/ myur mdzad ye shes mgon po bka' sdod tshogs//dam can gshin rje'i rgyal po 'khor bcas kyis/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las lhun grub mdzod/ /byams 'a/ byams dang brtse ba'i chu rgyun gyis/ /lus can kun gyi las nyon dri/ /bkrus nas gnasaskabs mthar thug (202ba)gi /phan bde'i sal sbyor byin rlobs/ /rnam thar sgo gsum shākya seng ge'i nga ro'i dbyangs/ /snyan brjid sgra yis yid srubs sde'i/ /ri dwags ma lus mthar byas te/ /rang gzhan don gnyis lhun grub shog /dngul yang kha bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs kyi rten/ /phun tsho gos bkra shis mtha' klas pa'i/ /sgo 'phar brgya phrag 'gro kun la/ /yongs 'byed bka' drin zla med stsol/ /lha mo srid pa gsum la mnga' sgyur pa'i/ /'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug mas/ /bsams pa'i re ba ma lus pa/ /'bad med lhun grub dngos grub stsol/ /lcag sbrel zla ba drug pa phyi mar rtser theg chen gling du phyin skabs gnas bcu/ dngul gdung / mgon khang chen mo/ byes pa rta mgrin/ smad pa'i mgon po/ byams chen chos rje'i sku bas rnams la snyan shal phul ba'i kha byang dpag bsam snam/ /gnas bstonges pa'i don du thub pa'i dbang po dang / /spang rtogs mnyam yang
