yi thos tshul bzung nas/ /phan bde rgyas mdzad gnas brten bcu drug gis/ /legs byas dpal gyis 'jig rten gsum khyab mdzod//dngul gdung bde gshegs mchod rten rnam brgyad ma dros pa'i/ /mtsho chen nas babs na las rnam pa bzhi'i/ khugs drag chu bos lus can mtha' klas pa'i/ /sgrib gnyis de 'bras dri ma zhakhyud par shog/mgon khang r+ṣa mo chos sku'i klong nas gdul dka' (203na tshe sil ba'i ched/ /rdo rje khro bo'i gad brgyangasadrag po yis/ /log 'dren dgra bgegs tshogs rnams tshar bcad de/ /bde ba chen por rjes su bzung ste sbyor/ /bye ye rta mcha rta skad thengs gcig sgra yis srid gsum gyi/ /log 'dren sdebargyad tshogs—393

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()rnams phyer btags nas//mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus pa//stsol zhig rta mchog yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal//smad pa'i mgon po bla ma yid dam chos skyong ma lus pa//gcig tu khrus pa myur mdzad legs ldan mgon//lcam dral dam can rgya mtsho'i tsho gis rnams kyis//zhi rgyas dbang gi 'phrin las ma lus sgrubs//༅mi mu chos rje'i sku wo shākya seng ge'i ye shes 'od zer gyis//rgya mtsho'i mthar thug skye rgu'i mun bsal nas//zhwa ser bstan pa'i snang ba rgyas mdzad pa//byams chen bla mas 'gro 'di rtag tu srungs//lde pa sangs rgyas rgya mtshos rma bya'i gdug ba po shis rtags brgyad dang rdza brgyad rgyal srid sna bdun rnams dpal lha stog tu phul bar dge ba'i mas ma mthong bar brten/lcag po spre'u'i lo hor zla drug pa nyis brtsegs kyi phyi ma'i rgyal sgegasum pa phur bu chu stod ga 'a tshes 'phrod pa'i wo phul pa'i dus dar r+pā sna lnga'i snyan dar gyi zhal byang lo med bdag tsho da pa lo lon//dmag zor rgyal mo zhi ba'i las bsgrub dze+e//dung skyong skur bstan yid 'phrog zla bzhin ma//'phrul snang 203bsing mar pad+ma thod phreng dang /khrong bas spyan sngar zhal 'tshes bka' skyong cher//rma bya'i gdugs mdzes bkra shis rtags rdzas dang //'khor sgyur rin wo sna bdun dngos bshams pa//ting 'dzin sngags rgyas kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin//nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo phye phul ba'i mthus//'jam dpal snying po'i bshad sgrub gtsug lag dang //de 'dzin 'dus sde'i zhabs 'degs rgyal blon 'bangs//lugs gnyis legs tsho gos ches cher dar zhing brtan//dga' ldan chos srid 'byung gnas pho brang che//skyong bar rmongs mun nyer sangs rnam dpyod gzi//rab rgyas rgya mtsho lta bur gto zab cing //mkha' ltar yangs pa'i mi dbang rigs brgyud sna bcas//tshe dpal dbang thang ngal bsos bur mtshungs mdzod//rig 'dzin bdag sogs 'khor dang bcas rnams kyi//nad gdon log 'dren dgra bgegs kun zhi zhing //'jig rten khams su tshe lo brgyad khri pa'i//skye rgu dang mtshungs bde skyid la spyod mdzod//brgya phrag nyi ma'i 'od kyis srid rtse'i bar//khyab pa'i mod la sum rtsen bdag po dang //legs mnyam tshe dbang dpal 'byor ma lus pa//rgyas par mdzod ༷ga 'dod khams dbang phyug ma//'jam mar+sā u

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ ()t+pal myu gu kha bye ba//reg pa'i mod la dregs ldan lha min gtsug/rkang sen zla tshes cod pan yongasa'achar ba'i//dbang gi 'phrin las sgrubs shig dpal lha mo//bsam skyor ngan 'chang dgra bgegasasha khrag drod//ma yal thod par blug nas shub 24 4 na ) drangs pas//ma tshim phyogs mtshams myul nas phyer 'thag pa//mngon spyod las la ma g.yel re ma tī//dbang phyug sras mo 'chi med lus phra'i gtso//nges pa'i don du ngag dbang dbyangs can mas//mchog thun dngos grub 'phrin las 'bad med du//stsol ba'i yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po mdzod//lcags sprel mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyi rim gror yi dam chos srung la snyan shal phul ba'i kha byang dgos tshul ltar se kho gas mi don sa grub//bla ma zhi khro yongs 'dus bka' brgyad lha tsho gos rnams//rang byung lus kyi dkyil 'khor la shar ba//rigs 'dzin bla ma rdo rje drag rtsal gyi//sku gsung thugs kyis byin rlobasadabang bskur stsol//lha mosangs rgyas kun dngos dbyangs can ngag gi lha//log 'dren 'dul phyir dmag zor rgyal mo'i skur//yongs bstan srid gsum dbang mos bar gcod rnams//rab zhi tshe dpal bsod nams rgyas par mdzod//da4lha 'dod khams kun la dbang sgyur dung skyong mas//zla ba lta bur gsalaba'i bzhin dngom nas//nad gdon bgegs dang bar gcod mun pa rnams//rab bcil phan bde'i snang ba rgyas par mdzod//be gtse bcom ldan 'jam dpal gshin rje'i bka' sdod mchog/sgrol gying chen po beg tse lcam bral dang //las mkhan srog bdag bka' nyan sdodapung gis//dbang drag rgyasadang zhi ba'i las kun mdzod//thang lha sa bcu'i byang chub 244bams dpa' nam mkha'i snying //tshangs ris dri za'i rgyal po'i skur bstan pa//rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal gyi dus kun tu//bsrung bskyab sba ba'i stong grogs mdzad du gsol//rgyal po sku lnga dregs pa'i gtso bo li byin hā ra che//sku lnga gsang yum sprul pa blon po dang //yang sprul bka' sdod bcas pa'i tsho gos rnams kyis//ji ltar 'dod pa'i re ba skong bar mdzod//sa cha lcog gsung gi chos rgyal dgra lha skyes gcig pu//gsang yum pad+ma skyes dang las mkhan che//rdo rje grags ldan 'khor dang ba/sa pa yis//'gal rkyen kun sol mthun rkyen ma

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()lus sgrubs//tsi dmar spu 'bar ba spun bdun btsan gyi sde dpon che//khyad par gnod sbyin chen po yang le ber//'khor dang bcas pas bar gcod nye 'tshe'i tshogs//zhi dang bzlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol//rdor legs rgyal dbang pad+ma'i bka' nyan dam tshig can//rdo rje legs pa mched 'khor sum brgya dang //drug cur bcas pas nyin mtshan dus kun tu//g.yel med bsrung zhing skyob pa'i las mdzod cig/lto wen las pa chu bo'i gzhung la brgyu ba'i dregs pa can//dge bsnyen chen po 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis//'phog thug phrag dog mtha' dag rab zhi ste//mthun rkyen thams cad yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod//lcags spre yem chi thabs mkhas gong du gser yig la phyin pa yar 'khor ba'i tshe rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling du snya dar sum ban rtsa lnga phul ba'i kha byang dgos tshul bsto bas pa legs byas ga mdzod//'ja' 2 na ) tshone ltar bkra spel legs lda ldi dar//sum cu rtsa lnga zhi khro rab stims sgyu//spyan sngar kun bzang mchod sprin spro ba'i ched//em chi thabs mkhas dad pas phul ba'i dges//grang yas skye bar sangs rgyas srasabacas rnams//sri zhun bgyid pa'i bsod nams phung po'i stobs//mgon med zas sbyin gnyis pa'i rnam par thar//'dzin pa'i skal ba bzang por 'gyur bar shog/'khor 'das rgud pa yongs zhi lha mi'i bde//tshe rabs rtag tu nyams su myong ba dang //ring por mi thogs 'gro ba ma lus pa//'dren nus kun mkhyen ye shes thob par shog/lho 'brug pa'i dpon tshab smon skyid pa mi 'gyur brtan pa g.yul gsar ba'i tsha bo ngag dbang rab brtan sog bya pa can rnams gso de pa spomatshon nang rang zhig gi sbyor ba mag du gyur pa'i tshe lcags spre zla 7 tshes3 la bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong zung mar gto rag rgyas par phul shā snyan shal gyi kha byang rnam par rgyal shā bdan/khrag po rtsal/dngos brgyud bla ma thams cad rdo rje'i lus//rang byung dkyil 'khor wo por yongs tsha ba//kun go snyag rdzo o rgyan rdo rje 'chang //mthu rtsal bskyed ltar slar yang byin pheb cig/4yi sa bco/sngags skyong ral gcig dam ༅ skyes bu che//rdo rje 'bar rtsal lho brag gte/ 9spyang gis/zhom par rgyal ba'i ru mar+sā bslang ba

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 9)ltar/ /slong ba'i dpa' brtul da dung snying stobs skyed / /bka' brgyad bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis sgrub sde brgyad kyi lha/ /me long gzugs brnyan ltar shar he ru gas/ /yid srubs gdong pa ched dmad slad mar (2sab)yang / /thugs rje'i gzi yis nag phyogs smag rum bcil/ /thod nang dgazor gdug can glo snying 'phrig bzhin pa/ /mang po'i ro mchog myang yang spyi gtsug nas/ shar ba'i nyi zla'i 'od kyis dam nyams rnams/ /btsal te lhag ma med par zhal du rngubs/ /dpal lha dran pas bde ster dpal ldan dung skyong ma/ /gangs can skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis kyis/ /gnyer gtad las bzhi ji ltar bsgrubasapa ltar/ /srid mtha'i bar du g.yar dam ma g.yel mdzod/ /ma ning gnyis med ma ning dregs pa'i sgedapon tshogs/ /sngar bcol log 'dren rdul du brlag pa bzhin/ /da bcol bsgrub rten mchod gtod 'di bzhes la/ /sde brgyad dmag sna dgra bo'i steng du drongs/ /phur srung dkar bdud phur skyong dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad/ /zab mo gter gyi srung ma mtha' dag gis/ /sngar bcol legs pa'i gtang rag phul ba bzhin/ /da bcol ma lus bsams pa bzhin du sgrubs/ /log tri drang srong dmod pa'i mthu yisasde brgyad rnams/ /gzugs can rang gshed babs ltar deng nas gzung / /rgol ngan tsho gos rnams ral mtshon rang nyid la/ /bsnun te rang khrag rang gis 'thung bar mdzod/ /tshe bdag log 'dren bla tshe srog gi bdag po sa /'jam dpal khros mar rnon po btab zin pa'i/ /rjes shul ming mthar byed la 'chi bdag dpung / /dgra bo'i yul du rings pa'i tshul gyis drongs/ /lang /sto bar srid gsum las (206na gyis grub na yang / /ched du dmigs bya bzlog bsad mnan pa'i gshed/ /babs smin rten 'brel bcu gnyis rang thog tu/ /log ste dug gsum nad kyis slar yang gzir/ /'chi bdag gi gang klu yi sdod pon chu srin khar/ /pha brgya bu stong dgra bgegs brdzangs pa rnams/ /bskal par mi ldang gsar skyes ma rungs tshogs/ /rim bdun sa gzhi'i 'og tu rgyas thob cig /bhe ral pa 'a dgu wa sa twa'i mche bas log 'dren snying / /phug nas khrag rlangs dron mo ma yal bar/ /btungs bas ma ngomasasha rus nang khrol rnams/ /chem chem za ba'i rkan sgra myur du rdabs/ /rtog gar gsur dud me rlung khrod —397

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()du 'phung byed dgra/stag chen spyon pas zos kyang nag po'i las//ma zad slar 'phel bsam ga sbyor rtsub can/kha khrag lcags khar nang du blug ste bzhes//mas 'a sdog lha bdun btsan rgod klu gnyan dregs pa can//sna tsho gis sbyor bas rgol ga 'phung ba bzhin//mtha' yas cho 'phrul gzer 'thibasamadze shu yis//ma rungs dgra bgegs tshogos kyi yul kun khong //sa 'og 'gas byed sa steng sa bla'i 'byung po kun//'dul bar zhal dgu so bzhi'i phyag gi tshogs//bcu drug zhabs dang mtshan ma gyen bsgreng ba//'jam dpal dpa' bos bdud sde'i dpung rnams cho mes//las skyon sngo bsangs rwa rtsesadagra bgegs gsang gnas nas//gtsug par thal mar phug pa'i rjes shul kun//206brdo rje'i zhags pas bcings te rim bdun 'og/gshin rje'i grong khyer wo por myur du khrid//phyag pa lag na pad+ma'i rnam 'phrul srin po'i gar/khyur mdzad mgon po lcam dral 'khor tsho gis la//sngar bcol dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i gtang rag dang //slad mar las bsgrub thugs rje bskul gsol 'debs//hā tu pu la gnod sbyin yal gam chen po'i rigs kyi sras//k+ṣe tra pā la'i gri gug rnon pos sngar//dam nyams mgo bo mang du bregs pa bzhin//da bcol las bsgrub bskul ba g.yel med mdzod//gur rnama'aphrul gaṇ+ḍi'i sgo las thon pa'i dmag/gnam sa gang bas dgra yul bachu mes pa ltar//mi bsrun rjesa'abrangs mtha' dag bla srog dang //phral te 'og min zhing du drongs shig kye//ga las ma sbyor ga 'chang dgra bgegs gzugs phung rnams//chem chem zos pa'i khrag rgyun 'khyil ba la//ma tshim mdung rnon dkar nag snying gi mtshams//phug ste mi rabs bdun brgyud rtsad nas da//yo dgra bo'i ro rkyang pu tra ming sring gis//mtshon gyis dum bur gtubs pa'i lhag ma rnams/khrag ral sprugs pas nang khrol sha rus kun//rul nas dmigs med dbyings su rgyas thob cig/beg tse/beg tse lcam dral bka' bzhin sgrol ging ches/khe sbyang zhon nas dgra yul dkrugs pa ltar//'o dod khu sgras bkang nas slad mar yang //log 'dren bla khug srog rtsa dmar po chod//207na tshe mgra 'dod dgu stsol ba'i gser mdog pad rwag tu//bsgyur nas gnod sbyin gdu/ ཿpa'i dmag tshogs kyis//mi bsrun cham la deng

sku gsung thugs rten gsang bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag gleg bam gsum pa/ 9)phob mthu rtsal skyed/ /da dung pha rol phru ma gzhom par mdzod/ /a po klu bdud dmu tsha li byin ha ra mched/ /'bar ba spun bdun btsan gyi sde dpon ches/ /dmigs yul rnams la rtags mtshan mngon sum du/ /bstan zin slar yang rgyun chad med par ston/ /khyabs ga zha 'khums rengs brgyal dug rlangs sngo dmar du/ /'thul bas dgra rnams mi rtag lam bkod ltar/ /da dung dmar zlum spyan gyis rab btsal nas/ /gzugs byang ming rus btab kun zhal du bzhes/ /ṣ+ka skyong rta nag rting dkar zhon nas phyogs mtshams kun/ /myul te dgra bo'i phung khams skye mched rnams/ /tshogs su rol la lan rer bltos min par / /ming gi lhag mar gyur par dgyes dgur spyod/ /bod dang bod chen yul lha gzhi bdag rnams/ /lha ngo nam mkha'i dbyings su mthor btegs pa/ /bla nas blar bskyed tshangs pa'i yul sa sa /reg pa'i dga' ston mchog la sbyor bar mdzod/ /drag po zhes pa lcags pho spre'u'i lo rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i mchod rdzas su gong dkar pa blo bzang bzod pa snya shal phul ba'i kha byang dgos tshul ltar bkod pa tshon las gru byu/ shar phyogs tsi na'i smin legs sor mo'i 'phrul/ /(207brko bang po'i gzhu ris thags su nyer btags pa/ /sna tshogs pañtsa li ga'i lda ldi'i phreng / /nyer gcig gis lhag sum brgya'i grangs tshang ba/ /rnam kun mchog ldan bde stong zung 'jug gis/ /stangs stabs bdud las mgo par rab rgyal ba'i/ /phan bde legs tshogos ma lusabashad pa dang / /nyer sgrub rig sngags 44 ba'i gling wo por/ /lho rgyud g.yor po sung ru'i yul phyogs nas/ /blo bzang bzod pa'i rnam dag bsam pa dang / /'bad rtsol gyis bskrun legs byas pha mtha'i tshad/ /mes pos ched du dgu tshigs sprul min nam/ /'dzad med dge ba kha ba'i rdul brtsegs nas/ /bsod nams tshogs chen nyal 'gro'i klung gi rgyun/ /bde skyid lhung lhung snyan po'i glu len bzhin/ /nges legs zla ba'i ma mar rtag 'bab shog /skye bar sgyud la gos pa'i sgrib gnyis kyi/ /tsha gdung brnag dka' bskal pa'i zhugs kyi ngad/ /gzhil byed chos dkar ma la ya yi rlung / /tsan+dan dri bsung 'dren la rtag 'grus shog /ma dag nyon mongs sna lnga'i lcags kyi khams/ /smin byed rtsi yis —37

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2)phung po rnam pa lnga//ye shes 'od lnga'i gser bsgyur rigs kun gyi//khyab bdag bcu gsum rdo rje'i sabarnyes shog/de ma thob kyi gnas skabs mtha' dag tu//mi khom gnas brgyad dang bral lha mi'i rten//gshin po'i zhing sar tshe ring nad med cing //phun tsho gos dpal 'byor myu gu bskyed bsring shog/pha mas20sa po tso byas dmigs yul bye brag dang //spyi khyab rgyud lnga'i 'gro ba ma lus pa//ma' mtho nges legs them skas la 'dzegs nas//byang chub mchog gi khang par 'jug ched bsngo//rtsa brgyud bla ma'i thugs rje chu 'dzin 'khrigs//yi dam zhi khro'i byin rlabs dbyar rnga ldir//mkha' 'gro chos srung 'phrin las char chen pos//sa steng kun tu khyab pa'i bkra shis shog/lcags spre ser shog pa blo bzang dpal 'byor gyis ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung dus dar r+sā sna lnga'i snyan shal khyon bsdom brgya dang don lnga phul phyo kha byang dgos tshul ltar bkod g.ye shes gur ri//brgya phrag zla zhun khu bas nyer byugs pa//gangasakyi ri bo'i khengs log du kū la//rnam par rgyal ba'i phan dang bde legs gter//'byung gnasasmin grol bshad sgrub gling chen por//lha ldan blo bzang dpal 'byor gyis phul mthus//gti mug dag pa'i gzugs phung me long gi/ye shes chen por bsgyur te gnas skabs su//nad gdon bar chad thams cad zhi bar shog/'dzam bu chu bo'i gser gyi mdangs bkrag la//nyi ma'i 'od kyis gsal 'dra'i lha rdzas gos//rnam par rgyal ba'i phan dang bde legs gter//'byung gnas smin grol bshad sgrub gling chen por//lha ldan blo bzang dpal 'byor gyis phul mthus//ser sna dag pa'i tshor phung mnyam nyid kyi//ye shes chen por bsgyur te gnas skabs su//tshe dang bsod nams mnga' thang rgyasapar shog/'char rka'i mtshams sprin mdangs kyi cha tsam du//bskrun par nus min 'jam mnyen reg bya can//208bsgom par rgyal ba'i phan dang bde legs gter//'byung gnas smin grol bshad sgrub gling chen por//lha ldan blo bzang dpal 'byor gyis phul mthus//'dod chags dag pa'i 'du shes sor rtog gi/ye shes chen por bsgyur te gnas skabs su//srid zhi'i yon tan thams cad dbang 'dus shog/stang zil an+da rnyil gyi mdog 'tsher ༷0//gtum drag dpa' po'i chas su 'os pa'i dar//

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 6) rnam par rgyal ba'i phan dang bde legs gter//'byung gnas smin grol bshad sgrub gling chen por//lha ldan blo bzang dpal 'byor gyis phul mthus//zhe sdang dag pa'i rnam shes cho sedabyings kyi//ye shes chen por bsgyur te gnas skabs su//nag po'i rtsa lag thal bar brlag par mdzod//sna tshogasari mo'i rgu'i bde skyid rgyas//mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus thar pa dang //rnam mkhyen ye shes ma' du 'gyur bar shog/yon sbyor rnams kyi nad gdon bar gcod zhi//tshe ring dpal 'byor chos srid legs tshogos dus209nabla ma yi dam srung mar mchod pa'i sprin phung spro bar mkho ched du cha gar bla ma'i dpon po dge slong can la dgos tshul mngags pa'i tshe kha byang du 7kho por bde'i rnye44hu/ /dkon mchog rin chen gsum mchod byin rlabs kyis/ /zhwa ser cod pan 'chang ba'i chos srid bstan//ga rgya har bod so gos 'dzas gling skye rgya yi//bsod nams zhing du bskalapar 'phel rgyas shog/ma rig gnyid sangs rnam dpyod rgyas pa'i lhas//dga' ba'i dpal ldan pho brang chos srid kyis//rgya mtsho'i gos can khyab phyir sku tshe dang //mnga' thang srung ma'i tsho gis kyisa'aphel bar mdzod//mang bkur 'jam dbyangs gong ma'i bka' khrims kyi//gser shing 'dzam gling skye rgu'i gnya' ba mā/lci bas bde skyid rdzogs ldan ji bzhin du//spyod par gnam gyi she mong mthus40

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ smyona'agrub shog/lcags sbre sto zla ༅ snyag pa'i nang du rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa spyi sos chos skyong spyi la sa bdun gyi ring skang bshags ba ba'i tshe chos srung rnams la snya shal kha byang dgos tshul ltar bkod pa mchog a 'dod dgu'i dpal ster//bla gsang bo zhi khro se rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i lha tsho gis kun//gang gi gsang ba gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du//yongs sa d+ma thod phreng rdo rje lang //ma smad nge wo pos deng rjes tshong //dra' rtsal steng 'og bar gyi gdon bgegs gar+sā po sa/rdo rje srin po'i sku rbod gtong dang //rigs 'dzin mchod bstod drag sngags nyer 'dus pa//rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor r+ṣa pos dngos grub stsol//tshe bdag kun bzang 'jam zhing zhi ba'i chos sku'i gdangs//gtum drag rngams pa'i gad brgyangs 'jig rten gsum//yongs 'dar phyag rgyas 'khor 'das ma lus pa//zil gnon tshe bdag nag pos bdud dpung choms//phur pa mchog thun dngos grub bsgrub la bar gcod pa//'byung pho brag ri phur pa'i thog mda' yis//phyer 'thag rdo rje gzhen nu'i nyi 'od kyis//bgegs tshogosadamag rum sdug po pha mthar skrod//lang /'jam dpal sprul pa'i sto bar khams gsum gyi//skye 'gro ma lus shong ba'i snod yangs can//'chi bdag 'char ka nag po'i zhal nang du//dgra bgegasagazugs phung bla srog kha raṃ khā hi/gi dang /khyu ru'i lhun po dus mtha'i me yi gos//rgyan pas bsgrun min gshin rje ki dang gis//logs par 'khu ba'i gzugs can gzugs med rnams//rim bdun sa gzhi'i 'og tu bskal par gnon//log tri gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin drang srong dri ma med//zhe sa rdo rje'i phyag mthil brag ri'i bar//gnod byed sdo brgyad dam sri rbod gtong sogs//phyer btags 210narjes med thal ba rlung la skur//'ag byed gdul dka' 'dul ba'i gawo por ma he'i zhal//bai ḍūrla 'dra'i rwa sngon srid pa'i rtser//gdengs nas khro ༷/ lis kun 'jigs mdzad pa//'jam pa'i rdo

sku gsung thugs rten gsar ba tshe ngas dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag gleg bam gsum pa/ 'darje'i mthu stobs nus dpung bskyed//gdul bya'i spyan ras gzigs snang ngor dkar dmar sku mdog mdangs //'char yang skye rgur rjes chags 'jigs rten dbang //'khor ba'i 'gro kun chos kyi dbyings chen por//sgrol ba'i thugs rje rigs drug yongs khyab mdzod/khyim yi ma lha chen nyi bu'i lag gi be con kyang //mtshan tsam rna bar thos pa'i mod nyid la//'chor mdzad bcom ldan gtsug tor rnam par rgyal//lha dgus 'chi med zil dngar char du phob/rnam ma glogasang sngags rig sngags gsangasasngags nus pa'i mthus//ma 'grub 'grub cing chud mi za ba yi//byin rlabs gzhan las khyad zhugasardo rje 'dzin/snyam par 'joms pas nyes tshogs dri rnams khrus//phyag drug shar lho tsas rkang gcig sdong po na//gar dgu'i nyams kyis rol kyang sgrub ba po'i//skyabs byon byin rlabs myur du 'jug mdzad pa//phyag drug lcam dral rnam bzhi'i las mdzod cig las gshin//bdud kyi zhags pas dgra bo'i yan lag rke//bcings nas thod dbyug 'bar bas klad pa'i rgya//tshal bar 'gems mdzad lasakyi gshin rje yis//210ba khrib bstan rin chen nyin mtshan dus drug srungs//rnam gras gdong lnga'i dbang po'i steng na gser zhun mdangs//brgya phrag nyi mas lkod pa'i gzi byin 'phro//rnam mang thosasras zhal dang ne'u le yi//kha nas 'dod dgu'i yid bzhin gru char snyil//dam gzor ma rlud nag 'tshub ma'i dbus na drel rta la//zhon pa 'dod khams bdag mo re ma twe//srid gsum dbang sdus gnod byed dgra bgegs sgrol//nad gdon rab zhi tshe dpal lung rtogs spel//gur thub bstan srung ma yongs kyi sdod pon du//'khor ༄ rgyal rdo rje gur gyi mgon//dpal ldan lha mo kun yum ral gcig ma//'khor dang cas sa 'dod pa'i don rnams sgrubs//sa tshad med rnam bzhi'i zhal gdangs mche ba'i bar//dgra bgegs chem chem zos pa'i khrag dron gyi//dbu ba'i do shal yongasa'akhrigs stobs 'phrog nag/yum bzhi dregs pa'i dmag gis mi bsrun sgrol//las mgon bram ze'i dmod 'bras khams gsum skye rgu'i srog/za bar smin pa gnod sbyin yab yum dang //gshin rje pu tra bha dra sring mo yis//khrag gi ral pa dgra bo'i steng du skrugs//lcam sring sgrol gying gnod sbyin beg tse 40

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)lcam dral dang / /las mkhan bshan pa'i dmag gi dpung chen pos/ /bsam ga sbyor rtsub 'chang ba'i dgra bgegs kyi/ /snying don phyungs (211na 'a khong khrag zhal du rngubs/ /tshong pho rgyud mo rgyud gnyisasu med pa yi/ /drag rtsal mthu yis bzlog pas mi bzlog pa/ /sngags bzlog mkhan po'i gshed gyur ma ning nag /log 'dren gdug pa'i tshogs rnams rdul du rlog /stag wo gsur chen dud sprin 'khrugs pa'i klong dkyil na/ /mon nag stag r+sā smo pa'i mas bo che/ /dgra snying dron mo lcags khar nang blug nas/ /gnam sar cher gdangs zhal du khung kyis drongs/ /byang ga kho srung ma lha brag zab mo'i gter gyi bdag po che/ /dpal ldan sngags srung e ka dzā ṭi sogs/ /pho rgyud mo rgyud dam can ma lus pas/ /mthun rkyen legs tsho gis spel ba'i 'phrin las sgrubs/ /thang lha bod skyong rtsad po'i sku lha tshangs pa'i rigs/ /zur phud lnga pa sprul yum mched 'khor gyis/ /zhi rgyas dbang gi don rnams bsgrub pa dang / /rgyal 'gong dam sri'i srog rtsa dmar po chod/ /khyab khug phyogs mtshams kun tu sdo brgyad bsdonges zla dang / /lhan cig rgyu ba'i dug rlangs dgra yul du/ /bskyal nas log 'dren 'jig rten pha rol gyi/ /ltad mor thong zhig khyab 'jug rā hu la/ /yo po gsang bdag dbang chen pad+ma kā ra yis/ /dam btags dgra lha khyung chen klu 'brug 'dul/ /sku lnga blon po gsang yum 'khor bcas kyis/ / bsams pa'i re ba ma lus skong bar mdzod/ /dgra lha (211ba)gnas sa skyes gcig mdzes byed pad+ma skyes/ /blon po rdo rje grags ldan mthu rtsal can/ /yang dgon gnas chung rgyal po chen po yis/ /thugs dam stong zhing nyams chags gso bar mdzod/ /gomar ba li sras lor pa sgron lam lo ge pa'i mthus/ /khrag gi sgo nga las skyes tsi dmar ba/ /rol pa skya bdun btsan 'khor sum brgya dang / /drug cu'i dmag tshogasadagra bo'i yul du drongs/ /rdor legs ba 'a skya the'u rang yongs kyi sdod pon che/ /g.yar dam nam yang mi g.yel dam tshig can/ /rdo rje legs pa yum bcas mched dang 'khor/ /sum brgya drug cus bcol ba'i wen las mdzod/ /wo skyong bam ro pho mo'i las mkhan sngon rgyug cing / /rta mchog smo nasaphyogs kun rab myul ba/ /bdud mgon seng ge'i gdong can yab yum gyis/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i dar —404

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 6)chen srid rtser sgrengs//lhan ma bsil ldan ru bzhi'i yul khams legs skyong ba//bdud mo gnod sbyin sman mo bcu gnyis mchod//bstan ma'i tsho gos kyis nad rims sad ser dang //btsa' than mu ge g.yul 'khrug zhi bar mdzod//sdod pon sngags 'chang khrag 'thung rol pa'i nga rgyal gyis//ma' spyod g.yul du rab zhugs dmag gi sna//'dren pa'i sde dpon sum cu'i tshogs rnams kyis//drag sbyor gnam lcags thog gi mda' wo phongs//phur srung bcu gnyis dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad//dkar mo nyi zla bdud rgyal thod 212na ) pa'i 'phreng //'khor dang bcas pas na las he ru gaḥ/bsgrub la bar du gcod pa zhi bar mdzod//ral pa 'a dgu skye 'gro khram la yongs 'debs srid pa'i grong //ma gshin dregs tsho gos bo klong 'khrugs nang dbus//las gshin bhe wa sa twa log 'dren dgra'i//bdud bzhi slong la tshe yi 'du byed bkums//nge sdog lha btsan bdud klu mas chen sdebazhi po//pad 'byung gnubs chen sprul sku zhang khrom gyi//spyan sngar g.yar dam gnyan po khas blangs bzhin//rig 'dzin sgrub po rnams kyi stong grogs mdzod//klu yi gas srung spyi dang sto zog sde dpon 'dzin pa lag mang sogs//gnas dang yul grong ri dang nags tshal kun//skyong ba'i gzhi bdag gter srung mtha' klas pas//bkra shis bde legs chen pos khyab par mdzod//dmu stag gro lod steng na 'chol ba'i khro rgyal che//rdo rje phur pa'i mar+sā rnon gdengs pa'i mod//rgyal bsen dam sri ma lus me dpung la//rtsasbur bsregs pa lta bur rdul du rlog/snyigs yang ga4 dus bdud bzhi langs bas dgra bgegs kyi//log spyod bco lnga'i cha shas gang ba'i rgyu//po glu drag po srid gsum rnam rgyal zhal//gdangs nas skad cig nyid la khyur mid thong //gon med 'khor sa yongs kyi tshe yi bdud rtsi'i bcud//bsdus te 'chi med srog gi ka ba yis//bskal brgyar a lha mi 'gyur rab brtan mthus//212ba〉tshen rje'i me long ngal gso'i gnas su mdzod//dregs〈mas dus dgra bor 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i mar//gdengasal sdo brgyad rbod gtong rig sngags tshogs//cig car 'dzoms mdzad gshin rje'i gshed po yis//srung bzlog bsad mnan tshon las kun sgrub maX//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()lcags sbre gnas chud lcog tu spyan gzigs mchod gtor sku mas dang bcas phan bde legs bshad gling pa spyi tsho gis nas ga bsagasol gyi tshe snyad ra kha byang dgos tshul ltar god pa ga shel 'od 'phro//dgra lha skyes gcig gsung gi rgyal po che//mdzes byed pad+ma bde skyid gsang ba'i yum//rdo rje grags ldan las mkhan mthu rtsal can//bka' nyan rgya mtsho'i tsho gis kyi spyan snga mā/gtor ma'i ri bo khrag chang btung ba'i mtsho//dngos bshamasayid sprul spyan gzigs dang bcas te//nyes byas kun bshags thugs dam legs skong ba'i//'phrin las snyan po dbyangs su gyer byed na//bdag cag dpon slob mi nor dgon gnas kyi//'gal rkyen bar chad ma lus zhi ba dang //tshe dpal bsod nams lung rtogs yon to sogs//'bad med lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//nyams chags sdig sgrib des bskyed nad gdon mun//dgra lha'i dbang po'i mas stobs rta ljang can//'phrin las brgya phrag snang bas mthar byas nas//rab 'byamasazhi ba'i don kun sgrub par mdzod//bskal par 'tsho ba'i tshe ring rnam grol bu'i//'byor bar 'gran pa'i srid kyi 213na ji ge legs dang //chabs cig lung rtogs yon tan ma lus pa//gong spel rgyasapa'i don kun sgrub par mdzod//srid zhi'i brtan pa thams cad rab logs nas//'khor 'dasayongs kyi phun tsho gis mtha' klas rnams//'bad rtsol med par ngang sa 'du ba yi//bgrang yasadabang gis don kun sgrub par mdzod//bsam ga sbyor rtsub 'amang ba dgra bgegs kyi//rtsa lag sdodapung rdul phran ltar brlag ste//rjes shul rlung la bskur nas ming tsam yang //grags na mngon spyod don kun sgrub par mdzod//lcags spre hor zla bsto par chos 'khor rgyal du de wī ko ṭir bskang ba 'bum/gur zhal beg tse dang mthil mgon khang gi phyag drug pa las gshin rnam gra rnams la stong rtsa/de smi gyi chos skyong rā brgya rtsags sa pa'i snya shal kha byang rtsa smin ljon pa//mthil gyi mgon go /lha yig gur kum mdangs las khro bo'i gzugs/shar bas bdud bzhi'i snying 'byin ma lha'i zhal//las gshin myur mdzad lcam dral rnam thos sras//dmag zor rgyal mo legs ldan gdong bzhi pa//beg tse lcam sring rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong /glu// 'gyur lhun grub gtsug lag chos 'khor rgyal//

sku gsung thug rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 6)bsrung mdzad bka' sdod rgya mtsho'i tsho gos rnams kyi//thugs dam gar+sā po dbyings su skong byed na//bdag sogs mi nor srid sder bcas pa la//than ltas byad rbod mi mthun kun zhi zhing //mos bzhi dbang sdud gnod byed sgo gcod cing //'jigs brgyad mthar byas lhor drug rgyas par mdzod//srid gsum 213brki wī koṭi bdag mo gdong can bdud bzhi'i lha//bstan ma bas gnyis jo bo rgyal mtshan par//nyes kun bshags shing thugs dam skong ba yi//dgyes bskyed 'phrin las 'bum phrag gyer byed na//than ltas mthu byad dbul phongs zhabrugs rtsod dang //nad rims dus kyi chad pa yongasazhi nas/khyu sbyor 'khor bcas tshe dpal bsod nams sogs//mnga' thang yar ro'i zla ltar 'phel bar mdzod//chos tshang steng bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kun//mchod bshags bskang bas dgyes pa bskyed pa'i mthus//yid grubs sde bcas g.yul ngo pham byas te//dkar phyogs rgyal mtshan srid pa'i rtse mor phyor//khyad par sgrol gying beg tse lcam sring dang //gnod sbyin bshan pa dmar po rā hu la//sprul pa'i chos rgyal rdo rje legs pa yis//las bzhi bsgrubs nas 'dzum zhal zla ltar ston//bsil po tshes gur mgon lcam dral pho nya rnam pa lnga//drag po gzi ldan dbang phyug 'khor bcasal//mthun pa'i rdzas rnams bshams te mchod bshags dang //dam skong bstod cing 'dod don zhu byed na//sngon las 'phral gyi rkyen byas mi mthun phyogs//sgo gsum zug rngu 'byin pa'i nyes tshogis rnams//rab zhi bde ba'i tshor ba dus kun tu//rtag tu myong ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod//sa po stogagatsug lag skyong bar pad+mā kā ra yis//bka' bsgos li byin hā ra mched lnga po//gsang yum sprul pa blon po 'khor tshogs214na ) kyis//nyin mtshan kun tu g.yel med mel tshe mdzod//klu gtsug na rin chen gnas pa'i chu mig la//'dzugs rgyu'i dar lcog 'phreng ba klu yi rgyal//'khor dang bcasapas dus su char 'bebs shing //lo tog sbrum zhing yams nad zhi ba sogs//yid la re ba'i bsam dgu grub par mdzod//rta rgod shel lcag gi ga'i 0ldogs rgyu//mas rtsal nus stobs ldan par gnod sbyin che//rta rgod shel lcag las byed pho nya'i tshogs/40//yel ba med par dkar mo ljongs kyi gnas//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ smyonabasrung zhing bskyab pa'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol//lcags spre zla chos la gnas chos rgyal mu por a shalakhabyang gos tshi sa dkar 'go pa rdo rje skyabs kyis nga spu༅khyo bkod pa chos srid rab rgyas//sangs rgyas kun 'dus pad+ma kā ra yi//spyan sngar bstan 'gro skyong ba'i g.yar dam can//pe gar rgyal po dgra lha skyes gcig pu//gsang ba'i yum gcig mdzes byed pad+ma skyes//blon po rdo rje grags ldan sprul pa dang //yang sprul bka' sdod pho nya kiṅka ra//gnam sa bar snang gang ba'i 'khor tsho gis la//dngos bshams yid sprul mchod pas mnyes byed na//bdag sogs mi nor 'bangs srid sder yos kyi//nad gdon bar gcod nyer 'tshe kun zhi zhing //tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor longs spyod sogs//chos srid don rnams rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//lcags spre hor zla bcaganyis par sri gcod 'bum pa bskor bar dzi 4bto sang rgyas rgya mtsho bteg skabs gung thang mar khang du snyan shal phul ba'i kha byang skye tso ngal gso//gung thang gi thung 'a mtshan dpe'i gzi 'bar gser gyi mdog can phyag/'khor lo'i ri mo lhar bcas skye rgu yi//gtsug tu khyod zhal srid zhi'i 'jigs pa las//dbugs dbyung phan bder sbyor zhig zas gtsang sras//༈gi nang du brtul zhugs spyod pa'i zlos gar gyis//bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal kyang gdul bya'i ngor//ngur sgrig gos mnabs zhang ston brtson 'grus grags//g.yu brag 'gro ba yongs kyi mgon des skyongs//chos kyi dbyings su rang grol mi dbying rang grol gyi dngul gdung kun tu bzang //zhing 'dir dpal ldan lung rtogs lor ba yi//'phrin las rab rgyas rje btsun bla ma mchog/khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpas deng byin rlobs//phyags pa phyi nang gsang ba'i bya rog gdong pa'i mtshan//nyer 'chang ma mgon dbang phyug phyag bzhi pa//yab yum bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho yis//'gal rkyen kun sol 'phrin las lhun 'grub mdzod//mthurtsal lta mo lcag phur ma mnga' bdag dpal ldan re ma ti//bkaṣa nyan kiṅka ra yi tsho gis bcas kyis//nad rims g.yul zhabrug dus kyi ho pa rnams//rab zhi mas rkyen legs tshogis 'phel bar mdzod//mang da' yo kha dpag par dka' pa'i mthu stobasaXphrul can/khregs pa'i sdod pon byu po pe ha ra//

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ tanasprul pa gsang yum blon po las byed kyis//dbang drag zhi rgyas las215na〉kyin sgrub par mdzod//blo ga zhes pa lcag mo bya'i gnam lo thog mar tshes pa'i 'dod khams dbang phyug dmag zor rgyal mo la snyan shal phul ba'i kha byang yid kyi 'dod lo//zla dkar bzhin chu sgros u t+pal dmar po'i 'dab//'dzum dbus tshems dkar ze'u 'bru dngom pa dang //lhan cig mgrin pa'i rgyud las rab drangs glu//snyan po rna ba'i rgyud du ster byed ma//'jam mnyen sor mos yongs bteg shel bum dang //mtho ris chu bos gtams nas nyer babs pas//mi mthun nyes brgya'i dri ma kun bkrus te//bde skyid gsar pa'i lang tsho dar drag mdzod//ser 'bum phrag nyi mas 'byud pa gser gyi ri'i//snyems 'phrog phra ldem nu 'bur rked skabasamatho//gnag snum lcang lo'i thor tshugs g.yo bzhin du//khams gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i gar mkhan ma//rgyu chu bo'i sa zla'i yol go'i nang //phun tshogs nor bus phyur bur gtams pa yis tshe dpal bsod nams mnga' dbang lung rtogs sogs//srid zhi'i yon to thams cad rgyas par mdzod//dmar chags nyams gdung ba'i drod kyis zhal khyim mdangs//pad+ma rā ga'i rjes 'gro mig gi dkyus//ring pos dgra bcom bsam gtan las slong ba//na chung smin ma'i 'khri shing g.yo byed ma//sa 'og sasteng sa bla'i 'jig rten kun//u t+pal dmar po'i zhags pas yongs bcings nas//lcags kyusa'akhor 'das legs tshogs mtha' klas pa'i//bstan pa rang dbang med par bsdu bar mdzod//sngo stong 215bsko sum rab za'i zhal gdangs mche ba'i sprin//ljags kyi glog phreng 'khyug dbusang ro'i sgra//dbyar gyi rnga gsang yongs ldir srin mo'i gzugs//mthong bas log 'dren snying rtsa 'dar byed ma//sho rdel khram shing byad dmar dkyus ring du//dgra bgegs kun btab mtshon dru nad rlangs kyis//thal ba'i rdul phran lta bur brlag mdzad pa//mngon spyod 'phrin las ma lus sgrub par mdzod//ljang me rlung 'tshub ma'i gur khyim phub pa'i nang //khrag zhag rgya mtsho'i rba slong rab zhabrug steng //rkyang ser drel rta la bcibs 'dod khams kyi//gtso mo dmag zor lha khyod nges don du//rgyal kun yum gcig ngag dbang dbyangs༅ ma//dbyings phyug rdo rje ༷༷na mo'i e dbyibs nang //waṃ yig 'jam dpal

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()dmar po'i gshed skor gyi/khyud sde'i gsang mdzod yongs kyi sgo 'byed mkhan//sna tshogs gdul bya'i 'gro ngor zhi rgyas dang //dbang drag las sgrub sku yi rnam 'gyur grangs//'bum phrag rdzing bur zla ba'i gzugs brnyan bzhin/shar yang rang rig don gyi lha mor nges//ltas ga keg sri chags che nyam nga sogs//nag po'i lhongs kun dpag dka'i rdzu phrul gyis//tshar bcad 'jig rten khams 'dir sum rtsen gyi//skye rgu'i bsod nams mnyam por longs spyod cing //sdebazhi'i dga' ston ldan pa rgyal po'i khab//chos srid zung 'jug 'phrin las 'khor lo yis//yangs pa'i nor 'dzin khyon kun yongasakhyab nas//phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//216na tshe gas bya hor zla dang por mdos gang tsom zer ga mis pa'i tshe snya dar gyi kha byang bsam pa'i re skong //dkar ma smad thugs rje 'bum phrag zla ba'i zer/khyab pas dus min 'chi dang nad gdon bgegs//mi mthun nyes brgya'i smag rus ma lus pa/khog car sel ba'i zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//sgo pa chu bo'i bum bzang las 'ongs pa//'chi gsos bdud rtsis gtams pa'i 'gyur med kyi/khrog gi ka ba mi yo nyer tshugs pa//rgyas pa'i 'phrin las lhun gyis grub par mdzod//dmar brgyu dang mi brgyu'i 'gro yid brtan pa rnams//'phrog dang lhan cig phun tsho gis yon to kun//'bad dang rtsol bar stosamin rang shugs kyis//dbang gi 'phrin las mtha' dag 'grub par mdzod//sngob rnag pa'i bsam sbyor 'chang ba'i dgra bgegs kyi//mas stobs nus pa rdzu phrul phyer btags nas//don snying khrag dron bcos te rnam par shes//mi bskyod zhing skyel drag po'i phren las mdzod//ljang dngos bshamasayid sprul mdos mchode 'bum phrag gis//srid gsum dbang mo'i thugs dam nyer bkang mthus//spyi dang khyad par kha ba'i sman ljongs 'dir//nad rims dbul phongs la ba rtsod zhi bar mdzod//rigs 'dzin bdag sogs dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi//chos dang srid kyi don kun rab 'grub cing //sangs rgyas bstan pa rgya mtsho bla nas blar//'degs pa'i sa dbang tshangs pa'i skrun zlar mdzod//yid bzhi dbang rgyal yongs2 sab rtoXdang //216ba tham bzang 'dod 'jo ma rmos

sku gsung thug rten gsar bzhengs dang mgo rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag gleg spo gsum pa/ thonalo tog ltar//legs tshogos char chen 'bebs par dus gsum gyi//rgyal kun yum gcig mthu dpung skyed du gsol// lcag bya lo chos 'khor steng sku skye rab stims pa lhan lon rgya mtsho la sgro skur cher 0 skabs 'dir gsal chos skyong so sor bden shan khed par gsol ba'i snyan dar zhal byang gos tso ltar bkod pa smag sto sgron me/sku skye bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho tshangs spyod las//nyams nas rku thabs gnas na sku skye dang //kun slong ga pas g.yo 'phrul rdzun rigs kyis//thog mar bsgrags mkhan gnyis po'i gzu dbang du//rdo rje 'jigs byed chos kyi rgyal po yi//ye shes spyan gyi dkar nag bden shan phye//bden med gang yin de la lo gcig tshun//gan wo pe kar rgyal po blon bams kyi//pad+ma dang ོ gying lnga gza' gdong gi/leg ldan nag po nga sto 'khor sa kyi//rgyal po mu po ba yi spras༅ gyi/khrid gsum dbang sgyur dmag zor rgyal mo yi/zhes ga rkang tsog po skur//lus srog tshe la rtags mtshan myur ston mdzod//lcag bya nag pa zla ba'i brgyad gtor chen mo'i dus chos srung rnams la snyan shal phul ba'i kha byang gnas gsum mkha' 'gro rgyang 'bod/ser mthu stobs mi bzad gser gyi 'khor lo yis//ma hā kā la yongs kyi gling bzhi la//dbang sgyur rdo rje srin po gur mgon dang //lcam dral ral gcig ma yis las kun mdzod//dkar bde chen 'khor lor man shel mdangs ldan sku//zhi khro'i nyams las 'phros 217na ) pa'i 'od dkar dang //bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis nyes tshogs smag rum kun//bsal nas 'chi med mchog sbyin deng 'dir stsol//dmar longs spyod 'khor lo'i dbus na khro chags gar//yongs bsgyur thugs rje'i lcags kyusasrid dang zhi'i//legs tshogos ma lus khab len rdo ba yis//lcags rdul ji bzhin dbang du bsdu bar mdzod//mthing khyachos kyi 'khor lor gtum drag rngam pa'i sku//mthu stobs ha la nag pos khamasagasum na//nyer gnas dgra bgegs srog rtsa dmar 'byin du//bto nas mi bskyod rgyal ba'i zhing du drongs//ser sho sprul pa'i 'khor lor gzi byin nyi ma'i lus//brgya phrag yongs brgal phyag mtshan ka pā lar/khyur bur rab gtos yid bzhi nor / las//'khor 'das yon to bdag rgyud gang bar

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()mdzod//ljang rin ོ rus rgyan dar gyi smad dkris can//snyan brdzid mi rkang gling bu'i sgra dbyangasakyis//gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'bod byed pa//bran dang grogs su ston pa'i bram ze che//rang byung rdo rje lus kyi grong khyer du//rtsa khams rlung gi dngas ma zhing skyong skur/shar ba'i skyo ti'i mdud 'grol tshe gcig la//zung 'jug lam du 'khrid pa'i sa mkhan mchog khyud gsum dregs pa mtha' dag rang gi sems//gsal stong bde chen klong du legs 'char ba//gdod nas yongs dag khyab bdag he ru kāḥ/gdul dka' 'dul la lha chen stobs 217ba tshe stso1ga che//rdo rje 'chang sogasabargyud pa'i bla ma'i tshogs//khyad par blo gros rgyal mtshan yab sras nas/khrin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam gsum gyi//bka' dang dam tshig gnyen po nyer dgongs la//dbang drag zhi dang rgyas pa'i 'phrin lasakun//yid la gang bsams ji bzhin lhun grub par//tsa tu rmu kha yum chen rnam pa bzhi//dam can rgya mtshos mthu stobs dpung skyed cig/lcam sring gnod sbyin lcam dral bka' sdod sgrol gying rnams//gnalog 'dren 'tshol phyir stong gsum khu sgra yis//bkang nas zhags pas ske bcings mdung rnon gyis//phug pa'i khrag rgyun zhal du hub sgras drongs//lcags mo bya lo rab 'byam pa bstan 'dzan rgya mtshos gsang phur mang ja'i thog snyan shal kha byang dgos tshul ltar bkod pa yid kya re skong /di paṃ kā rā'i yi dam 'phags ma'i sku//rngog ston legs pa'i shes rab rten skal du//nyer thob mi mthun 'thab rtsod las rgyal ba//sangs rgyas kun yum 'dus pa'i ngo bo yis//gangs can phan bde'i rtsa lag thub bstan spyi//bye brag dpal ldan gsang phu ne'u thog/khyad par stag tshang ra ba stod pa yi//chos spyod rnam bcu srid mthar rgyas par shog/lha rdzas 'jam mnyen reg bya legasadabul 218na tha'i//rab stims smra ba bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho yi//chos dang srid kyi bsams don ma lus pa//'bad med lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis zlo mes//dkon mchog yongs 'dus mdo rgyud dam chos rnams//phyogs bcur 'phel mdzad 'jam mgon bla ma yis//tshe rabs kun tu dge ba'i bshes mdzad nas//nges par legs pa'i sal ༷/da du gsol//rab dmar rgyal chen brtse yi khrab

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag gleg bam gsum pa/ 'dacan gyis/ /rab 'byams bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i rnam dkar don/ /rab yangs mkha' la nyi shar ji bzhin du/ /rab gsal phan bde'i snang bas khyab par mdzod/ /lcags bya sag zla ba'i dus 'a gyi nyin gsol dpon dpal grong sngags rams pa'i pha'i don du jo shāka thugs rje chen po/byams pa/ rje btsun btsong kha pa/'phags pa lo ke shwa ra rnams la snyan dar phul ba'i kha byang bde chen sang sbyor/ shwakya mu ni mtha' med rgyud lnga'i lam gyi 'phrang ring por/ /dkar nag las kyi grogs pos nyer khrid nas/ /blo gros bstan 'dzin bde sdug bar ma'i gar/ /bsgyur la don kun grub kye spyan gyis gzigs/ /bzod dka' zug jus mnar ba ga song gsum/ /'jur dang 'du byed kyis khyab lha mi'i rten/ khred pa'i mtsho las thugasarje'i gru bo ches/ /bsgral nas nges legs gling du bgrod par shog /kun tu bzang po'i smon lam khri phrag tu/ /nyer btab don ltar bde ba can zhing du/ /pad+ma'i sbubs skyes 'od dpag med kyi zhal/ /mthong nas(218ba)rgyal ba'i sras su 'gyur bar shog /bas khog dzigo sngon bsags las nye zhe 'thug po'i mun 'thibs pa/ /gnas ngan khung bur 'o dod phud sgra can/ /mi bzad nyam nga'i gzugs 'khyil lus rten du/ /blo gros bstan 'dzin ma nges 'gyur srid na/ /'jam mnyen phyag gi mthil nas gsal ba'i spyan/ /stong phrag dus las yol ba med gzigs la/ /lho phyogs gru 'dzin gzhal yas khang chen por/ /myur du drangs te phan bde la sbyor mdzod/ /byams pa gang gi dam bca'i gzungs sngags kha ton dang / /rna bar thos so cog rnamasang na song las/ /'dren par ma pham mgon pos zhal 'tshes pa/ /nam yang mi bslu bden pa'i tshig yin phyir/ /blo gros bstan 'dzin khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnas/ /gang du du khas mnar yang 'od dkar sbubs/ /brgyud de yid dga' chos 'dzin gnas mchog tu/ /skyes nas theg chen byang chub sems bskyed shog /long kha pa ngo mtshar med byung bkod legs dag zhing du/ /rgyal ba seng ge'i nga ror sangs rgyas pa'i/ /'khor du blo gros bstan 'dzin yongs gyur nas/ /brtse ldan thugs rje chen pos rjes 'dzin shog /mtha' bral stong nyid lta dang gsang sngags kyi/ /bskyed rdzogs zung du 'jug par nyams blangs pas/ /ring por mi thogs bgragasum rdo rje yis/ /brnyes—413

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()nas rigs kun bdag por 'gyur bar shog/lo )shwa ra chom 'phags ma ga thugs rje'i 'jug pa dusababs te//rgya bal 219nasgo tshams kyi nag klung stug po'i khrod//ha ri tsan+dan sdong por rang byon sku//mthong thos dran pas rnam grol 'jig rten dbang //byin chas nam yang mi zad ṛ kho'i 'od//blo gros bstan 'dzin nyal 'gror yongs 'phags pas//sdig sgrib nyes lhung dug zhi 'di phyi dang //gtan mdun yan lag brgyad dang ldan par shogablo ga zhes pa lcags bya gro bzhin zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi stong pa dang po'i tshe rigs kun khyab bdag rin chen bsod namasamachog grub bstan pa'i rgyal mas dpal bzang po dag pa'i zhing du sku'i bkod pa bsdus skab sku gdung rin po cher snyan shal phul ༅ kha byang mkha spyod lamasang //bgrang yas rten dang brten pa spro bsdu yi//byed por dpal ldan bla ma rigs kun bdag/dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor la//gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha tshogasayongs rdzogs pa//srid gzhi'i 'dod 'jo rin r+ṣa dbang gi rgyal//ljongs 'di'i bsod nams zhing sar mkhas btsun bzang //mchog tu grub pa'i snye ma g.yur za'i mthar//skal ga grang reg dus kyi sngon 'gro'i sgor//mgon khyod sbyangs gzhi'i gzugs sku nyer bsdus nas//spros bral chos dbyingasabade ba chen po'i klong //thig le hūṃ yig e sngon 'od 'bar ba//zung 'jug bde stong sgyu ma'i gar mkhan can//mkha' spyod he ru ka dpal grong khyer du//tshad med rnam bzhi'i lha mos yongs bskul bas//chu las rlabs bzhin gzugs kyi skur bzhengs te//dag pa'i 'khor la 219ba〉zhus 'khor bskor bar bskul//gangs can gdul dka'i zhing la smin grol lam//ston pa'i tha ma'i 'dzad pa deng bstan kyang //byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mtha' klas pa//rjes 'dzin 'phrin las 'jug sgor thugs bskyed mdzod//nyer bzhi'i ḍā gi baṃ yig rnal 'byor mar//gcig 'dus gsal stong rdo rje btsun mo'i dbyings//'byams su ma klas bzhin lag rnam pa yi//rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i gtso bor bzheng du gsol//gnas lugs rang ngo 'phrod pa'i sems nyid dang //dpal ldan bla ma dam pa he ru daḥ/rdo rje phag mo dngos po ro gcig par//lhu/ par skyong ba'i rnal lhor 'di lo byung //don dam

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 6)chu zil lta bur dbye ba'i skabs//bral yang kun rdzob bsod nams rgya mtsho'i zhing //khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i skur bzhengs nas thugs rje'i 'jug pa dus las yol med shog/chos rje bu ston tshar chen yab sras kyi//zab rgyas chos kyi mtho ris chu bo'i rgyun//rje bas skal ldan shing rtas nyer drangasapa//thub bstan rgya mtsho gnas par chad med shog/lcag bya hor zla brgyad par chos 'khor rgyal gyi mgon khang tshor mchod gtor bzabs rgyas 'bul bar mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab ba kho sna bsas 'a dang chos srung r+yā snya shal phul ba'i kha yig dpag bas gasnye ma//yid dga' cho jigs shal g.yas gos kug 'dzin 'chi med dga' ba'i tshal//dag pa'i zhing gi pho brang cher bzhugs kyang //'jig rten spyi 220na skong khyad par 'dzam gling 'gror//byams brtses rtag gzigs 'phagasamachog ma pham mgon//phyin drug rlabs chen spyod pa'i reg bya yis//yid srubs snying la tsher rnon ltar rtsub pa//ris med lus can yongs la nyer 'jam pa//sgo gsum sim pa'i tshor ba 'di med byung //lha min gdon gyi spyo chus snying brlams pa//bsam sbyor rtsub mo'i rna zhags ring rkyong bar//dran 'dzin thugs rje'i lcags kyus lus ngag yid//dul ba'i ra bar 'jug pa'i mthu dpung skyed//sgo gsum 'dzim mar mi dga'i gar bsgyur nas//dal 'byor stong zad mthar khrid dkar min 'bras//lnga bsto yid can spyi dang bye brag tu//rgya sto bod kyi skye rgu'i gdung ba sol//khyad par 'jam mgon blo bzang grags pa yi//bshad sgrub bstan pa bla nas blar 'phel ba'i pha mtha' 'ching la nam mkha'i ska rags ma//thungs pas tshangs pa oṃ yig zol bsten shog/lugs gnyis skyong la rmonges pa'i mun sangs shing //rnam dpyod nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rab rgyas pa//legs byas rtsibs stong 'khor lo rgya mtsho yi//gos can kun la yongs su 'khor bar shog/dga' ldan gnas nas ring bor brkyang ba'i phyag/sor mos gtor ba'i me rtag man+ta ra//nor 'dzin yongs la khyab pa'i bkra shis kyi//'jig rten gsum du kun dga'i rtse 'jor shog/snya sha bon gos dmar yug gzod ma nyid nas thugs bskyed sa bon tshogs//g.yin phan 'ba' zhig bsgrub 4220ba lnga'i chus brlan pas//chos gzugs ljon

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (21)shing rgyas pa'i grib bsil du/ /'gro kun ngal gsor 'dzad pa byams mgon kye/ /zhe snang me lces rang rgyud shing bsreg dang / /chabs cig chags gdung rngul chu'i rlabs 'khrug pa/ /mi srid 'gal ba'i nad brgya drungs 'byin par/ /mchog gi sman pa chen po khyod gzhan su/ /khams gsum zo chun ltar 'khor lam ring po/ khung zad ngal gso med rgyu 'khrul sems can/ /mtha' bral ma rgan nyam thag sdug bsngal gyis/ /mnar las skyob shig mgon khyod snyan du gsol/ /de phyir rang byas gzhan 'gebasabaston min yang / /chus khyer ra mda' 'bod ltar yus gtam la/ /bu gcig ma bzhin byams pa mgon po yis/ /dbugs dbyung bde skyid gnas su deng lung ston/ /gces 'dzin sgrog las grol min rang 'dod kyis/ /bod 'dir nad rims yib rtsod mu ge sogs/ /zhi ba'i smon don 'grub nasardzogs ldan dus/ /gsar pa'i nyi dkyil dgung nas wor bar shog /rnam dag thub bstan dka' thub 'jig pa'i gdon/ /phyogs lhung drag po'i dga' rab dbang phyug lus/ /mchog gsum bden tshig gtsug na zla ba'i mig /dmar zlum las spar zhugs kyis sreg par shog /byang chub yongs bsngosadage ba'i du kū lar/ /spyad kyang 'dzad med gos bzang bsod nams lhas/ /nge gro bzhin skyes kyi skal ba dang / /bdag sogs yid can mtha' dag mnyam par shog /rwa rtse srid rtser gdengs pas(221na sko ོ rnams mgon kho r+ṣa mo/ go dud kha/ /zhabs 'degs 'bangs gyur dpal ldan dus dgra'i dbang / /las kyi gshin rje 'chi bdag nag po'i gzugs/ /myur mdzad mgon po 'di phyi bar do'i skyabs/ /phun tsho gos 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs rnam thos sras/ /srid pa'i rgyal mo 'dod pa khams kyi bdag /legs ldan nag po dpa' bo bram ze'i gzugs/ /beg tse lcam dral chos srung rgya mtsho yis /gangs can bstan 'gro'i bde skyid yongs spel nyid / /mi dbang sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i tshe dpal stobs//bsod nams mnga' thang ngal bsos bur 'gran pa'i/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /rdo sku le 'bar ma/ ye bde sra mkhregs rdo bar me 'bar cho 'phrul gyis/ /log 'dren dgra dpung sngon chad spel bkod ltar/ /bsam sbyor ga 'chang gzugs can gzugs med kun/ /phye mar thogs—416

sku gsung thugs rten gsar ba tshe ngas dang mchod rdzas khang bzang go dkar chag glegs bam gsum pa/ 'dashig gzi ldan dbang phyug kye//mgon po kos ma/wo ne phyar ba tsam gyis log 'dren g.yul ngo sa/chas rnams nad yams nad zhabrug gis 'phung ba'i//byed po legs ldan nag po rten 'di la//bzhugs nas dgon gnas sdodang bcas pa srungs//tshe bdag/wo bde 'jam dpal rdo rje srid gsum za ba'i zhal//gar dgu'i nyams kyis rol ba'i gzi byin gyis//'khor 'das phyag rgya mtha' dag zil mnan te//ban bon byad rbod rang gshed rang la phob/rtsi co khang /ling dmar rim 22ba tha dun sa 'og gshin rje'i grong khyer na//gnas kyang sems can yongs kyi ltag pa sa/gdod nas shar ba bhe wa satwa yi//rnon po mche bas log 'dren don snying phug/me rlung zhakhrug pa'i lta sto sgo tso dbusan mon pa nag/stag chen smyon par 'on te phyogs mtshams kun//myul nas dgra sha drod rlangs ma yal bar//chem chem zhal du gsol zhig legs ldan nag/mthu wo sdog/ling ljang ga chubs chen rgya ston yid khrom spyan snga sa/srog snying phul nas zab gter legs skyong bar//zhal 'tshes lha btsan bdud klu dregs pa bzhis//gnod sbyin mtha' dag rdul phran bzhin du rlog/mgon kha bar gyi dmar zor ma/kha bkro cha bon ma ston zla'i bzhin dngom tshangs sras lus phra ma//srin mo'i gzugs kyis khrag dron 'thung bzhin du//brgya phyed mgo 'phreng mgul par rgyan 'chang mas/rigs 'dzin bdag gis bcol ba'i las kun sgrubs//de rdzi khi/gos sngon ga nges pa'i don du rgyal kun yum gyur kyang //gdul dka'i gshed du dmag dang zor gyi lha//zhi rgyas dbang drag bsgrub pa'i rnam 'gyur sku//gcig pu nyid las du ma'i gar mdzad ma//bdud rtsi'i chab kyis sgrib gnyis bde gos bkrus//yid bzhin nor gyis tshe dpal bsod nams spel//lcags gyo gzas pas brtan g.yo dbang du sdus//sna tshogs mtshon chas dgra bgegs phyer 'thag mdzod//zhwa ser bstan pa rgya hor bod gsum gyi//skyabs su song ba'i gzi 222na tha rjed nyi ma'i gzis//log par 'khru ba'i me khyer 'od nyams dang //lhan cig sde dpung srid mun mthar mdzod cig/lugs gnyas khrims 'dzin sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i tshe//ring 'tsho dpal 'byor bsod nams mnga' thang 'phel//nad gdon ba/gas dang bar chad zhi ba sogs//'phrin las rnam

sto dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho gsung tshom/ ()bzhi mtha' dag lhun gyis sgrubs//yid bzhi nor dang bum bzang 'dod las ba//yongs2 sabartol de bzhi gang bsams pa'i//re ba mtha' dag stong bar 'dod khams kyi//dbang phyug srid pa'i rgyal mos mas dpung skyed//da494zhigazur/cis srid gsum za byed zhal gdangs srin tha skur//bska kyang nges pa'i don du dbyangs ro ma//mi god bus bas yid dang rna ba la//phang 'tsho sgra dbyangs rtag tu lnga sgos bar mdzod//por gto li thong mtsho skyes rdo rje'i spyan sngar pur rgyalabod//skyong bar zhal bzhes bstan ma bstoganyis dang //bye brag sgos kyi gnas srung g.ya' ma skyong //mthu rtsal skyed lams pa'i stong grogs mdzod//46pos/4lcog bang sngon lhun po gar dgu'i rnam rol bar//dus mtha'i me dpung gis klubs rdo rje gur/khrad gsum dbang sgyur dpal ldan re ma tī//rgyud gsum dregs pa spro bsdu ral snyag ma//bka' yi 'khor lis rgya mtsho'i sde dpung cas//sa gzhi bar snang g.yo ba'i cho 'phrul gyis//bstan 'gro'i 222ba〉de skyid 'phrog pa spyi yi dgra//rigs 'dzin bdag gi sgos dgra gnyer gto na//bdud kyi zhags pa nag pos ske nas chis//gnam lcags spu gri 'bar bas khog pa phye//sbar mos don snying rtsa lag drod chas can//r+yā d+ku zhal du gsol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//dpal mgon spyo/go dud kha rkang gling sgra yis gnas gsum mkha' 'gro kun//phyi nang gsang mar mgron du nyer bos nas//las bzhi'i wen las sgrubasazhes bka' bsgo bar//bram ze'i gas kyis rol gar deng 'dir sgyur//btso sbyor ga 'chang gzugs phung 'dam ltar du//brdzis pas ma mis ma che ba rnon tsho bar//d+ku d+ku za ba stobasa'aphrog nag po ches//bdud bzhi sdo bcas 'joms pa'i dus la bab//gas drag yum wo rnam bzhi'i spar mo yis//gnyer gto dgra bo'i rgyu tho phyir phyung nas//ga shar byas kyang lhag mar lusapa yi//bla srog 'gugs la khu sgras stong gsum khong //nang g.yog bas g.yo shas gi ro rkyang phyi rol sbar mthil du//nyi slar shar ba gnod sbyin yab yum sras//pu tra ming sring ru tshon sdebazhi yis//log 'dren pags tho khrag 'dzag da gyon zhi/8/min rma steng gi bskyong spyi la kha bskas bon ri rgyal

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag gleg bam gsum pa/ tanaba'i spyan sngar zhal 'tshes gsang dam las//nam yang mi g.yel legs ldan lcam dral sogs//dregs pa'i sde dpon dam can rgya mtsho yis//spyi sgos bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid spel//'phrog byed zhal 223na〉kho stong ling skya bskyin da sgo pa'i mche ba'i rtser//dgra kun mi rtag lam 'god bdud mgon che//rtag nag la zhen srid gsum gar gnas pa'i//bsam sbyor ngan 'chang khong khrag hub kyis 'thung //be gtse ling rgyal srog bdag sgrol ging srin mo gar dbang ma//las mkhan bshan pa bdud btsan gnod sbyin sogs//'jigs shing skyi g.ya' dmag gi dpung tshogs rnams//gnam lcagasathog chen 'bab 'dra'i drag shul gyis//nyi ma phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og nas//langs pa'i log 'dren zas su gtad pa rnams//lo slar ma 'jog zhag dang dus tshone la//rdul du rlog ste rjesamed rlung la skur//rig pa'i lha mo ling skya 'jon dmar phur bus snying btab ral gri yis//dum bur gtubs pa'i sha rus nang khrol rnams//dred mo mi zan gyis zos lhag med du//mdzod cig rig pa'i lha mo gdong dmar ma//rwa hu la/li ras sdong zla lha srin sdebargyad dang bcas nas//mkha' la glog ltar 'byug pas dgra bo'i yul//thog ser gyis khong mi nor sdodapung rnams//thal bar rlog cig gza' bdud rā hu la//gza' gdos nag ling ser mkha' lding la zhon stong gsum rab myul te//dgra bo'i bu ga dgu nas 'dzags pa'i khrag/drod rlangs ma yal 'thung zhig gnod sbyin dbang //bshan pa chen po gza' rgod mig dmar kye//rtsa lo rtag ba glo bha ta hor gyi yul nas gangs can gyi//chos 'khor skyong bar spyan drangs dmu yi rigs//223ba / klu tsha pe har sde lnga 'khor bcas kyis//nyin mtshan dusadrug srung skyob 'phrin las mdzod//tsi dmar ba/ling dmar khrims ldan smon lam log pa'i khrag sgong las//skyes pa'i btsan rgod 'bar ba spun bdun po/khyad par dregs pa'i dmag dpon yang le ber//'khor dang bcas pas bsams don lhun grub mdzod//rdor legs/ling: skya bkra shis byin chags snying nye dam can che//rdo rje legs pa mched 'khor sum brgya dang //drug cu'i tshogs kyis sngags 'chang bdag bcag gi/bas gdon ma lus lhun gyis/༷ par mdzod//ma mun spyo lcog gyo yo/lo glo/dgra lha

rgyal dbang lnga pa nga gdabang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()skyes gcig gsung gi rgyal bo che//bde chen ye shes 'dren mdzad pad+ma skyes//las byed rdo rje grags ldan la sogs pas//bdag cag mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa srungs//jo bo sams pa/'ge laṅka mgrin bcu'i pho brang phyi sgo yi//srung ma 'bod sgrogs smon lam rnam dag mthus//dkar phyogs skyong ba lha yi dge bsnyen gyis//legs tshogis yon tan lhun gyis grub par mdzod//rta rgod shel lcag gi dar lcog te se'i mdzes pa 'phrog pa gangs kyi rir//gnas byas gnod sbyin rta rgod shel lcag gis//bdag sogs mi nor 'khor dang bams rnams kyi//mas pa'i rkyen tso i gyis grub par mdzod//lan po49bcaralcog tengs ro dbang po 'dzin pa lag mang gis//gnod byed khrung po'i 'tshob legs bsrung zhing /khyeshing nags tshal lo rta ge la sogs pa//224na snyo tsho gos 'dod dgu rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//lcags bya zla nga ba na pa'i tshes bco brgyad nyin gsum gyi bar sde pa sangs rgya rgya mtsho'i rim gror dpal ldan lha mo'i gsang mdosagrong phe dus phul ba'i snyan dar khi byang ga bur chu sa/khyul kun yum gcig ngag dbang dbyangs can lha//srid gsum mnga' bdag 'dod khams dbang phyug ma'i//skur bstan dmag dang zor gyi rgyal mo yis//༅ byung thugs rje'i mthu dpung rab bskyed nas//sar skyong ba sangs rgyas rgya mtsho yi//nad rimasagadon bgegs dus min 'chi ba sogs//bar chad mi mas phyogs kyi mun pa rnams//byin rlabasawo byed 'od kyis sangs par mdzod//tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor mnga' thang kun//yar ngo'i zla ba ltar bur rab 'phel zhing //srid dang chos kyis bsams don ma lus pa//'bad rtsol med par lhun gyis grub par shog/mar dpon ngag dbang shes pas kyis ma skyid skyid kyi don du sa shal phul pa'i kha byang thar phe shing rta/dran pas srid zhi'i tsha gdung kun sel ba/shwakya mu ni'i thugs rje'i nyi 'od kyis//tshe 'das skyid skyid 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal spyi//bye brag ngan song mun pa mthar byas te//gnas skabs mngone mtho lha mi'i rten bzang po//brgyud mar legs thob ring min sangs rgyas kyi//snang nga mtha' yas/mi skyod rdo rje/rang byon lnga ldan/ma sgomagon po/lo ṣ+ka ra/blo yong grag pa/pad+ma spyar/go zheXng mngon gyur mkha' mnyam 'gro ba rnams//

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang mchod rdza khang bzang gi dkar chag gleg bam gsum pa/ tanatshon pa'i ded dpon r+ṣa por gyur par shog/rma g.yas mkhan pos dpal dam gzor ma/rgyal po brtse khrag pa/khas sa chos rgyal gsum la ba kha ri kya shal phulaphe kha bya dgo 4ltas ma de po 'doga'i log rdzi bsrun ya ga'i 'jigs las rnam grol ba//bden pa mngon sum bstan pa'i gtang ra gtu//brtses sa༅ lagasu go sa por zhes rdzo bsgyur/'dod khams dbang 224bamor snyan shal phul ba'i mthus//bsam pa'i don kun lhun gyis grub par shog/lcag bya sde pa sangs rgyas rgya mtshos sri gcod 'bum skor gyi dus gung thang ga smyo lar phul ba'i snya shal kha byang tshangs pa'i ge'i lo//dkar mi shig skyil krung thug 'a gcig bcas ting nge 'dzin//bzhi ldan dam bca' 'khor lo rnon po'i mar//bdud bzhi'i sgra gcan mgrin bcad lha yi lha//don kun lhun grub shākya seng ge kye//'gro khams mkhyen cha phra mos rab gzhal nas//'khor 'phrang zo chun 'byud las nyer bsgral zhan//srid zhi'i legs tshogos 'dod 'jo gtong ba'i sgo//brgya phrag 'byed par bdag byin brlab tu gsol//spyo si po tsho rtse thung ma skad cig bskal par bsgyur nus spang rtogs kyi//yon to rtse mor phyin kyang dman tsho ngor//gnas lugs shākya'i bstan 'dzin dge sbyong tso//'dzin mdzad 'gro mgon brtson 'i 'grus grags pa zhabs//thugs rje kun la khyab 'jug 'phrul po ches//srid pa'i legs byasasaman+ta ga'i nor//mngon sum stsal nas yid grubs sder bcas las//rnam par rgyal te ru ma' bsgreng par shog/zur kun mkhyen ོ pho dngul gdung /ser chos kun ka dag dbyings nas snang bzhi'i mkhar//rang grol rdo rje snying po 'du ma byas//mi shigs rig rtsal kun bzang sgyu ma'i 'phrul//gdan gsum tshang ba'i rdo rje'i slob dpon gzugs//deng nas srid mtha' mi mdzo de srid du//dmigs med thugs rje'i 225na skogs kyus nyer bzung ste//mi 'dzad chos dkar brgya byin gtsug gi nor//bdag sogs skye rgu'i lus la reg par shog/'khor lo'i phyag pha pa dra ba sdom pa bcom ldan 'das//phyi nang gsang ba'i bya rog mtshan rtags can//rdo rje srin po ma mgon phyag bzhi pa//lcam dral dam can rgya mtsho'i tsho gis rnams kyis//gangs can bstan ༷gro'i phan bde spel ba dang //bdag sogs mi nor

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()'khor dang bcas pa yi//mi bsrun dgra bgegs 'tshe ba kun zhi zhing //las bzhi'i 'phrin lasamatha' dag lhun grub mdzod//gung thang lha mo me rlung las mar 'khyil ba'i dbus nyid na//gas drag rngams pa'i zhal gdangs srin mo'i gzugs//stong gsum skad cig myul ba'i pahrūl can//ma srin dregs pa'i gtso mo re ma tī//kha bas bskor ba'i ru bzhi'i rgyal khams 'dir//mi nad phyugasand dus kyi 'khrug pa kun//ming gi lhag mar byas nas sgo gsum la//sim pa'i tshor ba rtag tu myong bar mdzod//pad+ma'i yang dgon rgya go po rigs las dgra lha skyes gcig pu//dga' bzhi'i bde ster mdzes byed pad+ma skyes//rdo rje grags ldan snang srid dregs pa yi//dmag gi kha lo sgyur ba'i rdo tshil can//mngon sum bag la zha ba dgra bgegs kyi//glags blta'i dra ba mtha' dag mthu stobs mtsho ni//mi bzad spu grirnon pos nyer gtubs nas//bde skyid spyod yul 225ba〉ngas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//rnga 'a zhes pa chu khyi lo gsar gyi dus 'dod khams dbang phyug mar snya shal phul ba'i kha byang yid bsto dbang rgyal//dkar/sgrib gnyis des bskyed lusang ga yid mnar dri//'khyud byed mtho ris sman gyi chu klung gis//bdag sogs sgo gsum rdul bral ston zla ltar//rab dngas bde skyid 'dod pa 'jo bar mdzod//snernam thos bu yi legs byas mthud pa la la//'gran nus rin wo dbang gi rgyal po'i char//nyer phab bsod nams nyi ma stong gi gzi//rab 'bar 'od shus phyogs kun khyab par mdzod//dmar 'jam mnyen lcags kyus yid kyi brtan pa kun//phyogs pas lus can yongs kyi gtsug tor rtser //rkang sen zla tshes cha gang srid zhi la//dbang phyug ut+pal dmar po bzhad par mdzod//mthing phrig phrig don snying khrag dron rlangs par bcas/khub gcig drangs pas bsam ga sbyor rtsub can//dgra bgegasasdedapung ming gi lhag ma sa/nyer gtong mngon spyod las kun grub par
